818.descriptionId: This small rock key will open the door of Ded Aleicar's cave. So long as you find it, of course.

819.descriptionId: Holy Swords are awarded to young warriors during their training.

822.descriptionId: The Knight Sword is an efficient and sturdy sword. Properly used, it can inflict serious damage upon your enemies.

825.descriptionId: This basic sword can usually be handled by the most cretinous of Bworks, that is to say the ones who are incapable of using a bow or a staff... Some of these geniuses even mistake the blade for the handle. The tradition in this case is for the Bwork to poke its own eyes out with its fingers... Lovely!

828.descriptionId: This bow fires its arrows so rapidly that the whistling sound travels for miles. A sound piece of advice: if you want to be discreet, equip it with a silencer.

829.descriptionId: Due to its restricted range, this bow is not very popular... Use it to weaken your enemies before finishing them off with a close-range weapon or a crafty spell.

830.descriptionId: This wand increases the bearer's intelligence.

833.descriptionId: This wand increases the bearer's Wisdom.

836.descriptionId: This ring, made of Treechnid Bark, has great powers but carries great responsibility with it. However, in spite of its value, it is said to be cursed.

837.descriptionId: These boots increase your Strength but they affect your Intelligence. They could even turn you into a Iop in case of prolonged and regular use.

841.descriptionId: This ring increases AP in exchange for some Strength, Intelligence, Agility and Chance.

842.descriptionId: This golden shell is nearly unbreakable, but if the best jewellers polish it for generations, they can use its magic properties to make amulets with exceptional powers.

843.descriptionId: This black shell is nearly unbreakable, but if the best jewellers polish it for generations, they can use its magic properties to make amulets with exceptional powers.

844.descriptionId: A cute little Dreggon will come out of this strange egg if a female Sapphire Dreggon sits on it. All the same don't try to keep it warm against you.

845.descriptionId: A cute little Dreggon will come out of this strange egg if a female Golden Dreggon sits on it. All the same don't try to keep it warm against you.

846.descriptionId: A cute little Dreggon will hatch out of this strange egg if a female Black Dreggon sits on it. All the same, don't try to keep it warm against you.

847.descriptionId: A cute little Dreggon will come out of this strange egg if a female White Dreggon sits on it. All the same don't try to keep it warm against you.

850.descriptionId: Amaknian collectors are desperate to get their fingers into this ring, though it's not worth a penny.

862.descriptionId: These sandals increase the intelligence of the wearer. They are also eternally fashionable. They are finished off with a breathable walnut sole for exquisite grip.

863.descriptionId: These boots increase the Agility of the wearer so that he can get into character as a Tofu every time he feels like making a fool of himself.

864.descriptionId: These boots increase your luck in finding powerful items such as Gobball Slobber.

867.descriptionId: Made of Dreggon remains, this splendid amulet is impressive enough to make your bravest enemies run home sobbing.

878.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to use.)
Use this scroll to increase your Baker XP.

879.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to use.)
Use this scroll to increase your Shoemaker XP.

880.descriptionId: This wool is a mixed blessing, really. Soft and light, yet quite fragile, it is simply heaven to scratch with a handful of it. On the other hand, I've seen mental hospitals full of eczema sufferers of sound mind and body who do nothing all day long but scratch, scratch, scratch themselves with this stuff.

881.descriptionId: This wool is extremely soft because it comes from a Gobbly's fleece. But be careful, it's still drenched in its scent, so stay away from Gobblies during mating season if you don't want to end up in hospital.

885.descriptionId: Even if tailors don't use it that much, this rough wool is very popular with the Enutrofs, who use it to hide their premature baldness.

886.descriptionId: The incredible suppleness of this leather makes it fit for a king, and the web-like cracks are proof of the Royal Gobball's longevity. It's the best leather in all of Amakna.

887.descriptionId: "Yes there's something you can send back to me; Gobball Boots of Gobball Leather." The dying words of the renowned minstrel Jon Lemon before he died, suffocated by the stench of a Gobball War Chief.

890.descriptionId: These boots are made of Gobball leather. Thanks to the smell they give off, breeders can approach and kill Gobblies with the greatest of ease.

894.descriptionId: These daggers were created for cutting roots and young saplings in spring time but they were soon decommissioned in favour of quite a different purpose.

898.descriptionId: These modest-looking daggers are extremely dangerous. They are easily hidden down the pants which makes them a weapon of choice for murderous eunuchs throughout the land. The words chicken and egg come to mind.

901.descriptionId: Just like mimolette, this leather becomes a dirty shade of orange with the passage of time... and the horrible smell... Uggh!

903.descriptionId: These boots gave Klime the shoemaker such agility that he was able to ride Gobballs. He died when he mistook a Jelly for a Gobball, having spent an evening drinking in the tavern.

907.descriptionId: With these boots, Hogmeiser used to chase off the only human beings he couldn't stand the sight of: children. Fortunately for them, the weight of the footwear prevented him from ever catching a single one.

910.descriptionId: These boots belonged to Hogmeiser for many years, before he actually lost them on a stupid bet with Grizmine. The moral of this story is... never gamble with an Ecaflip.

912.descriptionId: These magnificent Hogmeiser boots are finely peppered with precious stones, protecting you against magic attacks. Brouce Boulgoure himself used them to crush the Treechnid King's head many years ago, just to liven up the opening of the Trool Fair.

916.descriptionId: Silicate made this amulet on a wintry morning for a famous adventurer named Rimb Vardi, who was hunting down an old Bwork Magus. The bungling magic that followed was the root of many a natural disaster.

917.descriptionId: This brooch was made one autumn morning in the depths of a Beech and Elm forest, near the Olag-Lacustre Island. It is considered to be a true relic by a great many lumberjacks.

918.descriptionId: This amber comes from an Ancestral Treechnid and is priceless. It can confer magic properties on some items, provided they are made by skilled hands.

919.descriptionId: These powerful daggers, forged from Ancestral Amber according to ancient techniques, were used during the colonization of Moon Island. It soon became wild again.

923.descriptionId: This battle axe was forged by Kademlia Boulgoure to fight against the most terrifying Treechnids. Legend has it that this legendary weapon killed more Treechnids in a night than there are trees in Amakna.

926.descriptionId: This wood was bewitched by a Treechnid Magus to give birth to a tiny Treechnid once put into water. This wood is obviously extremely magical.

927.descriptionId: This battle-axe was forged by Kademlia Boulgoure to fight against the Ancestral Treechnid. Only the best warriors can handle it.

928.descriptionId: Ogralimde was a great warrior who derived his strength from his master Adyol, an exceptionally intelligent and powerful Bwork Magus. This apprentice never surpassed his master.

929.descriptionId: This magic stone with a particular name is not suitable for general public as it can give great powers to weapons and jewels.

930.descriptionId:
This map reveals the location of the Dark Miners' Treasure Chest: 
"The chest may be found on an island. You'll have to pass behind a foundry to lay your hands on it."

931.descriptionId:
This map reveals the location of the Dark Bakers chest: 
"The chest may be found on an island south of Amakna; you have to walk behind rocks, between two small ponds."

938.descriptionId: This map reveals the location of the Dark Smiths' treasure chest.

939.descriptionId: This map indicates the location of the Bworks' treasure chest: "The chest may be found in a dead end, in the South-East of the Dark Forest. It will certainly be kept by a group of Bworks."

940.descriptionId: The Farter protects you from physical damage.

941.descriptionId: The Komintot increases the Wisdom of the wearer.

948.descriptionId: This magnificent cloak is a clever mix of Treechnid essence and nice familial Gobball.

951.descriptionId: This needle and thread will help you on your way to becoming a great tailor.

952.descriptionId: This cloak was made of hairs and other organic elements taken from Boowolves. I can smell its power from here.

953.descriptionId: With this handmade cloak of Tofu feathers, you will be able to run faster and escape from tackle zones with the grace of a shotgun-blasted pigeon.

954.descriptionId: The legendary Poak Cloak was specially embroidered for warriors who live for close combat situations.

955.descriptionId: Hairdressers use the Cape Hillary to tie up their hair. Will you?

956.descriptionId: This cloak increases your range, allowing distant targets to be attacked... or naive adventurers to be dumbfounded into unsuspecting admiration. Haha!

957.descriptionId: The Gobb increases damage and Vitality, but it gives off a nasty odour, too. Don't be surprised if the Gobballs think you're one of the gang.

958.descriptionId: This cloak is certainly one of the most powerful of its kind in the World. It increases all the characteristics of its wearer.

960.descriptionId: This potion is a cure for myxomawosis. A sip of it and you will be able to visit the Wabbit Islands safely.

961.descriptionId: An old Lenald key recycled by the Wabbits. This has passed through so many paws over the years, it'd be a shame to break it now!

962.descriptionId: This key hasn't been nibbled to pieces yet. Use it well.

963.descriptionId: This key is already quite nibbled, but you've got the most important part of it. Here's hoping you don't get peckish too!

965.descriptionId: This stone comes from the Dopple World. It's highly-prized by some inhabitants of Amakna.

967.descriptionId: This magnificent cloak increases AP, as well as Vitality and Wisdom.

969.descriptionId: This magnificent Crown once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit.

970.descriptionId: This staff once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit.

971.descriptionId: This cloak once belonged to the notorious Wa Wabbit. It is still imbued with his perspiration which will bring back a few memories of the amazing fight every time you put it on.

972.descriptionId: If a dragon really did lay this egg, then she must have been a right sweetheart. Especially since its main purpose seems to be to attract adventurers to the Wa Wabbit's island so he can nick all their garb and gear before humiliating them. All in all, it's quite a good way to obtain the latest sets without having to leave the house.

973.descriptionId: A very thin but very hairy Leg. The best alchemists manage to create powerful poisons with the juice extracted from these legs.

974.descriptionId: He had it coming: the distressed farmer lost his head...

975.descriptionId: This very pointy fang belonged to a vampire. If you wear it around your neck, or even if you simply carry it in your inventory... you'll be able to show it to your buddies. Sorry, were you expecting more?

976.descriptionId: A distinctive feature of the Pumpkwin is that it prevents the dispersion of magic particles, making it a good magic insulator. That's why some warriors use this vegetable as headgear.

989.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will restore 100 energy points.

990.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will restore 70 energy points.

991.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will restore 200 energy points.

992.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will restore 50 energy points.

993.descriptionId: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this minty jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

994.descriptionId: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this strawberry jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

995.descriptionId: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this blue jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

996.descriptionId: Multijely was banned after children started disappearing soon after eating it. Not long after, they realised the kids were just going to the shop to get more.

997.descriptionId: Round as a cannonball, the Kokokonut also has 3 holes, which makes it very easy to throw away.

998.descriptionId: Captain Pirate's shorts are the proof that ridicule has actually killed someone. But apparently, they are also very lucky.

999.descriptionId: This large piece of canvas is slimy and smelly but yet of quite good quality. Too bad it has so many holes!

1000.descriptionId: This big barrel was emptied a long time ago, nevertheless we can still guess what it used to contain: rum, kamas, drunken pirates. Basically anything you can find in a barrel besides water.

1001.descriptionId: What will you do with this plank? Build a boat? Lay a floor in your house? Do you really care? Whatever, it's just a simple plank for the moment.

1002.descriptionId: Kokokonut palm trunks are similar to other trunks: straight and strong, yet they are slightly thinner than the average.

1003.descriptionId: A solid wood beam. Don't poke it into someone's eye.

1004.descriptionId: No self-respecting adventurer would go without such a Rope in his inventory. You should be advised to do the same, although it's a piece of advice seldom taken!

1005.descriptionId: A receipt signed by Kib Rock telling you your raft will be ready soon.

1006.descriptionId: Large brim, the insignia of death embroidered on, fur to make it nice...This pirate hat is a classic of its kind among captains.

1007.descriptionId: Essential accessory for unlucky pirates, this hook can be used as a hand. Its colour gives it a classy style...

1008.descriptionId: People say that this Jaw necklace was created when a captain caught one of his sailors smiling at him.

1009.descriptionId: This headband-sporting skull proves that even a dead pirate can hide his baldness.

1010.descriptionId: The carapace of a mad turtle that thinks it's a ninja.

1011.descriptionId: The carapace of a mad turtle that probably ingested too many dangerous substances.

1012.descriptionId: The carapace of a mad turtle that liked tomatoes and cheese on a warm slice of bread.

1013.descriptionId: The carapace of a mad turtle who wanted to imitate Zowwo, the Masked Fox.

1014.descriptionId: This mask, belonging to Cheerful Kanniball, has been made in the image of Greenery, the element of meat seasoning.

1015.descriptionId: This mask, belonging to Whining Kanniball, has been made in the image of Lightning, the element of surprised young flesh.

1016.descriptionId: This mask, belonging to Irascible Kanniball, has been made in the image of Fire, the element of roasting meat.

1017.descriptionId: This mask, belonging to Surprised Kanniball, has been made in the image of Water, the element of slaking thirst between two mouthfuls of meat.

1018.descriptionId: This pot of pink jelly might smell good... But you must never taste it or you won't ever speak again. It's an excellent fixative.

1019.descriptionId: Wearing this hat creates a very special look, halfway between ridiculous and comical.

1021.descriptionId: For those who have always dreamt of flying like a Kwak, go back to bed because these wings will turn you into a public menace and an idiot.

1023.descriptionId: The label says '10 year old rum' but it is quite impossible to check if it tells the truth. Don't drink it excessively on the road for fear of seasickness.

1027.descriptionId: One day, the infamously crazy T. Bun Stek found two strange yet impressive knives... No one could figure out what they were for. He used the very same knives to sacrifice half his livestock to the Gods and soon after they bellowed the answer from the heave's. He was slaughtering a particularly noisy cow at that very moment... The poor guy didn't hear a word.

1030.descriptionId: This pair of daggers is in fact a magic game. Designed to entertain young Ecaflips, it was taken off the market when a visiting Sram decided to join. She was only a child... Shame on you... shame on us all.

1031.descriptionId: These magnificent daggers once belonged to the cruellest Sramette Amakna ever saw. Well, one of the most cruel. Actually, she was just a tiny bit more cruel than the others. No, I'm exaggerating there. She wasn't quite as cruel as the others. That's still quite an achievement though.

1033.descriptionId: This dagger was originally used by the secret brotherhood of Rowler. This guild wanted to plunge Amakna into chaos. They finally disappeared when the island where they hid and schemed was submerged by the waves.

1039.descriptionId: These Sram daggers are beguilingly shaped, leading one to wonder whether they're daggers at all. When the piercing truth is revealed, it is often too late.

1040.descriptionId: Ortimus Contrari is a legendary assassin. If I told you how he carried out his contracts... you'd want to kill yourself even before he got to you.

1041.descriptionId: The legends tell of a famous Iop who left his island home and travelled across the sea to find work as an interpreter for the Kings of Amakna. He took to the job full of hope, enthusiasm and diligence, dazzling Ecaflips and Fecas alike with his vibrant wordplay and passion for good grammar. Unfortunately, on his way to the castle, he stumbled over a rock that turned out to be a Mega Crackler, and this broken sword was the only trace they found of him, or his equipment.

1043.descriptionId: This shovel is made of a very rare wood. According to the legend, young girls fall into an eternal sleep when they touch this weapon. Note that in case of repeated contact, valiant heroes can also be affected.

1047.descriptionId: What can be better than an eco-friendly shovel to clear your garden of weeds? This shovel is THE best way of getting rid of daisies. It's also great to feed them to your enemies.

1053.descriptionId: The Woukuis family forged this shovel during the war between the Elle-Poma and the Touge-Woukuis. The one problem is that it covers your hands with grease. It's also very popular with unmarried warriors who spend a lot of time alone. Dunno why.

1054.descriptionId: Half trowel and half shovel, the Trovel went out of fashion with builders and was remarketed as a weapon. Easy to handle and to put away thanks to its size, it's the ideal accessory for any Enutrof that's fond of a drink.

1056.descriptionId: These ghastly shovels are hand-crafted by the islanders of Koutoulou who use whatever materials come to hand to make them. Useless for digging holes, their main purpose is to ward off imaginary spirits and naughty children.

1059.descriptionId: This shovel is much favoured by the potato farmers of the region. It can be used for all kinds of crops however.

1061.descriptionId: A weapon created by Dha, this aerodynamic mace hurts the very air as it cleaves through and splits your enemies skulls open... Are you convinced yet?

1065.descriptionId: Rumour has it that this hammer is one of a kind, handmade by the ancient Xelor Smiths. Some people are convinced it is a copy, only carrying a convincing forgery of the Xelor rune... Go find out for yourself, hit someone over the head with it!

1069.descriptionId: Before being struck by lightning for the last time, the creator of this mace truly thought it would allow him forecast the weather. Much later, it was discovered that the tool was better at giving than taking blows.

1073.descriptionId: According to the legend, Outar Great Bwork ordered these fearsome hammers from a village of Xelors with the promise of sparing the townspeople if the hammers were well made. When he received the hammers, he destroyed the village. He needed to try his new weapons after all.

1075.descriptionId: According to the legend, Outar Great Bwork ordered these fearsome hammers from a village of Xelors with the promise of sparing the townspeople if the hammers were well made. When he received the hammers, he destroyed the village. He needed to try his new weapons after all.

1077.descriptionId: This mace is the sole heritage left by the pacific Aj Taye tribe. Roll it on aching muscles and the pain will disappear. Big bullies will tell you it's quite good at making pain appear as well.

1079.descriptionId: This mace is the sole heritage left by the pacific Aj Taye tribe. Roll it on aching muscles and the pain will disappear. Big bullies will tell you it's quite good at making pain appear as well.

1083.descriptionId: This hammer is so ridiculous that your enemy will laugh his head off. This should give you just enough time to beat it off with the very same hammer... Is that ironic?

1084.descriptionId: With this fearsome Hammer you will be able to prove the popular belief that muscles are more important than intelligence. This logic only works for people who are weaker than you, however. As we say ourselves... Strong is... never wrong.

1085.descriptionId: Falistos are Xelor demons. They betrayed their old principles and increased their strength by forging more and more powerful hammers. After spreading chaos across the land, they were defeated and banished underground. But some of the weapons they forged remained intact.

1086.descriptionId: You can paint anything with this can of paint: your house, your Tofu pet, your friends or even yourself...

1088.descriptionId: This mask is the faithful replica, only a bit bigger, of the ones proudly worn by important Kanniballs.

1089.descriptionId:
Destination: Heavenly Island
Cost: 1,000 kamas
Ticket: One-way

1090.descriptionId:
You'll have the perfect hairdo with the Astrowig. That's something at least!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

1091.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Ecaflip spell Heads or Tails.

1093.descriptionId: This bow is specifically designed to hunt birds. Light and easy to handle, you'll be able to sneak up on an eagle.

1097.descriptionId: "With a Gobball, no waste at all!" Such was the motto of a visionary shopkeeper who specialised in recycling gobball carcasses. This bow is one of his finest products – not for aesthetic reasons, but simply because it's a fearsome weapon.

1102.descriptionId: The Eniripsa Mie Dopan made this series of sharpened wands to fight against the rising level of burglaries in the area. It can travel through time and nip any aggression in the bud. They often appear in hospitals, disguised as nurses asking stuff like, 'Have you seen so and so... well, he hasn't been born yet. Yeah a real nasty character.'

1107.descriptionId: This heavy Wand shattered more than one soul's skull. Iop priests use it to send repentant sinners to heaven with a bang.

1110.descriptionId: This staff is a replica of a legendary artefact, but with slightly lesser powers. It sends out light if it falls on the ground and it can distort your voice to any pitch you desire. The latter feature is useful for luring enemies into mortal traps... just don't try to kill them with it when they fall for your trick.

1116.descriptionId: A type of bow only made in the far North of Amakna, the I Kea Bow is a cheap, conveniently flat-packed weapon. Its effectiveness will strongly depend on the owner's ability to follow poorly translated instruction manuals.

1118.descriptionId: The instructions for the making of this 100% biodegradable bow have been found in the ruins of Din by an adventurer apparently renowned for his mastery of the whip. I never trusted those Greenies... Many die each year in passionate and misguided embraces with sleeping Treechnids.

1122.descriptionId: Take an old worn bow, dust it with magical cure, ask a dragon to blow on it and you'll have an enchanted bow. Be careful however, theorising with fairy recipes is all very well, but in practice, dragons take a malicious pleasure in blowing on everything but the bow.

1128.descriptionId: This unconventional bow has been created for the self-proclaimed king of a village of lowly peasants, who liked to show off by shooting two arrows at once.

1129.descriptionId: This sapphire shell is nearly unbreakable, but if the best jewellers polish it for generations, they can use its magic properties to make amulets with exceptional powers.

1130.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Ecaflip spell Perception.

1132.descriptionId: It's the symbol of purity and stupidity. Just like its creator who nevertheless gave it tremendous magic powers.

1134.descriptionId: This stick was the key to the emancipation of the Eniripsa housewives: a fearsome weapon against both monsters and hard-to-reach dust.

1138.descriptionId: Houvette invented these wands to claim back her Enutrof husband from the liquid grip of the bar where he spent his evenings. She also used them to spice up their relationship, but nobody knows exactly how.

1141.descriptionId: A distinctive feature of this feather is that it resists falling rocks. That's why Earth Kwaks are never buried by landslides.

1146.descriptionId: According to the tag, this wand has the power to make people obey whoever is holding it. The instructions say you have to shake it rapidly near your adversary. If it doesn't work, try and poke him in the eye with it.

1149.descriptionId: Most young Fecas have a staff quite similar to this one. It's gone beyond a trend now, and has become a ritual of sorts. Has no one ever told them how ridiculous they look?

1153.descriptionId: A short-sighted, grumbling, fortune telling, smelly old Feca accidentally created this powerful weapon when her staff rammed into her crystal ball as she slipped from the kitchen table. She'd read her own fortune long before and, well, she more or less lived on that table... wonder what it was she thought was going to kill her... well, I guess she wasn't the best fortune teller.

1163.descriptionId: The success of the Wa Wabbit Staff lead to the creation of a host of cheap copies. Today, there are far more fakes than originals.

1324.descriptionId: This plant will make the mouth of an Ecaflip water.

1325.descriptionId: Naturally resistant to all kind of aggressions, this shell symbolises the Feca ideology.

1326.descriptionId: This resistant and sharpened stone has apparently been used against something or someone. It is a raw and dangerous item which perfectly illustrates the characteristics of a Iop.

1327.descriptionId: It's a fearsome and gloomy item. Once worked it's as dangerous as a Sram.

1328.descriptionId: A Tofu head with a strange Tofu hat on decorates this kama.

1329.descriptionId: With its flexible and curvilinear shape, this big wooden branch makes you immediately think of Cras.

1330.descriptionId: It is an original creation of the silversmith John-Lay Nonne, and now one of the most sought after jewels on the continent.

1331.descriptionId: Oly was a female Iop with only one ability - cooking. It is said that Iop himself gave her this medal in order to compensate for her weaknesses in battle. Only pure-hearted people can wear it.

1332.descriptionId: Four-leaf clovers are rarer than five-leaf ones. So when you find one, you should rub it dry between two spell scrolls.

1333.descriptionId: This warming potion contains feeble fire magic, and can be used to weakly enchant all sorts of items.

1334.descriptionId: This little pouch of sulphur gives off an unbearable smell. The same smell as an Osamodas, come to think of it.

1335.descriptionId: This rippling potion contains feeble water magic, and can be used to weakly enchant all sorts of items.

1336.descriptionId: Rapidly rubbing this plant on your skin will make you suffer torture but the stimulation produces beneficial effects... well, that's what Sacriers say at least.

1337.descriptionId: This sighing potion contains feeble air magic, and can be used to weakly enchant all sorts of items.

1338.descriptionId: This vibrating potion contains feeble earth magic, and can be used to weakly enchant all sorts of items.

1339.descriptionId: Bluebells are very small, delicate and attractive. On top of that, some say they have the power to calm down spirits and cure some illnesses. They were probably created by a divinity who wanted a plant in the image of the Eniripsas.

1340.descriptionId: This trembling potion contains earth magic, and can be used to enchant all sorts of items.

1341.descriptionId: This undulating potion contains water magic, and can be used to enchant all sorts of items.

1342.descriptionId: This whistling potion contains air magic, and can be used to enchant all sorts of items.

1343.descriptionId: This crackling potion contains fire magic, and can be used to enchant all sorts of items.

1344.descriptionId: This special plant helps people go to sleep. It must be the emblem of Sadida.

1345.descriptionId: This fulminating potion contains strong fire magic, and can be used to powerfully enchant all sorts of items.

1346.descriptionId: This flooding potion contains strong water magic, and can be used to powerfully enchant all sorts of items.

1347.descriptionId: This howling potion contains strong air magic, and can be used to powerfully enchant all sorts of items.

1348.descriptionId: This bone-shaking potion contains strong earth magic, and can be used to powerfully enchant all sorts of items.

1350.descriptionId: This bow was created by a wizard who was fond of his cider. In order to ease his crippling hangovers, he invented this water-type bow.

1351.descriptionId: As the saying goes "With a bow, it's make or break". Wise men avoid this bow. The rumour is it has the evil eye.

1352.descriptionId: This bow carries the forces of earth and water. Woe betide him who cannot control at least one of the two.

1353.descriptionId:
All the pulleys of this bow were sawn off. It used to be a symbol of the conflict between Good and Evil.
Touch it and you'll feel the supreme justice of the ancient lawmakers running through your fingertips.

1354.descriptionId: Hick was an cursed Cra: he couldn't stop hiccupping. One day he threw his bow into the fire and decided to use a sword instead. The curse strangely disappeared at that exact moment.

1355.descriptionId: The man who created this bow, a certain Marc Hidsad, never really knew how to use it. He usually hurt himself just as much as his enemies.

1356.descriptionId: Rika Zarouil The Female Baker was renowned for having been the smallest Eniripsa in the whole World of Amakna. She made her loaves in small cardboard furnaces and used this old bread to impale many a hero.

1357.descriptionId: A mischievous sculptor tried to make people think his wands were daggers, calling them Wangers at first, and then simply Wangs. His plan didn't work, but his wands most definitely do.

1359.descriptionId: The origins of this wand remain quite obscure. I can tell you that it's great for finding parking on a rainy Monday in Amakna town... Just points in the direction you need to go... It does one-way streets and everything!

1360.descriptionId: This wand was created many years ago in the forging flames of Dyin Ard. You'd be well-advised to have a bucket of water at hand just to keep control of the mini-inferno.

1361.descriptionId: The Sylvian Wand gives you sharp sight. You'll probably use it for picking out a good escape route.

1362.descriptionId: The vampiric stake is, in fact, the wand of a vampire who retired long ago from social life and slaughtering. This strange piece of wood has nevertheless inherited a few qualities from its former master...

1363.descriptionId: On top of its unbearable name, this staff has many ways to get on its owner's nerves.

1364.descriptionId: This staff will help its owner forget about their worries and their strife. Unfortunately, it sometimes causes them to lose some of their memory and become subject to frequent lapses in concentration. Reserved for sages only.

1365.descriptionId: They say it was this staff that made a fearsome warrior of Heds; they say it was magic and could shoot fire. Ever heard of All Bran? Eight bowls of this stuff a day and you'd be shooting fire too, buddy.

1366.descriptionId: This staff is commonly used by gobbherds during the trading season to fend off the Bworks, who like to snack on the Gobball herds around this time. The prized dish is the gobbherd himself.

1367.descriptionId: This staff once belonged to the beautiful Dina Mite, renowned for her explosive voice. In her day, she was a cracker too.

1368.descriptionId: Apparently, this staff belonged to one of the 110 Amaknian firefighters it took to put out the fire started deliberately by the reckless Red Wyrmling. There were definite signs of arson about.

1369.descriptionId: These knives have been specially conceived to be used in luxury restaurants. However, because of their rather strange appearance, the owner decided to resell them to a travelling knife thrower.

1370.descriptionId: The hilt of this weapon is greasy and slippery but it really does look fab.

1371.descriptionId: Eulasse was a gobbherd in Amakna who one day found these dirty daggers in the Gobball dung heap. Be careful with them, the hilts are still a bit slippery...

1372.descriptionId: Otof'Mai'We was a hermit, a legendary disciple of Sram, who spent his life avoiding all sorts of contact with others. When he died, his favourite daggers were found next to his body. Only the nimblest of men can control them.

1373.descriptionId: Any Enutrof worthy of the name has a beard and old Krys Nosheive was no exception. One day his wife, Mrs Nosheive, bought him a razor, and he decided he would rather use it as a weapon.

1374.descriptionId: Penn was an ancient scribe of Amakna... centuries ago. He had the strange habit of carving stone using daggers instead of chisels. These magnificent and resistant daggers belonged to him.

1375.descriptionId: Terophyle the Iop was capable of lifting enormous stones... It's not really proof of intelligence to you or I, but a Iop who can capture the idea of picking up something round is already a king among his people.

1376.descriptionId: This axe might be heavy, but it will take down Trools in a flash. The magic runes it contains can also burn enemies.

1377.descriptionId: Hure was a young priest who used weapons freely to spread the word of God. His favourite weapon was an axe on which he inscribed numerous meaningful quotations. His final blows were always accompanied by a blood-curdling supplications, which ended, each word like a hot pin in the victim's ear, with the phrase "And, you will know my name is The Lord when I lay my vengeance upon thee!"

1378.descriptionId: Created for young, bloodthirsty warriors, this battle axe makes a deafening noise when it strikes another weapon.

1380.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Curative Word.

1381.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Wounding Word.

1382.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Draining Word.

1383.descriptionId: It took many, many years and many, many smiths to forge this hammer. The result is a magnificent weapon which has unfortunately inherited a particular concept of efficiency from its creators.

1384.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Healing Word.

1392.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Word of Youth.

1393.descriptionId: This Hammer was made from a clock, the famous clock swallowed by the Crocodyl when it devoured the hand of Captain Hawkfish. Though the clock has been located, the hand is still missing. Hawkfish's hand that is... the clock was in surprisingly good... oh, forget it.

1394.descriptionId: This potion lets you unlearn one level of the Eniripsa spell: Vampiric Word.

1395.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Word of Sacrifice.

1396.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Friendship Word.

1397.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Paralysing Word.

1398.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Lifting Word.

1399.descriptionId: Just like the amulet of the same name, the Aclou Mallet can transform your vital energy into strength. To be used in moderation.

1400.descriptionId: This potion lets you unlearn one level of the Eniripsa spell: Silencing Word

1401.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Word of Altruism.

1402.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Eniripsa spell Word of Recovery.

1403.descriptionId: This hammer once belonged to Aha, a young Osamodas who wasted all his days telling painful one-liners. The hammer couldn't break open a hazelnut, but it's useful for breaking the ice from time to time.

1404.descriptionId: So you like animals? So did Toh'Lo. He devoted his whole life to helping them out. This hammer kind of represents his relationship with animals, a communion as shaky as a lame Gobball on a freshly gravelled driveway.

1405.descriptionId: The fairy water has healing properties similar to those of Eniripsa's blood. No more need to bleed the poor fellows dry.

1406.descriptionId: This potion faithfully reproduces all the properties of Unikron blood, except immortality. Drink it and you'll be cured!

1407.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Slow Down.

1408.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Rewind.

1409.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Hand.

1413.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Tesseract.

1414.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Shriveling.

1415.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Xelor's Sandglass.

1416.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Temporal Dust.

1417.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Homing Hand.

1418.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Time Theft.

1419.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Devotion.

1420.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Flight.

1421.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Loss of Motivation.

1422.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Counter.

1423.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Mummification.

1424.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Xelor's Punch.

1425.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Xelor's Dial.

1426.descriptionId: Layte, the creator of this shovel, was a devoted disciple of Iop. You can guess what this guy's major flaw was.

1427.descriptionId: This shovel is used by the Kanniball High Priests of Moon Island to invoke Zebuth, one of their gods who is often depicted as a cow. Only vile characters use it.

1428.descriptionId: This strange little plant grows in arid environments and gives off a smell of curry. It seems it can resist ageing. If only all this could be said for women.

1430.descriptionId: This shovel, created by Mechba, is used by Enutrof followers to knock nuts from trees. On the battlefield, it has a similar function. Yowza!

1432.descriptionId: Gaston Houze, gardener and disciple of Enutrof, planted too many plants. It had to be said... There, I've said it. What's more this worn spade is the evidence of his dirty business. Never talk to this thing, it'll tell you stories, don't believe a word, it'll have you digging yourself into your own grave before you know it... and then where will you be? I hate this damn thing.

1433.descriptionId: This shovel was once a self-defence weapon used by a small group of female Enutrof's followers. Once they had even this puny pile of power in their clutches, they turned into horrible crea.......

1434.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor spell Clock.

1435.descriptionId: Very heavy shovel. For fa... um, big boned adventurers.

1436.descriptionId: Ikan was Churros the Warrior's little fish. The shovel doesn't look a thing like the creature, but the smell is almost identical.

1437.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Forced Punishment.

1438.descriptionId: This pick is considered a lucky charm, although anyone depending on a pick to make their living has usually seen that boat sail a long time ago.

1439.descriptionId: This pick seems to bring the evil eye upon you. With a few alterations here and there, perhaps you could have a great pick on your hands.

1440.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Sacrier's Foot.

1441.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Bold Punishment.

1442.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Attraction.

1443.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Life Transfer.

1444.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Assault.

1445.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Nimble Punishment.

1446.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Transposition.

1447.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Dissolution.

1448.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Spiritual Punishment.

1449.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Sacrifice.

1450.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Rogue spell Detonator.

1451.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Vital Punishment.

1452.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Evasion.

1453.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Cooperation.

1454.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Sacrier spell Punishment.

1455.descriptionId: These Scaraleaf wings have magic properties and are used in the making of elementary Water potions.

1456.descriptionId: These Scaraleaf wings have magic properties and are used in the making of elementary Air potions.

1457.descriptionId: These Scaraleaf wings have magic properties and are used in the making of elementary Fire potions.

1458.descriptionId: These Scaraleaf wings have magic properties and are used in the making of elementary Earth potions.

1459.descriptionId: This tube has been specially designed to be uncorked with just one hand.

1460.descriptionId: A thoughtfully-conceived phial which can be uncorked with no hands.

1461.descriptionId: This Arachnee leg poison will send your head right into space. Both literally and figuratively seeing that, after a short period of wide-eyed cosmic clarity, your skull explodes due to the massive increase in blood pressure.

1462.descriptionId: This liquid, a blend of several bloods, has the nasty habit of catching in your throat.

1463.descriptionId: This Flask is especially designed for capturing elementary essences.

1468.descriptionId: This bowl is multipurpose! It can be used for making potions as well as for drowning fish.

1469.descriptionId: Uba Tesse has given you this parchment. He has warmly recommended that you train as an alchemist.

1470.descriptionId: You got this parchment from Uba Tesse. He highly recommends the alchemist training. There is a small note from by Boff Chalon.

1471.descriptionId: Uba Tesse gave you this parchment. He highly recommends the alchemist training. There's a small note from Boff Chalon. A flower attached to it proves you attended the first lesson.

1472.descriptionId: This scroll indicates you have finished your training as an alchemist and that you're now ready to take the exam.

1473.descriptionId: With these gloves on, you can easily and safely gather all kinds of flowers.

1474.descriptionId: This ultra-powerful amulet is the fruit of the expert time-mastery of an old Xelor.

1475.descriptionId: The Pretty Blade has been crafted by the renowned blacksmith Dave-LoL, just before he died for the sake of the prettiest girl in the kingdom, a Iop. It is said that the efficiency of the blade is only matched by the grace of the wearer.

1476.descriptionId: This powerful pendant contains the life-blood of the Crackler, that is to say all the items he gathered before he was killed by some jealous adventurer.

1477.descriptionId: Mulette was a little female Ecaflip dogged by bad luck... until her grandmother presented her with this amulet.

1478.descriptionId: This pendant will make you feel more harmonious.

1479.descriptionId: This legendary Hammer has already proved itself in Amakna. It belonged to the powerful Cardboard Twot who used it to transform his opponents into confetti and papier-mâché.

1480.descriptionId: This pendant will make you feel at peace with the World.

1481.descriptionId: This pendant will make you grant you greater understanding of the World around you.

1482.descriptionId: This is an extremely useful amulet, but it turns its wearer as white as a Gobball.

1483.descriptionId: A mysterious symbol of a mysterious organization... by the way, it doesn't exist and you've never heard of it, understand?

1485.descriptionId: This amulet is said to be a modified version of the Golden Destiny... which is really strange when you think that these two amulets have nothing in common except their ridiculous appearance.

1486.descriptionId: Holy was a female Iop, intent on spreading Evil throughout the land. Renowned for her incredible composure, she would never get angry except when people compared her to someone named Oly.

1487.descriptionId: Not only is this belt elegant, it also massages you as you walk... You'd be surprised what a back rub can do for your murderous instinct.

1488.descriptionId: This strange name refers to an equally strange item made from previous amulets... goodness knows how. We know just as little about the circumstances in which it was found.

1489.descriptionId: With this near-perfect pin, you'll have the Wisdom of an Irish salmon. It's great for group therapy sessions among friends. Don't forget to bring some tissues, though, it can get emotional!

1490.descriptionId: The creator of this chain, someone called Ken Aton, was renowned for his strange habits. He spent all his time hunting the Minotoror for his coat which he wanted to make into a merkin.

1491.descriptionId: The Liche was a dirty creature known for infiltrating the ranks of valiant warriors in order to steal food. Marmalade and toast was his favourite. But one day, the warriors saw through its little game and the Liche had to run away.

1493.descriptionId: It is said that this ring emerged out of a Sacrier's grinning, pus-stuffed wound. Niiice.

1494.descriptionId: The main function of this pretty ring was to help Osamodas recognise their Tofus during fights.

1495.descriptionId: This small modest-looking ring was created by Degun. He was more famous for shouting his head off without the slightest reason and his violent aversion to the Liche than for his talent as a jeweller.

1496.descriptionId: This ring was made to increase its wearers luck during card games.

1497.descriptionId: Rings forged during Xelor's temporal journeys.

1498.descriptionId: These rings were cooled from the forge with the tears of Enutrof, shed over his lost shovel. Must have been some shovel!

1499.descriptionId: This ring is meant for Enutrofs only. It was enchanted by their God so that the followers would be the only ones to wear it. It allows all god-fearing Enutrofs to be even luckier than usual in treasure hunts.

1500.descriptionId: Made of many different fibres, this magnificent cloak is unique - just look at that patchwork of colour and the way the light plays on its surface.

1501.descriptionId: This wedding ring will satisfy the most mercenary of fathers-in-law.

1503.descriptionId: It is said that to create this wand, it is put into a warm corpse, which is then buried shortly afterwards. No one dares to imagine by what route exactly the wand is put into the dead body.

1504.descriptionId: Billy-Ray Red Neck was renowned throughout the countryside. One day, as he was yodelling at the top of his voice, someone cut off his head, which is why he got the nickname. The dagger was found but nobody looked for the murderer... Billy-Ray was famous for singing out of tune.

1505.descriptionId: This exceptional Treechnid wood flute is ideal for entertaining and inspiring your friends.

1506.descriptionId: It's really difficult to explain what this playing card represents. It's important, though.

1507.descriptionId:
Something is written on this piece of paper:
"Congratulations! You are now the proud owner of a KeK coupon, which proves that you are a great adventurer. Come see us, we are waiting for you!"

1511.descriptionId: According to the legend describing the Dantesque fight after which he was raised to the rank of God himself, Ecaflip used a weapon made by the ancient principle: "a tail for a life". This series of swords was forged as a tribute to him.

1512.descriptionId: This book relates the story of the notorious Crocoburio.

1514.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Ecaflip spell Repercussion.

1515.descriptionId: This egg was laid by a Fire Kwak, and is about to hatch. Like the rare Antipodean Grammar Bird, Bwaks are aggressive from the word go, but what is intriguing to Amaknian ornithologists is the fact that a Fire Bwak will never attack its parents.

1516.descriptionId: This egg was laid by an Earth Kwak, and is about to hatch. Like the rare Antipodean Grammar Bird, Bwaks are aggressive from the word go, but what is intriguing to Amaknian ornithologists is the fact that an Earth Bwak will never attack its parents.

1517.descriptionId: This egg was laid by a Wind Kwak, and is about to hatch. Like the rare Antipodean Grammar Bird, Bwaks are aggressive from the word go, but what is intriguing to Amaknian ornithologists is the fact that a Wind Bwak will never attack its parents.

1518.descriptionId: This egg was laid by an Ice Kwak, and is about to hatch. Like the rare Antipodean Grammar Bird, Bwaks are aggressive from the word go, but what is intriguing to Amaknian ornithologists is the fact that a Water Bwak will never attack its parents.

1519.descriptionId: This small rune can make the sharpest blades even sharper.

1521.descriptionId: This small rune can make the oldest blades even older.

1522.descriptionId: This small rune can make the brightest weapons brighter.

1523.descriptionId: This small rune can make the most resistant weapon even more resistant.

1524.descriptionId: This small rune can make the lightest of weapons lighter.

1525.descriptionId: This small rune can make the most attractive of weapons more attractive.

1526.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny flame in its centre.

1527.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny puddle in its centre.

1528.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny heap of earth in its centre.

1529.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny breeze in its centre.

1531.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny lake in its centre.

1532.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny gust of wind in its centre.

1533.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny inferno in its centre.

1534.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny mound of earth in its centre.

1535.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny explosion in its centre.

1536.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny ocean in its centre.

1537.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny cyclone in its centre.

1538.descriptionId: This strange-looking sphere seems to contain a tiny mountain in its centre.

1542.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of dagger smith.

1543.descriptionId: This Fragment comes from the pedestal upon which the notorious Crocobur has sat for many years and will continue to sit for many more. Little by little the stone is saturated with its powerful magic.

1545.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the sharpest of blades sharper.

1546.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the oldest of blades older.

1547.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the brightest of weapons brighter.

1548.descriptionId: This powerful rune can increase an item's Vitality bonus.

1549.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the lightest of weapons lighter.

1550.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the most attractive weapons even more attractive.

1551.descriptionId: This legendary rune can make anything at all sharper than the sharpest of blades.

1552.descriptionId: This legendary rune can make anything at all older than the oldest blade.

1553.descriptionId: This legendary rune can make anything at all brighter than the brightest of blades.

1554.descriptionId: This legendary rune can make the most sturdy weapons even more resistant.

1555.descriptionId: This legendary rune can make the lightest weapons even lighter.

1556.descriptionId: This powerful rune can make the most attractive weapons even more attractive.

1557.descriptionId: This rune is so powerful that it should be hurled off the World by the gods themselves. It makes a weapon so easy to use that you can slay ten warriors while... let's see... changing a nappy, sipping a cup of tea, erecting a dry stone wall in your front yard... just about anything.

1558.descriptionId: This rune is so powerful that it should be hurled off the World by the Gods themselves. It makes weapons so much lighter and so much easier to put away that you can sit back and concentrate on the important things... although what's more important than watching your enemies getting sliced up?

1559.descriptionId: This ring is in fact an outgrowth of the Soft Oak, uprooted during a storm. It's yours now – but keep it away from its master, as he could decide to take back what's his.

1566.descriptionId: This certificate proves that Hel Munster is your mentor. You will now have to call him "Master Hel Munster".

1567.descriptionId: This book tells the legend of the Treechnid Forest.

1568.descriptionId: Use this key to get into the Gobball Dungeon. Be careful, it will self-destruct after use.

1569.descriptionId: This key will grant you access to the Blacksmith Dungeon. Be careful, it will self-destruct after use.

1570.descriptionId: This key will grant you access to the Skeleton Dungeon. Be careful though, as it will self-destruct after use.

1572.descriptionId: This book is full of advice for novice Mages. Essential reading.

1573.descriptionId: (This item apparently contains no magic whatsoever)

1574.descriptionId: This sword belonged to the late lamented Kih Besans, known as the Yench Carver. This was his main hobby... Pointless to mention that some people waste their lives.

1575.descriptionId: This rare stone will give you the influence you need to create a guild. Without it, guilds such as Miners With Attitude and the Men Who Stare at Gobs would never have come into being.

1587.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of lumberjack.

1588.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of sword smith.

1589.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of bow carver.

1590.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of hammer smith.

1591.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of shoemaker.

1592.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of jeweller.

1593.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of staff carver.

1594.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of wand carver.

1595.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of shovel smith.

1596.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of miner.

1597.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of baker.

1598.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of alchemist.

1599.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of tailor.

1600.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of farmer.

1601.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of axe smith.

1602.descriptionId: This ring allows the Dark Treechnid to be very stylish when it goes dancing. And as life is kind, there are many parties in the Dark Forest.

1612.descriptionId: This root comes from the corpse of a Dark Treechnid.

1613.descriptionId: This fragment of shell will certainly be used to make beautiful boots.

1619.descriptionId: The Treemu is an elegant amulet. If you're planning on putting it on, we advise you not to wear any other clothes, as it makes silk look like the wool off a Gobball's backside.

1620.descriptionId: This bow looks as if it were still alive and can almost shoot arrows on its own like a big boy. It could have been the perfect bow for people who are clumsy with their hands but, unfortunately, the arrow always has to be loaded the right way.

1621.descriptionId: The Skill Boots increase Agility and Intelligence to the detriment of your Strength and Chance. Contrary to what many people believe, they won't defeat your opponent for you.

1622.descriptionId: These Power Boots increase Strength and Chance to the detriment of your Intelligence and Agility. Contrary to what many people believe, they won't bring you incredible power.

1623.descriptionId: The Anticipation Boots increase Strength and Agility to the detriment of your Intelligence and Chance. Contrary to what many people believe, these boots do not enable you to anticipate your enemies' next moves.

1624.descriptionId: These boots once belonged to the great knight Nexus - the poor bugger was frozen for eternity.

1625.descriptionId: This book relates the journey of the last Human who got to meet the Cruncher.

1626.nameId: Encyclopaedia of Alchemy Appendix A: Professions
1626.descriptionId: This is an encyclopaedia of alchemy recipes that are useful for unlearning professions.

1628.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1629.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1630.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1631.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1632.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1633.descriptionId: The story of this artefact originates from a very ancient legend but its real power is yet to be revealed.

1634.descriptionId: This sphere is a perfect imitation of a metaria's insulating membrane.

1635.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Break Wind emote. Use it in moderation as it can be dangerous for you and your friends. Your enemies will want to steer clear of getting in the path of this lethal stuff.

1637.descriptionId: This sword was created by a glamorous young lady who wanted a weapon in her own image and endowed it with her own graceful beauty and passionate nature. Have a look at this piece. Magnificent.

1642.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of dagger smithmagus.

1643.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of axe smithmagus.

1644.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of hammer smithmagus.

1645.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of sword smithmagus.

1646.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of shovel smithmagus.

1647.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of Bow Carvmagus.

1648.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of Wand Carvmagus.

1649.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of Staff Carvmagus.

1651.descriptionId: This sword is absolutely perfect for attacking the defenceless. Quick, handy and above all extremely sharp, it has been banned from shops for many years now. It is tolerated only if used on Bworks.

1652.descriptionId: A very thin and very hairy Leg, formerly used in the making of exotic brooms and wigs.

1653.descriptionId: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret. You have currently learnt bravery.

1654.descriptionId: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret. Now that you have learnt bravery and communication, all that remains is to learn patience.

1655.descriptionId: You have this ring in your pocket because you are looking for Don Rouann's secret.

1656.descriptionId: This ring can protect you from weak magic attacks... In practice, from infantile monsters with something to prove.

1657.descriptionId: This ring can protect you from weak magic attacks... In practice, from infantile monsters with something to prove.

1660.descriptionId: This magnificent amber contains a nasty bug that was caught in the dripping sap of its master. It's a kind of sarcophagus, and the Dark Treechnee keeps it as a reminder of all its summons long after they are dead.

1661.descriptionId: Wearing a necklace with a Moskito encased in amber will show your opponents you're a fearsome hunter of Moskitos! Unless you're still a toddler, that's got to be embarrassing.

1662.descriptionId: Wearing an amber Arachnee around your neck when attacking one of its sisters can be enough to disconcert it. Poor bug. It's what we call the "irony of fate".

1663.descriptionId: This Crocodyl Scale is like a little trophy for all beginner Crocodyl hunters. Don't hesitate to show it to the drunkards at the Inn. They'll be impressed and will offer you a drink to celebrate your success.

1665.descriptionId: These strange boots were first used by young disciples who were one or two socks short of a pair. Ah yes, popular with the Iops.

1666.descriptionId: These boots have been especially made for those who prefer to watch their summons do all the hard work during fights.

1667.descriptionId: This belt takes its name from its creator, a shoemaker who was less renowned and much older than Bowisse, but quite gifted all the same.

1668.descriptionId: The Dodu was a Sadida who loved frightening his enemies. He asked Bowisse to make him a belt that matched the colour of his hair... Like many charmers, the Dodu had a rotten heart.

1669.descriptionId: This belt was made for the most popular of all the Craettes who often organised parties and wacky events to keep her countless friends and acquaintances on her side. All this between ironing and washing Captain Chafer's leather underpants.

1674.descriptionId: This great hero was turned into a mushroom thanks to the bumbling magic of the mischievous Soft Oak. Being complete cretins, the Mush Mushes venerate and protect him as one of their gods.

1675.descriptionId: It's thanks to this magic bone that Chafer Foot Soldiers can achieve the most astonishing of feats. For instance, while in the middle of a fight, they can take off their briefs, put them on their heads without using their hands, and still avoid being hit by attackers. You will never get tired of this incredible performance.

1676.descriptionId: This piece of Bewitched Wicker will enable you to make a beautiful basket for magic fruits, combining elegance and power... quite the opposite of a bad Liche.

1679.descriptionId: It takes the patience of a saint but this stone can become round and bright like the pompom on a magic hat. Its shape makes it easy to fit almost anywhere.

1683.descriptionId: An artful Sadida carried incredible quantities of peeled potatoes in this sack and then sold them to prisoners. When he died, his bag passed down from artful Sadida to artful Sadida as a family ritual.

1685.descriptionId: Beware! You are now the unhappy owner of the last feather from the rump of the last Cheeken in Amakna. It might be a good idea to give it away to a tailor friend... or a Cheeken fanatic. There's a lot of them around lately.

1686.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives hair a magnificent red colour. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers.

1687.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives hair a magnificent greenish effect. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers.

1688.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives hair a magnificent bluish effect. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers.

1689.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives a magnificent auburn glow when applied to any kind of hair. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers as well.

1690.descriptionId:
This fur is quite the same as the Boowolf's only a little shorter, less robust and softer. 
Unfortunately, it smells the same.

1691.descriptionId:
Rare are the adventurers who have touched these living hairs.
Something, something, something, I like eating choc eclairs.

1692.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives hair a magnificent dark colour. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers.

1693.descriptionId: The famous tailor, Jules Yanos, was particularly renowned for having exchanged his wife for a magic thimble. What a businessman, hmm? Just great!

1694.descriptionId: This piece of wool comes from the most dangerous creatures in Amakna that, apparently, have been transformed into a bedspread by an unscrupulous tailor, the same tailor who – if you believe what is publicly rumoured – once exchanged his wife for a magic thimble. It's a mystery.

1695.descriptionId: It's plain as day that this cape is a replica of the famous Elya Wood's Cloak – the crocodyl symbol on the hem has been embroidered on in the wrong direction.

1697.descriptionId: Don't expect this bag to make a hero of you. It will keep all your personal items in one place. Better than nothing, I suppose.

1698.descriptionId:
This bag has been designed to hold a few collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

1699.descriptionId: This bag is ideal for those who never wander far from home but take useless things with them when they do. Like ash planks for example.

1700.descriptionId: Designed by Tengra Reufrus, this aerodynamic belt will make you as nimble as a Tofu and as windy as the breeze. Or is it the opposite?

1701.descriptionId: This belt has small pockets allowing you to stock more items in your inventory.

1702.descriptionId:
This bag has been designed to hold collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

1703.descriptionId:
This bag has been designed to hold many collectible resources.
Only true harvesters can carry it.

1704.descriptionId: Legend whispers of a miner who worked continuously for several months in 4 different mines simultaneously, raising a family in the process and running a successful one-man printing press with his feet. Ah, the Hammer-Sickle newspaper has been hard at work again.

1705.descriptionId: It's the ideal bag for holding all your bread and potions when you go away for several months... into the labyrinth for example.

1707.descriptionId: This is the ideal bag for keeping all your bread and potions in when you are on an exotic holiday on Moon Island.

1709.descriptionId: "Say hello to my little friend"... the last words of a proud female Enutrof who mistook a Boowolf for her trusty poodle.

1710.descriptionId: No one knows the origins of this crescent-shaped amulet. Well, almost no one. Who knows what might happen if you put it on.

1711.descriptionId:
Take this dog to the park, take him to the toilet, show him to your friends, but whatever you do - and please listen carefully - do not feed him. This pet will remove your arm up to the elbow.
(This legendary pet refuses to eat, so don't bother trying.)

1712.descriptionId: You'll recover between 201 and 400 energy points using this potion.

1713.descriptionId: You'll recover between 501 and 1000 energy points using this potion.

1715.descriptionId: Christmas Bestseller 634. This is essential reading. It's a classic!

1716.descriptionId: Second best seller of the winter of 634, this book is already a reference.

1717.descriptionId: The odds-on outsider for the beginning of 635, this book has gained a cult following in recent months.

1718.descriptionId: The powers given to this ring by the Dark Breath of Grougalorasalar are now considerably weakened. This relic was intended for Crocoburio, the only one capable of mastering it without being dominated himself.

1719.descriptionId: This pair of boots apparently belonged to Crocoburio. Only a few people can put them on and they are immediately plunged into a clever, Machiavellian frame of mind. Legend has it that this evil spell is due to the numerous skulls the boots have crushed.

1720.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar loved collecting the bone fragments of his most fearsome enemies. His affection for Crocoburio inspired the creation of this ultra-powerful belt.

1721.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Xelor special spell Rhol Bak.

1722.descriptionId: You've been turned into a Treechnid because of the Soft Oak's curse. To remove the bewitchment, you have to defeat an adventurer lost in the Treechnid Forest.

1723.descriptionId: This drop increases your energy for a short time.

1724.descriptionId: This blessing will increase Strength for your next few fights.

1725.descriptionId: This curse will reduce your Strength in your next fight.

1726.descriptionId: This tuft of hair proves your victory against Tarche. You're a star!

1727.descriptionId: A threatening letter addressed to Lady Marmalade.

1728.descriptionId: The fairer sex of any class will fall under the spell of this cuddly little ball of fluff. That alone makes it an animal to be feared.

1729.descriptionId: This ring once belonged to Mer, the laziest piece of stuff in Amakna. He worshipped doughnuts and ribs...

1730.descriptionId: This salt measure is the ideal quantity to season most family dishes. No meal can be cooked without it.

1731.descriptionId: A dose of tasty juice, sometimes known as chef's special sauce, will make a fine, rustic, slightly salty broth.

1732.descriptionId: There's nothing more convenient than a bowl to eat your soup properly, even if the fact of eating properly doesn't alter the taste. Unless your fingers are really dirty.

1733.descriptionId:
Terrine is like meat... Oooo, that hits the spot. Three cheers for the terrine! Hurrah for the terrine!!!
Go terrine, it's your birthday.
Go terrine, it's your birthday.
(Extract from the butcher anthem, verse 4)

1734.descriptionId: Xelors often mistake this fruit for a space hopper. Remember them!

1735.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bow Meow that you left at the Bow Kennel.

1736.descriptionId: This juice of this fruit is perfect for hiding the foul smell of rotting flesh. A must-have if you're serving leftovers to your guests.

1737.descriptionId: This Field Bread feels like a stone in your pocket... and in your belly for that matter. But it has that familiar rustic flavour that any good bread should have.

1738.descriptionId: This bread will give you the appetite of a bulimic giant. It'll also fill you very, very quickly. These conflicting properties have killed thousands. Don't be next.

1739.descriptionId: This wand is searingly hot to the touch. But the most enigmatic thing about it is its ash smell which would make you think it had survived a forest fire.

1740.descriptionId: The Crocobur contains the spirit of Crocoburio. So, the only way of stealing it is to kill Crocoburio. Simple.

1741.descriptionId: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 5,000 energy points.

1742.descriptionId: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 10,000 energy points.

1744.descriptionId: This tuft of hair proves your victory against Torche. Magnificent!

1745.descriptionId: One end pointed, a plunger on the other, it's a syringe, no doubt about it. You have been warned.

1746.descriptionId: Who would have travelled to the Wabbit Islands armed with a syringe with the sole aim of extracting some blood from the most genetically modified creature on the island? You, of course.

1747.descriptionId: Analysis clearly reveal that the blood comes from a Wabbit's hind quarter. After a thorough examination of the sample, the alchemist was able to determine which part of the backside was stung; for your information, it was the right cheek.

1748.descriptionId: This little Wabbit is domesticated. It won't bite you. Others might not be so lucky, though...

1749.descriptionId: You bought this token from Leonzi Trool. His humble dream is to open the biggest public fair the Cania Plains have ever seen.

1750.descriptionId: A cubic fish renowned for its particularly one dimensional thought processes. This piscatorial cretin is exceedingly easy to catch.

1751.descriptionId: The breaded fish can now be used as an ingredient.

1752.descriptionId: This tasty stick is made from fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its taste delights children but it has low nutritional value.

1753.descriptionId: This very tasty stick is made from decent, fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its taste delights children and has good nutritional value.

1754.descriptionId: This rare species of breaded fish usually lives, as its name indicates, in the icy waters of the far North. Because of its polar diet, its flesh is rich in fibre.

1755.descriptionId: This Igloo Fish can now be used as an ingredient.

1756.descriptionId: This incredibly tasty stick is made from the best fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its taste delights children and it has excellent nutritional value.

1757.descriptionId: This unusually-shaped crab is much appreciated for the great quantity of flesh it yields. It is also the only crab you can catch with a fishing rod because of its natural instinct to cut thread with its claws, which can't cut a thing!

1758.descriptionId: This Crab Stick can now be used as an ingredient.

1759.descriptionId: Although a distant relative of the Crab Stick, this crab has a few brain cells to throw around. This explains its rarity.

1760.descriptionId: This Exotic Crab Stick can now be used as an ingredient.

1761.descriptionId: This Kittenfish can now be used as an ingredient.

1762.descriptionId: This fish is much like a Kittenfish, but far, far more dangerous.

1763.descriptionId: This tiger fish can now be used as an ingredient.

1764.descriptionId: Enjoy it everywhere, but be careful not to eat too much...

1765.descriptionId: To be enjoyed slowly, very slowly, with some sauce to bring out the flavour.

1766.descriptionId: Made from Exotic Crab Stick, this meat tastes disgusting, but is very nutritious.

1767.descriptionId: Delicately smoked, this Kittenfish makes a marvellous meal. But be careful, as its smell will stick to your clothes for several decades.

1768.descriptionId: Delicately smoked, this Kittenfish makes a marvellous meal. But be careful, as its smell will stick to your clothes for several decades.

1769.descriptionId: Firmer and more refined than Smoked Kittenfish, this Smoked Tiger Fish will delight lovers of fine cuisine.

1770.descriptionId: This extract of Blop has a strong smell of coco. How can a monster residue smell like this?

1771.descriptionId: There's no doubt this tooth used to belong to a Plains Larvae. It's plain to see from its dangerously sharp tip.

1772.descriptionId: Say it with Coco Flowers or don't say it at all!

1774.descriptionId: Say it with Pippin Flowers or don't say it at all!

1776.descriptionId: Say it with Morello Cherry Flowers or don't say it at all!

1778.descriptionId: Say it with Indigo Flowers or don't say it at all!

1779.descriptionId: You can find this type of fish in glacial lakes and rivers. Fishermen really love it because of its size and its fresh flesh.

1780.descriptionId: The Lard Bass can now be used as an ingredient.

1781.descriptionId: This Grawn can now be used as an ingredient.

1782.descriptionId: A small and fast-moving freshwater fish, the gudgeon is often caught by children and novice fishermen. Don't expect to feed your family with it.

1783.descriptionId: This Gudgeon can now be used as an ingredient.

1784.descriptionId: The Blue Skate rules the sea bed in which, for some mysterious reason, it digs tiny holes all day long. Every once in a while, it returns to the surface. Sometimes long enough for you to catch it.

1785.descriptionId: This Blue Skate can now be used as an ingredient.

1786.descriptionId: Transformation of the Grawn. A distinguishing characteristic of this rare species is that it makes nauseating grunting noises when it moves around.

1787.descriptionId: This Horror Grawn can now be used as an ingredient.

1788.descriptionId: Farle Ingalsse personally discovered this particular species of ray during one of his great adventures. Apparently it has the ability to enchant fish with its deep, southern voice and rhythmic train-like beating of its tail.

1789.descriptionId: This Farle's Ray can now be used as an ingredient.

1790.descriptionId: This rare species of gudgeon comes from Kiye Island, off Moon Island. Accustomed to warm currents, it migrates once a year to a hotter clime.

1791.descriptionId: This Kiye Gudgeon can now be used as an ingredient.

1792.descriptionId: A cousin of the Lard Bass, the Siktrin Bass is officially an endangered species. The population was hunted enthusiastically ever since some quack idiot doctor claimed that it improved the singing voice.

1793.descriptionId: The Siktrin Bass can now be used as an ingredient.

1794.descriptionId: This creature is considered the wisest of all the freshwater fish. It's also surprisingly easy to catch... it's supreme knowledge of all things plunges many of its kind into an mind-numbing depression.

1795.descriptionId: This Ediem Carp can now be used as an ingredient.

1796.descriptionId: This small carp is sand-coloured, a distinctive feature which in theory should make it invisible to predators. What a pity there's not a single grain of sand in the lakes of Amakna.

1797.descriptionId: This Small Sandy Carp can now be used as an ingredient.

1798.descriptionId: This Kralove can now be used as an ingredient.

1799.descriptionId: This Kralove is monogamous. This is surprising when you know its habits.

1800.descriptionId: This Unique Kralove can now be used as an ingredient.

1801.descriptionId: This fish doesn't look like much but it is the slyest and quickest of its kind. It's worth a try though. Its matchless taste and unique flavour will be ample reward for your efforts.

1802.descriptionId: This Perch can now be used as an ingredient.

1803.descriptionId: With the hideousness of its father and the savagery of its mother, this fish is the most difficult of all to catch. It's the rarest of its kind, too. Indeed, the mating of a Kittenfish with a Perch was once described by a famous statesman as "Grotesque, unbelievable, bizarre and unprecedented." The phrase GUBU has since been coined to describe such scandalous events.
