1804.descriptionId: That Kittenperch can now be used as an ingredient.

1805.descriptionId: Some fish just don't know when to put it away... Cover up, get off the stage... Catching this bugger couldn't be easier.

1806.descriptionId: This Shiny Sardine can now be used as an ingredient.

1807.descriptionId: Unlike the Shiny Sardine, the Dark Sardine is extremely difficult to catch.

1808.descriptionId: This Dark Sardine can now be used as an ingredient.

1809.descriptionId: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a little while. It's not the tastiest, though.

1810.descriptionId: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a while. It's quite tasty, too.

1811.descriptionId: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. The problem is that they quickly become addictive.

1812.descriptionId: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. The problem is that they quickly become addictive.

1813.descriptionId: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful despite the smell off you for the following few days.

1814.descriptionId: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful despite the smell off you for the following few days.

1815.descriptionId: When cooked too quickly in black Bwork bwutter, this skate wing releases an eye-watering flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal is not a memorable one.

1816.descriptionId: When cooked in black Bwork bwutter, this skate wing releases a rather bland flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal wasn't too bad though, all things considered.

1817.descriptionId: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp's flavour will sweep you off your feet!

1818.descriptionId: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp will make you forget all your troubles. Tomorrow's gonna be another day... just enjoy this steamed-carp-flavoured moment!

1819.descriptionId: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp will make you forget all your troubles. Tomorrow's gonna be another day... just enjoy the steamed-carp-flavoured moment!

1820.descriptionId:
This grilled kralove gives off a strong smell, but it's a true delicacy if you manage to overcome your disgust. 
A small piece of advice... find something long and sharp to eat it with.

1821.descriptionId: This grilled kralove doesn't smell too bad, and it's a true delicacy if you manage to overcome your indifference.

1822.descriptionId: This fish swam a long way, but failed to make it to the spawning grounds. Still, it's ready to be eaten, even if it is a little bland.

1823.descriptionId: This fish swam a long way, and made it to the spawning grounds, where it spawned a few young. It's now ready to be eaten, and tastes good.

1824.descriptionId: This fish swam a long way, and spawned many young in the rivers of Amakna. It's now ready to be eaten, and tastes delicious.

1825.descriptionId: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this fried sardine, but it does make an excellent starter.

1826.descriptionId: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this fried sardine, but it does make an excellent main course.

1827.descriptionId: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this fried sardine, but it does make an excellent dessert.

1828.descriptionId: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a long time. It's absolutely delicious!

1829.descriptionId: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. With a low calorie content, it would stupid to refuse them.

1830.descriptionId: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful... And the usual horrible odour is masked by a mysterious scent of fresh flowers too.

1831.descriptionId: When cooked with care in black Bwork bwutter, this skate wing releases an incredible flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal will truly give you wings.

1832.descriptionId: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

1833.descriptionId: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

1834.descriptionId: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

1835.descriptionId: Your Daddy caught this pike one day during the war. Now he knew if his captain ever saw the fish it'd be confiscated. Your daddy wanted to bring that fish home to you, so he stuck it up... well, let's say he hid it. Your daddy died soon after, so I pulled it out of his body and hid it in my own body. Now, little warrior, I give the fish to you.

1836.descriptionId: Your Daddy caught this pike one day during the war. Now he knew if his captain ever saw the fish it'd be confiscated. Your daddy wanted to bring that fish home to you, so he stuck it up... well, let's say he hid it. Your daddy died soon after, so I pulled it out of his... body and hid it in my own... body. Now, little warrior, I give the fish to you.

1837.descriptionId: Your Daddy caught this pike one day during the war. Now he knew if his captain ever saw the fish it'd be confiscated. Your daddy wanted to bring that fish home to you, so he stuck it up... well, let's say he hid it. Your daddy died soon after, so I pulled it out of his... body and hid it in my own... body. Now, little warrior, I give the fish to you.

1838.descriptionId: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few spices before it ate you.

1839.descriptionId: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few hearty spices before it ate you.

1840.descriptionId: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few magic spices before it ate you.

1844.descriptionId: Trout are easy to catch. Experienced fishermen haul them in by threes.

1845.descriptionId: This Trout can now be used as an ingredient.

1846.descriptionId: This is one of the oldest trout in the World. If the simple passage of time makes you wiser, this trout must be the wisest of all. To be honest, though, that's not what I've heard.

1847.descriptionId: This pike is a freshwater fish of average size. It's a barbecue's best friend.

1848.descriptionId: This Pike can now be used as an ingredient.

1849.descriptionId: This new species - resulting from the cross-breeding of several types of pike by the scientists Halett and Tupe - is supposed to have magical properties. Created only for experimentation, two specimens escaped during a violent argument between the two experts.

1851.descriptionId: This Tupe-Halett Pike can now be used as an ingredient.

1852.descriptionId: This Sickle-Hammerhead Shark can now be used as an ingredient.

1853.descriptionId: A cousin of the Sickle-Hammerhead Shark, this animal is more ferocious and doesn't have a considerate fish-bone in its body. Catching an Open-Market Shark is the dream of every fisherman - or more precisely, catching one AND staying alive to tell the tale.

1854.descriptionId: The Gutted Open-Market Shark can now be used as an ingredient.

1859.descriptionId: This grilled kralove smells delicious. A cold Kikim Inn Beer, sunshine glinting off the Asse sea, a plateful of Grilled Kralove ****. Does life get any better than that?

1860.descriptionId: This very sturdy fishing rod, specially designed to catch sharks, has a hook resembling a bloody harpoon.

1861.descriptionId: This fishing rod has been specially designed for catching perch.

1862.descriptionId: The wood that this rod is made from smells of resin, and as a result, so does the hook and the wire. This heady scent must be like that of a female Kralove. Why else would all male Kralove rush towards your tackle?

1863.descriptionId: Cho was the most renowned cook at the round table. He always provided fresh food for his customers. This rod allowed him to catch the fish he needed for his famous "Carp at Cho" dish.

1864.descriptionId: The thread of this fishing rod is made of pure wool and a ball of wool replaces the bait. Few Kittenfish can resist playing with it.

1865.descriptionId: This fishing rod is especially designed to fit the "particular" features of the Breaded Fish.

1866.descriptionId: This basic rod will allow young fishermen to catch almost anything provided they are patient enough.

1867.descriptionId: This fishing rod is for professional fishermen only. If you master this hook cannon, you'll be able to catch small comets from their orbit.

1868.descriptionId: This fishing rod will go to incredible lengths to catch fish for you, but only if you're a master fisherman.

1869.descriptionId: This tooth extractor is specially designed for Gobballs but you can also use it to extract one of your own decayed gnashers. The rest will surely fall out not long after, though.

1870.descriptionId: This Gobball Tooth is so similar to a human one, you'll find it hard to tell them apart.

1871.descriptionId: The necklace the Mayor's daughter lost. Unfortunately, it's in bad condition since its sojourn in a Crobak's stomach.

1872.descriptionId:
Gunpowder. There's a label with a simple reminder printed on it:
Powder + Flame = Explosion

1873.descriptionId: A Plain Crackler's rock block, similar to those used in the building of fortifications of Bonta.

1874.descriptionId: Some Scurvion venom which shouldn't fall into foreign hands.

1875.descriptionId: Why cut wheat with this scythe when you can cut granite?

1876.descriptionId: This inspection form of the Brakmarian act n°243 enables you to detect whether a man is part of it or not.

1877.descriptionId: The former owner of this hat probably took a few blows too many to the head, which tends to happen when you rebel against Bonta's authority.

1878.descriptionId: This playing card has a particular appearance close to perfection. It is apparently a collector's card.

1879.descriptionId: A crate of edged weapons, full of all kinds of blunt instruments.

1880.descriptionId: Yum! Kittycare! Your Kaniger will leap over the moon with delight.

1882.descriptionId: You have picked up a very appetising Pulpy substance.

1883.descriptionId: The necklace the Mayor's daughter lost, as good as new.

1889.descriptionId: Sharpened into quill pens for years, these feathers are now used to adorn the rich and famous. No wonder Crobaks are nervous creatures – anyone who knows the value of these feathers will go a long way to get their hands on them.

1890.descriptionId: The hair of the Kaniger reflects the sun in a strange way, as if it was absorbing some of the rays.

1891.descriptionId: In adolescence, the Beaztinga's body gets covered by a soft fuzz, which is paradoxical next to the overly aggressive behavior it adopts during that period.

1892.descriptionId: One day, startled by the glint of something shiny from the corner of his eye, Lord Crow spread his massive wings and flew off, leaving behind this feather. It's just a feather... right?

1893.descriptionId: A fantastic trophy. It's a pity it oozes smelly fluid.

1894.descriptionId: This type of hair is really disgusting. If you have a closer look at it, you'll discover a great microcosm of different parasites living on it... How lucky you are!

1895.descriptionId: You'll recover a few Health Points with this highly alcoholic beer.

1896.descriptionId:
This Tofu leg is proof that hunters can show, albeit very infrequently, a tiny glimmer of sensitivity.

(This meat can be harvested by level-1 and higher Hunters.)

1897.descriptionId:
Mini Kwak thighs for maximum taste.

(This meat can be harvested by level-40 and higher Hunters.)

1898.descriptionId:
This disgusting yellow heap represents the Larva's true nature. Now you understand why their skin is so tough.

(This meat can be harvested by level-1 and higher Hunters.)

1899.descriptionId:
This disgusting yellow heap represents the Larva's true nature. Now you understand why their skin is so tough.

(This meat can be harvested by level-10 and higher Hunters.)

1900.descriptionId:
This disgusting yellow heap represents the Larva's true nature. Now you understand why their skin is so tough.

(This meat can be harvested by level-20 and higher Hunters.)

1901.descriptionId:
This leg is simply perfect. You just can't help eyeing it up greedily for a while before eating it.

(This meat can be harvested by level-80 and higher Hunters.)

1902.descriptionId:
This Wabbit leg seems to have added cawwot-flavouring. Perfect for goulash.

(This meat can be harvested by level-20 and higher Hunters.)

1903.descriptionId:
This well-muscled leg promises to be delicious.

(This meat can be harvested by level-40 and higher Hunters.)

1904.descriptionId: A White Dreggon Shell padded with leather and wool, this headgear will protect you against basic attacks and the lightning bolts of a stumbling, drunken Bwork Magus. You'll also look like you just fell out of a Dreggon's backside.

1905.descriptionId:
This hefty leg should fill most stomachs.

(This meat can be harvested by level-60 and higher Hunters.)

1907.descriptionId: These ears will accentuate your bright smile and get the opposite sex spreading rumours about you.

1908.descriptionId: Even Spartapine the Great Reaper doesn't have such a helmet, the precious stones and metals used to make it ensure your noggin will be kept safe and sound inside..

1910.descriptionId: This cloak is made from the body parts of an Ouginak, it still has the smell of the creature's humid nose. Personally, its taste reminds me of a horny set of Gobball's udders... Well, someone told me that... damn.

1911.descriptionId:
The odour coming from this leg goes away when it's cooked.

(This meat can be harvested by level-10 and higher Hunters.)

1912.descriptionId:
This leg reeks of death. I assure you it was cleared of all involvement in its owner's untimely demise... It just smells like death.

(This meat can be harvested by level-20 and higher Hunters.)

1913.descriptionId:
This is the leg of a Gobball War Chief. As solid as a Crackler, it could be a very powerful bludgeon, if you can stand the smell.

(This meat can be harvested by level-40 and higher Hunters.)

1914.descriptionId:
Tender but firm, not too fatty nor too dry, this leg improves with age, like fine wine.

(This meat can be harvested by level-50 and higher Hunters.)

1915.descriptionId:
Don't underestimate the nutritional value of this slimy, suffocating flesh.

(This meat can be harvested by level-1 and higher Hunters.)

1916.descriptionId:
This flesh is very similar to that of Moskitos, except there's ten times more of it. Fortunately, some people like it.

(This meat can be harvested by level-50 and higher Hunters.)

1917.descriptionId:
This choice morsel of Boar is quite bloody for the moment but it will make a great meal.

(This meat can be harvested by level-30 and higher Hunters.)

1918.descriptionId:
A bit bigger for a bit more joy, this impulsively carved lump of Plain Boar will delight all carnivores.

(This meat can be harvested by level-50 and higher Hunters.)

1919.descriptionId:
That piece of Dragon Pig is so tender and soft that it would make a perfect cushion. But it's still nicer to eat it.

(This meat can be harvested by level-70 and higher Hunters.)

1920.descriptionId: This badge is used to identify militiamen who have fallen on battlefields. Apparently some people collect them in Brakmar.

1921.descriptionId:
A deliciously firm loin of pork from an athletic pig.

(This meat can be harvested by level-60 and higher Hunters.)

1922.descriptionId:
Rare high-quality meat, it remains hot hours after roasting. Very convenient for picnics.

(This meat can be harvested by level-40 and higher Hunters.)

1923.descriptionId:
This dragomeat, on top of remaining hot, has a naturally smoky taste.

(This meat can be harvested by level-60 and higher Hunters.)

1924.descriptionId:
Dreggon dragomeat is a bit hard to chew but is far more nourishing than standard dragomeat. Some say it has magic properties.

(This meat can be harvested by level-70 and higher Hunters.)

1925.descriptionId: This pass gives you a day leave.

1926.descriptionId:
The meat of the Dragon Pig's dragon parts (nobody knows their exact location, nor does anybody want to try)
is a gift from heaven. It makes sense, given that Dragon Pigs can fly.

(This meat can be harvested by level-90 and higher Hunters.)

1927.descriptionId:
Miliboowolf muzzle, with its small, firm chops, accompanies all salads perfectly.

(This meat can be harvested by level-30 and higher Hunters.)

1928.descriptionId: The extraction of this Plain Boar tusk certainly required a great deal of know how.

1929.descriptionId:
This dainty muzzle is synonymous with a lack of will. Consume without moderation.

(This meat can be harvested by level-50 and higher Hunters.)

1930.descriptionId:
This tasty meat must be eaten in moderation. There's a reason Moowolves have such terribly bad breath!

(This meat can be harvested by level-70 and higher Hunters.)

1931.descriptionId: It's Amayiro's weapon. You can easily handle it but it seems to be slightly nicked.

1932.descriptionId: This weapon, which used to be nicked, is now ready to cut whatever you want. Amayiro won't be disappointed.

1933.descriptionId:
This small piece of Crobak is imbued with powerful magic. Lord Crow himself is probably responsible for its power.

(This meat can be harvested by level-60 and higher Hunters.)

1934.descriptionId: This knife is the typical hallmark of the hunter. The brighter, sharper and bigger the blades are, the better-looking the hunters are... according to themselves at least...

1935.descriptionId: Whoever pays his debts grows rich ok, but this is quite a sum! It would be better to avoid such debt, your children will be grateful...

1936.descriptionId: This axe is especially designed to quickly cut off any part of an animal, living or dead.

1937.descriptionId: This report written by Bishom Pot must contain lots of information about the daily activities of the Brakmarians.

1938.descriptionId: This blade has been designed for hunting purposes only. It is quite delicate to handle. Nevertheless, it can be of a great help to skilled hunters.

1939.descriptionId: This spear is really useful when you fight groups of monsters. Nevertheless, it requires some talent to be handled with dexterity.

1940.descriptionId: This isn't just any old hammer. It was designed in such a way as to knock its victims out, rather than kill them. Excellent for hunting, not so great for survival.

1941.descriptionId: This shovel is particularly recommended for killing monsters without damaging them. A tool for experienced hunters only.

1942.descriptionId: The hunting bow is considered as the safest hunting weapon. A maximum of damage for a minimum of marks, without exposing yourself.

1943.descriptionId: This wand will burn the animal in question perfectly... The meat is preserved and pre-cooked. Essential to warriors with an aggressive appetite.

1944.descriptionId: This weapon will launch a small copper ball in any direction you want. Its efficiency is frightening but its noise limits its usefulness to hunting only.

1945.descriptionId: This big knife can carve any type of meat.

1946.descriptionId: This huge knife can cut up any type of fish.

1947.descriptionId: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

1948.descriptionId: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

1949.descriptionId: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

1950.descriptionId: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

1951.descriptionId: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

1952.descriptionId: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

1953.descriptionId: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

1954.descriptionId: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Gobbly leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

1955.descriptionId: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Gobball leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

1956.descriptionId: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Gobball War Chief leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

1957.descriptionId: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Royal Gobball leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

1958.descriptionId: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

1959.descriptionId: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

1960.descriptionId: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

1961.descriptionId: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

1962.descriptionId: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

1963.descriptionId: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

1964.descriptionId: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

1965.descriptionId: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

1966.descriptionId: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

1967.descriptionId: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

1968.descriptionId: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

1969.descriptionId: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

1970.descriptionId: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

1971.descriptionId: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

1972.descriptionId: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

1973.descriptionId: What have Astrubian chips and Bontarian motorcycles got in common? This stuff.

1974.descriptionId: The favourite food of herbivores, it's also very good served as a side salad.

1975.descriptionId: Collected from the corpses of rather dim-witted adventurers who thought they were safe, but weren't. These onions give your meals the perfect zing.

1976.descriptionId: This Ancestral Trout can now be used as an ingredient.

1977.descriptionId: Rosemary was always late delivering packages. This prompted the head of International Herbs & Spices to call her supervisor, demanding to speak to the parcel sage about Rosemary and time.

1978.descriptionId: Ground pepper is an essential ingredient of mashed potatoes. Forget it at your peril.

1980.descriptionId: This curse will reduce your Agility in your next fight.

1981.descriptionId: This curse will reduce your Intelligence in your next fight.

1983.descriptionId: This blubber has been extracted from a Jelly's heart. Used in cooking, it's an excellent preservative and gives a nice meaty tang to your meals.

1984.descriptionId: Blops use this meaty blubber to create faithful Biblops that will stay by their side through thick and thin. You can use it in the kitchen to create sauces, soups and puddings that will stay on your plate with just as much determination.

1985.descriptionId: This small amount of resin can be extracted from trees by people who know what they're doing. This resin is of no use except for protecting something from the surrounding air.

1986.descriptionId: This temporal powder, a flour residue discovered by Xelor millers, can slow down the molecular decomposition of materials and even living things. It is above all used as anti-wrinkle cream by female Enutrofs.

1987.descriptionId: This Preserved Bird Meat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

1988.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Bird Meat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

1989.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Bird Meat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

1990.descriptionId: This Preserved Larva Flesh may now be hung for several days before use.

1991.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Larva Flesh may now be hung for several days before use.

1992.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Larva Flesh may now be hung for several days before use.

1993.descriptionId: This Preserved Insect Flesh can be kept for several days before use.

1994.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Insect Flesh can be kept for several days before use.

1995.descriptionId: This Preserved Gobball Leg may now be hung for several days before eating.

1997.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Gobball Leg may now be hung for several days before eating.

1998.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Gobball Leg may now be hung for several days before eating.

1999.descriptionId: This extraordinarily good Preserved Gobball Leg may now be hung for several days before eating.

2000.descriptionId: This Preserved Wabbit Leg may now be kept for several days before use.

2001.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Wabbit Leg may now be kept for several days before use.

2002.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Wabbit Leg may now be kept for several days before use.

2003.descriptionId: This extraordinarily good Preserved Wabbit Leg may now be kept for several days before use.

2004.descriptionId: This Preserved Pork Loin may now be marinated for several days before eating.

2005.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Pork Loin may now be marinated for several days before eating.

2006.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Pork Loin may now be marinated for several days before eating.

2007.descriptionId: This extraordinarily good Preserved Pork Loin may now be marinated for several days before eating.

2008.descriptionId: This Preserved Muzzle may now be kept several days before use.

2009.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Muzzle may now be kept several days before use.

2010.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Muzzle may now be kept several days before use.

2012.descriptionId: Contrary to received ideas, this very syrupy blood doesn't contain poison. What's more, it can be used to make powerful preservatives and nice beauty masks.

2013.descriptionId: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

2014.descriptionId: This Preserved Dragomeat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

2015.descriptionId: This tasty Preserved Dragomeat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

2016.descriptionId: This delicious Preserved Dragomeat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

2017.descriptionId: This extraordinarily good Preserved Dragomeat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

2018.descriptionId: This wheat contains a powerful magic.

2019.descriptionId: This flour was made with an Ear of Golden Wheat. Awesome!

2020.descriptionId: This Bread has been kneaded with Magic Wheat Flour. Selling it is a good way to get rich...

2021.descriptionId: This type of hop has a bright and subdued aura revealing the magic Mother Nature has endowed it with.

2022.descriptionId: This flour was made with Bright Hops. It contains magical energy for sure!

2024.descriptionId: This small brioche is made from Hops. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

2025.descriptionId: This small brioche is made with Bright Hop Flour. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

2026.descriptionId: This Flax went through the most terrible storms and rose up again more than seven times. Pretty extraordinary for flax, you must admit. After getting wet every day for more than 148 years by the magic dew of the Great Pahti fields, its fibre might be useful for something.

2027.descriptionId: This flour has been made with Storm Flax. It probably has the same properties of resistance.

2028.descriptionId: This type of Bread is made with Storm Flax Flour, which gives it a pleasant lightness and a great taste.

2029.descriptionId: This dark cereal can grow under the worst of conditions.

2030.descriptionId: This flour retains all the characteristics of Resisting Rye. Excessive consumption can therefore have chronic laxative effects.

2031.descriptionId: This Bread is prepared with Magic Rye Flour, which gives it an awful flavour but lends it unique nutritional qualities.

2032.descriptionId: This rare type of barley absorbed sweet rainwater during its germination phase, which accounts for its incomparable magical powers.

2033.descriptionId: Sweet Barley flour produces very light bread, so light in fact that it could be blown away by a gust of wind. That's no excuse to pig out on it though, OK?

2034.descriptionId: By extracting sugar from sweet barley flour, we obtain this unique magic-flavoured sweetie.

2035.descriptionId: This Hemp Stem seems to instantly destroy concentration and coordination, causing your enemy to hum ceaselessly, rifle through his sack for anything remotely edible and giggle uncontrollably. Handled by a specialist, it can prove very useful.

2036.descriptionId: When we look at this kind of oats we get the impression that the grains are covered with gold, the sign of the great magic power that is absorbed during sprouting.

2037.descriptionId: This flour was obtained using Gold-bearing Oats which impart their soft golden colour and considerable magical powers. They won't make a baker-wizard of you, though.

2038.descriptionId: This bread with an uber-soft centre is just perfect.

2039.descriptionId: You tried to take the test to become a hunter.

2040.descriptionId: You have found Tsog's Chest in a small box. It's strange but this box has the same smell as Tsog... yes, that same indescribably horrible smell.

2041.descriptionId: This leg reeks of death... I assure you it was cleared of all involvement in the murder of its owner... Just smells like... Death.

2042.descriptionId: You took this bone with you after you scattered Mak Gahan's body parts all over the room.

2043.descriptionId: The name of the Burnt Cat innkeeper's murderer is inscribed on this slimy, smelly piece of paper.

2044.descriptionId: This beer looks a little bit too much like Bow Meow pee. Actually, having tasted it, maybe not enough.

2045.descriptionId: This document proves that you've brought back a crate.

2046.descriptionId: This key was stolen by a squirrel for mysterious reasons.

2047.nameId: List of Soldiers Taking a Break
2047.descriptionId:
You got this list from the militiaman at the Inn. You can read the following names on it:
Brank Thoof, Haco Norss, Jack Rottance, Kad Maxy.

2048.nameId: List of Soldiers Taking a Break
2048.descriptionId:
You got this list from the militiaman at the Inn. You can read the following names on it:
Haco Norss, Tink Berval, Brank Thoof, Kad Maxy, Seta Bnamron.

2049.descriptionId: Xale DuGros confesses that he never goes to the Inn. But he regularly has a break.

2050.descriptionId: The warrior Nager Nacmeil confesses that he no longer takes breaks. He's been a bit under the weather lately.

2051.descriptionId: Bishom Pot confesses everything. His behaviour is unforgivable.

2052.descriptionId: This document indicates you've got a day off.

2053.descriptionId: The Badge of the militiaman Allen Tokar.

2054.descriptionId: The Badge of the militiaman Yook Aput.

2055.descriptionId: The Badge of the militiaman Barry Flaye.

2060.descriptionId: No need to break the foot of a Crobak. Especially as you know that, contrary to Wabbit paws, Crobak feet bring bad luck.

2061.descriptionId: This cloak, not really nice at first sight, is nevertheless really efficient. Once you get used to the smell of rotting Crobak.

2062.descriptionId: You'll be nicely hidden until your next fight.

2063.descriptionId: These boots are made from different parts of Crobak Corpses. The wearer has a strange feeling of nimbleness comparable to that given by the traditional flying potion made with grilled boletus.

2064.descriptionId: Thanks to this scroll you'll be able to camouflage yourself in the surrounding environment until your next fight. Avoid moving and making strange noises if you don't want to be found.

2065.descriptionId: This Chafer helmet is damaged, but it's still effective if you want to be part of the elite.

2066.descriptionId: This is an approximate replica of a Kaniger's staff. It holds many surprises in store – and they're not all good...

2067.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the elementary spell Leek Pie.

2068.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the elementary spell Cawwot.

2069.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the elementary spell Moon Hammer.

2070.descriptionId: This bone helmet has been in a Kaniger's pocket for many years. Worn and scratched it might be, but its properties are as powerful as ever.

2071.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the elementary spell Release.

2072.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the elementary spell Lightning Strike.

2073.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Iop special spell Brokle.

2074.descriptionId: This cute little bwak will eventually become an ugly kwak. Until then, feel free to keep it by your side.

2075.descriptionId: This cute little bwak will eventually become an ugly kwak. Until then, feel free to keep it by your side.

2076.descriptionId: This cute little bwak will eventually become an ugly kwak. Until then, feel free to keep it by your side.

2077.descriptionId: This cute little bwak will eventually become an ugly kwak. Until then, feel free to keep it by your side.

2078.descriptionId: This is the will of Oto Mustam's father, written in ancient Brakmarian. It's such a pity that the sum of your knowledge of the language is one word, "Guo'rhalys!"

2079.descriptionId: Apparently, it takes about 20 years to distil Greedovore Juice properly. Any less than that, and it'll kill you.

2080.descriptionId: Greedovore Juice is as toxic as Scurvion juice, but if it's well distilled, it gives an incomparable taste to wine. Only a few people can actually distil this juice, and most of them are pirates.

2081.descriptionId: This report written by the spy Finche Aticus gives an exhaustive list of the weapons and warriors in Bonta.

2082.descriptionId: When a young wild boar witnesses the death of its parents, it begs the murderer to look after it.

2083.descriptionId: A letter from your Master addressed to Vil Smisse. It is written in an unknown dialect to prevent nosy parkers like you from reading it.

2084.descriptionId: This is Vil Smisse's answer to Oto Mustam, don't worry, it is totally incomprehensible to ordinary mortals.

2085.descriptionId: This beer is not only tasteless but also outrageously expensive.

2086.descriptionId: This Morello Cherry Blop-flavoured beer is sometimes called Manoca.

2087.descriptionId: This beer makes you more momentarily more valiant, but be careful. The higher you fly, the farther you fall!

2088.descriptionId: This is a pretty standard beer and it comes in a wonderfully carved tankard. One of the few cases where the container has more value than the content (alongside Iop skulls and the popular press).

2089.descriptionId: This beer is hot which makes it hard to drink in summer. On the other hand, it gives off a pleasant smell of toast, thus making it the ideal beer to drink at breakfast when there's no bread.

2090.descriptionId: This beer tastes of old iron, which is both unpleasant and revitalising.

2094.descriptionId: The Dark Makroute is a hat created from a Mutilated Makroute stitched together without an anaesthetic. Strangely enough, the master who visited these mutilations upon him is the only one it obeys... it can't stand strangers.

2095.descriptionId: The Bear is a hat made from a head of a dead bear. Its fur is still silky and warm. The tailor who made it must have been really skilled to keep the look of terror on the dead bear's face.

2096.descriptionId: Brave the Ghost was the first one to use Dark Wicker in fields other than gastronomy.

2097.descriptionId: The Champo once belonged to one of the greatest Fungi Masters of Amakna. Valiant and brilliant, Gnion the Boletus was the only one of his race who gained the respect of Human beings.

2098.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Earth Bwak that you left at the Bow Kennel.

2099.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Fire Bwak that you left at the Bow Kennel.

2100.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Water Bwak that you left at the Bow Kennel.

2101.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Air Bwak that you left at the Bow Kennel.

2102.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Wabbit that you left at the Bow Kennel.

2103.descriptionId: Paw written by Welloy Cab, this report will delight mathematicians and fans of Namnmnuble Bmbmeckett

2104.descriptionId: The Daudgee is a disturbing helmet made of Ouginak remains and other rubbish. Worn for many years by Gourlo the Terrible, the Daudgee has come to symbolise hopeless desolation.

2105.descriptionId:
Empty Report Form.
Ready to be filled in by Welloy Cab.

2106.descriptionId: Come on you useless piece of... Get that bait.

2107.descriptionId: This special bait box looks like an ordinary can of KittyCare.

2108.descriptionId: Tabach's badge. Tabach is the Clerk of the Order of the Valiant Heart.

2109.descriptionId: Ybaul's badge. She is the Clerk of the Order of The Saving Spirit.

2110.descriptionId: The Badge of Aigurraf, the Clerk of the Order of the Sharp Eye.

2111.descriptionId: This book will teach you how to become a good fisherman.

2112.descriptionId: This book will teach you how to become a good hunter.

2116.descriptionId: How to make Nocabregor powder: 3 measures of Magical Cure and 1 measure of Oilbow Grease. Only a firework manufacturer or an enchanter can make this recipe, with the help of some Flint.

2117.descriptionId: This tooth was bravely extracted from a rabid wolf.

2118.descriptionId: This cloak allows you to remain incognito in a cemetery, or to transform yourself at will into a female Chafer. Both these things are entirely useless to anyone but the most criminally perverse among us.

2119.descriptionId: This cloak gives you wings of a sort. The smoke it gives off when you burn it... you'll be high as a kite.

2120.descriptionId: "My will can be found to the north of the lighthouse at Madrestam Harbour. Get yourself a Twiggy Shovel to dig it up. And give my son a smack from me!"

2121.descriptionId: "I've hidden a chest at Sufokia's most easterly point, in an underwater tunnel. A word of advice before you go: get yourself a Twiggy Shovel to dig it up."

2122.descriptionId: This letter is sealed and it would be very impolite to open it.

2123.descriptionId: This recipe allows Sonacixem, a formidable magic poison, to be easily made.

2124.descriptionId: The inspection form n°243 filled in by Leonzi Trool. From the looks of things, he didn't have anything to do with it.

2127.descriptionId: This letter indicates a spell capable of destroying Holbaids.

2128.descriptionId: You have increased perceptiveness until your next fight.

2129.descriptionId: This tuft of hair is ample evidence of your brutal treatment of Dike Tarak.

2130.descriptionId: Escort Colonel Lyeno to a Bontarian magus to have the bewitchment cast by the Soft Oak removed.

2131.descriptionId: This letter impudently says that all the owners of alcoholic drinks must pay a tax to soldiers. For the retirement fund it says... I don't believe a word!

2132.descriptionId: Escort Atall Tramston out of the prison of Brakmar and bring him to Amayiro.

2133.descriptionId: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

2134.descriptionId: Escort Gnort Stonma out of the prison of Bonta and bring him to Oto Mustam.

2135.descriptionId: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

2136.descriptionId: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

2137.descriptionId: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

2138.nameId: Cheque from the Glazov Vater Inn
2138.descriptionId: This cheque covers the new tax on Inns announced by Oto Mustam.

2139.descriptionId:
-3 pieces of Pippin Blop
-1 bowl
-2 cherries

2141.descriptionId: A big green diamond adorns this necklace. It's so flashy that people usually focus more on the diamond than the person who's wearing it, which can be useful in some situations.

2144.descriptionId: It's a standard Champo but at least, it protects you from the sun.

2145.descriptionId: Sbab has given you this small brooch as a mark of respect for your demon's honour.

2146.descriptionId: Oni Tnec describes the dreadful way he killed Rimaraf in his confession.

2147.descriptionId: Some Scurvion poison. The bill for the delivery is addressed to Oni Tnec.

2148.descriptionId: An Investigation Report which reveals all Oni Tnec's stupid mistakes.

2149.descriptionId: Oni Tnec's Badge, found in Rimaraf's home.

2150.descriptionId: These seeds, which grow on plants in Sidimote, stick to clothing, fur and skin. They stick to everything, really.

2151.descriptionId: This cake is delicious, as long as you don't add ingredients that are too sticky...

2153.descriptionId: This is the badge you picked up near the prison where Lyeno is locked up.

2157.descriptionId: The Clint is a simple but classy hat. The latest version of this hat strangely suits both delicate female adventurers and the more virile male sort. A sure sign of quality, that.

2158.nameId: Letter from Oto Mustam to Sbab
2158.descriptionId: The aim of this fully ironic letter is to denigrate Sbab.

2159.descriptionId: This parchment increases your Strength. It can be useful when a furious Kaniger charges you.

2160.descriptionId: Use this scroll to reduce the Strength of a single target. This can be useful when a furious Kaniger is charging your enemy.

2161.descriptionId: This parchment increases your Agility. It can be useful for dodging Moowolves.

2162.descriptionId: This parchment reduces the Agility of a single target. Use it to prevent your enemy from escaping a Moowolf attack.

2163.descriptionId: You can't be attacked until your next fight.

2164.descriptionId: This sample has been found East of the mine.

2165.descriptionId: This sample has been found West of the mine.

2166.descriptionId: This sample was found close to the mine.

2167.descriptionId: This sample has been found South of the mine.

2168.descriptionId: This report starts to outline the worrying changes in the Brakmarian magmatic mass.

2169.descriptionId: Bring Raaga to a magmatic cave.

2171.descriptionId: This report outlines the chaotic changes in volcanic activities around Brakmar.

2172.descriptionId:
Raaga roughly wrote down the information you need to find good lava samples:
'Search within a 5 miles radius. Look for small peaks.'

2173.descriptionId: This dictionary will teach you how to talk with squirrels, or at least how to try...

2174.descriptionId: With this piece of paper, you can freely enter the prison's small Interrogation Rooms

2175.descriptionId: This is a threat that Danathor wrote to cover his back later on.

2176.descriptionId: Rimaraf lives in a red brick house at 13 Carving Alley, in the butcher's quarter.

2177.descriptionId: Danathor gave you this small brooch.

2178.descriptionId:
This form is a good way to identify potential suspects of criminal actions.
(Tap on the scroll, then on someone to use it.)

2179.descriptionId: This tooth seems to be very sharp. It could become a fearsome weapon in the wrong hands. Fortunately, the Dragoturkey only uses it to chew salad.

2180.descriptionId: This person's alibi seems to hold up perfectly.

2181.descriptionId: This person is a suspect whose alibi doesn't stand up.

2182.descriptionId: A Militia Officer is keeping a close eye on you. You are a suspect in the killing of Rimaraf. The officer left his card after questioning you.

2183.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of fisherman.

2184.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of fishmonger.

2185.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of hunter.

2186.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of butcher.

2187.descriptionId: This fish can only be caught in the Sufokia Schwimming Pool. It is a cross breed of many diverse fish.

2188.descriptionId: This fishing rod is the only way to catch snappers in the Sufokia Schwimming Pool.

2189.descriptionId: This small piece of paper signed by Satirev Refibrom proves you voted on a Judgement, and you voted well.

2190.descriptionId:
This form is usually used to make suspects confess their criminal acts. All you have to do now is fill in a fake interview of Oni Tnec.
(Use it on yourself to use it)

2191.descriptionId: This small piece of paper signed by Satirev Refibrom proves you voted on a Judgement, and you lied.

2192.descriptionId: These top secret documents are sealed with a death glyph. Even if you break the seal, you will never be able to read them.

2193.descriptionId: You have given Oto Mustam's son a good hiding. Neither of them will appreciate it!

2195.descriptionId:
This tooth must be yours judging by the hiding Oto Mustam gave you. 
Wisdom would suggest you give it a while before going back to him... unless you want to be picking the rest of your teeth up with your other broken arm.

2196.descriptionId: This blessing will make you gain Intelligence for your next few fights.

2197.descriptionId: These rings can break the sacred bond of marriage.

2198.descriptionId: This parchment increases your Intelligence. It will help you keep your cool when faced with multiple enemies.

2199.descriptionId: This parchment reduces the Intelligence of a single target. It can be useful to prevent your enemy from moving when faced with a mob of angry Bworks.

2200.descriptionId: The Great Judge of Brakmar doesn't want to see you again. Apparently he's not overly fond of you. Don't worry, he has a heart of stone anyway.

2201.descriptionId: This blessing will increase Wisdom for the next few battles.

2202.descriptionId: This curse will reduce your Wisdom in your next fight.

2203.descriptionId: This scroll increases your Wisdom, which is essential when confronting Dark Vlad.

2204.descriptionId: This parchment reduces the Wisdom of a single target. It's necessary when your enemy tries to equal Dark Vlad.

2205.descriptionId: This paper indicates you've already changed your order.

2207.descriptionId: All the crimes you've committed have been written on this paper, as well as the date you were imprisoned. Great reading for those long trips, no?

2208.descriptionId: This curse will reduce your luck in your next fight.

2209.descriptionId: This parchment increases your Luck. Will you be lucky enough to find a Tofu in a haystack?

2210.descriptionId: This parchment can reduce the Chance of a single target, which is useful when, for example, your opponent's from the Emerald Isle.

2214.descriptionId: You'll have the Iop Attitude until your next fight.

2215.descriptionId: You'll have the Xelor Attitude until your next fight.

2216.descriptionId: You'll have the Sadida Attitude until your next fight.

2218.descriptionId: You'll have the Feca Attitude until your next fight.

2220.descriptionId: You'll have the Eniripsa Attitude until your next fight.

2222.descriptionId: You'll have the Enutrof Attitude until your next fight.

2224.descriptionId: You'll have the Sacrier Attitude until your next fight.

2226.descriptionId: You'll have the Sram Attitude until your next fight.

2228.descriptionId: You'll have the Osamodas Attitude until your next fight.

2230.descriptionId: You'll have the Ecaflip Attitude until your next fight.

2232.descriptionId: You'll have the Cra Attitude until your next fight.

2233.descriptionId: Xof the Fox created this belt after he inexplicably decided to gather up all the teeth he could find on a Wabbit battlefield. It has now become a lifelong passion of his.

2234.descriptionId: You'll have the Bonta Attitude until your next fight.

2235.descriptionId: You have the Brakmar Attitude until your next fight.

2239.descriptionId: This powder is only made in small quantities from Eniripsas' wings. Pets and petsmounts all over the World say yes to its amazing healing powers.

2240.descriptionId: Ideal for small weddings, and perfect for the annual Captain Chafer Panty Party.

2241.descriptionId: This Royal Jelly used to strike fear into the hearts of all but the craziest warriors. Be careful not to eat it... it's no plain Mint Jelly.

2242.descriptionId: This concentrate of Royal Strawberry Jelly can turn a pacifist Tabi into a bloodthirsty killing-machine. An excellent reason to avoid giving it to your friends as a starter.

2246.descriptionId: This crown was either broken by a powerful magic attack or by that last headbutt the Royal Tofu tried to give you.

2247.descriptionId: You'd have to be a lop not to realise that this feather comes from the backside of a Royal Tofu. You'd have to be an Osamodas to want to touch it.

2250.descriptionId: This piece of wood sounds hollow. The green sap coming out of it proves that it is the nose of the Trunknid.

2252.descriptionId: You've just broken the tooth of a Crackler. What a pity it was his only tooth! A denture could easily have covered the monthly cost of the Zaap.

2253.descriptionId: This flower facilitates digestion. Now you can stay as long as you want at the local free buffet.

2255.descriptionId: No recent dangerous activity has been reported. The Militiamen Organization is in turmoil since the murder of one of their people. The culprit is apparently a Bontarian.

2256.descriptionId: This rat is now dead meat... one less scum-rodent to crowd out the sewer entrance.

2257.nameId: A piece of the Sewer Wall
2257.descriptionId: This piece of Sewer Wall was found in the stomach of a thingamajig.

2260.descriptionId: Someone, apparently a Brakmarian, slipped this little card into your bag. It says that Warriors are interested in your talents as an assassin and suggests you join the crazy Brakmarian adventure.

2261.descriptionId: You're possessed by a Sniffling Spirit. Your odour and vitality are its bread and butter.

2262.descriptionId: You found a Bontarian who stank of blood. All you know about this fellow is written on this piece of paper.

2263.descriptionId: This staff is possessed by a sniffling spirit. This imp-like being haunts items and living things alike with a special smell before going back to the land of the not-quite-living-but-far-from-dead.

2264.descriptionId: Goblins often make fun of people, which can be quite irritating. Slicing up those bobbling, wobbling Goblins should shut them up, however.

2265.descriptionId: You've freed a sniffling spirit but he didn't anchor on the targeted person. You have written some information about the person on this piece of paper.

2267.descriptionId: This dragomilk is a rare commodity, and no one in the land has yet to see where it comes from. Close your eyes and chant "it's milk" and everything will be fine.

2269.descriptionId: This Eye is intact. Scrambled eyes with a pinch of oregano and some salty tears really gets you going in the morning. At the same time having it in your hands will prove to Oto that you've killed a Blue Larva.

2270.descriptionId: This bunch of eggs looks like a big bunch of grapes. Don't even think about popping them in your mouth though.

2271.descriptionId: Bwork handicraft remains very mysterious. Some adventurers think the purplish colour comes from Goblins. But the origins of the leather are still unknown. Very strange.

2272.descriptionId: This larva has just hatched. As its very first image of the World was your face, it considers you as its mother.

2274.descriptionId: Take an Enutrof. When it's dark in the mines, no one can see him. The Dark Miner you took this candle off on the other hand... well, he can't be seen either since you now have his candle.

2275.descriptionId: The Lousy Pig nearly disappeared from the food chain. People had to mate Boars with Piglets to fill the Cania Plains with Lousy Pigs once more. The Lousy Pig has been mad at the entire world ever since.

2277.descriptionId: To gain credibility, Ghosts roll themselves up in a Shroud. That's one way of frightening lost adventurers.

2278.descriptionId: This fabric once belonged to Mill Burray, hunter of gophers. He spread it out to trap the burrowing creatures and prevent them from tunnelling all over his golf course. The charismatic Captain Chafer took hold of the fabric before disappearing in mysterious circumstances.

2283.descriptionId: This Kwoan Eye has surprising hypnotic effects. Try to keep a clear head while using it.

2284.descriptionId: The entry of the Legendary Golden Larvae Cave is situated a little west of Amakna. The latent powers of your golden larva will allow you to enter the cave. But make sure it doesn't get hurt or else it will run to its daddy's arms.

2285.descriptionId: One absolute certainty about this fabric is that it's itchy. You'll understand when I tell you that an Ouginak used to use it as a handkerchief.

2286.descriptionId: These bandages are revolutionary: triple thickness, ultra-resistant and violet-scented. Shaped for confidence, shaped for comfort.

2288.descriptionId: Many tourists come to the Wabbit Islands especially to find a Wabbit Paw which is supposed to be a lucky charm. It's not true unfortunately, but keep it to yourself otherwise tourism could suffer from it.

2294.descriptionId: At first sight these entrails do not look particularly mouth-watering. However, if you chop them finely with some sun-dried herbs, some wild mint and then braise them in a rusty cauldron, they'll make a satisfying meal for discerning Chafers.

2304.descriptionId: This fragment of polished stone comes from the left buttock of a Crackblade. There's nothing finer for squashing Arachnees, except for the Crackblade itself, perhaps.

2305.descriptionId: This fragment of pointed stone comes from the right shoulder blade of a Plain Crackler. Or maybe it's a part of the lower abdomen. Anyway, just be careful where you put it.

2306.descriptionId: Jon Lemon used to do a cover of this stone's song: "You'll neeever break, neeeever break, neeeever break, neeever break... my heart of stone. (Oh no no!)"

2308.descriptionId: This badge allows warriors who have fallen in battle to be identified. Apparently some people collect them in Bonta.

2309.descriptionId: This red candle is unlike any other.

2322.descriptionId: Don't be fooled, these small toothy-pegs are actually real sharp, stinky, used fangs. Sometimes unscrupulous Enutrof dentists replace teeth with them.

2324.descriptionId: This piece of watermelon looks juicy and unparallelled in freshness.

2325.descriptionId: The famous minstrel Jon Lemon once composed an ode to this fruit: "Happiness is a warm Banana".

2326.descriptionId: They say that oranges are not the only fruit.

2328.descriptionId: This golden pearl is a gift from the small larva you have accompanied. Consequently, it has a great sentimental value... and some monetary value too. Its softness and colour make it a perfect gift for every person who has even the slightest feminine side.

2329.descriptionId: This juicy Lolwut pear is made of win.

2330.descriptionId: This capsule contains extracts of magical citrus fruits. You are advised to shake it before opening, so the pulp doesn't stay stuck to the bottom.

2331.descriptionId: This isn't the most nutritious of vegetables and it often requires strong seasoning to make it a bit more tasty. In spite of its bad reputation, however, it's really quite healthy. Well, healthy for everyone except Bworks. No one knows why, however.

2332.descriptionId: This boiled sweet appears to be slightly past its best-before-date, or might have been stored in a cupboard next to an open can of Bow Meow food, as it has a rather unusual taste. Eating it might stop you crying, for a few minutes at least.

2333.descriptionId: This sweet will increase your concentration during fights but it tastes truly terrible. (DOUBLE-TAP TO USE. Experience received bonus and a bonus of 10 Prospecting for the next 30 fights.)

2336.descriptionId: This poor Chafer will never rattle again.

2337.descriptionId: This book appears to be magic. Very strange.

2339.descriptionId:
A mid-level warrior should wear anything but rags or flashy clothes. A better option might be the following:
- A Camate
- A Vitality Headband and a Vital Belt
- Kluh's Boots
- A Brakmarian Cloak.

2340.descriptionId: You must be a real fetishist to own these... or is someone making fun of you.

2341.descriptionId: Mech Riorraw specially designed this bow. It can cross lava rivers and reach the top of Brakmar walls. No more, no less.

2342.descriptionId: Domen gave you this ring. If you give it back it means you support the destruction of life itself. Which is perfectly alright, of course, you'll just have to find some new friends.

2343.descriptionId: Djaul gave you this bracelet. It shows everyone that you agree with his words.

2344.descriptionId: Domen gave you this letter addressed to Oto.

2345.descriptionId: This turtle won't show off any longer.

2346.descriptionId: Sorry, this is NOT Dragovamp, the famous flying bat outfit. This is the outfit of an inhabitant of the cemetery, a sort of Rogue.

2347.descriptionId: This report relates the Brakmar attack on the East wall.

2349.descriptionId: Domen gave you this letter addressed to Oto, but you forgot to give it to him.

2350.descriptionId: Is this the tuft of hair you ripped out of that Osamodas' chest that time?

2351.descriptionId: You get to eat and drink at the same time with this bread.

2352.descriptionId: "I have to talk to you, come and see me when you have a moment to yourself. See you soon, my young friend."

2353.descriptionId: "Hi, I'm Larry Poller, we met when Colonel Lyeno was freed. I need your help. Come and see me when you have a moment to yourself. See you soon."

2354.descriptionId: Cooked with great loving care, this Turtle Brain can become a delicious meal.

2355.descriptionId: This blueish dust is a very powerful magic catalyst.

2356.descriptionId: You have a Wonderful Power until your next fight.

2357.descriptionId: This wood seems to be completely heat-resistant. Don't try to use it to make a fire as you will die of exposure before the wood ever lights.

2358.descriptionId: This wood is the softest you can find. It is solid, malleable and a joy to carve.

2359.descriptionId: Ufot Eticili gave you this small brooch.

2360.descriptionId: It's the title deed of Ufot Eticili's house.

2361.descriptionId: This bow is a creation of the inspired Mulic Bere. Its maximum range is just incredible. The problem is the minimum range can also be as incredible.

2362.descriptionId: Paro Cabanne's prediction for the next elections.

2365.descriptionId: This ordinary-looking bramble leaf is an essential plant for some strange recipes.

2366.descriptionId: This metal and diamond fishing rod is the only pole that can support a Kralove's weight. It is also drenched with the scent of a female Kralove in order to give you some chance of luring this monster.

2367.descriptionId: Raya Bean thought he knew how to make friends. He often invited complete strangers to fancy-dress balls and bought them dinner, champagne and magnificent jewels. His conversation, in contrast, was paltry and extremely monotonous...

2368.descriptionId: Ramoune was a childhood friend of the sunny Nova. When Ramoune decided to put his spotless mind at rest for an eternal nap, he put an end to their friendship.

2369.descriptionId: This dazzling belt is the result of a mad bet to restore one of the most dazzling belts ever created in Amakna: it's the Dazzling Belt. Pakape Promethe won the contest.

2370.descriptionId: Some incredibly light equipment that finally brings a little delicacy into the cruel World of the Bwork.

2371.descriptionId: Jiva recommends this belt for those long, cold waking nights. If stained, hand wash with Rimennelle.

2372.descriptionId: Wearing these boots, you'll feel like you're walking on fresh grass. Their particular niche is the bio-conservative Hyuppie demographic.

2373.descriptionId: Moon Hair, used to make this pair of boots, is absolutely ideal for keeping your feet warm. These boots are also a heart-warming memory of Moon.

2374.descriptionId: Tarsy the hermit quite obviously couldn't stand visitors. Any guests who did dare come along quickly left with nothing but a big, red boot mark on their back.

2375.descriptionId: Wearing these boots, you'll hear the noise of the wind on the coast or the cries of a chafer Lancer lost in the inmost depths of the labyrinth. They're disturbingly similar.

2376.descriptionId: This axe is the only blade capable of resisting the aggressive power of the Kaerlier tree and therefore, the only one that can cut it down.

2379.descriptionId: This wood comes from the legendary Kaerlier. Its properties are quite surprising.

2380.descriptionId: It's a strange cloak made of pieces of Mushd which are very much all of one piece. And you can give the one who is laughing a piece of his mind.

2381.descriptionId: This cloak was made out of a pennant which used to be kept on the highest tower of Amakna Castle. That's probably why it smells like fresh, sun-kissed linen waving in the Junssidor breeze...

2382.descriptionId: Maimpa, an Ecaflip who wasn't afraid of heights... he thought he'd always land on his feet. One day, he landed on a starving Trool and was buried the same day on the very spot where his remains were found... Well, the spot where the biggest pieces were found.

2383.descriptionId: Made of Scaraleaf wings, the Kwag'U Cape feels like stiff cardboard... as if the reddish dye had coagulated.

2384.descriptionId: There's something beastly about these boots. Don't be shocked if a Boowolf starts humping a limb when you put them on. Does your neck count as a limb? Well, it does for a loved-up Boowolf.

2385.descriptionId: Ideal for laying on the green grass of your garden or wiping the green mess in your nose, the Grazor is one of the few inanimate objects that can multitask.

2386.descriptionId: This strange cape draws its strength from its rundown look. The dirtier it is, the more useful it is.

2387.descriptionId:
This cloak smells very bad - it has to be said. Truth be told, it's made with a dense mixture of monster hairs, which gives off this wonderful medley of odours.
Do not confuse the Hairy Cloak with Hairy Pie, which is something else entirely.

2388.descriptionId: A long time ago, an Ecaflip follower called Dodge dropped a valuable treasure map which was carved on stone. He made an amulet of the largest piece, believing he would one day unite the pieces once more. Then he lost the amulet.

2389.descriptionId: Dodge brought meaning to his life by smashing, burning, grinding, selling... no, sorry not selling... ehh... throwing away, spitting on... everything he owned. And you should see what he did to his kamas. My Lord, I know they're only a moulded piece of copper, but still, I pity those poor coins.

2390.descriptionId: This amulet is almost perfect. It considerably increases the Wisdom of anyone who wears it. It's useful for making yourself appear wise in front of your friends, or passing yourself off as a model pupil.

2391.descriptionId: There's an old Sufokia saying that goes: "Spank one day, Fatty Bum Bum the day after." The longer you think about it, the more ridiculous that saying gets.

2392.descriptionId: Thanks to the artisans of Amakna who are multitalented, the Modified Dragolyre is almost perfect.

2393.descriptionId: The Osamodas Onehaieuf Bek craved the respect of his guild members, so he decided to create a revolutionary Amulet. He found inspiration one morning while making some breakfast for his friends... Okaaaay!

2394.descriptionId: This heart-warming, sun kissed little thing lends a feeling of invulnerability to the wearer. It's so light that many wear it for years without realising they have it on... Yes, there are those among you who do not shower for years at a time.

2395.descriptionId: Mad Bacon was a little vile demon with the enraging habit of standing right in front of people and not moving. He was magic-proof, which imposed a certain respect at the time. The Mad bacon went underground recently, he stood in front of the wrong guy for the wrong length of time.

2396.descriptionId: The name of this amulet is unpronounceable in the language of the country where it is manufactured, for non-natives, anyway. To make it more appealing to the Amaknian market, its designer used the services of a local translator, a certain Lou Gull, to help him come up with a new name. When the designer saw how much Lou Gull charged for his services, he used a cheaper translator instead. Evidently, you get what you pay for.

2397.descriptionId: Law-bibe was an old man who took whatever came to hand to create strange, strange items. One day, he made a locket with scrap off the street. He put it round his neck, and felt a strange sensation. A very strange sensation.

2398.descriptionId: The self-made Kaniger Rucky Balboua gave this eye to Melyonen to thank her for introducing his future wife, Adriana, to him. Soon after, they separated. Rucky would scream her name at the top of his voice and burst into tears without the slightest warning.

2399.descriptionId: José Bovey was a Mastogob shepherd. Mastogobs are a distant cousin of the Gobballs. Some of his Mastogob troop had a softer fleece than the others, and he sold these fleeces for more money. To distinguish between animals, he attached this necklace around their necks.

2400.descriptionId: These boots aren't just dark, they're Dark with a capital D. So don't be surprised if a vampire falls in love with you when you wear them. I don't know if you've had a hard life up to now, but I would say it would be the worst thing that's ever happened to you. The worst, seriously. Worse than, well, I don't know. Really bad. Like, awful.

2401.descriptionId: This card is linked to Master Kweats. That's all you'll ever know and all you need to know.

2403.descriptionId: In bygone days, it was used for parole, the Peeka Belt has apparently a spare power in relation to the other belts. But nobody has found what it is. You'd better keep a close eye on the thing.

2404.descriptionId: This belt once belonged to a Sewer Rat. It suits it perfectly. What I'm not supposed to tell you is that the little rodent had the most horrifying case of love handle you've ever seen.

2409.descriptionId: The Fire Kwak Headdress will make a real charmer out of you... Charm is the second best way of sidelining your enemies in the heat of combat... The other is raw, unpackaged, unapproved-by-the-FDA LUST. Let me tell you, though, with the beasts that wander round these parts, you'll feel like a big of cheese in a Bonta rat trap if you take the latter approach.

2410.descriptionId: The Treechelmet protects you from hangovers.

2411.descriptionId: This magnificent headgear increases Strength and Intelligence... if you can stand the smell.

2412.descriptionId: This cloak won't make you fly but it will itch like hell. Even if you sew a big "S" on it, it won't work... though some people a few years ago on a cliff were absolutely convinced of it. Too bad.

2413.descriptionId: With these Treechnid Leaves on, you'll be able to strut about in the forest without being recognised. However, beware of the Treechnids in search of spring buddings.

2414.descriptionId: This cape was designed to please - it's hard-wearing and comfortable, it looks classy, and it's a good step up from a Novice Cloak. But it smells dreadful and plays merry hell with your nostrils. Well, what do you expect? You can't have it all.

2415.descriptionId: The Fire Kwakblade is a magnificent weapon. Even if you don't scare your enemy away, at least, you might make an lasting impression.

2416.descriptionId: The user guide explains that this surprising hammer can release astonishingly powerful energy when correctly used. Another Osamodas' user guide translated into Sadida.

2417.descriptionId: This staff has kept all the aggressiveness of the Treechnid, but hasn't kept the musty smell which often characterises old Treechnids.

2418.descriptionId: Using this ring, your master may be able to find you if you get lost while delivering a letter.

2419.descriptionId: This ring once belonged to the renowned Bouze Lite Yeah, the saviour of the modern age. He never stopped going on about some place he used to drink called the Inn 'Finity and Beyond'.

2420.descriptionId: The branch of a Treechnid isn't easy to carve, but with some perseverance you'll get a simple and stylish ring. Simple and stylish like a sleeping Osamodas.

2421.descriptionId: With those Fire Kwak spurs on, every Sram for miles around will be on your back.

2422.descriptionId: These are the most comfortable boots ever created. The inside seems to be padded with Gobball Wool and you can feel a liquid running through your toes. For all you know, it could be Gobball Saliva... even Blood. Whatever!

2423.descriptionId: You'd get the same effects out of this pair of Boots as you would from an evening at the tavern. You must have a drink, or plenty of drinks, to get the optimum effect. And the next day, your legs will feel as heavy as these boots.

2424.descriptionId: With all these feathers around your neck, you'll look like Aldo Rado, the great Sacrier adventurer eternally searching for a golden city.

2425.descriptionId: A fine piece of Gobball horn, this. The material is known for bringing peace and wisdom to these tranquil beasts, so a Gobball Amulet should bring peace and wisdom too. Although since you murdered the poor thing to get it, maybe the opposite will happen. Who knows.

2426.descriptionId: This small Arachnee is the proof that you don't have to stuff an animal to turn it into an amulet. It will tickle your neck and might even spin a web in front of your mouth if you yawn too much or talk too much rubbish.

2427.descriptionId: This Belt is perfect to strut about like a Fire Kwak during the season of love. Provided, of course, that it's the only thing you're wearing.

2428.descriptionId: Easy to wear, this belt is quite light in relation to its size. The wool looks brand new... according to the legend, about a hundred Gobballs had to be cut to pieces to get this smooth and silky look.

2429.descriptionId: This belt will increase your self-confidence and give you abs of wood. An anti-Arachnee treatment is nevertheless strongly recommended once a year. It is more or less the same as the hair of a Sadida, but with a lot less anti-parasites.

2430.descriptionId: You pity the Blue Jelly, don't you... And you still managed to treat it like this!

2431.descriptionId: You've bullied this poor little Lemon Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as flat as it is now...

2432.descriptionId: You've bullied this poor little Strawberry Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as misshapen as it is now...

2433.descriptionId: You've bullied this poor little Mint Jelly. Be careful because one day you might find yourself as squashed as it is now...

2435.descriptionId: Thanks to these homemade boots, Kere was the only Eniripsa ever to win the Great Amakna Triathlon. The Ecaflips thought the second coming was at hand when they saw him skimming along on the Asse Sea... For years afterwards he was harassed by Pandawas begging him to turn their water into wine.

2436.descriptionId: This pot of Lemon Jelly looks quite strange. According to Elrik Ola, this jelly comes from his place. From the other side of the galaxy, to be more precise. It's a pity it tastes so good!

2437.descriptionId: Some people say that Royal Lemon Jelly is much tastier than all the others, but that could be because the lemon flavour hides the taste of the jelly.

2438.descriptionId: The Royal Gobball headgear will never go out of fashion. Besides being elegant, the bearer gains Strength and Intelligence.

2440.descriptionId: This sword doesn't know whether it's coming or going. It inflicts all types of elemental damage.

2441.descriptionId: This ring increases life, just like the smell of Royal Gobball it gives off increases its charm.

2442.descriptionId: They shine, they radiate power, they are fit for a king! Three cheers.

2443.descriptionId: This amulet increases Strength and Intelligence.

2444.descriptionId: This magnificent belt increases your Vitality and conveniently carries loads of items. It's so soft that you can even use it to bind your lady-love hand and foot when she refuses to stay home.

2445.descriptionId: On top of being classy, this cape, worn by the great Royal Gobball, inspires the wearer with incredible strength.

2446.descriptionId: Without any hairs or threads, this cape remains a mystery for the intellectuals of Amakna. At last count there were ten.

2447.descriptionId: With this headgear on, the hotties will be queuing up to lick you. It's one of those things Captain Chafer always dreamt of in his own time.

2469.descriptionId: There's no need to bite your nails with this ring on your fingers, just lick them instead!

2470.descriptionId: These boots are great in summer because they give off a smell of wild strawberries in the heat... which also masks the stench of perspiration left behind by the hairy toes of the old Sadida who wore them before you.

2471.descriptionId: The worst thing about this item is that when you get hungry, you'll be tempted to take a bite of it.

2472.descriptionId: This amulet betrays your love of jelly.

2473.descriptionId: Classy but not very effective, this cloak will suit young adventurers nonetheless.

2474.descriptionId: This hat is not really useful for anything... it does scare the boys away quite nicely though.

2475.descriptionId: A small but pleasing ring for beginners which will amuse young children, or Ecaflips.

2476.descriptionId: These standard boots are popular with young folk of adventurous spirit.

2477.descriptionId: A small belt for budding adventurers.

2478.descriptionId: Not too classy or even powerful, but it's better when you've collected the whole set.

2484.descriptionId: Keep this as a memento of the Lousy Pig you just defeated. The problem is that he might hold it against you later on.

2485.descriptionId: The MUST-HAVE item, but only in the North-East of Amakna.

2489.descriptionId: This elegant cape will make you irresistible to all the noobs out there.

2495.descriptionId: This Eye glows in the dark even once extracted from its owner's face. It's so bright you can read your favourite comic books all night long.

2498.descriptionId: The Vegamu attracts swarms of Moskitos that mistake it for one of their friends. They are always disappointed when they see this character.

2502.descriptionId: Whitish Fang Paws are highly prized by Amakna's gourmet chefs. They share their magical properties with whoever puts them on. If you put them on, however, you'll quickly find that luck is not as random as you.

2515.descriptionId: At first sight, this snout doesn't look very fresh. But don't be mistaken, it's the most tender and most refined snout that ever did sniff.

2517.descriptionId:
This cape used to belong to a famous hero known for confronting the terrible Doctor Wily who wanted to invade and dominate the World of Twelve with his army of summoned creatures. The good Doctor died before all his minions had time to attack.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

2518.descriptionId:
Silvia sewed this bizarre cape together from old curtains. Fortunately, you can't really tell since it looks more like a mop that's been boiled in Lousy Pig blood.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

2519.descriptionId:
This helmet is perfect for excelling in the most extreme situations and the most exclusive company.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

2520.descriptionId:
This helmet once belonged to the old Jojo, a renowned hero of times gone by. He is world famous for his exploits, but it's still hard to understand the legendary devotion of his fans.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

2521.descriptionId: Roll, the boot owner's lovely sister, specialised in astral taxidermy. Long ago, no one knew the difference between astral taxidermy and regular taxidermy. Nowadays, it's easy to see that astral taxidermy is the involves stuffing astral creatures. If you still can't understand where they went wrong, you obviously don't know just how stupid they were.

2522.descriptionId: These boots enabled the famous Jojo to perfect his famous roundhouse kick, which was known as "Hot Red Kick". No one knows where this name comes from since his boots were unmistakably white!

2523.descriptionId: This belt has been especially designed to protect the hips of our valuable heroes. Totally useless to you then.

2524.descriptionId: Rumour has it that this belt was created by Captain Blooe himself. Isn't that incredibly... incredible! You do believe me, don't you?

2526.descriptionId: This Scythe was originally designed to cut down Iops, but Lord Crow realised that harvesting grain was just as profitable as harvesting blood-thirsty warriors.

2529.descriptionId: Whatever you do, don't drink this potion. To dissolve cholesterol, hooch is a better choice.

2530.descriptionId: A bit heavy but really pretty, you'll be the queen of the night with these Caraboots on.

2531.descriptionId: Just like you, turtles have very small heads. How convenient! This cap is just the right size for both of you.

2532.descriptionId: A practical, well-made cloak. It won't make a champion out of you, but then again, I can't think of anything that would make a champion out of you.
