2534.descriptionId: Ideal for keeping cool in those hot summers on Moon Island, as well as ideal to cool down the advances of your more eager paramours, this cape will satisfy all the needs of the modern adventurer.

2535.descriptionId: This Ice Kwak headdress will keep your head full of fresh and brilliant ideas. And before you say anything, it doesn't work on Iops.

2537.descriptionId: Ideal for toning your hips, this belt will allow you to keep cool below the belt too.

2538.descriptionId: Whatever you do, don't drink this potion. To dissolve cholesterol, hooch is a better choice.

2539.descriptionId: As paradoxical as it may seem, this potion is liquid.

2540.descriptionId: As paradoxical as it may seem, this potion is liquid.

2541.descriptionId: Whatever you do, don't drink this potion. To dissolve cholesterol, hooch is a better choice.

2542.descriptionId: This potion brings you home whenever you want.

2543.descriptionId: As paradoxical as it may seem, this potion is liquid.

2544.descriptionId: Dreadfully sharp and incredibly classy, this blade will make your Crobak friends jealous.

2545.descriptionId: With these boots you'll feel incredibly light and peculiarly ridiculous.

2546.descriptionId: Thanks to this magnificent helmet, you'll have all the class of the notorious Lord Crow.

2547.descriptionId: Long ago, the best tailors of Amakna united to scavenge the remains of Lord Crow and make the greatest cloak the World has ever seen. It looks incredible draped grandly over your shoulders, but for some reason, it gives you the strong urge to eat cheese.

2551.descriptionId: The favourite dish of the Ouginak - Kaniger Ears with plain sauce. Traditionally, it should be cooked with a lot of wild mint and some nails for texture.

2553.descriptionId: This, ladies and gentlemen is a reaaal Cannonball. Heavy as a whipped hippy, it tends to make holes in the skull of anyone who gets too close. Not the best idea then.

2556.descriptionId: Blop pollen causes all mild allergies in the World. What is more worrying is that all lethal allergies begin with mild allergies. In short, don't keep this pollen in your pockets if you don't need it.

2557.descriptionId: As strange as it may seem, Blop Petals are not edible, neither when cooked nor raw.

2561.descriptionId: As if a Trool needed a Bracelet of Strength! This incredible bone-grinding machine wears one bracelet on each wrist.

2567.descriptionId: This blessing will increase Wisdom for the next few battles.

2568.descriptionId: This blessing makes you fall into a state of semi-consciousness... your reflexes will be weakened in your next fight.

2569.descriptionId: This parchment will make you sharper for your next fight.

2570.descriptionId: This parchment will make you a bit inert at one point during the next fight.

2587.descriptionId: This hatchet is the ideal mascot for any lumberjack. It's not really useful (you can't fell a tree with it), but having it attached to your belt might calm and reassure you.

2589.descriptionId: This small Axe can't cut down trees but can protect you against small monsters. If you find yourself face to face with a Minotoror, just drop it and run.

2590.descriptionId: One day, a Bwork smith apprentice made a range of axes, a range of one-size-fits-all, ergonomic axes... THE ideal weapon for a young, simple-minded adventurer like yourself.

2592.descriptionId: Very light and easy to handle, this axe allows the Bambou chopper to keep well out of harm's way.

2593.descriptionId: This axe, made of Oliviolet wood, is the only one that can harm the Oliviolet. You gotta fight fire with fire.

2595.descriptionId: This axe might be primitive, but it's also very deadly... like a kick between the legs.

2597.descriptionId: This long axe worms its way into the cracks of the biggest trees and splits the giants in half. Its use in battle is no different. Ouch!

2598.descriptionId: This peak is in fact an osseous protuberance. As Dragoturkeys never use it, people were wondering how it could be so worn out. But since scientists saw them rub it against Trools, it all makes sense.

2599.descriptionId: Located on the back of the Dragoturkey, this peak can be used to scratch your crotch, provided you can mount a Dragoturkey.

2600.descriptionId: This big axe makes a horrendous noise when it falls on something, reducing everyone in the vicinity to petrified silence.

2601.descriptionId: Darsson was a valiant Enutrof, though he was not very good with his hands. As he often dropped his shovel in fights, he decided to tie a spare axe onto his belt. It saved his life more than once. Then he dropped his axe. Poor bugger will never have kids.

2602.descriptionId: As big as a Crab Eye, the Glukoko petal is made up of lots of sticky sponge-bubbles. It's often used to plug leaks in roofs after a harsh tempest or a drunken Saturday night.

2603.descriptionId: This axe is very useful for chopping up the more stubborn parts of a tree, such as the grizzled knots on an old oak... A few swipes with this fellow and you'll have a perfectly round trunk.

2604.descriptionId: This bardiche is mainly employed by the militiamen of Amakna. Its unusually large size and girth undoubtedly compensate for something else.

2606.descriptionId: Many inscriptions can be read on this big axe. Its creator, Claus Ansipedi, thought it would be a good idea to bring a semblance of culture to those cretinous dogs. What a waste of time! Just as he was about to finish his inscriptions, a crazed Amaknan drunk cracked the poor man's skull open for 'spoiling a perfectly good axe.'

2608.descriptionId: This axe was forged between two great stones, and changed hands so many times in the process that it has travelled the World ten times over in its lifetime.

2609.descriptionId: But where's the owner hiding? Maybe he went out to buy some pizza.

2610.descriptionId: But where's the owner hiding? Maybe he moved out a short while ago.

2611.descriptionId: But where's the owner hiding? Maybe he's having a nap inside.

2612.descriptionId: This long axe is used by horny-fisted seamen to battle the biggest fish the briny depths vomit to the surface. It will atomize anything smaller than a whale.

2613.descriptionId: But where's the owner hiding? Maybe he's in the shower.

2614.descriptionId: Dame Zel was a pretty young princess who radiated intelligence and freshness. During a Bwork raid on her city, she shocked everyone when she took out this axe and, Moses-like, sent half the besieging army to oblivion.

2615.descriptionId: This axe is well known for rapidly and permanently resolving disputes between drunken Enutrofs.

2616.descriptionId: This axe owes its name to the test made to prove its dreadful efficiency: a gigantic axe, a mythophobiac and a hall full of bards.

2618.descriptionId: To sip a fresh drink, you need a coloured straw. Now, you'll have to find a hole in the Kokonut.

2623.descriptionId: Breeders have always believed the Bwaks flew away at the end of their lives... this Bwak must be an exception.

2624.descriptionId: The hardiest hunters always want to collect a Rokoko as a souvenir, whatever the cost, and then never come back to this cursed island. Why not give it a go?

2625.descriptionId: Strength emanates from this doll... you have the strange feeling that it is calling somebody.

2626.descriptionId: Strength emanates from this doll... you have the strange feeling that it is looking for somebody.

2627.descriptionId: Strength emanates from this doll... you have the strange feeling that it is listening to somebody.

2628.descriptionId: Strength emanates from this doll... you have the strange feeling that it is waiting for somebody.

2629.descriptionId: This cape, which looks royal, offers incredible protection. It made the reputation of a renowned female tailor who died victim of her success, squashed in the crowd.

2635.descriptionId: Danioul Garnioul the Baker, a jealous rival of Xavier the Baker, came up with this recipe. Since his customers were always making fun of his ridiculous name, he avenged himself by kneading his dough with his bare feet. It's said his sales went through the roof.

2636.descriptionId: This Bread contains tiny, delicious pieces of meat which look and taste like fowl. And yet, if you bring this bread to your nose, you will smell nothing but Tofu.

2637.descriptionId: Made of bone, horn and cartilage, this curved bone is as sharp as an Ecaflip's claw.

2638.descriptionId: 100% natural, this sword was forged from the sixth claw of an Ecaflip. Don't go picking your nose with it!

2639.descriptionId: A female Ecaflip smith created this sword after failing to master the ancestral technique "Claw of Ceangal". She called her sword "Fake Claw of Ceangal", happy in the knowledge she could master something at last.

2640.descriptionId: Strangely sculpted, this staff doesn't come from around here. It smells of the darkness and dankness associated with Brakmar's old haunts.

2641.descriptionId: This hat comes in red and white and is so classy, you'll be invited to all the best parties in town. If you see the Ambassador, as you soon surely will, don't forget to thank him in the traditional way: "Ambassador, you're really spoiling us with these..."

2645.descriptionId: The Dragon Pig didn't smell that one coming. Hahaha.

2648.descriptionId: The Kwak is no scavenger. The rotting flesh under his claw-nails is, in fact... well, I'll spare you the details.

2655.descriptionId: This belt is a patchwork of Lord Crow's body parts. Once equipped with it, you'll have a wonderful sensation of power. LeChouque even agreed to add his buckle as a show of support.

2677.descriptionId: This belt has been made out of LeChouque's most powerful belongings, notably his famous boxer shorts. It's enough to plunge the entire female clientele of the Pirates Bar into mass confusion.

2678.descriptionId: This belt almost looks like a loincloth. Very convenient for camouflaging yourself among the Kokokos of Moon Island, or even seducing one of them.

2681.descriptionId:
This small belt is ideal for protecting your most sensitive parts from critical blows. 
Just check that the shoemaker has removed the owner from inside before trying it.

2683.descriptionId:
This small belt is ideal for protecting your most sensitive parts from critical blows. 
Just check that the shoemaker has removed the owner from inside before trying it.

2685.descriptionId:
This small belt is ideal for protecting your most sensitive parts from critical blows. 
Just check that the shoemaker has removed the owner from inside before trying it.

2687.descriptionId:
This small belt is ideal for protecting your most sensitive parts from critical blows. 
Just check that the shoemaker has removed the owner from inside before trying it.

2688.descriptionId: Once you have equipped this belt it's hard to lose it, that's the least you can say! The scatterbrains and the serial victims of theft among you will be grateful.

2689.descriptionId: The shoemaker who created this belt using the leftovers of a Dragoturkey, certainly didn't think too hard about the name.

2710.descriptionId: An improved model of the standard version, the Wild Banisation Belt has been specially reinforced with hunting Wild Dragoturkeys in mind.

2803.descriptionId: That strange belt is made entirely of fragments of crab claws and carapaces. Even with its powerful magic, it will smell of fish forever and ever. You'd just better get used to it.

2804.descriptionId: The Boowolf donated his precious organs for the making of this incredible belt. Not willingly of course, but we can still be thankful. Don't trust its strange appearance, which could unnerve the most depraved Chafer - it's very powerful.

2807.descriptionId: Bowisse the shoemaker made this belt. He gave it to Brouce Boulgoure when the legendary lumberjack managed to uproot the Soft Oak... You don't even deserve to hear about such heroism, child!

2808.descriptionId: Yes my child, it will be hard to resist you with this belt on. Bowisse consequently advises you to never get too close to a Dragon Pig while wearing it. They're known to be lusty devils.

2809.descriptionId: Behind the grotesque name, hides a beautiful creation by Bowisse the Shoemaker. Behind the beautiful creation, hides a grotesque reality... the belt is made of the skin and bones of Bowisse's Chafer victims.

2810.descriptionId: The magical powers of this magnificent red belt will help you concentrate better and learn quicker. Some Iops even manage to hobble to the end of the alphabet before their ignorant lives are extinguished.

2811.descriptionId: Here's a belt that'll please the thrill-seekers among you! It was designed to aid the easy and safe hunting of Ouginaks. Mortality rates remained the same as before, but hunters kept wearing the thing. You have to admit it's classy though, no?

2998.descriptionId: This exceptional wool has experienced some bone-chilling moments, like the terrible encounter with Vlad. Its hairs are so thick that they can protect you from even the most deceitful blows.

2999.descriptionId: This leather is as resistant as Brakmar's fortifications. Its intrinsic qualities lend themselves to the making of high quality items.

3203.descriptionId: The supposed origin of this ring is doubtful, to say the least. Apparently it once belonged to a clan of Kanniballs of the worst type, the fern eaters. Certainly a story to frighten any young Sadida, and quite a few older Sadidas too.

3204.descriptionId: As of last spring, this is officially the trendiest belt on the streets of Bonta. The insignia of a renowned brotherhood of shoemakers adorns the buckle.

3205.descriptionId: It's the most fashionable belt in the sewers of Brakmar, perfect if you're looking to give the impression that you're a hard nut to crack. In your case it's just an impression, but it's useful nonetheless.

3206.descriptionId: Specially designed to reward skilful knights, the Xerbo must be worn without underwear and in winter only.

3207.descriptionId: These boots are a dramatic improvement on even the most carefully crafted footwear. Comfortable and light, they promise consistent pedal satisfaction with every wear. At the sight of this pair, even your opponent will give a faintly happy, wistfully envious smile.

3356.descriptionId: Some people may laugh at you because of this surprising shovel but what does it matter? It's time to accept your style and your personal taste!

3357.descriptionId: In Amakna, when pupils are too loud, too quiet, too smart or too dumb, they receive a firm smash on the knuckles with this hammer. Iop teachers in particular find it works wonders in the context of their one-tiered educational system.

3647.descriptionId: This sickle-like dagger was used to gut travellers who lost their way. It owes its name to the numerous binge drinking parties the owner organised with the money stolen from his victims. More specifically, the name refers to the morning after.

3648.descriptionId: Captain Chafer has disappeared but you have his dagger in your hands. Just imagine what the blade must have seen all that time it was in his murderous grasp.

3649.descriptionId: We owe this magnificent blade to a craftsman named Daguiero. Before a descent into gambling and other dubious activities, this was his last creation worthy of interest. Not a bad way of ending a career...

3650.descriptionId: These powerful daggers are the result of a collaboration between a group of wise craftsmen in order to secure their professional future. The group consisted of two. They both died arguing over the name of the daggers.

3651.descriptionId: A ridiculous, pint-sized artisan named Slaillehine had the wonderful notion of making these magnificent daggers.

3652.descriptionId: Marie Aigue knew how to treat the men folk. With her big staff, she thwarted the advances of many a great Iop knight. One fine day, it was discovered that Marie Aigue was, in fact, a boy dressed as a girl. Suddenly it all made sense.

4241.descriptionId: This sword's fantastic colour will pierce right to your enemy's heart, and then you can cut it out - which is exactly what an Ecaflipette would do! The magnificent pink hue is obtained by soaking the blade in monsters' entrails for several centuries.

4242.descriptionId: This sword was originally an ornate fan for overheated ladies. All you had to do was wave it energetically about the face. The product was soon withdrawn when angry widowers complained they couldn't put their wives' heads back on. It was quickly re-launched as a lethal weapon. That's market research for you!

4381.descriptionId: This strange amulet allows its wearer to relax, chill out and have a nap, right in the middle of a fight. Just like a Feca, in fact.

4382.descriptionId: With its cold, sharp blade, this sword makes the most primitive instincts bubble to the top. Each gesture, even with the best of intentions, results in a blow below the belt.

4684.descriptionId: This amulet contains a part of the Plain Crackler's story that could be summed-up in two lines if anyone knew it. Unfortunately, even the Cracklers have forgotten how it goes.

5122.descriptionId: Pol Dullbow himself ordered this amulet from a renowned jeweller. He wanted to play with several dolls at the same time instead of having to wait for one to die before summoning a new one, something Sadidas like to do a great deal.

5999.descriptionId: This wand gets its frightening powers from its creation, in conditions identical to those at the centre of the earth. That's the story anyway, but try to find someone with a bit of proof.

6438.descriptionId: This Wand is composed of soft materials, making it very tricky to use. However, once produced in combat by an experienced warrior, it reveals its true power.

6439.descriptionId: This ethereal wand is the result of a magic mixture of supernatural elements. Sometimes frightening, sometimes wacky, this wand is the epitome of instability.

6440.descriptionId: This wand is not just an ordinary ball of hair. Its centre absorbs the magic essence of the tufts that fall on it and merges them all together as long hairball. As strange as it may seem, it works!

6442.descriptionId: Always looking for ways to surprise his enemies, the Sadida Aga Dou took care to hang a small doll at the sharp end of his staff. Young Iopettes inevitably rush towards it to get the doll and die from severe impalement.

6443.descriptionId: The renowned and hilarious Yamato, a craftsman unjustly despised because of his ridiculous bow, was the first to dare to imbue an amulet with magic... until then it was believed to be impossible.

6444.descriptionId: Apart from its colour, this amulet has no connection whatsoever to the famous Turquoise Dofus. However, it is every bit as powerful. Sometimes you can read a book by its cover...

6445.descriptionId: This bow has been crafted with the utmost care, giving it a perfect curvature. It is said that its creator used the buttocks of a female Gobball as a model. Tragically, she was cut in half when the bow maker accidentally strung the bow with her inside.

6446.descriptionId: Chiduc was a bow carver, renowned for his errors of pronunciation. He was incapable of pronouncing the letter "b" without adding an "ow" behind. Yet another indication of his erratic genius.

6447.descriptionId: Use this potion to unlearn a level of the Chaferfu Summoning Spell.

6448.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Arachnee Summoning Spell.

6449.descriptionId: Personally I can't think of a better way of impressing the girls at the bus stop than turning yourself into a shadow or even into Lord Crow. This cape will let you do just that. It also makes a great pillow... if you're lucky.

6450.descriptionId: Aman, a renowned female shoemaker had a lover who often stood her up. As love is blind, she still gave him this magnificent belt as a symbol of their secret love.

6451.descriptionId: Seeing this bow, you have to wonder why it has such a soppy name. Maybe it's a respectful prayer to its hordes of victims.

6452.descriptionId: This strangely-shaped bow is a work of art. The Bow Sculptor who created it is also renowned for having exhibited his most controversial models in Loopine's cave, a place forbidden to all but the most hedonistic of bohemians.

6453.descriptionId: This weapon was inspired by this ancient, incredibly specific, Chinese axiom: "Many's the bow that was useful for catching a flying fish and then cooking it on a slow barbecue for several minutes each side, being particularly handy for turning said fish or plucking it out of the coals should it take a tumble."

6454.descriptionId: This Dark Treechnid branch is in fact one of the creature's arms. Ideal for arm-wrestling training, it's above all an excellent weapon for terrorising your childhood enemies or torturing the Trunknids.

6457.descriptionId: This remarkable Alloy was pulled out of the ground far from here. Use it to decorate the fireplace or, if you wish, to hit a Iop over the head.

6458.descriptionId: Kobalite is the most impressive alloy ever discovered. The ancient miners thought it was the perfect mixture until they realised it crumbled into dust when it came into contact with Gobball Slobber.

6459.descriptionId: Your only chance to survive in a mine infested with Dark Miners is to have light. Since you'll never manage to steal one of their precious candles, just wear this amulet... at least it'll bring you some luck.

6460.descriptionId: This magnificent brooch pays homage to the resistance of the miners of the Grimoth Silver Mine. They spent a winter fighting a Crackler of the worst kind but in the end they were killed by a Tofu who wandered into their hideout on his way home. Boy isn't life unfair.

6461.descriptionId: It was this amulet, which was especially designed for older Enutrofs, that allowed Setag to get rid of all the other miners in the Grimoth mine. Quite heavy-handed, but very effective, it must be said.

6462.descriptionId: This little brooch is truly lovely. It was made to encourage unlucky people to try their luck at the fun fair, but it's also useful when you go on epic hunting expeditions.

6463.descriptionId: This ring was made by a famous oriental itinerant, but unfortunately no one could remember his name. He died during an archery contest, putting a Wild Sunflower seed on his head instead of the larger Pumpkin variety.

6464.descriptionId: This ring is an improved version of the celebrated Ring of Satisfaction. It's ideal if you want to step out of the blood-red spotlight of dangerous battle.

6465.descriptionId:
Loopine once asked the monster that haunted his cave the secret to making this ring. The monster said he'd have to do him a few favours in return, and Loopine gladly agreed. 
Let's just say the poor guy never wanted to see another ring in his life after the monster was finished with him, let alone make the bloody things. Blimey!

6466.descriptionId: This amulet allowed Shika Ingalsse to survive on several occasions when furious Gobballs, bent on making her life a misery, attacked her.

6467.descriptionId: Nobody knows who the owner of this ring is. He wanted to remain anonymous after a humiliating defeat inflicted by a summoned Arachnee. We must say in his defence that this Arachnee had been compelled by a Iop...

6468.descriptionId: While other Iops of his age got presents like a Tabi or a wooden Goultard for their communion, Vald got this ring. It's hardly something you can show off to your friends but it's very useful for fighting.

6469.descriptionId: This wedding ring has been worn down by the scratching of barley through hundreds of harvests. It was even there to witness the union of Farle and Shika when they got married in the middle of barley field one spring!

6470.descriptionId: These magnificent boots are perfect for kicking Gobballs in the arse when you're herding the difficult little runts. Children respond just as well to the same encouragement.

6471.descriptionId: These small shoes have been reinforced, repaired and deodorised. They are often used to trap Mush Mush since the substratum left out by the Lousy Pig seems appetising to them...

6472.descriptionId: This padded Golden Dreggheadgear will protect you from bolts of Bwork Magus lightning. Sadly, it won't protect you from real lightning strikes, or the angry, baying mob complaining how, in the good old days of Old Amaknian, lightning strikes used to be called 'strikings'.

6473.descriptionId: This Sapphire Dreggheadgear suits you perfectly. Not everyone is made for it, though - just take a look at the Iops. The bumbling idiots don't even wear it the right way around!

6474.descriptionId: The Black Dreggheadgear is ideal if you want to remain discreet by night, and is thus quite popular with two deeply divergent sections of society: peeping Toms in Madrestam Harbour and those gentle souls, the Piwi watchers of Amakna. The annual convention is always a hoot, a real hoot.

6477.descriptionId: This magnificent hat will help you see everything as bright as daylight, especially during the daytime. It can also be useful to dazzle the beasts haunting the mines or to make Iops believe you're... well anything you tell them.

6480.descriptionId: This Piece of Wicker is as dark as the darkest ghost, as magic as the most magic ghost, as resistant as the most resistant ghost. Just remember ghosts don't exist.

6481.descriptionId: This magnificent hat was created on Dora Bora Island, south of Moon Island. Perfectly adapted to fight, it's also much appreciated as a fruit basket, for traumatised Kokokos nuts for instance.

6482.descriptionId: An improved version of the Jouik Krampe, this hat was made out of the best resources found on Moon Island, giving it a rural character. Even if you don't look like a Kanniball, you'll still give some great headbutts.

6483.descriptionId: According to the legend, this impressive helmet turns anyone who wears it into a Bronze Bwork. The helmet was held responsible for a string of incidents where defenceless hobos mysteriously disappeared, leaving only the taste of licked spoon behind them.

6484.descriptionId: When daggers are not enough anymore, when gods are making fun of you, you have to find your own way of fighting. Some followers of Sram have apparently understood, others are still counting on the help of gods.

6485.descriptionId: Because of his clattering bones and an obvious lack of dexterity and intelligence, the Chafer Archer has never been able to handle such a bow as this one. Although your bones may not shake like his, there's no guarantee a beginner like yourself won't look just as foolish.

6488.descriptionId: Some people make beer with this kind of root. Given that the Soft Oak had no tolerance for the grog, it's very inadvisable.

6489.descriptionId: This wood has had a few close shaves with Brouce Boulgoure's Axe. It has also experienced many other mysterious and dangerous things that even the book of the Bwork Magus does not reveal. You have every reason to expect the worst.

6490.descriptionId: This amber contains one of the Soft Oak's leaves, trapped for aeons in the sticky sap. This precious treasure is truly a collector's item, just like LeChouque's yellow and red polkadot socks.

6491.descriptionId: This bow is a messed up crossbreed of a Trunknid and a Treechnid. It's obviously a failure for a lumberjack, but a true success for a bow carver. Your parents wish they could say the same about you.

6492.descriptionId: The distance between the two ends of this staff is identical to the space between the eyes of the Lenalds. Will these howwible Wabbits stop at nothing?

6493.descriptionId: These wabbits thongs give you the "cawwot attitude." They are recommended by experts of ritual dancing, tap-dancing or the Captain Chafer fast tango.

6494.descriptionId: Used by the most renowned Amaknan Eniripsas, this wand is a great for casting vicious spells at your enemies. Most people use it to make themselves or their friends more intelligent. They say... though I find it hard to believe myself... but they say that someone once turned a Iop into a rat with this. Such an enormous leap in intelligence is unlikely, but try it out!

6495.descriptionId: Made from the remains of the Soft Oak, this wand is ultra-powerful. Just wave it from right to left according to the specified patterns and it may trigger a shower of toads... or you may look like a perfect idiot.

6496.descriptionId: This wand can sometimes turn against its owner. In this case, the best thing you can do is to give it to one of your enemies, or to a Iop - idiots like them will certainly believe it's a present.

6497.descriptionId: Brouce Boulgoure's wife, an Eniripsa, was always stealing her husband's famous axe. To stop her, he cut off one of her wings and an arm. Then, he gave her this wand by way of an apology. What a gentleman.

6498.descriptionId: These briefs of respectable size still sport the marks of their former owner (plus some really strange hairs). On the buttocks or on the head, this garment will bring you unlimited respect around Amakna.

6499.descriptionId: The teeth of this amulet have eaten away more Cawwots than Brouce Boulgoure has uprooted trees, so don't be surprised if you find Tiwabbits trying to give you kisses on the neck as a result of your powerful Cawwot awoma.

6500.descriptionId: These Ears won't improve your hearing but the good news is that your friends will easily spot you in a crowd...and that your enemies will have a good laugh. Keep smiling, this pair of ears will prove essential with time.

6501.descriptionId: If you carry this bag on your back, you can go on a trip without worrying about food. Even if the Cawwot is as empty as a Iop's skull, the leaves on top of it can grow again. Ideal to make herbal tea.

6503.descriptionId: The Polpullet is the result of a cross breed between an aggressive Fire Kwak and a sickly Tofu. Time out of mind, the Polpullet hunt has been an unchanged ritual. Hunting this horrible creature is a pleasure on many levels.

6504.descriptionId: The only things we know about the creator of this hammer are his nickname - a certain Fantal - and his woeful taste. He loved covering himself with Royal Jelly and Tofu feathers... An expensive, useless activity. Some people are starving for God's sake.

6505.descriptionId: This Hammer is ideal for fighting horned beasts... It isn't recommended you nail your colours to the mast with it, though.

6506.descriptionId: An Enutrof legend says that a miner is "gogorified" when he can't stand daylight anymore, a result of spending so much time working down his mine. Never bring a candle close to such a miner, he could turn you into bronze.

6507.descriptionId: The Terps was a very nasty creature, as dangerous and hated as the old Liche, its great rival. Determined to surpass its nemesis, the Terps created this hammer to crush its toes but ended up destroying its feet. The beginning of a great love story.

6508.descriptionId: An exceptional hammer which is ideal to take care either of your darling little Prespic or of your enemies if you're a follower of Chafer Fu.

6509.descriptionId: This magnificent hammer turned the heads of many an Osamodas. It's so impressive that people still turn around when they pass by its bearer. You wouldn't believe the number of chronic neck injuries this bloody thing has caused.

6510.descriptionId: Kahr was mad for hammer fighting, always fighting with that hammer he was. His pet name for it was 'Quire Boy', since, like many a 12th century singer, this hammer never did see a nail.

6511.descriptionId: It's the perfect hammer for talking yourself out of sticky situations. You'll be an instant success at all the best parties too. Just don't abuse its power. Yeah, you know what I mean.

6512.descriptionId: It's THE weapon Xelors dreamt of when they were fifteen, especially those looking for thrills and spills. It helps them to get over the endemic Xelor height complex nicely.

6513.descriptionId: This hammer's power comes from a subtle enchantment. You can't see it at first sight, nor at second. I thought it was worth pointing it out to increase its value for naive buyers.

6516.descriptionId: A Sram would cut his own parents up if you gave him these daggers at the wrong moment. They cannot resist. Some say they were invented by a powerful group of anti-Sramites who gleefully watch the entire population wipe itself out one by one.

6517.descriptionId: Any Srams looking for a new experience would be well advised to get their hands on a pair of these daggers. Their strange powers fill them with treacherous potential... for enemies or friends. The Captain Chafer would have loved them.

6518.descriptionId: Made by a famous sculptor, this wand has won the great N'hi Wand competition no less than 13 times. It easily beat old Boulgourde models, which were later taken off the market... too dangerous to be used by young Eniripsas.

6519.descriptionId: A renowned carver, he changed his name when he started using metal in his creations. Unfortunately, vanity often accompanies genius.

6520.descriptionId: The sculptor of this wand tried many times to change the unfortunate name of his magical weapon, but sales always plummeted. Any publicity is good publicity.

6521.descriptionId: People say that this staff would make a female Treechnid blush. We would not recommend you make use of this feature, male Treechnids are very possessive creatures.

6522.descriptionId: People say this root is herbivorous. It quickly worms its way through dead leaves and eats young shoots. Very impressive. But, well, unless you're fighting Dandelions, it's completely useless.

6523.descriptionId: This very stylish carved root will make an experienced summoner of you. Nothing to write home about in itself, but it's a magnet for the female Sadidas.

6524.descriptionId: A shy old Sadida tried to lure a young, beautiful female into Hornbeam Wood with this root. He waited for one hundred years but she stood him up. Since that day, walking past some Savage Root on your way to a date is considered a very bad omen.

6525.descriptionId: The inhabitants of Amakna were fed up of hearing Fecas constantly complaining about their spells, so they made this staff to give them something else to moan about. Blah blah blah, bring 2-turn Immunity back, blah blah blah. Give it a rest, already!

6526.descriptionId: The smith who created this shovel wanted to stay anonymous, as a mark of modesty. But he left a clue in the name of the shovel that would lead devotees of his work to his real identity. These craftsmen are vain after all.

6527.descriptionId: Krys Mass was an illustrious shovel smith. He was always singing about shovels, out loud and out of tune. This scarred his wife for good, and she transferred the wounds onto the shovel she made him.

6528.descriptionId: This Shovel has explored all the continents, watched the sun set on the ridge of Crackler Mountain and rise over the tranquil Asse Sea. What? You've never gone further than Moon Island? Shame on you!

6535.descriptionId: This strange multi-purpose shovel was used to kill lice, to remove dandruff and to get Iops to learn their nine times tables.

6536.descriptionId: Dark Miners use this shovel, which is as large as a Crackler's hand, to crush several Eniripsas at once. Try doing the same, just to know what it feels like.

6537.descriptionId: This shovel is really obnoxious. Nobody knows why, but the Mairhes Shovels are always unbearably cheeky. They must have some good qualities... everyone does for god's sake.

6538.descriptionId: This shovel allows the Enutrofs to see far into the distance... It's not magic or anything, they just stick it in the ground and climb onto it. Ideal for finding your house when you're lost in a field of gigantic ferns.

6539.descriptionId: The Truffle Shovel will make the people around you laugh. At you, though, not with you.

6540.descriptionId: People say the creator of this shovel truly resembled a beast. A kind of mix between a Boowolf and a Sadida. His shovel is said to have fallen in love with him. What a load of nonsense.

6601.descriptionId: When your guests get bored, crack open a box of Fairyworks! You can build them yourself using this powder and other ingredients. Guaranteed to create an explosive atmosphere at your next party.

6602.descriptionId: Bontarian safety standards request that you keep 100 paces from any Hyoactive substance. If you don't, the game will last 3 times longer.

6603.descriptionId: This stuffed Gobball is the spitting image of a Gobball; its creators were vicious enough to give it the same smell. So don't be surprised if you smell bad when you wake up.

6604.descriptionId: In levels of sheer idiocy, the Tofu, the Gobball and even the Iop can't hold a candle to the Quaquack.

6605.descriptionId: This stuffed Gobball is amazing, from the seams to the stuffing, everything's been thought about. It's an excellent gift for spoilt children or rich brats.

6606.descriptionId: This stuffed Sadida Dopple has a big alarm clock in its stuffing, very useful for Sadidas who find it hard to wake up. It's inadvisable to take it under the Hornbeam because you have to take your time in these moments.

6607.descriptionId: This stuffed Ecaflip Dopple amuses Ecaflips of all ages.

6608.descriptionId: This stuffed Dopple looks just like a real Iop. Too stupid for words and not even the smallest bit of stuffing in its head.

6610.descriptionId: This stuffed Sram Dopple was stolen from a young Sram who stole it from one of his friends...

6611.descriptionId: This stuffed Eniripsa Dopple could almost fly on its own if its wings were not so worn. It's far from new but it makes a nice present all the same.

6612.descriptionId: Be careful, it's very heavy. It's stuffed with Bauxite Stones and Golden Nuggets.

6613.descriptionId: This stuffed Feca Dopple is almost unbreakable, so it's perfect for young, unruly and careless Fecas.

6614.descriptionId: It is said that this stuffed Osamodas Dopple can summon other soft toys if it's correctly maintained. It is in fact an old legend that prevents the young followers of Osamodas from eating it.

6615.descriptionId: This stuffed Cra Dopple is made to be hurled onto your playmates, as a kind of boomerang which doesn't come back.

6616.descriptionId: This stuffed Xelor Dopple makes a strange noise. It has a clock in its stuffed head, a kind of lullaby to lull young Xelors off to sleep.

6617.descriptionId: This stuffed Boar looks like a stuffed Boar... Incredible! Please note that its hairs were taken from a real boar. Certainly a token of quality.

6618.descriptionId: Who has never dreamt of holding tight a Tofu to his chest? You? Well, in this case, you really buy anything or your friends have no taste when it comes to offer you something.

6619.descriptionId: This Mush Mush has neither painful thorn nor paralysing poison. But it's fearsome enough to frighten the most stupid of Iops.

6620.descriptionId: This stuffed Prespic has no thorn and can't turn itself invisible. But it's a good toy and will get your friends all envious.

6621.descriptionId: The stuffed Wabbit is indispensable just because it will never go out of fashion. Unlike you.

6622.descriptionId: This ordinary Rattle once belonged to Dark Vlad, which is enough to make it priceless.

6624.descriptionId: This stuffed Dragon Pig is unique. But be careful, it's only suitable for an... experienced... audience.

6625.descriptionId: This magnificent toy once belonged to Lord Crow. Too stupid to understand how it worked, he used it to crush his little Crobaks. Everyone has a right to a pastime.

6626.descriptionId: Captain Chafer used that skipping rope to keep his finger joints in shape. Since he disappeared from Amakna, it's been passing from hand to hand.

6627.descriptionId: This Fairywork will surprise and dazzle even your coolest friends, and is particularly useful for guild celebrations.

6643.descriptionId: This delightful ice cream is made using traditional methods by the small Mushden farm. The farm tries to impose the Mushd as a basic element in the making of iced desserts.

6644.descriptionId: The upper-part of this ice cream was inspired by the famous Wa hat.

6646.descriptionId: This ice cream, a subtle mixture of fruity flavours, is the result of the 'know-how of angels'. Well, that's what's written on the box, anyway.

6647.descriptionId: This ice cream combines both crunchy and sweet ingredients, and shows 'once again why Brakmar is superior'. Well, that's what's written on the box.

6648.descriptionId: This balloon is a souvenir from the Trool Fair.

6652.descriptionId: This nice snow globe will be right at home on a mantelpiece.

6654.descriptionId: Just listen to this... The Sewer Warden was devoured by the Sewer Keeper. He was digested for more than 100 years before he finally died. His boots were fortunately more resistant than he was and are still in good nick.

6658.descriptionId: This stuffed Boowolf will keep you warm and will diffuse a pleasant smell of Dead Boowolf sweat in your bedroom.

6659.descriptionId: Don't trust it, it's a fake Quaquack. Give it to Skroo Gee - he's near the Duck Stall. You will be rewarded.

6660.descriptionId:
You'll be irresistible with this hat.
You'll break hearts and discover the true meaning of glory!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

6661.descriptionId: Try catching a Quaquack at the Trool Fair with this.

6662.descriptionId:
This wonderful 100% southern larva silk hat, washable in fresh water, will make your beloved melt like a mint jelly in the sun.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

6663.descriptionId: This wonderful bouquet of Demonic Roses will show your beloved that you're ready to brave a thousand and one dangers for her/his sweet little face. For a modest sum and without a sore.

6664.descriptionId:
(Double-click to learn the spell)
This scroll will teach Ecaflips the class spell 'Felintion'.

6666.descriptionId: This tofu-flavoured lollipop is a delight for your taste buds but a cataclysmic nightmare for your breath.

6667.descriptionId: A really delightful and endless lollipop. To be eaten with your friends, preferably.

6668.descriptionId: This fatty sausage will give you enough strength to digest all the other sausages you've eaten.

6669.descriptionId: This impressive burger could feed an army of starving Chafers. To be eaten in moderation. Abusing Trool is dangerous for your health.

6670.descriptionId: These chips are made from Wild Sunflower stems, and cooked in boiling Wild Sunflower oil for them to feel at home while they're frying.

6672.descriptionId: This flour is exceptionally fine and light. It's so soft that it's often used to treat crotch rash. Then it's reused afterwards, to give even more taste to the bread.

6688.descriptionId: This tuft of hair belonged to a Sadida.

6690.descriptionId: A pair of damaged scissors, nothing more.

6706.descriptionId: These wrappings are as old as their owner who is himself as old as these wrappings. With the passing of time, they have become soaked with Mummy Nova's magic powers... and the smell of her decaying flesh.

6707.descriptionId: This stench-soaked cloak is made from pus-soaked Mummy Nova bandages. Enough to have the inhabitants of cemeteries for miles around turned on in their graves.

6708.descriptionId: This certificate celebrates the date of your last victory over a Dopple.

6713.descriptionId: Soaked with the blood of the terrible Lordsoth, these daggers helped him bring down the Chafer King during the famous dagger throwing contest at Troolmusement park. The Chafer King never again revealed his leather briefs and went into exile with the illustrious Captain Chafer in the surroundings of the Pandala cemetery.

6716.descriptionId: This pinchy little monkey seems to like you now. It is very docile, but when it comes to food, it is very demanding and will only eat vegetables that grow on its own island.

6717.descriptionId:
Take this dog to the park, take him to the toilet, show him to your friends, but whatever you do - and please listen carefully - do not feed him. This pet will remove your arm up to the elbow.
(This legendary pet refuses to eat, so don't bother trying.)

6718.descriptionId:
The fairer sex of the fairest class will fall under the spell of this cuddly little ball of fluff. For this reason alone it's to be avoided.
(This legendary pet refuses to eat, so don't bother trying.)

6719.descriptionId: This strange headgear used to belong to the notorious Bearman. Sewn from the remains of the head of a decomposing bear, the headgear will itself turn heads thanks to the unmistakable whiff-trace that follows you wherever you go.

6720.descriptionId: This beautiful cloak has been worn for years by the famous Bearman. It won't turn you into a bear, but you will be able to rival the greatest of fighters.

6721.descriptionId: These boots are lined with bear fur: even the coldest-blooded creatures will have toasty warm feet.

6722.descriptionId: The Bearman has vowed never to take off this wedding ring in memory of his dead wife... the besotted groom summoned a bear to impress his newly-wed love. She went to give it a hug... the summoned bear, raised by a distant father and an abusive mother, thought she was trying to beat him... you can guess the rest... The most tragic thing about this story is that Bearman hadn't made a single payment on the ring. Man, that has to hurt!

6723.descriptionId: The Bearman was wearing this necklace around his neck when he faced the hooligans of Bimdhul's lair. Legend has it that the amulet saved him, but on close inspection, you can see why it's just a legend.

6724.descriptionId: This little furry belt will hide your love handles perfectly. You should wear it always to avoid disappointing your beloved.

6725.descriptionId: The Bearman used this staff to tame his summoned Bear and from time to time, to rap his children's knuckles when they didn't do their homework. Here's a man who understood the value of education.

6731.descriptionId: With this amulet around your neck, you might fool yourself into thinking people won't smell your breath. No chance!

6732.descriptionId: Long ago this small ring was much sought after by Enutrofettes who preferred to use it to decorate their toes. An excellent way of hiding their warts.

6736.descriptionId: This little Ambusher bud contains a sticky, syrupy sap. If you have the misfortune to walk on an old Ambusher hidden in the long grass, you may remain caught until it devours your boots entirely. On the other hand, if you manage to make off with an intact Ambusher bud, you will be able to hush the most moany of Fecas by offering it to them and pretending it is chewing gum.

6739.descriptionId: Actually getting a complete piece of Crocodyl skin is almost a miracle. Most of the time, poachers only collect a few scales. Ideal to make bags, this old skin will also be appreciated by tailors who make fighting-underwear.

6742.descriptionId: This amulet is made of a mixture of Ambusher leaves and litter from Moon island. It looks more like a garland than a real amulet, but it will help you seduce the wildlife of the island, which almost exclusively consists of abominable creatures. No Ambusher will resist you, they all will fly into your arms to give you a hickey. Only the most unlucky in love will appreciate this piece.

6743.descriptionId: Take some Ambusher leaves, pile them up, let them macerate in stale alcohol, pierce them, drink the left-over alcohol, stick the leaves around a piece of bark, fix some pieces of Kokoko leaves with a slimy material, and here is a magnificent Deceitful Wedding Ring. It smells really bad and it will be quite handy for you to justify the smell of your fingers overall if you have a tendency to put them everywhere. Especially where you shouldn't.

6744.descriptionId: Once you've tried these boots on, you won't be able to part with them. Not because they are exceptional, but because they are exceptionally sticky. A feature they often share with female Ambushers.

6745.descriptionId: Outstanding handicraft made of remains of Ambushers and litter picked up along the Moon beaches, in the middle of the foul foam, this belt, when worn alone, will give you a really surprising look. Enough to disconcert your enemies or surprise your beloved, you'll be able to take advantage of this special moment when, for once, you'll have the upper hand.

6746.descriptionId: Oto Mustam, the leader of the Brakmar warriors, wore this small amulet long ago... though only at the organised orgies of Brakmar. They say it doubled as a leash!

6747.descriptionId: When the wind blows in its feathers, the Wind Kwak feels as free as an eagle, gliding like a dead leaf carried by a gust of wind. In spite of the clumsy description, it really is quite impressive.

6748.descriptionId: Judiciously worn, this ring will make your stubby little fingers look a little longer. Unfortunately for some, it only works on fingers.

6749.descriptionId: This ring is so light that it could be blown off by the least gust of wind. But don't expect you'll be taken away with it. At best, you'll be safe, humiliated and on solid ground.

6750.descriptionId: Cold and sharp, this blade will revive its users' most primitive instincts.

6751.descriptionId: "This ribbed blade is lubricated for increased pain." That's what the handbook says... What is that supposed to mean?

6752.descriptionId: Ideal for cutting clouds, this blade will also dissect Moskitos and split hairs.

6753.descriptionId: As perfect as ice-skates on frozen lakes, these boots are very useful for keeping your feet cool, or storing your flask. Recommendations? Don't put them by the fire to dry, you'll never see them again.

6754.descriptionId: "Nothing's better for the feet than a pair of Earth Kwakoboots" said Rola Ingalsse, the famous ploughwoman. Soon after she somehow shovelled a giant clod of earth into her own eyes and was blind for ever more.

6755.descriptionId: Basic but efficient, these surprisingly light boots are sometimes used as wind socks. Listen carefully though... People who find themselves downwind of this improvised apparatus often die.

6756.descriptionId: Ideal for camouflaging yourself as a lump of earth, this cloak will help you attack ploughmen by surprise and steal their treasures. It is for this reason that collectors of ancient pottery covet it so fiercely.

6757.descriptionId: Light and refined, this creation is also used as a curtain by the most destitute in the region. Mummy Nova herself used to wear this as an evening dress.

6758.descriptionId: The Earth Kwak is not very social and is especially hunted for its feathers, as everybody knows. If you wear this belt around your hips, you'll have the Earth Kwak hunters thinking you're an over the hill Kwak. Sometimes appearances can be truer than reality.

6759.descriptionId: "The only way to catch an upset old male Wind Kwak is to dress up as an upset female Wind Kwak. Then, the male will try to understand why the female is upset and will try every possible means to satisfy her. Once the male is satisfied with his performance, you should take advantage of his beatitude to fleece him." This is what one can read in part twelve of book three on Wind Kwak hunting. Besides, it is clearly specified that this belt is an essential element to pass yourself off as a female Wind Kwak. You know what you have to do now.

6760.descriptionId: This Earth Kwak headdress is so heavy it'll always keep your feet on the ground. If the ground happens to be soft, well, it'll keep your chin on the ground.

6761.descriptionId: To keep your hair streaming in the wind even with a headdress, there's nothing like this lovely Wind Kwak Headdress which will certainly enable you to give free rein to your hair in most circumstances. It is enough to take the most blasé of Chafers aback.

6762.descriptionId: "For a punch-up, there's nothing like an Ambusher-up." This is what could be read on Charlie's Agents' advertising leaflet. The agency offered to rebuild this staff for their clients themselves from various resources scattered on Moon Island. Some sort of treasure hunt except there are no maps.

6763.descriptionId: As the story goes, the dead Ambushers are very comfortable once they have taken the time to rot under the sun. Indeed, they become much more flexible and softer with time. Many adventurers would like to say the same about their beloved.

6764.descriptionId: This headgear isn't giving you the smartest look, is it? But you do still look less stupid with it on. So just keep it!

6765.descriptionId: Warning! As clearly specified on the package you should never give Mimilk to a young Bow Meow - it will ruin the carpets for sure.

6766.descriptionId: This apparently simple amulet was made from three magic ears of Corn, covered with the dust of precious stones, and planted in the Snossios plains during the thirteenth harvest of Istrabraq. It gives incredible courage to its bearer, who with its help can reap entire plains and valleys without rest.

6767.descriptionId: Shika covered this bracelet of precious stones with a hempen cloth to avoid drawing the Crobaks' attention while Farle sowed his barley.

6768.descriptionId: Take this miserable Bow Meow with you... That'll cheer the little fella up a bit.

6769.descriptionId: This marvellous staff is fitted with lovely tines on one tip, making it an excellent fork. Farle used it to create massive haystacks taller than the largest elms that once grew in Eltneg Wood. It is said that Brouce Boulgoure himself felled the tree for this staff, in return for an outrageous daily supply of oat flakes offered by Shika Ingalsse. He used to gulp down fistfuls before spending days on felling entire forests.

6770.descriptionId: This Moumouse was driven out of Grandma's house with a broom.

6771.descriptionId: This ring hasn't proved itself yet. It is a unique creation made by a jeweller's apprentice for an important test. It is made from a standard iron ring plunged into a magic Tea solution.

6773.descriptionId: This amulet was made in the Tude manner, hence its name. It is one of the earliest and simplest forms of jewellery, and so it is used to train apprentice jewellers. It is true that the thing is not very powerful, but you can't have it all, can you?

6774.descriptionId: These clogs have been carved from various rare woods, reinforced with leather pieces of priceless value and padded with magic cereals. Light, stylish and comfortable, these clogs will resist the passage of time. Many misogynistic adventurers would like to say the same about their beloved.

6775.descriptionId: This cape, a fashionable patchwork of cloth and leather, has allowed Farle Ingalsse to single-handedly sow entire fields for numberless seasons on end. Once folded up and used as a pouch, its capacity seems to be almost unlimited. Nobody really knows the tailor behind this marvel. All the story tells us is that his business went tail-up when his clients began to confuse his cloaks with floor cloths. What a sad end to a fine career!

6776.descriptionId: This belt served Farle Ingalsse as a butcher's apron when slaughtering Gobballs in his makeshift abattoir. A cruel, thankless task which he nevertheless carried out with obvious and undignified pleasure.

6778.descriptionId: This straw hat has been made with several plaited magic ears, and padded on the inside with various types of hair and fabrics hand sewn by Farle's wife, Shika Ingalsse. Classier than the Slob Headgear, and more stylish than the Daudgee, this hat will protect you from the heat as it did Farle through hundreds of long harvests. In this hat, you'll own those fields.

6779.descriptionId: Spy Ztiv Oztin's report: taken back with some difficulty from Joe Stonefiddler's very hands.

6780.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6781.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6782.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6783.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6784.descriptionId: With these basic-looking weapons, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6785.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6786.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

6787.descriptionId: This little form contains the name of a potential candidate for the baker's delivery man job.

6789.descriptionId: This small amulet blooms in spring, dries out in summer, fades in autumn, and goes rotten in winter. An ideal opportunity to change your style with the passing seasons.

6790.descriptionId: This form looks like a simple sheet of paper. Get this though - one touch and the paper figures out if the person suits the criteria in the heading! Isn't that nuts?

6791.descriptionId: With this little ring on your finger, you'll be able to walk through fields in the countryside. What do you mean you can do that already? Wow!

6792.descriptionId: This deflower-shaped staff is made from the remains of wild flowers that were cut down in cruel and bloody battles. All the anger and hatred felt by the poor flowers is concentrated in this tiny tool. This weapon is used by the most treacherous Srams who lure naive females with their 'bunch of deflowers'.

6793.descriptionId: This ring has proven its worth, as shown by the little mark made on the inside. It is a unique creation made by a jeweller apprentice for an important test. It is made from a standard iron ring plunged into a magic Tea solution.

6794.descriptionId: If you're looking for something to trample those flowers growing in your fields, these boots are just the ticket. Your feet mightn't smell so bad with them on. It's a shame they don't come as shorts too.

6795.descriptionId: If you're planning to go to one of those eternally popular BABA theme-nights, this cloak is just what you need.

6796.descriptionId: With this petal-peppered belt around your waist, you can slip out of a nasty situation while your enemies roll around the ground laughing. This will take care of the most war-weary Chafer army, and instantly reverse the situation to your advantage.

6797.descriptionId: If you have always dreamt of being a florist and having rose-scented breath, it's time for you to put this strange headgear on.

6798.descriptionId: It has a light, subtle, intoxicating scent, but Sadidas are the only ones who know the true secret of these flowers.

6799.descriptionId: Sharp as a Bwork blade, the Bwork Chief's blade has the advantage of being much heavier. It is certainly less easy to handle, but you just have to make it fall on your opponent and he'll be in two pieces. Lifting it up again if you miss is another issue, but your enemy will surely have run off by then.

6800.descriptionId: This cloak is made of Gobball Wool. It's neither classy nor attractive. Don't bother with it, basically.

6801.descriptionId:
A pretty, warm, powerfully smelling lining was sewn beautifully onto an ordinary cape. Around your shoulders, or lain in front of a roaring fire like a Gobball-skin rug, you'll find some use for this cape.
Eventually.

6802.descriptionId: These very soft earmuffs will keep your big flappy ears nice and warm.

6804.descriptionId: Although basic-looking, this flinty amulet is endowed with a very powerful magic that can turn a Bwork into a princess... or the opposite, nobody knows.

6805.descriptionId: Even your good friends will think you've married a great Bwork Chief if you sport this little thing on your wrist. It's enough to get you a few free drinks at the local inn... Don't be fooled though, they'll be pity drinks.

6807.descriptionId: These boots just look like ordinary Bwork boots. And yet, they are Bwork Chief boots. Hard-wearing, powerful, and smelly, they will be the deciding factor in any evenly-matched battle.

6811.descriptionId: Wear this cloak to look like a battle-weary Bwork warrior. It's perfect for stealing lunch money off the elderly in the village. All the same, if you're in search of a soul mate, you might want to change your approach... unless you wear it with nothing else on... Hey, that's it... that way, you can keep on scaring the elderly of the village too! Kill two birds with one stone.

6812.descriptionId: These purple leather briefs are all you need. You can wear them on their own and still look distinguished, provided that they fit you. You're better off keeping still in them, though - even the slightest movement will have you sounding like an old door creaking shut.

6813.descriptionId: If you really want to look like a weakling, this helmet is made for you. In your case, it mightn't make too much difference all the same.

6815.descriptionId: Dragonsly gave you this syringe to take a blood sample from Radlu Minite, the Dark Miner.

6816.descriptionId: You finally managed to take a sample of Radlu Minite's blood. Mouth-watering.

6817.descriptionId: This amazing amulet was made from a reptilian shield, from which all gems were removed. As a result, it's a particularly heavy, but very sturdy, piece of jewellery. Your neck will be protected from vampire bites, as well as from the aggressive advances of female villagers.

6818.descriptionId: This flower, once demonic, is now tame enough to make a nice, romantic present. If all you get in return is a blank look, you can always take it home and make some jam.

6819.descriptionId: This bracelet looks strangely like a glove... it's not a glove, it's a bracelet.

6821.descriptionId: Made from the remains of a Crocodyl Chief, this weapon will prove very useful if you are handsome, deft, clever and strong enough to handle it. In your case, I would try to find someone who will trade it for a Twiggy Sword.

6825.descriptionId: These beautiful slippers, made of Crocodyl Chief's skin and scales, come with sharp teeth at their ends. Be careful when you play footsie under the table with your beloved, you might rip her lovely Tabi woollen stockings.

6828.descriptionId: This hilt won't transform you into a master of sword handling, but it will help you on your way.

6829.descriptionId: This sword has just been forged.

6830.descriptionId: The first day back to school after the holidays is tough for any child, but for Iops, it's as though they die a little inside every time it happens. This bag makes the whole experience that bit easier to bear.

6831.descriptionId: Too stiff to be used as a whip, too flexible to cause any real bodily harm, this gem-covered belt nevertheless serves one obscure purpose... Armed with this, you'll never find your pants around your ankles again. Great or what?

6833.descriptionId: These kamas seem to come from another dimension. They should be quickly melted down before they go back to where they belong.

6834.descriptionId: If you've always dreamt of looking like a Crocodyl - without becoming one - then this headgear's make for you. Don't even think about using this headgear to fool your friends and tell them you've actually killed a Crocodyl. They'll never believe you.

6835.descriptionId: The pouch of questionable kamas was deftly transmuted by Dragonsly. A sword can now be forged with this metal.

6836.descriptionId: Though this sword was forged by Two-Fingers, it still seems too fragile for your purposes. Dragonsly the alchemist should be able to do something about that.

6837.descriptionId: Light and fearsome, this sword is meant for you. It lacks a little something, however. Something Ecaflip-ish, perhaps?

6838.descriptionId: Apparently the moon water had the desired effect. This solid sword can resist anything, but something from the Ecaflips is missing.

6846.descriptionId: An ordinary phial at first sight, this container has a tremendous power that only the Xelors know how to control.

6853.descriptionId: This wood has the distinctive feature of growing as straight as an arrow, which is handy for storage.

6854.descriptionId: A slimy piece of flesh snatched from a poor helpless larva.

6856.descriptionId: These scissors have been specially designed to cut the stems of demonic roses without damaging the petals, even when it bites into your calf.

6857.descriptionId: A six pack of this classic brew is the only six pack you'll be seeing for a while.

6858.descriptionId: This little form contains the name of a failed candidate for the baker's delivery man job. The small red mark at the bottom indicates that the poor sod didn't have enough Strength or Agility for the job.

6863.descriptionId:
The helmet of an Astrubian mercenary.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

6864.descriptionId: The petals of this rose are so dark that its shadow seems to twinkle in comparison.

6866.descriptionId: This piece of blue cloak is a victory trophy from your late attackers. Boy, how wrong they were when they thought it would be them crushing you!

6868.descriptionId: A handyman could use this plank to make something delightful - a coffin, for example. Just bear that in mind.

6870.descriptionId: Nomarow Transplent is now under your control. Take him safely to the jailhouse.

6871.descriptionId: Stellia is now under your control. Take her safely to the jailhouse.

6873.descriptionId: Qil Bil is now under your control. Take him safely to the jailhouse.

6874.descriptionId: Brumen Tinctorias is now under your control. Take him safely to the jailhouse.

6875.descriptionId: Akornaddikt is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to jail.

6876.descriptionId: Ogivol is now under your control. Take him safely to the jailhouse.

6884.descriptionId: This key will grant you access to the Bworker Dungeon. Be careful, it will self-destruct after use.

6885.descriptionId: Great for playing heads or tails so you can kill your enemy while the coin spins, this pure gold token will make you happy, but maybe unlucky as well.

6886.descriptionId: The cloak of an Astrubian mercenary... what were you expecting?

6887.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6888.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6889.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6890.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6891.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6892.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6893.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6894.descriptionId: This super-mighty fighting Bow Meow is the embodiment of super-might. Very impressive. Beware, it can only be entrusted to the care of Game Masters... because they're worth it.

6895.descriptionId: Less super-mighty than the super-mighty fighting Bow Meow, this small fighting Bow Meow is still very powerful. This pet remains a safe bet for Game Masters but it's not the least bit house trained and tends to roll around in its own detritus. Don't forget to throw some boiling water over it every once in a while so that it retains its splendour.

6897.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6898.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6899.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6900.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6902.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6903.descriptionId: This Piwi feather was taken from the butt of a hapless Piwi.

6904.descriptionId: Love can sometimes be more destructive than war, but that's not what Bworker told you.

6905.descriptionId: Opening this pack requires a huge amount of serenity on your part... its contents are sensitive.

6907.descriptionId: Enables you to set the alignment of the targeted character as Neutral.

6908.descriptionId: Hairy but elegant, this belt should remind you of your lady-love.

6909.descriptionId: These are the perfect boots for splashing around in the mud or making big dents in an expensive hardwood floor. It's forbidden to wear them on dance floors, beaches and in saunas.

6910.descriptionId: This ring used to be fixed on the legs of rutting boars so that breeders could easily recognise them. Today, you are the one wearing the ring. You can take from with what you wish.

6911.descriptionId: This ridiculously small ring will help you overcome your Arachnophobia once and for all.

6912.descriptionId: Made from the rotting remains of decaying Arachnees, you'll just love this belt. From time to time, it might come back to life and greedily bite you on the hips. Bloody thing!

6913.descriptionId: You'll look like a wild Arachnee if you wear this Arachelmet. What will that achieve? Well, you might scare off some flies.

6914.descriptionId: Did you know that Weak Arachnees only have four hairy legs? With only four blows of this axe, you could turn one into an Arachneetrunk. Blimey. Imagine everyone in Amakna doing that. It explains why you don't see Weak Arachnees any more, anyway.

6915.descriptionId: This is such a light ring that your hands can perform acrobatic feats when it's on. It's also quite useful if you want to humiliate somebody smaller than you by smashing their head with your thumb.

6916.descriptionId: Made out of Moskito skin and wings, this bag used to be a big fad in schools. Today, it is old-fashioned and has been replaced by the Small Crocodyl Chief schoolbag. I don't get it - one, a Small Crocodyl Chief bag is much more expensive and two, it's HORRIBLE. Kids these days.

6917.descriptionId: This headgear takes its name from the eccentric Enutrof who discovered it while stripping a sick old Moskito for all it had. Extremely useful for inexperienced adventurers, this headgear will help you seduce famished Arachnees.

6918.descriptionId: This small amulet is not as effective as the famous Arachnamu. It certainly looks good, though... To be worn on a bare, hairy chest for a great jewel-in-the-roughage look.

6919.descriptionId: The Mush Mush has a reputation for being a nasty piece of work. He'll pester and bite you at every opportunity, and he's very moody. I was married to someone like that once... Smelled like mushrooms too.

6920.descriptionId: When a Mush Mush gets married, he gives this wedding ring to his bride. Since the bride has no arms, the ring is put delicately on one of its thorns. If you get hold of this ring, you will forever break the sacred bond between the two creatures. At best, the Mush Mush will take you as his bride to make up for it, and just remember, Mush Mushes spend their whole lives where the sun don't shine.

6921.descriptionId: Before the prohibition, Musheadgear was smoked or drunk as tea. This headgear really has it all.

6922.descriptionId: The only thing more impressive than a livid Mush Mush is a livid Mush Mush in a cloak. Indeed, this particular cloak is the embodiment of a certain kind of ultra-powerful clothing... pretty ugly clothing if you ask me.

6923.descriptionId: This amulet used to belong to the great robber "Thisme" who was famous for his limitless cruelty and idiotic death. A central figure of Eniripsa folklore, he was crushed and drowned to death in an olive press having just come out of jail after a 30-year sentence for the theft of a giant walnut.

6924.descriptionId: These sharp daggers are very popular among robbers and very unpopular among the elderly for one and the same reason. The daggers cast spells that let them steal kamas from adversaries. At least that's the story their victims tell.

6925.descriptionId: This beautiful belt is essential you if you ever decide to become a highwayman. Don't wear it round town, though, you'll be arrested on sight.

6926.descriptionId: With this prespwig on, you'll look like Debbie Crockett, the most celebrated huntress of the modern age, but a tragic victim of premature baldness. That's not to say that this rat-bitten, off-red wig is any better than a balding nut.

6927.descriptionId: This reddish small cloak can be also used as a rug or doormat so that you can redecorate the house on the cheap.

6928.descriptionId: This ring, both simple and original, will seduce adventurers who long for the good things in life but could never afford them. The kind who would beat the daylights out of helpless animals and strip them of anything that seemed to be of any value. There's no shortage of them, believe me.

6929.descriptionId: The Prespic Belt is the ideal belt for keeping your hips warm. It itches like hell, though... you wanna be hard to wear this one!

6930.descriptionId: This helmet, directly hewed in stone, is worth its weight in gold. It will both protect you from the attacks of a Crackrock and allow you to give headbutts worthy of that of Desirock. It's perfect to make your opponents go off their rocker.

6931.descriptionId: This stone cloak is a bit too stiff, but you'll be grateful when you're in danger of being spat on by a Crackler.

6933.descriptionId: Incredibly heavy but equally effective, these rocky boots will give you a good excuse to drag your feet when you have to defend a Perceptor in a fight you know you can't win.

6934.descriptionId: This amulet is as heavy as a bulimic Blop. It has not been designed for weak adventurers. However, once you get used to bearing its heavy weight around your neck, you'll sure cut a dash!

6935.descriptionId: Wear it on your waist and you'll gain the respect of your peers. Wear it on your head and you'll be the laughing stock of Astrub.

6936.descriptionId: With this helmet on, you'll be able to pretend to be a Scaraleaf hunter.

6937.descriptionId: Your friends will think that you've joined the elite Scaraleaf hunter clan if you wear this helmet.

6938.descriptionId: Your friends will think that you've joined the elite Scaraleaf hunter clan if you wear this helmet.

6939.descriptionId: With this helmet on, your friends will think that you've joined the elite Scaraleaf hunter clan.

6940.descriptionId: Have you ever dreamt of wearing a cape made of Scaraleaf shells? Well, here's your chance! Once equipped, you should feel as if you were a real Scaraleaf and you might even succeed to slide and skid around. This should be enough to take aback a whole herd of Trools.

6941.descriptionId: Who's never dreamt of wearing a cloak made of Scareleaf shells? Once equipped, you'll probably believe yourself to be a true Scaraleaf, and maybe you'll manage to move on by way of slipping and skidding. That's enough to take a crowd of Trools aback.

6942.descriptionId: Who's never dreamt of wearing a cloak made of Scareleaf shells? Once equipped, you'll probably believe yourself to be a true Scaraleaf, and maybe you'll manage to move along by way of slipping and skidding. That's enough to take a crowd of Trools aback.

6943.descriptionId: Who's never dreamt of wearing a cloak made of Scareleaf shells? Once equipped, you'll probably believe yourself to be a true Scaraleaf, and maybe you'll manage to move along by way of slipping and skidding. That's enough to take a crowd of Trools aback.

6944.descriptionId: When you'll wear this ring, you'll spare a thought for all the Scaraleaves you have wiped out. You then maybe ask yourself if it is worth this slaughter... Yeah, of course it is worth it!

6945.descriptionId: When you'll wear this ring, you'll spare a thought for all the Scaraleaves you have wiped out. You then maybe ask yourself if it is worth this slaughter... Yeah, of course it is worth it!

6946.descriptionId: When you'll wear this ring, you'll spare a thought for all the Scaraleaves you have wiped out. You then maybe ask yourself if it is worth this slaughter... Yeah, of course it is worth it!

6947.descriptionId: When you'll wear this ring, you'll spare a thought for all the Scaraleaves you have wiped out. You then maybe ask yourself if it is worth this slaughter... Yeah, of course it is worth it!

6948.descriptionId: The Scarabelt was worn as an indicator of a warrior's fist-fighting skills. With a Green Scarabelt, your enemy knew you were a beginner. A red one meant that you were a lusty warrior who ate the uncooked internal organs of your enemies just for fun... And the white one indicated that you were really tough. A blue one meant you didn't spend long enough saving up for one of the others.

6949.descriptionId: The Scarabelt was worn as an indicator of a warrior's fist-fighting skills. With a Green Scarabelt, your enemy knew you were a beginner. A red one meant that you were a lusty warrior who ate the uncooked internal organs of your enemies just for fun... And the white one indicated that you were really tough. A blue one meant you didn't spend long enough saving up for one of the others.

6950.descriptionId: The Scarabelt was worn as an indicator of a warrior's fist-fighting skills. With a Green Scarabelt, your enemy knew you were a beginner. A red one meant that you were a lusty warrior who ate the uncooked internal organs of your enemies just for fun... And the white one indicated that you were really tough. A blue one meant you didn't spend long enough saving up for one of the others.

6951.descriptionId: The Scarabelt was worn as an indicator of a warrior's fist-fighting skills. With a Green Scarabelt, your enemy knew you were a beginner. A red one meant that you were a lusty warrior who ate the uncooked internal organs of your enemies just for fun... And the white one indicated that you were really tough. A blue one meant you didn't spend long enough saving up for one of the others.

6952.descriptionId: The smell coming from this Boowolf Headgear will handily mask your terrible breath.

6953.descriptionId: These boots are coated with Boowolf hair. They are extremely useful for cleaning dusty wooden floors or fixing up the heads of your enemies as they lie dead on the battle field.

6954.descriptionId: This Boowolf fur makes for excellent protection against the cold... and also adventurers with a highly developed sense of smell.

6955.descriptionId: Used as a whip, this thong can be a lot more efficient than it looks to motivate your fellow travellers when they've lost the will to live.

6956.descriptionId: Watch out! This ring will make your finger stink, although that's no bad thing, as the foul smell will mask a worse smell. This may just be the best thing that could happen to your finger, your hands in general, your family and your guildmates, in fact.

6957.descriptionId: This sword was used to cut the granite blocks for the city walls of Bonta and Brakmar. Nowadays, it's used to crush creatures in battle.

6958.descriptionId: Eternally fashionable, this hat will give you a unique look - a long, discreet look up the skirts of the Cra women. Perfect for those warm summer night parties.

6961.descriptionId: This ring is as popular with dentists as it is with gangsters. They both use it to break the teeth of careless people... They both use similar drills too, but let's not dwell on that.

6962.descriptionId: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!
