8050.descriptionId: The little immature Koalak who's skin you tore off didn't want you to treat him that way... but hey, you're stronger and crueller than he is.

8053.descriptionId: This torn skin was worn out against that of the Koalak Rider's Mount. Obviously, this is a proof of its good quality.

8054.descriptionId: This skin's smell should remind you of the Castle of Amakna stables. Very handy for scaring sensitive souls away and killing them before they decide to come with you to a dungeon.

8055.descriptionId: Mama Koalak has particularly solid bones that don't break under her weight. The same cannot be said for the famous minstrel Jon Lemon who lost the use of both his arms when he got squashed by Mama Koalak's humongous thighs.

8057.descriptionId: This bone can be used as a shovel to unearth corpses and strip them off, if you like spending your holidays next to cemeteries. Incidentally, it's also the Koalak Gravedigger's shinbone.

8058.descriptionId: Thanks to the Koalak Mummy's numerous wrappings, which give good protection against the most powerful magic attacks, this bone has kept all of its splendour.

8059.descriptionId: These hairs are covered with Blop pollen, which gives them a delectable taste, but a foul smell.

8060.descriptionId: These hairs are covered with Blop pollen, which gives them a delectable taste, but a foul smell.

8061.descriptionId: These hairs are covered with Blop pollen, which gives them a delectable taste, but a foul smell.

8062.descriptionId: These hairs are covered with Blop pollen, which gives them a delectable taste, but a foul smell.

8066.descriptionId: These hairs will give you a rash, making them a much more destructive war weapon than a Bwork's bad breath, if we were to compare them. Shocking!

8067.descriptionId: Some adventurers say that these boots enable you to walk on traps without activating them. But be careful, that might be a trap in itself.

8068.descriptionId:
This splendid cape comes standard with epaulettes so you'll finally look like a real champion.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8069.descriptionId:
With this imposing helmet, you'll become big-headed for sure, if you aren't already!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8070.descriptionId: With this low-slung belt around your hips, you'll finally be able to hide that pickle-sized bulge in your trousers. Will that stop the girls laughing? I doubt it.

8071.descriptionId:
This small creature only follows champions... You might get a few days out of it before it realises you're a hopeless imposter. From then on, you'll be wearing the leash.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8072.descriptionId: No one knows exactly which dragon created this Dofus, but the rumours suggest it ingested an incredible quantity of Kaliptus leaves before laying the egg and then dying of acute aerophagia.

8073.descriptionId: Rigroulak gave you this key in exchange for the Koolich set... Unless it's just a cheap replica crafted by a common-as-muck handyman. Either way, it should enable you to enter Skeunk's Hideout.

8075.descriptionId: This weirdly shaped piece of wood travelled for a long time through the air between enemy ranks before breaking. Rumour has it that it will always fly back to its owner, but rarely into their hands.

8076.descriptionId: This weirdly shaped piece of wood travelled for a long time through the air between enemy ranks before breaking. Rumour has it that it will always fly back to its owner, but rarely into their hands.

8077.descriptionId: This weirdly shaped piece of wood travelled for a long time through the air between enemy ranks before breaking. Rumour has it that it will always fly back to its owner, but rarely into their hands.

8078.descriptionId: A handyman could use this plank to make something delightful - a coffin, for example. Just bear that in mind.

8079.nameId: Little White Bow Meow Ghost Transformation
8079.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8080.nameId: Little Black Bow Wow Ghost Transformation
8080.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8081.descriptionId: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Hornbeam Wood.

8082.descriptionId: This fabric smells like death, whereas you smell as if you were dead. The difference is worth noting.

8083.descriptionId: This bone is quite spongy and enables the Fisheralak to float if it falls in while pulling up a big catch.

8084.descriptionId: This scar-covered skin is more resistant than a rock but remains extremely supple. It's perfect for making whips and tasteless sandals.

8085.descriptionId: These hairs are covered in Kaliptus sap, giving them a shiny glint. Unfortunately, they cannot be used for haute couture as they smell like rotting Dragoturkey.

8088.descriptionId: This wand, made out of useless office stationery, holds incredible magical powers. Legend tells that it can move of its own will, choose its target and protect its master even when death is seemingly inevitable.

8089.descriptionId: Iots was a parrot who repeated just about anything you could say. Rumour has it that this wand was carved from its beak.

8090.descriptionId: Legend has it that this staff bites people, or was it that people always bit it? Something about biting anyway.

8091.descriptionId: This palm cane celebrates a famous festival in the South East. Unfortunately this one isn't made of gold.

8092.descriptionId: The Ostwogoth is neither sharp nor smart but when he has his daggers to hand, no one dares face this monster.

8094.descriptionId: This sword perfectly illustrates the old Iop saying "In a slain enemy is a sword's hilarity".

8095.descriptionId: This conversation piece is mass-produced according to an unchanging style. Since it's also quite deadly, it's often used in combat. In this case, art doesn't imitate life, it tears it out at the roots.

8096.descriptionId: This hammer's previous owner used to dance with Moowolves, until one day he was wolfed down altogether.

8097.descriptionId: Even your enemies will be asking to be hit again and again with this weapon.

8098.descriptionId: This axe is really special. Its vibrating blade plays beautiful music while you slice the life out of your enemies.

8099.descriptionId: Rumour has it this weapon has been dipped into a fountain of pure lightning and then sprinkled with stardust. Other rumours entirely contradict this story.

8100.descriptionId: This axe has been pierced in many different places making it whistle pleasantly while you slice your enemies. As the old song goes 'Whistle while you Whack.'

8101.descriptionId: This troublesome axe claims it comes from a mysterious land far away... Don't listen to its rambling, though, it has made peace-loving fools out of more than one fine warrior. What a shame.

8102.descriptionId: This rock is said to be the heart of the Legendary Crackler. What we do know is that the Legendary Crackler never had a heavy heart. Therefore, this rock is incredibly light making it possible to create suitable items for characters who favour mobility, agility and protection. Just perfect!

8103.descriptionId: This bow is made from fossilised hair of a Sadida who slept for so long that Arachnees spun a film of tough webs around it.

8104.descriptionId: This bow is a bizarre colour but is perfect to show off at the Zaap of Bonta. You won't pass off as a rooster, but you'll surely attract all the chicks! Sometimes amazing, sometimes disgusting, it might even overcome your enemies without your needing to shoot a single arrow.

8106.descriptionId: Use this potion to forget the profession of handyman.

8108.descriptionId: As light as a Tofu feather, this amulet can be worn around your neck or around your forehead if you want to be original.

8109.descriptionId: This ridiculously small ring can end up being essential... your enemies might pity you so much they'll finish you off instead of letting you agonize. Let's be positive!

8110.descriptionId: Unlike what some adventurers may think, this wand is not used by Tofus - they're way too stupid to know how to use such a weapon - but to fight them. Indeed, this wand is made of Tofu feathers which enable hunters to simulate the Tofu mating dance and catch them. What else will these terrible hunters invent to satisfy their murderous instinct?

8111.descriptionId: Light and soft, these slippers are warm in winter and cool in summer. Unfortunately, they can't stand being washed in washing machines.

8112.descriptionId: This weird cloak has been cut in half. But why would somebody cut it in half? No one knows... though everybody has his own little idea about it.

8113.descriptionId: This belt is the ideal tool for strangling Tofus but hunters also use it to whip any adventurers who stray onto their land in hunting season.

8114.descriptionId: This safety helmet became a very fashionable item that every pretty lady adventurer should have. What's wrong in this World?

8116.descriptionId: This helmet will hide your teenage acne or your ugly face.

8117.descriptionId: More golden than a classical Scaracape and less black than a Black Scaracape, this cape is perfect to hide your outgrowths. The Scarabugly used to use it to hide its awful hump, for example. These days, this cape is mainly used to hide terrible-looking behinds. No need to point out that this cape is very popular.

8118.descriptionId: This magic wand is perfect for dusting old furniture or old people.

8119.descriptionId: If you love running naked on the paradisiacal Moon Island beaches, you'll surely fall in love with this belt.

8120.descriptionId: Worn on a hairy torso, this amulet just looks fantastic! Hair tufts are just the perfect match for this amulet.

8121.descriptionId: Scarabuglies are strange creatures. Born hunchbacked and ugly, they inevitably become the laughing stock of the other Scaraleaves. Maybe that's why you feel so close to this creature.

8122.descriptionId: These hooked boots make it easy for you to climb the sheerest of cliffs or to plough your fields without a plough.

8123.descriptionId: This amulet smells of Wild Sunflower oil and herbs. You can use it as a lure to trap dangerous rummagers... like Gobballs, or your mother-in-law.

8124.descriptionId: With its complementary pair of linen Bermuda shorts attached, the Beltudas is simply a must have. This belt is designed for those who need to get their clothes off in a heartbeat and burst into action just as fast. Be careful though. For reasons of hygiene, it is forbidden to wear it in public swimming pools... we don't want a repeat of the Bonta incident... I almost lost my sight that time.

8125.descriptionId: If you need protection from the sun while working in the fields, what you really need is a Slob Headgear. If you need protection from the sun while working in the fields and you're poor, the famous Farmer Sunhat will have to do.

8126.descriptionId: These moth-eaten mittens are a real treasure. They're said to be covered with diamond dust which gives them extraordinary resistance. They are also abrasive on one side, perfect for putting the finishing touches to that latest DIY project.

8127.descriptionId: This robust but damaged scythe doesn't cut very well, it's seen far too many harvests. However, it's extremely effective if you're looking to yank some veins out of a rival's arm... Nice and blunt.

8128.descriptionId: These boots are padded with wheat straw, absorbing perspiration and allowing the portable and low-cost cultivation of toxic mushrooms. Thanks to their soft sole, they've been recommended by all the great Gobbowl players.

8129.descriptionId: Behind this stupid name, you'll find an extremely powerful amulet, made with Boowolf fangs and bones which explains why it smells so bad. If it doesn't suit your neck, it will perfectly suit your breath.

8130.descriptionId: This terrible axe has beheaded many foolhardy adventurers even if it does not cut very well. Indeed, a dozen attempts can be necessary to finish cutting a resistant neck.

8131.descriptionId: This bag is very fashionable among school kids and is ideal for storing animal and vegetable flours. Once opened, unfolded and torn along the seams, you'll be able to use this bag as a skirt, just shave those legs, for Iop's sake.

8132.descriptionId: This belt is anything but original... funny, it seems to match your hairdo.

8133.descriptionId: This helmet is perfect for those who see the World through opaque black glasses.

8134.descriptionId: If you can't afford to buy a Mastralis Croak, but you like to scare Arachnees by wearing black clothes, this is the cape for you!

8135.descriptionId: This interesting key will allow you to drag open the door of the Bwork Dungeon... It can't promise you'll get out of there alive though.

8136.descriptionId: This beautiful ring can be worn around your big toe. It's perfect to hide your warts and your ingrown nails.

8137.descriptionId: These entrails are responsible for the difficult digestions of the Golden Scarabugly. You are entitled to fry them without feeling remorse.

8139.descriptionId: This wonderful golden key will grant you access to the Scaraleaf Dungeon. And you thought you'd seen it all.

8141.descriptionId: Unlike what some adventurers may think, Black Scaraleaf Wings are not black, but white. Another mystery Mother Nature gave us to discuss at the Inn.

8142.descriptionId: This key will grant you access to the Royal Tofu House. You'll get the thrashing of your life there too.

8143.descriptionId: This key will let you into the Field Dungeon. It won't let you out again, though.

8145.descriptionId: Bwork Beer will render a Feca drunk from twelve paces. No one knows if it's made of Bworks or by Bworks, but knowing the Bworks, it's probably a bit of both.

8146.descriptionId: If you like to break a few toes when you take your date out to dance, these boots are made for you!

8147.descriptionId: This is an improved version of the Crackler Helmet. This rock will efficiently protect you from falling rocks, but not from hair loss.

8148.descriptionId: This huge hammer is in fact a Crackler sword, adorned with a rock from the Legendary Crackler. This shocking creation will stun your opponents, just before squashing them.

8149.descriptionId: This rock, set with precious stones, is perfect if you want to leave a permanent mark on the forehead of an enemy.

8150.descriptionId: This amulet has quite a modest look though it contains many secrets including the one telling what secrets it contains.

8151.descriptionId: This little monster will follow you everywhere and feed on the remains of its fellow creatures. By turns terrifying and entertaining, it'll brighten up your long, sombre days. Although it could just as easily cut them short.

8152.descriptionId: The Legendary Crackler wears this belt around one of his toes. You wear it around your waist... at least for a few seconds before it clunks down around your ankles!

8153.descriptionId: This young Treechnid could no longer stand its family, and like yourself, has decided to rebel. Today, it is coming with you to count how many of its close relatives you can exterminate.

8154.descriptionId: This charming little southern beetle is in fact a thoroughly fearsome creature. Humiliated by its friends as a young beetle, it decided to take revenge. Just tell it if a Scaraleaf is giving you grief, and it'll be glad to sort it out for you.

8155.descriptionId: This magnificent creature is a distant cousin to the famous Lenalds of the Wabbit Islands. More reckless and a lot more unruly, it will help you in combat and, with unspeakable treachery, will also help you defeat members of its own family.

8156.descriptionId: This key will grant you access to the terrible Canidae Dungeon. Once inside, you'll most likely be gutted in a relaxing, low-key atmosphere.

8157.descriptionId: Just like any magical item, this one is impressive. The petal emits an aura that is as powerful as the incredulity of any onlookers.

8158.descriptionId: The Tofurby regularly smears himself with grease to stop his feathers falling off his plumage. A technique as old as the hills, which enables some Enutrofs to keep some of their hair beyond puberty.

8161.descriptionId: If you've always dreamt of flying like a fat Piwi, stick these wings to your belt and jump fro<m the Tower of Orders in Brakmar. As well as giving the locals a laugh, you'll make a great meal for Crobaks.

8162.descriptionId:
With this magic Pumpkwin on your head, you'll look even more idiotic than usual. But remember the Al Howin curse. Yes, the curse that transforms creatures into misshapen beasts.
It seems that this headgear is the only thing that can protect you from this terrible curse.

8163.descriptionId: Formerly worn by the authorities of the greatest cities, this helmet is now used to intimidate rebels and those who are a bit too curious about the rulers of the universe.

8164.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8165.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8166.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8167.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8168.descriptionId: Al Howin was the greatest Pumpkwin farmer on the continent. Unfortunately, he was also apprentice to a certain Bwork Magus who was far too interested in arcane knowledge for his own good. In order to win the 'Biggest Pumpkwin Cultivated with Lousy Pig Slurry' contest, Al Howin cheated by enlisting the help of the Bwork Magus, who decided to test a new incantation on the Pumpkwins... As a result of his idiocy, anyone who ate the bewitched fruits at a certain time of year wound up transformed into strange, misshapen creatures for several days... Apparently, the curse even spread to adventurers who got too close to the bewitched creatures. In desperation, the inhabitants of Amakna decided to start wearing Pumpkwins on their heads, hoping that this might somehow save them. The most surprising thing of all is that it seems to work!

8169.descriptionId: You've been turned into an Al Howin Gobball. To get rid of this terrible curse, you'll have to pick a fight with some unsuspecting fool.

8170.descriptionId: You've been turned into an Al Howin Tofu. To get rid of this terrible curse, you'll have to pick a fight with some unsuspecting fool.

8171.descriptionId: This Treechster Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8172.descriptionId: This Gobtubby Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8173.descriptionId: This El Scarador Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8174.descriptionId: This Minifoux Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8175.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Treechster that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8176.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Gobtubby that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8178.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the El Scarador that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8179.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Minifoux that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8180.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bworky that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8181.descriptionId: This cloak of big stone chunks will turn you into a big stone chunk.

8211.descriptionId: This creature must have escaped from a zoo or some remote island somewhere. It is known to improve the damage of its master in combat. Its most distinguishing feature – sometimes shared with its master – is its rotten-fish breath. We suggest that you tape its mouth closed (tape sold separately). Be careful, because this little creature is very demanding – it only eats fish.

8213.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried red Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8214.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried blue Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8215.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried purple Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8216.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried green Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8217.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried yellow Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8218.descriptionId: This amulet seems to have been made with a small, dried pink Piwi head. Vanity knows no bounds.

8219.descriptionId: This ring will allow your lover find you, no matter where you are.

8220.descriptionId: This ring will allow your lover find you, no matter where you are.

8224.descriptionId: This ring will allow your lover find you, no matter where you are.

8225.descriptionId: They're perfect for protecting your little feet and squashing small creatures that crawl through the grass, like Xelors or Eniripsas for example.

8231.descriptionId: If you're small enough, this cape of Piwi feathers may cover up your behind. Some modest protection that will at least draw attention away from your greasy hair and horrible warts.

8237.descriptionId: This small belt will accentuate your hips if you're fighting in front of important people. It's also handy for holding your guts in if a plain boar rips you open in the depths of a forest.

8238.descriptionId: This small belt will accentuate your hips if you're fighting in front of important people. It's also handy for holding your guts in if a plain boar rips you open in the depths of a forest.

8243.descriptionId: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

8246.descriptionId: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

8247.descriptionId: Some people might think you look ridiculous wearing this hat, others will find you adorable. That's life.

8248.descriptionId: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.

8249.descriptionId: This alcohol-soaked feather is extremely inflammable. It's very useful for roasting Drinkers.

8250.descriptionId: The Crowfox loves to dress up as a Crobak. No one really knows why, but most people have something to say on the subject.

8252.descriptionId: This greasy feather belonged to a tamed Crobak who spent most of his life locked up and force-fed until he became fat enough to completely fill the space of his cage.

8253.descriptionId: This amulet is often mistaken for a lucky-bag gift... It's actually something you win at the shooting range.

8254.descriptionId: Make no mistake – this isn't an armband! If you were counting on this ring to keep you afloat, you'll end up forty fathoms deep... Despite its small size, it can weigh at least as much as ten raul mops when soaked full of water!

8255.descriptionId: Many inexperienced adventurers will remember this terribly powerful weapon, used as a defence against sods of earth. If you wet it, it becomes soft and can be rolled about, though it generally takes at least two weaklings like yourself to manage it.

8256.descriptionId: With these boots, Eniripsas can walk on water... which is quite useless since they can fly anyway, but it always impresses the crowds. Normal folk can always use these boots to exfoliate their feet while they sit around the house.

8257.descriptionId: This belt allowed Vald to take his seasonal bath without putting his life in danger. Indeed, no Iop ever succeeded in learning so much as the doggy paddle.

8258.descriptionId: This cape is perfect for camouflaging yourself in the natural environment. Well, it's more like you'll be adding a pleasant touch to the countryside, but hey, who wants to be invisible anyway?

8259.descriptionId: This headgear comes in very hand when it rains. It'll let you leave your umbrella at home but... be careful all the same, as your head might become very hard to keep on your shoulders.

8260.descriptionId: This headband will make Iops more handsome than ever!

8262.descriptionId: The Amoolet holds a strange substance that is only found in the guts of a Moowolf. Some say it's the monster's essence, others say it's just the semi-digested remains of a Kirball.

8263.descriptionId: Beware! This ring will make your finger stink, although the foul smell may cover a worse odour. Actually, that might be the best thing that could happen to your finger, your hands, and the people around you, to be honest.

8264.descriptionId: Ubiquitous boots that are still driven by the voracious appetite of the Moowolf. If your feet smell of Clakoss, these boots will probably bite them.

8265.descriptionId: The Moowolf's beautiful, fluffy tail is so long that it trails on the ground. Driven into a jealous rage, some adventurers pulled it off and they now wear it to increase fertility.

8266.descriptionId: This coloured belt has a wonderful purple tuft on the front and if you wear it back to front you can pretend to be a Wabbit.

8267.descriptionId: While dismembering the Moowolf, hunters discovered that it only has one big horn going right through its skull. That doesn't seem to bother Iops, who wear it proudly anyway.

8268.descriptionId: This necklace protected the Minotoror from getting fleas, ticks and even lice. You can be the judge of whether you need it or not.

8269.descriptionId: Unlike what some adventurers may think, this ring was never worn by the Minotoror who was unable to fit such a delicate thing around his hoofs.

8270.descriptionId: This bracelet fully protects the arm of an Eniripsa, but triples its weight.

8271.descriptionId: This ring of leather and ivory makes it easier for you to stimulate your partner.

8272.descriptionId: This necklace protects the Minotot's cervical vertebrae from lethal Wabbit punches.

8273.descriptionId: This necklace comes with a small loop so the owner of the Dragon Pig can attach a leash to it. It also does wonders for Dragon Pig lice.

8274.descriptionId: This very axe actually beheaded one of the most dangerous Minotorors in the province of Amakna. What I can't believe is that you don't seem to care!

8275.descriptionId: This sceptre with a Plissken head made of precious stones at one end enables you to scare away young adventurers and kick their pinky butts.

8276.descriptionId: You won't go winning the legendary race of Amakna Bay with these terrible boots of Minotoror Hair and leather. You might manage to break the competitors' toes on the starting line, though.

8277.descriptionId: These incredible sandals will enable you to bathe in the most dangerous waters without hurting your feet. Be careful however, as they're said to scratch the bottom of bathtubs.

8278.descriptionId: A good pair of mules at your side and you'll feel stronger, more powerful and deadlier than ever. They're just ordinary mules, though. It must be the vibes they give off.

8279.descriptionId: Take a Minotoror. Firmly tie him up. Take a giant plane and peel his back at one go. There! You've got your Minotoror Cloak!

8280.descriptionId: This is the perfect cloak to go out or practice your seduction skills at the Captain Chafer's masked ball.

8281.descriptionId: This cloak will not turn you into a Piglet but at least you'll be able dress up for one night and seduce a beautiful sow.

8282.descriptionId: This supple belt can be used to whip unruly kids' bottoms. Its buckle might even mark their skin but this would only teach them their lesson once and for all.

8283.descriptionId: The Minotot used this stiff belt to hold his huge potbelly in, preventing him from toppling over every time he felt a draught.

8284.descriptionId: This headgear has been passed down from generation to generation through the Minotot family. This partially explains why it smells like rotting dandruff.

8285.descriptionId: With this huge skull on, you'll look like a stiff-bristled Grizball, but with no hair. Your admirers will be speechless.

8286.descriptionId: According to the legend, this scale-covered cape will protect you from lightning, beans and femmes fatales, whatever they are.

8287.descriptionId: A little angel like you could easily pass for a merciless warrior with such a terrifying and disproportionate helmet on. If that doesn't work, it'll make a great cloak rack.

8288.descriptionId: The most perverted minds in Amakna used to say that this belt could be used as a prosthesis. Fortunately the rumour was exposed as a lie - it's just a plain old Dreggon Belt.

8289.descriptionId: This ring, directly cut in the shape of a giant Dreggon scale, will protect a small part of your phalanx. Maybe the most important part...

8290.descriptionId: Made of Dreggon scales, this amulet will efficiently protect your Adam's Api or your tonsils. It will make all the difference on a battlefield.

8291.descriptionId: These boots are perfect for killing Gobballs while playing Gobbowl or making your enemies suffer some more during spanking sessions.

8292.descriptionId: You'll end up without a nose if you use this sword to shave your face. Save it for your back.

8293.descriptionId: This axe cuts through skulls like a hot knife through butter.

8294.descriptionId: Heavier than an empty Munchor Skull, but less solid than a Cave-dwelling Kirball femur, this hammer is nevertheless quite a fearsome weapon.

8295.descriptionId: This bow is so powerful that it can send Dreggon eggs over the great wall of Brakmar. What a wonderful waste of food!

8296.descriptionId: This wand seems to be a lot more effective when it's used as a club or as a Moskito swatter!

8297.descriptionId: One end of this staff is armed with a long, sharp point. No one knows where it came from, but you can guess where it usually goes.

8298.descriptionId: Shika used to help Farle at harvest time by picking up the magic grain his scythe swiped. She used it to make necklaces. Though their roots and stalks have been cut off, these magic ears keep on ripening every year around the same time.

8299.descriptionId: This bracelet covered up Shika's arms. This way it protected her from sunburn and Crobak pecks... The little creatures were attracted by her stunning beauty and many claim to have gotten lucky with her.

8300.descriptionId: This custom-made staff helped Shika make the highest haystacks in all of Amakna. Legend has it that they were so big that sailors used them as markers to tell how far they were from land. Now you know why sailors have a fear of harvesting.

8301.descriptionId: These clogs were created for Shika so that she wouldn't trample the seedbeds of the Snossios plains. The high-heels make it easier to run in the stubble without hurting her ankles and stop the dew getting in.

8302.descriptionId: Flowers from harvest time have been sewn to this cape made of woven magic cereals. It's driven by such a powerful magic that Shika used to use it for protection against lightning on stormy nights!

8303.descriptionId: This belt of leather used to protect Shika's thighs when she ran across the wheat fields to bring back to their herd lost Gobballs. Covered with pollen from magic cereals, legend says that it used to shimmer in the moonlight and ensured Farle didn't cut his wife's legs while reaping fields of cereals at night.

8304.descriptionId: Covered with a multitude of flowers, this hat made Shika look happy and bright when she left at the crack of dawn to plough the Church Hills.

8305.descriptionId: This strange relic is essential for you to meet the Minotoror.

8306.descriptionId: This strange relic is essential for you to meet the Minotoror.

8307.descriptionId: Crafted from diverse materials, this key will grant you an audience with the terrifying Minotot. If you go the distance, it'll make a great story for the taverns and picnic tables of the land. You'll also have a sore ass, or perhaps the remnants of a sore ass, if you do live to tell the tale... Good luck!

8308.descriptionId: This small shiny shell is very useful for creating nice jewellery at a low cost... You'll be able to sell it to an Astrubian for a fortune once you convince them it can make you fly.

8309.descriptionId: This feather is covered with magic stone dust which explains why one unit of Quetsnakiatl feather is heavier than three units of Tofu feathers. It's all logical, you know.

8311.descriptionId: This hair seems to be covered with short-haired-Tuftie-musk based brylcreem and cave Kirball grease. They almost look appetising.

8312.descriptionId: Worn out by the sand and the sea salt, this skin is as thin as an old sock worn out by... sand and sea salt. Does that mean a healthy Minoskito looks like a fresh sock? Yes it does.

8314.descriptionId: This roasted skin protects sensitive skins from rays of sunshine. It's a particularly close-fitting skin.

8315.descriptionId: This spotted skin is said to be covered with a poison capable of changing anyone into a dried Karaball.

8320.descriptionId: After getting lost in the Dragon Pig's Maze, you realised that you had forgotten the key to the Dragon Pig's Den. Fortunately, your Porco pals had a spare with them.

8329.descriptionId: Who would want the key to a disused mine on a frozen island, lost and guarded by strange goblins desperately seeking a lost nugget?

8330.descriptionId: This small headgear enables the Flying Dreggon to attack his enemies without bumping his head. It's been used for a long time on the greater worksite of Amakna. This headgear became quite popular after the invasion of Astrub by Moowolves coming from the Kruup Mountain. There's no logic in this story... so what?

8331.descriptionId: With this hat on, you'll be able to dress up and seduce any naive Astrubian you find... Just offer him a hot date for 100 kamas, and Bob's your uncle, his wallet's empty.

8333.descriptionId: This mysterious cape only comes out once a year, but the scammers always use it to get a fast kama from the kiddies.

8334.descriptionId: This hat will hide the scars all over your head. That way, no more toddlers will be injured trying to flee in terror from your Santa stall.

8335.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

8336.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

8337.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

8338.descriptionId: This strange sword sure won't make you invincible... In fact, people have died trying to kill snowmen with it.

8339.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

8340.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

8341.descriptionId: These boots smell of Pineapi juice marinated with wet socks. The great thing is that when you visit your friends, they will never ask you to take your shoes off.

8343.descriptionId: Some people say that a fabulous treasure is hidden in the Dreggon Dungeon. Sadly, this key will lead you to certain death.

8344.descriptionId: Not quite as pointy as a Xelor's Homing Hand, but a lot more solid, the Black Dragoss uses this horn to turn an arse-kicking session into an arse-piercing one.

8345.descriptionId: Not quite as pointy as a Xelor's Homing Hand, but a lot more solid, the Sapphire Dragoss uses this horn to turn an arse-kicking session into an arse-piercing one.

8346.descriptionId: Not quite as pointy as a Xelor's Homing Hand, but a lot more solid, the White Dragoss uses this horn to turn an arse-kicking session into an arse-piercing one.

8347.descriptionId: Not quite as pointy as a Xelor's Homing Hand, but a lot more solid, the Golden Dragoss uses this horn to turn an arse-kicking session into an arse-piercing one.

8357.descriptionId: The Dragostess has two small horns at the back of her head with which she detects the love waves that float through the air during mating season... which never really ends for the Dreggons.

8359.descriptionId: Even when his wing is damaged, torn and burnt, the Flying Dreggon can still fly freely above the void like a young, carefree Moskito.

8363.descriptionId: The Dreggon Warrior has three different horns: two on the back of his head and a third one on his snout. After a fight, a horn usually ends up in the behind of his victim and the two others stuck up in the nostrils of the foolhardy challenger. But from time to time, the Dreggon Warrior mistakes the behind for the nostrils. This only makes it worse for his victims.

8366.descriptionId: This cape used to belong to a famous Capon, a long-feathered bird that loved to dance in front of the Bonta Zaap where all the gullible poultry and immature chicken hang out.

8367.descriptionId: You could use this red skin to make a Little Red Waddling Cape, but your tailor would be very confused. "This recipe has produced nothing!" they would cry, somewhat awkwardly.

8368.descriptionId: This huge tooth was pulled out at the very last minute, right before Crocabulia closed her mouth for the very last time.

8369.descriptionId: This shell fragment belonging to Terrakubiack the Warrior should help you make a key to access the Dreggons' Sanctuary.

8370.descriptionId: This shell fragment belonging to Ignilicrobur the Warrior should help you make a key to access the Dreggons' Sanctuary.

8371.descriptionId: This shell fragment belonging to Aeroktor the Warrior should help you make a key to access the Dreggons' Sanctuary.

8372.descriptionId: This shell fragment belonging to Aquabralak the Warrior should help you make a key to access the Dreggons' Sanctuary.

8377.descriptionId: This magic stone can be consumed to teleport to the nearest workshop.

8378.descriptionId: This fragment contains some magic transferred by an ancient item. You should be able to get a few magic runes out of it at least.

8383.descriptionId: Deprived of his soft skin, poor Moon was taken by surprise and could only run away in the jungle screaming with pain. This is a nice bedtime story you'll enjoy telling your kids to make them go to sleep.

8384.descriptionId: This fabric seems to be magic and you find it hard to believe. But one day, you'll have to face the truth... You're just too stupid to tell if something's magic or not. Do not follow your Astrubian killer instinct... trust all these descriptions.

8386.descriptionId: No one would have ever believed that a Shin Larva would actually have a mouth full of teeth. It's probably because Shin Larvae only have one tooth.

8388.descriptionId: The Bworkette let you take some of her skin in exchange for your clemency. But she forgot to tell you that she told her big brother Bworker... he might want some of yours in exchange!

8389.descriptionId: The Bworkette has very soft skin everywhere but under her arms. Well, the little cookies she makes have to be flavoured somehow, don't they?

8390.descriptionId: If you believe the breeders, Farle was the greatest breeder of all. But then again, they were all jealous of Shika. Anyway, what's certain is Farle is the one who created Farle's Pigs. Another certainty is that he wasn't the most handsome creature - the pigs were created in his own image.

8391.descriptionId: Dorgan Ation has once more been extremely generous with you in spite of his bad temper. He gave you his skin before leaving and moaning like a Lousy Pig. What a nerve!

8392.descriptionId: You used a cheese grater to scrape this skin off a poor Blodz Uker. No doubt he will remember that terrible event for life. Don't count on him to tell you the way next time you get lost in his maze.

8394.descriptionId: This humongous rock looks like a rock from the Legendary Crackler, but it is not. It's a lot more special than that!

8397.descriptionId: The Wa Wabbit is usually quite miserly and balks at sharing his hairs. Exceptionally, to reward your courage (or buy your clemency), he has decided to give you one of his body parts. How touching!

8398.descriptionId: No one really knows where the Wa Wabbit got this fabric and no one seems interested in knowing either. Disturbing and disquieting, the origin of the fabric remains one of the greatest mysteries of all Amakna.

8402.descriptionId: Though the Koolich is quite a generous thing, he wasn't exactly happy about giving you his big stone. And it's understandable, given what you're going to do with it.

8403.descriptionId: This huge braid was made by the Koolich himself, some years ago. With the passing years, it became as stiff as a rock. However, it still holds a foul, slimy liquid that attracts Moskitos from time to time. The most surprising thing is that this braid used to perfectly suit the Koolich. Like a big Slob, you had the ridiculous idea to steal it.

8404.descriptionId: This piece of skin probably comes from Skeunk's heels which can explain its nice yellowish colour. Though this old skin won't enable you to make fashionable clothes, you'll still be able to create "retro" ones that younger generations will love.

8405.descriptionId: Skeunk thinks nothing of a full body-shave. Here's the proof.

8406.descriptionId: This wool is particularly thin making it possible for the Minotot not to have frizzy hair all over his body. No one knows why he has it. Maybe you should try to make hair grafts out of this wool so that you'll be able to display an abundant growth of brown hair on your chest. See, even your childhood dreams can come true!

8414.descriptionId: These daggers are perfect for cutting the top off a soft-boiled Dreggon egg. They're also very light which enables you to run fast when the Dreggon community realises what you've done.

8417.descriptionId: This small shovel was once given to a young Enutrof. He became so attached to it that he was still using it right before his death.

8419.descriptionId: Captain Mayhav is said to have used this very shovel to rip open the Great White Kralove known as Dopy Mick.

8420.descriptionId: Dreggons like to dig networks of underground passages but they never use these shovels. The Enutrof community studied this enigma but concluded that it was less important to know where they came from than how to hit someone with one.

8421.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8424.descriptionId: This gift is only meant for Breeders - it contains all kinds of breeding machines for your paddock. (Warning! The items contained in this gift are very heavy. You might be overweight when you open it.)

8425.descriptionId: This purse is very heavy - it must be worth a fortune. A tradesman will be happy to exchange it for its value in kamas.

8430.descriptionId: Unlike the fake ones you'll find at the Trool fair, this balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with Strawberry Jelly eyelid, according to the traditions of the great magus Betsy Krokerr.

8435.descriptionId: Unlike the fake ones you'll find at the Trool fair, this balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with Strawberry Jelly eyelid, according to the traditions of the great magus Betsy Krokerr.

8436.descriptionId: This key will grant you to access to the most intimate parts of the Soft Oak's anatomy... I bet you won't even know it when you get to the special place. As disturbing and exciting as the much loved Amaknan sport of naked Judo, this trip will not leave you empty handed, that's for sure.

8437.descriptionId: This key, made of marine waste and sea shells, will grant you access to the beach with the whitest sand of all the Asse Sea Coast.

8438.descriptionId: This key will let you into the Rat dungeon located deep in the sewers of Brakmar. No need for a disguise, you'll go unnoticed even if you're not a Brakmarian.

8439.descriptionId: This key will let you into the Rat dungeon located deep in the sewers of Bonta. No need for a disguise, you'll go unnoticed even if you're not a Bontarian.

8441.descriptionId: Bill wanted a halo. He screamed so loud and threw such a tantrum that he finally got it. A real little devil.

8442.descriptionId: Brouce Boulgoure used this mask to discreetly infiltrate a Grossewer rats' den and cut down an elm by the roots. On the way out, he squashed every single rat in the den with his wooden clogs.

8443.descriptionId: This cape can be made with any sort of animal hair provided that it's very dirty. They are plaited together and then cemented with various secretions. The smell is unfortunately not optional.

8444.descriptionId: Badly damaged, but extremely sharp, these dagger blades will slice off a limb with disconcerting ease. They'll sink through bones like butter, allowing you to carve your enemies up like spring chickens. What a pity they aren't rusty, poisoned and white-hot too!

8445.descriptionId: The rat who used to own this necklace thought he would become the chief of his clan. He was devoured by a rabid Lenald.

8446.descriptionId: Be careful when you put on these boots, as there might still be a foot or two of the previous owner inside them.

8447.descriptionId: Unlike his white Bontarian cousin, the Black rat is discreet and wears a simple fabric belt. But he also likes to take a lot of weapons with him and it all makes a terrible clinking noise at each of his steps.

8448.descriptionId: Turn this ring to the right if you're shaking hands with an enemy and to the left if you're shaking hands with a friend. Make sure you stay away from any situation where you may be forced to clap.

8449.descriptionId: A Treechnid bit you and passed on a strange curse.

8450.descriptionId: This weapon is the symbol of the White Rat. It will slice both enemies and allies with the same ease.

8451.descriptionId: The White Rat of Bonta looks like a real White Rat of Bonta when he wears this hat. Without it, he looks like a real White Rat of Bonta without a hat.

8452.descriptionId: This cape is the unmistakable banner of the Bonta white sewer rat network. It is the reward the rat gets after a long and difficult series of examinations and is proudly worn until he pants his final ratty breath... which usually isn't a long time.

8453.descriptionId: Plumbers wear this necklace when descending into the intestine-like sewers of our cities. If you wear it as a belt, it will protect your allies from your sewer-like intestines.

8454.descriptionId: This Gauntlet used to belong to Julia Dilch, master cook at the Bonta palace. After a while, she never took it off - a Gobball that refused to have its throat cut, a tough fillet of lamb, even the odd head of lettuce, all fell victim to her vicious blows.

8455.descriptionId: Though his Black Brakmarian cousin may not agree, the white rat likes to be as discreet as possible.... he padded the metallic links of this belt with tar so it doesn't make any noise... unless the person wearing it trips and falls... which happens a lot given it weighs about a ton.

8456.descriptionId: With these boots, your balance will be perfect... they're very popular with drunk drivers, they practically walk along the yellow line for you. Saying the alphabet backwards... that's another story.

8457.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Hat
8457.descriptionId: This headgear has nothing to do with a Dora... Honestly, it's completely unrelated! So don't bother spreading rumours about its designer being slack or uninspired. It's just a very nice looking cap.

8458.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Cape
8458.descriptionId: This colourful cape turns you into an ideal target. Only quick and nimble adventurers can wear it for more than a few minutes.

8459.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Necklace
8459.descriptionId: To dissuade greedy thieves, this necklace is secured around the neck of the heir to the Lord of the Rats at his birth. The only way to remove it is to take off his head... This doesn't seem to dissuade the thieves.

8460.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Ring
8460.descriptionId: This ring was designed at a time when the Lord of the Rats only had one finger left after mutilating all the others. The unfortunate lords that followed had all of theirs.

8461.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Belt
8461.descriptionId: The colours on this belt will have people thinking you're on fire. The optical illusion is so powerful that you shouldn't be surprised when complete strangers throw water all over you. Amazingly enough, this corresponds exactly to the ceremony's ritual.

8462.nameId: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Boots
8462.descriptionId: The very first Lord of the Rats died when he stepped in a pool of molten lava. To pay tribute to him, his lords wear these boots. By the way, they are not in the least bit fireproof.

8463.descriptionId:
This headgear was designed for Djaycy Awooare because he has a flat head, so balancing it wasn't an issue during wear.
He had it made after defeating the Ancestral Treechnid by cracking its nuts between his buttocks – but he doesn't brag about that much.

8464.descriptionId: In summer, the Ancestral Treechnid likes to sunbathe but as its wood is accustomed to dark forests, it doesn't stand it very well. This cape is made of his bark peelings.

8465.descriptionId: Worn around your neck with a low-cut top, this torc will accentuate your beard beautifully. If you don't have one... well... you only have yourself to blame.

8466.descriptionId: If you've had a little too much to drink, you might see the Moskito embedded in this ring wink at you. But don't tell your friends, the little beast will deny everything.

8467.descriptionId: With these wooden Shin Guards on, your legs will be fully protected. You cannot wear boots at the same time.

8468.descriptionId: This belt is supposed to inspire you with ancestral virility. Whether this was ever true or not, the effect has now surely gone without a trace.

8469.descriptionId: This piece of wood extracted from the very heart of the Soft Oak is extremely powerful. Indeed, it can even enrage the Soft Oak.

8470.descriptionId: This ring is made of Soft Oak faeces. It's wooden alright, but the smell remains the same.

8471.descriptionId: On Sundays, the Soft Oak takes a long nap and when he wakes up he likes to have an obedient Trunknid bring him his flip-flops. Fortunately, he doesn't have any feet so they're still brand new.

8472.descriptionId: More than 200 years ago, some fabric got stuck in the Soft Oak's branches. As the tree grew, it imbued the fabric with its magic. The cloth is now an integral part of this huge piece of wood and though it makes it hard to handle and highly flammable, its power can't be denied.

8473.descriptionId: In autumn, the Soft Oak wears its G-string to protect his precious acorns. In summer time, he likes to go commando.

8474.descriptionId: No matter how you wear this hat, it will always look like it's on sideways.

8476.descriptionId: You picked up this key in the Bonta Rat Dungeon. You'll need it, and its counterpart, to enter Sphincter's Dungeon.

8477.descriptionId: You picked up this key in the Brakmar Rat Dungeon. You'll need it, and its counterpart, to enter Sphincter's Dungeon.

8478.descriptionId:
This highly illegal potion is feared even by the strongest Pandawa warriors. A single gulp and you'll be obsessed with the idea of licking all footwear in sight. 
Students who are worried about their grades often use a similar potion for their teachers. Their breath smells slightly different though.

8480.descriptionId: This strictly illegal potion is dreaded even by the greatest. Indeed, just one sip will give the drinker a unique obsession: licking the nearest boots. Rumours speak of an alternative version that targets something else. The only clue as to this place is the bad breath of the unlucky drinkers.

8481.descriptionId: This hair is dirty and stinky. It roamed the most disgusting sewers of the area. And yet, it's still shiny.

8482.descriptionId: The scars all over this skin are actual proof of the Grossewer Rat's difficult childhood. You could at least feel sorry for him.

8484.descriptionId: They were once used to make fake moustaches, but they can also be used as fake armpit hair.

8485.descriptionId: Coiled around a soft wooden strip, this fabric can be used as a sponge or as a butt-scratcher. To each their own.

8486.descriptionId: This fabric, as greasy as a Wabbit Hair that has been dipped into Blop grease, efficiently protects you from the cold. Especially if you set it on fire.

8487.descriptionId: This fabric seems to be covered in a strange chemical... It definitely has side effects, but I really don't know what they are.

8488.descriptionId: This rat bone can be emptied, pierced and carved. Then it can be used as a musical instrument... or a little place to keep change if you're not into music.

8489.descriptionId: This tooth is actually a horrible fang that enabled the White Rat to transmit many diseases to his victims when he bit them. A way among others to make sure his victims would die even if he couldn't finish them off. All means are good when you want to be respected.

8495.descriptionId: This shrivelled up bud was completely drained of its sap by a hungry creature. If you plunge it into water, you'll see it resume its original form, swell, and then if you wait a long time, rot.

8497.descriptionId: This book contains the secret to a good Filtounga.... The mythic dish created by Mouss Bouff.

8498.descriptionId:
This meat is as tender as Mushd brain.

(This meat can be harvested by level-60 and higher Hunters.)

8499.descriptionId:
Most of the time, Koalak meat is quite firm. You can make it a bit more tender if you strike it with a Kaliptus trunk. Just like some (but not you) would do with an unruly child.

(This meat can be harvested by level-90 and higher Hunters.)

8500.descriptionId:
This tasteless meat can be preserved in mud for many years before it rots. Maybe then it'll have a bit of flavour.

(This meat can be harvested by level-80 and higher Hunters.)

8501.descriptionId: This Preserved Kaniger Meat may now be kept for many days before use.

8502.descriptionId: This Preserved Koalak Meat may now be kept for many days before use.

8503.descriptionId: This Preserved Crocodyl Meat may now be kept for many days before cooking.

8504.descriptionId: Either hot or cold, this Kaniger steak will satisfy the most voracious of appetites.

8505.descriptionId: This piece of meat will fill bottomless stomachs to the brim.

8506.descriptionId: This impressive piece of meat is obviously extremely hard to digest. But just as your eyes are always hungrier than your stomach, so your stomach is always bigger than your brain. Fool!

8507.descriptionId: The Filtounga is a unique dish. Its perfect melange of ingredients lends it a heavenly taste. Serve warm with a dash of cream and a sprig of fresh parsley.

8508.descriptionId: This dish is for the witch Paindep.

8509.descriptionId: The great Bworknroll Magus reveals his sacred Bwork beer recipe, without leaving out a single secret and even giving a few tips on how best to enjoy it. A delight for fans, a nightmare for those who've already drunk this beer without knowing what it's made from.

8513.descriptionId: Collecting "pieces" of creatures with the Bworknroll's scalpel will ensure you a good work since it preserves the Vitality of the torn off limbs. Use it in fight to collect the parts you want.

8514.descriptionId: Always overloaded with fresh globules, a vampire brain sucks in all the red blood cells it can. That's why vampires are so pale. As for Iops, it kind of explains their red feet.

8515.descriptionId: If we consider the weight and solidity of a Trool bone, it's easy to understand why it hurts so bad when they smack you during Trool-playing games.

8516.descriptionId: This heartless Bworkette, who got rid of her son Krazybwork and threw him in a pit, was cursed by Bworknroll when she refused his love. Locked up in a cellar, she feeds herself with her own heart. Every night, it grows back and starts beating again.

8517.descriptionId: This beautiful and fresh Mumussel is a great companion to Bworks when they go plundering away from their wives.

8518.descriptionId: From the depths of the Asse Sea, Mumussels collect kelp and roll it under their armpits. Once the material is shaped like French Fries, they reach the beach to brown them in the sun before eating them.

8519.descriptionId: This traditional Trool mess sponge cake is made according to an old Bwork recipe. Only a Bwork who's defeated a Trool with his bare hands is allowed to eat it. If he survived such a fight, he could eat just about anything!

8520.descriptionId: You can use this thick and nutritious grease to cook most types of food in old pots without ruining the dish. Some Osamodas also use it to slip tofus into places that the Iop moral code condemns. Bwork Magi sometimes use it for their spells.

8521.descriptionId: The red cape is the favourite artefact of megalomaniacs. Once on their frail shoulders, they believe they are Superman or an ultra-powerful magician. Until they meet a Minotoror at least.

8522.descriptionId: This surprising item contains a dark, concentrated magic that some say is highly unstable. No one can predict the effects it may have, but one thing is certain: you shouldn't wait too long before you use it.

8523.descriptionId: This family item glimmers with a sheen of extremely powerful magic. Usually passed from generation to generation, it hasn't lost any of its powers. There are very few artefacts that contain such power. Some say it has even been in contact with a Dofus...

8524.descriptionId: This Pingoku Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8525.descriptionId: Piwi eggs are a real treat for those who have a sweet tooth! However, they hatch very quickly when they're close to a source of heat. That's why you shouldn't leave it in your pocket or in your mouth for too long! A mini Piwi could come out of its shell when you're just about to swallow. And trust me, having a starving Piwi stuck between your teeth or swimming its way through your intestines is not what you need if you're ticklish.

8526.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bloody Koalak that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8527.descriptionId: These Goblin skin boots were created by Planbworksek to charge the enemy (if possible from behind) extremely quickly. These boots saved many a Bwork comrade in wartime.

8528.descriptionId: Thanks to Gordo McRamsay, you'll finally be able to make the perfect pancake dough to feed your little ones and send them quickly off to sleep. What's the secret ingredient of this filling and mildly narcotic recipe? Magical Cure, of course!

8530.descriptionId: This hat keeps your ears warm and absorbs the alcohol on your breath. What else could you ask for?

8531.descriptionId:
Who would dare wear such a ridiculous cap? No one, if not you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8532.descriptionId:
The power of this cape? When you turn your back to someone, your utter indifference will cause them to weep instantly. Only for the very spiteful among you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8533.descriptionId: The Flud is not really a hat. It's more of a parasite that tends to develop on loud or aggressive people's heads. Its disgusting appearance repels all and sundry, compelling its wearer to scream even louder which is useless since these people have nothing to say anyway.

8534.descriptionId: This padded cape absorbs all surrounding noise, plunging the wearer into a lifetime of incredibly awkward silences.

8535.descriptionId: These getas are so light that they make their owner run and jump all over the place whenever some action starts. Experienced adventurers just hate them... Every Tom Dick and Harry comes and crashes their fights uninvited.

8536.descriptionId: This belt must be worn tight... so tight that it forces its wearer to stammer, shake and generally jerk around in the inimitable style of Thrustin Timbertake.

8537.descriptionId: This small ring has no use beside making you look extremely flashy. Now people might actually want to talk to you.

8538.descriptionId: After several nights of hard work, the most famous jeweller in Astrub, also known for being raised by Bworks, announced to an astounded crowd: "c u l8r @ d gld hs". Even the renowned historian Champo Lhyon didn't manage to decipher the jeweller's message.

8542.descriptionId:
You can tell these gloves come from money. You can hardly smell the sweat of the previous owner, it's almost impossible to get your fingers into them, you'd swear they didn't have a hole at all.
All in all, these gloves just suck.

8543.descriptionId: This lemonade, made by the gods, is a mixture of water, bubbles, and animal extracts. It invigorates young souls on their arrival in Incarnam. For everyone else, this sparkling, vaguely yellow trash is just about good enough to use when training for burping contests.

8544.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Pingoku that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8546.descriptionId: Slightly curly, this skin will make a wonderful bedside rug. I'm sure someone around Incarnam will want it. You just have to find out who it is...

8547.descriptionId: Cirsid hizilnits irik nik gidik fir yik.

8548.descriptionId: Cuwsed cawwots awe bad fow youw health.

8557.descriptionId: This feather was plucked from the Batofu's armpit and it smells like a marinated ancestral Doobitchoo.

8558.descriptionId: If you're planning to communicate with Wabbits, this might be the hat you need. If you want to look good, put it on someone next to you.

8559.descriptionId: Mmmmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm, mmm mmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm mmmmmmm mmmmmm mmm mmmm'm mmmmm mmmm mmmmmmm.

8561.descriptionId: This cute Pandawa cub will gladly travel round the world with you and discover its mysteries with its big, round eyes. This tamed pet eats rice, but can also be fed with hazelnuts.

8563.descriptionId: Litol must meet his future magic teacher.

8564.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Pandawa Cub that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8565.descriptionId: This Pandawa Cub Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8566.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8567.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8568.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8569.descriptionId: This cap used to belong to a little Xelorette who got a kick out of disrupting the passage of time. Legend has it that she once stole several days off the inhabitants of Amakna. She had to hand out quite a few candies to make up for that little trick.

8570.descriptionId: This hair used to belong to the Bonta sewer rats. Indeed, they were the only ones to have hair tufts which matched the colour of their city wall.

8571.descriptionId: This hair used to belong to the Brakmar sewer rats. Indeed, they were the only ones to have hair tufts which matched the colour of their city wall.

8572.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the special spell Mount Taming.

8573.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the spell Perfidious Boomerang.

8575.descriptionId: A famous Feca warrior who lived in the jungle of Pandala was often heard to say: "To win the war, you have to become the war".

8576.descriptionId: Yse Vewybad gave you this scroll to thank you for your favours.

8588.descriptionId: This Rogue emblem might be the key to meeting their chief.

8590.nameId: Contract between Vil Smisse and Yse Vewybad
8590.descriptionId: This contract proves Yse Vewybad's treachery. All you have to do now is show it to the right person... For example, Amakna Kingdom's Steward, a man known for his loyalty to the throne.

8593.descriptionId: Uba Tesse gave you this potion. It will turn you into a Wabbit and this should let you pass yourself off as Allisteria's suitor.

8594.descriptionId: Uba Tesse gave you this potion. It will turn you into a Wabbit and this should let you pass yourself off as Allisteria's suitor.

8595.descriptionId: This egg contains an obese Tofu... a creature that may defeat the Prince of Wa in the future.

8596.descriptionId: This sharp sword gained this elegant crimson colour after gutting thousands of Bworks. Before, it was just purplish.

8597.descriptionId: This potion will permit Vil Smisse to force-feed the obese Tofu that you brought him.

8598.descriptionId: These blades have holes all over them so that they make a nice little whistling noise when handled quickly. The holes are also extremely useful when it comes to gutting your enemies.

8599.descriptionId: These daggers were forged for a manicure-addict Ecaflipette. She didn't like those heavy swords that didn't match her perfectly varnished claws.

8600.descriptionId: No wonder you're exhausted, you've been shouting at the top of your voice all this time. Wait 6 minutes or so. Maybe then you won't be so lazy.

8603.descriptionId: The Wabbit Prince's servant looks gorgeous, darling, when he slips into his livery.

8604.descriptionId: This shiny sword is perfect for trimming flowers and trees, even if the plants fight back.

8605.descriptionId: This blade has been lubricated to slip into its sheath more easily. However, it cannot be cleaned after use and must be thrown away, especially if it's covered in blood. Bear in mind that its main use is to protect you.

8606.descriptionId: The bride's wedding dress has been carefully wrapped in this gorgeous package. It just needs to be brought to Steward San Lavalss.

8607.descriptionId: It's a big staff with nails knocked into it. Do not hope for something else in this staff, it's simple and loosens your enemies' teeth nicely.

8608.descriptionId: Rumour has it that a Sadida named Fraye used this staff to protect his wife and son from an enraged flock of Gobballs. What a pity that he also mistook his family for the monsters during the fight.

8609.descriptionId: This bow is light, delicate, elegant and smells of cherry tree flowers. But watch out, if you use it properly it can also be lethal.

8610.descriptionId: If you hold this bow high and joyfully say "Pampulilu!", you'll look absolutely ridiculous.

8611.descriptionId: This wand belongs to a famous Grinegau who makes excellent coffee, but who just can't get the ladies.

8612.descriptionId: With the Bidjiz, you'll stay alive probably because your opponents will start dancing when they see the disco ball at the end of this wand.

8613.descriptionId: Created like a Smithmagic masterpiece, this shovel digs really bad, except when it's your opponents' heads.

8614.descriptionId: This shovel is a great invention. It can dig up a grave and be left on top as a cross, provided only one adventure fellow dies at the time... Or else you'll have to dig the other graves with your hands.

8615.descriptionId: This Hammer easily crushes skulls to pulp... which is exactly why it's tinted with a nice red tomato colour.

8616.descriptionId: This hammer was created during the reign of King Stephan, a terrible tyrant who terrorised trillions of people.

8618.descriptionId: This strange axe is designed to easily behead Bworks. The ease with which it can also behead Astrub's inhabitants clearly indicates that there's a connection between these two populations. But no one has discovered just what it is yet.

8619.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You can trade it in for a new item with Chaga Lachance at the Amakna Trading Counter.

8621.descriptionId: This appetizing cawwot looks pwetty owdinawy but it stinks of evil fwom 50 paces. Will you wesist the temptation to devouw it?

8624.descriptionId: Unlike the fake ones you'll find at the Trool fair, this balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with Strawberry Jelly eyelid, according to the traditions of the great magus Betsy Krokerr.

8625.descriptionId: This green balloon is a delicacy made by force-feeding a Green Larva a Luigie mushroom. The eyes of the larva roll out in the process and are sold to Bworks as appetizers. This balloon inspired Betsy Krokerr in some of her most famous recipes.

8626.descriptionId: Tis ippitiziknik hizilinik sims ti bik kitik nirmik bik is inik ficik ixtrimilik ivik. Wilik yik risiksitik tik timptitinik ti nibblik itik ik?

8627.descriptionId: Colleague and friend of the famous Guy-Guy (close parent of the Soft Oak), Sarr Ys is a minstrel whose enchanting melodies have been engraved in Amakna's collective unconscious. Unfortunately, this brilliant artist had a tragic Quaquack accident after a particularly humid new year's eve celebration.

8676.descriptionId: Vlad fell in love with this wonderful sword. He entered the most terrifying of all Dragokart races to get enough money to buy it. Unfortunately, he didn't know that the sword was cursed.

8677.descriptionId: This magnificent coney is the favourite pet of the famous Master Black Jack. Don't be put off by its appearance, it can be really fearsome in battle. This pet only eats cawwots and other plants.

8678.descriptionId:
Long ago, Satanass was a figure skater slicing up Holyball on Ice on second-rate rinks. While recovering from a broken tailbone, he had a life-changing revelation: his destiny was to be the most talented Dragokart driver of his generation! A little bump can sometimes leave a hefty lump.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

8679.descriptionId: This Ross Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8680.descriptionId: This slimy, slippery scale allowed its owner to escape capture by strange adventurers who fished with their teeth. Unfortunately, it was no use against the well-placed swipe of a rusty sword.

8681.descriptionId: Raul Mops has a real weakness. He loves to smear himself with water, wine and vinegar. What he loves most of all is rolling peanuts along the road with his nose. Dry roasted, by the way, just in case you ever feel like doing him a favour.

8682.descriptionId: Either side of this skin can be used for your DIY projects. The soft side is for cleaning delicate surfaces, and the rough side for scouring all your previously inaccessible body parts.

8683.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8684.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Ross that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8685.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bilby that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8686.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8687.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8688.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8691.descriptionId: You easily defeated the disciple. He agreed and gave you this scroll.

8692.descriptionId: This book contains theories from various alchemists about the possibility of Wabbit Twansfowmation. All it does is show how little they've done on the subject.

8693.descriptionId: Thanks to this pet, anyone of the opposite sex will be making eyes at you. Don't gloat too much, though. Very soon, you'll realise that your suitor has been hypnotised by Feanor. It won't be much of an advantage either: from then on, your admirer will only eat raw snapper and rub up against your legs... Sounds romantic, doesn't it? This pet only eats fish.

8694.descriptionId: This candied chilli is as explosive as the strainings from the devil's jockstrap. This mind bending mixture of sugar and fire led one Dragoturkey to a string of controversial victories in the World Dragokart championships before being banned by all major sporting associations. You can use it as a suppository if you need to make a quick exit or as a pill if getting in is your problem.

8695.descriptionId: Like Brice said: "It's not the size that counts, it's the sharpness."

8699.descriptionId: You'll always have an out-of-bed look if you wear this hat, even if you've spent hours brushing your hair. The hairs on a Tynril's bark curl when the weather is humid, which makes it the surest weather forecaster in the World. This hat fears fire, however, so be extremely careful and keep it away from flames if you don't want to become a human torch.

8701.descriptionId: This sumptuous sword used to belong to a famous thief who was renowned for getting nicked every time he committed a crime.

8704.descriptionId: If you shake your two little bells, you might be able to play music.

8706.descriptionId: This Feanor Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8707.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Feanor that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8708.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Atooin that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8709.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8711.descriptionId: If you shake this object vigorously and hold your ear to it, you'll hear a strange noise... like a tiny animal weeping... yeah, actually maybe you don't want to shake it... Ahhh, just open the damn thing. You'll find a wonderful pet inside it, as well as some food and healing Eniripsa powders.

8712.descriptionId: Congratulations! You managed to steal a piece of Goldemort's corpse. You'd make a vulture proud!

8713.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You might be able to get a few kamas for it from a kindly merchant.
