8730.descriptionId: This strategically-located bone enables the Coralator to sit down with dignity. Now that he's dead, you can use it to establish your own authority upon his fellow creatures.

8731.descriptionId: The only difference between the Worn Coral and the Great Coral is their size and what you can do with them. However, a whole lot of worn Corals will never replace a Great Coral.

8732.descriptionId: This coral's remarkable blue colour is a result of the Kurasso Craboral's unhealthy diet. It doesn't even manage to eat a single piece of fruit or veg a day, let alone 5!

8733.descriptionId: This coral's remarkable green colour is a result of the Mahlibuh Craboral's unhealthy diet. It doesn't even manage to eat a single piece of fruit or veg a day, let alone 5!

8734.descriptionId: This coral's remarkable red colour is a result of the Passaoh Craboral's unhealthy diet. It doesn't even manage to eat a single piece of fruit or veg a day, let alone 5!

8735.descriptionId: This coral's remarkable yellow colour is a result of the Mojeeto Craboral's unhealthy diet. It doesn't even manage to eat a single piece of fruit or veg a day, let alone 5!

8737.descriptionId: From what part of the Crackrock's anatomy does this ball come? And why do they always come in pairs?

8738.descriptionId: The Coralator offers you a bone from its backside. It doesn't have much use for it anyway.

8744.descriptionId: Just avoid shaking a Craboral on the pincer! You might lose your hand to politeness.

8749.descriptionId: Palmflowers don't grow from seeds but a bulb soaked in alcohol. Why? Just because!

8750.descriptionId: Palmflowers don't grow from seeds but a bulb soaked in alcohol. Why? Just because!

8751.descriptionId: Palmflowers don't grow from seeds but a bulb soaked in alcohol. Why? Just because!

8752.descriptionId: Palmflowers don't grow from seeds but a bulb soaked in alcohol. Why? Just because!

8753.descriptionId: This mane is an improbable hybrid of hairs and flower petals, which means it's doubly allergenic. So keep away if you're sensitive... a single sneeze could send your brain flying out your nose.

8755.descriptionId: No one knows whether the colour of this tuft is natural or due to some untimely bush fire.

8756.descriptionId: Kilibriss down is light and much sought after for the making of mattresses.

8757.descriptionId: Do you need an insect repellent? Just put Barbrossa's Shirt on! One side effect is that people will vomit automatically if they come within five feet of you.

8758.descriptionId: No one ever found an intact pair of Gourlo's shorts - he was a pyromaniac, and frequently burnt his clothes right off his body.

8759.descriptionId: This box is shaped like Flib... unless it's the opposite! In any case, it's still a cursed little chest.

8760.descriptionId: This scarf is an essential accessory for both the summer and winter seasons. It will give you an original look, though a bit kitsch. Its flashy colour will certainly excite male Gobballs, but is that really what you want?

8762.descriptionId: Thanks to this fragment, you'll learn the Cracklers' good manners: hand crushing to say hi.

8765.descriptionId: Thanks to its length, this staff will enable you to reach the most difficult places to access and to scratch yourself all over.

8766.descriptionId: One of Otomai's greatest riddles was inspired by this resource: what's the heaviest? One hundred pods of Kido feathers or one hundred pods of Pyrute?

8767.descriptionId: The Pikoko never was famous for its grace in flight. Once you've seen its wings, well, you'll understand why.

8770.descriptionId: This bark is curiously curved. It looks like it's been through a rasp.

8771.descriptionId: This bark is curiously curved. It looks like it's been through a rasp.

8776.descriptionId: There's no milk inside this Pikoko Nut, just brain juice. If you're lucky, you might find a few neurons floating on the surface.

8777.descriptionId: Should a Sacrier be lucky enough to remove several of these sexual organs from the four Tynrils after a long, arduous fight, the rest of his teammates would be well within their rights to refer to them as "The Sac's Pistils". Whether they should or not is another matter altogether.

8779.descriptionId: A little biology lesson: the flowers are the plants' sexual organs and the pistil is part of the flower while the carpel is part of the pistil... I'll let you decide what does what.

8780.descriptionId: This part of the Gwass' body is always green, no matter what. Is it due to some excess of chlorophyll or to something else?

8781.descriptionId: Don't bother trying to use the Barkritter Calyx to drink anything. It might resemble a cup, but it's about as solid as a sieve.

8782.descriptionId: The Warguerite bract refers to an area that decency prevents me from uttering.

8784.descriptionId: You won't defeat the Dark Treeckler by shooting an arrow in his Achilles' heel. But you can always try...

8785.descriptionId: With a lot of patience, time, water and fertilizer, you might manage to grow a Treeckler in your garden so that you can practice fighting against him. It would be easier to just catch a boat to Otomai Island..

8786.descriptionId: This thick and harsh hair can be used as a mop if not to hide your baldness. But you'll have to wash it many, many times before.

8789.descriptionId: Despite appearances, Kimbo does wear socks, but he just doesn't wear them on his feet. He prefers rolling them and then placing them in strategic places.

8791.descriptionId: This fabric has a strange texture but it can be used to quickly dress any modest monster.

8792.descriptionId: There's no milk in this Pikoko Nut but you'll find some brain juice with a few floating neurons.

8793.descriptionId: Round and shiny, this shell has been polished with slobber for several centuries.

8795.descriptionId: To hide his premature baldness, Kimbo puts on this stupid wig. Fortunately for him, the coconut covers most of it.

8797.descriptionId: A stump unlike any other stump, and yet, it spins.

8801.descriptionId: This fabric has more holes than Swiss cheese, but it is still capable of absorbing a maximum amount of waste to regurgitate at the least opportune moment.

8802.descriptionId: Just like all the other bones of the Zoth Warrior, this shinbone has been broken many times. It healed perfectly and became even stronger. If it could talk it would say: "What doesn't kill you, makes you stronger."

8806.descriptionId: This embroidered tab is more of a childhood memory than a military insignia.

8807.descriptionId: Unless you're flaming drunk, there's no way you'll confuse Ouassingue juice with any drinkable liquid you can name. The nauseating stench will dissuade the blind from knocking back a mouthful.

8808.descriptionId: This fabric has more holes than Swiss cheese, but it is still capable of absorbing a maximum amount of waste to regurgitate at the least opportune moment. BANG! And the dirt is back.

8809.descriptionId: Taking after their ancestor, Mopy King Dagobert, all Mopy Kings wear their shorts inside out. What's confusing is that it doesn't turn their stomachs inside out as well.

8810.descriptionId: Made from rotting vegetables, this peat has incredible powers of absorption. Mama Bworks save them for Auntie Floe's monthly visits.

8811.descriptionId: The Miremop spends a lot of his time taking mud baths in the hopes of slimming down. He has never lost an ounce, but at least his double chin evens out his figure.

8812.descriptionId: Slimy and dense, the Kralove ink can be used either to write romantic letters or to paint your room a depressing black depending on how your love life's going.

8813.descriptionId: Given the size of this sucker, there's no doubt about its grip. And when you remove it, the slurping noise is deafening.

8814.descriptionId: This purse is heavy - it must be worth a fair bit. A tradesman will be happy to exchange it for its value in kamas.

8815.descriptionId: This purse is quite heavy - it must be worth something. A tradesman will be happy to exchange it for its value in kamas.

8816.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

8817.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

8818.descriptionId: Made from Mopy King Fabric, this cape is riddled with micro-holes that allow sweat to escape more easily during periods of intense exercise - during aggressive melees in steamy swamps, for example. The holes may let the humidity out, but they keep the heat in, and so you always stay dry, whatever the situation. It's just a pity the stench of mould is so hard to shift.

8819.descriptionId: This cape may not be as powerful as the fancier Mopy King version, but it still has the same sweat evacuation system. You'll be able to face any situation wearing it, as long as you're able to fight while holding your breath, that is. The stench is truly unbearable!

8820.descriptionId: This sturdy wooden mask will have you fearlessly facing all kinds of dangers, which isn't surprising given that it completely blocks your view.

8821.descriptionId: From a distance, this hat looks like a lampshade with two holes for the eyes. It looks the same up close actually.

8822.descriptionId: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects.

8823.descriptionId: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects. The dark touch simply indicates that you're in a bad mood... and that you should not be annoyed and you're ready to throw a flurry of blows to anyone who does not respect that!

8824.descriptionId: You'll look like a Snailmet if you wear this hat. Of course it will protect your head from blows, but does that make up for the slobber all over your head?

8825.descriptionId: Bigger, heavier and more powerful, this mace makes a louder noise when smashing the enemies. But curiously, it's lighter and has a better grip to it. The Coralator we used to make it wasn't great for no reason!

8826.descriptionId: Despite her small size, the Zoth Girl carries a huge hammer. It's a way to reinforce her muscle structure. No need to add weights round her wrists and ankles to increase her strength. Dragging the hammer is quite enough!

8827.descriptionId: The Zoth Warrior is used to carrying two axes because he can't reach his enemy's left side with his right hand. It's hard to tell whether it is due to a lack of self-confidence or if he was just born clumsy!

8829.descriptionId: This hat is large enough to hide Barbrossa's ridiculously hairless head and beard. But it won't cover big-headed skulls.

8832.descriptionId: This sticky slobber won't break a Pikoko's bones, but it'll certainly keep one stuck to the ground.

8833.descriptionId: This hammer took its nice colour from the pieces of Coralator used to make it. Unlike what people think, it was not originally used to crush Iops and other enemies, but as a door-knocker for the hard of hearing.

8834.descriptionId: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. But don't worry, the dark colour is authentic, it's got nothing to do with the various sorts of deposits contained in the inaccessible cavities of the Treeckler.

8835.descriptionId: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. This might explain the stick's stickiness.

8836.descriptionId: Rotaflors use their stem to clean their ears. However, staff carvers prefer to use them as a weapon. Proof, if needed, that there's no accounting for tastes.

8837.descriptionId: This staff completely binds the Zoth Master, making him fearless and therefore formidable. When it comes to eating though, it makes an awful mess.

8838.descriptionId: Just like weeds, Tynrils can breed infinitely thanks to this simple piece of rhizome. After making this discovery some greedy staffmakers made a staff from Tynril and tried to breed it. It was a miserable failure.

8839.descriptionId: This is reputed to be the only mask that allows you to eat while you wear it.

8840.descriptionId: When Jav Kanniballs feel a little blue, they dye their hair this colour. Is it due to frustrated love or something else? Hard to know for sure, but It would be great if they could just wear the mask and stop telling everyone how sad they were.

8841.descriptionId: Many moons ago, the Kanniballs were travelling actors respected for their comedies and tragedies, as represented by two masks - one laughing, the other cruel. When their chief lost the happy mask, the Kanniballs descended into savagery.

8842.descriptionId: Kanniball archers can't concentrate and aim right unless they are very angry. They painted their masks red so they'd be fuming all the time.

8843.descriptionId: When he puts on this hat, Crocodyl Dandy thinks he's at the forefront of fashion. Fashion must be pretty dull if that's the case. However, it'd be best if you didn't let him know how ridiculous he looks, after all, he is particularly touchy.

8844.descriptionId: This hood serves as a royal headdress, and shares the same virtues as the Mopy King Sovereign Cape. Its micro-vents allow sweat to drain away more easily, so you'll always have a cool head. Unfortunately, it shares the same defects as the cape: its foul stench is so strong, you could cut it with a knife.

8845.descriptionId: It may be less efficient than the Sovereign Hood, but it still allows for a good draining of the sweat. Maybe too good, actually. As a result, whether you wear it or not, it won't make any difference.

8846.descriptionId: The Zoth girl's hat makes her see double. Strange. This is the reason she lisps.

8847.descriptionId: This helmet has the same advantages as other Zoth hats - it'll protect you from the sun no matter how hot it is, from blows dealt on the head, and it prevents the wearer from being aware of the danger by restricting his visual field. Anyway, this is the perfect warrior headgear.

8848.descriptionId: The main advantage of the Zoth Master Hat is that it restricts your field of view far more than any other helmet. Thanks to this peculiarity, the wearer can access the famous fighting technique known as "The Weasel". In short, this method consists of striking anywhere using all your strength. As it's completely unpredictable, you're guaranteed to defeat your opponent (or at least surprise them enough to finish them off with a well-placed kick).

8849.descriptionId: This stick is a firm favourite with the trunk-women. But it'll seduce any old kind of girl. Probably.

8850.descriptionId: If you're superstitious and always need to knock on wood, use the Floramor Root! On the other hand, you should try to be careful not to saw the branch you're sitting on and especially not to get your fingers in the way!

8856.descriptionId: When the Bherb has got butterflies, he wears his Bherbal belt and healthily eliminates them.

8858.descriptionId: These boots create a disgusting suction noise with each step, which will remind you of a rutting Trool's love chant if you've ever heard it. A painful memory that you could easily live without.

8859.descriptionId: This seal indicates that its owner is the undisputed sovereign of Otomai Island's Bottomless Peat Bog, although it's difficult to imagine a more pastoral kingdom...

8860.descriptionId: This ring was pulled off the still-warm finger of a freshly slaughtered Coralator. His mother was expecting him for dinner, until she saw him being transformed into a tombstone. Coralators are not as stone-hearted as people might imagine.

8861.descriptionId: Only Kimbos, with their weird feet, feel comfortable in these sandals. However, they're not the only ones who can benefit from their powers. But be careful not to wear them the wrong way!

8862.descriptionId: Parkinn Pan truly believed that he could fly thanks to this belt trimmed with Pikoko wings, but what he didn't know was that very few Pikokos can actually fly. That's why every time he jumped off the Tree Keeholo he routinely crashed to the forest floor below. His nickname "Cake" comes from "flat as a pancake".

8863.descriptionId: This amulet might be nothing more than a few pieces of wood bound with a strip of torn fabric, but the Zoths are absolutely convinced it has terrible powers. The doddery old fools!

8864.descriptionId: This bow string is made of Snailmet slobber, not too dry with a unique elasticity. However, its slimy and gooey texture reminds you of, well, nothing really, but it's quite unpleasant.

8865.descriptionId: Carved in a Snailmet carapace, this ring can resist anything and anyone.

8866.descriptionId: Woven from Zoth fabrics, this cape has extraordinary powers of unknown origin.

8867.descriptionId: With this cape on, you'll be craving for some vinaigrette.

8868.descriptionId:
The Cheeken Beak on this weapon is absolutely useless, and can be more of a handicap than anything else.
Fortunately, it is quite powerful.

8869.descriptionId: These boots are so heavy that they should actually be categorised as weapons. Indeed, they make the slightest kick lethal.

8870.descriptionId: Carved in a Dark Treeckler, this belt isn't pliable enough to let you move around easily, but at least, it'll protects you.

8871.descriptionId: Carved from a Light Treeckler, this belt won't afford you great protection, but at least it is soft enough to let you move around freely.

8872.descriptionId: This jewel is not precious but is the perfect size to balance the moorgale in a nice belgroot flavoured with a hint of Glaviooze.

8873.descriptionId: Finally a good excuse to smell of the sea!

8874.descriptionId: This jewel sometimes tries to steal some of your food when you're eating, so don't let it hang down too low.

8876.descriptionId: This strange cape seems to be made of black ink, but oddly enough, it behaves just like fabric - it doesn't run. As for stains, well, that's another matter. Your backside will never be clean again.

8877.descriptionId: Once round your finger, you won't be able to take it off, ever. Its suckers are way too powerful.

8878.descriptionId: This hammer is not handy, not particularly good looking, not very ergonomic, not powerful, too light, too fragile, unbalanced, too shiny and smelly. But at least it's got pretty colours.

8879.descriptionId: Unfortunately, this ring is only polished on the outside. You put your finger through a hole full of sharp rock fragments. It is recommended for Sacriers.

8880.descriptionId: It's the Mufafah moustaches that cause the wearer of this necklace to bellow so loudly. Why? They hang down and tickle the nipples constantly.

8881.descriptionId: Solo was a nice good-for-nothing, and he admitted as much himself. That didn't stop him from being hanged on the village square for stealing a thong belonging to the chief's wife. Solo wasn't a bright guy, no, but he was a nice guy all the same.

8883.descriptionId: This potion enables you to get back to your guild house.

8885.descriptionId: This Tabby Bow Meow Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

8886.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

8887.nameId: Tabby Bow Meow Bow Kennel Certificate
8887.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Tabby Bow Meow that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8888.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Mischievous Squirrel that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8889.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Leopardo that you left at the Bow Kennel.

8890.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

8893.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

8913.descriptionId: This potion has been made from extracts of bulbs that soaked in Kloug mash. The most audacious alchemists use rice flour instead of Kloug mash, which can no longer be found. Even though it might seem impossible, you'll get used to its taste.

8914.descriptionId: This card contains all the necessary information to find the handyman described herein.

8915.descriptionId: This empty card should be filled with all the necessary information to find a handyman.

8917.descriptionId: This strange key will enable you to enter the Grotto Hesque in one piece.

8922.descriptionId: This purse contains a considerable amount of kamas. Choose carefully who you bribe.

8923.descriptionId: A bag of potatoes? What are you doing with a bag of potatoes? Idiot.

8924.descriptionId: Once upon a time, a man named Rahm got lost in the jungle. Have you heard of Viet Rham?

8925.descriptionId: This strange bow was carved by a Sadidette during a very productive sleep-stroll. Just looking at it makes you feel sleepy - that goes for the archer as well as the target.

8926.descriptionId: These daggers are perfect for pushing Pineapis and shaking trees, or pushing Pineapis and grinding coffee, if that's what takes your fancy. Just remember: to the left, to the right, jump up and down and to the knees.

8927.descriptionId: Long ago there lived a mad Sram called Gaga... this guy, he robbed from the poor and gave to the rich.

8928.descriptionId: Porkeez is a better drinker than he is a fighter, and let me tell you he doesn't get any better as time passes by. All the same I wouldn't go around looking like a cork when he's got his daggers out.

8929.descriptionId: This should not be mistaken for the famous staff of similar name. The blades on this implement spill far more blood.

8930.descriptionId: Many a proud adventurer refused this weapon because of its colour. Many the same died by its blade.

8931.descriptionId: This sword used to belong to an old, power-hungry Enutrof. Just like his ego, it's made of solid gold.

8932.descriptionId: Smile! Say cheese! Perfect! Sliced in half!

8933.descriptionId: Ourag'han was an old Pandawa with skin so soft he was known as Slippiderm. His odour on the other hand gave rise to another name altogether. He christened his trusty axe likewise.

8934.descriptionId: Driven into a horticidal rage when a mischievous squirrel stole a grain of his rice during a summer holiday on Pandawa Island, Brouce Boulgoure used this axe to flatten each and every bamboo shoot the squirrel hopped onto. The Pandawas in the village had to feed him half their stock of bamboo wine to keep him from razing the entire forest. Trust old Broucey.

8935.descriptionId: Even as a young Iopette, Mel dreamt of slaying dragons. With a spade for a sword and a rock for a dragon, she honed her skills in the back yard. The mere mention of a shovel now has the poor rock in convulsions.

8936.descriptionId: This is a wild shovel which tries to bite its owner each time it's picked up. It makes the most unusual sounds when it's happy and can only be pacified with the soothing sound of chimes.

8937.descriptionId: A cunning Enutrof became a pirate after noticing that there were more treasures to be found on fresh corpses than in rotten graves. This blood-red shovel was his symbol and filled the sailors of the Asse Sea with terror.

8938.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase Wisdom by 20 points for 5 fights.

8939.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase Prospecting by 10 points for 5 fights.

8941.descriptionId: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.

8958.descriptionId: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.

8961.descriptionId: Superstitious folk believe that a simple rabbit leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, you'll be able to test the theory. Its blade is extremely sharp and doesn't it remind you of another sword you used to know.

8962.descriptionId: Superstitious folk believe that a simple rabbit leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, you'll be able to test the theory. Its blade is extremely sharp... doesn't it remind you of a sword you used to know?

8964.descriptionId: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.

8965.descriptionId: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.

8966.descriptionId: This sword represents the incarnation of the god Ecaflip's luck. You're holding in your hands the purest version of the Ecaflip Paw, which testifies to your incredible, yet somehow undignified, luck.

8969.descriptionId: This box radiates a saintly aura. Maybe you should think twice before opening it.

8985.nameId: Hippi-Ho for Pink Dragoone and Minifoux
8985.descriptionId: With this powerful pill, you can increase the characteristics of your Pink Dragoone or Minifoux for good. Be careful, though. Don't give it more than one dose or you'll have a dead Pink Dragoone or Minifoux on your hands. Speaking of which, both meats are very, very tasty. It's best to let them marinate for... okay, I'll stop talking.

8986.descriptionId: With this powerful pill, you can increase the characteristics of your Gobtubby or Ghast for good. Be careful, though. Don't give it more than one dose or you'll have a dead Gobtubby or Ghast on your hands. Speaking of which, both meats are very, very tasty. It's best to leave it marinade for... okay, I'll stop talking.

8987.nameId: Hippi-Ho for El Scarador and Croum
8987.descriptionId: With this powerful pill, you can increase the characteristics of your Scarador or Croum for good. Be careful, though. Don't give it more than one dose or you'll have a dead Scarador or Croum on your hands. Speaking of which, both meats are very, very tasty. It's best to leave it marinade for... okay, I'll stop talking.

8988.descriptionId: With this powerful pill, you can increase the characteristics of your Treechster or Minimino for good. Be careful, though. Don't give it more than one dose or you'll have a dead Treechster or Minimino on your hands. Speaking of which, both meats are very, very tasty. It's best to leave it marinade for... okay, I'll stop talking.

8989.descriptionId: If you spin around at the speed of sound while wearing this helmet, you'll take off. As for landing, well, you'll have to sort it out.

8990.descriptionId: This magical stone can fill the darkest corner with a shimmering glow - no need to waste your precious urine to mark your territory. Not to be used in moderation if you have a conquering spirit. Warning! You can place a prism only if you clearly display your rank (with the player versus player mode activated), and if you are in an area with no other prisms. The area where you want to place a conquest prism must be adjoining at least a 5-minute old ally area.

8991.descriptionId: This cold, slimy ring never stops sucking on your finger from the minute you slip it on. If you can see past its flaws, however, its great powers are yours to wield.

8992.descriptionId: This blade cuts wheat as well as enemies, but it also makes your allies extremely jealous. That's the destiny of powerful people.

8993.descriptionId: This sword holds an immense power of which the many victims fill chapters in the history books. On the other hand, wielding this weapon has proven mortally dangerous. Is there someone who can tame its vicious force?

8995.descriptionId: Used in the past as a blister bandage by Gourlo the Terrible, this fabric is still imbued with a dizzying stench. The funny thing is, one sniff and you'll be overcome with an irresistible hunger.

8996.descriptionId: This skin is softer than a Kilibriss' bottom. Fat lot of good it will do you.

9004.descriptionId: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Akwadala should do the trick.

9024.descriptionId: When we hit the floor, we're there to shine flashing our kamas up and down the line.

9025.descriptionId: Although it's all but useless, its stench alone will spread your fame far and wide. This shield accompanies many young adventurers on their first quests - maybe that's why so few make it to thirty.

9035.descriptionId: This potion enables you to go back to your guild paddock.

9037.descriptionId: Use this potion to reveal all of the invisible characters surrounding you.

9038.descriptionId: This potion will make you so angry that you'll automatically attack enemies that get too close.

9039.descriptionId: This potion lets you teleport yourself to the closest ally prism.

9060.descriptionId:
Part of a letter someone has torn up. Upon it, you read '...as we arranged, I'll make sure the investigation into this merchant goes nowhere. Come and pay me the amount we agreed where we usually meet... where the women are pretty...'
The letter is signed X.

9061.descriptionId: Exoram has to be escorted out of the goblin camp and up to the Sram temple.

9062.descriptionId: This document contains lots of interesting information about a guy named Xephires. What's most amazing is the amount of time he spends in the Drunken Pandawa Inn.

9063.descriptionId: This incredible list was given to you by Milone the jeweller. It tells you of the items necessary to create a sumptuous jewel.

9064.descriptionId: Is it really any different to ordinary slobber? It certainly doesn't look like it.

9065.descriptionId: This hastily written letter explains to Milone that the jewel is in danger... so why are you still reading this? Get going!!!

9066.descriptionId:
This was found on one of the burglars you beat at Milone's house:
Milone the jeweller has just created a very valuable jewel. Steal it by whatever means necessary. Fortunately, Milone gave them a copy, but it's no thanks to you.
On the back of the message, though, there is a guide to their hideout. A friendly visit? Why yes! Still, you probably shouldn't go alone.

9067.descriptionId: This letter from Oto Mustam explains to Xephires the plan in detail.

9068.descriptionId: You and Milone the jeweller joined forces to create this jewel. It'll sell for a fortune, if you ever manage to find anyone who wants it, that is.

9069.descriptionId: Oto describes the conditions for corrupting Xephires.

9070.descriptionId: This sword really is unusual. You've never seen such a thing in Bonta.

9071.descriptionId: Innkeeper Feubuk received the Ecaflips who mentioned Loudac's name.

9072.descriptionId: Innkeeper Pinchaut heard some guards talking about their problems with a gang of Ecaflips.

9073.descriptionId: You found this emblem on the Ecaflip Plain Bandits around Cania.

9074.descriptionId: This jewel will be just perfect for luring the bandit chief into your trap.

9075.descriptionId: This letter was transmitted to you through Marge the jeweller. Bring the jewel to Ekysoy Kubnan in the Woodenglass Inn. It'll be quicker for us and more profitable for you.

9076.descriptionId: This jewel looks just like the one Amayiro sent you to get.

9077.descriptionId: This Feca skull will make a perfect bookend, if you can stop the moans escaping from it.

9078.descriptionId: A Tofu here, a Bwork Magus there... This Osamodas disciple just lost his head!

9079.descriptionId: This trophy was already old before it became a trophy.

9080.descriptionId: This trophy was already morbid before it became a trophy.

9081.descriptionId: This skull is often mistaken for that of the famous mummy Toothan Khumin. But don't be fooled, those bandages aren't made from molten kamas, but from paper mache.

9082.descriptionId: That's enough of heads or tails. How about a game of knucklebones instead!

9083.descriptionId: Don't be cruel, this isn't a sparrow's skull!

9084.descriptionId: This trophy is as empty now as it was when it was alive.

9085.descriptionId: This cute Cra skull appears to have been fetched out of a recent archaeological dig.

9086.descriptionId: What? There's actually a skull underneath that huge thatch of hair?

9087.descriptionId: This bragging Sacrier, with his 6000HP, isn't so smug now, is he?

9088.descriptionId: You'd have thought that after being hung-over for such a long period of time, this Pandawa would have appreciated being placed in a coffin!

9089.descriptionId: You found this insignia during the (very easy) skirmish with Bontarian forces.

9090.descriptionId: You found this insignia during the skirmish with Brakmarian forces.

9094.descriptionId: This stuff looks more like mint jelly than poison. Bworks aren't known for making jelly, though... and neither are Brakmarian spies, which is even more worrying.

9096.descriptionId: The tactician agreed to follow you to your leader.

9097.descriptionId: You found this badge on a particularly frightening militiaman who vanquished several warriors from Brakmar. His equipment seemed very strange.

9098.descriptionId: This hammer will prove to Oto that you've vanquished the mercenary smith of Bonta.

9099.descriptionId: Signed by Amayiro, this letter is a request for official help.

9100.descriptionId: Lenglad won't want people gossiping about him for a very long time.

9101.descriptionId: In this toolbox are all the tools that Nara the blacksmith forgot.

9103.descriptionId: This letter, dated to a week ago, explains in detail the plan to attack Bonta. You'll need to be careful though, because a note at the end says the plan is still to be confirmed and may be changed in the coming days by officer Kapp Tenn. As a result, you'll have to find out what's happening with the plan at the moment.

9104.descriptionId: You found this insignia on a Brakmarian patrol you attacked at the Cemetery of the Tortured.

9105.descriptionId: Someone slipped this letter into your bag while Amayiro was giving you your mission: Retrieve the documents, but bring them back to me rather than Amayiro. You will be rewarded. Danathor.

9106.descriptionId: These documents contains lots of information on Bonta's defence system. But who are you going to give them to?

9107.descriptionId:
Break into the Tower of Brakmar at midnight and collect up all the documents that you find on the second floor. Come back to Bonta via the East road.
No, that's not what YOU have to do, they're the instructions for the spy you have to save.

9108.descriptionId: These documents contains lots of secret information on the Fogornleg Horn.

9109.descriptionId: This tattered old bandana is in a right state. It's covered in phlegm, like it's been used as a handkerchief by generations of Wabbits. It belongs to Elturt, that much is obvious, as despite the stink of cawwots, you can still smell rotten herring. It must contain very powerful magic if it still smells that bad after so many years.

9110.descriptionId: You tried blowing in it, but nothing much happened.

9112.descriptionId:
Break into the Tower of Bonta at midnight, cut the throats of anyone that tries to stop you, and collect all the documents you find on the first floor. Then return to Brakmar by road.
No, that's not what YOU have to do, those were the instructions for the spy that you have to find.

9113.descriptionId: These are the documents that the injured spy recovered from the Tower of Bonta.

9114.descriptionId: The secret documents that the injured spy found in the tower of Bonta. They were slightly crumpled during your fight against the Bontarian forces.

9115.descriptionId: This babbage was prepared in the primordial cauldron, which has given it special qualities. To find out what they are, you'll have to taste it. Sadly, it's destined for Elturt's consumption. Life can be so cruel sometimes.

9116.descriptionId: A weapon, a helmet, a shield: this crate contains rudimentary but effective equipment for warriors.

9117.descriptionId: Ougaa had a head thicker than anyone else, which is why a hammer created from the skull of this redoubtable deity is perfect for crushing those of others.

9118.descriptionId: Gidnish grishish me! This goody bag contains all you need for a successful shindig!

9120.descriptionId:
There was an unbeatable Cra, who performed all attacks from afar. He thought it quite strange, when the Neye stole his range, and his hits became very sub par!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9121.descriptionId:
A thirsty Pandawa went west, to see which great city was best. Not Bontarian beer, which was empty of cheer, but Brakmar's was quite full of zest!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9122.descriptionId: Once it wraps its Bloppish way around your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

9123.descriptionId: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

9124.descriptionId: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

9125.descriptionId: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.

9126.descriptionId: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

9127.descriptionId: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

9128.descriptionId: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

9129.descriptionId: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.

9130.descriptionId: This rough copy of the great Ougaa should be worn around the neck, with a hungry stare and a well-kept beard to boot.

9131.descriptionId: A young Craette named Colette lost her head in Eltneg Wood. The poor girl stepped in the way of Brouce Boulgoure's hatchet which he threw thinking she was a giant fern. Lucky she didn't live, she would have died if she'd found out she looked like a giant fern.

9132.descriptionId: Are you too young to get into the good clubs? Are you nervous around girls? Well, stick this ring on your finger, and hold it in front of your upper lip. It'll add a few years to your age and do wonders for your self-confidence. Just don't go out in strong winds, or it'll blow away, like your quickly evaporating self-esteem.

9133.descriptionId: If your enemies are allergic to mushrooms, let them nibble your fingers.

9134.descriptionId: This bow is made from sharp, thin, very flexible slats that are more often used to make beds than deadly weapons. Now they're used to bring on a more permanent sort of sleep.

9135.descriptionId: Originally, blowing hard into this trumpet-shaped fungal wand would call Jon Lemon, the wandering minstrel, to the scene of battle. He'd then begin singing and everyone who hadn't blocked their ears would die on the spot. Since this made it a bit too easy to kill monsters, the gods decided to plug the trumpet and turn it into a relatively harmless wand.

9136.descriptionId: The three points of this staff attract particles of plasmogrine present in the quadramental breeze. Carefully lick the points of the stick, align them with the hands of an inverted Xelor clock, count to sixty (try six if you're a Iop) and squeeze your buttocks together. You'll have a fifty-fifty chance of being hit by lightning or turning your enemies into grizzly Kirballs.

9137.descriptionId: These knives were once used to remove the fungus that infested the feet of adventurers. Removing the fungus actually means removing both feet, just below the knees.

9138.descriptionId: The different blades of this axe can be used to cut sausage very quickly. One blow is sufficient to produce three slices. It's not quite as useful when it comes to killing enemies, unless you're used to eating nothing but sliced food, of course.

9139.descriptionId: These boots are the perfect thing to put on if you want to go for a walk in the woods without crushing any dead leaves. You'll need to be careful, however, as their vegetal origins inevitably drive them to crush anything remotely related to manure.

9140.descriptionId: Contrary to popular misconception, the holes in these shoes are not there to let your feet breathe, but to let the spawn of your foot fungus escape and infect the feet of other footloose adventurers.

9141.descriptionId: If there wasn't so much mould on this rag, it would make a great tablecloth. Not to worry, you can always dry the dishes with it when your guests aren't watching.

9142.descriptionId: This cape used to be reserved for the best climbers, adventurers who could climb Crackler Mountain faster than anyone else. Today, it's mostly used to stand out from the crowd at parties.

9143.descriptionId: As its name suggests, this string assassinates any flies that get too close to your sweet spots. Just one piece of advice - never, ever pull it off a loved one with your teeth.

9144.descriptionId: The best way to solve crotch fungus is to lure it elsewhere. As there's no longer room between your toes to accommodate any more fungi, you can use this belt, a truly impressive residence for any fungus worthy of the name.

9145.descriptionId: Take an Elm, strip the bark off, soak it for a few months in a muddy puddle, cover it with fungal infections, stick it under your bed for a week while you sleep on the floor, basting it regularly with Blop fat. All you need to know to make an Elm belt that stinks. Are you happy now?

9146.descriptionId:
The tag on this belt says 'Sorry, but if you're looking for a way to get Ougaa's power, this belt is not for you.'
Well that's just great, isn't it.

9147.descriptionId: Take a Dora, cover it in Gobball Slobber and Iop sweat, let it stew for a couple of weeks and you'll get an idea of the intoxicating effects of the Mush Ombrero. Try to stay away from heavy machinery while you wear it. In fact, stay away from anything that's heavy.

9148.descriptionId: Instead of cutting down on impure Blop juice, Shika Ingalsse pressed on with her harvest through her inebriated state. One day, as she was stumbling and falling through the golden fields, Shika landed on this ring. Whoever said that impure Blop juice should be taken in moderation?

9149.descriptionId: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

9150.descriptionId: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

9151.descriptionId: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

9152.descriptionId: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.

9153.descriptionId: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

9154.descriptionId: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

9155.descriptionId: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

9156.descriptionId: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.

9157.descriptionId: They have to put heaps of artificial colourants and flavourings into this amulet to stop it coming out white when it's crafted. A word of advice, it might look great and smell delicious, but don't try to eat it.

9158.descriptionId: Does it make your mouth feel funny when you say the name of this object? Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face-to-face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot... Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad you have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.

Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face to face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot.. Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad to have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.

9162.descriptionId: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

9163.descriptionId: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

9164.descriptionId: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

9165.descriptionId: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.

9166.descriptionId: Some people let the grass grow under their feet. With these boots, you'll have enough foliage for four weddings and a funeral.

9167.descriptionId: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious, middle-aged men.

9168.descriptionId: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

9169.descriptionId: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

9170.descriptionId: Behind the silly name is a belt. A belt that we don't know much about. Its original design and its magical ability to conceal the worst love-handles known to science ensure this is always a favourite with image-conscious middle-aged men.

9171.descriptionId: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

9172.descriptionId: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

9173.descriptionId: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

9174.descriptionId: The tiniest bluesman in the World is playing the blues for this belt on the tiniest guitar in the World. It lost its buckle. If belts could cry, this one would never stop sobbing.

9175.descriptionId: If you tighten this belt fully, you can shut down your digestive system completely. Why you would want to do this is another question entirely.

9176.descriptionId: Jon Lemon created his last and greatest song as he was being slaughtered by the Bworker and this very blade. Goes a little something like - 'I heard the news today oh boy, Ten thousand holes all over meeeee'. Thank the gods that Bworker had the good sense to jot down the words and music of the ditty.

9177.descriptionId: The three points of this bracelet represent the three major weaknesses of the Bworker: Thirst for vengeance, thirst for victory and, well, thirst for liquids.

9178.descriptionId: This ring is covered in little bits of nose rubble from the Bworker's shnoz. The dirty creature uses the sharp points to achieve that perfect pick.

9179.descriptionId: When a certain Captain Chafer met the Bworker for the first time, he took the liberty of saying 'Wow, is that your backside or is it your face?' Nobody has seen the good Captain, or his famous moulded underwear, since. This amulet was created in his memory.

9180.descriptionId: The story goes that the Bworker sewed this cape from Rushu's butt skin. The story would be entirely believable if the Bworker actually knew how to sew.

9181.descriptionId: This beautiful helmet holds its fair share of secrets. For many years before it died, it was the Bworker's only companion. While it was still alive, he told it many stories about used protectives. It was having to listen to these atrocities that led to the helmet's death.

9182.descriptionId: A long, long time ago, Danous Kwaide wanted to be clever and beat the Bworker in a baiting contest: "Your boots are covered with earrings because you're too stupid to realise that you're not supposed to put boots in your ears", he teased. The Bworker replied by crushing Danous' skull with his axe. Do you blame him? Do you even understand what Danous was going on about? No, neither do I.

9183.descriptionId: This belt is used in the feast of the Dofus eggs which celebrates the gift of the six eggs, as recorded in the Biibl, an ancient text written by a Bontarian Joiner. Most people just paint ordinary eggs to look like Dofus and give them to one another, but some go a bit further, wearing this painful belt for the forty days and nights which precede the feast.

9184.descriptionId:
In spite of appearances, this helmet won't help your hearing. It'll help you see farther, though. Just watch out for any strong winds or you'll be blown away like a little feather.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9185.descriptionId: This headgear won't really make you any more fearsome, and definitely not more powerful... And if you think for a moment that some naive souls will mistake you for Goultard, well you're crazy. Your enemies will see you coming from miles away, that's all.

9186.descriptionId: Beyond his love for porcelain vases, there's little we know about Flash Gorgone. One legend says he was always in such a hurry that he could out run a Tofu... He learnt his lesson when he rushed out of bed one morning and tied his belt round his ankles. His porcelain collection still remembers that like it was yesterday.

9187.descriptionId:
Master Black Jack, the Eniripsa, was a dedicated follower of fashion. So much so, that he was even able to give stitches to real people after a while! A friend to tailors, they say that his inspiration for this headgear was a cruel tailor who once exterminated a tribe of Ouginaks called the Macians. What a lovely story.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9188.descriptionId:
This sombrero is the last trace left behind by a dark, heroic Xelor who is said to have disappeared suddenly. The last time he was sighted, he was serenading his beloved. What is more, they say his fiancée's brothers were in the know about the whole thing. Still others say he was whisked away into a parallel dimension just like that. The mystery shows no signs of solving itself.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9189.descriptionId: If you keep trying to butt the horns off your enemies, you're the one whose head will start to resemble a sieve! XVII's horns have the same effect - they make you forget everything. Except dinner time, maybe.

9190.descriptionId: This headgear is perfect for Cras who don't mind looking average. Careful though, you will look very silly, stupid even. Usually this headgear is given to retired combatants who've lost a good portion of their brain cells.

9191.descriptionId: This blade was stolen from a sword smith's shop window where it had laid for many years. Let's hope it sees more use in your hands than it did in the shop, because I think we both know that nobody will pay money for it.

9192.descriptionId: With this attractive and delicious belt, the bigger your love handles are, the better!

9193.descriptionId: This amulet will remind you of the happy days, the picnic days, the days before you turned into... this.

9194.descriptionId:
Lice used to eat your head. Not anymore: this new range of confectionery headgear will divert the nasty creatures. Now they'll graze on your hat instead, like a herd of tiny, white cows.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9195.descriptionId:
Roll it up in fruity jam, cover it in jelly and resist the temptation to scoff it. This treat is best enjoyed as a suppository.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9196.descriptionId:
Made from enormous coffee beans, this cape smells like a Pikoko's armpit. It really gets the blood flowing before a battle... and it's cheap, too.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9197.descriptionId:
Pop in two sugars, give it a quick stir, and quench your thirst with this revitalising hat. Sugar sold separately.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9198.descriptionId: If you find yourself stuck with a tasteless beer or coffee, stick this ring in there for a while.

9199.descriptionId: Look what you've done. Just look. Trying to smash coffee cups with your boots... what were you thinking?

9200.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to learn the spell.)
This scroll will teach you the Summoning of Chaferfu spell.

9201.descriptionId: This Scwoll weveals how to teach youwself, in 101 simple lessons, the basics of the famous but not particulawly secwet Wa Wabbit technique.

9233.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate cloaks. (You have to feed this living cloak other cloaks. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

9234.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate headgear. (You have to feed this living hat other hats. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

9247.descriptionId: This key grants you access to the terrifying Fungus Dungeon.

9248.descriptionId: This key grants you access to the Blop Dungeon.

9249.descriptionId: If you find the other pieces of this key, you'll have to go and fight the Rainbow Blop. If you don't want to look for the other pieces anymore after hearing that, I understand.

9250.descriptionId: If you find the other pieces of this key, you'll have to go and fight the Rainbow Blop. If you don't want to look for the other pieces anymore after hearing that, I understand.

9252.descriptionId: If you find the other pieces of this key, you'll have to go and fight the Rainbow Blop. If you don't want to look for the other pieces anymore after hearing that, I understand.

9254.descriptionId: This key grants you access to the Rainbow Blop Dungeon.

9255.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate amulets. (You have to feed this living amulet other amulets. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

9256.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate rings. (You have to feed this living ring other rings. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

9263.descriptionId: A parasite never feels so at home as when he's lodged in the bark of a Mushnid. From time to time the creature will scratch itself, tearing off a part of its diseased skin which can turn into a mushroom itself if it falls in the right place. This mushroom will then find the nearest Mushnid to parasite... as vicious circles go, this one is pretty gruesome.

9265.descriptionId: Here are some Miteters, those strange things you sometimes find on the heads of Cracklers with dubious personal hygiene.

9266.descriptionId: This blubber came from a Royal Jelly. It's an essential ingredient of paralysis potions.

9267.descriptionId: This Trumperelle trunk still has the toxic breath of its former owner. Now it's usually used as a phony musical instrument to kill whole audiences at 'assassination concerts.'

9269.descriptionId: The Mushmunch has a tongue of incredible length and softness for licking spores off its companions. If I'm not mistaken, it's the only enviable trait they have.

9277.descriptionId: The Mush Mish has the annoying habit of wanting to scratch its itchy eyes with its pointy staff. Sometimes it loses an eye, and sometimes when it scratches its neck, it loses its head.

9278.descriptionId: The Mush Tup has two arms, two legs and two heads. All this means is that it's two times dumber than you'd expect.

9279.descriptionId: This spit is delicious, if a little slimy. It's often used to grease weapons. Or warriors if they enjoy fighting with no clothes on.

9281.descriptionId: Ougaa has stunning headgear, and you're holding a piece of his special hat in your hands.

9339.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

9366.descriptionId: This pink tutu will be ideal for showing your little behind off at the New Year's festivities. Made of ancestral cotton and stretchy Sponge Mob mousse, soft and comfortable with a swishing skirt, this piece could be the first in a long line of tutus for a future star dancer.

9379.descriptionId: You should give this small box to the one you love. If you're the kind of person who hates everyone, you may as well eat it yourself!

9380.descriptionId: This special Fairywork will help spread the love. Can you feel it?

9381.descriptionId: Gluttonous Greedoblops get so hungry that they'll even consider eating their own flowers. Fortunately, their snappy jaws always seem to stumble upon a wandering adventurer just in time.

9382.descriptionId: This flower has been plucked from the head of a Blopshroom. Don't worry about it, the Blopshroom never liked it anyway.

9383.descriptionId: The Trunkiblop has great big roots which draw up anything adventurers throw on the ground.

9384.descriptionId: If this flower wasn't royal, I bet you would have thrown it out by now.

9385.descriptionId: If this flower wasn't royal, I bet you would have thrown it out by now.

9386.descriptionId: If this flower wasn't royal, I bet you would have thrown it out by now.

9387.descriptionId: If this flower wasn't royal, I bet you would have thrown it out by now.

9388.descriptionId: When dried, rolled and smoked, this leaf can evoke hallucinations in the weakest adventurers, as well as an implacable urge for... relief. An overdose can lead to speedy death.

9389.descriptionId: This leaf feeds on the grey matter of the Royal Rainbow Blop. It's a good thing it's not too greedy!

9391.descriptionId: This flower was hidden in the cranial box of the Royal Rainbow Blop. It plugged up all the holes in the creature's memory.

9394.descriptionId: This headgear will give Mitcho-class style to anyone who wears it. It does have a strong smell of undergrowth that your friends could do without.

9395.descriptionId: For several years this Bloprown was worn by Kuri herself, until the fickle gods of fashion mocked her for her taste in crappy hats and she stuffed it to the back of her wardrobe to gather dust with her Feca-style Wig, Youllbea Mantle, and fluff-covered Consolation Candies.

9396.descriptionId: Called 'Zawooin Ling' in the ancient language of the Lenalds... rumour has it that this item was forged in a volcano beneath Fire Pandala by Zeewon, a mysterious Wabbit.

9401.descriptionId: This skin has been through the wars and yet it has emerged unscathed. It should be just as useful now it's been removed from its former owner.

9402.descriptionId: The little wings attached to these slippers will give smelly feet some fresh air... But be careful, don't use them to play Gobbowl... Gobballs may not particularly like getting stung on the arse...

9403.descriptionId:
The little wings attached to this hammer make it lighter and easier to handle... It can even fly on its own and hit you on the head while you're sleeping. Hilarious.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9404.descriptionId:
The sting at the end of this cape will prevent your enemies from kicking your arse! However, you won't be able to sit down without getting hurt...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9405.descriptionId:
By wearing this hat, you have to accept that you're running the risk of being hit by a Moskitoswatter.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9406.descriptionId:
These Lousy Pig's ears are still warm, and they'll let you seduce any Lousy Pig you'll come across. Don't laugh; you still don't know how lonely you can get in the countryside of Amakna.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9407.descriptionId:
Some people actually call this cape "Cloak Screw" and just hate anyone who calls it anything else. No matter what you call this cape, one thing's sure, it's useless for opening up bottles!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9408.descriptionId: This ring will turn you into a Lousy Pig, which should satisfy your closest friends.

9409.descriptionId: This little cork-screw shaped tail will bring out the jealousy of the people around you.

9410.descriptionId:
Not as trendy as the Clint is, but a lot more elegant, this hat will show the others how sophisticated you are.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9411.descriptionId:
This cape will protect your back from getting sunburnt. But be careful: it doesn't go all the way down to the behind of every adventurer.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9412.descriptionId: The sling of this belt is tightly tied to it, so tightly tied that you won't be able to take it off. It will only impress highwayboys you'll meet.

9413.descriptionId: The spurs on these boots will enable you to cut up your Dragoturkey when you decide it's time to eat it.

9414.descriptionId:
Your head will easily fit this humongous emptied lemon and the little pip inside it will feel at home!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9415.descriptionId:
This cape was made from the peels of lots of different citrus fruits. It's a pretty, refreshing cape, but unfortunately it doesn't glow in the dark.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9416.descriptionId: If your water becomes tasteless, just stick this ring on your finger, stick your finger in the glass and vigorously stir it in until it falls off. There you go! A delicious blood orange and lemon mixture... and one finger less. You can't have it all, you know.

9417.descriptionId:
If you ever dreamt of drinking your enemies' blood while hitting them, this staff's made for you!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9418.descriptionId:
The next barber who tries to give you a haircut will be lucky not to break their comb.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9451.descriptionId:
This huge piece of crystal can be used as a rigid cape, though it won't make you stronger... But the next monster that tries to devour you will surely choke on it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9452.descriptionId: This ring will make your finger radiant.

9453.descriptionId: With this belt around your hips, no one will ever dare pinch you again for fear of having their fingers cut off.

9454.descriptionId: This amulet can be used as a bib for both the young and the old.

9455.descriptionId: You can wear this ring as a toe ring if you need to snuff out your foot odour.

9456.descriptionId:
If you think your backside never had the attention it deserved, just put on this long cape which will dress it up and catch everyone's attention.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9457.descriptionId:
This hat smells of Demonic Roses which should rid you off your lice, and any other form of parasites that squats your head.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9459.descriptionId:
Father Kwismas gets a twisted pleasure-pang when he reads the wish list of a child he's devoured.
You haven't written yours yet, so here's a sample.

9460.descriptionId: This is one Pokipik who'll never see the light of day. Aren't you ashamed of yourself?

9461.descriptionId: The Kimbo is said to wear this wig to pay tribute to a handsome, perfectly tanned young man that he met on his island. What a wonderful smile he had! Anyway, he hides the ridiculous wig under his coco.

9463.descriptionId: This jewel is so powerful that it'd kill a Moskito from 30 paces, if only its smell didn't prevent anything from getting that close!

9464.descriptionId: This scary amulet was hidden away in a remote mansion for ages. When it was alive, it used to dream of travelling around the World and all the places it would see. In the end, the only place it got to go around is your neck, the poor thing!

9468.descriptionId: This dangerous shovel will steal your Vitality, your youth, the water in your body and your precious Troofles.

9469.descriptionId: Made from pieces of fungi, this sword is perfect for infecting your enemies' bowels.

9471.descriptionId: This magic hat can only be worn by adventurers who are not yet married, and so wearing it advertises your all-consuming desire to find a soulmate to all the other tragic loners in Amakna, who will flock around you at the nearest Zaap, clucking and squawking like broody hens. Inevitably someone will let off a few Fairyworks in a vain attempt to win your affection, but you'll end up with a splitting headache, be unable to speak, and have the feeling that you're walking through treacle.

9472.descriptionId: Renowned for its aphrodisiac virtues, this sweet candy is the perfect gift for your beloved, and will restore between 11 and 20 HP.

9474.nameId: Risky Soul Stone for Sublime Souls
9474.descriptionId: You'll have a limited chance of capturing level 2000 souls using this soul stone.

9475.nameId: Regular Soul Stone for Sublime Souls
9475.descriptionId: You'll have an even chance of capturing level 2000 souls using this soul stone.

9476.nameId: Lucky Soul Stone for Sublime Souls
9476.descriptionId: You'll have a good chance of capturing level 2000 souls using this soul stone.

9479.descriptionId:
If nothing else, the pin nailed into this hat will shrink a big-head...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9480.descriptionId:
With such a nice target sewn upon your cape, your enemies will have no excuse for missing you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9481.descriptionId:
The pin nailed into this shield can be used as an extra-close combat weapon and kill your enemies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9482.descriptionId:
If you don't want to scare your friends away with your ugly face, just hide it behind this nice, welcoming shield.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9483.descriptionId:
When Iops get stars from their teachers for good work, they stick them to this shield. From time to time, they would stick them all over themselves to show off in front of their classmates.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9484.descriptionId:
This shield isn't quite a full protection guarantee for the owner, but it is great at chasing ghosts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9485.descriptionId:
The three little balls at the bottom of this cape will enable you to give great headbutts if you learn how to spin!!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9486.descriptionId:
With or without this hat, you'll look like a buffoon... But with it, at least, you'll have a good excuse!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9487.descriptionId: This certificate was given to you by Morgan Faym'n. It contains some details which may interest you and it attests to your conversion.

9488.descriptionId: This register belongs to Morgan Faym'n and contains many documents, some of which explain how to become a Bontarian. Inside is a page that you must fill in yourself.

9489.descriptionId: This register belongs to Morgan Faym'n and contains many documents, some of which explain how to become a Brakmarian. Inside is a page that you must fill in yourself.

9490.descriptionId: This certificate states that you belong to an order. If you want to join another order, you have to wait seven days from the date you received your certificate. Even warriors get to change their mind from time to time. Don't make a habit of it, though!

9491.descriptionId: You now see life through rose-tinted glasses, and you're happy as a princess on Kwismas Island.

9492.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

9525.descriptionId: This gift is a survival kit you might want to hold onto while going on dangerous love missions.

9526.descriptionId: You wrote a note on this piece of paper to remind yourself that you should never threaten an Astrubian when there are armed village guards nearby.

9527.descriptionId: Some old, powdered ingrown toenails which used to belong on the toes of an Enutrof. Many years have passed since it was ground down, but the powder still smells of feet. It makes you wonder if you might have been tricked.

9528.descriptionId: This powerful amulet used to belong to Lear, the leader of a long-defunct cult. Apparently he communicated with extra-dimensional beings and was able to clone souls. He was also able to resurrect himself... which must have been pretty handy when there were no priests about.

9529.descriptionId: Sometimes souls can't or even don't want to be reincarnated. This potion is useful for forcing them to regain their original forms.

9530.descriptionId: With a bit of luck, you'll be catching Gabby Tongues instead of Snappers with this rod.

9531.descriptionId:
This strange organ is sometimes used as part of the Gabby Tongue interrogation technique.
This underhanded method involves forcing the victim to swallow a Gabby Tongue, rendering them unable to speak without flailing around like a madman, as if they were moshing, or worse, slam-dancing. This tires them out very quickly, and then the secondary effects kick in - the victim mistakes the very first person they see for their best friend in the whole World. Getting information out of them when they're in this state is a piece of cake.

9533.descriptionId: This soul stone was enchanted by the master of the Order of the Putrid Eye himself and will coax souls into letting themselves be caught of their own free will.

9534.descriptionId: This soul stone contains the soul of Terra Bitya the Enutrof. You should take good care of it if you don't want your own soul to end up inside it.

9535.descriptionId:
If you manage to use it correctly, this potion can accelerate the growth of plants by modifying their genes. No one knows if there are any side effects when the plants are eaten, but shhhhh. What the customers don't know can't hurt them!
You'll need two farmers and two alchemists to carry out the operation.

9536.descriptionId: This scroll activates the effects of the Transgenesis potion when the latter is poured on oat cereals.

9537.descriptionId: This book doesn't only contain twisted stories of walking and talking dead, it also describes the ritual for forcing a soul to return to its body.

9539.descriptionId: You took this badge from a Bontarian renegade who didn't deserve to have it.

9540.descriptionId:
This cape will protect your neck from the wintry weather and your behind from low blows...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9541.descriptionId:
This rather original hat will make you look like the Godfather. You should be proud!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9542.descriptionId: These shoes are very shiny even when they're worn out. They're perfect for impressing your opponents when they get them right in their faces.

9543.descriptionId: This heavy ring will give more power to your slaps and more passion to your caresses...

9544.descriptionId: This fearsome magic weapon was made by the famous handyman Hissering. It channels the magic energy of its user before shooting it out with great force. It also changes the appearance of its user and gives them new spells to use. With this weapon, you'll become another person and your Tormentator your sole friend, until you decide you're done with it.

9545.descriptionId: This fearsome magic weapon was made by the famous handyman Hissering. It channels the magic energy of its user before shooting it out with great force. It also changes the appearance of its user and gives them new spells to use. With this weapon, you'll just become another person and your Tormentator your sole friend, until you decide you're done with it.

9549.descriptionId: The motto of the tailor who made this wonder was "Even in the heart of the action, your pants must always remain up your behind which they will thanks to these high quality flax suspenders". This really isn't a good motto...

9550.descriptionId: Merlinmagus told you where the Militiaman is going to use the Transgenesis spell. You must hurry and get there before it's too late.

9551.descriptionId: These sticky seeds have been modified, but you can't see the difference between them and regular sticky seeds. The real problem is, however, that you can clearly see the difference between them and poppy seeds. Only an idiot could confuse them.

9552.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

9556.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

9557.descriptionId: This key opens the safe which, according to Terra Bitya, holds the Statues of Sumens.

9558.descriptionId: This potion reveals all invisible characters around you.

9566.descriptionId: They say that the very first Raydi shield was forged in one of Pandala's taverns and that Pandawa herself, goddess of goddesses, had a hand in its making. Some say it protects from the ray while others say it was made from it. Reality or fiction? Marketing stunt by the shield smiths...? Who knows... only time will tell.

9567.descriptionId:
Hopefully you'll look like a masked avenger wearing this hat, rather than a masked a-wenger. Alright, alright, it's been a long day -_-
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9569.descriptionId:
The little pompom at the end of this cape is the greatest duster ever... It's so small that it can even fit under your furniture. Don't forget to take it off when you go work in the fields.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9575.descriptionId: This belt is reversible and can be worn according to what you wish to hide or show.

9576.descriptionId: Made from Black Wabbit backside skin, you'll be able to take your revenge on those nasty little creatures with these butt skin boots, as they'll feel like they're kicking their own butt every time you kick something. It's the simple pleasures that count.

9577.descriptionId: Your new favourite colour is green... It might bring you luck, or not!

9582.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

9583.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.
