9594.descriptionId: This gobtubby seems perfectly normal... Other than its wool being black in parts, that is... Give it time and you might be surprised!

9595.descriptionId: This Godfather's Gobtubby Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

9596.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

9597.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

9598.nameId: The Godfather's Gobtubby Bow Kennel Certificate
9598.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Godfather's Gobtubby that you left at the Bow Kennel.

9616.descriptionId: This Young Wild Boar Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

9617.descriptionId: This little ball of fur is more resistant to the cold than an ordinary bow meow. It's softer to stroke, but it's even more annoying than its short-haired cousin. This creature only eats meat and fish.

9618.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

9619.descriptionId: This creature is a little stupid. The only way to make it move forward is to attach a cawwot and stick to its back. Fortunately, it has been well trained, so it won't be breaking wind in a panic. This voracious soul nibbler feeds on the remains of other Wabbits.

9620.descriptionId: This Minimino was brought up by Minotot himself. Unfortunately, the beast's character rubbed off on the innocent creature, along with some nasty body odours from being cuddled. This soul-eater eats the carcasses of Minotoror Island creatures.

9621.descriptionId: This bag wasn't here a minute ago... What's inside? (DOUBLE-TAP TO USE.)

9622.descriptionId: This plant's existence is as mysterious and improbable as its name. Both here and here, but not right now, it's lucky it's not somewhere else, otherwise we'd really be lost. Take it to the Temple of Xelor in Amakna (coordinates 3, 1) or to Sorim Ait in Amakna Castle (coordinates 3, -5); only the enlightened such as they may try and understand it.

9623.descriptionId: Don't be fooled: this creature's pointed teeth will end up in your backside one day, that's for sure. This pet only eats its fellow swamp creatures.

9624.descriptionId: Take a Pink Dragoone, plunge it into a pot of black dye, throw some gold dust on it, dip it in oil, then water – now you have a Black Dragoone. This soul-eater only eats dreggon carcasses.

9625.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase Prospecting by 30 points for 30 fights.

9626.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase Strength by 50 points for 30 fights.

9627.descriptionId: Certain adventurers whom the gods have chosen may use this staff to aid their neighbours. What a noble quest you have before you!

9628.descriptionId: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increases Intelligence by 50 points for 30 fights.

9652.descriptionId:
This headband is perfect to absorb perspiration or to display your "Alowa Attitude".
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9653.descriptionId:
The wings on this cap protect you from your insults.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9654.descriptionId:
This cape will flatter the curves of your backside, or the hump on your back.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9655.descriptionId: The soles of these sandals are thicker than regular sandals to make sure they'll resist the weight of the heavier Alowas.

9656.descriptionId: These roller skates make it easier to go down stairs but considerably increase the risk of you breaking a few bones. It's up to you to take that risk.

9921.descriptionId: They say this bracelet is shiny, but only when you're in an inn or in the middle of the night.

9922.descriptionId: This belt has an incredibly powerful magnet built in to it which keeps it shut without a buckle. It's often used as added protection along with a chastity belt.

9923.descriptionId: The headspinners among you will have very little use for these shoes, but if you use your feet from time to time, they're just what you need.

9924.descriptionId:
The legend says that these horns were used as a lightning rod, concentrating lightning for several hours and then projecting bolts towards any unwary people who came too close. Another legend says they just make their wearer look ridiculous.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9925.descriptionId: This ring is closer to a glove or a mitten than a wedding ring, but who cares, no one will ever shake your hand the same way again.

9926.descriptionId:
This double-headed axe can cut off two heads in one swing, which equates to an eighth of a sixteen-headed hydra.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9927.descriptionId: If you wear these boots when climbing Mount Jifu, you're almost guaranteed to see strange UFO flying across the sky.

9928.descriptionId: These boots take approximately 12 hours to tie up and slightly longer to get off. That gives you just enough time to get some sleep every day or so, so long as you're single, unemployed, and very good with your hands.

9929.descriptionId: The Achilles heel isn't always below the knees, you know. Sometimes it's just below the waist. In that case, this heavy but effective belt will give all those wieners among you peace of mind and sackfulls of confidence.

9930.descriptionId:
This mask not only gives you the appearance of a terrifying, murderous man-eater, it'll also protect your delicate rosy cheeks from harsh wind and hot sun.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9931.descriptionId:
Long at the back, short on top, this hairdo has a bad reputation, but you'll surely change all that.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9932.descriptionId: This tuft of mangy hair was pulled out of one of Innkeeper Bagrutte's armpit. The smell of it makes you never want to smell anything ever again.

9933.descriptionId:
Every Rassler knows the most dangerous part of rassling is the crowd. So when the chairs and bottles come flying into the ring, wrap this Pikoko fur cape around yourself and curl up into the foetal position.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9934.descriptionId: The goblins are equipped with basic tools, so they recycle as much as they can, and this is no exception. Who would have thought that a simple bone could open their paddock? Not you in any case.

9935.descriptionId: This is some good string, and has the number one seller for climbers who go up for many long years. It also goes down, but this use is less popular. People from Amakna often use it to play greasy pig.

9936.descriptionId:
This helmet is perfect for people who look too kind. That can be very dangerous in the World of Twelve.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9937.descriptionId:
This hat comes with a fake toothbrush moustache, which is nice until you find yourself mistaken for a great dictator.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9938.descriptionId:
This sword's blade was soaked in concentrated firefly juice for 18 months to make it glow in the dark. It now stinks in the dark too, by the way.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9939.descriptionId:
This flexible bamboo cane is definitely not for leaning on... try twirling it round in the air instead.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9940.descriptionId: This mother of pearl will be beautiful when polished.

9941.descriptionId: This material is made from aragonite crystals and shellite. It was unknown up until Otomai Island was discovered and shellite was found on the Craborals there. This element is very precious to alchemists, although the recipes in which it's used are always jealously guarded.

9942.descriptionId: This ring is also known as the Black Band, but in spite of its two names, it remains unfinished. Even so, it's powerful enough to destroy a small planet.

9943.descriptionId: These shoes are rumoured to have been eaten by a starved gold miner only to be stitched back together when they came out the other end. That must be why they're so shiny.

9944.descriptionId: This charm is an amulet and a cravat in one, and it'll give you the air of a gentleman even when you're down and out.

9945.descriptionId:
Newddha the Prophet is famous for renouncing his family's wealth and sitting under a Kokonut tree, waiting for enlightenment to dawn upon him. Instead, a giant Kokonut cracked him on the head, leading him to leave all that spiritual nonsense behind for good.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

9946.descriptionId: Kain Dharyn's fame as a treasure hunter spread far and wide through Amakna. He discovered many crystals with incredible properties, including the power to uncross his eyes without using his hands. Kain told no one where the crystals were to be found, and to this day many Enutrofs seek it still.

9947.descriptionId: This Kain Dharyn Crystal was enchanted so as to multiply the greed of anyone who sees it.

9948.descriptionId: The Chief Thief will have a hard time walking with one Tibia less! Well, that'll teach him a lesson.

9949.descriptionId: This paste was invented by the famous Tra Khben, a geologist who specialised in ecosystems and harvests, and who suffered from arthritis of the back from a young age. This paste is remarkable for its ability to make any organic substance it touched rock hard. Tra Khben used this property to help himself stand up straight. When the geologist died, it became very popular with Enutrofs, for an entirely different reason. Its only downside is its smell which explains the ferociously bad breath of many Enutrof miners.

9950.descriptionId: This stone will attain its full potential when polished.

9951.descriptionId: This stone will attain its full potential when polished.

9952.descriptionId: This stone will attain its full potential when polished.

9953.descriptionId: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

9954.descriptionId: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

9955.descriptionId: This stone can corrupt unwilling souls, which is useful for transforming Tofus into Evil Tofus. When combined with other Corruptah Stones, it has the potential to give the bearer complete control over the souls.

9956.descriptionId: This stone comes from the Well of the Corrupted Souls. It can be used to control the souls of creatures trapped inside.

9958.descriptionId: This crate contains the kit of the perfect little militiaman. If the contents of the crate are of a similar quality to the crate itself, it wouldn't be surprising if it took less than a day to defeat the Bontarian militia.

9959.descriptionId: As you expected, this expert report confirms the poor quality of the Bontarian militia's equipment. Oto Mustam will be delighted with the news.

9960.descriptionId: This glass bowl contains what's left of what was lodged in Sennuig's stomach. The good news is that the keys to the warehouse are in there too somewhere. All you have to do now is stick your hand in there and pull the keys out. Don't forget to lick your fingers afterwards!

9961.descriptionId: This stone hammer was invented to lure smiths into believing that they were holding a hammer of excellent quality. It is strongly advised that you do not touch it, better still, do absolutely nothing with it at all.

9962.descriptionId: You stole this crate of ore so that Latem Sa wouldn't be able to use it to forge new equipment for the Bontarian militia.

9963.descriptionId: You stole this hammer from Latem Sa and replaced it with a Hurrian Hammer. Latem Sa is so incompetent that he probably won't know the difference.

9964.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

9965.descriptionId: This technique, developed by the famous Bow Meow trainer Roy Sigfred, tells you how to tame a Whitish Fang and make it man's best friend. It still won't think much of women, though.

9966.descriptionId: You got this booty in the attack on the Bontarian convoy. Stampitor the Boor, who you can find in the Brakmarian Militia Headquarters, will surely repay you well for your efforts. He might even let you go in one piece.

9967.descriptionId:
Laura Soho, waitress at the Amakna Inn, wrote down on this scrap of paper how to prepare a good bottle of Greedoburg with an alchemist's help.
- 5 Flasks of Pandaburg.
- 1 Greedovore Flower.
- 10 Babbage Leaves.

9968.descriptionId: This ultra-powerful mix of alcohol rips out your tongue, scrapes away your palate, burns your oesophagus and causes your stomach to explode before boiling your brain. In other words, it's a drink for real Pandawas. In tiny writing on the base of the bottle you can just about make out the following: "Consumption of alcoholic beverages may cause health problems. Drink in moderation, except when as an offering to the goddess".

9969.descriptionId: Wake up and smell the coffee, or so the saying goes. Well, this babbage does not smell of coffee. It smells of fish. Fish and sweaty feet. This is quite useful, really, because it masks the smell of poison, which, once gulped down, induces projectile vomiting. Great for livening up a boring wedding or playing a trick on your favourite guild leader.

9970.descriptionId:
Gropinson Cruaule wrote the recipe for fishy babbage in the sand on the beach and you copied it down onto a piece of paper.
- 1 Fishmonger (putting them in the dish is optional).
- 2 Lard Bass.
- 3 Crab Sticks ***.
- 2 Lemons.
- 4 Babbage Leaves.
- 1 Rasputin Cake (your own personal touch).

9971.descriptionId: These keys belong to Muric Bere. They unlock the door to his special forge where, amongst other things, he creates extraordinary items for very ordinary people like you.

9972.descriptionId: This hammer, to be used in a forge, was created for a specific purpose, which makes it difficult to use for anything else. Only someone desperate or on the margins of society would use it to make weapons.

9973.descriptionId: This Back-Scratcher Tip has several joints to make it easier to use. It has several prongs, and can double up nicely as an Osamodas'... hey, who writes this stuff?!

9975.descriptionId: On its own, this handle is of no use to you whatsoever. You could attach a scratcher to its tip, but that wouldn't be much use to you either. You'd be correct in assuming that only someone pretty twisted would know what to do with it.

9976.descriptionId: This back-scratcher is almost perfect. Almost, but not quite. Only a highly-skilled smith could complete it, and unfortunately, you don't know one.

9977.descriptionId: This very pointy back-scratcher will shape itself to your body's contours, reaching the parts other back-scratchers cannot. Yes, even there.

9978.descriptionId: Fatter than Gobball ticks, Plain Boar ticks can devour up to 100 times their own weight in blood. Vampires and even Dark Vlad himself would turn pale with envy.

9979.descriptionId: Nileza the alchemist created this potion hoping it would grant him immortality. Unfortunately, he died before he could use it, mistaking some Unikron Blood (which was in the bottle next to it on the shelf) for it.

9980.descriptionId: This dish perfectly illustrates Donna Kerbabben's favourite saying: "If it isn't for frying, it's not worth trying".

9981.descriptionId: Xavier the Baker used this flour to make the bread served at each of the funerals of the famous singer Jon Lemon.

9982.descriptionId: The name of this salad is a celebration of the day it was first created. It was served for the first time during the dubbing ceremony of the famous Iopette Donna Kerbabben. As with all foods destined for consumption by knights, it is strongly recommended that vegetarians give it a very wide berth.

9983.descriptionId: Served at the funerals of the famous singer Jon Lemon, this bread's taste and smell is so revolting that it would wake the dead, or kill the living. This explains Jon Lemon's many comebacks.

9984.descriptionId:
Here's the list Oto Mustam gave you:
- 1 Vaulting Rye Bread
- 1 Kerbabben Salad
- 1 Plate of Scrampi
- 1 Longevity Potion

9986.descriptionId:
- 1 Xavier the Baker's Flour.
- 1 Eniripsa Powder.
- 4 Onions.

9987.descriptionId:
- 5 Brawn Salad **.
- 2 Blop Petal
- 10 Treechnid Root.

9989.descriptionId:
- 2 Unikron Blood.
- 10 Potions of Old Age.
- 2 Memory Potions.

9990.descriptionId: This Brooch was given to you by Cheeka for your valiant actions during the attack on the convoy. It also seals her promise to thank you in person when she returns to Bonta.

9993.descriptionId: You must bring Sabine to the Militia buildings in Brakmar.

9997.descriptionId: This is the key to the bandits' hideout. Grimpil told you about a mechanism that closes the door automatically when someone enters. This is why everyone who associates with the gang has a copy of the key.

9999.nameId: Copy of the Bandit Hideout Key
9999.descriptionId: This copy of the key to the Ecaflip bandits' hideout is about to shatter. If you try to use it like it is, it will probably break. All this, plus the fact that there's no safety certificate, leads you to believe that the key is a forgery. You'd be right!

10000.descriptionId: When you hold this tuft of fur in your hand you seems to sense activity inside. You look closer, and yes... no... it's not fur at all, it's a tuft of enormous lice and ticks.

10003.descriptionId: Liroye Merline alone knows the recipe to this artificial jelly. When it's mixed with wet turf the jelly hardens and takes on the form of anything that's slid into it. This product is very useful for creating moulds.

10004.descriptionId:
This document on 1,001 uses for Nowaine Jelly was written by Liroye Merline. Here's what she says about copying keys on the cheap:
- 1 Nowaine Jelly
- 1 unit of Wild Grass
- 1 unit of Bakelelite

10005.descriptionId: A list of confidential Bontarian documents. You might ask what these secret papers are doing in the bandits' hideout.

10006.descriptionId: This report is very bad news for you. It accuses you of being disloyal to Bonta and implicates you in numerous dodgy dealings. Only an expert can tell you if the document is authentic or not.

10007.descriptionId: This flask of Brakmarian poison has been prepared just like grandma used to make it. The label advises you to keep it warm, and consume it slowly once you've opened the bottle. However, it goes on to say "don't swallow, unless you're the victim or a Bontarian". It would appear that the Brakmarians don't muck around when it comes to poison.

10008.descriptionId: This register lists all the clients who've visited the Alchemists' Workshop in Brakmar these last few weeks. The problem is that it's all written in Brakmarian - you can't understand a bloody word it's saying.

10009.descriptionId: Bring Xephires the traitor before Amayiro. They have a few things to... discuss.

10010.descriptionId: This key will unlock the door to the Burnt Cat Inn's gaming room.

10011.descriptionId: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had have done, so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

10012.descriptionId: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had have done, so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

10013.descriptionId: This is Petra's still-beating heart. It still bothers you that a disciple of Sram didn't put up any resistance when you took her life, but, after thinking about it, you tell yourself that the result would have been the same if she had have done, so, with a light heart, you take this heart to your beloved master.

10014.descriptionId: This cheque, made out to Oto Mustam, was written by Petra. It's a pity it's not a pile of glittering kamas, you could have discreetly helped yourself to some.

10015.descriptionId:
Oto Mustam is making you pay the price for failing the test of ill will so miserably. He wants you to find the following items:
- 1 Bag of Bronze.
- 1 Bag of Malt.
- 1 Bag of Hemp Flowers.

10016.descriptionId: This hatchet looks very basic, as if from another age. It's of such low quality that it would be impossible to cut a Trunknid with it.

10017.descriptionId: This Katana was made by Nara when he passed his apprenticeship exam. There is none other like it... it is up there with the Celt'axe for quality.

10018.descriptionId:
This blueprint is so simple that even a young Iop could understand it. Well... let's not exaggerate. In the hands of a handyman, it can be used to make items. If the handyman is a Iop, however, get ready for trouble.
You'll need this blueprint, 5 Etching Boards and 3 Kobalite.

10019.descriptionId: This bucket contains enough clothes pegs to hang up the underwear of the entire Amakna garrison. You could also use them to dry the skins of freshly-slain monsters, or the skin of your mother-in-law.

10020.descriptionId: You have a hard time believing that this ugly, smelly doll was once a Bwork Magus. Then you remember Bwork Magi are even uglier and smellier than the doll is.

10021.descriptionId: You ask yourself if the doll was better off before or after it was patched up by Maskara. One thing's for sure, only a god could make a doll more beautiful than it was originally. Now you know why the Bwork Magus was in such a bad mood and decided to shut himself up in a cave for years on end.

10022.descriptionId: It's enchanting to see this enchanted doll back in the hands of the enchanter who enchanted it by the enchanted lakes. If he was still alive, the singer Jon Lemon would certainly have written an unpopular song about it.

10023.descriptionId: Contrary to what its name suggests, this register isn't about Bwork Mamas, but the routes of Brakmarian patrols. There are many choices for an ambush on here.

10024.descriptionId: This old spellbook belonged to a cavern-dwelling Bwork Magus, so the illustrations in it will be difficult for modern cavern-dwelling Bwork Magi to understand, and even more so for an ordinary Bwork Magus. Let's just hope that Danathor will find some use for it. It would be a shame to have gone to so much trouble for nothing, wouldn't it.

10025.descriptionId: You were warned: the consumption of Greedoburg may cause health problems.

10026.descriptionId: Gropinson Cruaule wrote the recipe for fishy babbage in the sand on the beach and you copied it down onto a piece of paper.  - 1 Fishmonger (putting them in the dish is optional).  - 2 Lard Bass.  - 3 Crab Sticks ***.  - 2 Lemons.  - 4 Babbage Leaves.  - 2 Greenjely (your own personal touch).

10028.descriptionId:
This recipe was developed by the tailor Sosh to patch up magic clothing. Experienced tailors can use it to create a fabric that will withstand both the test of time and bad weather. (Action: sew a cape.)
- 5 Bwork Magus Beard Hairs.
- 5 Black Tiwabbit Hairs.
- 3 Gwandpa Wabbit Ears.
- 3 Snoowolf Hairs.
- 1 Silk String.

10029.descriptionId:
This recipe, perfected by the famous alchemist Uba Tesse, is a favourite among greying Stubbyobs, and now it's your turn to use it.
- 1 Magic Redness Dye
- 1 Magic Orange Dye
- 40 Red Scaraleaf Wings
- 5 Shiny Sardines

10030.descriptionId: This synthetic fabric, invented by the tailor Sosh, allows magic clothing to be patched up without affecting their powers. That might explain why experienced tailors value it so highly.

10031.descriptionId: This magic dye, invented by Uba Tesse, is particularly aggressive. It seems to be possessed of a willpower of its own, driving it to do harm. You have to wonder why it's just so aggressive, though.

10032.descriptionId: This bandana is in a much better state than it was when you first found it. It smells less of cawwot and more of fish, which shows it's back to how it was before. Elturt will be happy to have it back in such good condition.

10033.descriptionId: This warrant, signed by Kaffra Keeper, says that Brakmarians should hand over documents to Seci Ves at the foot of the Brakmarian Tower of Orders.

10034.descriptionId:
Here is the list of items to take to the Revelation Ritual:
- 5 Drizzle Potions.
- 10 Water.
- 10 Pandkin Seed.
- 4 Magical Cure.
- 2 Hornbeam Wood.
- 4 Draught Potions.
- 2 Trusted Friends.
- NO sulphur.

10035.descriptionId: Magus Ax has written the outcome of the Revelation Ritual on this parchment. To use the Fogornleg Horn, simply sling it over your shoulder and sing "Doo-DAH! Doo-DAH!".

10036.descriptionId: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of Fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

10042.descriptionId: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

10043.descriptionId: An extremely powerful beauty cream turned you into... wow! Just remember that being this hot can be dangerous!

10044.descriptionId: Mily slaps this cream on her body every morning to keep herself looking young and beautiful. Just try it and the results will amaze you! Make sure you don't get into any fights while you have it on, though - the least effort will leave you looking like an old hag.

10052.descriptionId: Use this potion to delevel the Osamodas special spell Spiritual Leash.

10054.descriptionId: This ring spent three years in a pool of Borbat guano. It's still magic, though.

10055.descriptionId: This amulet is supposed to stop vampyres sucking your blood. The idea is that they're meant to believe you're a vampyre too.

10056.descriptionId: This belt not only glows in the dark, it also glows in the light, although it's hard to be sure.

10057.descriptionId:
In the words of Lezan the Wise - "Well, bad hunters just see something, right, and then they shoot it like. And then though, good hunter, like, see something and shoot it. Good hunters." 
You can check if all this is true with this rune.

10058.descriptionId: Bram was right after all: you should watch out for grown men who prance around with makeup and long, flowing capes.

10061.descriptionId: They say that Countess Bathory herself used to wear these boots. Knowing her, they should be nice and soft... just hope there aren't too many pimples on them.

10063.descriptionId: An extremely powerful beauty cream turned you into... wow! Just remember that being this hot can be dangerous!

10073.descriptionId:
The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, had a magic shield. Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had a few copies forged to reward the best warriors of Hispañia. This shield is one of these few copies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10074.descriptionId:
This was found in combat against the burglars at Milone's house:
Milone the jeweller has just created a very valuable jewel. Steal it by whatever means necessary. Fortunately, Milone gave them a copy, but it's no thanks to you.
On the back of the message, though, there is a guide to their hideout. Revenge beckons, but you won't be able to do it alone.

10075.descriptionId: This horrible sludge appeared in your pocket as if by filthy magic.

10076.descriptionId: The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, concentrated all his powers into his shield, to his enemies' great displeasure. Years later, Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had copies forged to reward his best warriors... This very shield is no replica but indeed the original shield itself, rendering it the most powerful of all!

10077.descriptionId: Escort Terra Cogita around before taking him to meet Justfa Lafs.

10078.descriptionId: You need to escort and protect Deni Hoobe. It's almost as if the gods have been fighting against you ever since he's been with you.

10079.descriptionId: This bread is highly prized by the Iop community for its ability to fill warriors with overwhelming courage. The numerous deaths caused by its consumption are proof that it works. Xavier the Baker stopped making it when a company of limp-wristed troubadours terrorised the region for an entire winter.

10080.descriptionId: This message convenes the renegades to the Scaraleaf dungeon. You should go there yourself to find out more.

10081.descriptionId: In this message, the chief of the renegades requests that they meet him in the South of the bandit territory. This is your chance to get rid of this traitor.

10082.descriptionId: What do you get when you crush a Mojeeto bulb? Alcoholic sap that is used to make a wide range of cocktails. Otomai's disciples are very fond of these drinks and consume many litres during the summer festivals. Guaranteed to set the party on fire.

10083.descriptionId: Wake up and smell the coffee, or so the saying goes. Well, this babbage does not smell of coffee. It smells of fish. Fish and sweaty feet. Do not eat it in front of a rutting Lousy Pig, unless you're a female Lousy pig, that is.

10084.descriptionId: This whistle, crafted according to Roy Sigfred's Canine Breeding Technique, is used to call tamed Whitish Fangs. You can't imitate the master of a Whitish Fang which does not belong to you, though. It also works on wild Whitish Fangs.

10085.descriptionId: There's no mistaking the orders. Go and find the target.

10086.descriptionId: The fight with the Plain Bandits was so violent that one of them lost a tooth.

10087.descriptionId: This note was written by a Brakmarian. It says that Xarthan is to come to the Tower of Bonta after his next meeting. That means that he may be already there.

10088.descriptionId: You found this handkerchief during your battle with Xephires. It's a nice little souvenir, and could come in handy if you get a cold. You could also make a knot hat out of it, if you don't mind looking a bit crazy.

10089.descriptionId: Xephires has asked you to deliver this crate of merchandise to Counsellor Boyowa, care of the Grandapan, to show your "goodwill". You're not sure what's in there, but you know whatever it is valuable.

10090.descriptionId: Nara made a list of what he needs for his new forge: 20 oak wood, 1 sulphur pouch, 30 iron, 1 kouartz, 5 bakelelites and 10 Lousy Pig leathers.

10091.descriptionId: Erzal's Malediction indicates how to bring a soul back to life against its will. You'll need 1 healer potion, 5 magical cures and 1 Lear's Amulette, found on the corpse of a Treechnid or a Dark Treechnid.

10092.descriptionId: This letter, dated to a few hours ago, tells that the assault on Bonta has been cancelled due to improvements to their militiamen's equipment, and the capture of the traitor Xephires.

10102.descriptionId: This mask will protect you from the sun if nothing else.

10103.descriptionId: Ebru Of El entrusted you with this letter for Fidji Merline. You have to follow the Brakmarian Handywoman's instructions exactly.

10104.descriptionId: This manger has been modified to hide aubergines. You really don't want to be stuck on top of a mount that has eaten from it. The gases released by the excessive consumption of aubergines have been known to lead to horrific accidents.

10105.descriptionId: This leg is covered in Arachnee and Bow Meow hairs and can make a frightening weapon when Shush Tercesasti is confronted with it.

10106.descriptionId: This terrifying creature will take cruel pleasure in sucking the blood of your friends and will bite your ankles if they're a little too big. What it likes most of all, though, is sinking its teeth into a big filthy skeleton and nibbling every last morsel of its bones. We told you it was terrifying.

10107.descriptionId: This pet had a long, hard childhood, which was not made any easier by its frankly stupid name. Maybe that explains why it's a bit touched in the head, and why its sole obsession in life is killing Ouassingues and eating anything left on their bones.

10108.descriptionId: This Vampyrina Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10109.descriptionId: This Borbat Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10118.descriptionId: This Whitish Fang was trained according to Roy Sigfred's canine training technique.

10119.descriptionId: All of a sudden you feel quite different.

10122.descriptionId: Norb made a list of what you have to take to Nara. You'll need 2 Bakelelite, 10 Manganese, 20 Bauxite, 15 Dolomite and 20 Oliviolet Wood.

10125.descriptionId: This bow belonged to a bandit archer of old who used it to finish his victims off from a distance, so as not to get his clothes dirty. The magic which animates it is of such power that it can turn the heart of a saint into the gut of a daring bandit archer.

10126.descriptionId: This sword belonged to a legendary swashbuckler who couldn't stand chasing after his enemies. He learnt how to creep and crawl, and then took to cutting their legs off in the night. The magic which animates it is of such power that it can turn the heart of a saint into the gut of a daring swashbuckler.

10127.descriptionId: The wandering bandit who used to own this staff was terrible for the drink, and used to use his trusty pole to hold himself up while he practiced his noble profession - picking pockets. The magic which animates it is of such power that it can turn the heart of a saint into the gut of a daring bandit.

10131.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

10132.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

10133.descriptionId: Long, long ago this wand belonged to a Bandit Sorcerer who used it to reduce his enemies to ashes. The magic which animates it is of such power that it can turn the heart of a saint into the gut of a daring Bandit Sorcerer.

10134.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Vampyrina that you left at the Bow Kennel.

10135.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Borbat that you left at the Bow Kennel.

10156.descriptionId: These slippers are more comfortable than your average footwear, but it's hard to say why... perhaps the parasites that infest them massage your feet.

10157.descriptionId: This belt was made using the leftovers from spools of Flax String. It ties up rubbish bags too.

10158.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.

10168.descriptionId: Ponch polished his boots every morning before mounting his Dragoturkey and leaving on missions to save widows and orphans. Especially widows. Ponch was quite the charmer.

10169.descriptionId:
Ponch proudly wore this shield as he sat mounted on his Dragoturkey and ensured the safety of the streets of Bonta.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10170.descriptionId:
This helmet will protect the skull of its wearer should they fall off a Dragoturkey. It also makes you look like an idiot, even if you aren't one.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10171.descriptionId: These fingerless leather gloves are perfect for rainbow coalitions of dancing.

10172.descriptionId: This amulet will feed a vorpal slug for two days, or three days if it accompanied by a puree of your head.

10173.descriptionId: The soles of these boots are covered with a sticky slime and the interior is filled with a slippery slime. At least it's not the other way round.

10174.descriptionId:
The pores of this cape exude a sticky slime. You'll look classy if you lie on your back and let it carry you along the floor.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10175.descriptionId:
This slimy, dripping helmet will nourish your scalp and keep your hair shiny, if not healthy. The two eyes attached to the top can be connected to your skull if you agree to have the nerve endings inserted into your ears.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10180.descriptionId: This medallion acts as the key to a mysterious, forgotten city.

10181.descriptionId: This ring was found in a mysterious city where nobody knew of its existence until they began frantically searching for it.

10182.descriptionId:
This shield will reflect the sun right into the eyes of your opponent. Instead of dazzling them with your blinding wit, blind them instead with your dazzling shi...eld.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10183.descriptionId:
This mask will capture the sunlight and concentrate it on your face so you can stay nice and brown all year round, even if you live to the north of Amakna.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10184.descriptionId:
Noke loved to put on this mask and hide in the woods to terrify lost ramblers. He died a long time ago after seeing his reflection in a puddle.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10185.descriptionId:
Noke dreamt of becoming a big, bad wolf. Sadly, with this cloak on his shoulders, he was more like one of the three little pigs.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10186.descriptionId: This boar-tooth necklace will terrify boars, and by extension, your mother-in-law.

10187.descriptionId:
A long time ago, there was an aggressive boar that dreamt of becoming a stag. These daggers were used to carve it up.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10188.descriptionId:
This helmet will make you into an excellent protocol Wobot thanks to a unique device that translates the Oxon language in real time. It's also soundproof.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10189.descriptionId: This ring used to belong to the Oxon King. He liked to play with the sunbeams reflecting on the ring and used to say "Watch out for the Oxon Laser!'"

10190.descriptionId: Don't forget to put these boots on when you have your heads in the clouds, they'll keep you high. Even though they're cool, don't wear them to go dancing if you want to keep your feet on the ground.

10191.descriptionId: This belt is perfect when you need to rest and digest your granny's Oxo Bucco.

10287.nameId: The Four Bandit Brothers' Magic Formula
10287.descriptionId:
This magic formula was elaborated by the four bandit brothers: Smirkerth, Amlock, Dusolair and Firetellini. It will allow you to rob your enemies or young fans without a trace!
Once the formula is pronounced, its effects will spread to the World of Twelve... before fading away.

To celebrate the birthday of an illustrious queen, a feast is held. This crown is usually worn on the day of the feast. Its magic is very powerful, and it can change the colour of the person who wears it to orange. 
This will make it easier to hide among people dressed in this colour.

10417.descriptionId: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters - including a dungeon keeper - whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas, located in big cities.

10418.descriptionId: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters - including at least one archmonster - whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas, located in big cities.

10438.descriptionId: These boots belonged to the unforgettable Maidarte, a misunderstood genius who specialised in infinite loops and recursion. Nobody really understood what he was explaining nor why he or continually repeated the same stories. Just as the surf crashes against the rocky shoreline, so have his diatribes become a part of the landscape, forever colliding with the obstacle of common sense.

10516.descriptionId: This is what happens when you play with fire. Maybe it's not all bad, though. Pay Magus Ax a visit and get his advice.

10518.descriptionId: A handyman can make Climbing Rope using the following resources: 30 Hemp, 5 Silk String and 1 Flax String.

10519.descriptionId:
An alchemist can make Corruptah Stones of different colours using the following ingredients:
Blue: 2 Bluish Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.
Yellow: 2 Lemon Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.
Green: 2 Mint Jellies, 1 Ghetto Raid Potion.

10520.descriptionId:
A miner can make Corruptah Stones of different colours using the following ingredients:
Blue: 10 Impure Blue Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.
Yellow: 10 Impure Yellow Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.
Green: 10 Impure Green Corruptah Stones, 10 Water.

10544.descriptionId: This creature from elsewhere was tamed by its former master to only eat Blops. This may explain its strange appearance and its foul breath.

10552.descriptionId:
This headgear will keep your ears protected from cold and bad jokes.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10553.descriptionId:
Only a Gobbowl player would come up with the crazy idea of disguising themselves as a Tofu to intimidate their opponent. Mind you, this helmet's aerodynamic shape allows the wearer to slice through the air like a missile. Maybe it's not such a crazy idea after all. Either way, you'll certainly stand out from the crowd.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10554.descriptionId:
It's the integrated red sunglasses that make this the helmet of choice for any self-respecting Lamechester United player.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10555.descriptionId:
This imposing shield bears the marks of many a Gobbowl match. However, despite its robust, intimidating appearance, it'd be of no use at all in a real fight. You'd be better off using it to play peek-a-boo with Gobblies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10556.descriptionId:
This imposing shield perfectly sums up today's youth: style over substance – all bark, and no bite. It'd be good for nothing in a real fight, unless your opponent was coming at you with a ball.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10557.descriptionId: This battered old glove helps you catch Gobbowl balls, or any other round thing covered in wool, for that matter. What you do with it as result concerns you, and you only...

10558.descriptionId: With this glove on your hand, you can pretend you're a famous Gobbowl player when you're playing fetch with your Bow Wow.

10559.descriptionId: Gobbowl matches are brutal, and this belt was designed to protect players from muscular blows. However, you can also use it as a life-belt when you're taking a bath. Who'd have thought?

10560.descriptionId: They say that Gobbowl is a game for real men. This belt's for real men too, with plenty of protective padding to soften low blows. It's also great for training young Srams.

10561.descriptionId: These boots have been around for a while, you can certainly smell that. Plant them on your feet and you'll look just like a real Gobbowl player. Plant their crampons in the rump of a few Gobblies, and the fans will come flocking.

10562.descriptionId: "Fashionable footwear feeds fascinated fan's frenzy", reads the latest headline, and for once, the papers aren't wrong. When properly polished, these boots help make it look like your opponent pushed you over, when in fact, you slipped. Congratulations! You've just learnt one of the basics of Gobbowl.

10563.descriptionId: This orb allows you to redistribute your characteristic points. Temple masters know how to use it.

10564.descriptionId: This box contains a carefully wrapped orb.

10597.descriptionId: This Jellufo Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10598.descriptionId: If you hold this gift to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise which reveals the presence of a living creature inside. Open it, and you'll find a wonderful pet, as well as a book explaining how to raise it, some food and some healing Eniripsa Powder.

10599.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Jellufo that you left at the Bow Kennel.

10601.descriptionId: This document certifies that your characteristics have been reset.

10602.descriptionId: This scroll will teach you the special spell Mount Taming.

10603.descriptionId: This scroll will teach you the special spell Soul Capture.

10604.descriptionId: This scroll will teach you the elementary spell Moon Hammer.

10605.descriptionId: This scroll will teach you the elementary spell Perfidious Boomerang.

10606.descriptionId:
Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster.
Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

10608.descriptionId: This potion will take you straight to the indicated monster.

10618.descriptionId: This rune will increase damage dealt to your enemies.

10619.descriptionId: This rune will increase damage dealt to your enemies.

10621.descriptionId: This torn piece of paper lists all the instructions of the Sacre Family. They are quite simple. They order you to track and execute a target. And do not come back before 10 minutes after the fight.

10622.descriptionId: This sword allowed Grute the Bwork to cut his opponents' nuts in two, which is usually enough to make anyone give up a fight. This magical weapon is still imbued with the personality of Grute. If you equip it, you may well become him.

10623.descriptionId: Grute the Bwork wasn't very smart. In fact, he was as thick as two short planks. Fortunately, traditional teaching methods work equally well on Bworks than on children. After a few well-deserved strokes of the cane over the years, Grute became a real little brute.

10624.descriptionId: Those who have had to face Grute the Bwork will tell you, "Don't bother aiming for the head, it's empty". This advice also applies to all those who face Iops, Goblins or mothers-in-law.

10625.descriptionId: Grute's Boots give off such a pungent aroma that you'll be able to knock your opponents out with one quick kick to their head. These boots were forbidden in combat situations by the Sufokia Convention a long time ago, a convention which, it has to be said, has saved many, many lives.

10626.descriptionId:
The life of a Chafer Foot Soldier is not as rosy as you'd think. Although I'm not sure you've ever thought about it. Iop knows I've never thought of it myself, the life of a good, long, tall, strong Chafer Foot Soldier like Koksiks. In fact, I often lie awake at night, not thinking of the life of a Chafer Foot Soldier. Wonderful lads.
Anyway, enough of that. This sword is still infused with the spirit of Koksiks, and by equipping it, you could become him.

10627.descriptionId: This ring belonged to Koksiks himself, and a lovely ring it is too. He let me have it once... but took it back some months later. Ahh. When I think of it now...

10628.descriptionId: You should have seen Koksiks go in these boots. A sight to behold he was. Dancing. We danced once, but that was... a long time ago.

10629.descriptionId: Koksiks the Chafer Foot Soldier was a very talented fellow. I remember how we used to sit down around the fire after a long day of fighting, and he would take his mandolin and just play beautiful songs, such beautiful songs... just staring into the fire together... Anyway. That's all over now.

10630.descriptionId:
This staff looks very much like a lance... in fact, Goboff the Goblin used it to cut the tops off his boiled Giant Tofu eggs, back when the birds existed. What he used for toast soldiers is anyone's guess.
This magic weapon is still imbued with the spirit of Goboff. If you equip it, you could perhaps become him.

10631.descriptionId: A popular saying amongst Goblins is "Sometimes you get the bear, sometimes the bear gets you". If you look at Goblins closely, this saying is better summarised as "Sometimes the bear gets you".

10632.descriptionId: Goboff the Goblin loved to gobble rotten eggs. His digestive tract might have been able to deal with this atrocious habit, but those unlucky enough to get a whiff of his foul breath weren't, and fell like Moskitos. Those unlucky enough not to be rendered unconscious immediately would grab onto this belt to stop themselves hitting the floor.

10633.descriptionId: Goboff the Goblin was a keen gardener. He loved nothing more than whacking trespassers around the head with his rake. He found this ring on the finger of an impudent rambler who'd dared to trample his babbage leaves.

10634.descriptionId: Kanniball Lektor used this weapon to hunt his prey, and send a few arrows his children's' way when he was in a playful mood. This magic weapon is still imbued with the spirit of Kanniball Lektor. If you equip it, you could perhaps become him.

10635.descriptionId: When the two small balls attached to this amulet collide, they produce a slight rattling noise, which means a Kanniball is very close by. When you hear this noise, it is usually too late to escape, but there is still time to choose which sauce you want to be devoured with.

10636.descriptionId: The ring is infused with secret spices, used for flavouring broth when stirred by hand. The spices are so good that once you put the ring on, there's a real risk you'll bite your own fingers off, they'll be that tasty.

10637.descriptionId: Kanniball Lektor wore these boots for several years before trading them in for a tourist on Moon Island. Look, he was hungry, alright?

10638.descriptionId: Pandit Stroy Zemol used to hit his adversaries with the flat of this weapon's blade in order to knock them out without causing a scratch. Cursed for years with taunts about his name, the Pandit did not want to destroy them all, just render them unconscious for a while. This weapon is still infused with the spirit of Stroy Zemol, and by equipping it, you could become him.

10639.descriptionId: Stroy Zemol had a sister, Faye Pworme. She liked travelling alone and exploring dark, foul-smelling tunnels.

10640.descriptionId: This belt is allegedly reversible, only no one's ever dared try it as they don't want to be the first to discover that it isn't actually reversible.

10641.descriptionId: Stroy Zemol made these boots himself, from a few blocks of wood and a little bit of fabric. They might not look like other boots, but blimey, they're certainly magical nevertheless.

10642.descriptionId: Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner used this pickaxe to carve out the famous bottomless Kruup mine, in which Gaddie lived for several years. This weapon is still charged Fyred Ampe's magic. You might be able to use it to summon him.

10643.descriptionId: When it comes into contact with warm, sticky liquids, this ring changes colour, which explains why Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner loved it so much.

10644.descriptionId: The soles of these magic boots allow you to shatter lumps of coal by vibrating at its resonant frequency (look it up). The user guide indicates that they will even vibrate on their own when Slamdance music is played nearby.

10645.descriptionId: This belt, reinforced with several different metals, was strong enough to support the weight of Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner's enormous sack. Don't worry, though, it should be just as useful for tiny packets too.

10657.descriptionId: This strange pet is a cross of the best truffle hunters in all Amakna. Its massive snout lets it sniff out all sorts of rare plants, even ones hidden underwater. It seems Otomai took several years to achieve this species, and it's said that he's using it to correct one of his mistakes and find what he lost or let escape. The Ghoultus was raised on the beaches of Otomai Island and devours only the souls of the creatures that live there.

10658.descriptionId: This Ghoultus Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10659.descriptionId: This strange egg contains a tiny magical creature. Keep it warm, and it's sure to hatch.

10662.descriptionId: This rune will increase your luck in finding rare items.

10663.descriptionId: You'll need a strong stomach to swallow this pasty. The gobball meat used in it, not always the freshest cut it has to be said, gives it a flavour akin to oysters in chocolate. Bworks go mad for it.

10664.descriptionId: If you rub this tiny acorn gently, it will begin to swell, and after a short time, if you rub a little more, the Treechnid trapped inside it will come bursting out.

10665.descriptionId: Jorbak lost his entire fortune, could it be hidden inside this strange trunk? Open it and find out.

10667.descriptionId: You've noted down when Jorbak's spirit will be visible. No need to rush things.

10668.descriptionId: For a short time, you'll benefit from Jorbak's luck.

10669.descriptionId: That'll teach you to drink whatever is put in front of you!

10670.descriptionId: As easy to follow as a Wabbit Wecipe, this scroll's text reveals a bewitching secret.

10674.descriptionId: Mmmmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm, mmm mmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm mmmmmmm mmmmmm mmm mmmm'm mmmmm mmmm mmmmmmm.

10675.descriptionId: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!

10676.descriptionId: Your Prospecting and the experience you receive are increased for 20 fights.

10680.descriptionId: You tore this still-beating heart out of the body of Goultard's Evil Essence. You can now put it on your desk as a souvenir.

10686.descriptionId:
This fabric cloak, coated with a thin layer of gold, is magical. It attracts attention and reflects light directly into the pupils of dishonest types who try to stab you from behind. Essential if you have Sram friends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10687.descriptionId: This ring is so heavy that it greatly increases the inertia of your fist when you distribute blows to your opponents. When you begin punishing peasants, it will be virtually impossible to stop you.

10688.descriptionId: This belt is perfect to hang your gold bars around your waist, they'll pass unnoticed.

10784.descriptionId: No one has a clue what powers this amulet brings, but everyone knows what it takes away: your credibility.

10785.descriptionId: You've heard of the game "Pick it, lick it, roll it, flick it", right? Well this ring will protect you from the flicked stuff.

10786.descriptionId: The little immature Koalak who's skin you tore off didn't want you to treat him that way... but hey, you're stronger and crueller than he is.

10787.descriptionId: This wing smells like sulphur. Any Dragoturkey breeder will tell you it's the most tender part for a barbecue. Just don't forget to season it because the wing is also the most tasteless part.

10788.descriptionId: The domestic Dragoturkey tastes much better than its wild cousin. It has no sulphurous aftertaste, and the meat is delightfully moreish. That's why it's every child's favourite meal.

10789.descriptionId: These hairs are covered in Kaliptus sap, giving them a shiny glint. Unfortunately, they cannot be used for haute couture as they smell like rotting Dragoturkey.

10790.descriptionId: Mama Koalak has particularly solid bones that don't break under her weight. The same cannot be said for the famous minstrel Jon Lemon who lost the use of both his arms when he got squashed by Mama Koalak's humongous thighs.

10791.descriptionId: These hairs will give you beard rash. They change simple Brown Warko kisses into weapons of mass destruction.

10792.descriptionId: This flask once contained a urine sample. Now it contains a potion that'll give you back some HP. Was it washed beforehand? Dare you to find out!

10793.descriptionId: It's bone-dry, you'll break your teeth on it, it smells of unwashed Bwork underpants, but it'll give you back some HP, so stop pulling that face and swallow it down.

10794.descriptionId: Warm on the inside and cold on the outside, these boots will let you kick snowmen's arses without melting their pert little buttocks.

10795.descriptionId: If you hit this fish, you'll hear it echo. Hit yourself while you're eating it and you'll transform yourself into a musical instrument.

10796.descriptionId: Take a small amount of anything indigestible you can find in the country of Amakna, blend it up with some red-hot spices, wrap it in rancid, sweaty pastry, and you'll end up with this nigh-on inedible pasty. Pushed into a young Feca's mouth, it makes a great dummy, though.

10797.descriptionId: Unsheathed from its scabbard, this sword can cut ham, Enutrofs, one-legged men, dancers and one-legged, Enutrof dancers wrapped in a slice of ham. Sadly though, it's useless for killing monsters.

10798.descriptionId: This shield won't protect you from your own stupidity.

10799.descriptionId: Having problems hiding your dagger in your underwear? No problem, you can wedge it between your love handles and this belt.

10800.descriptionId: You'll be able to fly with this cape around your shoulders. Just close your eyes, clench your fists, open your mouth, stretch out your arms and jump off a cliff shouting "I can fly!". Moments later, you'll wake up with two broken legs.

10801.descriptionId: This shoddy hat admirably hides your baldness. Unfortunately, it's not big enough to hide your false modesty.

10802.descriptionId: More golden than a Black Dragoone, less pink than a Pink Dragoone, and rarer than a Skeleton Dragoone, this pet will draw all eyes towards you, even if you're as ugly as a piwi. This soul-eating pet only eats Dopples in the class temples.

10804.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

10805.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a ghost to be able to get in the Pet Sanctuary.

10806.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Golden Dragoone that you left at the Bow Kennel.

10807.descriptionId: This Golden Dragoone Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10808.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Golden Dragoone.

10809.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Golden Dragoone. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

10810.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of an Ghoultus.

10811.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Ghoultus. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

10812.descriptionId: "If you're looking for easy, well-paid work, head to the north of the city, east of the Statue of the god Sram. Come alone."

10813.descriptionId: You found this list of names in Pandale Soft's house. It seems they're all Pandawas.

10814.descriptionId: You must deliver this crate to Pandette, in Akwadala village. Its contents remain a mystery.

10815.descriptionId: Het Dawa has asked you to get Magus Ax' help analysing this liquid.

10817.descriptionId: This prototype antidote can cure Ouassingue Juice addiction.

10818.descriptionId: With this basic-looking weapon, you'll feel like you know how to fight.

10825.descriptionId: Was it really necessary to put yourself through so much trouble to get this?

10826.descriptionId: Your host has decided to block your access to his crypt for the next 24 hours because you were so rude to him.

10827.descriptionId: A bubbly, orange liquid that no one would want to drink.

10828.descriptionId: They say sticks and stones may break your bones, but names will never hurt you. With this helmet on, you'll certainly challenge that misconception...

10829.descriptionId: Having a dispute over money? Thanks to this rod, there'll only be one winner: you!

10830.descriptionId: Is that a Banana Cape in your pocket or are you just pleased to see me?

10831.descriptionId: Flambéed or sliced, topped with melted chocolate or just on its own, this fruit is a delicious dessert.

10832.descriptionId:
This polished stone contains a Crackrock who is anything but polished.
It appears that you can only use it near other Cracklers or Crackrocks.

10833.descriptionId: This bread is amazing! When you bite it, it meows!

10834.descriptionId: It doesn't take much to make you look like an Ouginak. Watch out for fleas.

10836.descriptionId: You wear this amulet proudly, as a symbol of your participation in this great sporting event. You need it to stay proud having been through a scrum with B.C. Trool.

10838.descriptionId: You know when you've been Tingoed!

10839.descriptionId: Sometimes, when you eat very stale bread, you might lose a tooth. If you eat this bread, stale or not, you'll lose all of your teeth.

10840.descriptionId: This one is more tender. Bon appétit!

10841.descriptionId: Didn't anyone warn you about the side effects?

10842.descriptionId: Well, that's what happens! If you start coughing up hairballs, you've only got yourself to blame.

10843.descriptionId: You've noted down at what time Krtek took a beating. That way, you'll know when to return to give him another one.

10844.descriptionId: Mmmmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm, mmm mmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm mmmmmmm mmmmmm mmm mmmm'm mmmmm mmmm mmmmmmm.

10846.descriptionId: Driven into a strange frenzy, any Tofus that you meet will want to rub up against your leg. Are you sure it's the cape that attracts them?

10847.descriptionId: Hulkrap slipped these comfortable boots on to his ample feet once a year, but he took them off every day, which suggests they might be magic.

10848.descriptionId: These boots can also be used as anvils. Their former owner urges you not to dance while wearing them.

10849.descriptionId: This belt is constructed around a magnetic metal frame which attracts the purses of those careless enough to rub up against you.

10850.descriptionId: Klume had three weaknesses: Arachnees, being tickled, and tickly Arachnees.

10851.descriptionId: This belt is still covered in flour, perhaps because Kloug the Dark Baker used it as an apron. Mind you, it might not be flour, it could be the powder he uses to soothe his embarrassing rash.

10852.descriptionId: Hulkrap stole this amulet from Ted Gonztipay, an anally retentive goblin with absolutely no sense of humour whatsoever.

10853.descriptionId: This amulet allows you to knead the skin on your neck without using your hands.

10854.descriptionId: Gontran Klume the smith traded a sword belonging to Dame Antium for this ring.

10855.descriptionId: This ring has been dipped in a multitude of different yeasts. It is said that it is capable of transforming those who wear it into mould. Some adventurers don't see any difference after slipping it on.

10856.descriptionId: Hulkrap was a terrible bandit riddled with remorse, and felt obliged to give back what he'd stolen. This magical weapon is still imbued with the soul of Hulkrap the Bandit. You may be able to become him if you equip it.

10857.descriptionId: This hammer was used to forge a Kriptonite zipper for Captain Chafer. This magical weapon is still imbued with the spirit of the Dark Smith Klume. By equipping it, you may be able to embody him.

10858.descriptionId: Kloug liked to make himself appear generous by handing out bread to those who dared to speak to him. He used this wand to judge and punish the innocent. This weapon is still charged with Kloug the Dark Baker's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

10860.descriptionId: You can use this potion to change your name. No one will remember that you used to be called Xx-Haxor-naruto-killer-feca-xX-pl. A new life, free from teasing and name-calling, awaits you. Finally, you will be someone.

10861.descriptionId: Pink hair, mauve socks, fuchsia skin. Mother Nature wasn't kind to you, but now you've finally got the opportunity to change things. Mustard yellow, here you come!

10862.descriptionId: This potion, to be drunk directly from the bottle, will allow you to become him if you were her, or to become her if you were him. To be consumed without moderation.

10863.descriptionId: This arachnee is very badly behaved: it jumps around, screams all the time, and bites anyone it meets... but for some reason you still love it. Mother Nature blessed it with a ferocious appetite, so this soul-eating pet loves attacking and then devouring moskitos and larvae.

10864.descriptionId: This unique mush mush was raised by a pack of Boowolves. That doesn't explain why it has such hairy armpits, though. Don't ask. This soul-eating pet loves seafood, and as such, only eats beach creatures.

10865.descriptionId: This tofu was struck by lightning 11 times while still growing. It'll give you an electric shock if you stroke it, and it'll shock you with electricity if you don't stroke it. The choice is yours. This soul-eater loves rats, so it jumps at the chance to devour them if any are around.

10866.descriptionId: This pet loves artichoke hearts smothered in Bherb blood, endives with Pikoko hair, and Jon Lemon's songs. It seems to enjoy your company as well. This soul-eater only eats Dark Jungle creatures.

10867.descriptionId: This Tarzantula Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10899.descriptionId: The Manitou Zoth was a former stevedore - he moved problems instead of solving them. In spite of that, the Zoth community were scared of him because he shouted louder than all the others, which was enough to make him the Zoth chief. This weapon is still charged with the Manitou Zoth's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

10900.descriptionId: What you're holding in your hands is all that remains of the enormous eggshells that appeared on the Dreggon Peninsula. It wouldn't even make a decent ashtray.

10901.descriptionId: Grasmera and Grozilla clashed in an epic battle. All that remains is this enormous fang. Who will believe that you were there?

10902.descriptionId: Now you can truthfully say that the Manitou Zoth is naked under his kilt.

10903.descriptionId: Using this key will allow you to fight the Manitou Zoth.

10904.descriptionId: You won this amulet thanks to your incomparable capacity for breaking eggs without making an omelette.

10906.descriptionId: Fashioned from one of Grozilla's scales, this is a heavy shield of exceptional stature. Only rare and fearsome fighters may proudly wear it.

10907.descriptionId: Well, there you are. You did it: took part in the greatest Dragonic birth-control exercise ever. As a result, you're going to have to eat omelette for weeks to come.

10908.descriptionId: You've been given this gift because you spent more time in the DOFUS 2.0 Beta Test dungeons than any other mortal.

10910.descriptionId: This set will make a star of you, if you can keep your mouth shut. But don't worry, even if you can't, it'll still impress the inhabitants of Astrub.

10911.descriptionId:
Twice as creamy and twice as unctuous a "classic" recall potion, Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion will allow you to teleport to the Astrub Zaap from anywhere. The potion's double effect ensures you will live long and prosper.
"Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion" is a registered trademark of Keurk & Stok Enterprises.

10912.descriptionId: Not all Kwismas gifts are the same size. Timid adventurers only get ridiculous gifts, as well as the right to be teased or burst into tears.

10913.descriptionId: Whoever gave you this gift is clearly very pretentious. They thought it contained something incredible.

10914.descriptionId: If you believe what's written on the label, this gift has potential. However, as any experienced adventurer will tell you - never trust what's written on the label.

10915.descriptionId: Harry Kwismas has revealed the identity of one of the monsters responsible for the break-in at Father Kwismas' workshop. If you aren't able to defeat the monster in two hours, you can head back to Harry and get a new order.

10916.descriptionId: Harry Kwismas greatly appreciated your victory. Come back in 24 hours, he'll need your help again if all the boxes of gifts still haven't been found.

10917.descriptionId: This small box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

10918.descriptionId: This box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

10919.descriptionId: This large box comes from Father Kwismas's workshop. You'll be a true hero if you return it to him.

10920.descriptionId: This delicious, hand-made biscuits were baked with love. It's a shame you can't taste them.

10921.descriptionId: No one knows what this gift contains. The Minotoball took the secret to his grave, as if you needing reminding that was your fault. You must be sick to death of hearing it, right?

10922.descriptionId:
This shield shows all other adventurers that you were a pioneer in establishing your profession.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10955.descriptionId: There's nothing unusual about a bird being ringed!

10956.descriptionId: Like the rest of the Black Crow set, this pair of boots has been passed down, foot to foot, through the generations. That explains the strong smell of Clakoss.

10957.descriptionId:
Some thread, a needle, a few feathers taken from the remains of decaying Crobaks, and voilà! You're in possession of the most chic of cloaks!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10958.descriptionId:
You can't hide! You've been unmasked! You're the Black Crow after all! You would have gotten away with it too, if it weren't for those meddling kids!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10959.descriptionId:
It may have taken you a while, but here it is, in your hands at last: the Black Crow's sword...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10960.descriptionId:
If you shake this gift vigorously, you'll find that it isn't empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.
This gift can only be opened on a DOFUS 2.0 server.

10961.nameId: The Black Crow's Piercing Lance Gift
10961.descriptionId:
If you shake this gift vigorously, you'll find that it isn't empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

10962.descriptionId: There's nothing better than this staff for unblocking drains, or the nostrils of your fallen opponents. This weapon is still charged with Plunder's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

10963.descriptionId: The soles of these boots are so spongy that they absorb sewer sludge and release it each time you place your foot on the ground. As you can imagine, it's quite handy if you ever need to retrace your steps.

10964.descriptionId: Plunder hung his booty from this belt. You can make out a small valve on the inside. This valve allows the belt to be inflated, transforming it into a buoy. An essential item when venturing into the sewers.

10965.descriptionId: This amulet was specially designed not to get stuck in Plunder's neck hairs, so you can wear it without fear under your armpit or even keep it in your hand.

10966.descriptionId: Gossips insinuate that your inner nature has been revealed. Might they actually be right?

10967.descriptionId: You'd need to be really desperate to eat this. No, don't do it!

10968.descriptionId: Somewhat surprisingly, you're not that partial to Cawwots at the moment.

10969.descriptionId: The sweetness of a Cawwot, the freshness of a Dragoturkey marathon runner. There's nothing better for getting you back on your feet. Good health, up the empire, cheers!

10971.descriptionId: With this bag slung at a jaunty angle over your shoulder, you'll be able to muck about while still keeping that charming smile on your face, you cheeky little monkey!

10972.descriptionId: Although very affectionate, you suspect this volatile avian will fly off at the first sign of danger.

10973.descriptionId: Your instinct tells you not to swallow the contents of this jar. Not just your instincts, either. Your nose, too. The mixture smells like a centenarian Bwork's armpit.

10975.descriptionId: It might smell of stale Mush Mish but there's nothing stale about this sword's blade. This weapon is still charged with Phong Huss's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

10976.descriptionId: Fungi generally have collars, but Phong Huss preferred rings, possibly so that he could boast about having fingers.

10977.descriptionId: Phong Huss wore this belt somewhat sloppily. He tried to wear it as a shoulder strap so he could sheath his sword in it. The belt pinched his nipples on multiple occasions, but other than that, was of no use whatsoever.

10978.descriptionId: The feet of fungi are rarely very clean - they are often covered with mycelium. Phong Huss's feet were no exception to this rule and he took care to hide them with his boots. They don't smell particularly good, but they are well suited for growing mushrooms. Which of your stomach or your nose will win?

10979.descriptionId: Ektope took great pleasure in dragging this weapon behind him. He was well-known for being as lazy as a Gobball, but he mainly wanted to warn his opponents of his sensational arrival. This weapon is still charged with Ektope's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

10980.descriptionId: This ghost's amulet must be extremely powerful, if one believes the legends about ghosts, that is.

10981.descriptionId: It's a well-known fact that real ghosts don't have fingers. So how were they able to wear this ring?

10982.descriptionId: A drunken Captain Haddock'n'roll once stumbled into Ektope leaving a party at the Ripate Inn. "Ectoplasm on skates!" he exclaimed. Poor Captain Haddock'n'roll, the alcohol was playing tricks on him, Ektope has never had any skates.

10984.descriptionId: When your enemies see this amulet around your smooth, slender neck they'll think you're actually as hairy as the YeCh'Ti, which will frighten the living daylights out of them.

10985.descriptionId: This bow meow has known the winter of the far north, even if it has never actually seen the far north. Nobody knows how it arrived in Amakna, although the elders claim that it was imported from Frigost Island to counter the ever-expanding Wabbit population. As such, this soul-devourer will only eat Wabbits.

10986.descriptionId: This Snow Bow Meow Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

10987.descriptionId: This belt cools the hips, nearby organs and ardour of all those who dare to wear it. To be given to your most stubborn suitors.

10988.descriptionId:
This hat is ideal for keeping your head cool and your ideas fresh. That said, if you don't want to look like an ugly ice cube, you'll have to find something else.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10989.descriptionId:
Jon Lemon wore a similar cape during his famous concert in Brouce Boulgoure's Clearing. Those who weren't deafened still remember the concert's climax, when he stopped singing after becoming trapped in the ice because of his own cape.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

10990.descriptionId: Heavy and stiff, these boots don't look particularly special, but their icy sole will have you ice-skating without the need for ice. Of course, you'll need to find a surface covered with ice-skate blades, but in these crazy times, that shouldn't be too difficult.

11008.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Snow Bow Meow that you left at the Bow Kennel.

11009.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Snow Bow Meow.

11010.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Snow Bow Meow. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

11011.descriptionId: Crazier than a regular Minifoux but much less ginger, this pet can swim underwater without needing to plug its nose. This pet feeds on creatures that live in the Tree Keeholo.

11012.descriptionId: This pet may have stripes, but that won't stop it from sniffing your bottom or trying to relieve itself on your carpet. What did you expect? This pet loves hunting creatures that live in the Sidimote Moors.

11013.descriptionId: This ugly little Black Quaquack was rejected by its own family because it was different: it loved listening to the songs of Jon Lemon, the famous minstrel. Maybe it was just misunderstood. After a difficult childhood, it decided to arbitrarily take revenge on all creatures of the Crobak family, and devours them without pity.

11014.descriptionId: This pet stayed out too long in acid rain. It doesn't glow in the dark, nor is it magical, but you can make a very potent salad dressing from it. This pet feeds exclusively on creatures from the Jelly family.

11015.descriptionId: This strange creature crossed the oceans on a block of ice to escape from a lost port. It looks like it's taken you for a block of ice. This soul-eating pet only likes the taste of Beach Monsters.

11016.descriptionId: This Brindled Minifoux Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?
