11872.descriptionId: Inferno was well known for his fiery temper and more than one apprentice got their wings burned trying to imitate him. This weapon is still charged with Inferno's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

11873.descriptionId: Styx was blessed with an Olympian calm, drawing the attention of the Bulbs and other, small vegetal creatures, who became catalysts for his magic. This weapon is still charged with Styx' magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

11874.descriptionId: Mandrin was a thief who specialised in grinding the skulls of Perceptors and their protectors. This weapon is still charged with Mandrin's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

11875.descriptionId: Will Killson was an ambidextrous barber by day and an assassin by night. Or sometimes it was the other way round, and not always at the client's request. This weapon is still charged with Will Killson's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

11876.descriptionId: This crate belongs to one of Granny Capping's convoys. She'll be delighted to get it back.

11877.descriptionId:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Obsidemon's Hypogeum.
Double-tap to use.

11878.descriptionId:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Asparah Gorge.
Double-tap to use.

11879.descriptionId:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Petrified Forest.
Double-tap to use.

11881.descriptionId:
This key grants access to a secret map in the Fangs of Glass.
Double-tap to use.

11882.descriptionId: The tail of the Yomi Snowfoux is always covered in bandages because the bone within it tends to break very easily, which is a very painful experience for its hapless owner.

11883.descriptionId: This Snowfoux condyle is perfectly designed to dig into any concave, bony cavity that presents itself. Your skull, for example.

11884.descriptionId: This leather is very soft but has a rigidity that is hard to beat. Unfortunately, the pheromones it gives off are likely to attract a lot of unwanted attention.

11885.descriptionId: Frigostians cook these gills in parcels of fabric made from Kanigloo hair before washing them three times in the snow. Their hallucinogenic properties have never been demonstrated, and those who have consumed them have strangely escaped from the island of Frigost by swimming, without ever managing to return.

11886.descriptionId: Even torn from its mycological socket this eye continues to emit a slight glow, but sadly not enough to help you find your way through the Petrified Forest at night.

11888.descriptionId: It is very important that you distinguish between a Fistulina's Volva, and another thing it has which, despite sharing a similar spelling, is actually something completely different altogether. Yep, that's right, a Volvo.

11890.descriptionId: The Fungore was once reputed to be an ugly creature who loved to play tricks on Frigostians. He was suspected of burning down houses and eating children. Fortunately, all this was a myth. In reality the Fungore is a gentle creature who burns children and eats houses.

11891.descriptionId: Frigostians once used this bark to cover benches and chairs. They would then all rush to rub up against them, with their bare bottoms hanging out of their pants, because having such smooth buttocks would allow them to reach much faster speeds when sledging on their backsides.

11893.descriptionId: The Serpula is known to Frigostians for inflicting considerable damage to buildings by devouring, among other things, their timber frames. It is said that cutting off its volva is enough to render it completely harmless. But as you've killed it, you'll never know.

11895.descriptionId: Thin, hairy, ugly and smelly, this foot is the perfect image of its former owner.

11896.descriptionId: This glassy eye is perfect to accompany a salad dressed with Haugue rat vinaigrette. Recommended for the toughest of palates only, or for those without taste buds.

11897.descriptionId: You've been transformed into lava residue having entered a secret map in the Obsidemon's Hypogeum.

11898.descriptionId: You've been transformed into melted ice having entered a secret map in the Snowfoux Caverns.

11899.descriptionId: Extract from the Aybeeceedarius Daemonica of Trisboulis. 544 Edition.

11900.descriptionId: Long John gave you this book to help you understand the history of the village.

11901.descriptionId: Flasho is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to the Snowbound Village Militia.

11902.descriptionId: Vinnie the Bearbarian is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to the Snowbound Village Militia.

11903.descriptionId: Snowfoux are much less impressive without their dentures. If you're not sure what to do with this pair, you could always give them to your Enutrof mistress as a present.

11904.descriptionId: Baka Laive gave you this letter in acknowledgement of your participation in the protection of the Snowbound Village.

11905.descriptionId: A letter written by Herr Peece, the doctor.

11906.descriptionId: A letter written by Herr Peece, the doctor.

11907.descriptionId:
This flank steak will have you drooling until your drool turns to ice. You will, in turn, cause all the Brockhards in the area to salivate over you.

(This meat can be harvested by level-100 Hunters.)

11908.descriptionId:
The smell of this flank steak reminds you of the sewage coming out of the Sacrier Temple. Why, though?

(This meat can be harvested by level-100 Hunters.)

11909.descriptionId: You'd better keep this flank steak cold while you wait for a skilled chef to cook it.

11910.descriptionId: You'd better keep this flank steak cold while you wait for a skilled chef to cook it.

11911.descriptionId: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

11912.nameId: Professor Xa Flank Steak with Frosteez
11912.descriptionId: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

11913.descriptionId:
This meat tastes naturally of honey, paving the way for a meal rich in calories.

(This meat can be harvested by level-100 Hunters.)

11914.descriptionId:
This meat tastes naturally of royal honey, paving the way for a meal rich in calories.

(This meat can be harvested by level-100 Hunters.)

11915.descriptionId: Bearbarian Breast is very firm once frozen, which pleases the wives of certain Enutrofs.

11916.descriptionId: Once frozen, the two ends of this Breast point to the north. Well, that's what Frigostians tell Iops, anyway.

11917.descriptionId: There's a rumour going round that Frigostian lumberjacks' bad tempers and weight comes from having overeaten this meat, which, rich in calories, formed their basic diet.

11918.descriptionId: Larger than those of Samantha Lenald and a lot more appetising, this breast meat will please the most chaste of men.

11920.descriptionId:
Pyrotechnic Brockhards are somewhat timid creatures, and their ears point backwards so much that it becomes almost impossible to find them.
You, however, appear to have succeeded.

11921.descriptionId: The hunters of Frigost used to sell Gluttonous Brockhard Tails to Dame Antium.

11923.descriptionId: The Bestial Brockhard is able to scratch his back very easily using his claws, but has to make sure he doesn't scratch any lower.

11925.descriptionId: This fabric is very insubstantial. Be careful it doesn't disappear into thin air.

11927.descriptionId: One of the great things about being a Icy Brockhard is that you can eat what you want and your breath stays as fresh as a snowdrop.

11929.descriptionId: This tail's only use is to keep the Venomous Brockhard balanced. In other words, it's neither useful nor ornamental. Ah, there you go! Something you have in common.

11931.descriptionId: Elderly Frigostians say that in order to shatter this claw, it must be heated to white-hot and then quickly plunged into the snow.

11932.descriptionId: Formerly known as Piautre, Kolosso was renown for having hair as strong as steel. Unfortunately no one has ever found any trace of lead in his brain.

11934.descriptionId: By virtue of having ice cubes placed between them, the ears of an Apewicubic Bearbarian have ended up growing an extra layer of fur over the years, which is why the Frigostians still continue to make many ear muffs out of Apewicubic Bearbarian ears.

11935.descriptionId: You laid into this poor creature with such ferocity that all that remains is this iris, without even its vitreous body for company. You're such a brute!

11936.descriptionId: These hairs could make a fortune if sold in Torpidbearbarianville. Unfortunately there's no such place.

11938.descriptionId: Every time you look at this piece of leather, you can't help but hum that famous song by the Amaknian duo Lark and Mard: "Oh what a glorious thing to be, a healthy, grown-up, busy buzzy bee, whiling away the passing hours, pinching all the pollen from the corned-beef flowers".

11939.descriptionId: Still covered in honey, this incisor must be rotten to the pulp.

11942.descriptionId: The Vespal Bearbarians don't use this big antenna to communicate, but it does give them the opportunity to tie their enemies up easily.

11943.descriptionId: If the Celestial Bearbarian's Tail doesn't stay a pristine white and if it touches the ground, or some honey, Frigost Island will be engulfed in ice five times over. Well, that's the Celestial Bearbarian's excuse for being carried around by a slave, anyway.

11944.descriptionId: The Celestial Bearbarian has broken this bone several times playing Growlf. Growlf is a game invented by the Bearbarians which consists of hitting small enemies into a hole using a sceptre. The prize for the Bearbarian who manages to do this in the least number of shots is a honey bath.

11945.descriptionId: The Mellifluous Bearbarian's tail puffs up when it is upset. No Frigostian has ever had the chance to see it unpuff, sadly.

11947.descriptionId: Don't let appearances fool you. This axe might be cheap but it can come in very handy for cutting down trees and frozen tourists.

11949.descriptionId: This tooth smells just like your underwear and you've got a terrible pain in your buttocks. There must be a reason behind all this.

11950.descriptionId: Feared by other pets because of teeth that would make a vampire blush, this creature had a lonely childhood and its social skills suffered. Until you adopted it, that is. This soul-eating pet feeds solely on Lonesome Pine Trail monsters' souls.

11951.descriptionId: This Kanigloopy Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

11952.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Kanigloopy that you left at the Bow Kennel.

11953.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Kanigloopy.

11954.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Kanigloopy. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

11955.descriptionId: Once fully grown, this pet will radiate a wonderful Frigostian charm, and like its Amaknian cousin, it loves to cuddle. In the meantime, it will give you lots of kisses to show its affection. This soul-eating pet only feeds on Petrified Forest creatures' souls.

11956.descriptionId: This Bulbisou Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

11957.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bulbisou that you left at the Bow Kennel.

11958.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Bulbisou.

11965.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Bulbisou. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

11966.descriptionId: This sweet little brockhard's fur is as smooth as a mama bwork's buttocks, but don't be fooled. Its cute appearance lulls its peers into a false sense of security, and it devours them while they sleep. Its mood seems to have improved since you adopted it, though, because now it lunges at its fellow creatures even when they're awake. This soul-eating pet only feeds on Fangs of Glass creatures' souls.

11967.descriptionId: This Brockheart Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

11968.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Brockheart that you left at the Bow Kennel.

11969.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Brockheart.

11970.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Brockheart. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

11971.descriptionId: This little Bearbarian cub escaped from Professor Obsidian-Heart's laboratory and was rescued by Granny Capping. Starved of affection, it will try to kiss you all the time. You should probably rub antiseptic cream around your mouth to avoid getting stubble rash. This soul-eating pet only feeds on Mount Scauldron creatures' souls.

11972.descriptionId: This Teddybearbarian Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

11973.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Teddybearbarian that you left at the Bow Kennel.

11974.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Teddybearbarian.

11975.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Teddybearbarian. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

11976.descriptionId: Most adventurers will find this amulet quite difficult to wear, not because of its weight, not because its prerequisites are so demanding, nor because it's so weak, but because of the moustache that adorns it. It's probably because he wears his moustache so well that Boostache is such a well-respected monster.

11977.descriptionId: Kanniball Andchain has had many women, each more beautiful that the last. He even went so far as to say that they were delicious. No one knows what has happened to them.

11978.descriptionId: Boostache doesn't care about losing his ring. After all, he doesn't have any fingers! The only thing that matters to him is his moustache. That's quite a treasure you're holding there.

11979.descriptionId: Kanniball Andchain only wears these boots when fighting the World of Twelve's most valiant warriors. It'll be a while before you see him wearing them to fight you.

11980.descriptionId: This cape, like Boostache, glows in the dark. As a result, it will have you failing every single attempt at breaking in to your ex-girlfriend's house, will stop you sleeping at night, and will annoy every single one of your guildmates. Just what you need to spice up your dull existence.

11981.descriptionId: As a child, Boostache loved to play Postman's Knock. He still loves to sneak up on adventurers, stopping abruptly if they turn around, looking as if nothing's going on, then attacking them savagely when he finally reaches them. It might be childish and annoying, but it proves the trick.

11982.descriptionId: Now that you know Kanniball Andchain wears a hood beneath his headgear, a hood with two holes for eyes, you are hit with the sudden realisation that this cycloptic mask must have rendered the poor sod completely blind.

11983.descriptionId: In Kanniball Andchain's hands, this sceptre unleashes strange magic powers capable of causing enormous totems to fall on the heads of opponents. In your hands, it just looks stupid, and won't even turn your allies' heads.

11984.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11985.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11986.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11987.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11988.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11989.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11990.descriptionId: This syringe contains a sample for Herr Peece.

11991.descriptionId: This cheque should be enough for you to take a relaxing break in the Silver Tavern on Frigost.

11992.descriptionId: When you think how powerful cooked Frozen Icefish is, you'd be right in assuming that the contents of this crate cost a fortune.

11993.descriptionId:
Pol the Octopus, also known as the Frigostian Oracle, was capable of predicting the results of various tournaments and bets. He ended his life as a kebab, sliced up with some red and green peppers, some onions, drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with ground black pepper. Oh, but he was so delicious! *burp*
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

11994.descriptionId:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Frigostian Carrier.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

11995.descriptionId:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

11996.descriptionId:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Pingwin's Excavation.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

11997.descriptionId:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the entrance of Frigost Village.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

11998.nameId: Let's Go A-Beating in the Woods

11999.descriptionId: Keep in a cool, dry place.

12000.descriptionId: This ring isn't perhaps as unique as it seems. It's your only clue for finding Herb Cut's attackers.

12003.descriptionId: They might be a bit stiff, but these skis are still of the highest quality. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

12004.descriptionId: Dark, but gracious, these skis are almost bewitching. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

12005.descriptionId: Cold to the touch, but smooth as a baby's bottom, these skis were made for speed. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

12006.descriptionId: Supple like a Bwork ballerina, these skis are one of Juss' pieces, but not one of his masterpieces. Selling them, however, is a different story. The Frigostians are not very keen to use this hare-brained mode of transport. You're going to have to be a bit crafty.

12007.descriptionId: This potion, to be given directly to a pet, will reduce its smallest bonus. Soul-eating pets will automatically regain a bonus after taking this potion. Please note, it will not cure constipation or bad moods.

12008.descriptionId: This potion, to be given directly to a pet, will reduce its largest bonus. Soul-eating pets will automatically regain a bonus after taking this potion. Please note, it will not cure breathing difficulties or overheating.

12009.descriptionId: As old and as stylish as an Enutrof, and as affectionate as the Eliatrope Goddess, this Platypus shines day and night. The children's stories give its home as Sufokia, and raise it to the status of the remains of an ancient civilization, but the veracity of these claims has never been verified. This ravenous pet eats all types of Jely sweets.

12010.descriptionId: This Platypus Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12011.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12012.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Platypus that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12013.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Platypus.

12014.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Platypus. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12015.descriptionId: The Kwakwa is proud and majestic, but everyone knows that its beak stinks. Everyone apart from you, it seems. Maybe you should have thought a little harder before picking it up.

12016.descriptionId: There's an old Osa nursery rhyme that tells of a Kwakwa with a khaki feather stuck to its kwokkwok. Unfortunately, the words don't mention what a kwokkwok is, nor where you can find such a thing.

12017.descriptionId: This key will allow you to study the Kwaks in their natural habitat, and who knows, you might even reach the summit.

12018.descriptionId: Following the example set by his subjects the Kwaks, the Kwakwa has a blade to his name. Even if we still don't know why, or for what occasion a bird would wear a sword, it does seem much lighter and easier to handle than a Kwakblade. Your enemies might be well and truly plucked.

12019.descriptionId: Though he has no master, the Kwakwa does have an identification ring. He uses the Kwaks' rings to identify and find them when they get lost, so they can be brought back to the nest safely. He wears his ring so they can find him when he gets lost looking for lost Kwaks. They go round in circles so much, they've never left Crackler Mountain.

12020.descriptionId: The Kwakwa carries out a mating ritual to seduce the Kwakeres, which consists of displaying his tail feathers. He makes himself look incredibly silly when he does it, as he only has five of them. This is a perfect example of the old adage, "Make a woman laugh and she'll play with your staff."

12021.descriptionId: As well as covering your little bird brain, this hat will give you a proud allure and might even make you forget you're an egg head. What more can you ask for?

12022.descriptionId: No, Tracon's sword isn't a lance. Its has a long handle so that it can be juggled - juggled so quickly it whistles, which creates an ear-piercing shriek that disconcerts any nearby enemies, and allies too. This weapon is still charged with Tracon the Pandulum's magic. You may be able to use it to incarnate him.

12023.descriptionId: Tracon's Belt, firmly attached to his stomach by its two straps, acts as a shock absorber. Coupled with his rather cushiony belly, Tracon is completely immune to his own attacks.

12024.descriptionId: These heavy square-toed metal boots force Tracon, who knows how to manipulate vibrations, to use all his energy to weaken the waves they give off. If he didn't, you'd be able to feel him coming from miles away.  Even worse, they stop him from aiming properly during Gobbowl.

12025.descriptionId: Due to his incredibly sensitive hearing, Tracon removed the main gear from his clock to stop it from making that incessant tick-tock and he now wears it as an amulet. Since then, everyone he meets tells him his clock has stopped, which is not a great improvement on the ticking.

12026.descriptionId: Mirh's hammer is basically just a drumstick. However, it has also been shown to be very useful for crushing heads, a fact that Mirh knows very well. This weapon is still charged with Mirh the Pandora's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

12027.descriptionId: Mirh, like any good percussionist, can't help but tap away at anything that moves, even when he's asleep. He's going to have trouble finding a partner who knows how to stay alive with him around.

12028.descriptionId: Mirh is a Pandora who has never been able to summon Pandora's Box. To compensate, he added a small box to his belt, in which he keeps various poisons which cause all sorts of maladies. Unfortunately, he never managed to make any of his enemies ingest one, so he only uses the sleeping poison when he can't get to sleep.

12029.descriptionId: Mirh sometimes uses his amulet as a pendulum to lull him to sleep more easily. The problem is, since it's also a little drum, when he drops it as he's nodding off, it wakes him up with a deafening racket.

12030.descriptionId: When Logram metamorphoses, he becomes so large that he can use his staff as a toothpick, which explains why he has buck teeth. This weapon is still charged with Logram the Maho Firefoux' magic. You may be able to use it to incarnate him.

12031.descriptionId: Logram always remembers to take his thick Getas off before a fight, ever since the day when he Metamorphosed with them still on. His paws grew to ten times their normal size and, needless to say, it was very painful.

12032.descriptionId: Logram has mastered the art of origami, and made most of his equipment, like this amulet, out of paper. That said, just because you're his incarnate, that doesn't mean you can play with fire like he did. I'd avoid wearing it, if I were you, unless you want to get your neck burned.

12033.descriptionId: Lenald's origami head, inside Logram's ring, allows him to project illusions of himself, which has never been much use in battle, since he has to stay within short range and stand absolutely still to do it. You might manage to impress one or two bystanders, but that's all.

12034.descriptionId: Kalkaneus's sword is two-handed, which means it requires superhuman strength to wield it when you've only got one arm. Except for the fact that when you're a skeleton, you don't have any muscles. Some mysteries are never meant to be resolved. This weapon is still charged with Kalkaneus the Hazwonarm's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

12035.descriptionId: No one knows what special power keeps Kalkaneus's pants from falling off his bony little legs. A few people have an idea but no one has ever wanted to check.

12036.descriptionId: Kalkaneus only has one leg, so it follows that he only wears one of his boots. If you wear it, and nothing else, you'll look just like him, without the need to summon him to be sure!

12037.descriptionId: In spite of the fact that Kalkaneus only has one arm, one leg and one eye, he's a great hit with the ladies. What you shouldn't tell them is that he didn't actually lose them in combat, he was just born that way.

12038.descriptionId: Hichete's name sounds like the old Amaknian word for an axe, so lots of adventurers think he uses one as his weapon of choice. If you were to ask him, however, he'd demonstrate that it's much easier to stick daggers into someone's stomach than an unwieldy axe. These weapons are still charged with Hichete the Barbrossa's magic. You may be able to use them to summon him.

12039.descriptionId: Hichete's been married before. Unfortunately, it didn't last: he kept pushing his wife over the edge. Trapped, with her back against the wall, she preferred to leave. Pushing and trapping is pretty much the story of Hichete's life.

12040.descriptionId: Hichete might have the appearance and mocking laugh of any old Barbrossa, but he surpasses them all in terms of guile. Even this belt can't hold his trousers up when he doubles up with laughter as he pushes, traps, fools and hinders his opponents.

12041.descriptionId: Hichete, dishonest and sore loser as he was, always used to cheat at thumb wars: he used two hands. One to pin his opponent's thumb down and, if that didn't work, one to chop it off with his dagger.

12042.descriptionId: With his wispy arms, Haku has never been an expert in the art of handling a staff. He pulls it out from underneath his wizard robe, which he wears when attending role-play evenings. That doesn't stop you from sticking it in his spokes, or anywhere else for that matter. This weapon is still charged with Haku the Zoth Master's magic. You may be able to use it to summon him.

12043.descriptionId: Haku has never been a particularly communicative Zoth, much preferring activities inside to those outside, which is possibly why he's lived to such a ripe old age, far from the grabbing claws of adventurers searching for Kristalite and Zoth Fabric.

12044.descriptionId: Haku isn't considered as a Zoth Master because of his social status, his studies or his ability to fight, but because of the numerous interminable evenings he spends as a game master with his Zoth friends. He likes to keep that to himself, though.

12045.descriptionId: Haku has never been able to keep a girlfriend for very long. Each time an adventurer introduced herself to him, he got the impression she was only after him for his Zoth Master Fly, a situation which suited certain people perfectly.

12046.descriptionId: The autobiography of Nileza, renowned alchemist.

12047.descriptionId: Frigostian mothers love this leather because of its ability to repair itself, which means their children can throw themselves off a cliff or lie happily between the slavering jaws of a rabid Snowfoux without them having to worry about damaging their clothes.

12048.descriptionId: The Gluttonous Brockhard is capable of regenerating its flesh and its blood. What happens if you isolate its blood, though? Is a new Gluttonous Brockhard formed? If that's the case, what you have there in your grubby little paws is enough to make an entire army of clones.

12049.descriptionId: This hot hair didn't come from an otter, a botter, a knotter or a frotter. It came from a Venomous Brockhard, obviously.

12050.descriptionId: Just like the brain of a Iop, the Pyrotechnic Brockhard's brain is good for nothing. Well, it was until you picked it up.

12051.descriptionId: Male Icy Brockhards only have horns to dissuade people like you from fraternising with the females.

12052.descriptionId: This muzzle is capable of distinguishing between a truffle and an acorn from 500m. You'd be happy if you could do the same from 3m.

12053.descriptionId: A little-known technique for defeating a Nightcrawling Brockhard is to stick a Dofus up each of its nostrils and then walloping it on the head with a hammer.

12054.descriptionId: This robust stretcher is waterproof and can withstand heavy loads, so you will easily be able to use it to carry, yes, you guessed it, your mother-in-law.

12055.descriptionId: This unguent is cold and viscous, like the inside of your nostrils, only not quite as foul-smelling.

12056.descriptionId: This surprising-looking concoction has an indescribable flavour and comes from an old recipe your senile grandmother wrote on the back of a pair of silk bloomers.

12057.descriptionId: Thanos practiced all manner of unsavoury occupations: drill sergeant, banker, moneylender, storyteller and occasional P.A.N.T.S. prophet. He used this staff to punish his apprentices and anyone that would listen to him, a daily habit that certainly kept him fit.

12058.descriptionId:
Dressed up in this strange hat, you have the strangest desire to stagger off to the nearest tavern, and drink shambrosia until you fall quietly into an apathetic stupor. A bit like you usually do, come to think of it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12059.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12060.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12061.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12062.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12063.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12064.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12065.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12066.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12067.descriptionId: What a terrible way to end your days, chopped up and stuck in a vulgar metal tin.

12068.descriptionId: Whether you're standing in a breeze, or wading through a strong current, you'll generate an enormous amount of energy wearing this belt. What you do with it is up to you.

12069.descriptionId:
There are those who will happily proclaim that the word "whitish" doesn't exist, and that "Whitish Fang" should actually be "White Fang". Show them this amulet, made from fangs that are neither white, nor yellow, nor grey, nor black, and see if they'll shut up for a bit.
They probably won't.

12070.descriptionId: Having thought about it, you wonder if this cloak, which you thought was an authentic piece made from Nelween Down, isn't actually what it seems at first glance. You don't remember Nelween being blue, or brown, let alone cut into two pieces the last time you saw her. Still, it'll match the wallpaper in your bedroom, won't it?

12071.descriptionId: These lovely leather boots suddenly become less appealing when you discover that the fur that lines them came from the still-smoking body of a living-dead Whitish Fang.

12072.descriptionId: The Nelween Smoke trapped in the buckle of this belt is still charged with magic. It'll help you accomplish minor miracles, like lighting your way at night, and stopping you from trapping your unmentionables in your fly. You know what they say - "that's got to hurt", and it does. It really, really does.

12073.descriptionId: This key, made from the remains of moorland creatures, goes perfectly with your clothes when you wear it around your neck.

12074.descriptionId: The Adventures of Captain Amakna - Volume 26.

12075.descriptionId:
You recovered this volatile smoke from the corpse of Nelween. Try not to breathe it in when you use it in a workshop, it can cause madness and hallucinations. 
Now, what did I say? Don't even think about it.

12076.descriptionId: You might not have recovered his precious smoke, but at least you managed to pull some of Nelween's hair off. It has no more power than the fabric of a Whitish Fang, but it's ever so shiny, and you know how distracted young adventurers get. I'm sure they'll pay a fair whack for it.

12077.descriptionId: If the fight drags on, this will be all that remains of Maya.

12078.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12079.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12083.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12084.descriptionId: The hairs sticking out of this hammer's handle will guarantee you an excellent grip, even amidst a horde of slobbering Mastogobs.

12085.descriptionId: This ring is unbearable for two reasons: it stinks of wet Mastogob, and it's covered in hairs which tickle you constantly between the fingers. Probably not the best present for your beloved.

12086.descriptionId: This ring is made of finest gold extracted from Royal Mastogob horns. It's sure to touch the heart of anyone who fully appreciates the efforts necessary for its fabrication.

12087.descriptionId: When correctly trailed in the snow, this cloak will leave horn marks fit to frighten off the weakest monsters, although the same can't be said for enraged Royal Mastogobs, who will see through the tracks in a flash and inevitably set off after you.

12088.descriptionId: Wands are Frigostine's speciality. This one, however, seems a little different from the others - be careful not to bite off more than you can chew!

12089.descriptionId: With this amulet around your neck, the delicious smell of steaming hot pastries will envelop your senses and give you the illusion of strength. It is just an illusion, though.

12090.descriptionId: When you find out that the main ingredient of Frigostine cream is Pingwin blubber, you'll suddenly be much less inclined to lick this ring.

12091.descriptionId: This belt will draw the enemy's attention to your love-handles and make them look good enough to eat. Decidedly, slimming techniques are getting more innovative by the day.

12092.descriptionId: These boots allowed Frigostine to crush bread into crumbs. They also sometimes came in handy on tourists who failed to leave a tip. If there's one thing you should know about life on Frigost, it's that they don't mess about when it comes to respect.

12093.descriptionId: This cloak, sewn with gold thread by an expert craftsman, will bring you the official credibility you are so severely lacking.

12094.descriptionId: This ring is certainly highly official, but the chances are that your loved one would prefer something more sparkly.

12095.descriptionId: Following several catastrophies caused by needles that were a little too sharp, Mayor Cantile made a habit of decorating Frigost's most skilful artisans with this amulet instead.

12096.descriptionId: These boots make so much noise when you walk in them that people say Lou Bricante, better known as "Loulou", filled them with lead so she could follow Mayor Cantile wherever she went.

12097.descriptionId: According to the P.A.N.T.S. prophets, the combined power of five of these rings would be enough to summon the Unknown Lord of Lava wearing just his pants. Yet another of that Ecaflip Lebar's flights of fancy...

12098.descriptionId: This belt will provide essential support to any self-respecting P.A.N.T.S. prophet.

12099.descriptionId: This staff, made with extracts of Obsidemon bowel, is a real relic. Its location and the way to get hold of it are two of the most closely guarded secrets of the P.A.N.T.S. prophets. That and their recipe for cheesecake.

12100.descriptionId: The jeweller who produced this ring had just enough time to start carving Tengu Snowfoux's head into a piece of wood before he was mercilessly trampled by his subject.

12101.descriptionId: They say that this was the wedding ring that Guten Tak offered his beloved Kami Snowfoux when they first met. Apparently, when she refused, his fur went white with rage.

12102.descriptionId: The story goes that one day a Frigostian tried to tame a baby Snowfoux by putting this amulet around his neck. That would probably have worked, if only the Snowfoux he had his heart set on hadn't been one of Guten Tak's offspring.

12103.descriptionId: Even if the origins of this bow remain mysterious, some Frigostians claim to have seen Guten Tak use it to cheat when competing at stalactite toss.

12104.descriptionId: Despite the fact that this is composed of a very rare mineral, only found in certain volcanic Fangs of Glass mines, and that it supposedly required several years of polishing, Waldos FieldChester Potcobble still never had the guts to offer it to Aurora Borealis.

12105.descriptionId: Aurora addresses a huge importance to watching her figure, and measures the length of the cords hanging from her belt every morning. So far, nobody has dared to tell her that leather stretches with time...

12106.descriptionId: Thanks to her aristocratic upbringing, Aurora was horrified when she saw the hat the head tailor had made for her - he was dismissed immediately. Since Frigost froze over, though, it seems that he's got his job back.

12107.descriptionId: Enamoured by her project of creating a hotel completely surrounded by ice, Aurora's boots were specially designed to keep her delicate feet from the cold. As far as not slipping is concerned, there's still work to be done.

12108.descriptionId: This cloak may not be very elaborate, but it was enchanted by the great Magus Ax to always billow heroically, even when there's no wind. This means it's perfect for show-offs, although Professor Xa really chose it because he knew it wouldn't get stuck in his wheels.

12109.descriptionId: It's said that Professor Xa, who's well known for being a skinflint, created this ring using a bolt that fell off his chair.

12110.descriptionId: The shoemaker who made these boots was the kind of guy who always had some kind of tasteless practical joke up his sleeve. Professor Xa fired him on the spot and swore never to wear the shoes.

12111.descriptionId: Don't be fooled by this amulet's ordinary appearance, as it is actually the key to the secret store of Professor Xa's favourite cereal, Cerebios.

12112.descriptionId: What might Professor Xa need this shovel for, I hear you ask? Other than using it to keep the rowdiest of his Gluttonous Brockhards in check, he supposedly uses it to dig rocks, though he does it horizontally and not vertically... and doesn't get very far.

12113.descriptionId: Too lazy to mine any diamonds for this ring, the Celestial Bearbarian chose instead to nab an unfortunate Apewicubic Bearbarian's ice cube to set in a ring of honey. It evidently didn't occur to him that his creation would melt as soon as it was worn.

12114.descriptionId: A miniature version of the crown so coveted by the Celestian Bearbarian, you should think twice before wearing it when he's around, or you'll run the risk of unleashing his fury. Which he has an awful lot of...

12115.descriptionId: Deeply embedded in a honey plinth, this sword bears the inscription that only he who manages to remove it will be named king of the Bearbarians. They say that the Celestial Bearbarian has asked several Rampant Bearbarians to help him, but nevertheless, it's a nice piece of work.

12116.descriptionId: These leaves are bigger than any found so far in the area around Mount Scauldron, which is why the headdress is so rare.

12117.descriptionId: Given the unhealthy amount of fur growing on Fuji Snowfoux's back, the small fraction needed for this cloak isn't going to make much difference to her body mass.

12118.descriptionId: With this headgear on, you can be sure to attract all the Maho Snowfoux during mating season. It's up to you to decide whether that's a good thing or not.

12119.descriptionId: Snowfoux leather is known to be extremely resistant, but its unbearable odour tends to put off even the most seasoned shoemakers. Using Fuji Snowfoux leather helps a bit with this problem, but watch out, as there may be other side effects...

12120.descriptionId: Before she gave birth to the Snowfoux, Fuji Snowfoux used to wear this ring as a belt. Nowadays, it fits her podgy fingers perfectly. It'll fit yours too.

12121.descriptionId: The recyclable paper made from Ouassingue fabric used to wrap the parcel might stop the contents from getting damp, but it doesn't offer much protection from the stench of smelly feet.

12122.descriptionId: The miners used to use this powder to smoke out the underground tunnels of Astrub and get rid of the rat infestation. The reopening of the sea route to the island of Frigost has led to its reintroduction into the kit of the perfect Enutrof miner.

12123.descriptionId: Despite the deafening noise of its detonation, this Fairywork is fairly harmless, unless you inhale the thick toxic smoke it gives off.

12124.descriptionId: This giant gold coin must be worth its weight in kamas, but it won't be easy to sneak off with it without raising suspicion. Rogue Bapapa must surely know how to do it.

12125.descriptionId: This pet can arise from its ashes all by itself.

12127.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12131.descriptionId:
This light, airy shield is great for showing off with, but not much more. For once, however, you merit your fifteen minutes of fame, so make the most of them.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12132.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

12133.descriptionId: Mother Nature did not smile down on little Solid Plissken. Teased by his peers because he has only one eye, he also has only one fang, which is nevertheless very useful for collecting flowers, plants, and the skulls of Kanigers who dare to mock him.

12134.descriptionId: This Solid Plissken Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12137.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Solid Plissken.

12148.descriptionId: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Rogue Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

12149.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Solid Plissken. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12150.descriptionId: This key was made by local craftsmen. Some of Kwismas Island's weaker monsters also have copies of it.

12151.descriptionId: This key was made by local craftsmen. Some fairly tough monsters on Kwismas Island also have copies of it.

12152.descriptionId: This key was made by local craftsmen. Some of Kwismas Island's strongest monsters also have copies of it.

12177.descriptionId: As contradictory as it may seem, Tofume is a very kind evil tofu. He will help you exterminate all the creatures living in the cemeteries of Amakna, Bonta and Brakmar, and enjoy every minute of it. Need I add that the concept of kindness is relative?

12178.descriptionId: This Tofume Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12179.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12182.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Tofume. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12183.descriptionId: This Dragoturkey will run off and hide in the nearest oven as soon as it gets the chance.

12184.descriptionId: If you don't like this gift, you can always sell it in Astrub.

12185.descriptionId: Hand this coupon over to one of the Thwee Kings on Kwismas Island, and they'll give you a gift.

12186.descriptionId: The fire that burns in your belly will make short work of this Kwismas Log.

12187.descriptionId: Placed on your head or draped across your shoulders, this delightful decoration will improve your appearance tenfold. Apparently Mel Chiow, one of the Thwee Kings, collects Kwismas Decorations.

12188.descriptionId: This precious stone was given to you by Cas Paw, one of the Thwee Kings. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

12189.descriptionId: This resinous gum was given to you by Balt Hasaw, one of the Thwee Kings. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

12190.descriptionId: This incense was given to you by one of the Thwee Kings, Mel Chiow. Its purpose on Kwismas Island remains to be discovered.

12191.descriptionId: These archives have been sealed. Only your employer is allowed to break the seal.

12192.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Phoenix that you left at the Bow Kennel.

This sweet will increase experience received for 10 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one sweet at a time. If your character consumes more than one, their effects will not stack.)

12199.descriptionId: Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster. Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

12203.descriptionId:
This hammer, which is as heavy as the atmosphere generated by Rattedaugue "humour", is perfect for crushing the Minotoror's hooves. It is equally effective should you wish to smash other, just-as-sensitive body parts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12204.descriptionId: This scroll sticks to your skin like an Enutrof sticks to his kamas. Its magic prevents you from going back to the jails of reconciliation, but, fortunately, it disappears after 24 hours.

12205.descriptionId:
This sweet, which is full of the magic of Kwismas, increases your Prospecting by 30 and your experience received for 20 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one sweet at a time. If your character consumes more than one, their effects will not stack.)

12230.descriptionId: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies small children.

12231.descriptionId: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies Astrubians.

12232.descriptionId: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies those who regularly venture into the Blop Dungeon.

12233.descriptionId: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies ordinary mortals.

12234.descriptionId: This box contains the heart of a monster that terrifies veterans of the World of Twelve.

12235.descriptionId: This heart is a warning. It is what will happen to you if you don't do exactly as Cuspular from Astrub asks you. Luckily, he's decided to leave you alone for at least one day.

12236.descriptionId: This terrible item will inflict the Chocrosis Curse onto any target of your choice. Make sure you don't use it on yourself!

12237.descriptionId: Made by Isgrate Giftoyu, this amulet symbolises passionate love. When you put it on, you can make Ballotwine's Day last forever.

12238.descriptionId: Made by Isgrate Giftoyu, this amulet symbolises passionate love. When you put it on, you can make Ballotwine's Day last forever.

12239.descriptionId: You received this Doploon as a reward for defeating a Dopple. You should be able get something of value in exchange for it.

12241.descriptionId: This scroll explains how to put together and take apart a boombot. It will also allow you to learn the spell to summon and control a boombot. Make sure you don't spill any oil on the carpet! This scroll can only be used by Rogues.

12242.descriptionId: You won't be blown away by this Rogue Skull. There's nothing astonishing about it either.

12243.descriptionId: Since you can't use his mask, which refuses to come off, this Masqueraider skull can be worn as a hat. Unfortunately though, it also comes with a very bad smell which you can't get rid of.

12244.descriptionId: This flower is commonly used to brighten up gravestones and get rid of moskitos. Offered as a bouquet, the often have the same effect on mother-in-laws. Their popularity is better understood around St. Ballotwine's day.

12245.descriptionId: A distant cousin of the demonic Rose, this flower feeds off the blood of dead people and the bones of the living.

12246.descriptionId: The Ingalsse family used to import this flower to feed the black tofus until they discovered its side effects on the birds who, as well as becoming depressed, found themselves saddled with egg shells on their heads.

12247.descriptionId: It was the botanist, Jeff Moshroom, who was the first to discover the secret of the Rosette Flower. He died shortly afterwards, a victim of the new song by Jon Lemon.

12248.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Iop class's special emote. It's so simple, even other classes can use it!

12253.descriptionId: This coin, which you received for defeating all the temple Dopples, can be exchanged for something valuable.

12254.descriptionId: This key opens Isgrate Giftoyu's chest.

12273.descriptionId: Certain adventurers claim that Bearendizer, in order to become the most powerful of all the Bearbarians, sold his soul to Djaul and, since then, his physical incarnation has been controlled by the bee on his shoulder, Actahive. This is only a rumour, though, and they're probably just trying to justify the fact that they're not very muscular.

12274.descriptionId: Cute and cuddly, Alyssum was the girlfriend of numerous sailors at Madrestam Harbour, which didn't particularly please Geordy, her husband. After a particularly violent dispute, he turned his wife into plant food and disappeared without leaving a trace. No one ever saw her again. Since then, though, a flower has been named after her.

12275.descriptionId: This venomous plant is used by Bworks as an accompaniment to meat served to tamed Trools. It stifles the meat's screams when the Trool eats one of its arms or legs.

12276.descriptionId: This plant owes its pale-red colour to the stagnant bodily fluids that it feeds off. It is an important part of the diet for vegetarian vampires.

12277.descriptionId: Thanks to this document, you can withdraw kamas from Masqueraider Babali's bank account, directly at the bank.

12278.descriptionId: This purse might not look like much, but its contents are guaranteed to make your day.

12279.descriptionId: This box contains several posters. They must be delivered to Igor Ant.

12350.descriptionId:
A long time ago, a Rogue and a Masqueraider were rivals for the hand of a famous tailor. When she wouldn't give a response, the infuriated suitors asked her to make a mask in the effigy of whichever one of them she preferred. Unable to make up her mind, she made the Rogueraider, a mask which resembled both the Rogue and the Masqueraider. After consultation, the two suitors decided to go and fight over the hand of another tailor instead.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12351.descriptionId: This key, that smells like dead rat and rotten Snapper, allows you to enter into the Sphincter Dungeon unseen.

12352.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12353.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to learn this emote.)
This scroll lets you learn to go where you know you shouldn't, at your own risk. That'll give your friends a cheap laugh.

12354.descriptionId: Watch out for starving adventurers if you don't want to end up on the barbecue.

12370.descriptionId: Push. Push harder. Still no luck? Are you sure you're trying to get the amulet around your neck...?

12371.descriptionId: Wrapped around your waist and passed between your legs, this cape will really emphasise your extra padding.

12372.descriptionId: Excellent for protecting your hands during a boxing match, this glove can be spun to collect the necessary fat to make potted dragon pig.

12373.descriptionId: Wearing these boots, you can make the ground tremble by tapping your foot, which is sure to titillate all the Lousy Pigs in your vicinity. A cheap but dangerous way of finding a partner.

12376.nameId: The Greatest Adventure of All Time
12376.descriptionId: This work is signed by Herdegrize the Mystic.

12377.descriptionId:
If you glue this hat to your head, you can bungee jump with your hair.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12378.descriptionId:
Watch out for Prespics, who will be all too happy to rub up against you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12379.descriptionId: When you pull this bristly bracelet on, you'll relive your last encounter with Fuji, minus the humidity. Oh and FYI you can also wear it on your wrist.

12380.descriptionId: You can't see any difference between these hairy boots and your feet, but it should be obvious: the boots smell nice.

12398.descriptionId:
Working as an apprentice is no picnic, but it lets you progress faster than theory-based lessons, especially when your employer is the most famous alchemist around.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12399.descriptionId: This crate contains a camouflage device made by Unterix Unter himself, as requested by Otomai's Apprentice.

12400.descriptionId: This bait was prepared by Otomai's Apprentice. It won't catch you any Snappers, but it should grab the attention of the Beast which is terrorising Astrub.

12401.descriptionId: A box of Plasmogrine. You need to give it to Otomai's Apprentice, who can be found in Astrub.

12406.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12407.descriptionId: This amulet is the trophy which proves that you decimated hordes of Sauroshells who had barely had the time to grow up. Now your mission is to conceal this mass infanticide from their parents, Grozilla and Grasmera, who are no longer weak and pubescent at all.

12408.descriptionId: When you asked your jeweller to make this amulet, you thought that its decorative bezoar would cool down eventually. Unfortunately, it is still as ardent as ever: it catches fire with every breeze, and you'll boil yourself alive if you forget to take it off before getting in the bath. The other side of the victory coin, eh?

12409.descriptionId: The compass embedded in this ring will prove very useful for finding the way back to your cosy little cottage after all your friends have been slaughtered by furious Sauroshells.

12410.descriptionId: In the past, this bracelet was given to tourists visiting Vulkania to make sure that they didn't come to the island twice despite only registering once. Charlie's Agents soon stopped this when they realised that nobody ever wanted to come back to Vulkania. That is, if they ever made it off, and didn't end up in the island's ever more populous cemetery.

12411.descriptionId: These boots, made from the remains of dozens of Juvenile Sauroshells, are very trendy outside Vulkania. On Vulkania, they're perfect for suicide missions amongst the Venerable Sauroshells, who'll take it upon themselves to avenge their little brothers without hesitation.

12412.descriptionId: The very fact that Grozilla has boots named after him might seem ironic considering the idleness he has famously developed since settling down in Vulkania with Grasmera. That said, who wouldn't be idle on a heavenly island with charming company and all the exotic meals one could wish for?

12413.descriptionId: The Saurosheller Cloak is a guilty pleasure for Vulkania's craftsmen, who get a kick out of seeing an adventurer run in one: the hard, heavy cape smacks against his calves, wears down his shoulder blades and often knocks him entirely off balance.

12414.descriptionId: With this pack on your back, you're ready to explore Vulkania at your leisure. Warning - Vulkanian craftsman by no means guarantee its efficiency once you've left the island... although some claim that a well-stocked PLVB is better than other bags when all you want to do is sit in a corner on a paving slab and break the fast.

12415.descriptionId: The Saurosheller Belt is traditionally presented to Vulkanian teenagers and becomes impossible to remove when they become adults. That way, they have to stay in shape if they don't want it cutting into their flesh. As for you, perhaps you can squeeze it around one thigh, or, more realistically, a calf.

12416.descriptionId: Grozilla and Grasmera's reported debauchery with Dragostesses has always been a hot topic of discussion, scandalising girl adventurers and awing their male companions. This belt and its enormous... buckles have become one way for the afore-mentioned boys to claim they live by the same rules. Obviously, they're lying.

12417.descriptionId: This hat will make you look like a hunter from the darkest wild, who'll make your enemies feel just like children. In any case, that's what a certain Pan Velt would tell anyone who'd listen.

12418.descriptionId: Jamming this headgear on, you look forward to showing everyone that you've defeated the terrible Grozilla. In practice, all you can really do with it is terrify children and/or get a job as the mascot of your favourite Gobbowl team.

12419.descriptionId: Only to be used for dodgy, deeply blameworthy activities.

12420.descriptionId:
Warning: It seems that if you line up with other adventurers while wearing this cape, you might make them disappear.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12421.descriptionId: Unlike the Tetra Cloak or Hammer, this Amulet always faces the same way no matter how much you turn around. Make sure you don't get a stiff neck!

12422.descriptionId:
This hammer will fill the hole in your enemy's head perfectly.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12423.descriptionId: This magic ring, if you should let it drop, will only slow down its fall by landing on its head.

12424.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate headgear. (You have to feed this living hat other hats. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

12425.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate cloaks. (You have to feed this living cloak other cloaks. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

12426.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate belts. (You have to feed this living belt other belts. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

12427.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate boots. (You have to feed these living boots other boots. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

12428.descriptionId: It seems that, since their business closed down, the confectioners Fer and Ro have had the ingenious idea of drying this mud, leaving pieces of Sauroshell in it, and offering it to the gods of the World of Twelve, claiming that they were the only ones worthy of eating this new 'chocolate'. The story doesn't say what the gods thought of this, but the goddess Eniripsa has been looking a little plumper since then.

12429.descriptionId: This thermospasmic mud is a cleaner's nightmare - if it gets on your clothes, the stains are so tough even a Piks machine can't get them out.

12430.descriptionId: Adventurers who want to hold off resorting to cosmetic surgery often cover themselves in this mud to prevent wrinkles. They forget, however, that this hardly makes them any more beautiful.

12431.descriptionId: Ever since you've been carrying this mud around in your bag, a strange smell has been following you around, as if you've stepped in something. If I were you, I'd stay away from Eltneg Wood, in case a Trool falls in love with your delicate perfume.

12432.descriptionId: Young Enutrofs with too much imagination have tried to sell this powder by claiming it's Gourlo's explosive powder. Their scam might have worked too, if they hadn't fallen upon a hungry lion.

12433.descriptionId: This powder is the perfect addition to any apprentice alchemist's briefcase.

12434.descriptionId: Ecaflip women of a certain age use this powder to cover their greying fur. Unfortunately, their ruse is quickly uncovered when their potential one night stand rubs them up the wrong way.

12435.descriptionId: This powder is used to make the famous Mont Noir pencils. Its rarity doesn't really explain their exorbitant prices though, or the ridiculous profits their manufacturers make.

12436.descriptionId: If you were hoping to see a Sauroshell be reborn from these ashes, you're going to be waiting a long time.

12437.descriptionId: These Ashes smell as bad as a pubescent Osamodas taking part in Captain Chafer's Panty Party.

12438.descriptionId:
What's small, black, covered in soot and smells of sulphur?
The Mature Ashes of the Incandescent Sauroshell! Although, the answer 'Zeurg' would also be accepted.

12439.descriptionId: You won't have to look far to find the source of that barbecued Lousy Pig smell. These still hot and smoking ashes are burning your fur.

12440.descriptionId: Here's an excellent weapon to use in a water bomb fight.

12441.descriptionId: Thanks to its rich vitamin and salt mineral content, this water can make you a small fortune when sold in large enough quantities.

12442.descriptionId: Cras really love water. It rains down on them and makes them laugh.

12443.descriptionId: It may be small, but this puddle can prove a deadly trap for any Xelor who steps in it. In fact, if he's not rescued quickly, he might drown.

12444.descriptionId: If you collect enough of this smoke, you'll be able to use it to make a screen.

12445.descriptionId: Here's the proof you CAN have smoke without fire.

12446.descriptionId: Smoking kills, and this Sauroshell's paying the price.

12447.descriptionId: This Sauroshell was just about to lay a magnificent Madreggon, but thanks to you, these dreams have gone up in smoke.

12448.descriptionId: If you were in the Sauroshell's place right now, it would be no yolk, believe me.

12449.descriptionId: Even dead, this eye continues to stare at you, reminding you of the very first time you met the in-laws. It's enough to make even the bravest adventurers shiver.

12450.descriptionId: The content of this shell could have given you a very cheap Madreggon, but you chose to give it a horrible and painful death instead. What goes around, comes around, you know...

12451.descriptionId: This long and pointy fang will be the envy of all your vampire friends. It is, after all, the size that counts.

12452.descriptionId: The young Sauroshell who once held this organ dear was awestruck by your presence. She wanted to defend herself, but without warning she just lost heart.

12453.descriptionId: With this kind of trophy, everyone will see that you ride through the land stealing hearts.

12454.descriptionId: Malicious gossips might suggest that you have no heart, which is why you go around stealing them from others.

12455.descriptionId: As venerable as your adversary might have been, he really ought to have thought twice before wearing his heart on his sleeve.

12456.descriptionId: Some old Enutrof women claim that if you grind this piece of Sauroshell to powder and mix it with rancid Lousy Pig grease, it'll create a rejuvenating face cream which will save them from shpinsterhood.

12457.descriptionId: As much as he tried to resist, this fragment's Sauroshell ended up shplattered everywhere.

12458.descriptionId: Sauroshells of all ages have a remarkable sense of humour. They're always ready to shplit their sides over a good joke.

12459.descriptionId: This is proof that Sauroshell fragments only get more shplendid with time.

12460.descriptionId: Lying on a beach under a palm tree with an Ensafalon Corktail in your hand can make you feel out of this World. Say goodbye to that migraine that's been bothering you!

12461.descriptionId: This Corktail with a hint of lingering wet earth odour is a particular favourite of Enutrofs and earthworms.

12462.descriptionId: Invented by Nono the Boombot, this alcohol-free drink is great for children, but we don't advise its consumption by Pandawas.

12463.descriptionId: No one knows why the straps on this mankini are so long. Did it once belong to the lanky Rushu? Was it used as a catapult in the Battle of the Crimson Dawn? There's certainly something off-putting about it.

12464.descriptionId:
It probably won't surprise you to hear the hairs on this hat didn't come from anyone's head.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12465.descriptionId: These varnished shoes are the height of fashion in some of the less well-developed countries of the World of Twelve. In Amakna, however, you might be mistaken for an ill-mannered immigrant.

12466.descriptionId: The Boracelet is really a simple bracelet made of black plastic. Its creator, however, managed to turn it into a great commercial success by inventing madder and madder ways to use it. Some of them were in such dubious taste we'd rather not go into details here. And that's saying something.

12467.descriptionId: Legend has it that Grozilla's front legs are so small because he's never been able to reached back to scratch his back without slicing a chunk off on his deadly dorsal spines. Really, though, they're just withered because he insists on killing his enemies by reducing them to ashes or swallowing them raw. All the same, this spine is mighty sharp.

12468.descriptionId: This magic bezoar, lodged in Grozilla's throat and burning eternally, is what enables him to spit fire. Lodged in your throat, you'll just cough your lungs out whilst running in circles and shrieking like a little sissy. Remember, wanting to be Grozilla won't make you Grozilla.

12470.descriptionId: This sole's no substitute for a cheap pair of flip flops.

12471.descriptionId: Thanks to the success of its daily shell hunt, and fearing a lack of Vulkanian shells, Charlie's Agency imported these shells, which, not unlike the summer tourists, reproduce like there's no tomorrow.

12472.descriptionId: This shell was once home to one of the most regal Crabs in Vulkania.

12473.descriptionId: Since this crab doesn't like staying in one place for too long, a very common trick on Vulkania consists of slipping it into one of the surfer's swimming costumes.

12474.descriptionId: This bloodthirsty shell hates tourists and very rarely lets itself be caught. That's why it scores the highest number of points in the Shell Hunt.

12475.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.
