12487.descriptionId: This ticket indicates the time at which you started the Shell Hunt. You have 15 minutes to collect as many shells as possible, and you'll have to wait 20 hours before you can take part in the next Hunt.

12488.nameId: Entry ticket to Grozilla and Grasmera's Den
12488.descriptionId: This ticket enables you to come back and face Grozilla and Grasmera again provided 20 hours have passed.

12489.descriptionId: This ticket tells you what time you finished the Sauroshell Search. You won't be able to take part in another Search until 20 hours have passed.

12490.descriptionId: This medal has been awarded to you by Charlie's Agents, as recognition for the skills you have shown on Vulkania. Valid until next year, you'll need it to obtain a Madreggon. Otherwise, it'll do the trick if you want to hog the limelight at trendy parties.

12491.descriptionId: Eh-Rehr would no doubt rather have his head on his shoulders.

12492.descriptionId: You dug this body up in a cemetery. This kind of behaviour is usually inexcusable... but we'll let you off just this once.

12493.descriptionId: Everyone knows that Eh-Rehr only has one left arm, so it's a good thing you've found it.

12494.descriptionId: Legend has it that if you put Eh-Rehr's arms back on his body and then apply pressure in the right area, the totem will complete an extraordinarily powerful action strong enough to slice bricks in half.

12495.descriptionId: You've found a leg, which should bring you one hop closer to peace of mind.

12496.descriptionId: Don't forget this leg anywhere before finding the other pieces of the totem, or you'll be haunted forever by a limping ghost.

12497.descriptionId: Eh-Rehr, whole, entire, magnificent. It's a shame he had to come apart in the first place, but at least reassembling him will earn you a ticket into the mysterious Pinki Crater.

12498.descriptionId: This little tongue is just perfect for tickling the insides of people's ears.

12499.descriptionId: This tongue is sturdy enough to poke into your nose, and scratchy enough to pull out anything undesirable from inside.

12500.descriptionId: This tongue would make a charming replacements for your worn out braces if only it didn't wriggle about when it was cut.

12501.descriptionId: This old tongue has already been in every hole you could possibly imagine, even those comdemned as immoral by Iop principles.

12502.descriptionId: This belt was made to match Pandalida's favourite weapon, the Andy War Sword, perfectly. It's the simply decorated sword that proves its worth in battle, not the belt, which is woven with pieces of gold that make so much noise your enemies always hear you coming.

12503.descriptionId:
Drape yourself in this cloak and adopt your most romantic look, squint slightly, and stare deep into the eyes of your heart's latest desire. They'll fall instantly. Down dead, that is.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12504.descriptionId:
This pretty headband will make you look like a right diva. It won't do much for your masculinity either.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12505.descriptionId:
Nobody ever taught Pandalida the art of war. She taught herself everything she knew. The way she held her staff, in particular, was very unconventional. She would point it at her mouth and scream from the top of her lungs. This quickly earned her the reputation of being one of the most monstrous killers of her time.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12506.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12507.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12508.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12509.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12510.descriptionId: This Moumouse is green with anger. It has to be said that it could end up between the claws of an evil Bow Meow.

12511.descriptionId: Under his cutie kitty eyelash-batting exterior, Dekster is a total psycho who thinks nothing of slaughtering one thousand rodents a day. His favourite hobby is chasing Mimice to add them to his trophy collection.

12512.descriptionId: Any self-respecting Masticator knows that he shouldn't try to harvest gum from the Wriggly tree with his bare hands, unless he wants to find his hands stuck to the bark... forever. And forever is filled with unbearable, unreachable itches.

12513.descriptionId: This porous volcanic rock has astonishing erosive properties. What's more, thanks to its low density, it also floats on water. The moral of the story is: you can occasionally use the pumice whilst washing your hands, but don't use it to go diving.

12514.descriptionId: Often used to plug holes, Wriggly gum is also much loved by children, until they get a bit older and realise that blowing bubbles does not count as a life aim, unless you're a Snapper.

12515.descriptionId: This sample was taken for the investigation. Don't spill it or urine trouble!

12516.descriptionId: Please, please, please, please wash your hands with a pumice stone after handling this sample, especially if you're going to eat straight afterwards.

12517.descriptionId: How do Srams produce samples like this one? This has to be one of the universe's greatest mysteries.

12518.descriptionId: Do not drink under any circumstances! Drinking it would hinder you in your quest for touristic justice. And it would be gross.

12519.descriptionId: Stok made a weird V sign with his hand when he gave you this sample. Thinking about it makes you kind of nervous. What did it mean?

12520.descriptionId: In ancient times, Bah Salt Crystals were harvested by Enutrofs with sickles and white robes. They were then used to season slabs of roast Boar served during nighttime feasts.

12521.descriptionId: This salt bounces when it hits the ground, or the inside of your stomach. Can cause nausea.

12522.descriptionId: This salt is so tasty it deserves a medal.

12523.descriptionId: This powder, made up of different types of salt, is what gives Plimok Soup its characteristic taste.

12524.descriptionId: This Sauroshell Heart was found on the beach at Tarada Bay. Its owner was probably far too sentimental.

12525.descriptionId: The words scrawled on this piece of paper are completely illegible. Why did they ever abolish handwriting classes?

12526.descriptionId: If you participate in the various activities on Vulkania, you can get your passport stamped, which would make you a Happy Camper.

12527.descriptionId: Thomas Cork uses these cards to record the number of points you won during the Shell Hunt.

12528.descriptionId: This amulet makes you living proof that you can take pride in your appearance even in this World of blood-thirsty brutes who wallow in the mud all day. As long as those weren't the criteria by which you were chosen...

12529.descriptionId: This amulet makes you living proof that you can take pride in your appearance even in this World of blood-thirsty brutes who wallow in the mud all day. Bet you feel just like Queen of the Lousy Pigs now...

12530.descriptionId: Your bulging muscles, your towering stature and your charisma have made you the World of Twelve's most gorgeous adventurer, and this amulet proves it. We all know that you were lucky not to have to sit an IQ test, though.

12531.descriptionId: This amulet is the proof that you have been elected as the most beautiful adventuress in the World of Twelve. Now you have to live with that burden, and do all you can to retain your title. In the end, you'll probably regret the whole thing.

12532.descriptionId: A box full of empty phials designed for collecting samples. This high-quality equipment is resistant to shocks, extreme temperatures and dodgy chemical experiments.

12533.descriptionId:
Nevark drinks the same potion every morning, which explains his superhuman powers and his hairy chest. When you drink it, your Agility, Chance, Strength, Intelligence, Initiative and Vitality characteristics will be augmented by 100 points, your basic damage will go up by 10 points and your Action and Movement Points will increase by 2 points for the next 5 combats. 
Moreover, it will grant you an extra spell point, which is yours to keep... forever.
It goes without saying that a potion as rare as this is not for sharing!

12534.descriptionId: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Suze McGraff is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

12535.descriptionId: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Hartvigg is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

12536.descriptionId: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Stok is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! That rapscallion!

12537.descriptionId: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Stak is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! That rapscallion!

12538.descriptionId: Nevark's Potion temporarily increases your characteristics.

12539.descriptionId: The Criminal Investigation Distillery has spoken: Tom Stone is the wrong-doer who's been running amok in Vulkania! What a fiend!

12540.descriptionId:
You can win these tokens by defeating Grozilla and Grasmera in their Den on the island of Vulkania.
If you collect 20 of these tokens, you can take them to Dina Tapio and swap them for a Madreggon.

12541.descriptionId: A reward for adventurers who have proved their worth by defeating Grozilla and Grasmera several times during their period of semi-dormancy, this Madreggon is very popular among the people of Astrub. Driven mad by its rider's stupidity, all it eats is Vulkanian sauroshells' souls.

12542.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the land of the living, so it's up to you: find a way of reviving it, or abandon it once and for all.

12543.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Madreggon that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12544.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Madreggon.

12545.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your petsmount. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12581.descriptionId: After your offering to the god Osamodas, you think you might have an opening. Now you just need to find out what it's for! Warning, this ephemeral gift will disappear as soon as you start fighting.

12582.descriptionId: This stone is as black as a Trool's underpants. Luckily for your entourage, it doesn't give off the same smell. So you can't use it as an excuse to explain that nauseating stench that lingers around you.

12583.descriptionId: This fake Sauroshell Heart has two uses. Children can fill in with Lousy Pig blood and use it as a water pistol by pointing the false artery at the target and squeezing it. As for the parents, this heart can be a welcome reminder of the heat on Vulkania Island when they're trembling from cold on Kwismas Island.

12584.descriptionId: Imbued with a powerful magic, each extremity of this relic shows the opposite direction to the other. So, it can tell you where the north and south are, or the east and west, simply by pointing the relic in the right direction. Now you think about, that salesman ripped you off, didn't he? What do you expect from a souvenir shop, though?

12585.descriptionId: This jam contains the vitamin-filled, spiced food that is associated with Vulkania Island. The package carries a somewhat unsettling warning though: May contain clothing.

12586.descriptionId:
This crystal is very popular amongst adventurers and, in particular, Enutrofs because of the blessing it has been bestowed with. Some people claim it was made by the protector of Junssidor, Sumens, himself, which would explain its powerful magic.
Nevertheless, some less gullible academics claim it's a rip-off, also known as a tourist-trap.

12587.descriptionId: This figure is an excellent way of attracting dust to your desk. If you're as short on conscience as you are on cash, you can always sell it on to a tribe of Sauroshell simpletons.

12588.descriptionId: Mmmmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm, mmm mmm mm mmmmmm mmmmm mmmmmmm mmmmmm mmm mmmm'm mmmmm mmmm mmmmmmm.

12589.descriptionId: This prospectus lists all the activities available on Vulkania Island. Please do not litter. That's not in the list.

12590.nameId: The Legend of Grozilla and Grasmera
12590.descriptionId: This book sheds light on some of the mysteries surrounding the Lords of Vulkania. Not exactly light bedtime reading if you're prone to nightmares.

12591.descriptionId: Written by Dina Tapio, an expert on Vulkanian Dracology, this book gives us an in-depth look at Dreggon reproduction.

12593.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12597.descriptionId:
With this hat on your head, you'll look out of this world. Or out of your mind. Probably the latter.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12598.descriptionId: This ring used to be the seal of an army general from a faraway country who wanted to invade Amakna. He didn't prove too much of a problem to his enemies due to his tactical errors. Essentially, his troops moved side to side as one big group, only advancing very slowly, instead of just moving forward in a straight line. This made them the easiest targets that Allister's Army had ever fought against.

12599.descriptionId: When this belt is equipped, you will feel like a true hero, able to single-handedly tear any army to shreds. Now you just have to find an army willing to let you do it.

12600.descriptionId:
It has been said that this staff is able to deal mortal blows which can destroy any invader with just one blow. Only a fool would fall for a thing like that.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12609.descriptionId: This basket is full of everything you need to have a successful picnic in the forest: a tub of Plimok soup, some mud pies, a tourist season salad and an assortment of dried-up fruit. Once you've finished your feast, you'll be able to take a little nap in the shade of the palm trees! Watch out for those bloody ants who are lurking around though.

12610.descriptionId: These rations, which have a peculiar taste, are old pieces of bread, soaked in Oilbow Grease before being rolled around the armpits. They keep for a very long time: it's not uncommon for them to survive longer than those who eat them.

12611.descriptionId: This typically Vulkanian soup is made from a mix of spices, salt crystals and rotten vegetables. Considered out of this World by most mere mortals, it is particularly invigorating to the organism. It is, in fact, so delicious that it is only consumed in small quantities: just one teaspoonful is perfectly adequate for a meal. Swallowing any more could result in uncontrollable spasms which could make you look like a plimok.

12612.descriptionId: Don't be fooled by appearances: this dish is absolutely delicious. The Leecha Tongue is a somewhat strange looking fish which is strangely reminiscent of a Clementine Boot. The texture of its bitter-sweet flesh is much more digestible than an old sole though.

12613.descriptionId: This blessing grants you Neutral resistance in your next battles.

12615.descriptionId: This broad shield was forged in Amakna to protect the Hispañic Knights amidst the riots and wild bloodshed which occurred in the city following the genetic modification scandal caused by certain crazy alchemists, such as N.E.R.F.

12616.descriptionId: The Caschoygan does protect its wearer's head rather effectively, but unfortunately it also covers his eyes, preventing him from seeing and - worse - reading anything. Most of the time, the adventurer ends up writing a load of piffle and yelling nonsensical expressions such as "HOYGAN" in the hope that someone will take notice.

12617.descriptionId: This strange, rare sword is a replica of the one belonging to a Iop knight, well known for the wigs under which he tried desperately to hide his bald spot. Forged with magic filaments taken from the original sword, the Masinko can do great damage against dirty meanies (though they have to be at least 51% dirty). The Amaknian smiths cannot be held responsible for any side effects such as hair loss or uncontrollable cravings to drink dodgy green drinks at breakfast time.

12655.descriptionId:
Rumour has it that this hat makes its wearer fluent in all animal languages. Careful, though, as it would seem most of the monsters of Amakna have not inherited your great conversational skills, and greeting them amicably isn't going to discourage them from tearing you limb from limb.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12656.descriptionId:
No one could really figure out what this strange cloak looked most like: a giant rat? A dinosaur? A being from another galaxy? In any case, one thing's for sure: it systematically disgusts the whole of the female population of the World of Twelve. Use it wisely.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12657.descriptionId: Strangely, whichever jeweller created this hairy amulet, with a rat nose and ears growing out of it, systematically refused to sign it. You can't really blame them.

12658.descriptionId: Only adventurers of a certain age will understand why the symbol on this bracelet is of a cat's paw, whereas the rest of these items seem to be linked to rats. Sneaky as they are, they're keeping quiet about it. Or are they senile already?

12659.descriptionId: This Trophy protects you from Fire attacks, but not Goblets of Fire.

12660.descriptionId: With this shield, everyone can see that you've left Incarnam and joined the World of Twelve to set off on the long search for the Dofus.

12661.descriptionId: This small bag, created by Poss'Ybel, is all the rage in Incarnam. Adventurers find it as practical as it is elegant. The more experienced ones keep the teeth they tear from the mouths of their enemies in it.

12670.descriptionId:
Once very popular, Davyd's cloak was considered a staple of any inhabitant of the World of Twelve's wardrobe because of its cheap price, high quality, its simplicity, and the big pocket on the back that can be used as a backpack. Unfortunately, the bag makers soon saw to it that this cape "disappeared", since it took away the very last advantage backpacks had over cloaks.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12671.descriptionId: The musical note on Davyd's belt is actually a button which, once activated, launches an S.O.S. into the sky, signalling to all the space oddities that an earthling's in trouble. Somebody up there likes him.

12672.descriptionId: Unwashed and slightly dazed, but always at the height of country fashion, Davyd was the one who invented this hybrid of clogs and boots, which combines the solidity and the rustic feel of the clog with the protection and practicality offered by the boot. He never stopped campaigning for their popularity, going so far as to say they were the product of his own sweat and tears. Which probably put a great many people off wearing them.

12673.descriptionId:
A great music lover, Davyd's bow is easily transported because it's attached to his scythe, which vibrates every time he shakes it. During the time it took to perfect his skill with this rare instrument, he managed to send all the other farmers running for the hills, meaning he now owns all the wheat fields in Amakna and his fortune is guaranteed.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12674.descriptionId: You've just put on the same hat that Daggero has been wearing since his early childhood. Unfortunately, you don't have the same excuse he did: no one ever told him it was already a good decade out of fashion.

12675.descriptionId: Daggero took this blood-coloured pearl necklace from the body of a Kitsou chief who had attacked his village in the past, Red. Let's hope no one ever asks you where you got yours from. No ones going to believe you're a Pandawushu Master if you admit you just ordered a cheap copy from your jeweller.

12676.descriptionId: This loincloth bears the marks of the long years of intense training that Daggero put himself through so he could one day defeat Zatoishwan. Strangely, it's only been giving off that musty smell since you put it on.

12677.descriptionId: After destroying his village, Daggero made this staff from its still-fuming remains. He was almost able to make himself another one from yours.

12728.descriptionId: This rare alloy gives off an energy powerful enough to fuel even the most demanding magical items, such as asymmetric bottle-openers or barycentre-less percolators, to cite just a couple of the better known examples.

12733.descriptionId: This extract is obtained by marinading various rotten planks in an unsettling kind of brine. It might remind you of one of your grandmother's favourite recipes, and you might not be far off the mark.

12734.descriptionId: The doctors advise you not to drink it, but your future heritors are all for it. Who to believe?

12736.descriptionId: This token is presented to warriors who win their Kolossium fights with flair. You can exchange it for a number of prizes, but, unfortunately for you, your tab at Astrub Tavern isn't one of them.

12737.descriptionId: You can skim this pebble beautifully across the surface of lakes or off the foreheads of people who are weaker than you.

12738.descriptionId: This pebble will enable you to forge powerful items whilst preventing you from forging an opinion on the quantative theory of kamas.

12740.descriptionId: This pebble looks like your own bald pate decorated with mashed firefly. That's all you have in common with it, though, because the pebble is magic.

12743.descriptionId: Heavier than heavy water, this potion is perfect for keeping the fishes' heads above water so they don't drown.

12744.descriptionId: Kruor the Wabbit was sprinkled with this liquid four times when he was still small and puny. I can't imagine a better start in life, can you?

12745.descriptionId: The association of retired but still very brave former firemen who now volunteer at Allister's castle would not recommend you use this liquid to put out fires. Unless you like adding fuel to the fire.

12747.descriptionId: This Trophy increases Earth attack damage. Only Earthworms are impressed by this.

12748.descriptionId: This Trophy increases Earth attack damage. Only Earthworms are impressed by this.

12751.descriptionId:
The circle in the middle of the Pongloak bounces off one of the sides with each step you take, making a characteristic "pong" sound. Even after years and years of use, a lot of adventurers still find it fun. Maybe the simplest games really are the best!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12752.descriptionId:
The flat, strangely-shaped Pongshovel is one of the worst shovels you could hope for when it comes to digging. It does make a pretty good table tennis paddle, though.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12753.descriptionId: The ball between the Pongbelt's two bands moves around the belt all the time, constantly kneading your love handles. In short, it's quite ridiculous, kind of unpleasant and definitely not glamorous. But they say it helps you lose weight, so you should give it a shot at least.

12754.descriptionId: The amulet around your neck is a miniature version of the original Pongulet, which was as tall and wide as a Treechnid. After a number of broken necks and a lukewarm response from critics, its creator decided to make a portable version, which was a great success.

12755.descriptionId:
With this cape on your back, you'll constantly have the feeling that someone's following you. It'll guarantee a non-stop flow of adrenaline, but is also likely to lead to acute paranoia.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12756.descriptionId: Whatever you do, don't give this amulet to a child: they'll want to chew on the ghost beads, and will die instantly. Strangely enough, chewing a special kind of gum will turn these dangerous ghosts into a tasty, and quite harmless, delicacy.

12757.descriptionId: These boots are capable of engulfing anything you kick with them. A kick in the danglies with a pair of Pacmaboots is every male adventurer's worst nightmare.

12758.descriptionId:
For a long time, people believed that the Pacmaggers were throwing knives: their first users were scared the yellow ball which decorates their handles was going to gobble up their hands, which caused them to throw them instinctively. Nowadays, jumpy adventurers are banned from using them because of their unfair advantage over standard daggers.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12770.descriptionId: Apart from Dragonsly, no one knows which creature's slobber forms the basis for this potion. Everyone agrees that whatever it is, it has seriously bad breath. Maybe it's your grandma?

12772.descriptionId: Volume IX of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

12773.descriptionId: Volume X of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

12774.descriptionId: These boots, which are fitted with wooden rackets, will be underfoot wherever you go. They are resistant to digestive juices and caustic humour.

12775.descriptionId: This wooden belt is just right for holding in large stomachs and protecting tummy buttons from Critical Hits.

12776.descriptionId: This little amulet is proof of your love of books, libraries and old, bespectacled owls. You can also use it as a bookmark.

12789.descriptionId: This work is a copy of one of the royal library's manuscripts. The original text was transcribed by George Segrob the archivist, which means its authenticity is guaranteed.

12790.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12791.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12792.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12796.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12797.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12798.descriptionId:
You are one of the smallest mammals in the World to have witnessed Grozilla and Grasmera's extinction and the apocalypses which followed, and to have survived. With a bit of luck, you'll take a leaf out of your distant ancestors' book and set about evolving into something better now. I mean, you kind of need it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12799.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to learn the spell.)
This scroll will teach you the Diffraction spell. Reserved for Masqueraider use only.

12814.descriptionId: Always dreamt of having your own hearty coat of resin and pine needles to protect against the cold? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

12815.descriptionId:
You're disguised as a Kwismas Pricky. That's what happens when you play with firs!
The transformation's effects will disappear if you move.

12816.descriptionId:
You're disguised as a Kwismas Gift Package. Your fault for getting so wrapped up in your own affairs! 
The transformation's effects will disappear if you move.

12817.descriptionId: Always dreamt of bursting out of a huge present during an important function, wearing nothing but a Boowolf Thong? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

12818.descriptionId:
You're disguised as a Kwismas Soft Toy. Don't worry, girls go crazy for cuddly guys!
The transformation's effects with disappear if you move.

12819.descriptionId: Always dreamt of being snuggled all day long and to have itchy, synthetic hairs growing all over you? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

12820.descriptionId:
You now believe you're a Kwismas Snowman. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

12821.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowman. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

12822.descriptionId:
You now believe you're a Kwismas Kaniger. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

12823.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Wintry Kaniger. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

12824.descriptionId:
You now believe you're a Kwismas Yiti. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

12825.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snow Yiti. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

12826.descriptionId:
You now believe you're a Kwismas Mini Inuit. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

12827.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Mini Inuit. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

12828.descriptionId: This wood can be used to heat up cold Lenalds or barbecue wabbit paws.

12829.descriptionId: You might be salivating at the idea of this sticky earthworm squirming about in your mouth, but it's not for you!

12830.descriptionId: These berries might look like pills, but we can guarantee that, just like Raymond Santho's cereals, they are organic. Well, the side effects are.

12831.descriptionId: This coarse carpet, taken from the underground rabbit tunnels, smells of cawwots and sweat. You can't wait to snuggle up inside it, humming under a moonlit sky.

12832.descriptionId: This pattern can be used by craftsmen to make part of the Redolph Set.

12833.descriptionId: This pattern can be used by craftsmen to make part of the Goblimp Set.

12834.descriptionId: This pattern can be used by craftsmen to make part of the Kwismas Nightmare Set.

12835.descriptionId: Just like the mould you find on bread, this is not meant to be eaten.

12836.descriptionId: Like most moulds, this can be used by men and women alike. The difference is in the way it's used... which is the same for all users.

12837.descriptionId: Using this mould, you might just be able to make it into Father Kwismas's House. That doesn't mean you're going to make it out alive though.

12838.descriptionId: This low-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Haven monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimposta.

12839.descriptionId: This medium-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Land monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimping Rich.

12840.descriptionId: This high-value kama was handed out to the Kwismas Taiga monsters by Nicholas Kwismas. To use it in his Kwismas shop, just speak to Blimpineck.

12841.nameId: Little Bag of Silver Chocolate Kamas
12841.descriptionId:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 20 silver chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-TAP TO USE.

12842.nameId: Big Bag of Bronze Chocolate Kamas
12842.descriptionId:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 40 bronze chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-TAP TO USE.

12843.nameId: Little Bag of Bronze Chocolate Kamas
12843.descriptionId:
Any Enutrof'll tell you that only a Iop would keep his coins in a flimsy net rather than a chest.
This bag contains 20 bronze chocolate kamas.
DOUBLE-TAP TO USE.

12844.descriptionId: Eating this baked delight will really get you into the Kwismas spirit: you'll suddenly be surrounded by snow, you'll be somewhat stouter than before and you'll become diabetic.

12845.descriptionId: This magical snowflake is a vital resource for crafting Kwismas items. Unfortunately, if you try to use it to cool down your suitors' enthusiasm it'll have no effect at all.

12846.descriptionId: This fairywork is very easy to use: just aim for a friend's face, and fire! That should leave them frozen to the spot.

12847.descriptionId: The perfect fairywork for sending chills up your new friends' spines.

12848.descriptionId: This coat is quite a paradox. You put it on to stop shivering, but the cold metal of the bells which hang off it here and there brush against you unexpectedly as they jingle, which makes you shiver even more.

12849.descriptionId: Wear this hat and your head will be sound as a bell!

12850.descriptionId: These underpants will keep your manhood safe and warm. Plus, the strategically-placed bells will let everyone know you've got a thing for the young lady who just walked past.

12851.descriptionId: The Goblimps have turned this baby rattle into a magnificent bracelet. If you shake it hard enough, you might be able to cover the Astrubian tourists' wailing.

12852.descriptionId: Jack would have loved to be a vampire, but instead, he had to be a lowly skeleton his whole life. In order to be just a tiny bit cooler, he had this cape made.

12853.descriptionId: Jack was such a devious fellow that he had the crazy idea of dressing up as himself to do his misdeeds and throw people off the scent. Using this mask, you can do the same thing! If you're a Sram, that is.

12854.descriptionId: Jack was a Sram who just loved tricks and treats. For that reason, he spent almost all his time knocking at doors to ask for sweets. One day, though, he knocked on Tengu Snowfoux's door when Fuji Snowfoux was visiting... All they found of poor Jack was this amulet.

12855.descriptionId: The other Frigostians always saw Jack as something of an eccentric, which is why the only person he could find to make these boots was an Amaknian shoemaker who was part of the Order of the Kicked Ass. The boots' shape was specially chosen to suit the Order's techniques.

12856.descriptionId: This saddlebag gives easy access to bottles during combat, which makes it an obvious choice for Pandawa adventurers.

12857.descriptionId: This headgear is great for showing your rivals that you're looking for a real challenge. It's also useful for sending out an explicit message to any ladies in the vicinity, although you shouldn't count on that working out well for you.

12858.descriptionId: Wear this halter around your neck if you're scared of wandering off and never being found again. Tried and tested by Gobball breeders.

12859.descriptionId: These hooves are fitted with anti-slip soles. The shoemaker who made them assures everyone that that's to avoid their wearer from slipping on ice, but everyone knows that they're really to stop the wearer from slipping in puddles of spilt beer late at night.

12860.descriptionId: This underpant gusset is squeaky clean and smells like lavender, unlike your own.

12861.descriptionId: This blocked up nose is leaking a sticky substance that stinks of alcohol. Only the most reckless Pandawas would put it in their mouths.

12862.descriptionId: These antennae are highly sought-after by fishermen, perhaps because they start vibrating whenever there's phishing to be done. It's probably not a good idea to wear them at the Astrub, Amakna Village and Frigost Village Zaaps.

12863.descriptionId: Sick of your reflection being ruined by your rotten teeth? Here's your chance to change your life! Pearly white smile and stray pieces of food getting stuck guaranteed.

12864.descriptionId:
When he was still on Kwismas Island, Rint used to dream of adventure. After a hard day's work at Gutenblimp's press, he fashioned his sword from a Kwismas tree branch and went along the Taiga to slay the dragons who, according to him, were hiding inside the gifts.
This weapon is still imbued with the Goblimp Rint's magic. Maybe when you use it, a little slice of his heroic spirit will flare up in you!

12865.descriptionId: You got this star for helping the Thwee Kings.

12866.descriptionId: You got this star for beating the Itzting in the Kwismas Dungeon.

12867.descriptionId: You got this star for earning the required number of Beside the Points.

12868.descriptionId: You got this star for making a Grump smile... or trying to...

12869.descriptionId: You got this star for earning the required number of Good Points.

12870.descriptionId: You got this star for bringing back boxes of stolen gifts to Harry Kwismas.

12872.descriptionId: The Goblimps absolutely love this type of sweet. The Astrubians enjoy them, too, but they don't say thanks when you offer them one.

12873.nameId: Toy for Good Boys and Girls
12873.descriptionId: These toys make a noise when you press on them, and wet you if you pull the stem... just like clowns, in fact.

12874.descriptionId: This egg is used to recruit the Wobots who make up the Wa Wabbit's personal bodyguards. The raw egg is dipped into Lenald liver oil, then placed in the Wobot's claw. Its guide then has to insert it into the orifice of his choice in an adventurer without breaking it. If he manages it, he makes it through to the next round in in the recruitment process. It is worth noting that this is behind the famous diarrhoea disaster.

12875.descriptionId: A bit of a cougar, this Cawwot is a favourite of young Wabbits and budding adventurers. Please note that its tapered shape and its absorbant abilities make it the first choice of cork against the famous diarrhoea disaster.

12876.descriptionId: If you're a fan of fine dining and bad jokes, be prepared to let out a little whine.

12877.descriptionId: All wabbits would be prepared to kill, massacre, disembowel, decapitate, eviscerate, mutilate and even bite, just to taste a few drops of this juice. An Enutrof would do the same for just a few sips of kama infusion.

12878.descriptionId: This Black Wabbit is so flat, you could use it to play music if they had such things as record players in the World of Twelve.

12879.descriptionId: You have won a Beside the Point by travelling all the way around Kwismas Island in search of ill-mannered Gomplimps. They really gave you the run around. Take some time to catch your breath before heading off again, or you'll give yourself stitch.

12880.descriptionId: Thanks to Fixou's work, you hold, in your hands, all you need to attract the ardours of even the most aggressive Wabbits. Make sure you don't use it on hunting adventurers, it will make their limbs all soft.

12881.descriptionId:
Put on this hat, get down on all fours, and any adventurers who cross your path will think they've discovered a new breed of mount that's infinitely nicer and cuter than Dragoturkeys. Then, impale those trusting nincompoops with your horn. Or let them take you for a ride. Whichever you prefer.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12882.descriptionId: These little boots will make a cute clip-clopping sound when you move. This will often by followed by a heavy "BOOM" when you fall onto the ground because these tough, round boots really aren't good for your balance.

12883.descriptionId: Tidy your hair up in an instant with this Brushdant, which will enable you to face up to any hair-raising situation. Unfortunately, though, its meagre powers won't ruffle your enemies' hair.

12884.descriptionId:
This long, soft and colourful mane, decorated with its pink flower bow, will attract the fervour and caresses of all the ladies in the World of Twelve. If you're one of them, that is. If you're a man, it will just remove your virility and remove you from your position as the alpha male. Forever.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12885.descriptionId:
This helmet will protect you from your opponents' blows like no other. Important disclaimer: does not protect against being stabbed, cut, burnt, scorched, scratched, slapped, insect bites, clingy adventurers, bad jokes, your own stupidity...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12886.descriptionId:
Adventurers who don't know what this strange staff with two round ends is for may assume it's for cleaning out a Trool's ears. That's not right though, it's exactly the right size for yours.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12887.descriptionId: These Gladiapants, worn on their own, are going to delight powerful and muscular adventurers. Of course, on you, at best they'll look like you're a little bit eccentric and, at worse, a dangerous pervert.

12888.descriptionId: These boots will weaken your kicks so you don't hurt your opponent. It's very kind of you, but it won't stop the Gobballs biting your knees off with very little effort.

12892.descriptionId:
Sick of seeing their roundels continually smashed to pieces, the three adventurers and cousins, Anne, Al and Arty Fissial, had a new one made that allowed them to do a little smashing of their own... until the day they met the Kwismas Minotoball, that is.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12893.descriptionId:
Anyone who equips the Wicked Shield will have a wicked time. Those were the words of Halden the Sram when he brought down the Kwismas Minotoball that was terrorising Amakna Village.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

12895.descriptionId: Vlad the Blimpaler gives good points to those adventurers he deems worthy. If you're particularly well-behaved, you should have enough of them to get your hands on the Workshop Star.

12896.descriptionId: The fire that burns in your belly will make short work of this Kwismas Log. Rumour has it that one of the Thwee Kings, Balt Hasaw, loves eating Kwismas Logs.

12898.descriptionId: With this wrapping paper, you can create a gift package to give to anyone you like!

12899.descriptionId: This wrapping paper will allow you to create a beautiful gift package. You just need to decide who to give it to!

12900.descriptionId: This wrapping paper will allow you to create a beautiful gift package. You just need to decide who to give it to!

12901.descriptionId: This bag contains the loot that Blimpristed coveted so much.

12903.descriptionId: This bag contains the loot that Redolph coveted so much.

12905.descriptionId: This bag contains the loot that Roachelf coveted so much.

12906.descriptionId: This bag contains the loot that Oogie Betty coveted so much.
