12914.descriptionId: This wrapping paper will allow you to create a beautiful gift package. You just need to decide who to give it to!

12915.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12916.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12917.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12918.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12919.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12920.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12921.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12922.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12924.descriptionId: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make that old grump Blimpristed see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.

12925.descriptionId: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make that old grump Redolph see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.

12926.descriptionId: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make Blimpristed the Bad-Humoured see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.

12927.descriptionId: This contract between Scooger and yourself stipulates that you have to make Oogie Betty see sense, by any means possible and as many times as it takes. Like any contract worth the paper it's written on, this one has many clauses added to your employer's advantage in tiny print at the bottom of the page, which proves its authenticity.

12928.descriptionId: With this wrapping paper, you can create a gift package to give to anyone you like!

12929.descriptionId: With this wrapping paper, you can create a gift package to give to anyone you like!

12931.descriptionId: This crate contains a pingwin-launcher in pretty bad nick. Blimpilator should be able to repair it.

12932.descriptionId: These parts will allow Blimpilator to repair all manner of things... like, say, a pingwin-launcher.

12933.descriptionId: Compress this pingwin a bit and it'll make excellent pingwin-launcher ammunition. They say that certain undesirable young men have used the same system on their over-defensive mothers-in-law.

12934.descriptionId: If you want breath so stinky it could knock a Minotoror for six, you have two choices. Either chew on socks stolen from Enutrof corpses every day, or use some of this oil.

12935.descriptionId: Made especially for you, this item (best kept chilled) can be used to open Blimpristed's grotto door. A tool such as this would have come in very handy for Jim Boned, the famous spy. He could have used it to open any bedroom door he liked... That's one way of making new enemies of jealous husbands.

12936.descriptionId: Harvested from the prickies when there's a particularly biting chill, these needles are valued by tailors who are skilled enough to work with mittens on.

12937.descriptionId: Judging by the designs you found inside it, this bag must be worth a fortune. However, since you're a heartless, noble sort, you're going to give it back to its owner, right? Right?

12938.descriptionId: This flat spanner can turn nuts, bolts and other screws. This tool is considered indispensable by the handymen who like to think that, without the Spanner of 12, the World would soon become unhinged.

12939.descriptionId: This design is soaked, the instructions are almost illegible and the plans look like baby food. Sadly, you're going to have to make do. If you want to make the toy Nicholas has asked for, use the toy machine just like the Goblimp workers do.

12940.descriptionId: Hector Kwismas gave you this Kwismas Card as you boarded the boat for Kwismas Island. It says "Merry Kwismas" on it. You might have the genius to figure out which holiday it's for, but will your intelligence be lauded during your lifetime? Nothing could be less certain.

12941.descriptionId: You took this loot from the Golden Scarabugly. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!

12942.descriptionId: You took this loot from the Dragon Pig. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!

12943.descriptionId: You took this loot from the Soft Oak. If you manage to get 3 of them to give to Harry Kwismas, you'll get the Dungeon Star!

12944.descriptionId: This notebook was written by an ingenious Goblimp, and it definitely contains a whole load of juicy information. Unfortunately, its stench is so nauseating that only a madman, a Porco or sobeone wid a gold would ever open it.

12945.descriptionId: To connoisseurs, this keg is worth all the kamas in the World. To uncultured drinkers who finish it too quickly, it's more likely to be worth a headache so violent it could split a Chafer's head in two.

12946.descriptionId: This message was written by Shug Arkane and is addressed to Docker Hiseze. It should allow you to get hold of the key to Redolph's stable.

12947.descriptionId: You sometimes come across stones such as this one in the icy bodies of Snowballs. Must be kept refrigerated. Some people use them as good luck charms, whilst others keep them for difficult post-party mornings, to cure persistent headaches or cover up bad breath.

12948.descriptionId: This key should allow you to pay regular visits to Redolph the grump.

12949.descriptionId: The cover of this diary is covered in bitemarks and dried saliva. Most of the pages have been ripped out, and all that's left is a few pages of illegible, spidery writing.

12950.descriptionId: This page was ripped out of one unfortunate entomologist's diary. The text is still legible, but there are some stains on the paper which suggest that the manuscript's author is probably no longer with us.

12951.descriptionId: They say that spoken words vanish and writing lives on. In this case, the author seems to have left a lot of himself in the text of this page.

12952.descriptionId: According to some people, Yitis keep items stolen from travellers who have lost their way as trophies. Perhaps preservation and self-preservation go hand in hand?

12953.descriptionId: Despite the freezing temperature, the information waiting to be deciphered on this page doesn't seem to have been kept very fresh.

12954.descriptionId: The pen may well be mightier than the sword, but it stands no chance against a Yiti's fangs and claws. The author of this travel journal learnt that the hard way.

12955.descriptionId: This key will allow you to go and annoy Roachelf in his loft as many times as it takes.

12956.descriptionId: This ice cube was taken from a Kwismas Island Crackler who was rather reluctant to let go of it. It will only melt if you dip it in boiling water, or if you get it to listen to one of Wastelife's more heart-wrenching ballads.

12957.descriptionId: The Slayhounds' diet, largely composed of mouldy adventurer meat and damaged souls, doesn't do much for their dental hygiene. White Slayhound fangs can be somewhat difficult to find. Take a good pair of tweezers and a life insurance policy with you if you want to get one.

12958.descriptionId: The potion contained in this flask is 99% water, but the other 1% makes all the difference. It's usually used to soothe upset stomachs, although some Imp aeronauts use it to get rid of excess ballast.

12959.descriptionId: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!

12960.descriptionId: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!

12961.descriptionId: Created by the famous Blimpulose out of pure barley sugar, this staff is great for anyone with a sweet tooth, and it's approved by the Goblimp Staff Placement Association to boot!

12962.descriptionId: These two oranges are starting to melt, little by little, at the bottom of your bag. Rather than wasting your time reading this splendid description, why not get on with the staff placing race?

12963.descriptionId: A loyal hunting companion of Goblimps who travel the Taiga, the Slayhound's bite is worse than its bark. It feeds on Kwismas monsters' souls.

12964.descriptionId: This Slayhound Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12965.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12966.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Slayhound that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12967.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Slayhound.

12968.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your petsmount. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12969.descriptionId: This bracelet is so enormous that you could use it as a belt or hang it around one of your swollen ankles. Big-headed adventurers like you can even wear it as a crown! The jeweller who made it really was the practical type.

12970.descriptionId: This package was given to the Kwismas Minotoball because he was a good boy all year long. Incidentally, that's also the reason he gets to take several weeks' holiday every year in Descendre, to unwind by brawling merrily with any adventurers who cross his path.

12971.descriptionId: Leo gave you this cage after your star hunt. To release the slayhound, you're going to have to go to Kwismas Island. It refuses to get out anywhere else. If you haven't reached a high enough level, the cage won't open. It's for you own good. You wouldn't want to end up as Slayhound food, would you?

12972.descriptionId: This Book, written by Oshimo Bigglip, explains how to raise a Slayhound.

12973.descriptionId: This key is your daily entry pass to Oogie Betty's Ice Sanctuary. A warm welcome awaits... maybe.

12975.descriptionId: If this Frozen Tofu does have a beak under that pile of snow, it's also pretty pecked off about the other creatures who live on Kwismas Island. It'd be only too happy to help you defrost them.

12976.descriptionId: This Frozen Tofu Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12977.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12978.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Frozen Tofu that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12979.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Frozen Tofu.

12980.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12981.descriptionId: This flat spanner can turn nuts, bolts and other screws. This tool is considered indispensable by the handymen who like to think that, without the Spanner of 14, the World would soon become unhinged.

12982.descriptionId: Mouselet is the most voracious vegetarian in all Amakna. Its favourite hobbies include upsetting the api cart and getting rid of the bad eggs, so it can have its cake and eat it too. And they say carnivores are bloodthirsty...

12983.descriptionId: This Mouselet Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12984.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12985.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Mouselet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12986.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Mouselet.

12987.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

12988.descriptionId: Scarakiri has a very extreme sense of honour. No longer able to bear the unjustified hostility shown by its brothers on Minotoror Island, it's resigned itself to getting rid of them all one by one to re-establish the honour of its long line of honourable Scaratos. And it's in your best interests to help it as much as you can: if you fail, it's likely to atone for its faults by committing suicide.

12989.descriptionId: This Scarakiri Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12990.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12991.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Scarakiri that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12994.descriptionId: Grauler is the smallest of all the Raul Mops, and it's not very happy about it. Even the Snappers are bigger than it – and they swim around, mocking it. It's always complaining about its fellow Mops, and it's decided to show them that size doesn't matter. It's going to help you teach them a lesson.

12995.descriptionId: This Grauler Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

12996.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

12997.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Grauler that you left at the Bow Kennel.

12998.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Grauler.

12999.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13000.descriptionId: When you chose to adopt the Moowitty, you might have expected a pet who's a laugh a minute. Unfortunately, it's not half as funny as its name would have you believe. A fan of crude jokes in bad taste, the Moowitty will have you at your wit's end. It's been banned from the Canidae Dungeon and the Sidimote Moors. It would love to go back there to confront its old peers under your protection. Be warned, it's got a few "Yo Mama" jokes lined up for them...

13001.descriptionId: This Moowitty Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13002.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13003.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Moowitty that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13004.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Moowitty.

13005.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13006.descriptionId: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, starry wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

13007.descriptionId: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, bright red wrapping paper. Who know's what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

13008.descriptionId: Check out this magnificent gift, with its magnificent, Kwismassy wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

13009.descriptionId: Spending their days talking to adventurers who are all as stupid as each other can soften up even the firmest of husbands. Mary uses a root-based recipe discovered by the famous biologist Jim Ger to help Harry stay in shape when he starts slacking off.

13010.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

13013.descriptionId: You can write the name of the person to whom you want to send the gift on this label.

13014.descriptionId: This label has the name of the lucky recipient of the gift written on it. It can be attached at a Wrapping Station.

13015.descriptionId:
This feathery, Turkohat-inspired hat will have your latest conquests all aflutter.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13016.descriptionId:
Showing off this cape, decorated with beautifully coloured feathers, you should have the object of your affections falling at your feet. Just make sure you don't get your feet caught in it, though, or you could end up falling at theirs.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13017.descriptionId: This feathery belt will really emphasise your waist. Not that it needs much emphasising.

13018.descriptionId: These downy boots, which give the impression you have Dragoturkey feet, would make excellent slippers. You know, the type your guests make fun of whenever you wear them round the house? You aren't really going to wear them outside, are you?

13019.descriptionId:
Every day, Maria Kitty does her singing exercises on the bridge of her ice prisoner boat, the Emancipation of Me, using her Hammegaphone. Little does she know, that's what keeps her safe from the region's monsters: the sound of Maria's amplified voice is so unbearable that all living creatures for kilokametres around run away and never come back. Only her husband, Nick Annon, stays. He's been deaf for quite a while, though.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13020.descriptionId: Of modest origins, Maria has only ever been known to wear boots on her feet. To keep up her image of being a diva, she asked one of the greatest cobblers in Frigost to find a dye that would turn them a pretty pink colour. He ended up taking his own life, unable to forgive himself for having created such a monster.

13021.descriptionId:
If little Maria from Frigost managed to appeal to a huge audience and make a name for herself right across the Amaknian continent, you can bet it was this cape that got her noticed. Anyone who wears it on their shoulders will make a real spectacle of themselves, so Maria always played sell-out shows. Don't hope for too much when you put it on though, the public's not stupid enough to fall for it twice.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13022.descriptionId: The crystal on Maria's necklace rings in harmony with her vocal chords and can create devastating shock waves. However, they will never do as much damage as her voice alone, which can effortlessly pierce your eardrums and ruin even your most beautiful fantasies.

13023.descriptionId: You get one of these tokens by winning a Gobbowl tournament. This one is still covered in sweat and saliva.

13026.descriptionId: This token was won from a Gobbowl tournament after several successive and successful attempts to bribe the referee. All in a day's work!

13032.descriptionId: You got this token from winning a Gobbowl tournament. The ref must have been blind.

13039.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13040.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13041.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13042.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13043.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13044.descriptionId: If you shake this object vigorously and hold your ear to it, you'll hear a strange noise as if you were waking up a real live creature. Don't wait a moment longer, open it now!

13052.descriptionId: This coin, which you received for defeating a temple Dopple, can be exchanged for something valuable.

13054.descriptionId: Ozz made a note of his measurements on this piece of parchment so that the outfit Paro Cabanne made for him would be a perfect fit. One of the measurements he's put for the breeches fitting was almost definitely made up to impress the seamstress...

13055.descriptionId: This scroll was signed by Allister himself, and proves that its bearer is in the service of the kingdom of Amakna. It's written in BIG CAPITAL LETTERS so even a Wabbit will understand how important it is.

13056.descriptionId: This noble hair comes from the Prince of Wa's beard - at least that's what the certificate of authenticity that came with it claims. Legend has it that this relic has the power to awaken the Wabbit that lies dormant within you.

13057.descriptionId: After you touched the Prince of Wa's sacred beard hair, you started to feel mighty funny... You had a desperate desire to start hopping all over the place and nibbling on cawwots whilst making self-important declarations. The slightest bump or shock should bring you back to normal, or as normal as you've ever been.

13060.descriptionId: This amber pebble is as rusty as your fighting skills and looks a lot like a gold nugget... if you squint slightly and turn your head 45 degrees to the left, that is! It might be best just trying to sell it to those that have never seen a gold nugget before.

13061.descriptionId: The origins of this pebble remain unknown. Certain adventurers believe it's actually one of the many burnt loaves baked by Xavier the Baker's careless apprentice. They say he always used to forget to turn off the oven when he went out to help his mentor beat off the monsters around the bakery.

13062.descriptionId: It's not the prettiest pebble out there, but for some reason it has certain citizens of Astrub - after a few drinks, admittedly - singing its praises as though it were some kind of god - and religion sells, dontcha know!

13063.descriptionId: Where there is Arty, there is his cane. Legend has it that one end is coated in black treacle to attract herds of lost Gobballs. The other is supposedly splintered wood, just to get those Gobballs moving! You certainly won't want to get the wrong end of the stick on this one! Unfortunately, this cane seems to have a serious design flaw which renders it unusable. Juss Tafinger, the ski maker in Frigost Village, should be able to exchange it for one that works.

13064.descriptionId: This cursed hat used to belong to Katar, but he lost his mind. Mad as a hatter, he ended up beheaded. Take heed!

13071.descriptionId: He's a little shell-shocked and a little crabby, but after years of experimentation, Mekrab has clawed his way out of the lab and into existence. He was designed to be a basic robotic life-form but, as with all crazy experimental subjects, he's gone a bit wrong... Obsessed with the meaning of life (as artificial as it is), he has taken it upon himself to exterminate the Craborals and all other creatures like them on Otomai beach. Eventually, he'll sponge up their life-force... and then their lives. He's counting on you to help him.

13072.descriptionId: This Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13073.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13074.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Mekrab that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13075.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormome can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Mekrab.

13076.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Mekrab. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause dissappointing results.

13089.descriptionId:
This shovel can do everything: dig earth, collect kamas, stun bandits and even repel your mother-in-law. As you can see, it's pretty much essential.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13091.descriptionId: Ronin Chafer bones are black from the hundreds of years spent wandering without a master, guided solely by dark intentions. If you're as black as this Kabuto, however, it's only because you haven't had a wash for ages, you dirty devil.

13092.descriptionId: If you've read up on obscure Draugur Chafer legends, you might think that this hammer will come back to you just like a boomerang when you throw it. To this day, the truth behind the legend is unknown, as most adventurers can only throw it as far as on their own toes!

13093.descriptionId: The Ronin Chafer doesn't need to wear any underwear underneath his loincloth: thanks to his lack of flesh, a glimpse of his coccyx from the front has never shocked a soul. You should probably avoid testing out people's reactions to the same frontal view of your coccyx.

13094.descriptionId: The tailor that created these boots thought he was making them for the Ronin Chafer. He obviously thought you looked primitive enough already.

13095.descriptionId:
The headband that you wear as an honoured guest of Pandala has many uses: covering your forehead, it shows all and sundry that your a friend to the Pandawa people; covering your eyes, it allows you to get some kip in the mid-day sun; and covering your mouth, it makes sure you don't talk nonsense.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13096.descriptionId: It is said that the weapons made from these black Ronin Chafer bones are so sharp that they can cut through butter. This time, it's not just a legend...

13097.descriptionId: The Draugur Chafer is known for the powerful noises he makes. Despite his lack of vocal cords, he produces the strangest of cries that sound somewhere between a gargle and an incredibly husky voice. You picked up his jaw as a souvenir of the joyous moments he brought you.

13098.descriptionId: This helmet is made of wood, even though metal and gemstones are much more fashionable; the horn is upside-down; it offers very little real protection... Yes siree, this headgear is just as primitive as its wearer - which is why it looks so good on you.

13099.descriptionId: Although Plop would never hurt a fly, he has never truly been accepted by the other aquatic monsters of the Astrub Rocky Inlet and Cania Bay. These monsters are horrified at the prospect of Plop growing up to be just like his three-times-removed cousin, the Giant Kralove, who scares the living daylight out of them. You find all this injustice and prejudice really infuriating. Go and show those Beach Monsters how wrong they are by hashing it out the only way you know how: violence.

13100.descriptionId: The Plop Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13101.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13102.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Plop that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13103.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Plop.

13105.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Plop. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13107.descriptionId: What's surprising about this cereal, besides its resistance to Frigost's extreme climate, is that it gives any milk it comes into contact with a delicate chocolatey flavour.

13108.descriptionId: Hardened to Frigost's harsh climate, this flower is much more resistant than its delicate appearance would suggest. That said, to preserve the alchemic properties of such a rare plant, it must be handled carefully when harvested.

13109.descriptionId: Spines as sharp as Bworker's blades, scales as thick as Soft Oak bark, and eyes as black as Crobak feathers. This fish may be formidable, but served up on a plate it is quite simply delicious.

13110.descriptionId: Hard enough to scratch glass and dark enough to sap your morale, this rock has lost all of the heat of the lava from which it came. It would be perfect as a tombstone, as long as it's not your own.

13111.descriptionId: This tree appears to tremble when you touch it. After all the axe blows you've dealt it, it's not surprising it's scared of you.

13112.descriptionId: This meat is fresher than your breath and more appetizing than your soulmate.

13113.descriptionId: Mix new technology with traditional methods and you end up with the Scampiscuba Helmet. This jazzed-up diving headgear will allow a Scampihorse to disappear down into the deepest, darkest depths of Sufokia for days on end for a little 'alone time'. As for you, you can use it as a scuba-diving mask, but please try to stay afloat. We wouldn't want to have to call the rescue team out again.

13114.descriptionId: This belt was made so that Brouce Boulgoure could properly sway his hips whilst singing his favourite chorus: "Tsamina mina eh eh, Wabbit Wabbit eh eh, tsamina mina zangelewa, anawa aa, this time for Amakna".

13115.descriptionId: This ring has sharp extremities which allow the wearer to mark the trees that need felling. They say that after a heavy night on the juice, Brouce Boulgoure gently stroked the wings of his dear wife Kassiopee Baine with this ring, leaving her with beastly tree fell markings. Being the fiery character that she was, she took his axe without asking which, of course, then gave him a real reason to mash up her wings. The moral of the story? Don't get on the wrong side of a lumberjack.

13116.descriptionId: These boots were specially designed by Brouce Boulgoure, with the help of Hogmeiser and Bowisse who stumped down the ash and walnut trees. You don't even want to know about the side-effects they can have on your arse.

13117.descriptionId: Otomai is a well-known alchemist who created, among other things, the vaccination for myxomawosis. One of his less well-known theories is the controversial claim that Cawwots improve your sight. He might just be right, though - after all, have you ever seen a Wabbit wearing glasses?

13118.descriptionId: These boots, which used to belong to Otomai, the renowned alchemist, have sponge soles useful for absorbing and cleaning up liquids spilt on laboratory floors. They're a little heavy, but take it in your stride and it will save you paying a cleaner each month. Return on investment guaranteed within 248 years.

13119.descriptionId: This blade has sliced through numerous innocent creatures - all in the interest of science, of course!

13120.descriptionId: According to rumours, Danathor poisoned Rimaraf, Amayiro's best friend, with a cake made from deadly Blops. What a pleasant story to tell your kids at bed time; it'll certainly teach them never to accept anything from strangers... especially when it smells like Blop.

13121.descriptionId: On the base of this amulet is an abrasive rock that will epilate the entire abdomen of its wearer. The merchant that sold it to you must have forgotten to warn you not to sleep with it on.

13122.descriptionId: Danathor was chosen by Jiva to be Steward of Bonta. He was such a bent and manipulating fellow, however, that the populace thought that he'd have been much better suited to Brakmar.

13123.descriptionId: Allister was a shepherd. Then he founded the first-ever guild in the World of Twelve. He went on to capture the demon Esra'Ruoy'Dnim by forcing him to drink gobball blood and imprisoning him in Amakna. These efforts were enough to make Allister a well-respected and popular king. A fine example for the depraved youth of today who sit and play all day long and never set off on adventures of their own.

13124.descriptionId: This ring was given to Allister by his old friend Amayiro. The rumour-mongers of the village believe it hides a secret engraving, Allister's closest friends see it as a mark of unwavering friendship and the village idiots see it as, well, a ring.

13125.descriptionId: Allister used to hide his secret forceps in these boots. Rumour has it he used them to offer a helping hand when any of his Gobballs ever had trapped wind. He kept it for many years, and word on the street is that when he became King he used it on himself after the great feasts held in the Castle of Amakna!

13127.descriptionId: This cloak makes its wearer invisible, as soon as he hides in a dark cupboard. For extra stealth, move around with said dark cupboard.

13128.descriptionId: Lethaline Sigisbul is an Astrubian mercenary with no scruples. She sells her services to whoever is offering the best price. The size of your pouch shows that you're out of the running, my friend.

13129.descriptionId: Leather, heels and more hide. It's enough to make you go mad.

13130.descriptionId: Ogivol Scalarcin's generally aggressive temper led him to steal everything he came across and he was eventually condemned to six months' imprisonment for contempt of authority. Young Astrubians, however, see him as a modern hero, a revolutionary and a free thinker who stands up for the right to indefinite borrowing of other people's property.

13131.descriptionId: It's hard to tell whether the bones that make up Ogivol Scalarcin's Cloak are those of victims or just spare parts for the arthritic Sram.

13132.descriptionId: Every passing day sees Ogivol Scalarcin's bones move a little bit further apart. That's the arthritic punishment Xelor chose. This belt was pretty handy as it held all his bones in place when he was trying to dance the Kamarena.

13135.descriptionId: After you met him for the very first time, all frail and low-level, Metamunch Kin made a whispered promise to the Key Master: "If this one here completes a tour of the World, I'll eat my hat." It took some time, and getting it back into its original shape was some hefty work, but it was completely worth it.

13136.descriptionId: With your head inside this hat, never have the contents of a chest been so disappointing.

13137.descriptionId: Once you have equipped this belt it will become impossible to take off without the key. This explains why it's only worn by women with incredibly jealous husbands, by girls with worrying fathers and by you, for the good of humanity (you should think about throwing away that key).

13138.descriptionId: The key for this pendant doesn't open the Chesty Hat, the Chestity Belt, or even the Chesty Boots. It doesn't open any other lock that you have ever come across, for that matter. The only reason for it existing is to incite hope that one day it will serve some kind of purpose. A little bit like you.

13139.descriptionId: These boots are the safest boots in the World of Twelve. Pop them on your feet and you can be sure that nobody will steal your socks. Please note: toe-stubbing protection not included.

13140.descriptionId: When you smashed the Smiths' Chest to smithereens to get the loot hidden inside, you didn't even notice that the lock attached to it was never actually locked. Obviously, your motto that day was: act first, think second. Iop would be proud of you.

13153.descriptionId: This species of Orchid is eaten by Dragoturkeys during the lovey-dovey season. It's probably a good idea to make sure there aren't any males behind you when you bend down to pick one.

13155.descriptionId: Big and hairy, this item boasts all the characteristics of a perfect ear.

13156.descriptionId: This eye looks at you with a burning desire for vengeance.

13157.descriptionId: Too big to use as a lucky charm, too dirty to take pride of place on your mantelpiece... This is yet another item for you to stuff under your bed, amongst your dirty washing, to be lost for eternity.

13158.descriptionId: Once upon a time, all the kingdoms and dukedoms were fighting for independence... People of the same lands battled against one another, fighting to the death. Chaos reigned. Then, one day, a general assembled a troop of elite soldiers: 1000 men, ready for anything. These heroes strove to eliminate the fear in the World. With his army, the general succeeded in putting an end to the war. This shield, a symbol of true bravery and a reminder of those difficult times, is now awarded to the land's most courageous, gallant soldiers.

13165.descriptionId: This eiderdown duvet allows the Master to keep warm, even if it is as cold as ice in his library.

13167.descriptionId: Worn on your arm, this feather is sure to tickle someone's fancy.

13168.descriptionId: This tiny bone from the Minotot's skull isn't the strongest, but it has never been broken thanks to the featherweight brain that it's used to supporting.

13170.descriptionId: If you wear this amulet just underneath your chin, its small wings will help keep a spring in your step.

13171.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13172.descriptionId: When the Key Master explained, with a wide grin, that this completely and utterly useless helmet was the finest gift he could possibly offer you, you thought he was joking. First the Kin relic, and now this – don't you deserve a better reward for all your efforts?! Still, might as well try to work out all the dents, just in case.

13173.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

13174.descriptionId: The nostril-tickling fragrance of these droppings is very similar to the smell of pepper. Make sure you can tell them apart or you might just ruin your lunch!

13175.descriptionId: Within this collection, you'll find a series of engravings which illustrate one of Herdegrize the Mystic's works. It was printed in Astrub by a highly-respected Goblin. Yes, you heard right; a highly-respected Goblin!

13176.descriptionId: Within this collection, you'll find a series of engravings which illustrate one of Herdegrize the Mystic's works. It was printed in Astrub by a highly-respected Goblin. Yes, you heard right; a highly-respected Goblin!

13177.descriptionId: This substance is supposed to reveal all sorts of hidden things: texts written in invisible ink, unspeakable goings-on and deep, dark, hidden secrets. Use with caution. Avoid contact with eyes (contrary to all other powders!).

13178.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

13179.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

13180.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

13181.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

13182.descriptionId: The Karmeleon is just as stupid as an armoured dragoturkey, and even more useful! Some breeders claim that it is at the root of the khamelerost gene in dragoturkeys, although all attempts to get the two species to mate have failed resoundingly. Otomai might be behind this miracle creation, although he has yet to comment on the issue.

13183.descriptionId: This Karmeleon Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13184.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Karmeleon that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13187.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13188.descriptionId: This Coney will follow you around without dealing any heals. A bit like Astrubian tourists on Frigost.

13189.descriptionId: This potion is inexhaustible, much like an Enutrof woman.

13191.descriptionId: As any Wabbit will tell you - if you don't want to see red, avoid Myxomawosis like the plague.

13192.descriptionId: This spell will increase your talent with sausages. Ladies and gentleman the World over will now respect you that little bit more.

13195.descriptionId: This frozen experimental cream is made from animal gunk and is the latest creation from Bora the explorer. He has confirmed on many occasion that this cream can be used for anything, from dessert toppings for King Allister to lubing up the cogs of one of Count Harebourg's inventions. Metamunch Kin has already ordered an entire barrel full to use on his family relic.

13196.descriptionId: As well as being smoother than a Dragoturkey's bum cheeks and more resistant than an Enutrof's hairpiece, this leather is also an excellent insulator. That's probably why Frigostians use it to gag their wives, children and mothers-in-law.

13197.descriptionId: The cloak, the latest creation from Juss Tafinger, will help you brave the glacial temperatures on Frigost. Thick, hot and smelly... It takes you back to the days of Mama Bwork cuddles.

13198.descriptionId: This book bears the seal of the Astrub printers and is considered a holy book amongst Wabbits.

13199.descriptionId: This old document is covered in pictograms that are completely incomprehensible to a layman. Perhaps a Wabbit might help you get some sense out of it.

13200.descriptionId:
You can win these tokens by defeating Grozilla and Grasmera in their den on the island of Vulkania. 
If you collect 20 of these tokens, you can take them to Tina Ninopogot and swap them for a Krolimea.

13201.descriptionId: What's orange, makes you wince and burns holes in your lino? No, it's not a Prespic with a crankshaft...! If you're depressed, there's nothing better than a good swig of Fermented Cawwot Juice to put an end to all your worries. Consume diluted to avoid loss of sight and then life.

13202.descriptionId: If you're a townie it might be best not to try this Cawwot after twilight - you risk getting arrested by the Militia for noise pollution.

13203.descriptionId: This crate is loaded with copies of the Cawwot consumers' sacred book. Wawitna will be chuffed - he can teach his brothers all about peace... Or at worst, he might be able to create a weading society.

13204.descriptionId: This humongous syringe will be just right for taking a sample of Wawitna's blood.

13205.descriptionId: This sample contains enough blood to feed an army of Moskitos for a whole year.

13206.descriptionId: This tablet seems to react when you touch it. It must be the work of an ingenious inventor. Unfortunately, your fat sausage fingers don't work on it...

13207.descriptionId: This dark stone can't be trusted. In fact, it feels like he's somehow watching your every move... Nah, it's just a figment of your imagination... Right?

13208.descriptionId: An ingenious method of transport that would sell like hotcakes... if it worked, that is! Well, at least now you have a great zimmerframe, if nothing else!

13209.descriptionId: An elegant copper mask that will allow you to not only solder away to your heart's content, but also impress your friends with your metallic voice and blood-shot eyes. Try not to fall head over heels, you might just get a shock.

13210.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate boots. (You have to feed these living boots other boots. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

13211.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate cloaks. (You have to feed this living cloak other cloaks. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

13212.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate belts. (You have to feed this living belt other belts. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

13213.descriptionId: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate headgear. (You have to feed this living hat other hats. You can give it a fresh meal every 12 hours.)

13214.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13215.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13216.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13217.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13218.descriptionId: This item is reserved for tourists who actively participate in the competition between Vulkorog and Otamaisle. It can be exchanged for whatever tickles your fancy from Jennifer Engie and Clare Bonnet.

13219.descriptionId: You earned this scarf by competing for Otomaisle in the competition. If your team wins, 20 of these scarves will get you a special reward.

13220.descriptionId: You earned this scarf by competing for Vulkorog in the competition. If your team wins, 20 of these scarves will get you a special reward.

13221.descriptionId: Kick back and relax on a sandy beach, in the shade of a palm tree, Portation Corktail in hand. You'll really feel like you're somewhere else.

13222.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Pink Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

13223.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Golden Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

13224.descriptionId: You now believe you're a Pink Dragoone. The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13225.descriptionId: You now believe you're a Golden Dragoone. The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13226.descriptionId: The Hearts in this box were up for grabs... So, you grabbed! Their former owners probably won't find it in their hearts to forgive you.

13227.descriptionId: This message from Charlie's Agents has been stamped with the official seal and exudes a faint odour of cigars.

13229.descriptionId: These designs seem to describe the fabrication of an infernal, explosive machine. The word "Bombadaboom" is written in bold on each sheet in particularly bad handwriting.

13230.descriptionId: Fed up of the injust way of life on the archipelago of Vulkania, this creature has decided to follow you and strike out against all the sauroshells unlucky enough to cross its path.

13231.descriptionId: This Krolimea Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13232.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Krolimea that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13233.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Krolimea.

13234.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Krolimea. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13235.descriptionId: An Incandescent Sauroshell is like fire - you need to whack it when it's hot to get some good Shparks.

13236.descriptionId: You're not quite sure how Bo Pye wins trophies like this one week after week, considering he's a complete and utter loner. Anyway, he offered you one of his Cannonballs to thank you for your participation. It's the same colour as him and far more interesting to talk to.

13237.descriptionId: Rogues say that you can make a wicked bomb with this wick. It will probably shake the room too.

13238.descriptionId: Tick. Tock. Tick. Tock. There's an alarm clock inside this parcel, but something tells you that you don't want to be there when it goes off.

13239.descriptionId: This crystal is as shiny as it is fragile. Reduced to powder, it is sought-after by the Bontarian bourgeoisie as well as the dregs of Brakmar, who are usually on the lookout for get-rich-quick schemes.

13240.descriptionId:
This magical shield reflects the soul of your guild.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13241.descriptionId: At the time, keeping this tooth as a souvenir of your victory against Blam Stoker seemed like a good idea. In hindsight, it's pretty vile, even for a brute like you. After all, you're not a Bwork. Once you've finished your mission, get rid of this so-called trophy.

13242.descriptionId: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!

13243.descriptionId: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!

13244.descriptionId: Now you can jot down the different weights of the people that Bo Pye asked you to go and see. When you've finished you'll be able to reread everything you've noted and do lots of complicated maths. How lucky are you?!

13245.descriptionId: Where there is Arty, there is his cane. Legend has it that one end is coated in black treacle to attract herds of lost Gobballs. The other is supposedly splintered wood, just to get those Gobballs moving! You certainly won't want to get the wrong end of the stick on this one!

13246.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13247.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13248.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13251.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13252.descriptionId: The beloved tradition of swapping tales of bravery and danger over endless rounds of beer has led to more than one tragic death from alcohol abuse. The bearer of this ring can boast that they survived their harrowing adventures in every tavern in Amakna as long as their liver holds out.

13253.descriptionId: A shooting migraine takes hold of your head. You can't think straight, and make decisions at the speed of a bedridden Larva. You can still feel DuhBrane's piercing look. Next time, you might not want to show off so much in front of him... if there is a next time...

13254.descriptionId: After the hit that you just took you'll need a bit of time to rearrange your brains. But don't panic... Word on the street is you didn't have much to lose in the first place.

13255.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13256.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13257.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13259.descriptionId: Bo Pye has noted a name on the back of this playing card. It's a shame he writes like a Lousy Pig. Good luck trying to decipher his scribbles!

13261.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You can trade it in for a new item with Chaga Lachance at the Amakna Trading Counter.

13262.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You can trade it in for a new item with Chaga Lachance at the Amakna Trading Counter.

13263.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You might be able to get a few kamas for it from a kindly merchant.

13264.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You might be able to get a few kamas for it from a kindly merchant.

13265.descriptionId: This item has served its purpose well. You might be able to get a few kamas for it from a kindly merchant.

13266.descriptionId: They may not look very interesting, but these metal balls are a godsend for Foggernaut technomagi. Very light, they bob at medium depth and if you put one to your ear, you'll hear a funny sound. If you put one IN your ear, on the other hand, you won't hear anything at all.

13267.descriptionId: This little box seems to contain something toxic, judging by the almighty stench it gives off. If you've any sense at all, you'll give it to some unsuspecting fisherman to bait his net, but if you do insist on using it yourself, remember the old saying: "Add too much nasty bait in and ye might just go blind."

13268.descriptionId: Turn these straps upside down and you can use them as raunchy underwear for your pet octopus.

13269.descriptionId: After an epic battle, you finally captured the terrible creature from the blue lagoon. It was just an obese Snapper, of course, but you won't tell the grandchildren that.

13270.descriptionId: It's never easy to hold your guild's emblem high and proud when it's butt-ugly and neon green. With this potion you'll finally be able to give your guild that long-overdue makeover with a leader-of-men emblem.

13271.descriptionId: So, you've been on the receiving end of the bitterness and insecurity left over from your mother's own adolescence; you've spent a childhood believing that the only ambition worth following was to win a beauty contest; you've braved thousands of makeup sessions, heinous costumes and camera flashes... and you've been voted one of the beauties of your generation. Let's hope it was worth it!

13272.descriptionId: So, you've faced hundreds of hours of tortuous gym workouts; you've weight trained and fake tanned like your life depended on it; you've downed a raw egg milkshake every day, even on Kwismas... and you've been voted one of the hunks of your generation. Let's hope it was worth it!

13273.descriptionId: It's not exactly easy to take responsibility for the mistakes of your youth. A "brung" instead of a "brought", a "lellow" instead of "yellow", not forgetting "an Iop" instead of "a Iop". But hey, you could always just change your name... This potion will allow you to do just that.

13274.descriptionId: This unlucky Fogger took one gulp too many. All the more reason to use his empty skull as a cup!

13276.descriptionId: They say that eating Frozen Icefish makes you smarter. Yet another story told to young Sadidas to make them eat Icefish.

13278.descriptionId: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to your class temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

13279.descriptionId: This metallic disc is particularly heavy – no wonder it cost you so much. If you look at it closely, you'll see several minuscule grooves. You have no idea what it's for, but Ada Blablage's machine will know what to do with it. Deep down, you know this kind of item has no possible future.

13280.descriptionId: There are a few fragmented sentences printed on this paper in a language incomprehensible to most mortals - with the exception of Ada Blablage and LaeTux, of course. Fortunately, the information needed for Bo Pye to win his bet is pretty clear.

13281.descriptionId: There are a few fragmented sentences printed on this paper in a language incomprehensible to most mortals - with the exception of Ada Blablage and LaeTux, of course. Fortunately, the information needed for Bo Pye to win his bet is pretty clear.

13282.descriptionId: The stifling methane which fills up the Dragon Pig's Den almost cost you your life. All that's left to do is hope that its effects subside before the final encounter.

13283.descriptionId: If you breathe too much of the gas in the Dragon Pig's Den, you'll end up with wind poisoning.

13284.descriptionId: If you inhale too much of the gas in this room, you'll have to suffer the consequences...

13285.descriptionId: It's customary for Sufokians to dissolve these pearls in vinegar to make pickled pearls. There's no point in mixing them with your fish and chips as it ends up rather costly, hence them only coming to play on special occasions.

13286.descriptionId: You found these salt crystals in a shell. You were hoping for something else. Oh, life is so cruel...

13287.descriptionId: These freshly laid eggs taste best when sipped out of a ladle. If you wait a few weeks, you'll see that they grow into absolutely massive gobstoppers.

13288.descriptionId: Long considered no more than a type of wild grass, this cereal is the main ingredient used when making invigorating porridge. Consumed every morning, it'll help with internal plumbing issues as well as inopportune vapours that might arise throughout the day.

13289.descriptionId: This very heavy metal is mainly used for making diving helmets. It's also great when it comes to bringing down a party like a lead balloon, especially if you throw it at the musicians that are hitting bum notes all over the shop.

13290.descriptionId: Cut from dry branches, this rather dense wood is appreciated by superstitious sailors who think that, paradoxically, it warns of oncoming shipwrecks. This piece has been drifting for a long, long time.

13291.descriptionId: Foggernaut philosophy says that Kraloves are able to foretell the future. True or false? Whichever it is, the fact remains that many Sufokians have adopted these creatures and regularly consult their divinatory fish bowls before making important decisions. Some really wealthy Foggers even keep theirs in crystal balls!

13292.descriptionId: This five-leaf clover is so rebellious it even grows underground. Use it to season a warm soup and sit back and enjoy those cold, wet nights.

13293.descriptionId: This salty meat comes from those creatures that skinnydip at midnight. Don't pretend you haven't noticed them!

13294.descriptionId: Highly valued by clairvoyants, astrologists, oracles and those who want to look at the World a little differently... Jelly Juice tastes awful but offers wonderful insight when used as eye-drops. If a phoney asks you to ingest it, be careful - he might be planning to use your insides to see into the future.

13295.descriptionId: This Hot Staff, often used as a dumbbell by the show-offy warriors of the World, is sought high and low on Pandala. It's fairly rare to come by so you'll want to hold on to this one - the carvers have a shortage of the raw materials needed to make it and consequently the ecosystem is gravely suffering.

13296.descriptionId: O'Basan was an Enutrofette who was convinced that her magic spade made her shrink at unexpected moments, allowing her to understand animals. Unfortunately, she couldn't think of any "magical" excuses for her crumbling bones, severe deafness and deteriorating sight that stopped her from recognising her friends and family.

13297.descriptionId: The metallic pieces on this ring are folded inwards on the inside for maximum comfort. You can use a common stapler and a band of paper to make a similar ring at home for much cheaper, but it's not recommended for non-Sacriers.

13298.descriptionId: You were right to break that habit of ring-gnawing. At least if you have a lapse, this ring will stop you putting on too much weight.

13299.descriptionId:
This cloak is the ideal garment for a late night. It'll keep you buzzing into the early hours and will probably send your enemies raving mad.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13300.descriptionId:
Wearing this cloak is the best thing to get your enemies drooling with envy.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13301.descriptionId: These boots, made out of leftover soup ingredients, were a gift from Auntie Cranny. Waste not, want not is all very well, but for a couple of days now you've been sure there are maggots crawling around between your toes...

13302.descriptionId: Typical footwear for big-hooped, gum-chewing, female Gobbowl fans, these boots are ideal for training in. They're usually enough to make someone start a fight with you themselves, but on slow days, you can always speed things up by chucking them into the enemy camp.

13303.descriptionId: They say that if you wear this belt and say the magic words "Time for bed, time for bed" in the most ridiculous voice ever, you'll be transported to a magical world. It'll also make everyone around you point and laugh.

13304.descriptionId: This scaly belt is very trendy and rather powerful but can only be used in certain situations. At the smallest sign of danger its wearer is overcome by an irrepressible desire to snap at everyone around him. Not suitable when in the company of Crocodyls.

13305.descriptionId: This hat will make you want to run through the town in your nightwear. For the crazy, lazy fool that you are, that doesn't change much, so why not try putting it on your head when facing adversaries?

13306.descriptionId: Nobody's figured out why, but when small, ginger, chubby, whiskered, very hairy adventurers with abnormally large pupils and funny accents put on this hat, they suddenly change in the eyes of women from the "definitely do not approach under any circumstances" type to the "aww can I stroke it??" type. Wonders never cease!

13308.descriptionId:
(Double-click to learn the spell) 
This scroll will teach Foggernauts the class spell 'Breakwater'.

13314.descriptionId: Contrary to the fake ones that one might find at the Trool Fair, this balloon won't deflate and will follow you no matter the danger. It was made by hand out of pet shadows and good old-fashioned Astrubian fish glue, using the traditional recipe by Berry Pills.

13316.descriptionId: This gift contains a randomly selected special Krosmaster reward. Open it, quick!

13317.descriptionId: This gift contains a randomly selected special Krosmaster reward. Open it, quick!

13318.descriptionId:
With this snug hat on your head, you feel as airy-fairy as a goddess of light. Of course, to everyone else, you just look like an albino Boowolf cub.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13319.descriptionId:
It's said that the hem of this cape makes flowers bloom wherever it skims along the ground, even in the most desolate landscapes. Oddly enough, when you're the one wearing it, these flowers wilt immediately. Must be something to do with your armpit hygiene.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13320.descriptionId: This ring also works as a magic paintbrush. Just wave your hand and magnificent lines will appear from nowhere! Obviously, waving your hands everywhere also makes you look like an absolute nutter. The choice is yours: do you want to be an artist of genius, or hang onto the few friends who aren't already embarrassed to be seen with you?

13321.descriptionId: Whilst shoemaking critics (yes, they exist) consider these boots to be the crowning point of their art, you're inclined to see them as proof that art definitely doesn't exist in this day and age.

13322.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13323.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13324.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13325.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13326.descriptionId: It's a shame the lights aren't on upstairs - you'd make a pretty little lantern!

13327.descriptionId: Al Howin stuck the Pumpkwin seeds onto the back of this cape himself. He wanted to plant Pumpkwins all over the World in order to spread his curse. Whilst you're waiting for that to happen, why don't you have a nibble - they're most nutritious!

13328.descriptionId: Al Howin wore this cursed belt religiously until the day it came to life and started attacking all the the other belts it came across, whether they were attached to waists or not. As you can imagine, the whole thing was rather embarrassing for Al Howin and gave him quite a reputation.

13329.descriptionId: Al Howin has such dishevelled hair that anybody would think that it was him that'd been raked over the coals!

13330.descriptionId: This token proves your devotion to the Meridia, the Keepers of the Days listed in the Almanax. You can exchange it by going to see Xanamla... Or you can guard it with your life like a dragon perched on a pile of gold and precious stones.

13331.nameId: Born under the Sign of Gobball
13331.descriptionId:
You've decided to free your inner Gobtubby for the whole World to see. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13332.descriptionId: If you're the type to claim that the signs of the Doziak mean nothing at all, then you've obviously never drunk an Astromagical Potion... Have you always dreamt of looking like one born under the sign of Gobball? Well, now's your chance! The effects of this potion will wear off if you enter a fight.

13333.descriptionId: This key will allow you to get into Al Howin's Vegetable Patch, but only during Pumpkwin season (one month starting from the day that Al Howin touches back down in Amakna).

13334.descriptionId: This is what will happen to your teeth if you eat too many treats on Al Howin's Day, kiddywinkles!

13335.descriptionId: Sideburns were banned on the Amaknian continent at the same time as Al Howin. They're now considered even more of an atrocity than Al's famous curse.

13336.descriptionId: If you plant these seeds and wait a few months, you'll soon see a horde of Cursed Pumpkwins come at you, snapping for your head. Why aren't they very popular again...?

13337.nameId: Gobball - Signs of the Doziak I
13337.descriptionId: If you were born between the 21st of Martalo and the 20th of Aperirel, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13338.descriptionId: This smoke machine is supposed to be the cause of the mist that constantly surrounds the Zoth Village and the Canopy. Some people say that Zoth Disciples' heads are all full of mist too, but nobody dares say that to their faces.

13339.descriptionId: This fake but very real-looking seal might just help out those that aren't too bothered about having the real deal. Getting caught with this seal will result in a century of imprisonment.

13340.descriptionId: Mixed with stale beer, this slobber will heal all of your ailments, including unhappiness.

13342.descriptionId: This tattoo comes from some unfortunate beefcake. It seems to have been bitten off... It's no doubt a souvenir taken by a sentimental murderer.

13343.descriptionId: This knot is very popular with sailors and will win the hearts of young girls who dream of adventure.

13344.descriptionId: This Dofus changes colour with the seasons. The warm gold it displays in the summer gives way to a glacial chill as winter sets in. They say it was laid by a dragon who fell in love with a pedlar who stopped by its cave to flog an out-of-date calendar.

13345.descriptionId: If you pray to the Meridia every day, then Antyklime Ax will give you a calendar page for each day that passes. Keep them safe: when the year's up, you'll be able to reap the rewards of your devotion. That means you can't use them to light camp fires, note down lottery numbers, peel vegetables or do any other shameful deeds.

13346.nameId: Born under the Sign of Minotoror
13346.descriptionId:
You've decided to free your inner Minimino for the whole World to see. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13347.nameId: Born under the Sign of Bworkette
13347.descriptionId:
You've decided to free your inner Bworky for the whole World to see.
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13348.nameId: Born under the Sign of Bow Meow
13348.descriptionId:
You've decided to free your inner Tabby Bow Meow for the whole World to see. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13349.nameId: Born under the Sign of Snapper
13349.descriptionId:
You've decided to free your inner Grauler for the whole World to see. 
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

Have you always dreamt of looking like one born under the sign of Minotoror? Well, now's your chance! The effects of this potion will wear off if you enter a fight.
