13353.descriptionId: If you're the type to claim that the signs of the Doziak mean nothing at all, then you've obviously never drunk an Astromagical Potion... Have you always dreamt of looking like one born under the sign of Snappers? Well, now's your chance! The effects of this potion will wear off if you enter a fight.

13354.nameId: Minotoror - Signs of the Doziak II
13354.descriptionId: If you were born between the 21st of Aperirel and the 19th of Maysial, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13355.nameId: Dopples - Signs of the Doziak III
13355.descriptionId: If you were born between the 20th of Maysial and the 21st of Junssidor, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13356.nameId: Craboral - Signs of the Doziak IV
13356.descriptionId: If you were born between the 22nd of Junssidor and the 21st of Jullier, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13357.nameId: Bow Meow - Signs of the Doziak V
13357.descriptionId: If you were born between the 22nd of Jullier and the 23rd of Frauguctor, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13358.nameId: Bworkette - Signs of the Doziak VI
13358.descriptionId: If you were born between the 24th of Frauguctor and the 22nd of Septangel, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13359.nameId: Kilibriss - Signs of the Doziak VII
13359.descriptionId: If you were born between the 23rd of Septangel and the 22nd of Octolliard, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13360.nameId: Scurvion - Signs of the Doziak VIII
13360.descriptionId: If you were born between the 23rd of Octolliard and the 21st of Novamaire, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13361.nameId: Centoror - Signs of the Doziak IX
13361.descriptionId: If you were born between the 22nd of Novamaire and the 21st of Descendre, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13362.nameId: Seadragon - Signs of the Doziak X
13362.descriptionId: If you were born between the 22nd of Descendre and the 20th of Javian, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13363.nameId: Puddly - Signs of the Doziak XI
13363.descriptionId: If you were born between the 21st of Javian and the 18th of Flovor, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13364.nameId: Snappers - Signs of the Doziak XII
13364.descriptionId: If you were born between the 19th of Flovor and the 20th of Martalo, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

13365.descriptionId: This little pebble is warm in spring, hot in summer, cool in autumn and icy cold in winter. Some people refuse flat out to believe that this is possible, whilst others spend as long marvelling at it as they do choosing their first set.

13366.descriptionId: This pebble is named for the curious light that it gives off, which makes it look like the moon. It doesn't glow in the dark, so there's no point taking it with you for your midnight encounters.

13367.descriptionId: Please make sure nobody ever throws this pebble at your head. Not only will it leave a nasty bump; it could also give you sunburn.

13368.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Be Cold emote. You'll be able to play it cool thanks to the refreshing breath of Inooni, the Meridia of Frost.

13369.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Kowtow emote. It's very handy for kneeling in front of the altars in the Almanax Sanctuary, or to curry favour with your guild leader.

13370.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Be Hot emote. No doubt Troyle, the Meridia of Hot Flushes, will be pleased to see you as red as a Strawberry Jelly.

13371.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Flex Muscles emote. Finally, you'll be able to impress Eltruteht, the Meridia of Muscles, and show off your biceps in front of the puny runts in Astrub.

13372.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Read a Map emote. Sad, the Meridia of the Sense of Direction, has showed you the way. Now use it wisely!

13376.descriptionId:
Some Wabbits say that the Wa starved his subjects, going so far as to pull Cawwots clean out of the jaws of hungry Tiwabbits. One day, the unhappy citizens rebelled and took up arms. This shield now symbolises their revolution. Of course, they hadn't realised just how cruel His Majesty Barf I could be. The rebellious rodents all ended up in a stew.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13418.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Raised Fist emote.

13419.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Thumb Your Nose emote.

13420.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Draw Attention emote.

13421.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Mum's The Word emote.

13422.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Rub Hands emote.

13423.descriptionId: Captain Chafer's real panties, which were very tight and very leathery, disappeared along with their owner. Luckily for us, the famous tango dancer left behind various pairs of worn undies that perverse tailors were able to use for inspiration. This pair of Spare Panties has a comfortable, elasticated waistband and an affordable pricetag. It's even reversible, so you can use it twice (or four times)!

13424.descriptionId: Ere be th' hat of Ol' John, th' great grand sailor o' th' 107 oceans! Legend says that his parrot died 'ere yonder one stormy, stormy night. Ever since that fateful eve, any hearty who puts on this topper starts talking a little like Ol' John did himself.

13425.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13426.descriptionId: This bag contains an item stolen from an honest citizen of the City of Mercenaries. You should take it to Oremor, a Sram that celebrated the Night of the Bandeads by raiding rooms and taking what he pleased. Now he has to make sure that everything is returned safely. Oh yeah, and if you keep the loot, you won't be able to set foot in Astrub without suffering the wrath of the Council. There's no doubt about it; scavenging adventurers who count on free generosity only end up regretting it.

13427.descriptionId: These quivers have been kept in a humid environment. They're mouldier than... than... than something really mouldy!

13428.descriptionId: The leather of these quivers is as dry as the tongue of a talkative Enutrof.

13429.descriptionId: The tenacious odour emanating from these quivers reminds you of your stepmother's perfume...

13430.descriptionId: Hastily replaced arrows ended up destroying the skins of these quivers. Hey... at least it wasn't your skin!

13431.descriptionId: The strands of long-haired leather and the fresh blood stains that adorn this club show that it's been used recently.

13432.descriptionId: A hammer is used to smash in nails. A club is used to smash in heads.

13433.descriptionId: This piece of ballasted hardwood gives more weight to its user's arguments.

13434.descriptionId: This easy-to-use club will help you tie your enemies up in knots.

13435.descriptionId: Tirkortritt loves Al Howin's Day tricks. To share his joy and love for this special day, he has decided to scatter surprise gifts all around. Trikortritt is a joker and a disciple of Asid, the god of Fear. Who knows what he could have hidden in this box?

13436.descriptionId: This treat was hidden in Trikortritt's surprise box. Its taste (a mixture of Cawwot, Pumpkwin and Orange Larva juice) is a delight to children, parents and even dentists.

13437.descriptionId:
It looks like you've been Trikortritted! Even your own mother won't recognise you!
Fortunately, the effect will wear off once you enter a fight.

13438.descriptionId:
Today, you have decided to be most disgusting in the land. Thanks to the makeover proposed by Our Miss Triste, you managed to make all your wishes come true. Ah yes, careful what you wish for!
Fortunately, the effect will wear off once you enter a fight.

13439.descriptionId:
Today, you have decided to be the ugliest in the land. Thanks to the makeover proposed by Our Miss Triste, you managed to make all your wishes come true. Ah yes, careful what you wish for!
Fortunately, the effect will wear off once you enter a fight.

13440.descriptionId: Being ugly does have its advantages. This curse will allow you to inflict more damage in your next fights.

13441.descriptionId: What's good about the Al Howin festivities is that it's not just good kiddywinkles that get treats. The sweet that you just greedily gobbled down will increase the experience you receive for 5 fights.

13442.descriptionId: This potion will allow you to teleport to the Temple of Scriptures, otherwise known as the Almanax Sanctuary. Now you have no excuse to not make an offering!

13443.descriptionId: This lollipop will increase your Intelligence by 50 points and reduce your Vitality by 100 points for one fight.

13444.descriptionId: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

13445.descriptionId: This lollipop will increase your Strength by 50 points and reduce your Vitality by 100 points for one fight.

13446.descriptionId: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

13447.descriptionId: This lollipop will increase your Agility by 50 points and reduce your Vitality by 100 points for one fight.

13448.descriptionId: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

13449.descriptionId: This lollipop will increase your Chance by 50 points and reduce your Vitality by 100 points for one fight.

13450.descriptionId: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

13451.descriptionId: These sweets will increase your Power by 100 points and reduce your Vitality by 200 points for one fight.

13452.descriptionId: Al Howin force-fed his Devhorror Cheweez to make it more powerful. Not only did it work, but its mouth became so saturated in sugar and cariogenic bacteria that even its gentlest bite can make your teeth fall out. This treat will dramatically increase your Power in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

13453.descriptionId: A Borbkin will follow you until your next fight.

13454.descriptionId: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Borbkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.

13455.descriptionId: A Toadkin will follow you until your next fight.

13456.descriptionId: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Toadkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.

13457.descriptionId:
With this cape on your back, you can finally fly with your own wings. If you don't have wings, you'll be up a creek. Which can be quite nice as long as you have a paddle.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13458.descriptionId:
Your enemies will find you adorable; you'll remind them of childhood memories. But rest assured, they'll kill you all the same.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13459.descriptionId: This amulet generates magical interference that changes the way your vocal cords work and forces you to sing "Di di di di di". Unfortunately, that sounds awfully like the Kidos' wedding march. It's never too late to learn how to lay an egg.

13460.descriptionId: This coloured ring will remind you of your naive and worry-free youth, when your arms were covered in multicoloured bracelets from market stalls. Fashion spares no man.

13461.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13462.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13463.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13464.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13465.descriptionId: The Boarhog is the common boar's sturdier, friendlier cousin. As long as you let it truffle around after Tanukis, it'll be more than happy to carry all the stuff that won't fit in your already-bulging pockets for you (and you thought it looked big on the outside!).

13467.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to learn this emote.)
Use this scroll to learn how to shake it in the dark to make it glow. It works in the daytime too, although it's much less effective. We're talking about shaking your Pumpkwin Head... You know that, right?

13468.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13469.descriptionId:
The legendary Dal-Uk-Wet, who unified the Kingdom of Hispañia, had a magic shield. Sir-Dal, his great-grandson, had a few copies forged to reward the best warriors of Hispañia. This shield is one of these few copies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13470.descriptionId: This token is awarded to people who've run into misfortune through no fault of their own. That's right: for once, it wasn't your fault! Take it to Sorim Ait at the Amakna Castle Zaap (3,-5) to exchange it for something nice.

13471.descriptionId: Not to be confused with the consolation prizes you're so used to, this gift has been given to you to make up for the inconvenience you suffered. Inside, you'll find 30 Compensokens that you can exchange with Sorim Ait at the Amakna Castle Zaap (3,-5).

13472.descriptionId: This candy will increase your Prospecting by 100 points for one fight.

13473.descriptionId: This candy will grant you a Prospecting bonus of 100 points for your next fight.

13474.descriptionId: This sweet will increase experience you receive for one fight.

13475.descriptionId: This sweet will increase the experience you receive during your next fight.

13476.descriptionId: This Boarhog Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13477.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Boarhog.

13478.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Boarhog. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13479.descriptionId: This potion is one of the most powerful an alchemist can craft and its recipe was jealously guarded by the oldest among them. When asked about it, they had a tendency to complicate the recipe, saying that it needed resources that were simply impossible to find just to discourage competition.

13480.descriptionId: Don't fancy equipping the Arachelmet? Then you're not going to like the Hairy Arachelmet! It's lined with Arachnee web, sewn together with threads of the stuff and perfumed with pheromones in such a way that an amorous Arachnee will always be following you. It might be better offering it to an Arachneephobe; they'll either overcome their fear, or die from terror. Either way, it's for their own good.

13481.descriptionId: Plerti the Xelor is the author of numerous theories on time travel. This cylinder is his last experiment's prototype. Just one problem: he needs Meridian magic to make it work... Antyklime Ax will be able to tell you more at the Almanax Sanctuary.

13482.descriptionId: This gift is offered as compensation for a problem in DOFUS. You can use it on any character, but only those that haven't finished the Year of the Dragon (Dolmanax) quest and have fewer than 365 Calendar Pages can be awarded one. You can collect your reward from Antyklime Ax.

13483.descriptionId:
This hat will allow you to hide your biggest secret: that you too have a "super-deformed" head.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13484.descriptionId:
This cape was specially designed to hide the flabby builder's bum that peeps out of your trousers when you bend over to pick stray kamas off the ground.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13485.descriptionId: This belt's buckle has a little slot in the top for you to keep your GG points. Unfortunately, your local shoemaker attached that piece upside down, probably because he knew you were going to make a habit of losing.

13486.descriptionId: It doesn't matter if you can't give your enemies a kicking in Krosmaster tournaments; with these boots on, you can take it out on monsters in fights instead!

13487.descriptionId: This towel can be used for beach tanning, rubbing down sandy-skinned Sadidas or soaking up Ecaflip gambling debts. It's so absorbant it would also make a great mop.

13488.descriptionId: This atrophied wing won't give you the power to fly, nor can you use it to knock out your enemies. It is, however, the perfect prosthetic for Eniripsa who have torn their own wings.

13489.descriptionId: The reflection that you see in this mirror is deformed by your darkest thoughts. Another reason to believe that beauty isn't on the inside.

13491.descriptionId: Several stories explain how this relic was passed down from generation to generation. Is it a cursed pasta necklace made by a schoolchild for Mother's Day, knicker elastic stolen from a grave by a tomb profaner, or a fossilised bogey rosary? Only an expert will be able to tell you that.

13492.descriptionId: This vicious little flea has just one purpose in life: spread the ugliest illnesses. It particularly likes silky fur and Ecaflip cards.

13494.descriptionId: Some years ago, swimmers participating in the Krozolympiks decided to fix Snapper fins onto their swimming costumes to improve their performance. Following a rather painful accident where one of the athletes put on his trunks the wrong way around, this technique has been strictly forbidden. All those who want to break the rules, go get changed!

13495.descriptionId: According to the Reapalaks, Adventurer Skulls are better than Kaliptus Wood in two ways: they can be harvested all year long without causing deforestation and they are just as hard. Whether you use it as a decorative ornament or as building material for sinister edifices, you can't deny that this is a fantastic item.

13496.descriptionId: This accessory, appreciated amongst pirates, can be used as an eye-patch, a nose-patch or a privates-patch, depending on the size and occasion.

13499.descriptionId: What kind of Iop brains would let a child play with a toy like this?

13502.descriptionId: Glacial Fluid, which is much loved by practical jokers, is also useful for cooling down the rampant ardour of randy Wabbits and Dragostesses with a little too much fire in their bellies.

13503.descriptionId: There's no better way to steady your nerves than by taking a puff or two from a peace pipe such as this one. An old legend says that the clouds that float in the sky were actually created by the accumulation of smoke from the Zoth Village.

13505.descriptionId: To your great disappointment, there aren't any kamas in this pouch. It contains a few scraps of lead, a handful of peculiarly shaped dice and an old pencil with the rubber half chewed off. Probably the elements required for some kind of suspicious, demonic ritual.

13506.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Piwi emote. Mylka's disciples use it just after leaping off cliffs and just before crashing dismally in a cloud of dust.

13507.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Cheer On emote. Totot, the Meridia of Enthusiasm, is always telling people to share their joy with the World rather than keeping it bottled up, so feel free to jump around and get the troops psyched up. Waahoooo!

13508.descriptionId: The tasty doughnut you just wolfed down will increase the experience you receive for 5 fights.

13509.descriptionId: You found this doughnut inside a Party Bag, and it looks so good that you're drooling. Go on, hang the diet and scoff the lot! You can shrug off your spare tyre next time the Brakmarathon comes round.

13510.descriptionId:
Judging by your protruding yellow stomach, you've opened up a Party Bag.
Your disguise looks great, but don't get in a flap: when you enter a fight, it will disappear.

13512.descriptionId: What could be inside this Party Bag? The only way to find out is to take a deep breath and open it up...!

13513.descriptionId:
That hearty swig of Ayerish Kaffee's special Grinness hasn't made you sick as such, but you're looking kind of green nonetheless. Watch out for gardeners and hedge-trimmers, who probably have it in for you.
The leafy effects responsible for your current condition will release their hold on you as soon as you enter a fight.

13514.descriptionId: Ayerish Kaffee's fermented Grinness isn't all bad, you know. Its special blessing will make you more resistant for your next fights.

13515.descriptionId: This extra-fine flour can be used to make pancakes, but also bread and other pastry delights. But can it be fearlessly consumed?

13516.descriptionId: These grains form the base for various Amaknian dishes. You might want to make sure that they haven't been poisoned, however.

13517.descriptionId: If you roll this squidgy dough into a tight little ball, you can use it to mop up sauce from your dinner plate or plug your ears when rowdy youths start playing their god-awful music on the bus.

13518.descriptionId: A little face-lift never hurt no one. Because we're all worth it!

13519.descriptionId: And there we have it! You've been transformed into a pistachio-coloured Chocobwak. Try not to get into flap when you realise what you look like.

13520.descriptionId: Some people believe that you shouldn't put all of your eggs in one basket but that's not to say you can't shamelessly hoard them in your inventory!

13521.descriptionId: Legend says that the recipe of this chewy little bar is kept secret by the god Rabmarac. Nobody can resist the authentic taste, nor the painstaking humour of the joke that can be found on the inside of the wrapper.

13522.descriptionId: This chewy bar will light up the cheeks of girls and boys alike. Want to know why? Maybe it's because of the Rabmajoke written on the inside of the wrapper, but we can't be sure...

13523.descriptionId: To be consumed in moderation, especially when you're in a hurry. Take the time to read the joke on the inside of the wrapper - it'd be a real shame to miss out on it...!

13524.descriptionId: It is said that Nitsougnal absolutely loves this chewy little sweet. Given its colour, that's probably to be expected, but he also loves the hilarious joke written on the inside of the wrapper.

13525.descriptionId: John Pesterton wanted to recreate the taste of his Cocalane and pop it into a chewy treat. The god Rabmarac is no stranger to the fact that the so-say miraculous drink invented by the alchemist was none other than a bad joke. Whatever happens, if the taste of this Kola bar has been imitated, the Rabmajoke that's written on the inside of the wrapper is unimitable.

13526.descriptionId: This chewy bar is reserved for dungeon guardians only. Any monster able to swallow one whole will be abandoned in the arena at the mercy of cruel and avid adventurers. Before passing away, the carefree creature is allowed to read the Rabmajoke written on in the inside of the wrapper just to get one last laugh out of life.

13527.descriptionId:
"What cheese do you use to encourage a Celestial Bearbarian?
Camembert!"

13528.descriptionId: These buds will nip you in the bud!

13529.descriptionId: This leaf is as soft as an Eniripsa's hands. It's unfortunate that its odour is more like that of a retired Foggernaut's diving suit.

13530.descriptionId:
"What do you call cheese that isn't yours?
Nacho cheese."

13531.descriptionId:
"What does cheese say to itself in the mirror?
Halloumi."

13532.descriptionId:
"Why are Prancing Chimeras so happy?
Because they eat what bugs them!"

13533.descriptionId:
"What's the nicest thing a Kanniball can say to a girl?
You look good enough to eat!"

13534.descriptionId:
"Why do Masqueraiders have such a hard time making friends?
Because they're always two-faced."

13535.descriptionId:
"How do you get out of the Asse Sea?
Wet!"

13536.descriptionId:
"What does Alit Elfminate say when a customer gets too demanding?
Suit yourself!"

13537.descriptionId:
Why did the vampire's lunch give him heartburn?
-	It was a stake sandwich.

13538.descriptionId:
"What do you give a sick Piwi?
Tweetment."

13539.descriptionId:
"How does a Pingwin build its house?
Igloos it together!"

13540.descriptionId:
"What's the most musical part of a Cheeken?
The drumstick."

13541.descriptionId:
"If you had 8 Apis in one hand, and 5 Apis in the other, what would you have?
Really big hands!"

13542.descriptionId:
"What's orange and sounds a bit like a parrot?
A Cawwot!"

13543.descriptionId:
"Why did Kelog Hornflex stop making doughnuts?
He was bored with the hole business!"

13544.descriptionId:
"What is the librarian Hippolyte Thermia's favourite vegetable?
Quiet peas!"

13545.descriptionId:
"What do Ghasts eat on Al Howin's Day?
Ghoulash!"

13546.descriptionId:
"Why can't you starve on Otomai Island?
Because of the sand which is there."

13547.descriptionId:
"What do you give a sick Boar?
Oink-ment."

13548.descriptionId:
"What do you call a legless Bow Wow?
You don't. You have to go and get it yourself!"

13549.descriptionId:
"What did the Flax Flower say to the Edelweiss?
What's up, bud?"

13550.descriptionId: "A hungry Sufokian goes to a restaurant in Madrestam and asks: 'Do you serve crabs here?' The owner replies, 'We serve everyone, sir.'"

13551.descriptionId:
"What do you get if you divide the circumference of a Pumpkwin by its diameter?
Pumpkwin Pi!"

13552.descriptionId:
"What do you call a girl with a Prancing Chimera on her head?
Lily!"

13553.descriptionId:
"How do Treechnids get on the Internet?
They log in!"

13554.descriptionId:
"How do you know if the YeCh'Ti is under your bed?
Your nose touches the ceiling!"

13555.descriptionId:
"What has one hundred heads and one hundred tails?
One hundred kamas."

13556.descriptionId:
"What always comes at the end of Fanks Givingue?
The letter 'e'!"

13557.descriptionId:
"What's the best method of transport at Fleaster time?
Itch-hiking!"

13558.descriptionId:
"Why is Jon Lemon always so cool?
Because he has so many fans!"

13559.descriptionId:
"What's the most musical part of a Kittenfish?
The scales!"

13560.descriptionId:
"How many months have 28 days?
All of them."

13561.descriptionId:
"Why did the Iopette sit on the clock?
To be on time!"

13562.descriptionId:
"What smells the best at a Fanks Guivingue dinner?
Your nose!"

13563.descriptionId:
"Why are Vampyres tough to get along with?
Because they can be a pain in the neck!"

13564.descriptionId:
"How do you fix a Worm-O'-Lantern?
With a Pumpkwin patch!"

13565.descriptionId:
"What do Frigostians eat for lunch?
Ice berg-gers!"

13566.descriptionId:
"How does a Pingwin make pancakes?
With its flippers!"

13567.descriptionId:
"What is a Prancing Chimera's favourite cold drink?
Croak-a-cola!"

13568.descriptionId:
"Why did Kerub run from the tree?
Because he was afraid of the bark!"

13569.descriptionId:
"Two antennas met on a roof, fell in love and got married. The ceremony wasn't much...
But the reception was excellent."

13570.descriptionId:
"What do Bow Wows eat at the cinema?
Pupcorn."

13571.descriptionId:
"How do Foggernauts like their vegetables?
Steamed!"

13572.descriptionId: "There are two Catbreads baking in the oven. One says to the other, 'By Ecaflip, it's hot in here!' The second replies, 'Holy Crab! A talking Catbread!'"

13573.descriptionId:
"What's an Osamodas's favourite food?
Whipped cream!"

13574.descriptionId:
"What kind of book does a Wabbit like to read?
One with a hoppy ending!"

13575.descriptionId:
"What's stupider than a Iop?
Several Iops!"

13576.descriptionId:
What's the difference between a babbage leaf and a bogey?
You'd never convince a goblin to eat a babbage leaf!

13577.descriptionId: This cristalline horn contains 5 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller but will keep its shape and size in the cold.

13578.descriptionId: This cristalline horn contains 4 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, yet even if it's been used, it'll still be an acceptable shape and size.

13579.descriptionId: This cristalline horn contains 3 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.

13580.descriptionId: This cristalline horn contains 2 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.

13581.descriptionId: This cristalline horn contains the last dose of a powerful healing philter. Once it's been used, there'll be nothing left of it. You'll need to find a bigger Unikron Horn if you're planning on impressing the apprentice alchemists.

13582.descriptionId: These magnificent slippers are a perfect excuse to dance. They can be worn with a tutu, or with other garments if you're worried about looking ridiculous.

13583.descriptionId: This wand looks very much like a Great Sweet Gum branch, the mythical tree that grows in the Jellith Dimension. So much so, that it's hard to tell them apart. It's probably for that very reason that it attracts sweet, trembling little Strawberry Jellies.

13584.descriptionId: This chest, worn like a bag, is an incredibly practical invention. Unfortunately, it seems that it attracts young Koalaks and other undesirables. Only adventurers with strong shoulders should consider using it without being dogged with bad luck.

13585.descriptionId: Despite its mariney ways, this curious Snapper can only be caught in freshwater. Fishermen say it is endowed with various powers, including that of making skin oily and shiny.

13586.descriptionId: This Magic Snapper can now be used as an ingredient.

13587.descriptionId: There is certainly something fishy going on... Fortunately, the effects will wear off as soon as you enter a fight.

13588.descriptionId: A promising dish that will pleasantly surprise your taste buds... Once you get over the fishy smell, that is!

13589.descriptionId: They say that the first Pyrofuegos were particularly magnificent. Since the fires they caused were equally spectacular, explosives manufacturers saw their sales drop. They had to do something and so now spectators can stand and marvel before these beautiful lights with no fear of danger.

13592.descriptionId: This very special fishing rod can only be used by experienced fishermen. Use it to catch Magic Snappers. Don't expect to catch Perch or Bass.

13596.descriptionId: Wild Enutrofs love to wear coats made of Golden Larva Skin because it makes them feel rich.

13602.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Boarhog that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13603.descriptionId: The Razorbuck is one of the oldest Boars in the World of Twelve. A legendary fighter who's considered a god by little porklings, it has always been a perfect role model and has spent a large part of its life keeping its long-time enemies, the Pandits, in check. It feeds on the souls of Kozaru, warriors it respects for their strength.

13604.descriptionId: This Razorbuck Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13605.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Razorbuck that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13606.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Razorbuck.

13607.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your petsmount. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13608.descriptionId: No, these aren't Bow Meow hairs, but Ecaflip hairs. And not just any Ecaflip... They grew on the illustrious Kerub Crepin himself. It's highly unlikely that he'll be asking for them back so it's completely up to you to decide what you want to do with them.

13609.descriptionId: According to Kerub Crepin, there are dangerous magical items kept inside this crate. Judging by the creaking noises and acrid smoke pouring from it, we'd probably say he's right.

13610.descriptionId:
You think you're a Kwismas Snowball all of a sudden.
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13611.descriptionId:
You think you're a Kwismas Crackler. Well, at least you'll be able to pop some ice cubes in your Cocalane.
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13612.descriptionId:
You think you're a Kwismas Sakai and have a crazy urge to gulp down a few Cheekens whole.
The illusion will disintegrate if you enter a fight.

13613.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowball. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

13614.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of an Ice Crackler. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

13615.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Sakai Firefoux. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

13616.descriptionId: This pastry is much more pleasant when it's not fighting back! Beware of its side effects, though...

13617.descriptionId: Sometimes, a Kwismas Pastry needs an extra grilling. Have a bite of this one; it'll keep you on your toes.

13618.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13619.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13620.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13621.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13622.descriptionId: This is what happens to oranges when you leave them in the snow for too long. Much like shy young men when approached by pretty young women, they undergo a shocking colour change.

13623.descriptionId: This is what happens to oranges when you leave them in the snow for too long. Much like shy young men when approached by pretty young women, they undergo a shocking colour change.

13624.descriptionId: This potion will allow you to teleport to Kerub Crepin's house in Astrub. It will also magically clean all that poop from the soles of your shoes!

13625.descriptionId: This gift was given to you by Kerub Crepin, the hairiest Ecaflip in the World of Twelve. Open it quick!

13626.descriptionId: This scroll will teach you the Write emote. We're not expecting you to be as good as Acidrik Gutsplitter, but you could at least try to write something other than what a Bwork would. Just this once...?

13627.descriptionId: You found this letter in a gift envelope. The paper shines with an iridescent gloss. Could it be magic? To know more, why don't you go and wish Kerub Crepin a merry Kwismas? He's waiting for you at his house in Astrub.

13628.descriptionId: What could be in this envelope? Open it, quick!

13629.descriptionId: This wheel-shaped ring turns on itself very slowly, in a clockwise direction. Only Henual understands the importance of this very discreet movement. One thing's for sure: the ring must not stop turning under any circumstances. Be very careful, the state of the entire Krosmoz may well depend on the piece of jewellery wrapped around your finger.

13630.descriptionId: This belt is supposed to protect its wearer from temporary paradoxes, Krosmic waves, repeat delays and that feeling of déjà-vu. In theory, anyway. It's probably a safe bet just to use it when you don't want to lose your trousers.

13631.descriptionId: This hammer is equipped with a chronomagical convector. As soon as you whirl it around your head at the speed of 88 kamiles per hour, it'll transport you back to the future. If, however, you don't manage to spin it fast enough, you'll disappear into a puff of smoke. Get working on those biceps!

13632.descriptionId: When you wear this helmet, you'll look like a battered old Bow Wow. Looking like that, you risk coming across as a bit of a bonehead, but you might also come across animal-lovers that take a certain shine to you. If you're lucky, maybe they'll end up adopting you?

13633.descriptionId: A necklace that demonstrates how loyal and disciplined you are. If that's not the case, you could always show your teeth and look all beastly.

13634.descriptionId: These boots leave very interesting marks that will allow you to mash up your footprints, ridiculing your hunter friends. Careful, you might still take an arrow or two on your way.

13635.descriptionId: Warm, resistant and self-cleaning, this cloak is practical and beautiful. Who would've thought you could be the greatest hunter in the World of Twelve and look fashionable?

13636.descriptionId: The tooth that adorns this amulet was ripped from the mouth of a legendary monster. Was it a dragon? A YeCh'Ti? A mother-in-law? Only Nevark knows and he'll take it with him to the grave.

13637.descriptionId: They say that whoever wears this belt becomes capable of hitting a Moskito in flight from three kilokametres away. It is, however, unadvisable to walk through a shooting range with this accessory around your waist.

13638.descriptionId: The first cloak of this kind was worn by the sergeant major, Darkfountain. The militiaman is said to have given Antyklime Ax the cloak off his back to thank him for his help editing his memoirs. It has to be said that the tempestuous life of a Brakmarian officer often results in a lot of ink spilt.

13639.descriptionId: According to the legend, this amulet can erase all the mistakes you might have made as an adventurer. In your case, you'll probably need a few of them.

13640.descriptionId: These boots tend to leave black marks on the carpets and tiles, which will frustrate your house staff no end. Unless they're Goblins, of course.

13641.descriptionId: This helmet looks like the head of the late Ivory Scarabugly that got squashed by Nomarow in his younger years. The merchant who sold it to you guaranteed that it was the original. The mysterious label that says "781 / 10,000" makes you think differently.

13642.descriptionId: A long time ago, the sages had a fallout about how to wear this large ring. Some believed it should be worn around the thumb, and others believed that it was made for the big toe. Nomarow switches it between the two on alternate weeks.

13643.descriptionId: Nomarow is the unbeatable champion of skullcrushing. When he chucks on these getas, you'll want to hope you don't come across him.

13644.descriptionId: Like any respectable magician's helmet, this one doesn't look anything special... However, it was used as a tankard, a sick bag and even Hel Munster's chamberpot when he was a young, impressionable apprentice. Even nowadays, few helmets can guarantee so many functions at once.

13645.descriptionId: When Hel Munster asked his master how he could fight against the cold, he responded that the answer was in the pages of his spell book. So he pulled out the pages one by one and sewed them together to make this original cape.

13646.descriptionId: The precious jewel in this amulet contains a Quadramental Breeze digest and that is exactly what is wrong with it. To be able to fully benefit from its magical powers, you'll need to free the Breeze, but only a blonde, beautiful, intelligent woman with a good chest and sense of direction can do it. Otherwise, get used to its basic powers.

13647.descriptionId: This helmet went out of fashion ages ago, especially amongst housewives under 50. Nobody dares tell Aermyne, however, for fear of the consequences.

13648.descriptionId: Housewives over 50 can pick up this cloak for dirt cheap at cooking events. You, unfortunately, didn't think about that and bought it from a tailor who sold it as a state-of-the-art item. You were warned that a good merchant is, above all, a good liar.

13649.descriptionId: Originally made to prepare tarts, this rolling pin is now used to dish out clouts. You'll have a feast when your kiddywinkle invites his friends round for his birthday.

13651.descriptionId: A light, yellow feather that smells of gas.

13652.descriptionId: This Gullipop feather has been shaped into a quill. If you don't know how to use it then just write the idea off.

13653.descriptionId: A long, immaculate, slightly dusty feather.

13654.descriptionId: This ticket was given to you by Kerub. It should allow you to free access Astrub's public transport for one trip.

13655.descriptionId: This tuft of hair was designed by Clyde Parker but you get the impression that it's been thrown together with a few old Sabredon split ends.

13656.descriptionId: This wrist of this paw that you got from Baka Laive is hollow. So, you can use it as an ashtray, an inkwell or even a beer mug.

13657.descriptionId: This cape was originally worn by Sylkauf the Meridia of Hibernation's prophet. The idea came to him when he was watching some Snailmets lug their houses around on their backs. Weary of falling asleep in uncomfortable places, he took the opportunity to traipse around with his mattress with him at all times.

13658.descriptionId: This slippers are very highly regarded by the new generation who love comfort, but refuse to put in any effort to get it. Come to think of it, they might just suit you. Try them on!

13659.descriptionId: These boots are the epitome of your life. Don them proudly and make those who pity you flee. They are also efficient for crushing beggars' fingers and kicking children up the backside.

13660.descriptionId: A compilation of the jokes printed on the backs of Rabmarac wrappers. A summit of humour for kids, grown-ups and Goblins.

13661.descriptionId: The Snickermite is a big joker. Always ready to play a trick on someone for kicks and giggles, it's so affectionate it'll make you forget just how exasperating it is. It is, however, a bit of a prude and loathes monsters from the Lousy Pig Plain because of their bad taste in jokes.

13662.descriptionId: This Snickermite Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13663.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13664.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Snickermite that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13665.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Snickermite.

13666.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Snickermite. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13667.descriptionId: As its name might suggest, Bulbutting was created by taking cuttings, which means that it is a clone, genetically identical to its mother. So why does no other bulb look like it? Determined to solve the mystery of its origins, it decided to explore Pandala Island to take as many samples as possible from the Kwapa on the island. If they don't survive the process, well, that's just too bad – all in the name of science.

13668.descriptionId: This Bulbutting Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13669.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13670.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Bulbutting that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13671.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Bulbutting.

13672.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Bulbutting. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13673.descriptionId: Snailmate is a Snailmet with a passion for the dark sciences. Its lack of hands makes performing incantations tricky, so as you can imagine, it's not too dangerous. All the same, it seeks to absorb the vital essence of monsters in the Dark Jungle on Otomai Island, hoping to one day gain their terrifying powers.

13674.descriptionId: This Snailmate Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13675.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13676.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Snailmate that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13677.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Snailmate.

13678.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Snailmate. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13679.descriptionId: With the Toucantankerous, it's like name, like nature. If you don't know how to behave around it, don't worry, it's really quite normal. In fact, it even comes with an advisory note! But even if it makes your life difficult, it means well and will prove incredibly helpful in combat if you let it overcome its flaws on Otomai Island.

13680.descriptionId: This Toucantankerous Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

13681.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13682.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Toucantankerous that you left at the Bow Kennel.

13683.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Toucantankerous.

13684.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Toucantankerous. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

13685.descriptionId: An advisory note from Oshimo stating the results from his Toucantankerous feeding research and what it prefers to eat.

13686.descriptionId: Matt Sacurrin is your prisoner but he'll flee at the first opportunity.

13687.descriptionId: Let's just say that under this hat you'll find anything but gifts.

13688.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

13689.descriptionId:
It has to be said, you do have certain similarities with a rat. You are extremely hairy, long in the tooth, have a rather pointy snout, and a tendency to repel the opposite sex. All you're missing is the long tail.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13690.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you. This gift can only be opened on a DOFUS 2.0 server.

13697.descriptionId: Koalaks don't go to school, so the Koalak Warrior didn't have the opportunity to become the playground bully. It has, therefore, decided to take revenge on random adventurers and become the Agony V'Helley bully.

13698.descriptionId: The Bloody Koalak only has long, white hairs on two parts of its body. These look like they sprouted from his head... Or at least that's what you'll continue telling yourself...!

13699.descriptionId: The Wild Koalak doesn't wear this scarf to look like a bandit, but rather to mask its horrific, Bwork-killing breath!

13710.descriptionId:
When this sword was forged, its blade was quenched in mimilk more than a hundred times, which is why it shines so brightly.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13711.descriptionId:
This jaunty hat has an adjustable strap that pretty much guarantees you won't lose it on your adventures, even if you take a nasty tumble. Not only will you land on your feet, but your pride and dignity will remain happily intact.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13712.descriptionId:
This shield of the utmost feline elegance will protect you from low blows, cutting remarks, and rotten tomatoes. You can even use it as a scratching post!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13716.descriptionId: The only advantage of putting this beak in your mouth would be to shut you up and give your team mates some peace and quiet.

13718.descriptionId: Apparently, the Blastofu is capable of being reborn from its ashes. Since they've changed hands and been exposed to the cold and all that, these ones probably won't work any more.

13719.descriptionId: The Tofuzmo used this feathery ruff to look cool and rebellious. Sadly, it just makes you look like another teenager who hasn't quite got to grips with puberty.

13722.descriptionId: The Tofubine was so busy cavorting with the Royal Tofu that she dropped a few feathers, which you were quick to pick up.

13724.descriptionId: Apparently Jon Lemon wrote his seminal song "More Eating Good (This Podgy Tofu Has Flown)" whilst gnawing on one of these legs.

13726.descriptionId: If you lift this conch to your ear and listen, you'll hear the roar of the ocean. If you lift this conch to your mouth and blow, you'll hear the roar of the militiamen who have come to arrest you for bursting everyone's eardrums.

13727.descriptionId: Some people claim that a suntan is a sign of good health. Others disagree with this plainly preposterous notion, but not for long, because the goddess Peasbwin likes to shut them up. Halcyon days if you've got leathery, burnt skin!

13728.descriptionId: Some starfish have stars in their eyes, while others turn their eyes to the stars. As for the starfish on the Asse Coast, well, they only have eyes for the muscle-bound adventurers who strut along the beaches in the summer.

13729.descriptionId: Dopples use dark paper like this to create copies of anything they can lay their grubby hands on. Ancient engravings, love letters or graffiti in public toilets: anything will do. What does it mean? Is it a sign of the Dopples' over-developed instinct to reproduce? Or maybe it just shows that they're incorrigible copycats.

13730.descriptionId: Sown by troublemakers and the god Mikart, these seeds germinate rapidly and grow into large plants surprisingly quickly. Dark Bakers use slices of the plants' fruits to garnish their pies, and then delight in throwing them at your face.

13731.descriptionId: According to the legend, the Dok Alakos were so intent on finding the very best Medicinal Stones the world had to offer that they dug and dug and dug, until their mountain was criss-crossed with ravines. Only Enutrofs and baby Koalaks actually believe that tosh, of course.

13737.descriptionId: The Mama Bwork saves her leather thong for special occasions such as stag nights. She graciously passed it on to you so that you can carry on her trade when she's gone.

13738.descriptionId: The merchant who sold you this bandana swore blind that the bullet hole was real.

13740.descriptionId: The hole in this bandana is big enough for you to fit three or four of your fingers through. Which means it should be big enough for... But no. You mustn't.

13742.descriptionId: Unfortunately, wearing this bandana won't stop your good ideas from flying away.

13744.descriptionId: It's no good wearing this bandana if you want to avoid getting a head cold.

13746.descriptionId: It's no good shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted, but really, if the Cybwork had been more careful with his hardware, he wouldn't be so screwed over now.

13748.descriptionId: This Trophy enables you to stick undesirables onto the bottom of your boots, or vice versa. Don't forget to tie your laces, now.

13768.descriptionId: In a fit of inspiration, an artisan used a chisel to engrave the following on this trophy: "Would you rather get lucky or luck out? Depends on where you are..."

13769.descriptionId: This Trophy protects you from really cracking hits but also prevents you from scoring them yourself. You should take the opportunity to claim that you hate wanton violence and stand with your hands on your hips, tutting disapprovingly at everyone you see.

13784.descriptionId: The packaging this Trophy came in says that it works best when you have fresh air against your bare bottom. You can't wait to try it out.

13790.descriptionId: The good thing about this Trophy is that, if you hit an ally by mistake, there's little chance they'll be able to do anything about it.

13796.descriptionId:
This Trophy oozes a slippery liquid that gives you the upper hand when escaping from Lock-happy opponents.
Just don't be surprised when you don't get any free hugs on Ballotwine's Day.

This Trophy oozes a slippery liquid that gives you the upper hand when escaping from Lock-happy opponents.

13799.descriptionId: This Trophy turns you into the clumsiest warrior anyone has ever seen. Just turning around to check the height of the sun in the sky sends four of your allies flying into bushes and walls.

13802.descriptionId: When the pressure gets too much, when people start throwing their weight around, and when you realise you're a total pushover, it's time to equip this Trophy.

13805.descriptionId: Having the first turn gives you the limelight to commit the first fatal error, show everyone what an idiot you are, prove that you're not a priority target, be the last man standing and come home a hero.

13823.descriptionId: Wind up this Trophy and you'll be going strong all night! You're never too old for the generation game.

13826.descriptionId: This Trophy is seasoned with Cania Bay sea salt, delicate herbs and rustic rust, so your enemies can enjoy a taste sensation when they smash their front teeth out on it.

13827.descriptionId: This Trophy is seasoned with Cania Bay sea salt, delicate herbs and rustic rust, so your enemies can enjoy a taste sensation when they smash their front teeth out on it.

13828.descriptionId: This Trophy is seasoned with Cania Bay sea salt, delicate herbs and rustic rust, so your enemies can enjoy a taste sensation when they smash their front teeth out on it.

13829.descriptionId: A lifetime of mischief and monkey business has finally paid off. You carved Blop Goldof lyrics into the bench behind the church in Amakna. You spent your evenings throwing people weaker than you into the harbour at Madrestam. You orchestrated that magnificent event whereby all the bins in Astrub were filled with Fairyworks and innocent creatures and then set alight. This Trophy was made for you.

13830.descriptionId: This Trophy will help you leave the nest and take your first steps as a real person. Next up: learn how to cook something other than pasta. Doesn't anyone around here have a replicator?

13831.descriptionId: If you would stop using it to check out birds for a second, you would discover that this Trophy is an incredible instrument of precision. You won't miss a thing, not even the Blop stain on the hat of an enemy crouching behind a bush in a hole on the other side of that hill all shrouded in mist.

13832.descriptionId: This Trophy will show your enemies that you are capable of the best actions known to man, and the most evil, and that you prefer the latter. And they will weep, forsooth.

13833.descriptionId: This Trophy will show your enemies that you are capable of the best actions known to man, and the most evil, and that you prefer the latter. And they will weep, forsooth.

13834.descriptionId: This Trophy will show your enemies that you are capable of the best actions known to man, and the most evil, and that you prefer the latter. And they will weep, forsooth.

13845.descriptionId: Ever since you swallowed that piece of rotten Filtounga, you've had one fervent wish: to die quickly and painlessly. Luckily for you, this gut-wrenching pain will wear off all on its own once you do some exercise.

13846.descriptionId: Ever since you swallowed that Soul Pearl, you've felt like a fish out of water. You have an insatiable desire to comb your hair, sit on rocks and sing seaside ditties. In fact, you're lovelier than you've ever been in your life. Entering a fight will dispel the effects... but is that really what you want, little lady?

13847.descriptionId: According to the old sailors' tales, Soul Pearls are made by mermaids and left at the surface when their owners come up for a breath of fresh air and a singsong. If you swallow this pearl, you should definitely stay away from fishmongers, unless you want to end up as sushi.

13848.descriptionId: You hold in your hands a knife that, unlike you, is far from ordinary. A legend as old as the sea itself says that its barnacled blade will help you open Mumussels wider than any other knife, coaxing them into giving up their dearest treasure: Soul Pearls fallen to the bottom of the ocean. If you've always dreamt of having a bra made of shells and a bottom half that smells like sardines, today is your lucky day.

13849.descriptionId:
This buzz saw is the most important piece of a bloodthirsty killing machine from another place. Unfortunately, you're missing all the other pieces. This bit will do as a shield for the moment – just make sure you don't lose a hand to it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13850.descriptionId: The members of the Black Hornet gang used to wear masks just like this one. These sinister individuals were accused of all the worst deeds known to humanity: kidnapping, bridge destroying, fake treasure mongering and ill-timed humming in people's ears. To this day, nobody has got to the bottom of these ne'er-do-wells' motives.

13851.descriptionId: It's thanks to belts like these that the Black Hornets were able to buzz off as soon as the militia arrived. Nobody was quick enough to net them! Without a good belt around his waist, a bandit runs a high risk of his trousers falling down, causing him to lose his dignity, his freedom of movement, and his freedom full stop.

13852.descriptionId: Some washerwomen claim that parsley prevents dirt from resettling on recently washed clothes. Most people brush this off as an old wives' tale and stick to using parsley for flavouring their babbage leaves.

13853.descriptionId: There are few occasions when you should want to add something short and curly to your saucepan. One of them is when you're holding a handful of Chervil. This aromatic herb will definitely give your dinner some oomph!

13854.descriptionId: Jives are a fun-loving herb with a surprisingly sharp edge. Make sure you soften them up before using them in the kitchen - unless you want to serve up your guests' tongues for pudding.

13855.descriptionId: Taragorn is the unsung heir of Ovendoor and the rightful claimant to the thrones of herbdom. It takes a while to realise its full potential, but when used in conjunction with Lisran extract, its taste is powerful enough to wake the dead.

13856.descriptionId: Sow these seeds on Plantalot Monday and they'll make sure you live a life full of skips and jumps, with an impressive dental record and a boundless libido. In short, they'll ensure you live a Wabbit's life.

13857.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Gith Smold needs.

13858.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Al Shab needs.

13859.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Frigostine needs.

13860.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Francky needs.

13861.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Dutch needs.

13862.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.

13863.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Ingram Part needs.

13864.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.

13867.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Brokkreitri needs.

13868.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Clarisse Tocate needs.

13869.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.

13870.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.

13871.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Bea Fortax needs.

13872.descriptionId: This bag contains some of the resources that Carla Garfield needs.

13873.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13874.descriptionId: This huge, trashy necklace sells for an extortionate price, much like all useless things coveted by young guns intent on blowing their first pay check.

13875.descriptionId: This dish's smell of mouldy cheese is enough to make the YeCh'Ti keel over. The taste is worse.

13876.descriptionId: To enjoy this sweet treat in all its glory, you need to keep your mouth loose and your tongue slobbery. Maybe that's why Bow Wows seem to enjoy it the most.

13877.descriptionId: This box is full of nuts, bolts and other miscellaneous stuff that might come in handy one day. It looks a bit like the inside of your brain when you're scrabbling desperately to answer the question "Where were you last night?!"

13878.descriptionId: With these crampons on your feet, sliding is a thing of the past! However, they won't stop you from stepping in Pingwin pats... And they're very, very difficult to clean.

13879.descriptionId: This sword will barely have time to leave its sheath before the vapours it emits knock your enemies out without you having to raise a finger. Originally, it was a cheese knife, marketed with the slogan, "Cut de cheese, Windy Battle!"

13880.descriptionId: This shield is as cold as ice, but it's willing to sacrifice.

13881.descriptionId: These daggers are enough to make anyone smile from ear to ear, even the grumpiest ratbags in the World of Twelve. Just ask Rekojeht in Brakmar if you don't believe it.

13882.descriptionId: Billfer invented this saw for a contest in which carcasses had to be sawn into slices like salami. He won by a landslide after transforming four carcasses into 8595 slices in less than an hour.

13883.descriptionId: After many years of research and testing, this swatter was completed by a group of scientists intent on destroying the rare species known as Xambols. And do you know what? They succeeded.

13884.descriptionId: This shovel is great for dislodging ice and snow, stunning corpses-to-be, and digging up cadavers that are long buried, if you're looking to make a quick kama.

13885.descriptionId: One kilopod of this ghastly cheese is enough to give a whale halitosis for one hundred years.

13886.descriptionId: Iops use this bag to bludgeon their enemies to death; most other classes are wily enough to look inside and find the ammo.

13887.descriptionId: This crop darkens the skin with pleasing effect. Some adventurers use it as a substitute for UV machines, which, naturally, do not exist in the World of Twelve.

13888.descriptionId: On its own, this little stub of wood isn't much good. Don't throw it away though; you might stumble across the rest of a Slibou set and be glad of it!

13889.descriptionId: It's yellow, it's ugly, it doesn't go with anything, but it could save your life! This is how Carla Garfield describes her latest creation.

13890.descriptionId:
This giant snout may not increase your sense of smell, but its tusks will help you ward off approaching danger.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13891.descriptionId: The inhabitants of Amakna who could be described as a few sandwiches short of a picnic believe that the Woolly Piggoth, being a prehistoric ancestor of the common Boar, is 100% extinct, and that creating jewels from its ivory is therefore perfectly ethical. That's why wearing this ring will make you look like you've never actually been to Frigost and as though you're a bit dense.

13892.descriptionId:
What could be better than a cloak made of antediluvian Woolly Piggoth leather to protect you from the icy winds of Frigost? Maybe an elegant cloak of Woolly Piggoth leather. Beggars can't be choosers.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

13893.descriptionId: Warning! Risk of death! This amulet was manufactured using a Woolly Piggoth rump. Never ever try to use it as a gas mask.

13894.descriptionId: A bespectacled Foggernaut by the name of Timmy Mallard was the creator of a word association game where you couldn't pause, hesitate, repeat a word or say a word he didn't like, otherwise you got a bash on the head with this mallet. OK, technically it's a staff, but after a couple of blows to the head you really won't feel like arguing. And remember - the one with the most bruises loses!

13895.descriptionId: This document is proof that you've worked hard for the Frigostian effort. Collect 20 of them, and you'll really be something special.

13896.descriptionId: Western Amakna can be pretty wild, but you should be alright if you're wielding a hatchet like this. And who knows, if you survive long enough out there, they might even give you a shiny, star-shaped badge.

13897.descriptionId: This eerily lifelike, fleshy ring weighs exactly a pound adapts to the size of its wearer's fingers. Surprisingly, no one had thought to try it on other extremities until you picked it up.

13898.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13899.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13900.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13901.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13902.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13905.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.

13906.descriptionId: This bag is full of resources prized by Frigostian craftsmen.
