14393.descriptionId: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.

14394.descriptionId: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.

14395.descriptionId: This dust is supposed to be divine in some way, although Orreip was keeping shtum about what he needs it for. Yet another mystery of the wide and wondrous Krosmoz.

14396.descriptionId:
This enchanted shield is imbued with the inimitable essence of your alliance.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14397.descriptionId: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!

14398.descriptionId: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!

14399.descriptionId: Astonishing! You feel as though you're in a Gobball pen, just without the Gobballs!

14400.descriptionId: If you're looking to keep your feet on the ground, this Fairywork will be no help at all.

14401.descriptionId: This Fairywork is especially popular with Boars, who set them off in great number during all kinds of celebrations, and then scurry off into the grass to truffle around for the fallen treats.

14402.descriptionId: The best Fairywork on earth for celebrating Captain Chafer's Panty Party.

14403.descriptionId: A Fairywork in memory of the night when Sadida got so sick of lying in bed, wide-awake, that he got up and switched off all the stars.

14404.descriptionId: Use with caution: in certain areas, the use of this Fairywork can be seen as acutely boastful.

14405.descriptionId: This Fairywork sounds nice the first time you hear it, but once you've heard 10,000 of them in a row to celebrate Gobbstock, the novelty kind of wears off.

14406.descriptionId: This Fairywork is rarely used, because it gives off a distinctive, pestilent odour. Still, it's always a good idea to have a few on you, to cover up all those... embarrassing moments.

14407.descriptionId: This Fairywork will put stars in your friends' eyes. Tonight, Matthew, I'm going to be... A Wabbit!

14408.descriptionId: A Demonic Rose explodes over everyone's heads. Biological warfare has never been so pretty.

14409.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14418.nameId: Pack of 10 White Gobbly Summoning Fairyworks
14418.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14419.nameId: Pack of 10 Black Gobbly Summoning Fairyworks
14419.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14420.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14423.descriptionId: If you suddenly get the impression that there's someone following you around, then you've probably fallen prey to this helmet's power to make its wearer think that shadows are alive. Hey, a shock to the system might finally cure your sciaphobia!

14424.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14426.descriptionId: When you drink this potion, you'll fly into such a rage that any enemies that get any closer than 6 cells away will find themselves automatically attacked.

14433.descriptionId: Ever since he can remember, Tubskito's family and friends have teased him about his weight. He finally took his life into his own wings and dumped his friends. Now he can't wait to get back at the monsters from the Astrub Fields with you. Warning: he can be a little irritating. He's still a moskito, after all!

14434.descriptionId: This Tubskito Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

14435.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Tubskito that you left at the Bow Kennel.

14436.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Tubskito.

14437.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Tubskito. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

14438.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14439.descriptionId: Looks like the Meridia of Heat really got to you!

14442.descriptionId: When leaving your enemy as quiet as the grave isn't enough for you, use this potion to send his soul straight to the cemetery without passing go.

14443.descriptionId: You were supposed to protect that young, impressionable adventurer, but you failed miserably. Heigh-ho, you can always use this potion to revive her and save her a trip to the cemetery.

14444.descriptionId: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Undertaker.

14445.descriptionId: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Healer.

14446.descriptionId: This document certifies that you are capable of exercising the role of Sentinel.

14447.descriptionId: With this potion, you can teleport straight to the Alliance Temple. Now you've got no excuse for finding yourself all alone without a role whilst the battle is raging!

14449.descriptionId: Here's a Fairywork for the Arachneephobe in you. What could be more soothing than seeing a nasty Arachnee projected into the air and blown to pieces?

14450.descriptionId: The Rogues know how to use this Fairywork better than anyone. Spectacular vanishing acts guaranteed!

14451.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14452.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14453.descriptionId: Some frail, mentally under-developed Wabbits use Rock cards instead of the real thing when stoning enemies.

14454.descriptionId: Hold this card above your head during a storm. It won't do much to stop the rain, but it'll probably attract a lightning bolt, which will light your way for a brief instant.

14455.descriptionId: There's no point in trying to cut your loved one's whiskers or your pet's ears with this card. At best, you'll get cramp; at worst, you'll get a nasty bite.

14456.descriptionId: This Cawwot was taken from the Wabbits, but it has absolutely no commercial value at all. Perhaps that's why Old Time Wabbit uses it to keep score (his faulty short-term memory certainly won't do the trick).

14457.descriptionId: Can you pick a paw paw? Ow a pwickly peaw?

14460.descriptionId: Tie a Dofus to the end of this branch and perch on the shoulders of a slow-witted Astrubian and he'll carry you wherever you need to go without question!

14463.descriptionId: You've hit the jackpot! This skull is the most important of the 224 Skeleton Wabbit bones you need to reconstruct a REAL Skeleton Wabbit in the comfort of your own home! Look at its definition, its nobility. Want to see the rest of this tip-top, Cawwot-nibbling hunk? Only 223 bones to go! Call now!

14464.descriptionId: Ever since you got this blasted key, you've been dying to make it into stew. Lovely hot stew in a thermos might save you if you get lost out in the wilderness, and it would taste so good...! But no. You should save it and pay a visit to the Wa Wabbit in his castle instead.

14465.descriptionId: Some adventurers claim that this key grants access to the Wa Wabbit's harem - hundreds upon hundreds of lonely female Wabbits. Why don't you go and find out for yourself?

14466.descriptionId: This headband is soaked with as much Wabbit blood as the blade of your sword. Armed with a gift like this, you'll finally win the heart of that Sacrier you've had your eye on!

14468.descriptionId: This beard is just what you needed to finish off your Kwismas outfit! This year, the kids are in for a scare!

14469.descriptionId: You might find it hard to believe, but this stomach is filled with Cawwots and Cawwots alone. Looks like even people who gorge themselves on veggies can become fatty bum-bums.

14470.descriptionId: Wobot Wosungwees have much softer fur than their Wabbity counterparts. The Tiwabbit Wosungwee may do more exercise, but the Wobot is on a permanent Cawwot Juice diet, and it pays off.

14471.descriptionId: This helmet was designed to cover up the whole of a Wabbit's head whilst allowing the ears to poke out. Stick it on a Iop's head and he'll do a pretty good Wabbit impression, provided he's not too big-headed.

14472.descriptionId: To your great disappointment, this staff isn't magic. The Whitepaw Wabbit you stole it from just used it to walk without limping. Although you have to admit that it made him look a darn sight more impressive when he started gesticulating wildly to cast a spell. Come to think about it, you kinda miss the old guy.

14473.descriptionId: The soldiers in the Wa Wabbit's personal guard carry bolts like this for good luck. It helps them keep their feet on the ground.

14474.descriptionId: This blood changes colour according to the cycles of the moon. In other words, it's a nightmare for scatter-brained alchemists.

14475.descriptionId: You may well ask yourself how a living Cawwot manages to survive in a land filled with Wabbits. Perhaps the Wabbits from the abandoned labs don't like Cawwots. Perhaps Cawwotmen aren't edible. Nibbling on these leaves might bring you all the answers... but you don't feel brave enough. Where's that dim-witted friend of yours?

14476.descriptionId: These soft little ears glow in the dark. If only they hadn't been brutally ripped off the head of a live animal, they could have replaced your favourite cuddly toy.

14477.descriptionId: These teeth are pointier than the other Wabbits'. And that means... Yes! Their owner must feed on something other than cawwots. You genius, you.

14478.descriptionId: Only one of the Janus Wabbit's heads is sane. By extension, only one of its eyes is edible. Just putting that out there in case you ever find yourself lost on the Sidimote Moors with nothing to eat.

14479.descriptionId: Biting into this Cawwot will bring about some surprising effects. If you're scared by the very thought of it, just remember that all your childhood heroes were born in puddles of radioactive waste and genetic laboratories.

14480.descriptionId: This Cawwot... Er, I mean Callot... This Callot shines like a thousand bonfires when it's pointed at the sun. This strange effect can probably be explained by the essential oils it is dipped in before each use.

14481.descriptionId: Unlike other mushrooms, this one needs sunlight to survive. That means you can safely slip it into your pants without having to worry about it running riot down there.

14482.descriptionId: The slightest contact with these weeds will have you dying to get naked and rub up against all things green: magic beans, Green Piwis, the Itzting, nettles, etc.

14483.descriptionId: You mustn't underestimate the aroma given off by this Wabbit meat. It'll turn even the most adamant vegetarian into a wide-eyed, insatiable carnivore with juice dripping off his chin.

14484.descriptionId: Nobody can resist this tasty, unique dish... Especially not Dees, the Meridia of Gluttony! You'd better hurry up and make your delivery before that roast hog gets wind of it.

14485.descriptionId: This shape-shifting creature absorbs the appearance of the only meal it has in its life before forming a fusional symbiotic relationship with a host item of the same type. When the Mimisymbic is removed from its host by force, it loses its adhesive powers and shrivels up into a sad little ball of no use to anyone. Awww.

14486.descriptionId: This travel journal is in a pitiful state. Most of the pages have been torn out and/or chewed up. Only a few raggedy pages are still legible.

14487.descriptionId: Wabbits are wotten... er, rotten... at spelling, as the name of this veggie demonstrates. You're so disgusted at this wanton replacement of one letter by another that the mere sight of this Cawwot makes you want to puke. Just as well, because it's past its prime.

14488.descriptionId: The Cawwot soda that flows so freely in Gwimace's restaurants has all the same benefits as other sodas: high sugar and calorie content, brief impression of refreshment and hydration, increased risk of diabetes and cardiovascular disease, and decreased life expectancy. However, it also has something the others don't: Cawwocola teleports you straight to Isle of the Crown!

14489.descriptionId: A patchwork of myths and stories, this book was written in Piglet Blood on Lousy Pig skin by a mad poet called Ludba Al-Derzah. The cover itself is made of skin from none other than the Dragon Pig. As for the contents... They're so preposterous that reading too many pages might give you a heart attack.

14490.descriptionId: The Tiwobot can't see much through these goggles, which is why it's so fearless. If you could see the faces you pull in battle, you'd prefer to fight blind too.

14491.descriptionId: This beast of a crown only comes out on special occasions, on account of its weight. If you feel like wearing it on your head would be a pain in the neck, you can always use it as a shield.

14492.descriptionId: This cloak weighs heavy on your shoulders. Have you unwittingly agreed to bear the Wa Wabbit's guilt, or is it all your own?

14493.descriptionId: This belt is actually totally hollow and was designed to hold emergency Cawwots for the Wa. You feel around inside, but the ruddy swindler managed to finish all but a few mouldy end bits before you got to him. Curses!

14494.descriptionId: You've heard that the pair of ears fixed on this gleaming helmet will enable you to hear just as well as a Wabbit. It seems that the original owner of this particular specimen was as deaf as a post.

14495.descriptionId: This belt was awarded following a great tournament in which Wabbits went head to head in red-hot, bare-pawed combat. Once the winner, a Whitepaw, had been declared and the madness had died down, the Wabbits started wondering whether the whole thing hadn't been an elaborate set-up to sell over-priced Cawwot juice to all the spectators.

14496.descriptionId: It's a funny thing: when Wabbits get old, they all start to look like one another and smell kind of fusty. These bracelets were invented to help distinguish the different Whitepaw Wabbits: each one periodically releases a spray of a unique odour: peach blossom, fresh pine, damp soil, last week's bedding...

14503.descriptionId: This Cawwot looks about as fresh as your breath in the morning (ie. Its stench could kill a wildebeest).

14504.descriptionId: The famous explorer Hariston Jaune wore a hat similar to this one. According to the legend, the Okapicap is magique: it whips up your curiosity while sharpening the mind. How excellent it would be if we placed this on the heads of dunces rather than a simple cone!

14506.descriptionId: This poor imitation of a Iop's flamboyant hairstyle is said to have been made using a ball of wool blessed by the god Ecaflip himself. That's probably why Woolly Bow Meows have such fun playing with it.

14507.descriptionId: If the legends are true, then this relic used to belong to the god Ecaflip. Apparently he threw it away after losing a Bow Meow's cradle tournament. You've got to admit: if you lose at a game you invented yourself, you may as well not have any balls of wool at all.

14508.descriptionId: This rustic wax was crafted using Boar Hair and Boar Snouts, among other things. Nobody knows whether the name "Blibli" is a nickname for Boars, an abbreviation of "bling-bling" or something else. Frankly, it sounds ridiculous, but who knows? Maybe in hundreds of years everyone'll be using it. Ha!

14519.descriptionId: Back in the day, Judge Lou was the big cheese around the north of Cania. Her sentences were harsh, the word 'appeal' wasn't in her vocabulary and she was the terror of the courtrooms. Bonta's criminals trembled before her. Apparently, Kerub Crepin is the only one who ever convinced the judge of his clients' innocence. How he did it is another matter entirely.

14545.descriptionId: Luckily for you, Fosfor is one of the only survivors of the Abandoned Labowatowies that isn't toxic to touch. Well, he was only discovered recently, so who knows what might happen, but he's probably safe. Either way, he's the most charming night-light you've ever had. This voracious soul nibbler feeds on the remains of other Wabbits.

14546.descriptionId: This Fosfor Ghost hasn't left the living world yet. Will you find a way to resurrect it or cowardly abandon it once and for all?

14547.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14548.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the Fosfor that you left at the Bow Kennel.

14549.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of a Fosfor.

14550.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your Fosfor. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

14551.descriptionId: You wrestled this trophy off a gruesome, terrifying, life-threatening... squirrel. You can expect some jibes once your pals find out, but they'll never know just how harrowing the experience really was.

14552.descriptionId: With this module, you'll be able to upgrade your alliance prism so it can teleport characters to other controlled prisms or Zaaps.

14553.descriptionId: Use this potion to summon a Perceptor.

14554.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14555.descriptionId: Farod's terrifying scream is still ringing in your ears.

14556.descriptionId:
This mask may get you into the prestigious Miss Ugly contest, but you'll need something really special to win it! Most people just use theirs to hide their faces at parties they'd really rather not be at.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14557.descriptionId:
This cloak was designed to help Miss Triste win the Miss Amakna contest. You can probably guess how that one finished.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14558.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14559.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

14561.descriptionId: This blessing will make you agile and on the ball in the fights to come.

14562.descriptionId: You got this divine flail head from Xa, the Meridia of Endurance. You have no idea why he had a spare flail head on him, but one thing's for sure: you'll feel as light as a feather once you've got rid of it.

14563.descriptionId: There's a stinging pain at the base of your spine. You've done something silly again, haven't you?

14564.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14565.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14566.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14567.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14568.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14569.descriptionId:
The god Makss has used his power on you... The question is, are you better or worse looking than before? The jury's out.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14570.descriptionId:
Uh oh... You were so obstinate and pig-headed trying to have the last word with the Meridia of Stubbornness that you started to look like him.
You'll go back to normal as soon as you enter a fight.

14577.descriptionId: With its thick lining, this bag will give you a halo or two without fail. Unfortunately, they risk centering around your armpits.

14578.descriptionId: Thanks to this headgear, rushing headlong into a fight has never head such an impact.

14579.descriptionId: Even if it doesn't make you stronger, this belt will make you look more superb than you really are. Well, so long as you stay in the sunshine.

14580.descriptionId: Thanks to its considerable weight, this amulet can also be used as a weapon, if you happen to lose yours.

14581.descriptionId: The boots will ensure you're victorious with a simple well-placed kick. Although it's hardly glorious, a victory's still a victory.

14582.descriptionId: Worn on the middle finger, this ring will allow you to inflame whoever you like all while showing off your wealth... so long as they don't take too close a look.

14583.descriptionId: With such protection, nothing can happen to your little head. But be careful all the same, because the tag says that wearing this helmet for a long period of time may make you dependent on bird seed.

14584.descriptionId: Wearing this cloak won't prevent you from sprouting feathers just like the Celestial Piwi, whose plumage was removed to make it. Still, it'll keep you warm until then.

14585.descriptionId: The solid sole of these boots will provide you with unequalled protection against all the dangers of a Piwi's everyday life: walking on seeds, walking on acorns, walking on earthworms... In short, it's the ultimate foot protection you've been dreaming of.

14586.descriptionId: This belt will make you one of the greatest fighters the World of Twelve has ever borne. This effect will come to an end once you try to leave the comfort of your lounge, so be careful.

14587.descriptionId:
This hat was invented by an anonymous tailor ahead of his time. Indeed, his market research revealed an upsurge in the number of poopy heads and fartfaces. He therefore decided to make a hat that would flatter them, and made a fortune in no time at all.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14588.descriptionId:
Trool underwear is much too big to be used thusly, even by you. But, since nothing can stop you once you get an idea in your head, you decided to wear them anyway by strapping them onto your back until your posterior was big enough.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14589.descriptionId: Your little cheeks have never known comfort like this. But beware of strangers; one of them might belong to the bizarre panty-raider cult. If that's the case, they won't hesitate to beat you senseless until you disrobe and hand over the goods. So take some advice: watch your behind!

14590.descriptionId:
Now here's a weapon that left Cra herself scratching her head. She turned it this way and that, examined all the seams, and she still couldn't understand why it was so popular with her disciples. Sure, it's got a light draw and it's machine-washable, but its combat-worthiness remains to be seen.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14591.descriptionId:
This mask not only makes you seem more fierce than you actually are, but it also hides your terrifying face. Two advantages for the price of one!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14592.descriptionId:
This ample cape will hide all your cheap gear, and if you stay perfectly still, you could even pass for a talented actor.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14593.descriptionId: Fin Fang: two opposing yet balanced forces. Light and Dark. Good and Evil. Surf and Turf.

14594.descriptionId:
This staff is useful for knocking hecklers (and sleepers) around during a performance. It's also quite good for squishing the Arachnees and Moskitos who always come, uninvited, to gate-crash your performances.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14595.descriptionId: Pro-tip: if you wear this hat as protection during a storm, wring it out later and you've got cheap tea.

14596.descriptionId:
If you found this shield at the end of a rainbow, then it'll bring you fortune and good luck. However, if you got it off a smelly corpse, then it'll never be anything more than a leaf with a relaxing odour.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14599.descriptionId:
This hat might look a little silly on its own, but coupled with the rest of the set, its generous curves will make you Astrub's heart-throb.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14600.descriptionId:
This cape is carefully crafted to make hideous things look cute - for example, your ample rear end.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14601.descriptionId: If you were only wearing this, you'd look like an idiot. A super cute idiot, sure, but an idiot all the same. Ah, who cares? You don't need to be smart to be attractive.

14602.descriptionId:
You won't think these daggers are quite as cute when they rip slowly through your flesh all the way down to the bone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14603.descriptionId:
This wig is extremely popular with young Enutrofs, who use it to hide their characteristic baldness, which is itself caused by their hair constantly being yanked into a bun.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14604.descriptionId:
This cape is mostly worn as a sign of distinction by artists and upper-class women. So it has nothing at all to do with those garish capes worn by the courtesans at Allister's Castle, understand?
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14605.descriptionId: Despite what you may think, this ring isn't worn on your finger. Certain Osamodas tried to wear it in other ways during certain of their ceremonies – they had some problems.

14606.descriptionId:
The lightness of this axe makes it pretty easy to use, even for frail, sweet women. But don't underestimate its razor-sharpness – more than a few overly-daring men have found their flames of passion permanently extinguished by it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14607.descriptionId:
Thanks to this helmet, your fantasies of being treated like a bad little ducky can become reality!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14608.descriptionId:
To collect the feathers required to make this cape, you'll need around a hundred Black Quaquacks and a cheese grater.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14609.descriptionId: No one knows exactly where this ring came from; all we know is that it fell off the end of a Quakane during a particularly vigorous fight against the Bworkette.

14610.descriptionId:
Originally, this staff was immaculate; it picked up its permanent black tint by being repeatedly thrust into the nooks and crannies of Bwork dungeons... and of the Bworks themselves...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14611.descriptionId:
After playing the fool so often, you finally managed to become one for real. To reward you and to show their pride, your parents gave you this helmet.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14612.descriptionId:
Because blood would stain yellow feathers, Yellow Quakapes can't be manufactured the same way as Black Quakapes. For that reason, they take a lot longer to make.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14613.descriptionId: This ring is given annually as a prize to the first imbecile to dress as a Tofoone, head into the Eltneg Wood and come out alive. Due to a recent change in rules, being in one piece is also required.

14614.descriptionId:
Pandawushu masters are able to catch a Moskito mid-flight with two of these wands in the same hand. Not surprising really, when you consider the viscous slime they're usually covered in after being used to dig for nostril treasure.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14615.descriptionId:
Despite his benevolent nature, or maybe because of it, the White Ninja has completely disappeared from public awareness. So he fashioned his hat after that of his eternal rival: the Black Ninja.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14616.descriptionId:
The White Ninja is a stickler for appearances, which is why he always wears this magnificent white cape and goes to great pains to keep it clean. It's also why the Black Ninja never misses an opportunity to stain it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14617.descriptionId: The White Ninja is extremely superficial and superstitious. He paid a fortune for this amulet to protect him from bad spells, but it only protects him from having too many kamas.

14618.descriptionId:
Using a bladed weapon would mean running the risk of staining his clothes with your blood, so the White Ninja prefers blunt instruments, like this hammer. He may not like messes, but when he reaches for it, you're in for a world of hurt.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14619.descriptionId:
Extremely evil and more than a little cowardly, the Black Ninja wears this cap to hide his identity. Like many adventurers, he can't take responsibility for his actions.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14620.descriptionId:
Black and White Ninjas have several things in common, one of them being an impressive wardrobe. But as all experienced fighters will tell you: when you have to fight for your life, throw the cape away. How many adventurers have been killed in battle because they got their arms and legs trapped in their capes at a critical moment?
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14621.descriptionId: The Black Ninja's amulet holds dark and terrible powers, remnant of ancient times, which according to the legend are powerful enough to kill even a god. The only problem is that the method of accessing those powers has long since been forgotten, which explains the amulet's cheap price.

14622.descriptionId:
Flat broke, the Black Ninja had to trade away his sharp blades for some food and a hatchet sharp enough to cut to the quick. All he has to do is aim for his target's neck.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14623.descriptionId:
This cape: it gives you wings.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14624.descriptionId:
Arthur Dint, illustrious voyager, used this shield at times as a fruit basket, and at other times as an umbrella. But with your knack for getting into trouble, you'll probably only have time to use it as a shield.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14625.descriptionId: They say the messenger Airmees could fly using the prototype of these boots. Amakna shoemakers, on guard against potential abuses since the incident involving Klime's overpowered boots, decided to nerf these boots before marketing them.

14626.descriptionId:
You wanted a bow capable of shooting arrows of pure light across the Krosmoz. Unfortunately, you spoke to the wrong artisan and ended up with this shovel instead. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14627.descriptionId:
Pandikazes use this shield not only to protect themselves but also to stave off starvation during long periods of isolation.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14628.descriptionId:
For the first time ever, your face will make the people of Amakna drool with desire. A great way to be desired without having to call on the neighbourhood surgeon/butcher.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14629.descriptionId: More practical than dried rations, and less cumbersome than hunting gear, this belt is still used during certain Pandikaze operations.

14630.descriptionId:
We're not quite sure what the blacksmith was trying to do when he made this sword, but we're pretty sure he was hungry.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14631.descriptionId:
They had to find a use for the Pink Dragoone's head once its dismembered corpse was turned into a cape. So for those who have wished they could show off their pet while riding a mount, your wish has been granted.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14632.descriptionId:
The wise men, who are paid to do nothing in particular, have oft wondered what happened to the skins of the animals the butcher killed. Now that they've seen this cape, they know.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14633.descriptionId: These boots aren't quite as classy as those made of white dragon scales, but they're still pretty popular with adolescents looking to find gear that matches their Adora Set.

14634.descriptionId:
A typical example of the type of equipment that is all the rage not for its utility or (non-existent) efficiency, but for the fact that it could never go out of fashion according to the standards of prepubescent Eniripsas.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14641.descriptionId:
Wearing this cape feeds so many fantasies that some eccentric enchanters are trying to make a food out of it. They claim that if they succeed, they'll be able to satisfy all the Word of Twelve for at least ten generations.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14642.descriptionId:
This diadem is to this set as a cherry is to a cake: useless, but indispensable.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14643.descriptionId:
Before becoming a weapon, the Domestick was a tool used for all sorts of housework. It could be used to dust the shelves, clean the oven, and even to administer a well-deserved spanking for the lady or the man of the house.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14644.descriptionId: Numerous adventurers are ready to sell their parents, sacrifice their families and eat their mount to see, even for a moment, what lies under this belt...

14645.descriptionId: It would be in bad taste to say that this pendant is as light as a feather. But hey, it doesn't make it any less true.

14646.descriptionId: This ring was used to differentiate the Celestial Piwi from the rest of the brood. It may be able to help you to differ from other adventurers.

14647.descriptionId: Thanks to its aerodynamic shape, this headgear provides its wearer with the swiftness of a Tofu. However, the pressure it exerts on your head will also make you think like one.

14648.descriptionId: This beautiful adornment can be used as a cover, a broom, and even as a cloak.

14649.descriptionId: With all these feathers of your size, you'll stay quite warm this winter, unlike the poor animal they were "borrowed" from.

14650.descriptionId: Bringing together elegance and lightness, these boots will make you the prince of all costume parties. They won't, however, be very useful you're in a fight.

14651.descriptionId: Made from the finest and most immaculate of Celestial Tofu feathers, this wedding ring is the ultimate touch that your well-groomed style needed. It's also highly practical for tickling your neighbour's ear.

14652.descriptionId: Although it looks like a precious stone, the locket decorating this amulet is actually made from a hardened Celestial Tofu egg.

14653.descriptionId: As well as providing rudimentary protection during fights, this hat will give you a tidy-messy hairstyle that's one of a kind. Say goodbye to the long hours in front of the mirror spent coating your hairy leather in jelly grease.

14654.descriptionId: Hot, sturdy and impressive, this cloak has it all. Yep, even its weight, its stench, and the hair it'll leave on your clothes. Do we really need to mention that it'll make your neck itch?

14655.descriptionId: Carved straight out of one of the Celestial Boar's tusks, this belt represents the acme of vanity in the eyes of all those who are passionate about swine.

14656.descriptionId: Whenever you complain your feet hurt while wearing these boots, imagine what it must be like for your opponents when they receive a kick up the backside from them.

14657.descriptionId: This ring, carved out of a Celestial Boar horn, will make you stronger in the face of both enemies and mockery.

14658.descriptionId: If you can't find a use for this amulet while fighting, you can still try making your friends guess what its shape represents on those boozy evenings at Astrub Inn.

14659.descriptionId: This headgear, made from the head of the Celestial Arachnee, will partially protect you from the sun. However, don't bother trying to scratch your back with it; there could still be some poison on its fangs.

14660.descriptionId: This cape is as fine as an Arachnee's sloughed skin, which isn't too surprising, seeing where it comes from.

14661.descriptionId: This cape will definitely allow you to scare your enemies, but your also your allies, your friends, your family and probably your other half too.

14662.descriptionId: These boots are extremely comfortable, as well as elegant. It's said that this is due to their soles, made from Arachnee Eggs.

14663.descriptionId: This amulet, made from a Celestial Arachnee's eyeball. The question is, how many eyeballs does an Arachnee have? It really could be any of them.

Wearing this mask brings a horrible curse, causing the wearer to take on a new personality as long as the mask is worn. Counterfeits were used at times by Astrubians looking to justify their infantile behaviour, but their massive use near the Frigost Zaap alerted the authorities, who have put a definitive end to the fraud.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14898.descriptionId:

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

14899.descriptionId: This magical wedding ring, which was found in an ancestral treasure, has the power to change the colour of its wearer's pee. Too bad it's not especially useful at sea...

14992.descriptionId: This multi-purpose cloak will protect your behind from grains of sand. Now there's nothing to stop you from getting the best tan on the island!

If you listen closely, you can hear a strange chant repeating faster and faster, coming from inside this shell-shaped shield.

15050.descriptionId: You may be wondering how these wings manage to cope with the weight of a Ghoulton. It's another question to add to your collection of futile questions that will never be answered. How will you sleep at night?

15051.descriptionId: A dash of idiocy, a drop of frivolity, a few grains of nonchalance: it's actually rather difficult to tell ghoul blood apart from Iop blood.

15052.descriptionId: Just like Chafers, ghouls can switch their eyes without injury. Therefore, they sometimes use them to barter for certain favours. More and more ghouls only have one eye left, which is of real delight to eye patch sellers.

15053.descriptionId: Ghoulverness Nails are so imbued with the power of Shushu Ross that they can turn you into a Ghoul. Luckily for you, they never use their hands to fight.

15054.descriptionId: You really don't want to know what part of the Deleghoul these hairs were taken from.

15055.descriptionId: You can throw this staff, fetch it and run around with it in your mouth until you're utterly lost.

15056.descriptionId:
This shield might save your life if you ever find yourself up against carnivorous enemies. Chuck it into the fray and run for your life!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15058.descriptionId: With this headgear gracing your lovely crown, the Moowolf will think you look good enough to eat.

15059.descriptionId: This ring sticks out its tongue when you're hungry. In other terms, it always sticks its tongue out.

15060.descriptionId: Specially designed to give you that oh-so-desirable Ghoul limp!

15061.descriptionId: Very effective for shutting up conversation partners who are a bit too chatty, this hammer will be with you in your best discussions.

15062.descriptionId:
This shield once belonged to one General de Ghoul. He was a valiant ghoul who prepared a secret rebellion against the vampires, but who had a hard time finding allies among his peers. Eventually, one eighteenth of Junssidor, he went into action alone: the most notable thing he did was throwing a shovel at a vampire.
Even if he didn't have much of an impact, this event is still foremost in the minds of the ghouls, who will never forget it and still today talk of the heroic actions General de Ghoul and his shovel on that eighteenth of Junssidor.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15063.descriptionId: Once worked, this fearsome and gloomy item is as dangerous as a Sram.

15064.descriptionId: For generations, all the members of the Homlett family have been the servants of a powerful necromancer. They're so loyal that they continue to serve their master after their own demise, in the form of talking skulls. Dead or alive, they remain loyal. "To be or not to be" is not a question the Homletts have asked. This pet feeds on his cousins, the Chafers, against whom he holds a stubborn grudge.

15065.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to cowardly leave it behind once and for all.

15066.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15069.descriptionId: A message found in a bottle.

15070.descriptionId: A page from Will Sone's journal, found on Horrib Isle.

15071.descriptionId: A page from Will Sone's journal, found on Horrib Isle.

15075.descriptionId:
After outwitting Gein's double, sidestepping his traps and foiling his invisibility gimmick, you really deserve this skull as a symbol of your clear-headedness. You should probably hide it if you ever come across the real Gein, of course, as it'd be a shame to be stripped of your title so soon.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15076.descriptionId: This leg seems to have suffered from the ravages of time... and the beastly violence of ghouls.

15077.descriptionId: It is said that its former owner loved cracking jokes. It would seem he also cracked his leg in the end.

15078.descriptionId: Perhaps her mother advised her to nibble on her arm for a snack, and to save the other for dinner.

15079.descriptionId: Even in death, his head has stayed as smooth as a glassy sea. That seems imminently logical after all.

15080.descriptionId: The shape of this arm is so unrecognisable that it looks more like a Marylork painting than a human limb.

15081.descriptionId: This bone has been broken several times, but it is still impressively resistant.

15082.descriptionId: The B'one Doctor is a skittish wee rake... If he loses his jaw on top of that, he'll be about as offensive as an army of hibernating ticks.

15083.descriptionId: This is some good quality cord. Heavy though... You'd be amazed how many people put their backs out just picking it up!

15084.descriptionId: The fabric used to craft the B'one Boor cloak is so thin that it allows you to move easily among the shadows. But it is very fragile, so that's why you only have an old ripped piece of it.

15085.descriptionId: This oil is widely used by breeders to keep Moskitos away from Dragoturkeys. But be careful not to get the oil on yourself or breathe it in too closely.

15086.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

15087.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

15088.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

15089.descriptionId: This key won't open any doors into caves for you, but it will delight its future owner, who will certainly let you enter.

15090.descriptionId: This key will allow you to enter the Ghoulden Palace and meet the charming staff.

15091.descriptionId: Their smooth shape is aerodynamic enough to delight Chris.

15092.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Neophyte Necromancer ornament.

15093.descriptionId:
Thing is a hand that can think, write and act by itself. It's a very obliging creature. It's believed that it once worked for the prestigious Dadums family from Forfut. However, they used this hand in ways we wouldn't want to mention in polite company, and it was eventually driven to run away and find a less twisted owner. It happened to find you, and there's a good chance you won't be much better than the Dadums family. Thing's destiny is nothing if not tragic.
Thing loves all the creatures that live near the Tree Keeholo, from the roots to the trunk.

This hat gives off such an awful smell that it's hard to know whether your head smells like your feet or your feet smell like your head. At least you have a choice. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15100.descriptionId:
This cape is in such bad shape that it looks like the slightest gust of wind will tear it into shreds. And yet, it hasn't happened yet. That's the power of the zombite-attitude: "I'm still standing, even though I'm living dead" as sang the zombie minstrel, John Elton.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15101.descriptionId:
This shield seems to have a mind of its own and it likes to become one with its owner. If you're in any doubt, just take a look at the necrosis running from your hand to your shoulder.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15113.descriptionId: Actually, Troololens wears this belt on his wrists, which speaks volumes about the monster's girth.

This pet devours Undried souls.

Sometimes it will lick you from head to toe, and it won't hesitate to swallow and suck on the former! Never has such an affectionate animal been seen, just so long as it doesn't take you for its next snack... The Skrot eats Dark Monsters, thereby preventing their overpopulation.

Use this scroll to obtain the Sidimote Warrior ornament.

15163.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the New Blood ornament.

15164.descriptionId:
On steep slopes, you'll want to hold on tight to its horns so you don't fall off.
(This petsmount doesn't need to be fed and cannot die.)

15165.descriptionId:
When it's warm, this shield opens and a smelly juice leaks out. Nature in all its splendour.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15166.descriptionId:
Every rose has its thorns. And this does too.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)
