(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Sidimote Hero ornament.

15168.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Warrior of Otomai ornament.

15169.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Hero of Otomai ornament.

15170.descriptionId: Once worked, this fearsome and gloomy item is as dangerous as a Sram.

15172.descriptionId: This is some good quality cord. Heavy though... You'd be amazed how many people put their backs out just picking it up!

15174.descriptionId:
This fragile helmet is imbued with Kwismas magic. In other words, it allows you to exchange blows with comrades in an unparalleled moment of sharing. The winner is granted the right to steal the toys of their choice because – as is well known – other people's gifts are always better.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15175.descriptionId: With your little feet protected from the cold, you're now ready to face the long winter evenings slouched in front of the fireplace.

15176.descriptionId: This belt won't be enough to turn you into a brave little tailor capable of defeating seven giant Moskitos in one fell swoop, nor will it allow you to capture Unikrons.

15177.descriptionId:
Like your soulmate, this cape will keep you warm despite its basic appearance, and you won't be able to go out without it on your back.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15178.descriptionId:
In the cold winter camps of Frigost, girls have only two topics of discussion: the glorious pompom of the beaniwool, and boys.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15179.descriptionId: This pattern can be used by craftsmen to make part of the Father Whupper Set.

15180.descriptionId: These jester boots will be a splendid addition to your wardrobe. It's well known that black is slimming and goes with everything.

15181.descriptionId: Wearing this ring will be very poorly looked on: it's a reminder of the suffering Father Whupper inflicted on the inhabitants of Kwismas Island. Certain groups are even trying to have it outlawed.

15182.descriptionId:
This belt, with bells lining the entire length, was crafted and offered to Father Whupper as a sort of early warning system. He's not the sort of person you want sneaking up on you.
Why doesn't he just take it off, you ask? They got his mother-in-law to give it to him as a gift - now he has to wear it at Kwismas time.

15183.descriptionId: You took out its heart, but the powerful animal was still dangerous even in death and could have exploded your brain in a sudden shock.

15184.descriptionId: A Crovus Eye is always useful... so long as you know how to avoid the evil eye.

15185.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Celestial Gobball set. Go and see Chaga Lachance at [4,3] in Incarnam or at [5,3] in Amakna to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15186.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Celestial Tofu set. Go and see Chaga Lachance at [4,3] in Incarnam or at [5,3] in Amakna to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15187.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Celestial Piwi set. Go and see Chaga Lachance at [4,3] in Incarnam or at [5,3] in Amakna to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15188.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Celestial Boar set. Go and see Chaga Lachance at [4,3] in Incarnam or at [5,3] in Amakna to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15189.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Celestial Arachnee set. Go and see Chaga Lachance at [4,3] in Incarnam or at [5,3] in Amakna to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15191.descriptionId: You received this voucher in exchange for a piece of the Charlie's Agents Set. Go and see Chaga Lachance in [ 5 / 3 ] to trade 3 vouchers for a random item from the set.

15192.descriptionId: This purse contains a considerable amount of kamas. Choose carefully who you bribe.

15193.descriptionId: Don't stuff your pillow with feathers as scratchy as this one, or you'll get a very bad night's sleep. You can, however, use it as a writing implement.

15194.descriptionId:
This scroll says that Lord Crow is looking for an assistant librarian.
(Double-tap to read the document.)

15195.descriptionId: Because of your altruistic nature, you are always ready to donate blood – especially when it's not your blood.

15196.descriptionId: Place 2 lumps of coal, plenty of water (20 measures) and 3 flasks of Oilbow Grease in a pot. Have 5 Yew branches on hand to heat the brew. Once the mixture has cooled, add the main ingredient: Black Boowolf Blood. It needs to be taken directly from Boowolves from Eltneg Wood: 12 doses will be needed.

15197.descriptionId: Unlike pleasant ink, this ink never goes away. It leaves marks that are as black and eternal as Lord Crow's soul.

15198.descriptionId: After beating the pants off of Tyranike, you ended up becoming the new owner of a used leather thong. Alas! It's not your size. I wouldn't wear it if I were you – it's likely to be as uncomfortable as it is embarrassing.

15199.descriptionId: Take Folyo to where his life-changing interview will happen.

15200.nameId: First Piece of Lord Crow's Library Key
15200.descriptionId: Use this piece of the key found in the lair in Eltneg along with the other piece (once you have it) to enter Lord Crow's Library.

15201.nameId: Second Piece of Lord Crow's Library Key
15201.descriptionId: Use this piece of the key found in the lair in the Domain along with the other piece (once you have it) to enter Lord Crow's Library.

15202.descriptionId:
Add Black Boowolf Blood to this mixture and you'll have unpleasant ink.
(Double-tap to use.)

15203.descriptionId: A key allowing you to open the unfortunate Goblins' cages.

15204.descriptionId: Early on, young Enutrofs try and get hold of Bwork Scalps to hide their growing bald spots. Wearing these things on their heads, they look even more ridiculous than normal – to say nothing of the Bwork odour that comes with them! Although, that might be part of the appeal, as it's strong enough to mask bad breath.

15205.descriptionId: Rarely in your life have you ever seen a shovel in such a state. You can't help but wonder about the dubious use this item was put to when you see a crushed Crobak.

15206.descriptionId: Nothing makes you want to learn more about the origin of this liquid – especially not its colour and odour.

15207.descriptionId: The typically Bworkish odour coming from this pair of socks gives you an idea about the last time they came into contact with water... Clearly a very long time ago.

15208.descriptionId: A book that time has not spared. While the text is no longer legible, you can still admire the pictures and drawings on its pages.

15209.descriptionId: An object of great value – certainly the only one in the entire Outpost.

15210.descriptionId: A carefully carved stone whose excessively red colour makes it somewhat grotesque.

15211.descriptionId: When you have this map in your possession, you are an honourable member of the Free Goblin Syndicate.

15212.descriptionId: This fur reeks of Bwork sweat. Without a doubt, it's the result of spending many a long night snuggled tightly in Bworkoward's armpit.

15213.descriptionId: To slice your opponents in two like a cheap Slice of Trunknid, all you need to do is drop this blade on them. If your enemy doesn't die from the pain, they'll die of shame – while you split your sides laughing.

15214.descriptionId: The excellent workmanship of this cord makes it perfect for tying up all sorts of things, including your friends.

15215.descriptionId: Thick and chunky, Trool snot is widely used by masons to patch cracks and insulate buildings. A cup of linden tea with Troolibrius's snot in it also makes an excellent cough remedy.

15216.descriptionId: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pork, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

15218.descriptionId:
Kevin was a painter who produced as many works in a year as Wa Wabbit had offspring. With success under his belt and wanting less stressful days, he contacted a sorcerer who knew how to put his talent up for auction. An old and unscrupulous book-face collector who was on the decline eventually bought it in exchange for this mass-produced cape.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15219.descriptionId: This ring once belonged to a great speaker. Legend says that when he wore this ring on his finger, he could convince entire armies that it was time to lay down arms. Unfortunately, this ability was hardly useful for an inhabitant of the Dark City, and he rapidly fobbed the ring off on a travelling salesman.

15220.nameId: Title Scroll: Always on the edge
15220.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Always on the Edge".

15221.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Historian".

15222.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Neophyte Necromancer ornament.

15223.descriptionId: Kwyness will surely satisfy your taste for luxury. The custom leather saddle alone will make for a unique flying experience, not to mention the aerodynamic feathers. But you'll have to cater to its whims – Sir Kwak doesn't sleep in just any nest, you know.

15224.descriptionId: It just so happens that your petsmount here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15225.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15228.descriptionId:
In addition to giving you presence and originality, this shield will protect you from your enemies' mortal blows in the middle of the battle. But when you open your mouth, it won't protect you from the sarcasm and jeers when people realise you don't actually have any personality to speak of. It's a risk you'll have to take. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15229.descriptionId:
If you like to read what others are doing over and over again, make acerbic and worthless remarks on nothing very important, or simply have the right to downvote in Amakna, this shield is for you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15230.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

15231.descriptionId:
This little dragon will take you to infinity and perhaps beyond...
It devours Alchimeras' souls.

15232.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to cowardly leave it behind once and for all.

15233.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the petsmount that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15234.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your petsmount.

15235.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your petsmount. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15237.descriptionId: This small chest was stolen out from under the nose of its previous owner. Hurry up and trade it in with Miss Engere, before the previous owner finds you and makes you pay for your theft.

15238.descriptionId:
Love gives you wings, but singletons can always pretend with a pair of these strapped on.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15239.descriptionId:
With this crown on your head, you'll be King Casanova! Even the Gobballs will be falling at your feet!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15240.descriptionId:
A hammer that makes you feel like a small, pink, cute, fluffy woodland creature... and yet incredibly tough at the same time!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15241.descriptionId:
The most important part of any lover's set. If wearing your heart on your sleeve backfires, you'll have a great big red shield to protect yourself from rejection!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15242.descriptionId:
If this amber breaks in combat, it's likely the villainous Arachnee that's been locked inside for fifty-three years will try to bite you. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15243.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Eniripsa class's special emote.

15245.descriptionId: Once this hat is on your head, its fangs sink into your flesh to prevent it from flying off at the slightest gust of wind. You don't care that it's sucking up your cerebral matter, since it was of no use to you anyway.

15246.descriptionId: Its appearance makes it more effective for fending off suitors than a chastity belt.

15247.descriptionId: The merchant who sold you this necklace assured you it was harmless. Yet, you have the unpleasant sensation that it's about to stick its fangs into your neck at any moment.

15248.descriptionId: Nicknamed the jaws of the sands, these boots are worn only by the boldest nomads and Iops.

15249.descriptionId: This cape is still alive and ready to bite anyone who dares caress it, which makes it very popular among celebrities who hate mingling with the crowds.

15250.descriptionId: Because this ring is permeated with the personality of the Wurmlord, it pushes its owner to wear it in other places than on a finger.

15251.descriptionId: They smell just as bad as the retirement home where you sent your grandparents.

15252.descriptionId: This piece of shell is robust enough to serve as a sled on the dunes.

15253.descriptionId: Let's just hope that any toothless Mimice are willing to pay you for it!

15255.descriptionId: Ridiculously small, this paw is a painful reminder of the mockery you suffered in the school locker room.

15256.descriptionId: This is what happens when you bite your tongue with a mouth full of several rows of sharp teeth.

15257.descriptionId: A Stapleworm without spikes is like a Sadida without a doll, or an Enutrof without a beard: it loses everything that characterizes it and gives it its charm.

15258.descriptionId: This skin is ideal for camouflaging yourself in a rocky environment... so long as you're a Crackler.

15259.descriptionId: Tons of Enutrofs have sold their parents for their weight in Tourmaline.

15261.descriptionId: The heat of combat boosts your abilities.

15262.descriptionId: Bring Sedierta to the mysterious rift so she can study it.

15263.descriptionId: Once analysed, this sample will tell you more about the appearance of the unusual rift.

15264.descriptionId:
All that Bamboo Milk and other fermented beverages haven't got the better of you, but it was a very close call.
The effects go away after a few fights.

15265.descriptionId:
This antidote prototype should be able to protect you from the harmful effects of Spice.
The label indicates that ingesting too much may cause severe heartburn.

15266.descriptionId: This is what happens when you bite your tongue with a mouth full of several rows of sharp teeth.

15267.descriptionId: This skin is ideal for camouflaging yourself in a rocky environment... provided you're a Crackler.

15268.descriptionId: This probe seems to measure all sorts of things that mean nothing to you.

15269.descriptionId: The impact seems to have thrown this probe completely out of whack. It is displaying incoherent and constantly changing data.

15270.descriptionId: Drink this elixir to get back all the energy you lost in combat, plus unbelievably smooth skin.

15271.descriptionId: It is said this fabric comes directly from a Mane's clothes. Its very structure protects against the Black Fire of Externam for a while.

15272.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Bugkiller".

15273.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Best-a-Tester".

15274.nameId: Title Scroll: I beat a champion
15274.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "I Beat a Champion".

15275.descriptionId:
There was a time when the Marquis of Lhambadda entertained himself by sailing the waters of the Kawaii River, on a gutted slot machine just stolen from the Ecaflip Temple. He found out that just one small token stuck in one of the slots was enough to stop the makeshift boat from taking on water. Obviously, those pursuing him were in a bad mood, and they didn't leave him time to cash it in. But these events gave him the idea of producing sharivakens as symbols celebrating the creativity of Shariva's Tumult.

Can be spent at the Shariva Merchant at [5,3].

15276.descriptionId: The seal of an authority lost to the ages, Shariva of Antiquity with beard and braids, or something else? The heads of this coin keeps a team of numismatists busy full-time. And time is money: the common view is that this coin has what it takes to make you lose both. On the flipside of the coin, Shariva's Favourites think that stormy horizons could be in store for you, now that you are in its possession.

15277.descriptionId: This Trump Card might be useful to you... for everything. For want of cutting a clubs, will this this Trump Card allow you to cut in line? To get carte blanche for the destination of your choosing? To find out, it's up to you to turn it over and make it your ace in the hole! Unless it cuts your lifeline... Now you'll need diehard courage to dare look at its other side. Come on: this is just the right time, at very most.

15278.descriptionId: This small ticket certifies that you have met the necessary requirements to receive what has been offered to you in exchange. Legend would even have you believe that this item could let you go to spectacular places...

15279.descriptionId: With this ring on your finger, you can proudly assert your attachment to your customs, and demonstrate your colourful traditions. Come on, no one will judge you! Diversity is a requirement!

15280.descriptionId: They didn't live together happily ever after. And your responsibility in this ordeal is entirely confessed. Sometimes, some people just want to see the World of Twelve burn.

15281.descriptionId: Nothing seems to limit your kindness, altruism, and selflessness which define you. This seal honours you for your behaviour. But who might be in the shadows, taking advantage of your naivety?

15282.descriptionId: Proudly wearing this jewel sets you apart from the boring old people: common ways disgust you, and major factions aren't for you. You find happiness where you're not expected, where commonplace regulars turn tail. Defending the shy voices of the assembly, the young and lost causes suits you much better.

15283.descriptionId: A disciplined knight on the chessboard of Shariva's Favourites, you can recognise the importance of rules, and the truth which is hidden behind obedience. Your choice of the party of order was indeed noticed by who it may concern.

15284.descriptionId: Tumult has burst into you, and this seal is the material evidence of it. It symbolises the link which unites you to Tumult's plans. No doubt things will now never again be the same as they were before: at least you will be able to parade your finger, adorned with this distinctive mark.

15285.descriptionId:
Four's a good number. A lot of things come in fours: seasons, doors, tops, lokos, squares... Most say the elements do too, but some rumours say there's a fifth one.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15286.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Boxer emote.

15287.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Pandawa class's special emote.

15289.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Tavern Scourge ornament.

15290.descriptionId:
Just like Mishell, this cape is soft and protective. All cute little animals are drawn to it, and they love to snuggle up inside. This isn't going to do much good for your reputation as a warrior with a heart of stone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15291.descriptionId:
A mask that will awaken your animal side.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15292.descriptionId: An enormous necklace, which is more useful for covering your torso than as pretty jewelery!

15293.descriptionId:
Usually given at parties, this robust shield is nothing more than a big square of chocolate. It will delight the palates of your enemies, so busy devouring it that they won't attack you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15294.descriptionId:
There was once a vast underground city called Gazjol-Nureb, where Scarabs – those proud giant beetles – had prospered for centuries. But their civilisation disappeared one day in mysterious circumstances... Archaeologists hypothesise that the terrible King Lytch was responsible, but nothing has been proven definitively. All that's left of these legendary insects are the Scaraleaves, their closest living relatives.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15295.descriptionId:
I wouldn't expect to have much success when you spread the wings of this cape, if I were you. Not unless you're hoping to seduce eager Scaraleaves nearby.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15296.descriptionId:
The carapace used for this shield makes it extremely resistant but still light. Better keep a close grip on it. It'd be a shame to lose it with the first gust of wind – like you did your first love and your last hat.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15297.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Visitor from Externam ornament.

15298.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Externam Ambassador ornament.

15300.descriptionId:
Fleaster falls on the first Sunday after the first full moon following 21 Martalo, so on 22 Martalo at earliest, if the full moon falls on the evening of the 21st, and on 25 Aperirel at latest. This does not mean the moon as it is seen, but rather the "Fleastal" moon, calculated using an inexact but traditional method. The modern peoples of the World of Twelve – having adopted both the Grougorian calendar reform and a concurrent correction for the lunar cycle – often celebrate on a different day than the orthodox peoples, and the discrepancy can be either nothing, or one or five weeks (depending on the year), or exceptionally four weeks if there is a new moon in Bonta but not in Brakmar.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15301.descriptionId:
The metal ears on this headgear amplify the sound of growling stomachs in those around you. It's ideal for hearing enemies approach, or verifying whether your friends are properly digesting the delicious meal you've reheated for the twelfth time.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15302.descriptionId: This amulet symbolises courage and bravery. At least, that's what some intellectuals think.

15303.descriptionId: These stone boots are perfect in combat, as long as your legs are strong enough to lift them.

15304.descriptionId:
This cape has a kind of integrated belt. You can use it to tie it to your waist at any time, to prevent enemies from grabbing it and slowing you down.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15305.descriptionId:
The motif on this shield is strangely reminiscent of the ones that can be found in the remains of old Sufokia.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15306.nameId: Title Scroll: Survivor of the Abyss
15306.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Survivor of the Abyss".

15307.descriptionId:
This shield was designed by Harry Stottel. While it might not help you avoid certain death, it will make your silhouette much curvier.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15308.descriptionId: A garden gnome that won't look you in the eyes. The more you look at it, the more you feel an incomprehensible unease.

15309.descriptionId: This garden gnome is unique in that it has a sickly pallor and runny nose – making it superbly realistic.

15310.descriptionId: The radiant and glowing face of this little gnome fills you with joy.

15311.descriptionId: You're surprised at how warm and fuzzy this little garden gnome with its silly grin makes you feel inside.

15312.descriptionId: It's hard to tell whether this garden gnome has its eyes open or closed. Either way, it seems to be in a deep trance.

15315.descriptionId: Stiff and disagreeable. No doubt about it: they're broom bristles.

15316.descriptionId: The hedgehog's best friend, the doormat bristle.

15317.descriptionId:
This is not the bow you're looking for.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15318.descriptionId:
Careful! Flaunting this shield is considered an open act of rebellion.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15319.descriptionId:
The cloak of choice for all those adventurers who are stubborn, cheeky, and effortlessly adorable.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15320.descriptionId:
If you rub this helmet up the right way, it might just show you the hologram it's storing.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15321.descriptionId:
Friendrakes are born in the waters of Sufokia, away from prying eyes. These miniature dragons have long lacked affection, and they make for extremely loyal companions. When a Friendrake adopts you, it's for life! When you go on nights out with your fellow adventurers, you can count on your Friendrake to warm up the room and lighten the mood with the funny faces it makes.
The Friendrake devours bworks' souls.

15322.descriptionId: It just so happens that your pet here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15323.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15324.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15325.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15326.descriptionId: It's almost always in a bad mood, but then again, so are you.

15327.descriptionId: It just so happens that your petsmount here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15328.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15331.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special elemental emote.

15333.descriptionId: This large album contains the clues needed to find Ralf Loupain's missing garden gnomes.

15334.descriptionId:
This shield was given to Dantinea when she was just a little girl, during the Miss Abysses contest. The other candidates mysteriously disappeared before the prize was awarded. Nobody dares to question her title today, yet everyone knows that the mermaid Arielle Little is the most beautiful creature in the ocean. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15335.descriptionId:
A cape in the Samurai Set?! This is the work of some unscrupulous tailor who cares more about selling to his uninformed customers than he does about accuracy. It's his fault this set is not as effective as it could have been if there weren't a cape to hinder your movements in combat.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15336.descriptionId: Sometimes used to discipline insolent young Iops, this solid belt is usually worn pulled quite tightly, to hold in the paunch. This style is particularly popular with King Allister's personal guards.

15337.descriptionId:
Besides hiding your natural baldness, this helmet will make you look like a fearsome warrior. But keep in mind, if you feel like fighting, that your martial arts skills are still non-existent.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15338.descriptionId:
This sword, with a blade as sharp as an Ecaflip's senses, excels both at cutting off limbs and cutting up sushi. For seppuku however, you might prefer this sword's little brother. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15339.descriptionId:
This shield is mainly used to terrify opponents. As if that weren't enough, the instruction manual says to throw it in your target's face and run away.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15340.descriptionId: This garden gnome's face is frozen in an annoying grimace. You feel an almost irresistible urge to kick him in the face.

15342.descriptionId: This superb undergarment will let your best features really shine.

15343.descriptionId: A steel tooth for a toothy grin.

15344.descriptionId: Provision sack and balaclava – this fake beard clearly has all the top-of-the-line features.

15345.descriptionId:
When created, this shield was placed under a powerful spell intended to exponentially increase the oratory talents of whoever carries it. However, a slight grammatical mistake in the incantation of the spell means that its power is only activated when it is used to create chaos.
In short, it's the perfect shield for family gatherings.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15346.descriptionId: This ring suddenly starts to shine in extreme heat, which can warn you about dramatic incidents if ever you don't realise on your own.

15347.descriptionId: If you're looking for a way to camouflage yourself in the desert, this cape could prove useful.

15348.descriptionId: Essential for walking on the hot sand without damaging the arch of your foot, these boots will also prevent you from sinking into quicksand.

15350.descriptionId: This strange and valuable ore is the pride of the Hard-Head clan.

15352.descriptionId: A finely worked fragment of Arkastone made sublime by the Stubbyobs' know-how.

15353.descriptionId: To make up for what the Stubbyobs call a "sorry lack of dramatic flare among Twelvians", Durandial, the smith, has made this Arkatector for you; it will alert you when Arkastone is nearby. Smaller than a Stubbyob, and less annoying, but just as effective!

15354.descriptionId: Have you always dreamt of having four tails? Then here you go!

15355.descriptionId: Ava Taroun won this necklace gambling against a passing Ecaflip, not long before he left for Vulkania.  Its former owner ensured her it would bring luck and fortune to whoever wears it. Ava's disappearance in mysterious circumstances at the heart of Pinki Crater suggests that it was a fable.

15356.descriptionId: This claw, more decorative than anything else, lets you pretend to be a monster from Vulkania's fauna. Don't try and fight with it, because you'd risk paying the price.

15357.descriptionId: Flo Inghair is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to the Hard-Head Militia.

15358.descriptionId:
This wax shield is just what you've always wanted for making moulds of your enemies' faces.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15359.descriptionId:
This cloak is excellent at hiding your lack of charisma, but it isn't quite long enough to hide your enormous posterior.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15360.descriptionId:
This is the undisputed palace of lice, fleas and ticks. Probably because it's so comfortable and smells like testosterone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15361.descriptionId:
This staff makes you feel positively regal. Heck, you can even leave the table whenever you want now!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15362.descriptionId: These boots are the cause of your favourite team's speediness, and are just as useful for racing to victory as fleeing from a thrashing.

15363.descriptionId:
An ideal protection from any projectiles that may be thrown during the match, this shield will be your most valuable ally in getting out of the stadium in one piece.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15364.descriptionId: This belt, which bears a picture of the reward earned by the Gobbowl World Cup winners, will let you gloat excessively to the other teams' supporters by giving you an air of superiority and snobbery.

15365.descriptionId:
This helmet in your favourite team's colours will make you the ultimate fan! Now all you have to do is yell "Go Bigoks!" in the Gobbowl stadium on a game night and hope your team doesn't lose miserably.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15366.descriptionId: This discreet amulet is great for timid fans or fans who aren't completely confident in their favourite team: it's easy to hide if your favourite team bombs.

15367.descriptionId:
An essential part of a Gobbowler's gear, the shield should be solid and block every blow. This one is just really pretty – it won't block anything, especially not your adversaries' insults.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15368.descriptionId: Not many fans go as far as wearing a belt with their favourite teams colours. That's what separates the true fans from the cheerleaders.

15369.descriptionId:
Proudly show your belief in the Greenengol by wearing this helmet. Or you could grab some pompoms and start screaming the name of your team, but that might be embarrassing.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15370.descriptionId:
This pet rolls up in a ball at the slightest hint of danger. Depending on how the ground slopes, it'll roll randomly in one direction and can sometimes work as a distraction.
Koalak Mountain is its favourite playground due to all the terrain it offers. It's therefore entirely natural that it feeds on the souls of the Koalaks it encounters.

15371.descriptionId: It just so happens that your pet here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15372.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15373.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15374.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15376.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Rebel Recruit ornament.

15377.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Early Rebel ornament.

15378.descriptionId: This scroll contains a fresh sketch. The stained paper gives off a sickening smell like a subtle mixture of mud and dirt.

15379.descriptionId: The world seems to have grown suddenly... Either that or you've shrunk...

15380.descriptionId:
A low-calorie snack made from mine mushrooms and enriched with Arkastone. One Stubbenol a day will make your rear end as round and firm as it was when you were 77.
Warning: the package insert says that excessive use may cause you to shower insults on everyone you meet, even your friends.
(This snack will turn you into a real Stubbyob until you start fighting.)

15381.descriptionId: Gari has agreed to show you his village if you go with him.

15382.descriptionId: A wide metal belt. You notice that there's a specially designed spot to hang your tankard of beer.

15383.descriptionId: The Arkastone shard set in this ring creates a small source of light in dark places, allowing its wearer to move about more easily in low-light environments like mines.

15384.descriptionId: An elegant helmet which will make all of your arguments a bit more cutting, both verbal and non-verbal.

15385.descriptionId: A last minute date? An unwanted stray hair? Not a problem if you bring your magnificent pocket razor with you on all your adventures. Never dulls, so you stay looking sharp! (Also available in blue.)

15386.descriptionId: If you ever feel like blending into a Stubbyob meeting unnoticed, this fake beard is just the thing for you.

15387.descriptionId: The sweet softness of this cloak offers a strange contrast to the bristly stiffness of the beards that so uniquely define the Stubbyob people.

15388.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

15389.descriptionId:
According a recent study, the symbol on this cape is a one-legged gnome with his arms spread wide.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15390.descriptionId: A very fashionable accessory, this necklace set with small gold-plated bones will be all the rage, especially if you go walking in the Sidimote Moors.

15391.descriptionId:
Granted, it's not very sharp, but you're the Emperor, your footmen will do the cutting for you!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15392.descriptionId: These varnished shoes are the height of fashion in some of the less well-developed countries of the World of Twelve. In Amakna, however, you might be mistaken for an ill-mannered immigrant.

15393.descriptionId:
Forged in the heart of a volcano, this shield offers weak protection against your opponents' insults. It is, however, highly effective at making their spray of spit evaporate before it reaches you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15394.descriptionId:
Since he's getting senile with old age, Moum-Ra regularly loses his hood, which forces him to steal them from other Mumystics.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15395.descriptionId: No one knows why the straps on this mankini are so long. Did it once belong to the lanky Rushu? Was it used as a catapult in the Battle of the Crimson Dawn? There's certainly something off-putting about it.

15396.descriptionId: The Boracelet is really a simple bracelet made of black plastic. Its creator, however, managed to turn it into a great commercial success by inventing madder and madder ways to use it. Some of them were in such dubious taste we'd rather not go into details here. And that's saying something.

15397.descriptionId:
This cape's little epaulettes will remind all the snotty toerags to call you "Boss".
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15398.descriptionId:
If only you were a little stronger and cooler, you could have used this shield as a shuriken.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15399.descriptionId:
Wearing this hat grants you the right to give the orders when you and your teammates are having fights... Snowball fights, that is!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15400.descriptionId:
Not only do you always feel under the weather when wearing this cloak, it doesn't even give you the flashes of inspiration you were hoping for.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15401.descriptionId:
Even if your next sword flail totally misses your enemy, at least you'll look electro-cute. Teehee!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15402.descriptionId:
The ears on this headgear act like two lightning rods. Finally, you've fulfilled your dream and become a conductor!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15403.descriptionId:
Lightning usually only strikes once, but it's strangely attracted to this shield.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15404.descriptionId:
There's nothing better to calm young Iops' zeal than a good whack of a Seastaff.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15405.descriptionId: To make the most of summer, why not show off your feet? They're just asking to get a tan!

15406.descriptionId:
When placed on your head, this flower – which only blooms in summer – will always point you in the sun's direction.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15407.descriptionId:
This lovely cape is the perfect adornment for a gentle summer's night.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15408.descriptionId:
Sensitive about those big ears of yours? Here's a good way to hide them.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15409.descriptionId:
In Bonta's colours, this cape gives its wearer the air of purity and candour. But, as they say, clothes don't make the mage...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15410.descriptionId:
Be careful not to get your head trapped because of this bell.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15411.descriptionId: Inspire terror among your adversaries by wearing this necklace in the form of a skull, the symbol of strength and brutality. If Khan does it, it must mean it works!

15412.descriptionId: Wearing these briefs won't make you a Gobbowl champion, but they'll sure show off your goods.

15413.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Sacrier class's special emote.

15414.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Enutrof class's special emote.

15415.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild, the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

15416.descriptionId: Straight from the Depths of Sufokia, this Glub owes its name to the sounds it makes when you pull it out of an underwater cavity – its natural habitat. Its cuddly side and its funny shape make it Trituns' best friend. It spreads terror among Moon Pirates, which it eats.

15417.descriptionId: It just so happens that your pet here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15418.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15419.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15420.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15421.descriptionId: Although not quite as cute as a Konalak, you'll feel just as much need to take care of it, cuddle it, stroke its head, and rub your face against its soft fur. To eliminate all competition and make sure it gets as many hugs as it can, it devours other koalaks' souls.

15422.descriptionId: It just so happens that your pet here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15423.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15424.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15425.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15426.descriptionId: As massive and heavy as it is deep, this tankard seems to have been used as a stool and a club as often as it was used for drinking.

15427.descriptionId: Massive pieces of armour that will protect you very effectively once you put them on, provided you're still able to move.

15428.descriptionId: These beard hairs are incredibly tough. Their rough and bushy appearance reminds you of the hairy coats of certain boars of the plains.

15429.descriptionId: Once you've climbed the steps, this key will give you access to the Hard-Head Dam.

15430.descriptionId: These teeth aren't reinforced with Arkastone like most Stubbyob false teeth. But they still have the same greyish colour as those artificial dentures, which doesn't reflect too well on Stubbyob hygiene.

15431.descriptionId: This heavy armour leaves you wondering how little creatures like Stubbyobs manage to wear it around all day without collapsing from exhaustion.

15432.descriptionId:
Looking at this sling brings back nostalgic memories of the old Robin the Hoodlum stories that your mum used to tell you at bedtime. 
And swinging it over your head for a second brings back more painful memories of multiple childhood trips to your local hospital. You somehow feel less nostalgic all of a sudden.

15433.descriptionId: These leggings seem to offer satisfactory protection thanks to their double strap that allows them to be adjusted to any body type.

15434.descriptionId: Unlike others of its kind, this Mastifang seemed to have exceptionally tough feet. They weren't much use escaping you, though.

15435.descriptionId: A Stapleworm without spikes is like a Sadida with nothing to sell at the marketplace: it loses everything that gives it its unique charm.

15436.descriptionId: This page, clearly ripped out of a very old book, is covered in strange symbols.

15437.descriptionId: You have captured a worm. Whatever are you going to do with it?

15438.descriptionId: If you don't move a muscle, maybe nobody will notice you!

15439.descriptionId:
This recipe, perfected by the famous alchemist Uba Tesse, is a favourite among greying Stubbyobs, and now it's your turn to use it.
- 1 Magic Redness Dye
- 1 Magic Orange Dye
- 40 Red Scaraleaf Wings
- 5 Shiny Sardines

15440.descriptionId: Given that Stubbyobs have a tendency to clench their jaws so tight they break their teeth, grithril is a good choice to replace their broken chiclets.

15441.descriptionId: These strange precious stones are unique in that they are entirely black, without the slightest sparkle.

15442.descriptionId: This is a simple grey pebble. That's all. Nothing more, nothing less.

15443.descriptionId: As soft and cushy as anyone could wish, this sleep aid will be your best friend at bedtime.

15444.descriptionId: This plushie goes "baaaaa" when you squeeze it.

15445.descriptionId: This wool is incredibly soft, despite its dense and bristly appearance.

15446.descriptionId: A thick string that's tough enough for use with the cargo lifts on Mount Neselite.

15447.descriptionId: (Sapphire, "Gleaming Gobball" farm, south-west of Mount Neselite. If you find this Gobball, please return it to its owner.)

15448.descriptionId: (Jade, "Gleaming Gobball" farm, south-west of Mount Neselite. If you find this Gobball, please return it to its owner.)

15449.descriptionId: (Topaz, "Gleaming Gobball" farm, south-west of Mount Neselite. If you find this Gobball, please return it to its owner.)

15450.descriptionId: Upsid Owncake has scribbled down the names and addresses for today's delivery.

15451.descriptionId: Upsid Owncake has scribbled down the names and addresses for today's delivery.

15452.descriptionId: A case of Grinness, ready for delivery.

15453.descriptionId: A case of Kronengob, ready for delivery.

15454.descriptionId: A case of Stellarga, ready for delivery.

15455.descriptionId: A case of Kramelite, ready for delivery.

15458.descriptionId: The foreman insisted that with a sharp eye, one could clearly make out the words "Property of the Hard-Head Clan" engraved on the precious stone. You didn't say anything at the time, but you suspect it may not be entirely true.

15459.descriptionId: Sharpened into quill pens for years, these feathers are now used to adorn the rich and famous. No wonder Crobaks are nervous creatures – anyone who knows the value of these feathers will go a long way to get their hands on them.

15460.descriptionId: It's hard to make out exactly what that nauseating little thing is, squirming around at the bottom of the bottle.

15461.descriptionId: An especially repulsive odour emanates from this little piece of sea grass. Rumour has it that certain tribes wrap their meals in this same type of seaweed.

15462.descriptionId: Sauteed with just a touch of oil and a bit of garlic, these mushrooms will be perfect for tonight's dinner.

15463.descriptionId: The longer you look at these glowing mushrooms, the more everything around you seems to start swaying and morphing in all kinds of crazy ways.

15464.descriptionId: This larva makes an unpleasant sucking sound every time it peels its body off the ground to move forward.

15465.descriptionId: In olden times, young Twelvians used Arachnee eggs as bouncing balls. Fun and easy to carry, but with a downside: kids sometimes found themselves with a bag full of Arachnees when they went to get their balls.

15466.descriptionId: Covered with a thin layer of dust, you can only imagine how many times this sweet has rolled on the floor.

15467.descriptionId: Flambéed or sliced, topped with melted chocolate or just on its own, this fruit is a delicious dessert.

15468.descriptionId: As unlikely as it seems, the sight of this slice of pizza almost makes you want to gobble it down. However, you can't be certain that the mushrooms scattered all over it were part of the recipe.

15469.descriptionId: These flowers are incredibly soppy and sweet, but you think they're cute all the same.

15470.descriptionId: You really have to wonder what sort of alchemical situation would actually call for toenails.

15471.descriptionId: What's orange, makes your eyes water, and puts holes in the linoleum? And no, it's not a Prespic with a brace and bit! If you're feeling depressed, there's nothing like a nice shot of fermented cawwot juice to put an end to all your worries. Consume diluted to avoid loss of sight and/or life.

15472.descriptionId: The shimmering water in this bucket reminds you of the blue expanse of the sea around Horrib Isle, minus the ghouls.

15473.descriptionId: What do I see? What do I see? Red, blue and green!

15474.descriptionId: A heady yet repulsive odour surrounds you as you near this yellowish cheese. Would some people actually be so bold as to eat this stuff?

15475.descriptionId: With its rosy colour and its cloud-like appearance, you might almost confuse it with a big heap of candy floss.

15476.descriptionId: Stubbyobs who are having bad luck often grow clover in individual pots. The really unlucky ones can't even get them to grow.

15477.descriptionId: A shiver runs down your spine when this fish's keen eyes look into yours.

15478.descriptionId: This little piece of Arkastone looks like an ordinary pebble. But when you take it in your hand, you feel an impressive power at its core.

15479.descriptionId: Boars all love acorns and everyone everywhere wonders why this is. Hey... a haiku.

15480.descriptionId: Pumpkin is delicious at any time of year, but it's mainly enjoyed in Septangel and Octolliard.

15481.descriptionId: While you may find this bulging eye revolting at first glance, you'll soon fall in love with its slimy texture.

15482.descriptionId: At first glance, it looks like a strange mixture of Grinness and... something else.

15483.descriptionId: Despite its completely opaque appearance, this juice gives off a sweet scent of flowers. You then notice a small "poison" label on the side and get away from it quickly.

15484.descriptionId: A powerful odour of red fruits seems to emanate from this flask.

15485.descriptionId: A powerful lemony odour seems to emanate from this flask.

15486.descriptionId: A powerful odour of plants seems to emanate from this flask.

15487.descriptionId: As fun as it is slimy, this starfish seems as fascinated by you as you are by it.

15488.descriptionId: A beer so thick that you can't even see through it. Its consistency comes from Arkastone powder added during the brewing process to give it that deep amber colour. This strong and highly nutritious beer is served with a clover.

15489.descriptionId: The fruity taste of this beer is a striking contrast to the famous virility and hairiness of the Zeesmithy family, a long line of anvil smashers. The secret to their technique lies in their open-tank brewing method. Since the Stubbyobs are especially resistant to heat, they can keep working in a room where the air temperature is close to the 72°C needed for a perfect brew.

15490.descriptionId: A bit misshapen at the sides, this skull seems awfully big for a Wabbit.

15492.descriptionId: The Hard-Heads often use Arkastone to make and repair weapons, armour and buildings. These solid Arkastone buttresses will be useful for reinforcing the Hard-Head Dam.

15493.descriptionId: Given that Stubbyobs have a tendency to clench their jaws so tight they break their teeth, Arkastone is a good choice to replace their broken chiclets.

15494.descriptionId: If you shake this gift vigorously and hold it to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise as if it contained a real live creature. Don't wait a moment longer, open it now!

15495.descriptionId: Peb'Houlud is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to the Hard-Head Militia.

15496.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15497.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15498.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15499.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15500.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15501.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15502.descriptionId: This bit of paper has been signed by a member of the Mount Neselite Protection Committee.

15503.descriptionId: Pattah Spinhair gave you this package to deliver to Eda Mame.

15504.descriptionId: Delicious and incredibly tender, this Tender Cawwot is a perfect addition to your favourite salad.

15505.descriptionId: Looking at this sand fills you with an irresistible urge to head for the beach.

15506.descriptionId: This highly concentrated potion will surely come in handy for moving the Mount Neselite Hefty Stone.

15510.descriptionId: This piece of Arkastone looks like an ordinary pebble. But when you take it in your hand, you feel an impressive power at its core.

15511.descriptionId: Mind your fingers! This Moumouse is off its rocker and ready to bite anything that gets near its snout.

15512.descriptionId: This symbolic item is a concrete sign of the Grodunk family's gratitude.

15513.descriptionId: This symbolic item is a concrete sign of the Zeesmithy family's gratitude.

15514.descriptionId:
This shield was designed to be carried on the back. Some use it because they need to protect their backsides while fighting, and others use it because they'll turn tail and run at the first sign of trouble.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15515.descriptionId:
Careful not to get bitten when you scratch its head.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15516.descriptionId:
Beautiful scales for a nicely rounded back.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15517.descriptionId:
You are finally equipped to play the Kikousaure!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15518.descriptionId:
This hat offers protection against bad weather. It should therefore be worn if you are in a stormy relationship and you keep getting the cold shoulder from your significant other.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15519.descriptionId:
Do not deflower this cape, or anything else, without consent.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15520.descriptionId: This ring has a different meaning depending on which finger it is worn. For example, on the middle finger, it means you are blossoming.

15521.descriptionId: These boots are said to improve Kwismas dinners. Independent studies have shown that wearers of this footwear do show a marked increase in their appreciation for sprouts.

15522.descriptionId:
Underneath its warrior-like appearance and unrivalled strength, this cape is soft and silky smooth. Finally, an item that will let you look both gentle and powerful at once.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15523.descriptionId:
This helmet provides optimal protection for the skull, but diminishes the visual field considerably. If you're used to rushing in headlong, this helmet will become your best friend.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15524.descriptionId: You'll be saying "wow" and taking bows every time you take this tiny bow wow out to do its business. Its ginger fur reminds you greatly of Stubbyob beards: you are what you eat, after all.

15525.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15526.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15527.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15528.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15529.descriptionId: This pet walks sideways so as to always have its back to you. It's hard to tell if it hates you or it trusts you implicitly. It feeds on other beach creatures.

15530.descriptionId: It just so happens that your pet here is only MOSTLY dead. There's a big difference between mostly dead and all dead. Mostly dead is slightly alive. Maybe you should find a way to revive it.

15531.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15532.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion which will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15533.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15534.descriptionId: Bring the wounded soldier to a healer as fast as possible

15535.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Jurassic ornament.

15536.descriptionId:
This shield lets you present your most beautiful summer hunting trophy to the world.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15537.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild, the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

15538.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Draeggosaure emote.

15539.descriptionId: If you'd like to quit using your bow and take up magic, or if you're bored with magic and have been eyeing that big sword over there in the corner, then this potion is for you! Gulp it down to instantly become the adventurer you long to be.

15540.descriptionId:
An exceptional shield for an exceptional warrior.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15541.descriptionId: More agile than a Tofu at dinner time, the Maulleycat surprises its prey with its extreme speed, which makes it an exceptional predator, and also uncatchable. It's said that anyone that can tame the furry beast while naked will acquire its speed. It feeds on rats, but is that really so surprising?

15542.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15543.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15544.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15545.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15546.descriptionId: Rather than raising flesh-and-blood Drhellers, Foggernauts prefer to make them out of spare parts. That way, they can change their appearance at will and provide them with any improvements they deem necessary. It devours Mechaniacs' souls.

15547.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15548.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the petsmount that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15549.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your petsmount.

15550.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your petsmount. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will cause disappointing results.

15551.descriptionId:
As soon as you say the word "divine", people can't help but answer "whine". Either this word has some link with the gods that you've failed to grasp, or your entourage has a really poor sense of humour.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15552.descriptionId:
This cape, also known as "The Adornment of the Gods", is known for its immaculate whiteness. Rumour has it that nothing can sully this cape, but it wasn't counting on your diet, mainly consisting of fatty foods, and your messy passion for sliding in the mud.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15553.descriptionId:
This helmet sends you visions from a distant astral plain, as if the gods you were whispering in your ear regarding the mysterious fate of the universe. Had you been someone else, you would have interpreted them and might have become an oracle or prophet, but fortunately, you don't understand a word of it.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15554.descriptionId:
Despite the large notch in it, the shield is so smooth and reflective that you can easily see your face in it. Legend has it that the former captain of the Boo Caneer crew would use his shield to fix his hair when no one was looking.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15555.descriptionId: Be wary of pedlars selling this cape, claiming it was made from several Dofus. This one certainly isn't as powerful as its paronym, but it's much more shimmery.

15556.descriptionId:
This sublime headgear will make you the unchallenged master of all fowl in the Bayou. 
Glory can be just as foul.

15557.descriptionId: Between this beautifully colourful belt, your rolling gait and your incessant clucking, you can now blend in perfectly with your feathered friends from the Bayou.

15558.descriptionId: These elegant little boots covered with the feathers of innocent Dodus reflect your taste for the finer things in life... and your lack of interest in protecting Dodus' lives.

15560.descriptionId: This is a fragment from a larger, more important, more powerful being than you, and it makes the puny little carcass in which you took up residence at the time of your birth seem very humble indeed. However, the creature from whom you took this scale is clearly less "all in one piece" than you, which is a starting point in what might be the first successful episode of your life.

15561.descriptionId: What a sight! You hold a piece of history here... part of a plastron that safeguards the natural state of a monster born among ashes and salt. This fragment of a mighty being crackles in your hands, calling you to a challenge that you won't be able to refuse. You will bleed and burn like a star in the firmament... but this is progress for someone of your calibre.

15562.descriptionId: Civilisations protected by folk braver than you have been extinguished by the beast to whom this scale belongs. Behind your pasty little face hides the bravest of ideas... that of a heroic confrontation after which the bards will sing your name. But you must make haste: this ardent shell is unlikely to become a trophy if all that you want to protect goes up in flames.

15563.descriptionId: Once upon a time, Osamodas summoned two Guardians to preserve Amakna's Dreggons. I am sure he would have liked to see a hero like you sacrificing yourself in the fires of their revenge. Fortunately, nature knows what she does: you hold in your hands the open-sesame offering a one-way ticket to this fabulous bestiary of the Great Conjurer, now gathered for a new purge.

15564.descriptionId: There is no doubt that this stone is older than you can ever hope to be. You do not know where it came from, and nor would you wish to. What you do see, however, is that there is blood. The blood of dragons with magical properties. It might be a good idea to confer with Pistachio, who can be found in the Amaknian countryside.

15565.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

15609.descriptionId: Whether you've got two eyes or fifty... The most important thing is always to keep your eyes on the prize.

15610.descriptionId: A wood sculptor had started by carving bows from dead branches found in the Dark Forest. Sadly, they were too soft when drawn and proved to be unusable by the authorities. The sculptor then tried his hand at truncheons made from Soft Oak branches. Surprisingly hard as nails, they were immediately adopted by Brakmar instructors, who continue to use them on the heads of unruly Chafers to this day.

15611.descriptionId:
Something about this shield captivates you, but you can't quite put your finger on what – and it's keeping you awake at night. It is handsome – very handsome – but you've got better things to do at night than stare at it constantly, starting with getting rid of those horrid bags under your eyes or doing your homework.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15612.descriptionId:
When wet, this shield tends to become a little salami and you may find that carrying it makes you rather ham-fisted.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15613.descriptionId:
The Sadida King made this shield so he could touch wood when he found himself at a disadvantage. The fact that the Sadida King is no more today says a lot about the effectiveness of such an act.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15614.descriptionId:
With this shield on your arm, everyone will think you're returning from a long holiday in the islands. Too bad you didn't get the tan to prove it!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15615.descriptionId: A heavy key used by Stubbyobs of the Hard-Head Clan to repair the dam or scare off Twelvian tourists who are a little too curious.

15616.descriptionId: This thin blade imbued with the blood of many vampires has been used to kill over the course of years. The disturbing scent of onions emanates from the handle on very hot days.

15617.descriptionId: Although imposing, this sword is still very manageable. Its wide blade guarantees perfectly sliced-up ghouls of all sorts.

15618.descriptionId: This sword belonged to a butcher called Franky Abatz who used it to disembowel his enemies for sausage meat. I used to go to that stall... Believe me, I made sure the dirty mongrel paid for every sausage he ever sold.

15619.descriptionId: These incredibly robust crystals are exceptional materials used by the Guild of Hunters to make their weapons and armour.

15620.descriptionId: The Kanniballs fashioned this item with an image of Moon, who they consider the God-Monkey of the island. According to legend, it was a strike of the monkey hammer that gave it the shape of a crescent moon. At least, that's what the employees at Charlie's Agents tell travellers who come to spend their holidays on the island when they're trying to extort a few kamas for the amulet.

15621.descriptionId:
This cloak is made from kokoko leaves and citronanas, which explains its exotic colours and undeniable charm. Unfortunately, it emits a less charming odour that attracts every kind of wild animal imaginable, who take you for a giant, delicious banana.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15622.descriptionId:
Moon found this magical hammer when he was captured by a Poacher pirate. In his hands, a single hammer strike to the ground is enough to cause an earthquake, which is especially handy when trying to shake down the kokokonuts in the highest branches.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15623.descriptionId: Created by a witch of questionable morals, this amulet can tighten on command. Weirdly, the witch was never short of volunteers to wear it.

15624.descriptionId:
Thanks to this cape, you can finally justify wearing tattered rags every day.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15625.descriptionId: As the swimsuit version was too risky, you opted for this belt to force you to keep an eye on your waistline, and thus keep a flat stomach.

15626.descriptionId:
With this crown on your head, Treechnids might mistake you for Chopperella. So, don't be surprised if while walking through the forest, a woodland prince suddenly puts his knobbly lips to yours.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15627.descriptionId:
"What is dead cannot protect."
That's the motto of champions who keep their shields to defend themselves instead of giving them to their weaker allies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15628.descriptionId:
"It doesn't shine when it comes to intelligence."
This quotation could be used to describe this cape, as well as some of your closest friends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15629.descriptionId:
The two horns on this headgear can be used as lightning rods in order to give you flashes of genius.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15630.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Sadida class's special emote.

15631.descriptionId: This shovel straight out of Ohwymi was spit up by Peb'Houlud. It undoubtedly belonged to one of the archaeologists sent by the Corporation to study the fauna on the island.

15633.descriptionId: This soft, silky feather would be perfect for stuffing pillows.

15634.descriptionId: This feather of sparkling colours is particularly appreciated by the Pazteks when crafting ornamental masks.

15635.descriptionId: This is a beautifully soft, silky feather that's perfect for the best little tickles!

15636.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere.

15637.descriptionId:
Bzzzzzz. Bzzzzzzz. Bzz Bzz. Bzzz? Bzzz!
This pet loves terrorising Stubbyobs, and draws its strength from theirs. 
It feeds on the inhabitants of Mount Neselite – or at least those found on the surface. What on earth is behind that door?

15638.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15639.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15640.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15641.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15642.descriptionId: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.
