Use this scroll to attain level 100 in the Tailor profession.

15658.descriptionId: This skull was taken from the corpse of an especially dangerous Ghoulaurant.

15659.descriptionId:
(Allows you to use the spell: Binary Bloodlust)
From its appearance, as well as its deformity, you realise very quickly that this fake Dofus comes most certainly from a Shushu.
Although it's not known how, one of these demons' souls is contained within it, and it closely scrutinises the outside world.
Its eyes, grafted to the walls of the egg, allow it to see and spy on everything.
You can sometimes hear whispers coming from the captive Shushu.

15660.descriptionId: This plaster is imbued with the powerful curse weighing on Mummy Nova. Make sure you don't mistake it for an ordinary plaster. Perhaps you should visit Pistachio in Amakna to learn more.

15661.descriptionId: The Boostoplasm stain in guise of a signature on this contract demonstrates Boostache's desire to help you confront the guilty party in this dessert debacle.

15662.descriptionId: The tiny drawing of a skull and crossbones in guise of a signature on this contract demonstrates B'one Shot's desire to help you confront the guilty party in the dessert debacle.

15663.descriptionId: Don't use these strips of cloth to wipe up just anything. You're likely to leave a trace.

15664.descriptionId: This plaster is imbued with the powerful curse weighing on Mummy Nova. Not to mention other, much harder to identify and less disgusting things. Do not swallow.

15665.descriptionId:
Morgan Forr, nicknamed the Air Knight, is an old man (in excellent shape for his age), who defends widows and orphans, along with his loyal flying destrier, Pier. He claims to be an "independent righter of wrongs" and says he used to be the god of a celestial island, back in the day. Perhaps he's lost his marbles after all those years of solitude, but he's still a hero in the eyes of the little people.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15666.descriptionId:
The Air Knight helps the most vulnerable by fighting for them when they get into trouble. He's given them a whistle so they can easily call him in case of difficulty. But clearly not everyone has the same understanding of the word "difficulty", so the knight has a very busy schedule that alternates between epic fights and thankless chores.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15667.descriptionId:
According to the Air Knight, this helmet is the most aerodynamic helmet ever made. Experts all agree that this title actually belongs to the Wind Kwak headdress, but they're also keen to point out that the knight's helmet is also "really cool". 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15668.descriptionId:
With this multi-functional shovel, the Air Knight can fight off his enemies and repot pumpkins in his vegetable patch. Rather practical, don't you think? 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15669.descriptionId: The legend says that this amulet contains the soul of a powerful magician who challenged and defeated Ecaflip at celestial belote, the favourite card game of the Twelve. If you wear it around your neck while playing cards, maybe he'll make an appearance...

15670.descriptionId:
If you haven't got a lively spirit and a virtuous spirit, you can at least look like you do, thanks to these wings made from pure celestial matter.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15671.descriptionId:
Thanks to the light coming from this headpiece, no one will be able to surprise you, which is a useful feature for walking around Incarnam in peace.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15672.descriptionId:
This orange headband may well be little out of fashion, but it's still effective: now you're a mysterious righter of wrongs, a defender of the oppressed! You'll have to rise to the occasion. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15673.descriptionId:
The Green Ninja's shell is useful for both holding its weapons and protecting its rear. In your case, it's also handy for hiding your spinal malformation and your huge bum.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15674.descriptionId:
The first thing you did when you got your hands on these nunchakus was to imagine yourself doing all sorts of windmills and figures-of-eight to impress your enemies. It's only after months of training and multiple facial and groin injuries that you realised that there's more to the mastery of this weapon than meets the eye (and groin). Becoming a ninja isn't all that easy.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15675.descriptionId:
This shield, made from a hot Margorito pizza, won't protect you from blows, but you can still throw it at your enemy's feet to distract them while you run away like the little coward you are. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15676.descriptionId: These size 2 waders were made for Ecaflips with small feet. Unless you share a shoe size with Kerub, they'll make a lovely decoration for your living room.

15677.descriptionId:
Those who are victorious write history. Those who flee, endure it. And those who look, look away.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15678.descriptionId: This marvellous piece of armour is an exact replica of the breeches Kerub wore. It will stop any enemy weapons heading cruelly towards your intimate areas.

15679.descriptionId:
Many proud warriors have attempted in vain to put this helmet on in the pursuit of its power, but it only confers its abilities on someone whose head can fill it completely. So far only Kerub has succeeded, which has made him the legend we all know. Will you manage to take his place?
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15680.descriptionId:
If you doubt their power, know that these Nunchaku have left scars on even the most redoubtable beings in the World of Twelve. Admit it: that shut you up!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15681.descriptionId:
Some say you need a tail to wear this piece of armour, while others say it's only ceremonial. Anyone who's seen Kerub use it can tell you it's possible to be both extremely classy and extremely deadly at the same time.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15682.descriptionId: Worn as a necklace by very large beings, this Torque is the main piece of Kerub's armour, protecting his entire upper torso.

15683.descriptionId:
"Greet your guests courteously, then stab them in the back when they turn away." That's your philosophy. Un-lackey for some!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15684.descriptionId:
Now that you have this hat, your masters will be able to keep you in their sights at all times and constantly call upon your services.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15685.descriptionId:
This cloak has been enhanced by the addition of a dustpan and brush extension. Now you can keep on opening doors and carrying your masters' bags without needing to interrupt those all-important cleaning sessions.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15686.descriptionId:
This shield will provide effective protection from swipes and blows from certain masters. It can also be flipped and used as a platter to serve them.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15687.descriptionId:
This headgear will give you an excuse to look like something the dog dug up without having to mention last night's party.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15688.descriptionId:
The person who sold you this cape claimed to have acquired it from a wise old hermit who lived long ago, in a crypt where he meditated, far away from the stupidity of man. The hermit must have been truly wise and very brave to live in such deprivation and put up with the smell of urine, alcohol and dead animals that emanate from this cape.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15689.descriptionId:
Filled with powerful magic, this shield will protect you from crypts. You can, of course, get attacked in a crypt, but not by the crypt itself, or so your friends tell you. It's clear that those oblivious fools have never been attacked by a garden shed, or they'd have bought this shield too.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15690.descriptionId:
Originating from another time, historians don't understand how this shield came to be found in the Dofus Era.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15691.descriptionId:
Legend has it that this shield was previously owned by a great peacemaker, who adorned the shield with a star for each conflict he ended.
While no one knows where these conflicts took place, it is still a highly impressive piece of work.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15692.descriptionId:
This shield – which is much better at decorating than protecting – shakes up preconceived notions, tilts truths, and makes legends tremble. It is also your way of proclaiming to the world: "Let Shariva laugh!"
The following inscription can also be read on the back: "Forged in the Maelstrom." 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15693.descriptionId:
The two feathers attached to this axe help it fly further when you throw it at an adversary.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15694.descriptionId:
The feathers on this cloak will slow down your fall when you slip out of bed in the night.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15695.descriptionId:
The three feathers on this shield enable it to be used as a boomerang that never comes back.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15696.descriptionId:
With all these feathers on your head, only Piwis will look up to you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15697.descriptionId: If in some dreadfully unfortunate circumstance, someone were to push granny into a bunch of cacti, don't worry! Dauge won't hesitate for a second before helping her and becoming the sole beneficiary of her will. Dauge feeds on others of its kind in the Sidimote Moors.

15698.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15699.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15700.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15701.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15702.descriptionId: Legends claim that the Eliom, a chatty and mischievous spirit, is a wandering soul that is not ready for reincarnation just yet. Although it can be irritating, even annoying at times, the Eliom is not evil at heart... It just likes to get into people's ears with its shrill voice. The Eliom devours Fungi souls.

15703.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15707.descriptionId: In this volume of "Paztek for Ninnies", you'll find all the rudiments of the mysterious Paztek language. We suggest you also acquire the companion volume, "Paztek-Twelvian Dictionary" (by the same publisher).

15708.descriptionId: This dictionary is a compendium of Paztek words and expressions. In order to better understand this mysterious language, we recommend you also acquire the companion volume, "Paztek for Ninnies" (by the same publisher).

15709.descriptionId:
Mummy Nova found this tiny Borbat outside her hideaway in Amakna. This poor animal had gotten lost, followed the scent of Pumpkwins, and ended up far from Al Howin's home. You're its new mummy now.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15710.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15711.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15712.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15713.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15714.descriptionId: The result of Doctor Morose's experiments, the Mastostroke was created by repeatedly crossing angora bow meows with evil dandelions. Its mischievous character, inherited from its gene pool, has made it the target of much Iopery. The pirates that turned it into a Gobbowl ball are now it's favourite food.

15715.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15719.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Moon Tourist ornament.

15720.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Sram class's special emote.

15722.descriptionId: Didn't anyone mention the side effects?

15723.descriptionId: If you eat this sweet, you're sure to be looking at the world through rose-coloured glasses.

15724.descriptionId: Didn't anyone mention the side effects?

15725.descriptionId: This sweet will have you glowing – even in the dark. A shining star.

15726.descriptionId: Didn't anyone mention the side effects?

15727.descriptionId: With a little luck, this sweet won't have you breathing fire, but you just might get a little red around the edges.

15728.descriptionId: Didn't anyone mention the side effects?

15729.descriptionId: While it won't turn you into a Jelly, this sweet will have you looking like one.

15730.descriptionId: This sweet will increase experience received for 5 fights.

15731.descriptionId: This sweet will keep you serene, even during the most important moments of your life.

15732.descriptionId: You've just found this scroll in a bottle you tripped over.

15733.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Talented Smithmagus".

15734.descriptionId: This Gobtubby is wearing a disguise out of solidarity with its gobball friends, as Al Howin is a traumatic time for the fluffy creatures; they are forced to don silly pumpkwin masks to try and scare Astrubians. This pet feeds on Fungi's souls.

15735.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15736.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15737.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15738.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15739.descriptionId: This compass seems to point in any direction as you walk. Perhaps it will lead you to fortune?

15740.descriptionId: The most important thing for treasure hunters is to have a sense of smell. If you don't have one yourself, this cloak should help.

15741.descriptionId: After a long career as a researcher spent scouring every path looking for gold and precious stones, you at least deserve some waterproof boots to wade through the mud.

15742.descriptionId: This sharp beak could be dangerous if it were to close on your skin.

15743.descriptionId: This lovely flower is worn during the mating season by female Dofus looking for a partner.

15744.descriptionId: This piece of watermelon looks juicy and unparallelled in freshness.

15745.descriptionId: What better than some headgear to gear up a head like yours? Nothing, surely.

15746.descriptionId: An orb with a surface as smooth as an Enutrof's shiny head and filled with a small amount of magical energy.

15747.descriptionId: An orb with a surface as smooth as an Enutrof's shiny head and filled with a large amount of magical energy.

15748.descriptionId: An orb with a surface as smooth as an Enutrof's shiny head and filled with a huge amount of magical energy.

15749.descriptionId: Every Shushu has a token to indicate their rank within the hierarchy.

15750.descriptionId: It is said that this volcanic rock comes from a faraway island in the Archipelago of Scales. Known to the Paztek as Shibaparta, and considered sacred, it is a valuable resource that can be used as a currency for trading.

15751.descriptionId:
The heating function of this cloak allows you to put meat to be cooked on the spikes decorating the back of it. 
How could you refuse such a useful garment?

15752.descriptionId: The way you're waving it around, this sceptre is definitely a lethal weapon.

15753.descriptionId: These large knives are formidable in expert hands – or in Crocodyl hands...

15754.descriptionId: The perfect crown for a monarch who wants to keep an eye on one's subjects.

15755.descriptionId: It's certainly much more pleasant to wear this ring than to kiss it on another person's hand. But that's not really a sign of quality.

15756.descriptionId: These flip-flops are ideal for asserting your power as a monarch. You can show how much you're stretching your toes are while others are slaving away. It's a must-have.

15757.descriptionId: It's said that this sacred headgear has the power to protect its wearer from curses – and it even has a return-to-sender feature. It is also said that this headgear was designed by the Dream Academy, a renowned school of magic. Shortly after it was crafted, the school was struck by a strange curse and its members disappeared one by one.

15759.descriptionId: This Dofus shard gives off a noxious, disturbing aura. But the power it holds quickly makes you forget your unease.

15760.descriptionId: This golden, fruity wafer is the ideal travelling companion for your adventures. Maybe because it's the only thing that'll put up with you.

15761.descriptionId: Once fried and properly seasoned, these bird wings are truly delightful for your tastebuds, but a tragedy for your figure. Just as well the recipe includes some fruit to stop you from feeling guilty.

15762.descriptionId: This Preserved Bird Meat may now be kept for several days before cooking.

15763.descriptionId:
Mini drumsticks for maximum taste.

(This meat can be harvested by level-50 and higher Hunters.)

15770.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Kwismas ornament.

15771.descriptionId: Lets you display the Legend ornament of Ascension Island.

15772.descriptionId: Lets you display the Diamond ornament of Ascension Island.

15773.descriptionId: Lets you display the Crystal ornament of Ascension Island.

15774.descriptionId: Lets you display the Gold ornament of Ascension Island.

15775.descriptionId: Lets you display the Silver ornament of Ascension Island.

15776.descriptionId: Lets you display the Bronze ornament of Ascension Island.

15777.descriptionId: This potion lets you teleport to Ascension Island. Be careful where you put your feet on arrival, or you could end up inside a Crocodyl!

15778.descriptionId: This mixture is really quite repulsive! You'd never dare drink it... Never, isn't that right?

15779.descriptionId: This sturdy stem may be used to craft several items.

15780.descriptionId: This sturdy stem may be used to craft several items.

15781.descriptionId: This sturdy stem may be used to craft several items.

15782.descriptionId: This sturdy stem may be used to craft several items.

15783.descriptionId: You are now disguised as a Crocodyl. Without anyone noticing, you'll be able to infiltrate Orado.

15784.descriptionId: It's said that the Scale King himself ripped out a fang to make himself a lucky charm. The fact that you're wearing it around your neck would indicate that it isn't very effective.

15785.descriptionId: Cut from a ship's sail, this cape makes you want to sail away.

15786.descriptionId: This headgear will give you a big mouth – a hawkin' big mouth – and you'll be able to make a fortune at the Astrub market.

15788.descriptionId: These sandals with platform soles allowed Paztek high priestesses to perform ritual sacrifices without leaving dried blood between the toes.

15789.descriptionId: This ceremonial cloak is both comfortable and warm, which stops its wearer from catching a cold because of the many draughts going round temple-tops.

15790.descriptionId:
During rituals, Paztek high priestesses wore large masks to reflect their rank. 
The purpose of these masks was to protect the priestesses from blood splatters, so as not to deprive the gods of part of their offering.

15791.descriptionId: Sacrificial daggers are very precious items. Upon reaching adolescence, Pazteks receive these weapons blessed by the high priestess. These daggers are then linked forever more to a single Paztek and are used only during sacrificial rituals. Using them outside of rites is, however, allowed in the event of imminent danger.

15792.descriptionId: Style and practicality come together with these boots. Although they're admittedly somewhat worn, they'll let you go around wet areas with ease! The bayou will hold no secrets for you when you wander around it like a Crocodyl in... Wait, what?

15793.descriptionId: By wearing this cape, you'll feel the soul of a great adventurer waiting for you, ready to duke it out with the unexplored world. Then, very quickly, you'll notice that the fastener doesn't really stay where it should... Ah, collectors' items!

15794.descriptionId: Recognised by his peers for his many accomplishments in maritime discovery, Captain Meno is believed to be one of the first navigators – if not the first – to have reached the Archipelago of Scales. This solid helmet will no doubt let you relive this bold achievement through its scratched glasses and worn look.

15795.descriptionId:
With its long sharp fangs and tousled hair, this shield is fearsome enough to instil fear in your enemies' hearts. The way it resembles your mother-in-law seems to be purely by chance, even if quite obvious.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15796.descriptionId:
This thick fur cape is uniquely comfortable, perfect for facing the hardships of winter. Your friends say you look plump when you wear it, when actually, it's the hair that makes you feel puffy.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15797.descriptionId:
This headgear is ideal for exploring the frozen lands of Kwismas Island, as the thickness of the hair stops the cold from getting through, and the glasses protect the eyes during snowstorms. But be careful that you're not mistaken for a Slayhound – a misguided hunter might inadvertently shoot at you.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15798.descriptionId: This Crocodyl statuette has the unique property of being completely white. Two rubies have been put in place of the eyes.

15799.descriptionId:
Behind its adorable appearance, the Raccoon is a cruel and highly meticulous animal. It both scares you and impresses you at the same time: it'll always clean your enemies, do their makeup and dress them up properly, before finishing them off in cold blood. It's a weird habit, but one that has the merit of giving them a dignified death. You can have a clear conscience. 
It feeds on the Undried that it just can't kill for good.

15800.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15801.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15802.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15803.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15804.descriptionId: You are now disguised as a Crocodyl. You'll be able to infiltrate Orado without anyone noticing.

15805.descriptionId: This little Arachnee follows you everywhere now... but why?

15806.descriptionId: This potion will definitely allow you to communicate with the Arachnee in Mage Upichu's hut.

15807.descriptionId:
This Shushu eye caught in amber is as fascinating as it is disturbing.
Exchange it with Kitlatonak in [-73/-17] to try and improve part of your ascension.

15809.descriptionId: It's a long, sharp blade that looks like it could cut through anything.

15810.descriptionId: A piece of the strange and valuable ore that is the pride of the Hard-Head clan.

15811.descriptionId: This brooch is meticulously crafted, and has many decorations enhanced with precious stones. An elegant "M" is engraved on the back of the jewel.

15812.descriptionId: This potion has a powerful, vomit-inducing smell. You'd have to be quite mad to drink it!

15813.descriptionId: This maritime map shows exactly how to navigate through the Archipelago of Scales.

15814.descriptionId: If you sewed them together, these pieces of cloth could form a nice, solid sail for your boat.

15815.descriptionId: Lets you know if the player has completed the quest "The Secrets of the Bensieve" (1500).

15816.descriptionId: This vial contains a sample of Mage Upichu's bensieve. A memory is kept within it.

15819.descriptionId: You reek of a putrid smell. How horrible!

15820.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Masqueraider class's special emote.

15821.nameId: {Quest "The Secrets of the Bensieve" (1500) Complete + Mucane Dialogue Already Seen}
15821.descriptionId: Lets you know if the player has completed the quest "The Secrets of the Bensieve" (1500) and if they have already seen the dialogue with Mucane after defeating her.

15822.descriptionId:
Use this item to leave Ascension Island. 
Warning: your progress in the current threshold will be lost.

15823.descriptionId: Let's just say that under this hat you'll find anything but gifts.

15824.descriptionId: This item lets you resume right from the last floor attempted.

15825.descriptionId: This small magic potion gives ingredients a magnificent greenish effect. Oh, and it seems to have a few magical powers.

15826.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Bolgrot's Wrath special emote.

15827.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legendary Climber 1".

15828.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Diamond Climber".

15829.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Crystal Climber".

15830.descriptionId: The preferred headgear of adventurers everywhere, it's been awarded "Hunters' Product of the Year" three years in a row! "This helmet will give you the looks and elegance of great men." Sponsored by the great Klay Kayton.

15831.descriptionId: A snout torn from a ferocious beast several months ago is encrusted in the centre of this ring. Despite the greenish, speckled look and the foul smell coming off the snout, this ring will do you proud within the distinguished hunters' community.

15832.descriptionId: Whoever said that hunting was a byword for bad taste? With these super-flashy boots, you won't need to lie low in the undergrowth any more to surprise your target! Animals are quite simply hypnotised by the trendy colours of your new boots.

15834.descriptionId:
Even though it's made of pure gold, this headband weighs almost nothing! This is probably due to the light feathers adorning the headdress. This light fluff will also serve as an effective earmuff when you are on the snowy heights of Ascension Island.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15835.descriptionId: A lover of Goblimps' warped sense of humor, Komet was charmed by your own. He decided to leave the snowy forests of Kwismas Island so he could accompany you on many a rousing adventure. This pet feeds on Wabbits' souls.

15836.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15837.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15838.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15839.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15840.descriptionId:
Its little tadpole face reminds you of someone... But who?
This pet feeds exclusively on creatures from the Jelly family.

15841.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15842.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

15843.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15844.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15845.descriptionId: This petsmount is completely unable to keep its head out of the clouds, preferring to embark on wild flights of fancy and going wherever the wind blows. It likes to dream of a place where it can roam freely without adventurers always trying to mount it.

15846.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15847.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the petsmount that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15850.nameId: {Display Ul'Khan on map 50bis of the TOA}
15850.descriptionId: GD Context: To display Ul'Khan on the TOA ending map

15851.descriptionId: Kwismas magic has transformed you... literally.

15852.descriptionId: You, too, can taste the Kwismas spirit. Contains no additives or preservatives.

15853.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

15854.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Jack of Hearts ornament.

15855.descriptionId: This cape has a scaly coating, making it waterproof and perfect for use as a sledge while on holiday on Kwismas Island.

15856.descriptionId: With this headgear, you can mingle with the Scaly population in the city unnoticed. Same colour, same smell.

15857.descriptionId: If you want to take a bite out of life, what could be better than a belt adorned with a Scaly skull? Just make sure you don't injure yourself in the loo.

15865.descriptionId: This bag contains several babbage leaves.

15867.descriptionId: This bag contains several measures of pepper.

15868.descriptionId: This bag contains several measures of magical cure.

15870.descriptionId: Is used to display the bonus dialogue of Laura Soho if the player talks to her in temporal bubble 1.29

15872.descriptionId: This bag contains several measures of salt.

15873.descriptionId: This barrel contains several drinking waters.

15876.descriptionId: This barrel contains several infected bloods.

15878.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Rising Star".

15879.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Ace of Stars".

15880.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15881.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
This allows you to obtain the Astral Hero ornament.

15882.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legendary Climber".

15883.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Diamond Climber".

15884.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Crystal Climber".

15885.descriptionId: Yellow eyes are generally a symptom of an ailing liver. It just goes to show that your mum was right and the Scalies' carnivorous diet might not be the best example to follow.

15886.descriptionId: This Scaly scale seems destined to become a new handbag.

15887.descriptionId: A thick Scaly hide to help you hide from the cold.

15888.descriptionId: Given how big it is, this fang really brings home the meaning of the expression "it's like pulling teeth".

15889.descriptionId: This bag contains several hunks of blubber.

15891.descriptionId: Something is written on this piece of parchment.

15892.descriptionId: Something is written on this scrap of parchment paper.

15893.descriptionId: Something is written on this scrap of parchment paper.

15894.descriptionId: Something is written on this scrap of parchment paper.

15895.descriptionId: Something is written on this scrap of parchment paper.

15896.nameId: Full Story of the Pilgrim of Knowledge
15896.descriptionId: This parchment contains the full story of the Pilgrim of Knowledge.

15906.descriptionId: You've been turned into a Stubbtenant so you can lead the Stubbyob squad.

15908.descriptionId:
Discreet, submissive, weak, servile, fearful, dependent: the marvellous woman doesn't have any of these qualities. She does have a wonderful look though, thanks to this shield.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15909.descriptionId:
This shield, made from black dragon scales, might make you think of a charred skull. If you could breathe fire, it would be brilliantly threatening to your enemies.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15910.descriptionId:
This cape is very useful if you need to pass yourself off as a huge lizard or puny dragon. Be warned, however. Its wings won't let you fly, and the tail doesn't grow back, so be careful.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15911.descriptionId:
A fierce jawline, sharp fangs, made from the darkest black metal edged with gold, glowing eyes under scaly eyebrows – this full-face helmet has all the bells and whistles if you want to make an impression. It is, shall we say, not very practical if you want to pick your nose, cough, sneeze, or even throw up.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15912.descriptionId:
It seems that this backpack carries the answer to an ultimate question that hasn't been asked yet. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15913.descriptionId:
The origin of this shield is still a great mystery; no one knows where it came from, nor what it's made of. However, some use it as a dice tray when games get heated.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15914.descriptionId:
This helmet has no business being in this world, and even less business being on your head. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15915.descriptionId: Dehluge and Brulay get along quite well, despite their very opposite temperaments: while Brulay tends to be hot-headed, Dehluge prefers the path of least resistance. However, he's definitely not afraid to dive in and get his feet wet.

15916.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15920.descriptionId: Brulay is a bit of a hot-head with a short fuse. You'd better not upset him if you'd like to keep your butt out of the fire.

15921.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15935.descriptionId:
This technological parasite seems to come from a different era. Despite its harmful impact on the environment, adventurers are deliriously fond of it and ready to do anything to get their hands on one.
Noxine devours scaraleaves' souls.

15936.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15937.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the petsmount that you left at the Bow Kennel.

15938.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

15939.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

15940.descriptionId:
It's hard to know if this creature is alive or whether it's an item inhabited by powerful magic. You won't get the answer by burning it.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15945.descriptionId:
Tanuks don't hit puberty for a few decades, but when they do, they gain both their independence and a ferocious temper. Before adolescence they're as docile as a lazy Bow Meow, but it's impossible to tell the males from the females, since their distinguishing features at this age haven't grown much bigger than their tails. The poachers working in Pandala make a nice bit of money from the trafficking of these creatures, to which you are contributing by taking this little Tanuk under your wing.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15950.descriptionId:
Dracolytes are loyal and affectionate animals who will follow you everywhere. True, they don't have the stature of a real dragon, nor even of a Dreggon, but they can breathe modest flames and cook small amounts of food to perfection! This may appear useless, but how many have perished because they neglected good cooking at a critical moment?
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15955.descriptionId:
Unfortunately, heartfelt kisses aren't enough to keep your Minikron fed.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15960.descriptionId:
Unlike the Maho Firefoux, the Fouxar won't transform into a Yokai Fouxar when in combat. But it does like to roll up into a ball and hide until the fighting is over, letting you do all the work. You thought you'd managed to tame a vicious predator, but you ended up with an adorable pet instead. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

15965.descriptionId: Quite unlike Sirocco, Kompost is very down-to-earth, undoubtedly the perfect companion for those with their head in the clouds. He'll keep your feet solidly on the ground, forcefully if need be.

15966.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

15971.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Pilgrim of Knowledge".

15972.descriptionId: This coloured paper contains a gift just for you!

15973.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Anomalies emote.

15974.descriptionId: This potion lets you teleport to Mage Upichu's house.

15975.descriptionId: You're accompanying Araknas to his temple inside the city of Orado.

15976.descriptionId: This powder lets you revive the braziers in the city of Orado.

15977.descriptionId: This powder has already been used on a brazier in Orado.

16004.descriptionId: This medallion is covered with blood. But not even that can hide the finesse and value of the jewel. The precious stone set in its centre lights up the gilding with a delicate emerald glow. An elegant "Z" is engraved on its back.

16005.descriptionId: This is a very light dagger. Its finely worked blade is covered with scratches bearing witness to the many victims it offered up in sacrifice.

16006.descriptionId: This fresh blood came a creature on Orado Island.

16007.descriptionId: This blood pouch contains a few kalitres of blood.

16008.descriptionId: This Ice Dofus isn't really real and does not have the power of the original artefact. A temporal anomaly made it possible to take the Dofus out of phase with its original time.

16009.descriptionId: These heavy arkastone chains radiate impressive power. Yerg's know-how and talent are obvious in this artefact. These chains could subdue the Shushu Ul'Khan.

16010.descriptionId: This piece of arkastone looks like an ordinary pebble. But when you take it in your hand, you feel an impressive power at its core.

16011.descriptionId: This is a beautifully soft, silky feather that's perfect for the best little tickles! Too bad you're not in the mood for tickles right now.

16012.descriptionId: This bit of bronze is guaranteed to get you into the Scale King's pyramid. It doesn't make any promises about getting you back out in one piece, though.

16013.descriptionId: The Domoizelle is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to Amakna Castle.

16014.descriptionId: Mastigator is now in your custody and needs to be delivered safely to Amakna Castle.

16015.descriptionId: You can only imagine the still-intact cutting edge of this solid fang. Gold shards seem to be embedded in the tooth.

16016.descriptionId: They say this out-of-the-world fabric gives anyone wearing it a killer look. Your mum's already mended it three times, so make sure you don't rip it during your adventure.

16017.descriptionId: Some say the smoke coming out of these boots is caused by residue from the other world... others claim it's just an olfactory manifestation of the wearer's personal hygiene. In either case, enemies are sure to flee at the first whiff.

16018.descriptionId: Having sojourned in the other world, this ring gives its wearer incredible power. The legend of the bandit just might be true after all...

16019.descriptionId: This mask is the ultimate accessory when pillaging. It lets you conceal your identity, show off your success to other pillagers, and even hide in a trove of treasure if you don't move a muscle.

16020.descriptionId: Try it once, keep it forever. The quirky shape of this ring lets you slip it on easily but, unfortunately, once it's on your finger, it's on for good.

16021.descriptionId: "The Lumberjacks of the Apocalypse" was an amusing alliance name when you were fifteen and dreamed of being a lumberjack. But it hasn't been much help in your romantic life, nor in recruiting other guilds. Give your alliance a new name and imagine a new life!

16022.descriptionId: These wide boots let you store loot in them and keep your hands free to pick locks. They don't do much for discretion, though.

16023.descriptionId: There's no doubt: you were right about this choker.

16024.descriptionId: This cloak makes you look terrifically terrifying! Unfortunately, your opponents are much more likely to charge you from behind than they are to run away, especially if they have horns.

16025.descriptionId: This belt looks like it came straight from the Shustuft Crust.

16026.descriptionId: This mask will help you see clearly in even the darkest areas, and will provide all the oxygen you need to go deep-sea diving.

16027.descriptionId: Armed with this bracelet, you will be kept informed about the forces of pressure acting upon your body. Now, that may not seem useful anywhere beyond the deepest depths of the oceans... and in fact it isn't.

16028.descriptionId: These waterproof sandals are the product of advanced technological developments, and will keep your feet dry in any circumstances.

16029.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16030.descriptionId: Making a necklace out of a lantern is rather daring in hostile territory: the light might attract a certain type of person, and your skull probably isn't strong enough to deal with the threat.

16031.descriptionId: For those passionate about underwater treasure who just can't stop themselves from digging up every possible spot in the hopes of finding something, this shovel-harpoon will help you defend yourself if you happen to accidentally unearth an unfriendly crustacean.

16032.descriptionId: This belt didn't belong to Meno – it was used to designate his prisoners.

16035.descriptionId: This sceptre is said to have made King Allister lose his mind during a high-stakes card game.

16036.descriptionId: Long on the minds of many an adventurer, Kideebom can now be on their heads instead.

16037.descriptionId: You don't really know what to do with these entrails taken from the Scale King. Use them as a skipping rope, maybe?

16038.descriptionId: Managing to get a piece of the Scale King's hide, no matter how dirty it is, is almost a miracle. Usually, adventurers are the ones who get their hides tanned in the fight.

16039.descriptionId: This little Quetsnakiatl has been your shadow ever since you took it from its native island. It feeds on the Scalies that invaded its home.

16040.descriptionId: This ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

16041.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

16042.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

16043.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

16044.descriptionId:
This cape was made from a giant Piraniak frequently dissected in science class to study its anatomy. 
Once dried, its unparalleled rigidity made it the perfect choice for adventurers.

16045.descriptionId: This Piraniak may have been out of the water for a long time now, but you can't help shudder at the thought of dipping your toes in next to it.

16046.nameId: Sample from the Fountain of Youth
16046.descriptionId: A tiny sample from the Fountain of Youth is encased in this flask. Mage Upichu most likely has special plans for its contents.

16047.descriptionId: This scroll tells one version of the legend of the Fountain of Youth.

16048.descriptionId: This gutted Piraniak can now be used as an ingredient.

16049.descriptionId: Steamed to preserve all its flavour, the taste will make you forget all the stress and worries in your everyday life and temporarily stop thinking about tomorrow.

16050.descriptionId: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Piraniaks.

16053.descriptionId: The autobiography of Nileza, renowned alchemist.

16054.descriptionId: What's important is keeping an open mind. Intelligence depends on it because without it, nothing gets in.

16055.descriptionId:
This tasteless meat can be preserved in mud for many years before it rots. Maybe then it'll have a bit of flavour.

(This meat can be harvested by level-90 and higher Hunters.)

16056.descriptionId: This preserved Crocodyl meat may now be kept for many days before cooking.

16057.descriptionId: This slab of meat is clearly very hard to digest. But gluttony always wins out over reason.

16058.descriptionId: This slab of meat is clearly very hard to digest. But gluttony always wins out over reason.

16059.descriptionId: This preserved Crocodyl meat may now be kept for many days before cooking.

16060.descriptionId:
This tasteless meat can be preserved in mud for many years before it rots. Maybe then it'll have a bit of flavour.

(This meat can be harvested by level-90 and higher Hunters.)

16061.descriptionId: Admit it: you're wondering what's inside this small chest. A kit to mend the warp and weft of space-time? An egg laid by a creature able to destroy the Krosmoz? A miniature version of the Goblin Encyclopedia? Patience. You'll find out one day. If one day ever comes.

16062.descriptionId: This cape used to be a symbol of valour and glorious deeds, but those days are gone. Now its value is aesthetic, worn by those looking for attention. Real Vigilantes have stopped wearing it, even in full dress, after one of their peers was crushed to death in less than a minute, having caught his cape in a revolving door.

16063.descriptionId: This potion will make you little again, for a dust-up trip down memory lane. Also works on Xelors.

16066.descriptionId:
This potion will make you little again, for a dust-up trip down memory lane. Also works on Xelors.
(Please note that you can only use one sweet at a time. If your character consumes more than one, their effects will not stack.)

16067.descriptionId:
The snailrotate rolls freely around the city of Orado, and the Scalies have learned the hard way that its shell is harder than their fangs.
The snailrotate feeds on Scalies' souls.

16068.descriptionId: This Ghost has not yet left the world of the living. It's up to you to find a way to revive it, or to leave it behind once and for all like a coward.

16069.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the pet that you left at the Kennel.

16070.descriptionId: This dehydrated growth hormone can be used to make a powerful potion that will improve the characteristics of your pet.

16071.descriptionId: Use this powerful potion to permanently increase the characteristics of your pet. Be careful though, as only one dose will work. Trying more than once will have disappointing results.

16073.descriptionId: Epsilon told you so you know it's true: this little box looks shabby but protects a very powerful item. If he hadn't told you otherwise, you'd think this box contains stale biscuits or rotten food.

16075.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Ratty".

16076.descriptionId: Korriander remembers that in the past you chose to defend the Mystified Forest.

16077.descriptionId: Korriander remembers that in the past you chose to let the Frigostians act with impunity in the Mystified Forest.

16080.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Sing emote.

16081.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Shadragon emote.

16088.descriptionId: Notufyne has given you the fuses you need to open a passageway in the cave on the mysterious island. You need five fuses to make the kegs of powder explode.

16102.descriptionId: For those not familiar with the temporal arts, this bracelet looks exactly like a simple trinket. In reality, however, it is an extremely powerful artefact said to have belonged to the god Xelor. Five distinct temporal fragments are now set into the bracelet, giving the artefact its full power.

16104.descriptionId: This blue stone sparkles faintly and appears to be somewhat out of time, not completely anchored in your era. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact.

16106.descriptionId: This yellow stone is full of light. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact. However, Epsilon has asked you to place the stone in a different era so that Septangel can't get her hands on it.

16108.descriptionId: This green stone is full of light. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact.

16110.descriptionId: This red stone sparkles faintly and appears to be somewhat out of time, not completely anchored in your era. You idly wonder what this small stone could be good for. Better hold on to it for now...

16118.descriptionId:
Does it talk, cluck, chirp, and tweet, making a constant, endless infernal racket? Does it copy everything you say and recite your password out loud in front of the Zaap? If so, you're the lucky owner of an admirable parrot, albeit one that's a bit short on feathers...
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16119.descriptionId: According to some misguided magi of the World of Twelve, this mask lets you manipulate matter with your mind. Doubtful...

16120.descriptionId: Worn for horrendously stuffy official ceremonies or when meeting the in-laws, this cape is as awkward to wear as those situations are to live through.

16122.descriptionId: The feathers decorating this cape will also make a lovely scarf for those colder days.

16123.descriptionId: Crushing, squeezing, breaking, stamping, grinding... Those are just some of the things these boots are made for, besides walking, once your magic has reached its limits.

16124.descriptionId: Great for carving out abs of stone... and lumbering lumbar vertebrae.

16125.descriptionId: This hammer was created to cause suffering. First visually, with its appearance. It also generates sounds imitating a cheap plastic flute, which makes your ears suffer. And, of course, it can generate massive physical damage.

16126.descriptionId: With this ring, pointing the finger at someone has never been more meaningful.

16127.descriptionId: Furious insanity, masked madness, monstrous hallucinations... Some things would be better left in the abyss.

16128.descriptionId: Each spike on this promise ring symbolises one of the Minerock guardians. The alliance between these five guardians is a promise to ensure the safety and stability of the Minerock people. You can only hope that the same goes for your life.

16129.descriptionId: It's an interesting experiment, trying to come up with a description for an indescribable item. Some would opt for the easy and economic solution: which is to not describe the item. But we're better than that. If a wall of text must be written, so be it! Here we go. There's a lot that you can say about the nature of indescribability. It could have several meanings: it might mean that we don't have the right words to describe the thing in question, because it's completely unprecedented, because it's unlike anything we've ever known, or maybe also because we don't have the lexical knowledge necessary to choose the right words that will best express the indescribable nature of the thing. It's easy to hide behind such a phrase: "Haha! It's indescribable!", pronounced in a very persuasive tone. But is that really the case? If we search deep inside, maybe an exact and appropriate description will reveal itself. Something sufficiently clear, and at the time sufficiently abstract to facilitate understanding of the described thing. If the words aren't sufficient, maybe it's necessary to invent new ones? Words coming from the heart. Words which speak for themselves when the limits of language have been reached. The indescribable, in the end, is actually an unknown, which requires only that we put forth the effort to understand it, to let your imagination, your reason, and your feelings play in order to better understand and therefore find the words that could describe it. But that would be too much work for a simple cape description.

16130.descriptionId: This helmet won't remedy your migraines, but at least you'll know what caused them.

16131.descriptionId: What is unspeakable cannot be said.

16132.descriptionId: Wearing these boots is like carrying the weight of the world on your toes.

16133.descriptionId: When you aren't using it to defend yourself, this shield is perfect for dice games with friends.

16134.descriptionId: This belt is eminently comfortable – once you get used to the itching and fleas, that it.

16135.descriptionId: This magnificent shield contains a few drops of water from Otomai beach. Not only will it bring you good luck, it can also be used as a flask now that water is such a valuable resource.

16136.descriptionId: Luckily the boar that provided this snout is dead, otherwise it would be forced to smell your feet all day long.

16137.descriptionId: Kanniballs originally used this shield as a stool when they needed to rest. If you fold the feet in, it will protect you from a wide range of attacks. Nothing will protect you from the cruel laughter of your opponents, however.

16138.descriptionId: Half lucky charm, half smelly paper cutter.

16139.descriptionId: This shield is covered with peepers to allow you to give one of those devastating multi-evil-eyes. Unstoppable.

16140.descriptionId: It's rumoured that even a glove-maker's son can become famous wearing this mask.

16141.descriptionId: This stone shield is in fact made from a Crackler's head, smashed by the foot of a Minotoror. A perfect combination of big head and smelly feet.

16142.descriptionId:
Did anyone ever tell you that wearing a dead Crobak around your neck brings good luck? No one?
Maybe there's a reason for that.

16143.descriptionId: This shield is the result of an incredible experiment that attempted to turn a trivet into a shield. Triveting, right?

16144.descriptionId: This shield's magnificent ring will allow you to hang it anywhere. Just don't get it confused with your hunting trophies.

16145.descriptionId: Not all Wabbits are nice little creatures. In fact, all Wabbits are vile creatures. Some get their kicks smashing up cawwots with this huge shield and taking baths in the juice.

16146.descriptionId: This shield may be adorned with ordinary children's drawings, but it's not a toy. Of that you can be sure.

16147.descriptionId: Perfect if you want to fit in on Pandala, or to stand out anywhere else! The biggest advantage of this shield is that it's entirely covered with hypoallergenic Pandawa hair, so now you don't need to pack your underwear and your armour in separate suitcases when you take your vacation.

16148.descriptionId: This shield will give you a classy air in snowy lands, allow you to come back from the dead, or even seduce white-haired, pale-skinned people. At least if the tales are true.

16149.descriptionId: Forged in the flames of the Undersmithy, this shield is clearly a tribute to Bowisse's Cloak, which itself was a tribute to a famous relic composed of three triangular fragments. Blimey, all this history is putting me to sleep.

16150.descriptionId: It won't offer you much protection, but this nest of germs will store all sorts of diseases and transmit them to your enemies.

16151.descriptionId: Hidden behind this shield, some naive adventurers could mistake you for a Treechnid and run off screaming. Most will attack all the more eagerly, thinking they can get some amber out of you.

16152.descriptionId: You'll just need to figure out if the pen is mightier than the sword.

16153.descriptionId: This huge shield saved the famous adventurer Kloome from an awful death: squashed under the weight of a Crackler who was in love with him. The legend doesn't say if he survived the side effects of his subsequent romance with the stony beast.

16154.descriptionId: This shield will save you on many an occasion. Forgot Saint Ballotwine? Your auntie's birthday? An early death? No worries. You'll always have flowers handy for the occasion.

16155.descriptionId: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Aerdala should do the trick.

16156.descriptionId: This thick, downy-soft shield can be used as a pillow and will remind you of your dearly departed beloved Bow Meow.

16157.descriptionId: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Terrdala should do the trick.

16158.descriptionId: While worrying, the eye on this shield is really only good for measuring adventurers' ecological footprints. You'd better toss items in bins rather than on the ground if you want it to protect you.

16159.descriptionId: A renowned adventurer spent his whole life looking for all four quarters of this shield. Some say that when the shield is complete, it has the exact opposite effect of that of breaking a mirror.

16160.descriptionId: Like you, this shield is steaming hot.

16161.descriptionId: You might find it taxing to be constantly accused of being "shellfish" for not sharing your shield.

16162.descriptionId: The Snowfoux leather and wool making up this shield are so thick and solid it'd take a sword blow to damage them. And there's no chance a serious adventurer such as yourself would ever be hit with a sword, right?

16163.descriptionId: Looking to fend off a frenzied attack? This shield from the village of Feudala should do the trick.

16164.descriptionId: The external spike on this shield lets you skewer your opponents with ease, and the thick layer of mushrooms growing on the inside will help cushion you from blows. That makes this shield doubly efficient.

16165.descriptionId: This shield used to protect lumberjacks from falling trees. Its function quickly changed, and now it is more often used to protect warriors from enemies who tend to land on them without warning!

16166.descriptionId: This shield is so chilly you can keep food fresh. A cool way to limit waste while adventuring.

16167.descriptionId: This shield of skin will fit you like a glove. Don't forget to treat its warts and furuncles from time to time to prevent them from getting worn.

16168.descriptionId: If you take a hit despite this third eye, you won't be able to claim you didn't see it coming.

16169.descriptionId: When all the cloth and planks have been used to make the ship ship-shape again, you'll need to find something else to protect you. Sometimes you have to make concessions.

16170.descriptionId: With its Mastogob wool, this shield will protect you from the Frigostian cold much better than granny's Kwismas sweater.

16171.descriptionId: Greenish and smelly, this shield remains a first choice for protection when it comes to fighting the creatures of green and smelly Mount Stinkky.

16172.descriptionId: A solid table will be necessary if he decides to set them on it.

16173.descriptionId: This original shield will protect you in a timely manner and give your opponents time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

16174.descriptionId: While not a real spine, this is undoubtedly something unpleasant stuck in the back of the Crakillian guardian.

16175.descriptionId: This original shield will protect you in a timely manner and give your opponents time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

16176.descriptionId:
Drhexler is an all-terrain petsmount. He'll trek on, unaffected by the longest journeys and the toughest climates. He's so insensitive, in fact, that he won't even notice if you fall off his back; he'll just soldier on into the sunset without you.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16177.descriptionId: This shield is a replica of the trophy awarded to the winners of the famous Dragoturkey race. It's not as prestigious as the original, of course, but if it stops you from getting sliced in two by an anonymous madman, who are you to complain?

16178.descriptionId: Among dungeon keepers, the ones with the most bark have the least bite.

16179.descriptionId: As strange as it might sound, some say this shield of wood and hair enables the lightest adventurers to become airborne for a brief moment... a final attempt to shock their enemies before falling flat on their faces.

16180.descriptionId: If you hold this giant shell to your ear, you just might hear the sound of the Hermaffrodaight Sea.

16181.descriptionId: This original shield will protect you in a timely manner and give your opponents time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

16182.descriptionId: This indescribable pile of foam and decomposing coral surprisingly does not give off any putrid odours – a sufficiently strange occurrence in the World of Twelve to be noteworthy.

16183.descriptionId: This original shield will protect you in a timely manner and give your opponents time... Time to make their last wishes that is!

16184.descriptionId: The seams are reinforced and the inside is as soft as the outside. Once soiled, you can therefore turn them inside out and wear them another month.

16185.descriptionId: Once recognisable from kilokametres away due to their appearance, the Trools have become experts of disguise. Posing as quite normal individuals to more easily spread chaos, there's been a marked increase in the number of them in the civilized world. In order to combat this scourge, some adventurers with sharpened senses have decided to take up arms and wear this shield as a distinguishing sign. Be careful though, because there might be some Trools who are smarter than the others hiding in their ranks.

16186.descriptionId: "Comfortable on the inside, spiky on the outside." These slippers remind you of someone who hurt you horribly, but whom you miss terribly all the same.

16187.descriptionId: Made from Riftworm carapaces and entrails. With its threatening spikes, this shield can be used for protection or as a hand weapon.

16188.descriptionId: "The advantage of these dead fish boots is that they mask the smell of my feet." Ah, what poetry emerges from the depths of the sea!

16189.descriptionId: A young adventurer once dreamt of joining the Bonta militia to protect the oppressed. Considered morally unfit for service, he was contacted by an Amakna alchemist who took advantage of his good nature, using him as a guinea-pig for his potions. You'll be glad to know that this is one story that ends... well, the middle bit is happy. He became so strong that he was known forever more as Captain Amakna and had this reputedly indestructible shield forged for him. The end... well, you don't wanna know the end.

16190.descriptionId: Hard to know which way is up with this mask... Big teeth and small ears, or the opposite? This difficult decision will keep you busy during those long winter nights.

16191.descriptionId: This shield will remind your opponents you grew up in the Sidimote Moors. That alone could be enough to scare them away.

16192.descriptionId: The artisan who created this wand used a few drops of sea foam, a pinch of decomposing matter, an ounce of a bad faith, and a piece of good will.

16193.descriptionId: When your allies run out of breath, or when you want to clear the air after an unexpected wind of panic, this shield can save your life. The only thing you need to do is to shake it energetically in all directions, like you'd do with a hungry baby.

16194.descriptionId: This magic wand has the amazing power to transform offal into sweets and boiled celery into Turkish delight. A curse for foodies, a blessing for the younger generation.

16196.descriptionId: This cape belonged to a dangerous aquatic criminal whose sins were forgiven.

16197.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

16198.descriptionId: It will make you world famous – among crustaceans.

16199.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

16200.descriptionId: This is a real head, shrunken to a twentieth of its original size (by a secret ancestral technique, naturally) to fit onto a finger. An anonymous researcher managed to carry out the same process on Pikoko Rumps, but not even modern art students wanted to wear them. That's what happens when you're ahead of your time.

16201.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

16202.descriptionId: The legends say that Eltux, the Meridia of the Colour Blue, painted all the Kanazures in homage to Blou, the Meridia of Humidity. Nobody really knows what exactly he was hoping to achieve, or whether he succeeded, but at least now we know why the Kanazures are always feeling so blue.

16203.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

16204.descriptionId: Kanazure Ray the tailor invented this cape after his attempts to market his adult Haloperi Doll replica failed miserably. The sales numbers were well behind even the XXXboxes sold in the seedy quarters of Bonta.

16205.descriptionId: Close inspection tells you that it's sticky.

16206.descriptionId: This headgear will make you look like some kind of terrible Iop-beast that'll scare the bejesus out of the Astrubians and maybe even some Amaknians.

16207.descriptionId:
With a hidey-lidey-lidey and a hidey-lidey-lay, we fold paper into little cranes all hidey-lidey day.
Mikariba will trade something for this crane. But where is he?

16208.descriptionId: The number of red marks on an Orfan's belt is a sign of how good at hunting its owner is. Every time he devours his prey, alive and kicking, he has to loosen his belt by one mark so he doesn't get bloated. You can use it in much the same way to count how many beers you've had down the tavern.

16209.descriptionId: Another fine addition to your Pandanini sticker album.

16210.descriptionId: Visitors to the region are always asking where the Orfans' second eye went – all except those who have one of these amulets. They know the answer, but won't breathe a word to anyone.

16212.descriptionId: This ring will peck off the end of your finger before you know it. Some reckless adventurers use it as a dangerous kind of nail clipper.

16213.descriptionId: This token is a sign of your steadfast devotion.

16214.descriptionId: These boots will probably make you feel like a fatty. Not only are they unflattering on your calves; they also don't appear to be able to lift you off the ground like it said on the advert.

16216.descriptionId: Clearly, this helmet makes you look like the perfect predator. Now you just need to practise turning invisible and making creepy noises in the trees.

16217.descriptionId:
Finally, a cape worthy of your power and style. Will it bring you glory or put an end to your adventure? Only time will tell.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16218.descriptionId: You might doubt just how effective an edible shield can be, but this one is surprisingly very resistant. Do wait until the end of the fight before nibbling on your shield, though, or you might never get another chance to taste it.

16219.descriptionId:
This terrifying mask portrays the potential hostility of an angry Iop – better not mess with those horns.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16220.descriptionId: While some have tried to use this as a cooking utensil during barbecues among friends, this shield's main utility is without a doubt shielding you!

16221.descriptionId:
There's no better way to face your destiny than wearing a mask. Plus, your ears won't get cold! Or your horns. No judgement here.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16222.descriptionId:
The following words can be read on the back of this shield: "Death is a necessary evil, but even so, we'd all prefer it comes for someone else."
Unfortunately, time has erased the author's name.

16223.descriptionId:
This vision-enhancing visor makes the wearer extremely precise – so precise that they'll always hit their target.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16224.descriptionId: It is said that Klime used this shield to seduce most of his conquests. Apparently, gold is a good reason to follow a stranger home.

16225.descriptionId:
Who's never dreamed of having a cannon for a forearm? Today, that dream came true. Just be careful scratching your nose.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16226.descriptionId: Forged with all of Missiz Freezz's know-how in the heart of the Frostforge, this sparkly shield will freeze the bones of your enemies.

16227.descriptionId:
This glove amplifies the wearer's energy, supposedly endowing each blow with the force of a Rhinoblasty.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16228.descriptionId: The shape of this shield makes it easier for you to collect Crocodyl tears from your enemies after their defeat.

16229.descriptionId:
Riding the combat steed is like travelling to the ultimate battle. Forgetting time and living in the moment. Fighting to understand a world without really understanding the world you're fighting for.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16231.descriptionId: [!] L'esprit martial vous a transformé, littéralement

16232.descriptionId: This tongue certainly explored many dark places before you got your hands on it.

16233.descriptionId: Your essence now wears Sokeri's body. Do him honour.

16234.descriptionId: This Eye glows in the dark even once extracted from its owner's face. It's so bright you can read your favourite comic books all night long.

16235.descriptionId: Considered a weapon it its own right because it had nearly lethal effects on tourists for years, shaké is now included on the cultural heritage list and may once again be sold, albeit in a much milder version. If you'd like to lose several of your senses for good, and probably your mind, make sure you give it a taste.

16237.descriptionId: You've temporarily merged your mind with that of Sokeri. This isn't the time to play knucklebones with your arm. You have a mission. Your harmonisation won't last more than one fight, so stay focused.

16238.descriptionId: This hair is the subject of many a Iop's jealous rage. In fact, they were so incensed by the idea that their hairstyle was not unique that they spent centuries trying to massacre the Alyeenas. Unfortunately, they continually confused one another with the monsters and ended up fighting with their own kin. Rish Claymore had to intervene in person to put an end to this madness.

16239.descriptionId: This potion will teleport you to the Astrub stagecoach station. From there, you can take a stagecoach to one of the offered destinations for just a few kamas.

16241.descriptionId: Klime wears this hat to avoid being deafened by the cries of the victims he brings to the back room of his private quarters, and also to prevent their jerking limbs from messing up his hair. After all, it's important to look one's best at all times.

16242.descriptionId: With two of these canines inserted into your dentures, people will sincerely hope that you are not coming back to bite them in the bum.

16243.descriptionId: Trust us: you really do not want to know what kinds of vicious torture this ring can provide, nor which horrific instruments it's been attached to.

16245.descriptionId: Ever since Klime came to Frigost, he seems to have forgotten all about the esthetics of shoemaking in order to focus exclusively on the power of his creations and the sordid magic he breathes into them. By that measure, these boots are magnificent.

16249.descriptionId: This is where you can carefully record each panji you discover throughout your journey of discovery.

16250.descriptionId: Sniff this silky fur and the warm, bestial musk it gives off will send your testosterone levels through the roof. Naturally, specimens regularly fetch small fortunes on the black market, but unfortunately for the Enutrof collectors who see it as their latest get-rich-quick scheme, most of the hunters who try plucking it straight from the source end up as adventurer stew.

16251.descriptionId: Flambéed in soy sauce then covered in chocolate, this fruit makes a delicious pudding.

16252.descriptionId: This tail is covered with silky fur and is bendy, solid and machine-washable all at once. You can think of a thousand things to do with it, but none better than using it as a replacement bathrobe belt.

16253.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "WAKFU S4 Producer".

16255.descriptionId:
Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16256.descriptionId: If you spent all day digging up the earth and crushing gravel with your bare hands, your skin would be just as tough and rocky as a Kannihilator's!

16258.descriptionId: Believe it or not, Kannihilators are born with snow-white manes. They take on their terracotta hue over several years, as the Kannihilators get used to burrowing for food in the entrails of Iop hunters who brandish their swords a little too close to the Alyeenas.

16259.nameId: Title Scroll: Veteran of Old Pandala
16259.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Veteran of Old Pandala".

16261.nameId: Title Scroll: Doyen of Old Pandala
16261.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Doyen of Old Pandala".

16262.descriptionId: Rumour has it that Nevark shaved the manes off all the Orfans in a single day, after leaving them each with just one eye to cry with. The hunter himself is unable to confirm if every single Orfan was really there, because he was only two years old and didn't know how to count yet.

16263.descriptionId:
If in some dreadfully unfortunate circumstance, someone were to push granny into a bunch of cacti, don't worry! Pandauge will immediately jump to her rescue to become her sole heir.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16265.descriptionId: This special seed was entrusted to your care after you gathered all the seeds from the spirits of Plantala.

16267.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Pandalan ornament.

16268.descriptionId: Technically speaking, this fragment doesn't belong to an Undried, but to one of the many creatures living off it.

16269.descriptionId: Item indicating the date of departure from Incarnam

16270.descriptionId: This looks like ligaments connecting pieces of putrid mud together, and it's rubbery. With any luck, it'll make for a chewing gum that doesn't lose its taste after ten minutes.

16274.descriptionId: This harmless-looking little creature will cling to you and suck your blood down to the last drop. In this sense, it's a nice metaphor for married life.

16276.descriptionId: This removable protection can be used as an elbow pad, knee brace or muzzle, to name but a few.

16278.descriptionId: The Micrab claims to wear this armour for purely defensive purposes, but has never managed to explain what adding thorny growths to it was supposed to do in this regard.
