16280.descriptionId: It took several days to figure out if this is snot or some kind of mycosis. But now the verdict is in: it's mycosis. Or perhaps snot.

16282.descriptionId: You can impersonate a Unikron by sticking it to your forehead, or you can always impersonate a Unikron by sticking it to your forehead.

16284.descriptionId: Despite its high quality, shoemakers refused to use this leather for many years. Customers thought it was fake because it has no smell! As they say, never judge a boot by its odour.

16288.descriptionId: Boar hooves are generally covered with mud or dirt but sometimes with colourful Biblops, which is not that unusual. Bliblimeads hate Biblops as much as you do.

16290.descriptionId: This Bliblycerin Tusk will you remind you how unpleasant this type of Bliblis is. Indeed, the tusk is as worn as a nibbling Wabbit Tooth, which probably means it's already skewered its fair share of adventurers.

16292.descriptionId: Contrary to its leather, Blibliternal fabric has a smell that should never be sniffed. It could rouse a Sadida from hibernation.

16294.descriptionId: This stomach is big enough to hold many things. A heaven-sent opportunity for a Iop to sort its Swords out.

16304.descriptionId: Early on, young Enutrofs try and get hold of a Bizarbwork Scalp to hide their growing bald spot. Wearing these things on their heads, they look even more ridiculous than normal – to say nothing of the Bwork odour that comes with them! Although, that might be part of the appeal, as it's strong enough to mask bad breath.

16306.descriptionId: This flesh has been scorched by numerous exposures to open flame.

16310.descriptionId: Mabworks need first-class material to make their implants. At first glance, this ear seems to have been ripped off a piglet's head without its permission.

16312.descriptionId: A boot like this is almost useless. Once it has been correctly patched up by a skilled shoemaker it'll do something, but for now its smell can help you repel the advances of your eager fans.

16314.descriptionId: Bwork handicraft remains very mysterious. Some adventurers think the purplish colour comes from Goblins. But the origins of the leather are still unknown. Very strange.

16316.descriptionId: The second in a long line of bows where an eye replaces the cord. Nobody really understands how it works, but it seems as if the arrows it fires come from another dimension.

16330.descriptionId: Disquieting to look at, this wand will sow doubt in the minds of your opponents.

16332.descriptionId: When they hit their target, these daggers let out a viscous and disquieting liquid, as if they were sucking it out of their victim's body.

16334.descriptionId: You might think that a thief would have preferred to use daggers for a little more discretion. But after all, who ever said that ghosts make noise?

16336.descriptionId: This sword strikes straight at the soul of your enemies.

16338.descriptionId: If you don't really know how to use a spear, you could always use it like a staff.

16344.descriptionId: This snake's garnet eyes can hypnotise an Enutrof for hours on end.

16346.descriptionId: This robust ring will leave quite an impression on anybody you hit with it.

16354.descriptionId: This translucent loincloth is a favourite among exhibitionists: even if they're not completely naked, they're certainly not hiding much.

16356.descriptionId: The Belteen is more suited to imposing physiques. But unlike other belts, this one inflates to squeeze its wearer, giving an illusion of more volume. It can also be used as a flotation device in the event of a water landing.

16362.descriptionId: Orange enough to make a pumpkwin jealous, this mask will be a hit come Al Howin.

16368.descriptionId: These shoes are often used in snowy or icy environments: they stick really well, and don't sink into snow.

16370.descriptionId: The mouth of these boots can open, though their breath will make you wish they didn't.

16376.descriptionId: Made up, as it is, of little bits of Krobes, you'd better have a solid and healthy constitution if you're going to wear this cape. Otherwise it might make you a bit of a hypochondriac.

16378.descriptionId: With this cape on your back, you'll feel like a fish in the water. You probably won't feel as nimble though, given its size.

16382.descriptionId: This amulet represents a simplified version of a Spookkoth. Not that you needed to be reminded of their appearance – you're not likely to forget any time soon. P.S.: The necklace is elastic.

16384.descriptionId: Having a trashcan within arm's reach to throw away anything you like seems interesting, and this pendant could effectively fill that role. However, it gets heavier with each item ingested, so you'll have to work out your neck to keep wearing it.

16386.descriptionId: Two eyes are better than none, and two extra eyes are even better. They'll make you look serious. Or annoyed. Or thoughtful.

16388.descriptionId: According to legend, this amulet is supposed to protect its wearer from all sorts of possible death scenarios. But considering what you did to its last owner, it's probably just a false rumour.

16390.descriptionId: This belt sticks its tongue out when it's too tight. So it will also let you know when it becomes time to do a sit-up or two.

16392.descriptionId: Wearing a Yoloinist Crab shell is very dangerous: they have a tendency to pinch similar things with all their strength to test them.

16394.descriptionId: This solid gold torque is essentially used to flaunt one's wealth to everyone.

16398.descriptionId: These boots are designed to produce a metallic rattling noise with every step. The shrill sound that results from walking on the stone floor of the pyramid is amplified by the resonance of the vast corridors. This leads us to believe that like Astrubians, Mumystics like to be the centre of attention.

16400.descriptionId: Tal Kasha couldn't stand people walking on her feet, which is why her sandals have evolved to look like this.

16402.descriptionId: Monday in the sun is something people around you will never see, because they'll be so dazzled by the brilliance of your headgear.

16404.descriptionId: Ambitious Enutrofs have led great conquests with the sole purpose of getting a head of hair as thick as this.

16406.descriptionId: This is the pendant you give to your loved ones to reassure them, and keep them from knowing the true nature of Koutoulou.

16410.descriptionId: This helmet will give you a look that's completely normal and acceptable – for a lunatic.

16412.descriptionId: This ring constantly biting into your finger will remind you not to make stupid decisions. Like wearing this ring.

16418.descriptionId: The Warrior of KOs wore this belt to show everyone he was the KO Champion. Now that it belongs to you, it's your turn to show off!

16420.descriptionId: Crushing, squeezing, breaking, stamping, grinding... Those are just some of the things these boots are made for, besides walking.

16422.descriptionId: These boots will do nothing to help your athlete's foot.

16424.descriptionId: Outlawed outside of Srambad by Sadida lobbyists, these boots have a tendency to wilt any vegetable matter under your feet. Quite an effective way to get rid of weeds, despite some tiny side effects.

16426.descriptionId: Ahhh, finally a pair of boots that breathe! Just be careful when you walk around, as it's common for little items to slip inside unseen. They're also known for sneezing, often and always at the worst moments, making you fall down stairs, off cliffs, into swimming pools, etc.

16430.descriptionId: All the experts insist that Dremoan is in fact edible, but no one has really had the courage to try: its colour is about as appetising as your great-aunt's special Gobball tripe. Not very.

16432.descriptionId: Equip this cape to proudly proclaim that you defeated the worst threat in the Petrified Forest. But be careful not to keep it on your back too long – nobody really knows what Dremoan is made of, and it could be dangerous.

16434.descriptionId: Necroticks recognise their allies primarily by their smell, and this cape is soaked with it. The only problem is that this odour is a direct result of the powerful poisons they release. Use it at your own risk.

16438.descriptionId: This Drellhair cloak is very popular among the little savages who vacation in Vulkania jungle. It gives its wearer a bestial look that could almost rival Kanigrula herself. And above all, it'll keep you warm.

16440.descriptionId: With its tiger-striped motif, the Weremoggy Cape will let you scramble your opponent's vision so completely they'll be effectively blind.

16442.descriptionId: Legend has it that whoever wears the ‘Circle of Lightning' contained in this cloak will be able to control lightning. It might be nothing more than a legend, but it's worth a shot!

16444.descriptionId: Only to be used in emergencies. This jewel contains a powerful poison capable of ruining your life, or saving it, depending on the situation.

16448.descriptionId: This amulet is said to have belonged to a famous performer at King Allister's court, Dumsh, before he got played and imprisoned in a dungeon.

16452.descriptionId: Because of its value in gold, this belt is very rarely actually used as a belt. And for those of you who think it'd make a good weapon: think again. It's way too heavy!

16454.descriptionId: You thought you'd be able to blend in with the Weremoggies by wearing their symbol around your waist, but this cat's head is actually used to mark their next target. Too bad for you.

16456.descriptionId: This ring has the strange characteristic of making its wearer's phrases start with the word "Zounds!". However, it doesn't seem to work on you. Maybe it's just another old adventurer's tale...

16458.descriptionId: This sword's formidable power can strike your enemies with lightning. Please note that for best results, this technique should be attempted during a storm, when the sword is held towards the sky and when your enemies are holding the blade.

16460.descriptionId: The rope of this belt is made with an extremely rare material that absorbs lightning bolts and retains their energy. It's just the thing to protect you on stormy days when you can't find anywhere to take shelter.

16462.descriptionId: Wearing this belt isn't easy – nor is removing it.

16464.descriptionId: One might be tempted to knock you on the head, given the shape of this helmet... that's where the thorns come in handy.

16466.descriptionId: This cape can by equipped in two ways: one being recommended for anyone who isn't a Sacrier.

16492.descriptionId: Designed for bad weather, this cloak tends to swell up in the Vulkania humidity... and gets so heavy that it could pin you down. You probably shouldn't use it as a towel. Or should you?

16502.descriptionId: These boots make little squeaking noises when you walk. You'll lose the element of surprise when you wear them, of course, but every well-placed kick to your opponents' backsides will be all the more humiliating.

16508.descriptionId: Although they're supposed to symbolise virility, these boots are most often on the feet of people who need to compensate for something. Curious...

16512.descriptionId: Legend says that every time Dina Tapio tamed a Madreggon, she made an amulet like this one at the same time. Trophy, souvenir or warning? No one really knows what these jewels symbolise.

16522.descriptionId: For those not familiar with the temporal arts, this bracelet looks exactly like a simple trinket. In reality, however, it is an extremely powerful artefact said to have belonged to the god Xelor. Five distinct temporal fragments are now set into the bracelet, giving the artefact its full power.

16528.descriptionId: It's never felt this good to have horns! China shops, here you come!

16534.descriptionId: So you want to play the swaggart and have everybody's eyes on your mediocre self? This hat's for you. It'll replace all your bragging and cowardice with actual virtues, and all for a modest price.

16540.descriptionId: The message is clear enough: whatever lies behind this belt is very dearly guarded indeed.

16550.descriptionId: Splinted and taped all over the place, this bow is nevertheless still an efficient weapon, capable of shooting right through an imbecile hanging out at the Astrub Zaap, in the middle of the other hawkers.

16552.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Gladiator".

16554.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Az'Hassin".

16556.descriptionId: There's a large skull drawn on this set of voodoo darts. An inscription has been engraved on the back: "Four darts in dead centre, when the right score has been attained, then shall a curse upon your enemies be named."

16558.descriptionId: Given the sorry state of this mop, you wonder when such an object was last used on Captain LeChouque's ship.

16560.descriptionId: A hefty dose of this gunpowder and you'll finally be ready to win the next cannonball shooting contest!

16562.descriptionId: [!] Verdâtre ou orangeâtre, vous ne savez pas trop. Ce que vous savez par contre, c'est que vous perdez vraiment votre temps à récupérer n'importe quoi, n'importe où.

16564.descriptionId: The odour wafting out of this flask is abominable. Even just opening the flask will probably make you dizzy.

16566.descriptionId: This tiny container holds a few of your tears. They'll probably be good for something...

16568.descriptionId: Have you always dreamed of being a pirate? Well, today's your lucky day!

16570.descriptionId: This is the dried seaweed soup Fat Bob cooked. This soup has been seasoned with salt.

16572.descriptionId: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

16574.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Cra class's special emote.

16576.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Ecaflip class's special emote.

16578.descriptionId: This scroll lets you learn the special Rogue class emote.

16580.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Feca class's special emote.

16582.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Selfie emote.

16584.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Foggernaut class's special emote.

16586.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Rhythm emote.

16588.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Big Wave emote.

16590.descriptionId:
Legend has it that this helmet belonged to the famous war chief named Romulu Ceremu. Taken in and raised by a Boowolf family when he was a boy, he grew up to become a powerful warrior and an ambitious conqueror. You must honour his name.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16592.descriptionId:
Romulu Ceremu had a habit of wearing this cloak with a small purple skirt and large sandal-boots. Strangely enough, this habit has disappeared, and people wear only the cloak now.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16594.descriptionId:
Romulu Ceremu regularly organised warriors' games to entertain his soldiers in peacetime, the DeeDubYuess. Fans could proudly wear the symbols of their favourite teams on their shields to support them in these contests.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16596.descriptionId:
No more failed entrances due to gusts of wind making your hood fly off too soon – and your credibility with it. The inside frame allows the hood to stay perfectly in place, worthy of the greatest Az'Hassins. On the other hand, you won't be able to turn or raise your head, which could be a problem when you have to look right, then left, then right before crossing the street.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16598.descriptionId:
Since you got this cloak, it regularly makes you want to jump from absurd heights just for fun. Provided there is a cart full of straw below, you can survive the fall. This may sound strange, but you will be surprised at the number of straw-filled carts below just about every high spot from where you might want to jump. Looks like they were put there deliberately...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16600.descriptionId:
This is not a shield. It is actually a kind of glider disguised as a shield, which the Az'Hassins raise above themselves before jumping from a high spot to enter or escape somewhere by air. Since its canvas is very fragile, a mere encounter with a small bird in flight could pierce it and make you fall. Also, even experienced Az'Hassins hardly use it, reluctant to end their lives in such an inglorious way.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16602.descriptionId:
These daggers were made for sneaking up on opponents, but it became apparent that they also had another very special ability. Indeed, if you are attacked head-on and you manage to counter the attack with these daggers, your body will – on its own – move to counterattack and kill your opponent for sure. If your enemies had the intelligence to attack all of you at the same time, you wouldn't have a chance, but since they stubbornly line up and attack one at a time, you'll massacre them.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16604.descriptionId:
This shield will be the object of your opponents' desire until they realise that it didn't stop you from being ground to crumbs in your last fight.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16606.descriptionId:
From behind, you'll look like a knight running away.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16608.descriptionId:
This headgear will make you look like a knight. You may sleep while wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16610.descriptionId:
This hood preserves your anonymity so you can steal from the poor to give to the rich, without any of that pesky glory.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16612.descriptionId:
This discreet and lightweight cape is perfect for your spying missions, especially when you have to hide in the dark.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16614.descriptionId:
This hood preserves your anonymity so you can steal from the rich to give to the poor, without any of that pesky glory.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16616.descriptionId:
This discreet and lightweight cape is perfect for your spying missions, especially when you have to hide in the snow.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16618.descriptionId:
This shield was designed specially to resist cannonballs, and thereby protect its bearer during naval battles. Make sure to read the fine print, though: "Only works if you have prodigious strength." So, make sure you build up as much muscle as you can before your next battle.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16620.descriptionId:
If by some odd twist of fate, your boat was ripped asunder, this solid cloak could replace it perfectly. Provided, of course, you had several dozen of the same model and sewed them all together, which leaves you plenty of time to go under.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16622.descriptionId:
The shape of this hat makes it an excellent tool for rapidly bailing out large quantities of water. Quite handy when your ship is sinking as fast as your career as a pirate and your dreams of grandeur.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16624.descriptionId:
This shield is probably the result of a prank.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16626.descriptionId:
Unlike other hats of its kind, this magical hat never bends to its wearer's will, and its desires will go over your head.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16628.descriptionId:
This cape renders you invisible, but only in total darkness.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16630.descriptionId:
This shield has seen a few battles too many and in this state is good for nothing. Bouwada, in Pandala village, might be able to replace it for you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16632.descriptionId:
Your enemies are likely to grit their teeth when they see you with this shield.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16634.descriptionId:
With this cloak, the next time someone taps on your shoulder hoping to give you a start, they're the one likely to be startled.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16636.descriptionId:
This nearly-full-face helmet is ideal protection on your travels, especially when riding the more recalcitrant mounts.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16638.descriptionId:
This bow is the only one made from Cyclouse carapaces. It'd be a shame to forgo owning such a rare item.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16640.descriptionId:
This shield shines with equal intensity day and night. Its manufacturer had no concept of energy efficiency.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16642.descriptionId:
This cape will protect you while you're exploring dark, terrifying, and oh-so-exciting new places.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16644.descriptionId:
This mask was designed for adventurers who've always dreamt of being known for their bright ideas but never have any ideas, bright or otherwise.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16646.descriptionId:
The only thing original about this weapon is its name, and whoever named it couldn't be bothered.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16648.descriptionId:
Every year on 6 Javian, Twelvians come together to eat the famous Thwee Kings Cake. This tradition has been adapted from Wabbit customs, consisting of hiding this crown somewhere in the world. Whoever manages to find it earns the right to wear it and is named "Wa Odanowth" for the celebration.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16650.descriptionId:
There's nothing more elegant than a diadem adorned with feathers to command respect but keep the mood light as a feather.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16652.descriptionId:
This cape is reminiscent of a dragon's mane and gives you a refined air whenever you want. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16654.descriptionId:
This shield is adorned with a ruby in a colour so bright that the Crocodyls will keep their distance from you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16656.descriptionId:
Never let your guard down again when it's time to clean someone's clock.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16658.descriptionId:
Sometimes it's wiser to adapt one's adornment to the world around you. Even though it might mean compromising your references.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16660.descriptionId:
Magical hats are named after the first words said to them. I'm sure you can already imagine the look on the hatter's face when her apprentice commented on her work.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16662.descriptionId:
Thanks to the many spikes adorning this cape, you can easily hang your demonic swimsuit bottoms out to dry along with your friends' while you walk along the beach.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16664.descriptionId:
This mask will protect you from the sun's effects thanks to its demonic power. However, its effects are limited to the covered portion of your face.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16666.descriptionId:
Valiant adventurers know how to tout the advantages of this advent cap to novices visiting Kwismas Island.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16668.descriptionId: This pouch contains no less than 15 Doploons. You don't want to miss this offer!

16682.descriptionId:
What an odd creature it is, this Karne. Many theories abound. Some think it's an obese Tofu that grew in a skull; others prefer the version that says it's a skull animated by dark magic that caused it to grow wings and feet; while others still believe that a scientific experiment went horribly awry. One thing is sure: Karne is not the most affectionate animal ever, nor the cutest, but having it in your company will naturally give you a considerably evil aura.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16684.descriptionId:
Gobbalux has been training for war since he was a nipper. He can skewer barbecued meat or a Bontarian's forehead with just a jab of his horns.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16686.descriptionId:
Gobbalator has been training for war since he was a nipper. He can open a can of beer or a Brakmarian's head with his teeth alone.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16688.descriptionId: This carapace-covered mount loves bloody combat and stories that end poorly.

16690.descriptionId:
It's like a Noxine but much more: more feet, more light, more patterns, more sound, etc.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16692.descriptionId:
Tired of regularly getting extorted while crossing Cania, Amaknean merchants have financed the raising of hard-shelled Drhellers. For now, they are delivered as a kit with the Drheller on one side and its armour on the other, but Otomai's Disciples are working to merge the two into one species.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16694.descriptionId:
Torvil has always dreamed of flying, feeling light as a feather, riding an updraught, getting lost in the vastness of the sky, and watching migratory birds soar off into the horizon. Unfortunately, his status as a turtle keeps his feet firmly on the ground in the mud with the Gobballs. Still, he hasn't given up hope of one day soaring above the clouds and living his dream.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16696.descriptionId:
Hot like fire and cruel like a nursery school teacher, the Drhellilax burns with desire to wreck everything in its path.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16698.descriptionId:
The Minowang has dark fur and a feisty temperament, inherited from a childhood spent in the shadow of a mountain of fire. Extremely stubborn, it preferred to join you rather than put its hooves up and lounge on the sandy beaches of Minotoror Island.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16700.descriptionId:
Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them. 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16702.descriptionId:
Not all dragons are creatures of legend and creators of Dofus with unparalleled powers. Some are much smaller and weaker, but they've been able to exploit their metamorphic abilities to perfection to trick gullible adventurers. Many of these adventurers do not see through the trickery and are all too happy to parade about with what they believe to be a primordial dragon at their heels, letting them sponge off them. 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16712.descriptionId:
Aispiks are of a very discreet nature. The icy peaks covering their skin allow them to camouflage themselves effectively in snow-covered lands. Paradoxically, it's also this ability that led to their discovery, when an unfortunate adventurer sat on what he thought was "a comfortable little pile of snow".

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16714.descriptionId:
A small tree with a wandering heart, this Pikip is the perfect companion for sowing thorns into the sides of your opponents' jumpers.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16716.descriptionId:
The Storf is made up of magic snow, so it can stay at a very low temperature in any environment. This ability has not escaped those who like to drink cold beers under a blazing sun, who have therefore renamed it "The Icebox". Another fine example of conversion.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16718.descriptionId:
An identical reproduction, made by an adventurer who has certified that he slipped into a temporal anomaly, this mechanical pet is perfect for studying your target before taking action. Be careful when looking up in the shower as its eye is very sensitive to shampoo splatter.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16720.descriptionId:
Many adventurers have fallen for Lezia's appearance, but very few are still around to talk about the chaos she can cause. Ignore this warning at your own risk and peril.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16722.descriptionId:
The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16724.descriptionId:
The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16726.descriptionId:
The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16728.descriptionId:
The label attached to the back of the Prez' says "from Auntie Nielleda". Better let it follow you than risk opening it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16730.descriptionId: Have you always dreamed of being a pirate? Well, today's your lucky day!

16734.nameId: Sardines in Oil for Fat Bob
16734.descriptionId: Sardines in oil for Fat Bob.

16738.descriptionId: The idea of taking this Angora Bow Meow to Peter "the Scabber" to help him rid the ship of rodents has crossed your mind.

16740.descriptionId: This is the dried seaweed soup Fat Bob cooked. This soup has been seasoned with gunpowder... an explosive treat, for sure.

16742.descriptionId: The water stored on Captain LeChouque's ship is the only clear thing on board.

16744.descriptionId: You can use this beer to restore health points. Initially wrapped in an old hemp-fibre rag of dubious cleanliness, as surprising as it may seem, this beer is popular, especially for its calming effects. It can, however, cause a bad case of the munchies in some individuals.

16766.nameId: Skull of a Victim of a Shushu Ritual
16766.descriptionId: This skull of a victim of a Shushu ritual is recognisable by the demonic glyph engraved directly on the bone. Don't even think about where the rest of the victim is: you're not peckish and it's the only indication you need.

16768.descriptionId: This possible remnant of a melody was found in the Virtuoso's last home. The years have not been kind to it: all the annotations have disappeared. Perhaps it can be restored to some extent.

16770.descriptionId: For those not familiar with the temporal arts, this bracelet looks exactly like a simple trinket. In reality, however, it is an extremely powerful artefact said to have belonged to the god Xelor. A purple temporal fragment is already set into the bracelet, and spaces for four other stones are still empty...

16772.descriptionId: This debris probably comes from the reinforced hull of a ship, which makes this plank a solid way to cross the gulf that cuts the Paltry Pleasures Cavern in two.

16774.descriptionId: This possible remnant of a melody was found in the Virtuoso's last home. The temporal power that Amine used has restored the sheet music.

16776.descriptionId: This possible remnant of a melody was found in the Virtuoso's last home. The temporal power that Amine used has restored the sheet music, and with Pandalida's help, you've been able to decipher the music.

16778.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Shushu Ross's Witness".

16780.nameId: Title Scroll: Requiem for Four Seasons
16780.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Requiem for Four Seasons".

16782.nameId: Title Scroll: Oration for Four Seasons
16782.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Oration for Four Seasons".

16786.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

16864.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Shadragon ornament.

16868.descriptionId: This is the perfect tool for building or rebuilding your cherished furniture. It can also be used for settling a score with some noisy neighbours.

16870.descriptionId: These solid wooden planks will make for a perfect makeshift raft in the event of an apocalypse. It's best to be prepared, because it could happen sooner than you think!

16872.descriptionId: Used primarily in the ongoing renovations of the city of Astrub, this rope is quite effective for making your way to your soulmate's balcony.

16874.descriptionId: This red stone is full of light. It now seems fully anchored in your era. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact.

16876.descriptionId: This yellow stone is full of light. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact.

16878.descriptionId: This blue stone is full of light. It now seems fully anchored in your era. Thanks to Epsilon, you know that it is a temporal fragment and that, once set in the Cog of Infinity, it will greatly increase the power of that artefact.

16880.descriptionId: You feel short and stubby and are in a terrible mood: Epsilon's Stubbyob illusion seems to have worked on you. Your peers in the Undersmithy won't notice you at all.

16884.descriptionId: It would seem things didn't go as planned...

16886.descriptionId: This ticket lets you use the Amakna stagecoach network for free. Present this pass in any stagecoach station to receive a free ride.

16888.descriptionId: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.

16890.descriptionId: This minor fortification rune can be used on a shield to improve its rank.

16892.descriptionId: This average fortification rune can be used on a shield to improve its rank.

16894.descriptionId: This major fortification rune can be used on a shield to improve its rank.

16896.descriptionId:
This Dragoone looks scrumptious indeed, but comes with a sternly worded warning. 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16898.descriptionId:
Young sleep-deprived parents are snapping up this pet. That's because it loves to snack on bad dreams, making it your best ally for peaceful nights.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16900.descriptionId:
Being tall isn't always an advantage when it comes to time travel. Less mass to transport means more opportunities to create paradoxes that could give a narrator nightmares.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16902.descriptionId:
After ages spent flying alongside the angel Raziel, your bravery has convinced it to accompany you in this lifetime and the next.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16904.descriptionId: Fleaster magic has transformed you... literally.

16906.descriptionId: You, too, can taste the Fleaster spirit. Contains no additives or preservatives.

16908.descriptionId:
Its spotted pelt doesn't make it as fast as a Bow Meaguar, but it will give you a killer look.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16910.descriptionId:
If petting a dreamy creature has always been a pipe dream of yours, now you can.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16912.descriptionId:
Forget space. Forget time. Ride Pandowla and experience legends before they're written.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16914.descriptionId:
This shield is popular among bowlers at bowls championships. Thanks to its magical nature, it provides unparalleled protection against bad losers' inadvertent accidental throws.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16916.descriptionId:
While mastering subordinating conjunctions has never saved an adventurer from a bloody battle, it can save you a few kamas. If it won't spread chaos, you can eat it on toast instead of hazelnut spread... or cover it with hazelnut spread and eat it instead of toast.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16918.descriptionId:
A wee oven to keep your wee head warm.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16920.descriptionId:
Even though it looks like a woodburning stove, this helmet won't keep you warm and cosy enough for a good night's sleep. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16922.descriptionId:
This headgear will let you dress up as a Fleaster Wodent so you can hop through the bushes and scatter chocolate eggs to your heart's content. To each their own. We would never judge you for your hobbies.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16924.descriptionId:
A glass container full of mess at all times.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16926.descriptionId:
Fleaster falls on the first Sunday after the first full moon following 21 Martalo, so on 22 Martalo at earliest, if the full moon falls on the evening of the 21st, and on 25 Aperirel at latest. This does not mean the moon as it is seen, but rather the "Fleastal" moon, calculated using an inexact but traditional method. The "civilised" peoples of the World of Twelve – having adopted both the Grougorian calendar reform and a concurrent correction for the lunar cycle – often celebrate on a different day than the "primitive" peoples, and the discrepancy can be either nothing, or one or five weeks (depending on the year), or exceptionally four weeks if there is a new moon in Bonta but not in Brakmar.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16928.descriptionId:
The thin layer of praline filling between the two squares of chocolate that make up this shield absorbs blows very well. Properly wielded, this shield can even return certain attacks to their senders. You can't count on it to protect against diabetes, though.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16930.descriptionId:
This strap of leather adorned with bones and fur will give you an animal air and terrify your prey.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16932.descriptionId:
This cape requires special care to keep its fur soft and silky, and the claws that drag on the ground tend to get dirty quickly.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16934.descriptionId:
The best defence is a good offence. But a furry shield to push back attacks isn't half bad.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16936.descriptionId:
Some shields want to use you, some shields want to get used by you, some shields want to abuse you, some shields want to be abused...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16938.descriptionId:
Every night you hope and pray that dream wings will come your way, wings to flap instead of arms, so you can know the magic of their charms.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16940.descriptionId:
Dream when you're feeling blue, dream, that's the only thing to do. Just put this helmet on your hair... 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16942.descriptionId:
The message this hood conveys is not to fight with your face covered, but to fight with an open heart.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16944.descriptionId:
It's not enough to oppose the evil forces hanging over the World of Twelve – you've got to do it in style. This cape is a perfect example of that.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16946.descriptionId:
When woe has conquered the heart of time, this shield will illuminate the path for those fighting to save it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16948.descriptionId:
Fantasy is a concept quite foreign to this shield, although its origins lie on the edges of reality.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16950.descriptionId:
The Melodious Cape is currently very fashionable with minstrels, because it lets you record a voice using its magic. Once recorded, you need to press different areas of the cape to create a melody from the voice. Purists debate using it, but you have to admit that it opens many interesting possibilities.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16952.descriptionId:
It's not enough to just move forward through life, you have to dream of your destination.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16954.descriptionId:
This shield is quite tangible in spite of its name. Each blow is a painful reminder of its very material condition.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16956.descriptionId:
Fortunately, this shield is much stronger than its name suggests. Its bright colours will also allow you to blind your enemies.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16958.descriptionId:
This hat makes you think of the time when celebrity tailor Kog Wan tried, in vain, to make you look good naked.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16960.descriptionId:
This cloak contains enough cogs and gears to run an entire old-school merry-go-round.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16962.descriptionId:
With this shield in your grubby hands, you can finally go backwards as well as forwards.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16964.descriptionId:
The gear doesn't do anything, but it looks awesome. This axe really makes you think of someone for some reason.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16966.descriptionId:
Turn this shield upside down and you can dig its horns into the ground to use it like a hoe or a rake.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16968.descriptionId:
Don't be gloomy: this is one gloaming good shield!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16970.descriptionId:
Some people choose to decorate their shield with the head of a lion, a dragon, or a griffin as a symbol of power and majesty, but you've chosen a shield with the head of a stupid dog.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16972.descriptionId:
This shield was given to you by Parillia for managing to calm the Royal Gobball down. However, you have been banned from ever setting foot in Tainela again after the chaos you caused. But, as the proverb says: "You can't make peace without breaking things to pieces."

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16974.descriptionId:
After a fun dungeon, there's nothing like a glass of bamboo milk and a new shield before jumping back into the fray.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16976.descriptionId:
The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16978.descriptionId:
With this shield, you can create traffic jams and send all the Dragoturkeys in the land on lengthy detours. Go on, you know you want to!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16980.descriptionId:
With this cloak on your back, the militia will finally stop hounding you for stealing bits and pieces of Astrub for your private fortress.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16982.descriptionId:
With this cone on your head, people will do all they can not to bump into you, turning early to give you a wide berth. Just like they do already, actually.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16984.descriptionId:
Just right for smashing up all the hard work your co-workers did yesterday.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

16986.descriptionId:
"The fighter sharpens up his shield tirelessly, but only gets it out for good reason." — Vee'Two

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17012.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Electromagic Guitar emote.

17014.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Timeless emote.

Use this scroll to obtain the Shiny ornament.

17018.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Lucky Devil ornament.

17020.descriptionId:

17024.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Gears ornament.

17026.descriptionId:
If the weight of the end of the world on your shoulders isn't enough for you, these shoulder pads are just right for you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17028.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Fleaster ornament.

17032.descriptionId: If you dry it out really well, you can play marbles with it – as long as the stench doesn't bother you.

17034.descriptionId: Several illustrious Amakna thinkers are still stumped as to what use a crab could possibly have for a tongue. They would probably be shocked if they knew.

17036.descriptionId: This ridiculous little Batofu beak looks harmless but is extremely sharp. The archers of Amakna have used them as arrowheads since the beginning of time.

17040.descriptionId: Strawberries are the Strawberry Jelly's staple food. If you smell these delicious red berries somewhere, it's likely that you've stumbled into a Strawberry Jelly's hunting ground.

17042.descriptionId: This scroll contains valuable information on the situation in northern Cania. This report will surely be useful for the people involved.

17044.descriptionId: This chest is shaped like Flib... unless it's the opposite! In any case, it's still a cursed little chest.

17046.descriptionId: Sprinkle this powder into the underwear of your fellow adventurers who are just a bit too smooth-talking for their own good.

17048.descriptionId: Most definitely containing something precious or dangerous, this chest will invite jealous stares either way. But don't get too curious... You know what it did to the Bow Meow...

17050.descriptionId: Looking at this thing, you probably think "slimy", "crunchy", "tasty", or maybe "revolting"? Some have attempted to gulp down one of these odd creatures, but very few have survived the creature's fatal grip on their trachea and lived to tell the tale.

17052.descriptionId: These monsters tend not to be very generous. Count yourself lucky to have this container filled to the brim with their fat. Now to find a use for it...

17056.descriptionId: Emuskal is Kanigrula's pet Bowzai. Don't trust those sweet eyes – a bloodthirsty beast is hiding beneath the creature's angelic features.

17058.descriptionId: "If you keep eating the same thing, you're going to end up looking like what you eat." That was the wise advice of Bontarian chef Boolya Wild. This would explain why Bwork stomachs are such a strange colour.

17060.descriptionId: This type of vegetation is used for bedding in Gobball pens. This grass is wild, though – it often gets up and leaves the pen of its own accord, which is quite rare among plants.

17062.descriptionId: The Blue Spimush is covered in a thin layer of this powder, which shimmers strikingly. Another striking (but less pleasant) feature is that it bursts into flames on contact with skin.

17064.descriptionId: There's no doubt this tooth used to belong to the Staff Deleghoul. That's plain to see from its dangerously sharp tip.

17070.nameId: Water Drawn from the Minerock Plains
17070.descriptionId: This bucket contains a non-negligible amount of drinking water. It will be of great use to the Kanigs.

17076.descriptionId: This matted clump of hair is almost intact, despite the punishment you must have inflicted on the poor Ghost Hicidal when pulling it out.

17078.descriptionId: You could use this shell to protect your most precious parts.

17080.descriptionId: It's easy to get too attached to Dreggons. Quite literally, particularly when one gets its claws into you.

17082.descriptionId: This naiad could've become a beautiful dragonfly if you had given it the chance. But it's clearly not your type.

17084.descriptionId: The Wa Wobot has a really bad back, so he uses this wedge to correct his posture.

17086.descriptionId: Seeing this bone reminds you of the last time you fought a Cannon Dorf, especially his horrible accent that could scare away Moskitos and Orange Larvae. You didn't say anything at the time, to avoid sparking an outburst.

17090.descriptionId: Made of a soft and resistant material, this fabric adapts perfectly to your figure and hides what needs to be hidden, as long as the smell doesn't bother you.

17092.descriptionId: Legend has it that the aroma emanating from this slobber is a blend of all the smells in the world. A real potpourri of fragrances that will make you want to cut your nose off.

17094.descriptionId: With this key in your possession, you'll likely be able to set foot in the Minerock Sanctuary.

17096.descriptionId: If you're lily-livered, this key will let you dive into the ruins of the Flooded Chapel.

17098.descriptionId: This key holds the promise of a future filled with hours and hours of wild, torrid excitement. You like claws and whips, right?

17100.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17102.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17104.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17106.descriptionId: The smiths' chest is very self-conscious so it uses this padding to look softer and more attractive.

17108.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17122.nameId: Lair of the Giant Kralove Key
17122.descriptionId: If you shake it properly, you can use this tentacle to penetrate the Lair of the Giant Kralove.

17124.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title : Abyss Traveler.

17126.descriptionId: After you took a big slice out of this Tikokoko, you can be sure it's wishing it had taken a slice out of you instead.

17128.descriptionId: Although it's all but useless, its stench alone will spread your fame far and wide. This shield accompanies many young adventurers on their first quests – maybe that's why so few make it to thirty.

17130.descriptionId: This major fortification rune can be used on a shield to improve its rank.

17132.descriptionId: Juicy, bloody or medium rare... You can't help but drool whenever you imagine this meat cooked to perfection on your plate.

17134.descriptionId: This scroll is covered in wine stains and traces of grease, but it contains valuable information on illegal Blibli deliveries.

17136.descriptionId: Wilhemina entrusted you with one of her precious Snoofles. Be sure to take good care of it!

17138.descriptionId: There are consequences for everything you do! Especially searching tombs... Now you have a guilty conscience and we can see why.

17140.descriptionId: There are consequences for everything you do! Especially searching tombs... Now you have a guilty conscience and we can see why.

17142.descriptionId: This rock is cold as death... Makes sense, considering where it came from.

17144.descriptionId: Theo Rist wrote this note specially for his colleague Archie Vist, who is studying the marine creatures in Bonta Cemetery.

17148.descriptionId:
This pet is crazy about kamas and goes nuts when it smells any nearby! Some boutiques use Snoofles as kama detectors to determine whether their customers have money to spend there or not. The only downside is that when someone asks if you can spare a few kamas, you can't pretend not to have any...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17150.descriptionId:
If you get the urge to turn this cute little thing into a meatball, just remember that every Plop has a beating heart.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17152.descriptionId:
If you think you've adopted a pet which will snooze peacefully by the hearth, you're in for a shock. The Bowzai's ferociousness is inversely proportional to its size, and it spends all day yowling, hissing and scratching everything to pieces. It also loves to stare at you whilst sniggering, which is neither cute nor reassuring.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17154.descriptionId: If you think you're teasing, mischievous or a joker right now, it's probably because of this headgear. Indeed, it has been imbued with the character of its former wearer, an impish little monkey whose main occupation was annoying the gods by playing bad tricks on them all day long. The monkey ended up being turned into a mountain, so go easy on the jokes.

17156.descriptionId: The staff attached to the back of this cloak has a very unusual power. It can change size at will, making this an item coveted by all, especially men who think that their virility depends on the size of their stick. It's often forgotten that too big a stick is impossible to handle, so why would you want a big stick at whatever cost if you're not going to use it? Besides, that's why the Monkiki'ng uses a sword.

17158.descriptionId: All your monkeying around with this shield will protect you from many things, except one-night flings. Using proper protection should still be a priority.

17160.descriptionId:
Some legends claim that sacrifices of young, innocent souls were necessary to stir up its ferocity, but this is no longer the case.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17168.descriptionId:
Burning with desire to escape from Minotoror Island, the Wingepig's tiny wings took it too close to the sun. Ever since that day, adventurers the world over have been drooling over its perfectly grilled back.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17170.descriptionId:
True believers in their god's precepts, Iopscot pets are always quick to charge head first into close combat.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17172.descriptionId:
With a skilled swoop of its beak, this vulture steals anything that comes within its reach. That makes it an ideal companion for thieves and bandits. The main issue with this method is when you want to get your hands on what it stole. But then, getting your hands dirty is part of the job. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17174.descriptionId:
Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17176.descriptionId:
Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17178.descriptionId:
This pet's suckers, pointy tongue and long tail make this pet the perfect companion for masked parties in the depths of the Osamodas Temple.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17180.descriptionId:
As a well-known fable says, there's no point in being fast if you don't leave on time. With this petsmount, you won't be the first to get there, but you'll still reach your destination. What's more, its exceptional longevity makes the Armoured Tortoise a perfect gift for whichever successor you name.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17182.descriptionId:
Six-legged and highly mobile, the Bony Arachnee is an all-terrain mount that allows you to visit all those hard-to-reach places. Careful, though: don't forget to give it some milk from time to time to make its bones stronger, or you could find yourself in a bad way in a secluded place.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17184.descriptionId:
Foggernaut technology lets land creatures survive under water and lets aquatic creatures survive on dry land. This pet is living proof of that, even though the others ended their lives as toppings for seafood pizza.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17186.descriptionId:
Follow this pet's advice and you, too, will become an expert in the art of outfoxing your opponents.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17188.descriptionId:
Underneath this reinforced carapace, sharp horn and big eyes hides a faithful pet who will be as devoted to you as you've been to the White City.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17190.descriptionId:
Rather playful and a little vicious, the Skrull is the perfect companion to paint the town red throughout the World of Twelve. If you feel like crushing someone's party, look no further: the Skrull is for you.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17192.descriptionId:
It would seem you've caught its eye...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17194.descriptionId:
This unobtrusive little ghost will follow you around without making a peep. Listen closely and you'll hear him say he's the friendliest ghost around.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17196.descriptionId:
This mount has a reputation for responding to every twitch of a finger, every wink, and every sound its rider makes. This last point is extremely important and has been the cause of numerous accidents. It is best to only use the words "charge", "attack", "offence", or indeed any war-related term at all in the appropriate context and circumstances.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17198.descriptionId:
Thanks to this ingenious pet, you'll have the perfect alibi and be at the inn when the militia building explodes.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17200.descriptionId:
The trail of slobber behind this watchdog can be a formidable weapon if used properly, and will show off your pilot skills. However, it makes it extremely easy to follow your trail. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17202.descriptionId:
This spellbook is possessed by a Shushu who was sentenced for having encouraged adventurers to listen to the complaints of other Twelvians rather than letting those same adventurers merely nod without listening and then complain they don't understand the mission they had just accepted.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17204.descriptionId:
When you can't afford the luxury of being accompanied by seven Cras into battle, this miniature version is the next best thing. At the very least, it won't be turned away at the entrance to the Kolossium.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17206.descriptionId:
The gem on her forehead allows Ratalda to accurately determine the beginning of the year of the rat. Since the invention of the calendar, the little rat has unfortunately had a hard time harnessing this talent.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17208.descriptionId:
No one knows how long he's been locked in his ice cube, but one thing is for sure, he could put the whole world at risk if anyone touches his acorn.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17210.descriptionId:
Dorulphe isn't the strongest, Dorulphe isn't the fastest, but he'll always be there on cold and frosty mornings.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17214.descriptionId: Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

17216.descriptionId:
Symbolic of an adventure full of magic, Grifforis will remain faithful to you no matter what you do.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17218.descriptionId:
This pet is cute enough to bite, both literally and figuratively. And that's not all! Its cuteness is made even better by its practicality thanks to the hole in its back where you can insert anything and everything – especially anything – safely.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17220.descriptionId:
An old saying, known to all good disciples of the god of bravery, claims that Iops must sometimes know how to use their heads. Purists decry the use of this shield instead of one's head to strike opponents. Still, you must admit this shield has certain appealing qualities.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17222.descriptionId:
This tiara puts an end to the stereotype of the abusively virile warrior who wears a 200-kilopod wrought-iron helmet, a 3-kametre-long sword covered with the blood of his enemies, and a shield the size of a door. This tiara brings a certain breath of fresh air to Iops' image. However, that won't stop some of them from using it as a weapon in a fistfight if the situation warrants it. As the saying goes, a leopard cannot change its spots!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17224.descriptionId:
Some Iops who are slightly better thinkers than usual question what use the two epaulettes on this cape are, knowing that the vast majority of the Warrior God's followers already wear two of them. But the others generally agree that three epaulettes are always better than two.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17226.descriptionId:
What could be better than a floral ensemble to express your love of nature? In these troubled times, you'll remind everyone to respect what was here before you and what will remain after you've gone.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17228.descriptionId:
This cape can't be worn year-round, but as soon as the sun is out, it blooms! Its colour and smell will leave a lasting impression on everyone you meet.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17230.descriptionId:
If you think fighting with style and grace is impossible, you've never given this shield a try. That said, remember to water it every day or you'll start to look a bit wilted.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17232.descriptionId:
Some tradition-bound Twelvians thought it was forbidden to wear anything other than the Wa Odanowth's Cwown when it was Thwee Kings Cake time. So they wouldn't catch a cold, they voted for the right to wear other attire worthy of a Wa during the event, such as this marvellous cloak.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17234.descriptionId:
This hood reminds you of the days when wearing a hood in class let you copy off your neighbours without the teacher seeing where you were really looking. The acronym "HDFLL" on the label has you completely stumped, however.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17236.descriptionId:
You figured that with a griffin on your arm, you'd outshine every falconer everywhere. But no, alas. If you'd bothered to look at the inscription inside the shield, you'd have seen "VBMR - Secondary Wheel". VBMR probably stands for "very best magnetic roundel" but you're still wondering what that could possibly have to do with flying beasts.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17238.descriptionId:
When you asked what this cape had to do with magic, and they answered "SUIM", you concluded that they were clearly clueless: griffins can fly but aren't very fond of water. But deep down, you suspect they might not be the ones who are clueless.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17240.descriptionId:
The bestial god's horns are very popular among fans of assault and battery. On both the giving and receiving end. No judgement here.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17242.descriptionId:
This shield was designed for Osamodas who have trouble taking a beating and would rather watch than participate actively in the hostilities. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17244.descriptionId:
This cape is the perfect chic accessory when attending a shockingly good party. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17246.descriptionId:
If you've always dreamed of joining the nocturnal world, these wings are perfect for you. Who knows – maybe you'll cross paths with your childhood hero.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17248.descriptionId:
This mask will make you seem wildly charismatic at carnivals. Just don't expect to be able to spy on your ex in the dark while wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17250.descriptionId:
Elegant and downy, this will allow you to do housework in style... or defend yourself, of course!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17252.descriptionId:
Legend has it that the creator of this headgear dreamt of becoming a Unikron, which partly explains the gaping hole in the front of this crownlike piece. The myth was tested, but researchers only got sunburn on their foreheads for their trouble.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17254.descriptionId:
This cloak is over 50% fabric, which is fairly surprising for a piece of Foggernaut equipment.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17256.descriptionId:
This technological jewel shaped like Oktapodas features six golden, rust-resistant tentacles designed to withstand all kinds of damage. From the front and the back, this high-quality item won't let you down. Only one recommendation on use: remember to protect yourself!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17258.descriptionId:
The tail attached to this bag will give you an animal look, but be careful not to step on it...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17260.descriptionId:
Even though this is clearly a fake pair of ears, seen from afar, people will think that you can hear everything and will be careful not to say bad things about you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17262.descriptionId:
The wood of this shield comes straight from Moon's tree, making it extremely robust while remaining light and easy to handle.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17264.descriptionId:
This lance looks like a giant sweet, and you're quite safe putting it in your mouth. You simply need to like the taste of metal and varnish to truly enjoy it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17266.descriptionId:
When you're done parading around, don't forget to hang this shield up on the wall and equip a real shield made for combat, or you'll get a nasty surprise when you find yourself in the middle of the action.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17268.descriptionId:
This cape is designed to impress young boys and appeal to older girls. It works just as well the other way round.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17270.descriptionId:
This helmet's aerodynamic shape shows that it was designed to be worn on the back of a mount, unless it's to help you withstand the wind you'll get in the face.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17272.descriptionId:
Initially designed to mutilate, this weapon can also be used to mutilate or mutilate. The only limit to how you use it is its designer's imagination.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17274.descriptionId:
This shield is used as a portable summary execution tool when you're unable to take your gallows with you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17276.descriptionId:
You alone know whether your father- or mother-in-law was used in this cape's design. That way, you can always complain about your in-laws being on your back.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17278.descriptionId:
Your pet's death made you tougher, but you still can't quite bear to be separated from it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17280.descriptionId:
The most wicked nightmares use these horns to jab sleeping dreamers on the bum. Now they're yours, you can play a nasty trick on your friends, who will have a good laugh once they've stopped screaming.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17282.descriptionId:
Draped in this black-feather finery, you can sneak into innocent villagers' homes in the dead of night to scare them, chuckling all the way. Be sure NOT to wipe your feet off when you go in, as this will up your villain game.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17284.descriptionId:
It is said that if the eye on this shield were to open, whosoever should meet its gaze would fall into a dreamlike limbo for eternity and go completely mad. Just in case the legend is true, keep it facing your enemies.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17286.descriptionId:
Wearing this headgear is very popular among Sssram's disciples, but there are consssequences. Wearing this headgear will make you whistle when you speak, which may annoy everyone around you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17288.descriptionId:
The treacherous part of this shield is that it can be used as a dagger: its bone edge is extremely sharp and very effective for stabbing your enemies.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17290.descriptionId:
Srams hide all sorts of traps and other snares under their capes, and the few visible snags are irrefutable proof of this.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17292.descriptionId:
Every good hunter of strange and mysterious creatures needs this hat, even if it's just to make it look like they take hunting seriously.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17294.descriptionId:
With this cape made from real Boowolf hairs, you won't catch a cold in the chilly corridors of haunted mansions.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17296.descriptionId:
This cape provides efficient camouflage in the darker corners of the World of Twelve. However, wearing it about in broad daylight isn't recommended as the militia is likely to pounce on you very quickly. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17298.descriptionId:
Many use this nightmarish headgear to rascal about anonymously and strike fear in their victims' hearts. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17300.descriptionId:
Young Rogues make one common mistake – using this shield left, right and centre. But they quickly learn that's not the best way to go unnoticed. You need to look unobtrusive so you don't scare your vict... err, clients.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17302.descriptionId:
The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17304.descriptionId: Perfect for when you want to jump into the fray and fight beak and claw!

17306.descriptionId:
The quality of one's appearance is often found in the details. With this cape, you're certain not to make a mess of it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17308.descriptionId:
This headgear gives off a presence that will make everyone think that you belong to the upper classes.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17310.descriptionId:
These protectors are rare and highly prized pieces that give whoever wears them unrivalled elegance.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17312.descriptionId:
Nobody knows if Moushu was a little mouse or just a little girl who liked mice. One thing is certain: both stories are told every new year of the rat.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17314.descriptionId:
For some odd reason, you are very seriously asking yourself if slipping your milk teeth into the hem of this cape would do any good at all.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17316.descriptionId:
Forged to celebrate the year of the rat, this small ornamental shield is so refined that it'd be a shame to use it in combat. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17318.descriptionId:
This headgear is just what you needed to hide your big head.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17320.descriptionId:
This cloak is lined with a layer of polystyrene composite, to protect your botty from smacks.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17322.descriptionId:
This shield looks like a target and will attract arrows from archers high and low. Give it to your worst enemy as a present.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17324.descriptionId:
With this wand, you can show your guests the door when they prove themselves to be wittier than you at your dinner parties.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17326.descriptionId:
When Father Kwismas climbs down the chimneys in Amakna, he usually leaves a lot of gifts for young adventures with big dreams. This time, he left you his sack – maybe so you can bring some Kwismas magic of your own to the World of Twelve...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17328.descriptionId:
You exude style and class. This headgear never fails to impress.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17330.descriptionId:
With this cloak, you can rule the world from your ship... but don't lose your way!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17332.descriptionId:
It may not be ideal for self-defence, but it'll come in handy when you write your flowery epic.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17334.descriptionId:
Donning this golden horned headgear will show everyone that luxury and elegance are your thing, but no one will dare comment on it to your face.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17336.descriptionId:
The process used to weave this cape made of Albino Arachnee silk is highly complex but produces a light, sturdy and ridiculously stretchy fabric.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17338.descriptionId:
The culmination of Feca art, this shield is indestructible and a source of eternal pride for its designers. Its refined colours are a treat for the eyes, too.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17340.descriptionId:
Bearing this shield is a not-at-all discreet way of showing the world you're a conqueror.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17342.descriptionId:
This cape will make your comings and goings more momentous. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17344.descriptionId:
While it won't help your eyesight any, this helmet will make sure you're seen. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17346.descriptionId:
This thick cloak will easily cushion a few smacks on the bottom.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17350.descriptionId:
With its antiquated design, this hat will make you look like a seasoned explorer.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17352.descriptionId:
Whether by land or by sea, set off to discover new places! Assuming there are any left to discover...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17354.descriptionId:
This compass-shaped shield won't tell you where north is, but you CAN use it to play roulette with your adventuring mates.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17356.descriptionId:
Wearing this mask, which was forged with the soul of a monster, you can defeat many a monster... Just take care not to become one.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17358.descriptionId:
The perfect finishing touch to any disguise is a cape. This one will add a considerable class to your mysterious style.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17360.descriptionId:
This shield is made of gold and feathers, which makes it solid and easy to wield. In addition, its sharp sides mean you can use it offensively as well as defensively should the need arise.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17362.descriptionId:
Wherever you go with this bag bearing the effigy of Nekineko, don't be surprised if you get followed around by a crowd of Enutrofs.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17364.descriptionId:
This shield saved a Stubbyob prince's life when he faced an albino Bwork. It may save yours when you face your in-laws.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17366.descriptionId:
This coat of arms rewards the most tenacious veterans and superb tacticians. The lowest of low blows and most dazzling acts have no secrets for them.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17368.descriptionId:
This coat of arms rewards the spectacular feats of the best fighters from among the ordinary rank and file. This gives them a place of pride in all the inns in the World of Twelve.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17370.descriptionId:
