This coat of arms is a reward for young fighters who show great promise. So you see, fighting in the mud and biting your opponent's foot or pulling his ear was worth it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17372.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Magic Hat emote.

17374.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Magic Broom emote.

17376.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Animal emote.

17378.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Insectoid emote.

17380.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Carnival emote.

17382.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Mark of War ornament.

17384.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Mark of Misery ornament.

17386.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Mark of Servitude ornament.

17388.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Shariva Standard emote.

17390.descriptionId: Either hot or cold, this steak will satisfy the most voracious of appetites.

17392.descriptionId: Either hot or cold, this steak will satisfy the most voracious of appetites.

17394.descriptionId: This preserved Kaniger meat may now be kept for many days before use.

17396.descriptionId: This preserved Kaniger meat may now be kept for many days before use.

17398.descriptionId:
This meat is as tender as Mushd brain.

(This meat can be harvested by level-70 and higher Hunters.)

17400.descriptionId:
This meat is as tender as Mushd brain.

(This meat can be harvested by level-80 and higher Hunters.)

17404.descriptionId: A beautiful, delicious hazelnut that would be coveted by any squirrel in the World of Twelve.

17406.descriptionId: They say that the Monkiki'ng could travel the length and breadth of Amakna without ever tiring. The boots he wore are said to have been enchanted after he won a bet. Although their power has waned over the years, they are still powerful items.

17408.descriptionId: If you don't feel like using this "thing" as a shield, you can always use it to unclog sinks or as a signal in the event of a road accident...

17410.descriptionId: This solid armour plating was designed to use crushed bones of the Undried. Surprisingly flexible and elegant, this carapace will certainly be an effective ally when finishing off those marine monsters.

17412.descriptionId: This shield has been liberally padded with hair of diverse origins to make it softer. Odd for an object like this, wouldn't you say? Yet, this shield has been used alternately as a serving platter during Kanig celebrations and as a cushion for lengthy naps while on guard duty.

17414.descriptionId: The Minerock culture is deeply marked by respect for their ancestors. This bit of rock claims to be a splinter of an ancient, honoured Minerock. When you hold it, you feel great power between your hands. A very unique aura emanates from this stone... Or maybe it's all just in your head...

17416.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17418.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17420.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17422.descriptionId:
When you wear this cape, you announce that you're a proud and honourable GA member.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17430.descriptionId:
Condemned to fight for all eternity in the arenas of the Krosmoz, this skeleton of a warrior has found a way to escape its fate by sticking to you like glue.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17432.descriptionId:
Sow death while respecting nature. Cut down souls and flowers in one fell swoop.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17434.descriptionId:
Keep your upper body toasty and your lower body cool, for those transitional seasons.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17436.descriptionId:
Perfect for winter, or for avoiding your grandpa's war stories.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17438.descriptionId: This very fine object was fashioned by Xelor's skilful hands and will let you keep track of time! The "tick-tock" you hear means that the item is working and you're losing valuable minutes gazing at this chronokameter rather than working towards your goal.

17444.descriptionId: This certificate describes the characteristics of the petsmount that you left at the Bow Kennel.

17450.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Gladiator ornament.

17452.descriptionId: Not much to say about this. It's a Trool head... so it's ugly and very smelly.

17454.descriptionId: Flexible enough that they won't hinder movement, but with thick enough soles to keep in heat. For everyone who's always wanted to go out and fight in the rain on stormy nights, this shoe fits.

17456.descriptionId:
If petting a dreamy creature has always been a pipe dream of yours, now you can.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17458.descriptionId: This thing stinks. It stinks so much that merely imagining the stench that can waft from a Trool's mouth turns your stomach.

17460.descriptionId: You've recently picked this beautiful wild flower in Eltneg Wood.

17462.descriptionId: This bouquet was clearly not put together by skilled hands. It has a certain elegance all the same.

17464.descriptionId: This necklace is made of several yellowish teeth that give off an abominable smell.

17466.descriptionId: Admit it: you have never even come close to being as romantic as that child.

17468.descriptionId: Much too heavy to belong to a creature of this world, this skull, according to the witch Blair, is the key to defeating the infamous Lord Crow. That's all.

17470.descriptionId: You can always hang this tooth from a strap around your neck and claim it used to belong to the terrible trash-vampire, Edward.

17472.descriptionId: The lumberjack in Cania Forest entrusted you with this chest containing wood for Stah Gekoach. He is supposed to be in the Crow's Domain, a region that's said to be cursed...

17474.descriptionId: Not much to say about this. It's a Trool head... so it's ugly and rather smelly.

17476.descriptionId: This Kanig powder keg contains a variable amount of explosive powder.

17478.descriptionId: Use this Kanig powder to make things go... BANG!

17480.descriptionId: This barrel contains several kalitres of mineral water.

17482.descriptionId:
This mineral water is a favourite among Minerocks. Fully approved by the Crakillian Guardian.

You'll obtain this water by opening barrels of mineral water owned by the Minerocks.

17484.descriptionId: If you don't move a muscle, maybe nobody will notice you!

17486.descriptionId: Mystical Crystal Skull Marked by Lord Crow's Magic

17488.descriptionId: Don't swallow these seeds for a laugh – a sapling might decide to grow in your stomach!

17492.descriptionId:
Once you try this shield, you'll never let it out of your grip, and vice versa.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17496.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Az'Hassin ornament.

17498.descriptionId: These weapons appear to have served their owners for a long time.

17500.descriptionId: You stole this crumpled note from Aryssa Chervil's bandits' hideout.

17502.descriptionId:
This gland gives off a strong smell... You idly wonder if Lori's plan is going to work.

You can collect this resource from Bliblis in Cania Forest.

17504.descriptionId: Concocted from smelly Blibli glands, this small amount of fragrance emits an absolutely repulsive odour.

17506.descriptionId: Aryssa Chervil has come with you to find her friend Lori Luncco.

17510.descriptionId: This small translucent Plop that washed up on the shore should come in handy.

17512.descriptionId: This powder was extracted from rocks that are special to Minerocks. You can use it to appease the tormented spirits of the Minerock ancestors.

17514.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Musical Aura emote.

17516.descriptionId: Shockingly, a Bwork's cranium does contain grey matter.

17518.descriptionId: This ring, made of Treechnid Bark, has great powers but carries great responsibility with it. However, in spite of its value, it is said to be cursed.

17520.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17522.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

17524.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Explorer Emeritus".

17528.descriptionId: Now, not only you can have your head in the clouds whenever you want, you can also soar wherever you go!

17538.descriptionId: Many generations ago already, the Pandalans sculpted their incense holders out of stones like this one supposedly imbued with the memory of local truths. However, no one will tell you that this material was above all used to reason with those who turned a deaf ear to obvious truths that were already under their very noses.

17540.descriptionId: This document details coordinated action by Pandissidents against those they describe as harmful to efforts at maintaining their influence near Aerdala.

17542.descriptionId: This scroll seems to be several centuries old. At the top is a description of the family that used to live in the clearing. A more recent annotation has been added to the family tree: the only descendant still alive would seem to be on long-term assignment at the Pandawa Temple in Amakna, and has never claimed the family inheritance.

17544.descriptionId: It is said that this precious instrument has the power to trigger curious symptoms in its owner, notably hallucinations, incoherent speech, and headaches. Some would call all these additions to traditional meditation an "alcohol-free hangover".

17548.descriptionId: These fibres represent the fragile but lasting ties you've forged between the Kozaru and the Pandawas.

17550.descriptionId: Made from powerful artefacts from the major spirits of Pandala, this paintbrush will let you do astral calligraphy.

17552.descriptionId: This sacred stone was blessed by the Rock Spirit in person. Extremely rare, it allows those who hold have one to attempt Astral Calligraphy.

17554.descriptionId: This stick of ink was made from the ashes and embers of the Fire Spirit.

17558.descriptionId: This water – the clearest and most limpid of all water – is the first element used in astral caligraphy. It is so perfect that just looking at it makes you tear up. So make sure you don't drink it if you get thirsty.

17560.descriptionId: This kit contains everything needed to practice the art of calligraphy properly.

17562.descriptionId: Kwapa water isn't very different from the water you drink every day, but crafters continue to believe that it's needed to make many different items.

17564.descriptionId: This item is a sort of hollow tube that shoots small projectiles when you blow into it. Kind of like a blowgun, only made out of bamboo.

17566.descriptionId: It is very hard to explain just what cucumbers are and what they're used for. Mainly because how they're used depends on the context.

17568.descriptionId: These pants are red, of course. Not blue. What am I saying? They're not vulgar underpants, they're a true work of art! You could even call them a masterpants! Get it? Masterpiece, masterpants... Don't worry... That joke will get funnier every time you (don't) hear it.

17570.descriptionId: These coveralls are a very functional piece of clothing. Oddly, however, these don't come in XXL and so they rarely cover all.

17572.descriptionId: Katana is a very big word to describe such a tiny wisp of a thing that can barely cut anything. At the same time, the Kwamurai are very pale imitations of samurai. They seem more like children waving twigs than real swordsmen. Good riddance!

17574.descriptionId:
The Lady of the Water is a huge fan of the rubber Quaquack method. Have your plans to capture small children all come up empty? Telling your Quaquack all your troubles could help you figure out where you've been going wrong!

That said, holding this duck in your hands isn't a sure sign that the method will work.

17576.descriptionId: If you find a way to integrate a statuette and the grains of white sand inside this artefact, you can leave it on your fireplace on Kwismas night.

17578.descriptionId: This nectar contains all the energy of Plantala – an unexpected natural power that could surprise you.

17580.descriptionId: This bud bodes well for new beginnings but also seems a wee bit unstable... As a precaution, keep it in a stable, shake-free environment.

17582.descriptionId: This hollow stalk has many uses. Indeed, when bamboo runs short, some Kwapa use it as a blowgun.

17584.descriptionId: It's said that, because of their inflatable pistils, flowistils would be able to fly if they breathed in helium.

17586.descriptionId: When a plant doesn't seem to have thorns, that's when it pricks you. That's Plantala's hidden talent.

17592.descriptionId: This magic artefact is used by the Pandawushu disciples to enchant their equipment.

17594.descriptionId: The Kozaru can cut through the air effortlessly with this pelt.

17596.descriptionId: This scarf floats in the air constantly even when there's no wind. This significantly increases your charisma, except when it flaps into your eye or it catches on a branch.

17598.descriptionId: If you see an Uchiwang tie a ribbon around her hair, you can bet she's just invented a new technique for tearing you apart.

17600.descriptionId: Certain unscrupulous people sell these bracelets by claiming that they bestow "insert random property" on anyone who wears them.

17602.descriptionId: Don't fan yourself shamelessly with these fans: you wouldn't want to lose your life or your sight.

17604.descriptionId: This scrap of fabric is waterproof and extremely durable. It's your best friend when the rain-and-wind apocalypse arrives. But everyone knows that such an apocalypse will never happen...

17606.descriptionId: Experienced Fangshu use the tips of their spears like harpoons to jump on their enemies.

17608.descriptionId: Just like thorns and brambles can give you a nice prick after you've cut them down, this broken blade still cuts deep. Take care, there's plenty of fight left in it.

17610.descriptionId: How can anyone hold an object made entirely of air? The answer is right in front of you.

17612.descriptionId: Tanukis reputedly bring good luck and fortune. These hairs, which you ever so gently borrowed, will make an excellent good luck charm.

17614.descriptionId: These enormous testicles are covered with a very soft down which works wonders in resisting magic attacks, accidental self-inflicted blows from stilts, and the trance-induced damage the Tanukouï San does to himself when summoning a Tanuki Chan. In any case, you're holding something really very special in your hands!

17616.descriptionId: This mask enchanted by Earth magic lets Shinobuubusus turn into terrifying golems.

17618.descriptionId: One can reasonably wonder how stone gloves can be articulated. They aren't really, but become articulated in the hands of Ishibig Paks and their stupefying Rock magic.

17620.descriptionId: It's difficult to say which – this wand or your face – most offended the massive Titinuki from whom you managed to steal it.

17622.descriptionId: These glasses are too small for your face, but if you want to amuse those around you, they'll fit your family jewels nicely.

17624.descriptionId: You destroyed this piece of pottery but unfortunately it didn't contain any rubies.

17626.descriptionId: Not to be confused with the artefact from the poorer side of Brakmar.

17628.descriptionId: Take this with you on a date if you intend to ask your beloved for their hand. If the answer's a "yes, oh, yes", give them this item to symbolise the burning flames of your love. And if the answer is "no, just no", you can always use this burning flame to hide your feelings of rejection.

17630.nameId: Valley of the Lady of the Water Key
17630.descriptionId: This key lets you adventure into the Valley of the Lady of the Water, a mysterious valley at the edge of Akwadala. Please note: bathing is strongly discouraged in this beautiful place.

17632.descriptionId: This key lets you enter Tanukouï San's Workshop. Be careful, though: it will be destroyed after use.

17634.descriptionId: This key lets you enter the Wind Dojo. Be careful, though: it will be destroyed after use.

17636.descriptionId: When stuffed up the nose, this key will protect you from foot odour and stinky breath after a night of excessive imbibing at the inn.

17638.descriptionId: This key would make a lousy toothpick but an excellent nose pick. It can therefore keep your hands (and nose) busy as you travel through the Damadrya's Bamboo Grove.

17640.descriptionId: Those are not actually eyeballs floating in the bottle; they're just apriplums. That means they're a lot less creepy than you thought and altogether a poor idea for an Al Howin accessory. But Umeshusu is delicious. Just take a sip and let yourself be carried away on fruit-filled waves of nectar to a land of unsuspected flavour.

17642.descriptionId: This dry beer is recommended by the Grandapan for unclogging the ears and thereby hearing the voice of the goddess better.

17682.descriptionId: This little bag contains a prayer to the Fire Spirit.

17684.descriptionId: This inky egg seems colourless and translucent. Has it lost some of its magic? The dragon Orukam should be able to answer that question.

17712.descriptionId: This lantern isn't perfect but you've poured all your love into making it; maybe the Fire Spirit will be moved by what could be called your "artistic process".

17716.descriptionId: This traditional Pandawa pastry is a ball of sticky rice stuffed with sesame seeds. Why not have a contest to see who can put the most in their mouth at once? Just don't forget to take a breath first: that mistake cost their creator, the famous Pandamanu Wanchiao, his life.

17732.descriptionId: Eating this fruit once will then let you enter a different world.

17754.descriptionId: This katana gives off an intense heat without actually burning you. When you use it, you seem to be able to detect your enemies' weak points more easily.

17756.descriptionId: This katana is unusually light, which helps you pull off aerial moves and effective dodges. When you lower this weapon, it seems to disappear in a puff of wind.

17758.descriptionId: This katana has tried and true handling, which helps you perform fluid and unpredictable movements. When carrying it, you are filled with a sense of calm and serenity.

17760.descriptionId: This katana is extremely heavy for its size but also rock solid. It's difficult to handle for a novice but makes a formidable weapon in a sabre duel.

17766.descriptionId: Thanks to this shield, win your battles without buckling under the weight of flowers!

17768.descriptionId: If you've always dreamed of having lots of children, don this cape and dance through the fields. When you return in the spring, your babies will have sprouted.

17770.descriptionId: Despite the rumours, jumping on the back of a Kwapa won't ensure victory.

17772.descriptionId: This headgear has many uses. These include as a head-covering, of course, but also as a bucket, chamber pot, or spittoon.

17774.descriptionId: Bakas typically use cucumbers to make handles for their axes... but this was clearly an exception. That said, it is true that a wood and metal handle is more appropriate than cucumber for a weapon.

17776.descriptionId: If you've ever meanly swiped this hat from someone, know that someday someone will make you eat this hat.

17778.descriptionId: What's the secret to a roasty breadstick? Know-how and love! Available only from the best local artisans. And maybe elsewhere.

17780.descriptionId: Ideal for those spontaneous and oh-so-explosive games of lawn bowling among friends, this handmade cloth bag contains a full set of the highest quality Firefoux balls. Burn ointment not included.

17782.descriptionId: This Firefoux cannon is fantastic for launching fireworks far and high. Sadly, replacing the fireworks with tiny humans has been forbidden ever since the incident with a... Oh, never mind.

17784.descriptionId: The Ino-Naru use this nunchaku-boomerang hybrid in everything they do: hunting, fishing, and traditional activities.

17786.descriptionId: This cape will do a marvellous job of protecting you from the most violent of winds, but it won't stop you from being ignored by everyone you try to talk to.

17788.descriptionId: Hanshi has performed many a feat with this extendable staff. While it's truly impressive in size, don't be ashamed if yours is smaller – you, too, can do big things.

17790.descriptionId: Don't fan yourself shamelessly with these fans: you wouldn't want to lose your life or your sight.

17792.descriptionId: Never stand around idly with these boots on your feet or you just might take root.

17794.descriptionId: Swallow this amulet and it'll release a small seed in your stomach. If you open your mouth regularly on sunny days and drink enough water, maybe a shrub will grow inside you.

17796.descriptionId: Accused of stealing children to drown and devour them, the Lady of the Water really just wants to adopt them. So, she turns them into Kwapa so they don't drown.

17798.descriptionId: Very useful for shelling small nuts, these gloves are also – and above all – formidable weapons against opponents of the male persuasion.

17800.descriptionId: With a belt such as this one, it's hard not to imagine what's below it. And equally hard not to think of what's below other people's belts.

17802.descriptionId: The craftsman who designed this ring clearly wanted to revolutionise how jewellery is worn. As you can see, this beautiful object doesn't fit around one finger but instead between two fingers thanks to its clever design.

17804.descriptionId: These rockets might not get you all the way to the moon, but you've got a decent shot at landing in hospital.

17806.descriptionId: If you drop the pearls on this necklace, you'll be certain to hurl in frustration.

17808.descriptionId: Like a moon veiled behind dark clouds at night, the brightest light is often hidden in the blackest of inks.

17810.descriptionId: They say that every one of the Dorigami's thousand folds hides a mystery, the reflection of a lie or painful truth, of blinding purity, like as many facets of a paper diamond.

17812.descriptionId: You're accompanying Urametus to the Sad Clearing in Pandala.

17814.descriptionId: This piece of jewellery seems to give off special affection. It's said that spoken words fade away and only written words remain, but keeping certain things can cause suffering.

17816.descriptionId: Surely once a bouquet full of affection, the unique feature of this item is the extraordinary care that was taken to keep each flower in its place.

17818.descriptionId: It's not your place to read the contents of this correspondence. However, you assume that its author didn't have a recipient more suitable than the blue waves.

17820.descriptionId: This roll of hand-crafted stationary has seen powerful emotions and the story of more than one life play out. Between the very first letter received and this piece of paper, what was behind this beautiful and symbolic correspondence?

17830.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Star Gazer".

17832.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Earth Lover".

17834.descriptionId:
This shield is proof of your interest in the mysteries of Pandala Island. And by that we don't mean the Grandapan's private reserve. This is not really a pass.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17836.descriptionId: This bouquet with a characteristic scent seems to contain the perfect balance of colours. There's no doubt that these delicately cut flowers were a beautiful message full of affection.

17846.descriptionId:
Don't be fooled by its nonchalant air: the Weebamboo is a fearsome fighter and always eager to give you a hand in a scrape.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17848.descriptionId:
Niceties schmiceties, your flying mount with its talons travels on foot because that's what it likes. Other adventurers can laugh if they like, but you'll be the classy one on its feathered back.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17850.descriptionId:
This shield is rare and likes that fact to be known. So don't get it dirty, or you'll be sorry.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17852.descriptionId:
This shield will take you to infinity and beyond.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17854.descriptionId:
You might be surprised at there being a shield in an Az'Hassin's paraphernalia, but there is actually a very simple explanation. In fact, apprentices sometimes mess up their first attempts at murder, so they are given a shield to try and survive after having failed miserably to kill a defenceless person by surprise.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17856.descriptionId:
Make sure you keep this shield with you for the day you no longer feel like holding out an olive branch to everyone you meet. It is very easy to wield, which will help with your defence.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17858.descriptionId:
Cloaks are annoying – always getting underfoot and tripping you up. A flask full of bamboo milk, however, always comes in handy.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17860.descriptionId:
There are all sorts of doras out there, but it seems that the bamboo this one was made out of has taken over and is still growing.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

17864.descriptionId: This rice was polished with love. Apparently, that's a vital step in ensuring good shaké tastes the way it should.

17870.descriptionId: Hikatori made this little bag with great care. The coloured fabric gives off the scent of citrus.

17872.descriptionId: The intoxicating scent of this drink has a heady effect on you before you've even taken the first sip.

17888.descriptionId: This item can be used to reset a daily quest.

17890.descriptionId: This item can be used to reset a daily quest.

17896.descriptionId: This thick, stinky hair was ripped forcibly off the backside of a horrible, ginger creature.

17898.descriptionId: This hair came from a small ginger creature full of tricks and trickery, like so many others.

17900.descriptionId: These hairs come from a Boombardier, a terrible creature that looks quite puny but in reality has terrible magical powers.

17902.descriptionId: This smooth, fine skin offers excellent protection from the various magical attacks that the Gingerocket encounters when spells backfire.

17904.descriptionId: In times gone by, people used this to make underwear for children with sensitive skin. Spitfoux skin underwear has been approved by Captain Chafer's descendants.

17906.descriptionId: This tail is so magical that it's still wagging, even after having been cut, dried and stuffed! If you're smart enough, you'll find another use for it that doesn't involve hanging it above your fireplace.

17908.descriptionId: This red-coloured magic fabric is imbued with an ultra-powerful magic. Not quite a feature you share!

17910.descriptionId: This classic wooden pipe seems to have survived the ages. The many layers of residue tarnishing it could, however, reveal the secret of Founoroshi's legendary calm. But that remains to be seen!

17912.descriptionId: Originally, Nagate didn't wear a crown of any kind. Seeing her as their mother, however, the Kwapa began giving her all kinds of presents made from objects found throughout the region or taken directly from the inhabitants of Akwadala. This crown is one such gift.

17914.descriptionId: With this brush, Tanukouï San's every work is a masterpiece. If only your parents could have borrowed it!

17916.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of onions.

17918.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many onions.

17920.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of cherries.

17922.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many cherries.

17924.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of lemons.

17926.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many lemons.

17928.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of babbage leaves.

17930.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many babbage leaves.

17932.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of hunks of blubber.

17934.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many hunks of blubber.

17936.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of doses of pepper.

17938.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many doses of pepper.

17940.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of magical cures.

17942.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many magical cures.

17944.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of resin.

17946.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many resins.

17948.descriptionId: This bag contains lots of doses of salt.

17950.descriptionId: This bag contains a great many doses of salt.

17952.descriptionId: This barrel contains lots of drinking water.

17954.descriptionId: This barrel contains a huge amount of drinking water.

17956.descriptionId: This barrel contains lots of infected blood.

17958.descriptionId: This barrel contains a huge amount of infected blood.

17960.descriptionId: This spell scroll will teach you the spell: Soul Capture.

17962.descriptionId: You'll have an even chance of capturing level-150 souls using this soul stone.

17964.descriptionId: This little burning stone contains the soul of the Yokai PwaPwaPwa.

17986.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

17988.descriptionId: The trinket seller in Pandala wrote down some instructions to get you to the site of the meeting with his fake Dofus supplier.

17990.descriptionId: This egg is a bit strange because it smells rotten even when it's not. Just imagine what it must smell like when it really is rotten. Note that nobody knows which arrived first in Amakna, the Tofu or the Tofu Egg.

17996.descriptionId: A Pandawa samurai is accompanying you to offer aid to General Tiliwan.

17998.descriptionId: This little pile of polished rice isn't perfect but it should be enough to make shaké. Too bad it's all dirty...

18000.descriptionId: This letter, written by General Tiliwan herself, should be enough to convince people that you're on an official mission.

18004.descriptionId: This book by Agra Tseki contains every bit of information currently know about the Kwapa.

18008.descriptionId: This cucumber dish is one of the Osakwa innkeeper's regular specials. A taste of it can even calm a somewhat aggressive Kwapa.

18014.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18016.descriptionId: An odd little Kwapa is following you to recover the photo you showed him. Be careful. He could take fright easily.

18018.descriptionId: This is a delivery slip. Several drawings of explosives have been sketched out roughly alongside numbers. The exact meaning escapes you, but you can tell that it appears to be a very dangerous order. The signature on the bottom of the slip belongs to a certain Spyro Technic, a pyrotechnician.

18026.descriptionId: Burning this incense will most certainly thicken the layer of clouds above Feudala and help prevent Light Parasites from invading the region.

18028.descriptionId: This colourful poster invites the Yokai, Pandawas and Firefoux to take part in the festivities as volunteers!

18060.descriptionId: This tuft of hair is both silky and rough at the same time. The creature it came from must be quite surprising.

18062.descriptionId: This huge volume contains all the information needed to handle the "Showstopper".

18064.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18074.descriptionId: This Kwapa water is crystal clear. It's a real shame you can't drink it.

18076.nameId: Letter of Recommendation from Anaki Nawa
18076.descriptionId: This letter proves that you've brought a bit of order back to Akwadala. Take good care of it.

18102.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18104.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18106.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18108.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18110.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18112.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18114.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18116.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18138.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18140.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18146.descriptionId: This seed was entrusted to you by the spirits of Plantala in every corner of Pandala Island.

18152.descriptionId: You've solved the stone riddle. Congratulations!

18156.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18164.descriptionId: This bamboo wood comes from the woody region of Plantala. It seems to be in perfect condition and would undoubtedly come in very handy when making a weapon, a building, or even art!

18166.descriptionId: The Tanukis wear this artefact with pride. It is said to bring good luck and ensure those who wear it unparalleled fertility.

18168.descriptionId: This work of art is supposed to represent the quintessence of the Tanuki people. Why? Only an expert in Tanuki art could say!

18170.descriptionId: This document contains extensive information on the tensions between Plantala and Terrdala. Another document seems to be attached to it.

18176.descriptionId: This insignia proves that you've successfully completed the Kozaru balance challenge.

18178.descriptionId: This insignia proves that you've successfully completed the Kozaru wisdom challenge.

18180.descriptionId: This insignia proves that you've successfully completed the Kozaru strength challenge.

18182.descriptionId: You have successfully taken control of a being's spirit through meditation.

18184.descriptionId: This letter bears the Daimya Hikomi's seal. If you decide to open this letter to read what it says, you'll need to break the seal and everyone will know!

18188.descriptionId: The seal on this letter, signed by Daimya Hikomi herself, has been broken. Everyone can now see that you've read it...

18200.descriptionId: This carefully folded letter was signed by Pandarin Mukiwa himself.

18202.descriptionId: Even though this scroll was scribbled in haste, it is your only hope of rallying the Kozaru to your cause.

18208.descriptionId: This book teaches you about the Tanukis.

18210.descriptionId: This mixture is very unstable. Tanu Morphuki has asked you to pour it over Tanukouï San's terracotta soldiers.

18214.descriptionId: You're hiding in a magnificent jar so that no one spots you. Try not to move so you don't attract trouble...

18244.descriptionId: The flame lodged in this lantern warms your heart. Handle it carefully so you don't burn yourself.

18252.descriptionId: This book by Agra Tseki contains every bit of information currently know about the Kwapa.

18254.descriptionId: This book teaches you about the Tanukis.

18256.nameId: Quest: Fake Dofus dialog Pandassiss Tant
18256.descriptionId: Quest: Fake Dofus dialog Pandassiss Tant

18267.descriptionId:
Inspired by the infamous Sadida dolls, Masquerscots look more like sad clowns than world-class fighters. Unfortunately for you, you can indeed judge some books by their covers.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18268.descriptionId: This very small purse of kamas should ensure that you don't starve to death today.

18269.descriptionId:
Many an Amaknian has heard tell of the Tofoone that laid the golden eggs, but no one has ever seen it or its eggs. Gobtubbys with golden horns, on the other hand, are very real – and you've got one right here to prove it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18270.descriptionId: This purse of kamas should ensure that you eat well today.

18271.descriptionId:
Blitzem is the ideal pet for all those who sorely need a flash of brilliance at every level.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18272.descriptionId: This fat purse of kamas should ensure that you eat very well today.

18273.descriptionId:
This little Pandawa stays afloat by releasing a constant stream of natural gas. That way, it can avoid obstacles and easily join you when it's time to wet your whistle.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18274.descriptionId: This small purse of kamas should ensure that you don't starve to death today.

18275.descriptionId:
Rather than carrying their barrels on their backs, lazy Pandawas prefer barrels that can move around on their own.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18276.descriptionId: This small pouch of doploons should help you buy items in your favourite class temple.

18277.descriptionId:
This Slayhound has the ability to adapt the colour of its fur to the colours of its rider. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18278.descriptionId: This pouch of doploons should help you buy items in your favourite class temple.

18279.descriptionId:
This headgear was inspired by the Lotus flowers that grow on Pandala Island. You can only imagine its scent, however, since sniffing the hair of strangers is usually frowned upon.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18280.descriptionId: This pouch of kolossokens should let you earn items in the Kolossium without putting your life on the line.

18281.descriptionId:
If you don't like going unnoticed, here's a cape that should delight you. As imposing as it is elegant, it symbolises several noble Pandawan dynasties.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18282.descriptionId: This large pouch of kolossokens should let you earn items in the Kolossium without putting your life on the line.

18283.descriptionId:
This umbrella may seem flimsy but it's surprisingly sturdy. It can protect you from the sun, will come in handy in the rain, and could even become a means of locomotion on very windy days.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18284.descriptionId: This large pouch of doploons should help you buy items in your favourite class temple.

18285.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Vitality.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Vitality.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Vitality is below 25.

18286.descriptionId: This small pouch of kolossokens should let you earn items in the Kolossium without putting your life on the line.

18287.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Wisdom.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Wisdom.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Wisdom is below 25.

18288.descriptionId: This fragment contains a few runes that will surely come in handy.

18289.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Strength.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is below 25.

18290.descriptionId: This fragment contains a few runes that will surely come in handy.

18291.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Chance.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Chance.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Chance is below 25.

18292.descriptionId: This fragment contains a few runes that will surely come in handy.

18293.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Intelligence.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Intelligence.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Intelligence is below 25.

18294.descriptionId: This fragment contains a few runes that will surely come in handy.

18295.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Agility.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Agility.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Agility is below 25.

18296.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18297.descriptionId:
Since blood baths don't really make the hearts of Twelvians flutter, well-prepared Sacriers never leave home without a Sacriscot. That way, their blood baths last longer.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18298.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18299.descriptionId:
The engineer who built this pet had the bright idea of giving it the same shape as a die, but then forgot to put the pips on the sides. So, instead of raking in the winnings, it's mainly good for collecting dust.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18300.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18301.descriptionId:
The elders say that once you come back to life, you're never really the same again. It would seem that the darkest aspects remain, while all the good dissipates, leaving only a sad husk lacking that once-defining spark. No one knows why the Virizeon comes back to life, but everyone agrees that he attaches himself to very unsavoury beings afterwards.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18302.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18303.descriptionId:
Just like gobballs are a dinner's best friend, dolls are a Sadida's best friend. Day or night, rain or shine, hugs are always welcome.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18304.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18305.descriptionId:
Since he can't turn back time, he loves wasting yours by making you turn back the clock over and over again.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18306.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18307.descriptionId:
Your companions are always the first to make you suffer, especially in situations you'd rather have avoided, such as listening to them snore loud enough to wake the dead at night. This sword, however, will only make you bleed the strict minimum. Just enough so you can show off your scars at the Astrub Zaap. Maybe a little bit more. If you're lucky.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18308.descriptionId:
[!] (Double tap pour gagner de l'expérience)
Ce parchemin permet de gagner de l'expérience sans prendre de risques.

18309.descriptionId:
This small fennec fox is particularly fond of napping in and around tombs, especially ones that are lavishly decorated. 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18310.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain XP.)
Use this scroll to gain XP without putting yourself on the line.

18311.descriptionId:
This Unikron will shower glitter on you wherever you are and whatever you do, which means you'll find it in your pockets, safe, haven bag, socks, hair, food and just about everywhere else.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18312.descriptionId:
[!] (Double tap pour gagner de l'expérience)
Ce parchemin permet de gagner de l'expérience sans prendre de risques.

18313.descriptionId:
Since Masqueraiders have surpassed Sadidas when it comes to masks, those nature lovers have sought out other attributes to set themselves apart. With this headgear, you might say they've succeeded.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18314.descriptionId: This pouch contains a valuable quantity of goultines.

18315.descriptionId:
With the real feathers in this cap, you'll feel ready to conquer the world whenever you wear it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18316.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title Lucky.

18317.descriptionId:
This helmet tends to reflect the immense void often found in the hearts – and sometimes heads – of those who wear it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18318.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title Daily Quester.

18319.descriptionId:
This lightweight headgear won't ruin your beautiful knightly hairdo.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18320.descriptionId: This small pouch contains a valuable quantity of goultines.

18321.descriptionId:
This headgear is all the rage among Enutrofs in the middle of that awkward adolescent phase, which often includes sudden hair loss. Sacriers would have gladly done without this kind of publicity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18322.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Agility.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Agility.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Agility is above 49 and below 75.

18323.descriptionId:
Inside the helmet is a brief inscription engraved into the metal: 
"Victoriae mundis et mundis lacrima." This doesn't actually mean anything, but it does sound pretty amazing. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18324.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Intelligence.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Intelligence.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Intelligence is above 49 and below 75.

18325.descriptionId:
It may look quite like a luxury trool toothpick, but don't be fooled: this bony sword won't fail to bring your enemies that bit closer to their final hour in the World of Twelve.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18326.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Chance.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Chance.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Chance is above 49 and below 75.

18327.descriptionId:
Just because you look like death, it doesn't mean you can't be stylish. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18328.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Strength.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is above 49 and below 75.

18329.descriptionId:
Proud war gear or dust collector? The future of this headgear is in your hands.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18330.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Wisdom.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Wisdom.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Wisdom is above 49 and below 75.

18331.descriptionId:
Ideal for all those who've spent too much time pulling out their hair in training. This headgear is guaranteed to make you look like a hero.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18332.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Vitality.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Vitality.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Vitality is above 49 and below 75.

18333.descriptionId:
"Make do with what you have," or so says a wise Sadida tailor.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18334.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Vitality.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Vitality.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Vitality is above 74 and below 100.

18335.descriptionId:
Fashion trends come and go but if you can control time, you can ensure that this cape never goes out of fashion.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18336.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Wisdom.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Wisdom.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Wisdom is above 74 and below 100.

18337.descriptionId:
"Winners write history; losers tell it." Wearing this new cloak, you just know you'll finally learn how to write.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18338.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Strength.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is above 74 and below 100.

18339.descriptionId:
Thanks to this lightweight cloak, you can flee as fast as a Pegasus soaring on the wind.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18340.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Chance.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Chance.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Chance is above 74 and below 100.

18341.descriptionId:
Created from the instruments of torture used on a Sacrier, this cape is soaked in the blood from their injuries. The crobak whose wings were ripped off to adorn this cape in the honour of the goddess was mistreated in proper form and then released back into nature.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18342.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Intelligence.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Intelligence.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Intelligence is above 74 and below 100.

18343.descriptionId:
Don't try to act all high and mighty. Everyone knows not to judge a general by their cape.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18344.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Agility.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Agility.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Agility is above 74 and below 100.

18345.descriptionId:
"The delicate, complex folds of this cape are a reminder of the precariousness of existence and the fragility of the material form that binds us to this world." – Van Itas

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18346.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Agility.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Agility.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Agility is above 24 and below 50.

18347.descriptionId:
This simple piece of clothing proves, among other things, your fighting worth more than any ostentatious armour would do.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18348.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Intelligence.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Intelligence.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Intelligence is above 24 and below 50.

18349.descriptionId:
Donning this cloak is the fastest way to bounce back for combat.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18350.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Chance.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Chance.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Chance is above 24 and below 50.

18351.descriptionId:
Sadidas have become masters in the art of plant sculptures, and this shield is decidedly one of their greatest creations.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18352.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Strength.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is above 24 and below 50.

18353.descriptionId:
Become the north star that your people follow when you bravely take up this shield and head out to face danger.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18354.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Wisdom.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Wisdom.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Wisdom is above 24 and below 50.

18355.descriptionId:
There's nothing like a bit of solidity when you tend to lug your destiny around like a beloved weight.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18356.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Vitality.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Vitality.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Vitality is above 24 and below 50.

18357.descriptionId:
This feather that makes up this shield looks more like a piwi feather than one from your spirit animal. But no matter: it's the thought that counts.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18358.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Spell Points.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Spell Points.

18359.descriptionId:
Too heavy to be worn around the neck, this necklace is worn on the forearm like a shield. It doesn't protect the wearer one bit, but that doesn't seem to bother Sacriers in the slightest.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18360.descriptionId:
You can make out the tiny inscriptions engraved delicately around the edge of the shield. If you look closely at the writing, you'll realise that it's in an ancient language and, given the insane handwriting, most likely a demonic language at that...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18361.descriptionId:
They say that the artisan who designed this shield mistakenly left his blade inside when he put the two halves together. After realising his mistake, he ultimately decided to leave it that way. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18362.descriptionId:
This shield is your third best friend! What are the first two, you ask? Your kindness and your unflinching courage, of course!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18363.descriptionId:
This shield can be used in one of two ways: to defend the most skilled fighters from death, or to decorate their tombs if they don't manage to use it correctly. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18364.descriptionId:
The glistening colour of this long cape does not make it any less imposing. You almost wish it were even longer – a real train – to give it even more punch in the best bad guy style.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18365.descriptionId:
With it open, you can use it to rally your troops on the battlefield and lead them. With it closed, you can use it to protect yourself in sword fights.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18366.descriptionId:
This sophisticated piece of apparel gives off a series of loud clicks with every step you take. Granted, it's not much use when infiltrating enemy lines, but it can't be beat when you want to cut a dashing figure!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18367.descriptionId:
What better than a massive shield to distract everyone from your puny body?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18368.descriptionId:
When you don this strange helmet, an evil force seems to take hold of you and you feel gripped with an irresistible desire to control the world. The single eye in the middle of your helm lets you scrutinise in exacting detail the slightest movement around you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18369.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Virizeon's Breath emote.

18370.descriptionId:
When you're wearing this helmet, all you'll hear is "yes, Staff Sergeant" this and "no, Staff Sergeant" that.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18371.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18372.descriptionId: This oozing chitin is often the last thing adventurers see in their brief but eventful visits to Plantala. In your case, the last thing the Pandogorgo saw was you tearing this off of it in one huge slimy piece.

18374.descriptionId: Thanks to this extremely developed eye, the Deathblossom has a considerable advantage that has earned it a spot among the greatest predators of Plantala: night vision. Eating this eye won't give you any curative benefits, except perhaps an excellent and fast-acting gastric cleanse.

18375.descriptionId:
Did you ever wonder what it would be like to have a little brother? Now you know: this little troll will follow you everywhere day and night.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18376.descriptionId: The Trunkplosion is a creature that boasts an incredible rate of cellular regeneration. Its highly unstable trunk can partially self-destruct, throwing needles as far as 50 kametres away, and then grow back in just a few minutes. Handle this piece carefully, or your friends will be taking you home in a bucket.

18377.descriptionId:
His body may be wearing armour, but his heart contains nothing but love and devotion for you.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18378.descriptionId: The wood of this bark is anything but natural. It seems as if a spiritual force drew each line and ridge on this artefact.

18380.descriptionId: This dark seed seems to squirm with an unnameable evil. Its outer coat is wrinkled and warped. A cruel, twisted face seems to peer out from its surface, sending shivers down your spine.

18382.descriptionId: The seed has recovered its glow; it shines and shimmers in the sunlight.

18385.descriptionId:
"(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Duster ornament."

18386.descriptionId: This box contains a spiritual gem from a dungeon keeper.

18387.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Saiya ornament.

18388.descriptionId: This box contains a spiritual gem from a dungeon keeper.

18390.descriptionId: This box contains a spiritual gem from a dungeon keeper.

18392.descriptionId: This box contains a spiritual gem from a dungeon keeper.

18394.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18396.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18398.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18400.descriptionId:
Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18408.descriptionId:
This cape was made from real Tanuki hair. Judging by the terrible itch whenever you wear it, the fleas and ticks are 100% original too.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18410.descriptionId:
With this heavy shell on your back, you can only assume you'd sink like a stone as soon as you set foot in the water. How do the Kwapa manage to swim with these things on their backs?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18412.descriptionId:
The Firefoux are known for their bothersome habit of blowing up everything in sight, but no one ever told you how soft and pleasant their fur was to touch.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18414.descriptionId:
When you wear this headgear, you realise that you look much more intimidating than usual. Is that a good thing? That's for you to decide. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18416.descriptionId:
It's just a piece of headgear, but its viscous and gooey texture is supremely unpleasant.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18418.descriptionId:
Wearing this headgear gives you an irresistible urge to dance around the fire, shoot off fireworks and blow up everything in sight... You know what, maybe you'd better take it off before someone gets hurt.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18422.descriptionId: This surprise chest is a reward for hard work; may its contents satisfy you completely!

18423.descriptionId:
This Shushu eye caught in amber is as fascinating as it is disturbing.
Exchange it with Kitlatonak in [-73,-17] to try and improve part of your ascension.
The advantage of this amber is that it won't disappear when Ascension is closed.

18426.descriptionId: This bag contains a random container full of resources.

18427.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Pioneer".

18428.descriptionId: [!] Ce coffre surprise est la récompense d'un dur labeur, puisse son contenu amplement vous satisfaire !

18429.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Krosmic Dance emote.

18430.descriptionId: [!] Ce coffre surprise est la récompense d'un dur labeur, puisse son contenu amplement vous satisfaire !

18431.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Panty Party emote.

18432.descriptionId: [!] Ce coffre surprise est la récompense d'un dur labeur, puisse son contenu amplement vous satisfaire !

18433.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Samurai emote.

18434.descriptionId: A dark wound runs the length of your arm, which acts up at times, stricken by painful spasms.

18440.descriptionId: A dark wound runs the length of your arm. The skin around the injury is swollen and infected with reddish spots.

18441.descriptionId:
This lightweight headgear won't ruin your beautiful knightly hairdo.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18445.descriptionId: These boots used to belong to the Koolich - even if you can't tell, you can smell! These boots are so comfortable that you'll almost forget how miserable your existence is.

18447.descriptionId: This headgear once belonged to the famous Koolich, renowned for his clay feet and his legendary good mood.

18449.descriptionId: The Koolich uses this bag to keep his Kaliptus leaves fresh or to suffocate Koalaks that are a bit too enterprising.

18451.descriptionId: This staff is really an emptied bone of one of the Koolich's ancestors. Pierced on both ends, it can be used as a Kaliptus pipe but also as a shepherd's stick. Ahhhh... sticks, eh! What would we do without them?

18457.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

18458.descriptionId: Pairs perfectly with a Curryless Curry Bread.

18459.descriptionId:
A quick glance sideways to anticipate an opponent's attack, a quick snap, and then a searing pain at the base of the skull. The pain spreads as fast as lightning to your jaw, ripping a cry of anguish from your throat and leaving you paralysed. With its special armour and well-muscled neck, the Armourtle is immune!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18461.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Meteor emote.

18463.descriptionId:
This headband is an elegant and practical way to keep your grizzled mane out of your eyes.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18465.descriptionId:
Never confuse his cape and his cloak... Jahash keeps these two items straight by the wings on the cloak. He used the cloak for battle because it shows the path of justice that leads to peace. The cape is used outside of battle to differentiate between the two.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18467.descriptionId:
Originally, only the Guardian of the Ivory Dofus could carry this Aegis designed by Julith, wife of Jahash. Will you prove yourself worthy of this noble heritage?


(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18469.descriptionId:
They say that only a great adventurer can ride the proud Ekirin. If you feel up to it, try your luck and prove your worth.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18471.descriptionId:
The first person to ever get this pet was the captain of a prestigious ship. Ironically, he was also a fastidious control freak who insisted his crew hoist their trousers way up above their waists before hoisting anchor.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18472.descriptionId: Fish, rice and seaweed. Nope, it's not the contents of your rubbish bin but rather the contents of your plate.

18475.descriptionId:
This practical folding headgear is lightweight and always seems to be dripping. Take care not to let others track you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18477.descriptionId:
Meticulously folded according to traditional origami techniques, this cape has also been decorated with a non-staining ink.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18479.descriptionId:
We all know that paper can cause horrific flesh wounds, but it also becomes ultra-strong if folded the right way. This shield is a great example. It is structurally perfect because it was made from paper folded 12 times, which is apparently a record. 


(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18481.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Origami emote.

18483.descriptionId:
According to the Association of Thwee Kings Cake Tasters Keen on Tempting Confectionery (ATKCTKC), using an ordinary knife to cut your cake is absolutely positively unthinkable. Only this sword is worthy to cut the royal dessert.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18485.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Of Ink and Paper ornament.

18487.nameId: Reaper's Perfect Soul Stone for Small Souls
18487.descriptionId: Invented by Otomai, these stones are flawless. Perfect for capturing the souls of monsters killed in combat.

18489.nameId: Reaper's Perfect Soul Stone for Average Souls
18489.descriptionId: Invented by Otomai, these stones are flawless. Perfect for capturing the souls of monsters killed in combat.

18491.nameId: Reaper's Perfect Soul Stone for Big Souls
18491.descriptionId: Invented by Otomai, these stones are flawless. Perfect for capturing the souls of monsters killed in combat.

18492.descriptionId: This is fatty junk food. It's ghostly, sure, but junk food all the same.

18493.nameId: Reaper's Perfect Soul Stone for Gigantic Souls
18493.descriptionId: Invented by Otomai, these stones are flawless. Perfect for capturing the souls of monsters killed in combat.

18495.descriptionId: This potion will take you back to your last save point.

18497.descriptionId: This potion lets you teleport to Mage Upichu's house.

18498.descriptionId: As a great master chef of Pandala once said: The best part about sushiwi is the shaké you drink with it.

18499.descriptionId: This potion will allow you to teleport to Kerub Crepin's house in Astrub. It will also magically clean all that poop from the soles of your shoes!

18503.descriptionId: This rice-based potion enables Brakmarians to return to their hometown instantaneously. Thankfully, Bontarians can't use it.

18504.descriptionId: While it looks inoffensive, this mushroom can release dangerous parasitic spores, as you now know.

18505.descriptionId: This rice-based potion enables Bontarians to return to their hometown instantaneously. Thankfully, Brakmarians can't use it.

18506.descriptionId: This item looks exactly like a huge red button that anyone would be eager to push. That would be an excellent idea if you want a gigantic geyser of flames to destroy everything in a 10-metre radius.

18507.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title) 
Use this scroll to obtain the Napkin Folder title.

18508.descriptionId: This item is very light and extremely compact. If you don't know how to use it, you can always use it as a projectile when you run out of rocks to throw.

18509.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Ecaflipus Ambassador title.

18510.descriptionId: You can put your ear up against the blue orb in the middle of this object. You won't hear the sea, but you're sure to make great memories if you exclaim "in the water?" in front of a few friends.

18511.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Osteomancer title.

18512.descriptionId: When making this object, you'll finally be able to brag about breaking wind without shame.

18515.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Elementalist title.

18516.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to use.)
This formidable item encloses the ancestral techniques used in the Awakening ritual. It can be used to channel the powers of a Legendary Weapon to remodel them as you wish. Thank you, White Chtigers!

18517.descriptionId: You are filled with an unparalleled sense of determination. Use it wisely!

18518.descriptionId: You now own an astral paintbrush and all the other items necessary to use astral calligraphy in Pandala.

18520.descriptionId:
Now you'll never run out of paper again, no matter where you go.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18521.nameId: Title Scroll: Friend of the Yokai
18521.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Friend of the Yokai".

18522.descriptionId:
[!] WIP

(Équipez cet objet sur un emplacement d'apparat pour utiliser son apparence)

18523.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Distiller of Dreams title.

18524.descriptionId:
The panji on this cape will draw admiration and respect all across continental Amakna. Pandawas, on the other hand, will politely ask you why you've written "bamboo soup" on your clothes.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18526.descriptionId:
[!] WIP

(Équipez cet objet sur un emplacement d'apparat pour utiliser son apparence)

18527.descriptionId:
A problem? A bug? A clever adventurer gave you 10% of your kamas? Don't panic! No need to contact Ankama Support because the adorable Weegle Owl will be there to guide you and dry your tears throughout your adventures in the World of Twelve.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18528.descriptionId:
With this headgear, there's no need to buy hair gel ever again. Just dip your head in a giant can of paint. As a bonus, it'll bring a bit of colour to your sad little face.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18529.descriptionId:
Do you hear those jingling bells? Those crunching footsteps in the snow? It's Kwismas, and this pet is here to remind you of that!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

At Queen Ginju's feasts, the berserker Heiji would claim to have opened a rift which swallowed over 30 bworks, with a single axe blow to the ground. Although this story was considered untrue, no one tried to prove him wrong.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18565.descriptionId:
One day, a fishmonger drunk on regret decided to release all his rotten fish into the sea along with the cloth they were wrapped in. Since the cloth was of decent quality, three fishermen sailing off of the Wabbit Islands nabbed it. They used it as a jib until vomit, friction from the wind, and bird droppings made the sail less efficient. They pawned it off on a cloth seller who was oddly fascinated by the washed-out colour of the cloth. Now, you've donned this cape made from that proud cloth that's seen more and lived more than you ever will. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

Unfortunately, most of her enemies couldn't read.

In passing, they also stole half his fortune. And his wife. O'Sean clearly doesn't like leaving anything to chance – or leaving anything behind, apparently.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

Don't be fooled by her sweet looks: Mira can be a vile creature whom you either love or hate. If you're not to her liking, watch out – she'll make sure you remember it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18596.descriptionId:
Flexible and always cheerful, Jûmô will accompany you on all your adventures, both artistic and IRL.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18597.descriptionId:
Louz likes to pick fights, so if you take your eyes off him, he'll be off looking for trouble in no time. This tendency towards violence might be useful if Louz weren't as tiny as a catoken from the casino.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18598.descriptionId:
This pet is the perfect balance between the forces of Wukin and Wukang.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18599.descriptionId:
Malo is brave and independent. Even though he likes to be left alone, he's always ready to come to the rescue. No matter what stands in his way, he'll always overcome it and emerge victorious. And when it comes to casinos, he often walks away with the big prize.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18600.descriptionId: The first warrior in the Posseshoved clan to craft this ring had a side job as a jeweller. His name was Stan Torum. Oddly enough, no one has ever wanted to name this ring after its creator.

18601.descriptionId:
Desse has got a pedigree that's the envy of every alley cat in Ecaflip City! With her elegance and class, she's welcomed like a queen at all the top-notch establishments, and those who are with her can barely believe their good luck.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18602.descriptionId: History books have immortalised the Posseshoved shoemakers as the greatest liars the World of Twelve has ever seen. Passing themselves off as travelling dentists in cities, they would rob their victims of every last tooth to make ritual clothing for their clan.

18603.descriptionId:
This pet will follow you everywhere, no matter where you go. No point trying to lose it: your scent will betray you, and this pet'll find you faster than you can say "woof".

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18604.descriptionId: Posseshoved Clan tradition demands that the hand of one's first defeated enemy be worn around the winner's neck to preserve vital force. Legend has it that warriors who forget to take this amulet off at night have been found strangled in their beds while they slept.

18606.descriptionId:
This festive hat reminds you of a very odd dream you had two years ago. See there: you do have a good memory when you put your mind to it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18608.descriptionId:
This birthday candle is brought to life by ancient magic. As you gaze at it, you relive memories that you thought you'd forgotten. Smiles, tears, adventure... So much has happened these past few years. Keep it safe.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18609.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Practically Purrfect".

18610.descriptionId:
They say that this Dragoone got fed up with being compared to the pink buttocks of a female Bwork and wanted to set herself apart from her peers. So, she ran off to Ohwymi to sunbathe in peace. Just look at her now! She's taken on the colour of a real flaming dragon! 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18611.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Disciple of Yakasi".

18612.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 5 years... And you have been here for them!

18613.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Huge Romantic".

18614.descriptionId: This carefully rolled scroll has been sealed by Hoku Sensei, who would like to introduce you to Yang Jing, a master calligrapher at the Temple of Awakening.

18616.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

18617.descriptionId:
With this cap equipped, Ecaflip's luck will always smile upon you. Or not! Who knows? And besides... It's not like an adventurer ever got rich just by wearing a cap shaped like a piggy bank.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18619.descriptionId:
This adorable ball of feathers is a very rare species of bird renowned for its ability to do cartwheels. This particular bird, however, cannot do cartwheels and so it's been ostracised by its peers. It just goes to show that a lack of gymnastics skills can have very sorry consequences.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18623.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Incarnated Class 652"

18625.descriptionId: Some say Captain Chafer tried to steal this cloak to replace his famous leather panties. But it didn't suit him at all - it just wasn't perverse enough.

18627.descriptionId:
"At this range, he won't get us."
Last words of Gooba the Mush Mish
