18650.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18652.descriptionId:
This impressive animal is known mainly for being extremely territorial. Train it properly and, together, you'll build an empire. Beware, however, if you neglect it because you're the one who'll pay the price.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18656.descriptionId:
This sparkly helm in Enutrof's likeness has left you in a state of horrible uncertainty – is he a god? Or a dragon? Or maybe both? But in that case, is he a draconic god or a divine dragon? Does he really whisper in pebbles' ears? Can pebbles talk? So many questions that remind you that knowledge is a treasure that even the most sumptuous headgear cannot bestow.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18658.descriptionId:
Don't be fooled by the wings on this cape – they are purely decorative. I'm sorry to say that your dreams of flying high on wings of steel have come crashing down like a lead balloon even though lead is only one of the many metals that went into the composition of this cape.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18660.descriptionId:
It's said that the god Enutrof hid a priceless precious stone in the compartment on this shield but then lost the key that would let him open the lock. You'll just have to find it, or drive up the price of this shield by spreading the legend.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18662.descriptionId:
This shield represents the great spiral of time. What makes it especially interesting, though, is that if its owner can spin it quickly enough, they can hypnotise their opponents.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18664.descriptionId:
Apparently, pets have a nasty habit of stealing their masters' loot at the end of fights. Obviously, it's just a rumour. But when this pet is with you, you can't help but think about it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18666.descriptionId:
Whenever you wear this headgear, people say you look rather long in the tooth. You only hope they mean it literally.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18668.descriptionId:
The majestic fur used to make this cape is both soft and comforting – and you can sense powerful magic straining at the seams to get out.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18670.descriptionId:
The best defence is a strong attack! And there's nothing better than a shield covered in sharp claws when you're on the attack and want to come out on top.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18672.descriptionId:
During one of your talks with a famous ghost, you learned of the existence of a chtigress whose flames were rivalled only by her presence. If you manage to tame Sherajah, she'll follow you in your quest for power and soak up power along the way.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

This shield has been specially reinforced to increase the likelihood that its bearers survive matches against the Brakmar team. It is so heavy that only the strongest athletes can hope to carry it with ease. Drop it on your opponents' toes to slow them down.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18707.descriptionId:
Enough sugar to give a Trool diabetes.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

This type of ebony shield has cracked a large number of Bontarian skulls during wild derbies. If you join the Dark City's team, yours will likely become covered in blood too.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18709.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

18710.descriptionId:

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18717.descriptionId: This rune will increase fixed resistance to Air damage.

18718.descriptionId:
This shield can absorb any of your opponents' blows thanks to its aqueous consistency drawn directly from Nagate's magic water.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18719.descriptionId: This rune will increase fixed resistance to Water damage.

18720.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Warrior emote.

18721.descriptionId: This rune will increase fixed resistance to Neutral-type damage.

18722.descriptionId:
Adorable and endearing, the Horneteddy packs a bit of a sting as a pet. He loves being petted but does have a wee issue with sudden mood swings and you can easily end up with a stinger stuck in your palm.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18723.descriptionId: This rune will increase fixed resistance to Fire damage.

18724.descriptionId:
A Pandalan legend has it that pigs attract mooflies, nuisance and trouble. It doesn't seem to bother them. By adopting such creatures, Pandawas have lived calmer lives, with any annoyances stuck to the backsides of their pets. Who'd have thought it? That's why Porcigami are so popular. They are great for avoiding trouble and capturing misfortune, thus bringing you happiness.
Folded from particularly absorbent paper that keeps it clean, this faithful friend could also be of great help if you find yourself helpless in a shed at the end of the garden.


(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18725.descriptionId: This rune will increase fixed resistance to Earth damage.

18726.descriptionId:
Centurius will follow you into your most epic battles, and even make your defeats more pleasant.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18727.descriptionId: A six pack of this classic brew is the only six pack you'll be seeing for a while.

18728.descriptionId:

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18820.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Osamodas. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18821.descriptionId:
A cape would be more of a bother than it's worth in the water. That's why Tritun guards usually only wear a simple trident to show off their sense of style.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18822.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Pandawa. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18823.descriptionId:
According to adepts, when you smash the skulls of your opponents with this conchield, you can hear the sea.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18824.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Rogue. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18825.descriptionId:
Awww, just look at its itty bitty cuteness! Oops. Not so fast. You're going to have to coax it out of its shell if you want to see it with your own eyes. This Amphermit crab stays in its shell and only comes out if its master sings its favourite song from a movie that takes place "under the sea". Start singing! 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18826.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Sacrier. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18827.descriptionId:
When you stare out from behind this mask, the art of osteomancy holds no secrets for you.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18828.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Sadida. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18829.descriptionId:
Read your future in this cape. To do so, engrave your existential questions along the spine and press it against white-hot tin. Then, all you need to do is interpret the cracks produced by the heat.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18830.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Sram. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18831.descriptionId:
This shield will protect you from bad blows during your osteomagic sessions.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18832.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Foggernaut. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18833.descriptionId:
With this petsmount, have no worries when you head out in search of bones – you'll have ample warning of any pile-ups along your chosen itinerary. Pro tip: to avoid traffic tie-ups caused by slow-moving dragoturkeys, don't travel at the start or end of major holidays.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18834.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Xelor. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18835.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Rain Call emote.

18836.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Masqueraider. The keys to your destiny are in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18837.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Osteothentic ornament.

18838.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 6 years... And you have been here for them!

18839.descriptionId:
"Its days are uncertain, 'tis indeed plain to see;
But such is its age of fine things, so it goes.
Jealous are the fates of our prosperity,
Letting thistle grow wilder than rose."

— Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18841.descriptionId:
"Violence is in us; we all bear it, but only a few pursue it to its full extent."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18842.descriptionId:
Don't trust that cute little bluish face – Shushus are usually bloodthirsty, terrifying and cruel. So it's probably a bad idea to snuggle up to this pet for comfort on those long winter nights. It's impossible to say which body part you'll lose if you do.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18843.descriptionId:
No pirate has ever managed to touch this magnificent three-cornered hat during a sword fight thanks to its wearers' agility and flexibility. If, however, it were ever to receive even the tiniest scratch (heaven forbid!), the wearer will be cursed to the end of their days and no longer worthy of wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18844.descriptionId: When their lances become less effective in close combat, Forgelances sometimes use this formidable hammer to smash in even the thickest skulls.

18845.descriptionId:
"Let he who would don the mantle of Justice first chase wrath from his heart; for while reason seeks to decide what is just, wrath seeks to deem just that which it has decided, and justice is then but a mask for rage."

— Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18846.descriptionId: The height of Albueran fashion, this cap topped with an authentic tail will turn the workers in the colony green with envy.

18847.descriptionId:
"Hate is sacred. It is the indignation of strong and powerful hearts, the militant disdain of those infuriated by all forms of mediocrity and foolishness."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18848.descriptionId: Roki's fur is thick enough to protect him from the brutal cold during his many long walks in the heights of the Snowbound Timberland. Among other things, that makes it easy for him to perch high in a tree and spy on Twelvians to his heart's content.

18849.descriptionId:
This Pirate Coat, nicknamed the "Thousand Battle Trophy", symbolises the astounding feat of having triumphed in at least that many sea battles. Best to think twice before attacking a pirate of such renown! Rumour has it that wearing this coat before accomplishing that feat will make you horrifically seasick... Sailors, take heed!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18850.descriptionId: Not many foreigners in Albuera could wear such a cloak on their shoulders. It seems for once that you're the chosen one.

18851.descriptionId:
Have you always dreamed of cleaning up your vegetable patch while fighting? With this fabulous heater shield combined with the working end of a pitchfork, your dream can now come true. Poke your opponents and protect your pumpkins with style!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18852.descriptionId: Albueran soldiers earn the right to don this unique helmet by bringing honour to their homeland. You'll have the respect of any Forgelances who see you wearing it.

18853.descriptionId:
This shield – which is much better at decorating than protecting – shakes up preconceived notions, tilts truths, and makes legends tremble. It is also your way of proclaiming to the world: "Let Shariva laugh!"
The following inscription can also be read on the back: "Forged in the Maelstrom".

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18854.descriptionId: Your deeds may be forgotten in a hundred years, but this amulet is a testament to your bravery now. Turns out you're more important than you thought.

18855.descriptionId:
This shield was made from bricks thrown by the angry mob that appears every time the World of Twelve undergoes a major change.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18856.descriptionId: This ring won't reveal your marital status, but it may bring you good luck in your future adventures.

18857.descriptionId:
Is it a shield? Or a sheath? Or both at once? This splendid and versatile Pirate Shield lets you block your opponents' most fearsome blows and store your sharpest weapons.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18858.descriptionId: These marvellous boots will inflate your ego and hide the size of your ankles at the same time. They're an absolute must-have.

18859.descriptionId:
"Curse these Bontarians, hold them in as much contempt as you like, but never forget that it is because they are our enemies that we are strong. So cherish your city, your friends and your family, but above all, cherish your enemies."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18860.descriptionId: This beautiful belt will set you apart at whatever ceremony you may attend in the World of Twelve. But avoid whipping your enemies' butts with it – you wouldn't want to get it dirty.

18861.descriptionId:
"We may feel disdain towards the Brakmarians, but we must never lack in respect for them, for underestimating them would be our gravest error and the finest gift we could offer them."

— Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18862.descriptionId: This strong lance was forged during a sacred ritual of the Forgelance people. Wielding it in combat will either boost your courage or trigger your impostor syndrome.

18863.descriptionId:
They say that a bow wow is a Twelvian's best friend... But for pirates, there's nothing like heading out to sea with a faithful, feathered parrot. And this parrot always gets the hiccups right before a storm. Which is why sailors often say, "Put away your cups if you hear Hikups."

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18864.descriptionId: Pounding a shield with your fist is a solemn and meaningful gesture in Forgelance culture. Be sure to do so with flair when you carry this beautiful targe.

18865.descriptionId:
"When you're searching for authenticity, you realise that chaos is here, inside each of us, and you'll have to get used to that."

— Rick Manalan

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18866.descriptionId: Albueran soldiers earn the right to don this unique helmet by bringing honour to their homeland. You'll have the respect of any Forgelances who see you wearing it.

18867.descriptionId:
If you like total chaos as much as you like relaxing, you can use this cape spread on the wet grass like a blanket and enjoy a picnic that is both peaceful and tormented.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18868.descriptionId: Albueran soldiers earn the right to don this unique helmet by bringing honour to their homeland. You'll have the respect of any Forgelances who see you wearing it.

18869.descriptionId:
Apparently, this shapeless blob is supposedly a shield. Clearly, artificers have taken the avant-garde a wee bit too far when trying to make a name for themselves.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18870.descriptionId: Albueran soldiers earn the right to don this unique helmet by bringing honour to their homeland. You'll have the respect of any Forgelances who see you wearing it.

18871.descriptionId:
The larva of this charming creature – the Tae'Niak – hides in the uncooked and under-cooked meat eaten by the demonic boats known as Kar'Draks. They grow in the guts of all those unfortunate enough to taste the meat by mistake. At least, that's what Bwork parents tell their children to dissuade them from nibbling on everything that comes their way, be it putrid old carcasses or the ears of their playmates. Never forget: you are what you eat.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18872.descriptionId: Not many foreigners in Albuera could wear such a cloak on their shoulders. It seems for once that you're the chosen one.

18873.descriptionId:
Berlo is the king of games of chance. He's seen it all, done it all, and reached the top of the great pyramid of players. If he challenges you, you'd better run, because your chances of beating him are really, really slim. Although that does mean that your victory would taste all the sweeter...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18874.descriptionId: Not many foreigners in Albuera could wear such a cloak on their shoulders. It seems for once that you're the chosen one.

18875.descriptionId:
The Solar Bear has always been loyal to Father Kwismas, and he'll be loyal to you too. Thanks to his thick, downy coat, you'll never get cold, even on the iciest islands. Rub his belly once in a while to warm up his body. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18876.descriptionId: Not many foreigners in Albuera could wear such a cloak on their shoulders. It seems for once that you're the chosen one.

18877.descriptionId:
"Adventurer, whether you're in town or rushing down the slopes, your ears will never get cold with this cap." Hard to believe the slogan when your ears aren't completely covered, but whatever... They say it's true: satisfaction guaranteed. No refunds!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18878.descriptionId: This ring won't reveal your marital status, but it may bring you good luck in your future adventures.

18879.descriptionId:
When you wear this backpack, you aren't just carrying a simple backpack: you're carrying a simple backpack that is carrying a simple pair of skis.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18880.descriptionId: This ring won't reveal your marital status, but it may bring you good luck in your future adventures.

18881.descriptionId:
A sign that you can slide down the slopes without taking a tumble, this shield will show off your prowess as a novice skier from Frigost.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18882.descriptionId: This ring won't reveal your marital status, but it may bring you good luck in your future adventures.

18883.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Skiing emote.

18884.descriptionId: This beautiful belt will set you apart at whatever ceremony you may attend in the World of Twelve. But avoid whipping your enemies' butts with it – you wouldn't want to get it dirty.

18885.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Samuralive ornament.

18886.descriptionId: This beautiful belt will set you apart at whatever ceremony you may attend in the World of Twelve. But avoid whipping your enemies' butts with it – you wouldn't want to get it dirty.

18887.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Shushauron ornament.

18888.descriptionId: This beautiful belt will set you apart at whatever ceremony you may attend in the World of Twelve. But avoid whipping your enemies' butts with it – you wouldn't want to get it dirty.

18889.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Etching ornament.

18890.descriptionId: Your deeds may be forgotten in a hundred years, but this amulet is a testament to your bravery now. Turns out you're more important than you thought.

18891.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Staff Sergeant ornament.

18892.descriptionId: Your deeds may be forgotten in a hundred years, but this amulet is a testament to your bravery now. Turns out you're more important than you thought.

18893.descriptionId:
One day Lilzilla will become a bigzilla and eat you. Until then, it'll follow you around, thinking you're its mum. You better hope that it lasts.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18894.descriptionId: Your deeds may be forgotten in a hundred years, but this amulet is a testament to your bravery now. Turns out you're more important than you thought.

18895.descriptionId:
In this world, you need to grab the knight by the horns.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18896.descriptionId: These marvellous boots will inflate your ego and hide the size of your ankles at the same time. They're an absolute must-have.

18897.descriptionId:
You are the night. Well done!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18898.descriptionId: These marvellous boots will inflate your ego and hide the size of your ankles at the same time. They're an absolute must-have.

18899.descriptionId:
This shield is ever vigilant, as it never sleeps. Of course, not having eyelids, it's got an unfair advantage!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18900.descriptionId: These marvellous boots will inflate your ego and hide the size of your ankles at the same time. They're an absolute must-have.

18901.descriptionId:
Made from magic crystals, this shield changes colour based on your emotions. Or maybe just based on temperature – no one knows for sure.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18902.descriptionId: Pounding a shield with your fist is a solemn and meaningful gesture in Forgelance culture. Be sure to do so with flair when you carry this beautiful targe.

18903.descriptionId:
Whether you're a Belmont or an amateur hunter, protection is key when you're on a hunt.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18904.descriptionId: Pounding a shield with your fist is a solemn and meaningful gesture in Forgelance culture. Be sure to do so with flair when you carry this beautiful targe.

18905.descriptionId:
From a young age, Finn became known as a travelling scribe, but even more so as a storyteller. His tales enchanted listeners of every age, warming their hearts when the biting winds of a lonely winter descended.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18906.descriptionId: Pounding a shield with your fist is a solemn and meaningful gesture in Forgelance culture. Be sure to do so with flair when you carry this beautiful targe.

18907.descriptionId:
Don't trust that cute little face – Shushus are usually bloodthirsty, terrifying and cruel. So it's probably a bad idea to snuggle up to this pet for comfort on those long winter nights. It's impossible to say which body part you'll lose if you do.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18908.descriptionId: This strong lance was forged during a sacred ritual of the Forgelance people. Wielding it in combat will either boost your courage or trigger your impostor syndrome.

18909.descriptionId:
If you want to toss your hat into the ring, the Hatsofftoyou is a good choice. Hats off to you!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18910.descriptionId: This strong lance was forged during a sacred ritual of the Forgelance people. Wielding it in combat will either boost your courage or trigger your impostor syndrome.

18911.descriptionId:
Small in sword but big in bravery, this young Pandawarai will protect you from the fiercest dangers.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18912.descriptionId: This strong lance was forged during a sacred ritual of the Forgelance people. Wielding it in combat will either boost your courage or trigger your impostor syndrome.

18913.descriptionId:
This repulsive-looking shield is a good representation of the horror children must have faced in this frozen cave. If you stare at it a bit too long, you may get the impression that it's moving.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18914.descriptionId: We can try to translate this text to see the Query in Japan.

18915.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Community Helper".

18916.descriptionId: This marker item is given to characters created in Albuera.

18917.descriptionId:
Everyone who runs into the Mystery Man asks themself why he's always carrying around a spoon. Everyone has a theory but no one knows for sure. Is it a lucky charm? A souvenir? Something to remind himself that he's not dreaming? For most people, though, it's just the final finishing touch to this unusual man's intriguing personality.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18918.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Cra. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18919.descriptionId:
The Mystery Man's modesty has always been at odds with his elegance. In a world where everyone looks alike, he stays true to himself and imposes his sense of style wherever he goes. If ever you encounter him in the World of Twelve or Externam, you'll be struck by his subtlety. Class can't be bought.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18920.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Cra. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18921.descriptionId:
They say that the Mystery Man and his hairy acolyte spend all their time testing the solidity of every item they're given. Yet, they are never late for a break when it's time to talk about new ideas and tell stories. That's probably thanks to this huge pocket watch, which always shows the right time. After all, punctuality is the mark of a true gentleman.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18922.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Ecaflip. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18924.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Ecaflip. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18925.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Insatiable Archaeologist".

18926.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Eniripsa. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18927.descriptionId:
It's said that this helmet was once worn by Miyaji from the White Chtigers' unit. That seems hard to believe because the helmet already feels tight on your head, but you feel stronger and more confident wearing it all the same.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18928.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Eniripsa. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18929.descriptionId:
Your shoulders will be protected from the burden of responsibility and your back from your so-called allies. Now you're ready to head into battle.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18930.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Enutrof. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18931.descriptionId:
You can't really remember which of the White Chtigers carried a sabre like this, but having it by your side still makes you look truly impressive.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18932.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Enutrof. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18933.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-50 Ecaflip. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18934.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Feca. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18936.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Feca. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18938.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Osamodas. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18939.descriptionId:
Thanks to this warrior hat, Iops really cut a fine figure. The only problem is that it limits their field of vision and prevents them from hearing their opponents' words properly. In short, the Hat Ariutokinabot is designed for those who like to strike before they think.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18940.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Osamodas. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18941.descriptionId:
This headgear makes whoever wears it confident and headstrong. Thanks to it, you'll forge ahead believing you can accomplish anything you set out to do. Remember to take it off from time to time, though. If you don't, you could end up in some rather sticky situations!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18942.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Pandawa. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18943.descriptionId:
Whenever opponents come face to face with this headgear, they turn as silent as the grave. No one dares ask what this entirely atypical headgear is supposed to look like. But no matter. Srams aren't known for their sensitivity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18944.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Pandawa. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18945.descriptionId:
This headgear looks a lot like the Sulik and the Paperb Hat. But since it's very comfy and Xelors never take it off – even when they sleep, it is commonly called the Hatter Lily. It gives off a pleasant water lily smell that helps you get to sleep. However, it also causes snoring that's as unbearable as toads' song during mating season.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18946.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Rogue. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18947.descriptionId:
Thanks to the Hat Wisholdoo, Eniripsas always know how to deal with emergencies. Indeed, all the first aid tips are discreetly written on the lining. This headgear also makes them look as if they just graduated even though no one would normally wear such a ridiculous hat, not even for a school ceremony!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18948.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Rogue. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18949.descriptionId:
You might have expected this headgear to be a handsome orange colour. It's nothing of the sort. Not only that but this fashion accessory is more of a mask than a cap... So why did the creators decide to call it a Cap Ricott? Probably just to get people talking about it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18950.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Sacrier. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18951.descriptionId:
The sharpened points coming out of this cap not only let you hurt your enemies but also increase your chances of being struck on the head by lightning during a storm. Indeed, Sacriers are a class who love to hurt others as much as themselves. The nice smell of grilled meat: nothing's better to start your day!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18952.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Sacrier. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18953.descriptionId:
Thanks to this headgear, you'll really look like a horny beast. People will turn round to admire the huge pair on your head. This roomy hood can also keep food fresh like hay for gobballs or bread for tofus.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18954.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Sadida. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18955.descriptionId:
This helmet can make wearers make promises they instantly forget. Is it because it exerts pressure on the part of the brain which deals with memory or language? No one truly knows. What matters is to take into account only the less extravagant words.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18956.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Sadida. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18957.descriptionId:
Robbie Hood was a famous Cra who lived in the woods. This explains the camouflage green colour of the cap. He wanted to take the law into his own hands and spent all his time stealing money from the rich for a good cause: himself!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18958.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Sram. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18959.descriptionId:
Fecas increase their luck, as well as that of their allies when they wear this hat. If you've hired a Feca wearing the Zinda Hood to guide your group, you're sure to arrive safely and almost without a scratch. The problem is, it smells so foul that it's only useful for protecting you from widows and orphans.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18960.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Sram. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18961.descriptionId:
This hood can be used to fend off the bad weather, but it's also great for cooking scrumptious dishes at just the right temperature. You see, it lets you fan a cooking fire by tipping your hat. And, since everyone knows that stew is best when it stews a long time, that explains why Enutrofs have such muscular wrists.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18962.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Foggernaut. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18963.descriptionId:
The skull drawn on Rogues' headscarves allows them to pretend to be dead in order to take dim-witted enemies such as Tofus and Iops by surprise. Be warned, though: undesirable side effects have been reported by people wearing the scarves in cemeteries during Chafer mating season.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18964.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Foggernaut. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18965.descriptionId:
The Arpone Mask, which is based on the Stinkshop Mask, smells less strong but is unfortunately less powerful as well. That's why it's best used alongside other equipment – why not try it with the Misu Tiara?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18966.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Xelor. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18967.descriptionId:
With this diving bell on your head you might look a little bit silly, to say the least. Your new friends will probably feel a little uncomfortable around you and avoid looking you in the eye. Their loss...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18968.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Xelor. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18969.descriptionId:
The floating cape will give you the aura of a warrior, especially when you turn your back to your enemy. Some think it's reinforced by a metal sheet capable of staving off the slyest attacks.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18970.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-100 Masqueraider. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18971.descriptionId:
Cut from a soft and strong fabric, this cape gives the Ecaflips the impression that they're always the best, no matter what happens. When they win, they love to wear this piece of clothing and claim their reward: "And now, gimme the cash!"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18972.descriptionId: You've been transformed into a level-200 Masqueraider. The keys to your destiny are now in your hands... Will you continue to worship this god?

18973.descriptionId:
This cape is so light and thin that the slightest wind – wind of any sort – will blow it off... It's anything but discreet especially after a meal of beans and fermented drinks.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18974.descriptionId: This debris is proof of your landing here from Incarnam. What an adventure.

18975.descriptionId:
The dark colour of this cape makes it easy to match any other cloth, of any colour. Since it's a very wide cape, it can also protect your head and nose.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18976.descriptionId: This bonus pack is a blessing given by Ayin Spyr. It lets you earn more experience and reset your characteristics and spells!

18977.descriptionId:
Place the cape lightly on your shoulders to prevent stiff joints, stiff upper lips and other stiffness-related problems. Its medicinal properties make it the envy of Pandawas, who spend lots of time carrying their opponents and allies alike. They, too, would love to have attire like this.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18978.descriptionId: You're taking your first steps in Albuera, but you've already lived quite a bit.

18979.descriptionId:
This item is used to hide the Sadidas' weight problem. Because they spend most of their time sleeping instead of practicing sports, the characters of this class tend to become rather stout. If Sadidettes actually have anti-starvation supplies flatteringly placed in the eyes of men, Sadidas usually use this cape to hide theirs.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18981.descriptionId:
This piece of clothing plays an essential part in the Sacriers' style. They use it to bandage their wounds, to clean off blood, to warm their feet during the cold seasons. We cannot say it enough – this class is terrified of frozen ground!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18982.descriptionId: This page contains information that is vital to building the Albuera aqueduct.

18983.descriptionId:
This soft cape is sometimes used by the Osamodettes as a wide-brimmed hat. Male Osamodas only use it as a cape. Thanks to the drawing that decorates this piece of clothing, this character class has inherited the reputation of being frank. Indeed, they can't laugh up their sleeves since the laugh has actually been sewn onto the cape!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18984.nameId: Official Letter from Great Jarl Ordyn
18984.descriptionId: This letter should be given to the Great Jarl's mariner. It should convince her to take you to see Belladonna in addition to giving her something to fuel her fire.

18985.descriptionId:
Pandawas use this cape as protection against bad weather and as a dance accessory. They put it on the floor, in the middle of a circle of tipsy dancers. Then they start their improvised choreography during which their feet can't leave the cloth.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18986.descriptionId: This isn't the key to the immortal witch Belladonna's heart, but it will let you explore her dungeon. That's something, at least.

18987.descriptionId:
The Hulco cape was named after a very unusual Cra. His sense of orientation defied all logic. He was even known to get lost in his own home. A tiny studio flat, it was. This was because of a visual processing impairment: everything he saw looked like a tropical beach at sunset, surrounded by palm trees. At least he never had to pay for a sun holiday.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18988.descriptionId: Distilled from the best five-leaf clover honey in the region, this sweet mead is the pride of the Albueran people.

18989.descriptionId:
This cape's warm and comforting colours take its wearer on an imaginary journey to sunny lands, full of canyons carved by the elements, and cave paintings hidden amongst wind-blasted rocks and weathered cliffs. This is extremely useful way of forgetting that the weather is usually cold, grey and rainy.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18990.descriptionId: This tasty juice is sure to please children and anyone who needs to ride their dragoturkey home from a party.

18991.descriptionId:
Enutrofs have the habit of drawing a map on their capes. They live in such a mess that they can barely find the toilets. This is quite a problem, especially when nature calls urgently!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18992.descriptionId: This debris is proof of your landing here from Incarnam. What an adventure.

18993.descriptionId:
Vil Smisse was the first to use this cloak for subterfuge; in fact, it saved his life many times, including once when he was hanging by his toes. Since then, Rogues condemned to death have got used to following his example.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18995.descriptionId:
Masqueraiders like to fight to music and this cloak is perfect for keeping time. They also use it to drum lessons into naughty children's heads.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18997.descriptionId:
This backpack ensures your breathing tank is firmly held in place, ready for deep sea adventures. Now why did you fill it with beer again? You'll be as drunk as a fish!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

18999.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Astral Agitator".

19000.descriptionId: No one knows just what went into this blood-red lipstick, but some claim it can seduce even the most valorous Forgelance. That remains to be seen...

19001.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Heroism.

19002.descriptionId:
This artefact was used to send adventurers to unknown lands. Each exploration would take these adventurers further and further and, whenever they ended up in front of a gate, they couldn't help but think: "Oh, just one more!"
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19003.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Teleglyph.

19004.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain XP.)
Use this scroll to gain XP without putting yourself on the line.

19005.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Magnet.

19006.descriptionId: This charm will let you call Ayin Spyr to you for help at the start of combat. It can only be worn on Belladonna Island.

19007.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Dirty Trick.

19008.descriptionId: This medal will show everyone that you're someone special in Albuera. Of course, you'll then have to explain that Albuera really does exist...

19009.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Scaphander.

19010.descriptionId:
The Snowly's thick white plumage makes it perfectly suited to cold and snowy environments. What a pity that you had to come and spoil this harmony.
(This petsmount doesn't need to be fed and cannot die.)

19011.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Evolution.

19012.nameId: Title Scroll: Terror of the North Lands
19012.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Terror of the North Lands".

19013.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Feline Movement.

19014.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Nordic ornament.

19015.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Bestial Heal.

19016.descriptionId:
If you need a hand getting a handle on life, then Cire's Hand is the steady hand you want helping you along. If danger knocks at your door, gather your courage in both hands and let fly with a heavy hand. Ultimately, no need to be a dab hand, and if you don't force its hand, it'll be putty in your hands.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19017.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Power.

19018.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Albuera Initiate title.

19019.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Jump.

19020.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Rallying Horn emote.

19021.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Clumsiness.

19023.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Fortune.

19024.descriptionId:
Legend has it that this legendary animal is the reincarnation of a goddess with the power to bring her paintings to life. All the same, there's no use asking her to paint kamas to make you rich: all you'd see is flowers blossoming in a riot of colours.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19025.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Clover.

19026.descriptionId:
This gobbly has followed you from Incarnam to help you as you make your first steps in the World of Twelve. He's still a bit puny, but he'll do his best to help you break in your weapons.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19027.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Feline Leap.

19028.descriptionId:
This fabric is of such great quality that you'll often wonder if you're worthy of wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19029.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Insolent Bramble.

19030.descriptionId:
With this mask covering your nose, you'll trade your traditional clown outfit for that of a gracious fox.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19031.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Tree.

19032.descriptionId:
It's hard to say whether the paper covering this shield will protect you from weapons, but it certainly will do from the sun.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19033.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Martyr Punishment.

19034.descriptionId:
Although it's very difficult to take off, this gorget will protect you from uppercuts, as well as midnight cravings. It's an absolute must-have. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19035.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Retribution.

19036.descriptionId:
This fur cape is particularly well insulated. Using it in the desert will protect you from both hot and cold temperatures. 
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19037.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Bling.

19038.descriptionId:
This mechanical shield is the ultimate form of protection and lightness. Its fur will even absorb your sweat.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19039.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Stampede.

19041.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Grapple Arrow.

19043.nameId: Cra Seal: Summoning of Tactical Beacon
19043.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Summoning of Tactical Beacon.

19045.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Vulnerability.

19047.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Stabilisation.

19049.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Paralysing Trap.

19051.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Double.

19053.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Mummification.

19055.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Rewind.

19057.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Stimulating Word.

19059.descriptionId: This seal shows your absolute mastery of the spell: Word of Altruism.

19061.descriptionId: With this blessing, Xelor offers you a bit of his time to help you save yours.

19065.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19067.descriptionId:
Slowly but surely.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19069.descriptionId:
Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19071.descriptionId:
After defeating that dungeon hands down, it's the perfect time for a quick trip to the inn to have a bite and show off a new shield.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19074.descriptionId:
This mechanical bird is a technomagic marvel. It's almost enough to make Count Harebourg jealous.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19077.descriptionId:
The Buboulder isn't overweight – it's simply storing a little fat to get through winter. Because some Amaknians will hang them on their Kwismas itztings as a tradition. Luckily, the bugs and arachnees that wander into your home will be more than enough to keep it fed. Convenient and ornamental.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19079.descriptionId: You are imbued with the knowledge of the ancients... and a persistent locker room smell.

19080.descriptionId:
Tomi the executioner never said he could count to a thousand or read Old Scaly. But one thing he could promise was a quick death done right. This honest work earned him pride of place at the queen's side. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19081.descriptionId: This trophy makes your heart rate drop, so you'll be able to run six or seven times longer than usual before you run out of breath. That should take you to somewhere between 30 and 40 seconds, if you've got wind in your sails.

19083.descriptionId:
Just as proud and majestic as you are once you're on its back. That is, if you manage not to fall off... 

(This petsmount doesn't need to be fed and cannot die.)

19085.descriptionId:
Protector of your life by day, saviour of your nights after dark. This hide shield is a must-have for those who love adventure.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19087.descriptionId:
The frozen lands and their icy winds blowing down your neck are nothing but a distant memory since you found the comfort of this fur.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19089.descriptionId:
One day, this fleece will become a legend. Let's just hope you'll be part of it, too.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19093.descriptionId:
When you think about it, it's rather ironic that a heart breaker would put so much heart into breaking other people's hearts.

19095.descriptionId:
What could be better than a rousing quarrel to weaken love, that constant connection just dripping with tenderness?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

This shield will protect you from the thunderbolt that is love at first sight and those abominable flirts that might otherwise soften your heart of stone.

19101.descriptionId:
This Croum will always hold a torch for you, which becomes problematic when this clingy pet tries to nuzzle you. No matter what you're doing, or what mood you're in, when it decides to get close to you, it'll warm your heart – and probably the rest of you.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

You'll be able to fly with this cape around your shoulders. Just close your eyes, clench your fists, open your mouth, stretch out your arms and jump off a cliff shouting "I can fly!". Moments later, you'll wake up with two broken legs.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19108.descriptionId: [!] Son sourire est ravageur mais elle vous fait un petit peu peur.

19109.descriptionId:
This shield won't protect you from your own stupidity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19111.descriptionId: When you're village chief, even the heaviest shield doesn't have to be just for protection or for showing off. For example, this one seems to have been designed by a Crackler who took one too many rocks to the head as a child. Chiselled from a block of bramblestone, it will truly be the jewel of your collection.

19112.descriptionId:
"More than a hundred of our soldiers were burned on the spot. A good fifty more came back weeping blood. And that's not counting those who were turned into crobaks last week! It's her all right."

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19113.descriptionId: Originally used by carpenters to cut slate for the roofs in the ancient kingdom of Ephedrya, people with a chequered past now use it to slice the slate clean.

"They say witches are wicked and cruel. They boil children in cauldrons, tear the wings off butterflies, stick needles under innocents' nails and do business with shushus. Personally, I'm not like that. I love flowers, for example. Oleander petals are a delight to behold. If it were up to me, every pleasure garden would have some."

— Belladonna, the evil witch of Ephedrya

— Belladonna, the evil witch of Ephedrya

— Belladonna, the evil witch of Ephedrya

She ultimately became a real samurai and climbed the ranks through skill and bravery. She now commands the samurai order that serves the Daimya no less. Her story of success and liberation is a great example for all young girls (and boys)!

"Be a Iop
We must be swift as the coursing river
Be a Iop
With all the force of the great typhoon
Be a Iop
With all the strength of the raging fire
Mysterious as the dark side of a moon."

Despite her devotion to Pandawa, Wulan has much respect for the fighting spirit of the disciples of Iop, and takes inspiration from them to motivate her troops.

The darkest corners of Plantala were feared by the White Chtigers themselves. Seeing the forest as a living entity, they compared its invasive roots to black arteries filled with blood. But there's no need to panic – whether it's one or the other, this shovel will cut through them in one fell swoop.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19147.descriptionId: According to respectable belt makers, crafting engirdle ishisms may seem tempting, but you can quickly get carried away and start putting them everywhere. Although sometimes used subtlety and sparingly, the aforementioned respectable craftsmen generally don't make them because they consider their usage to be lazy and unsuited to the World of Twelve. Ah, belt makers and their principles! That being said, this belt is a must-have.

Anyone who knows how to read Kianzhi will, however, tell you that they simply say: "Made in Pandala. Size 5".

19163.descriptionId: If someone gazes pointedly into this pendant for 42 hours straight, they will be completely under your command.

19175.descriptionId: You might be wondering how Gein manages to see anything at all, given that this hat completely covers the eyes. But one generally doesn't have time to ask too many questions when face-to-face with him.

19176.descriptionId:

19177.descriptionId: Gein actually uses this belt as pants, but it might be a bit tight on you.

19178.descriptionId:
"Kentora, I need help tearing down that mountain over there. Can you lend me a hand?"

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19179.descriptionId: Gein is a bit of a gambler: you just have to yank on the chain of his amulet to immobilize him. Obviously, if he takes that kind of a risk, it's because anyone who gets that close to him is already regretting it.

19180.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Incarnated Class 653".

19181.descriptionId:
If a bitter old bugger with bats in his belfry tries to put a boot in your behind for burgling his bounty, boldly break out this bitter-shield to bounce back his blows, and we bet he'll think better of it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19182.nameId: Title Scroll: Mr. World of Twelve
19182.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Mr World of Twelve".

19184.descriptionId:
There's nothing worse than having your hair flop over your eyes when you go to deliver the fatal blow. Any self-respecting assassin therefore needs their hair do to be on point. This elastic headband was designed with just that in mind – you're sure to love it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19185.descriptionId: This crescent-shaped weapon would make any warrior interested in astronomy most happy. Don't be fooled, though – if an Ereborian Bylhuk tells you you're going to the moon, it won't be to see whether it's made of cheese. The Reaper can take on many guises, but it's always the same outcome: you'll get nothing but a one-way ticket to the Grey Country.

19186.descriptionId:
You've always thought that wearing a cape at work is a bad idea. Such an ample and impractical piece of clothing would only make it easier for your targets to spot you. Your pragmatic side therefore pushed you to add this katana holster to your wardrobe so you could move quickly once you sheathed your weapon.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19187.descriptionId: This hammer, which is typical of the Stubbyobs living in the tunnels of Ereboria, has many uses. You can whack, bang, hit, break, smash, nail, pound, pulverise, crush and – obviously – hammer with it. It's a yobligatory and universal tool that works well in anyone's hands, as long as they aren't too attached to their fingers. Berylbell usually prefers her tonfas, but she's certainly no less fearsome when wielding this hammer.

19188.descriptionId:
Wiley finisher that you are, this shield will let you eliminate your opponents before they can even begin to understand what's happened. Indeed, it has a hidden blade and an ingenious mechanism that slides the blade out to counterattack after blocking a blow.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19189.descriptionId: Jokes abound when adventurers challenge Berylbell in her stronghold. "She's gonna knock seven bells out of you!" "She'll ring your bells!" "She's as sound as a bell!" They all stop ringing once the Stubbyob's fists have spoken. To bell with subtlety.

19190.descriptionId:
If you aren't pleased at the idea of celebrating Fleaster, bring this pet along with you.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19191.descriptionId: You have to wonder what could inspire the guardian of Ereboria to wear an item of clothing more commonly associated with one of Srambad's less reputable sports. Are Stubbyobs really a nation of wrestling fans? Not that it really stubbin' matters. You can't judge a book by its yobber, and Berylbell does what she wants anyhow. After all, she's the one who wears the pants in the Bitter-Hammer clan! She's not trying to be a pain in the rear... quite the opposite, in fact.

19192.descriptionId:
If nature has taught us anything, it's that you can never judge a creature by its size. Even the smallest critter can be very dangerous, as this Geckymosis proves. One belly rub too many and you can say goodbye to your hand, so be careful if you adopt this one.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19193.descriptionId:
A few winters back, when the Bitter-Hammers were despairing of ever returning home, a Pandawa marched into the tunnels of Ereboria to give Berylbell Copperbeard a piece of her mind. A storm was brewing in her stern, black-ringed eyes. She was a master of a unique variant of the art of Pandawushu.
The two warriors had already fought many battles, and this confrontation went on for a long time. A very long time. Such a long time, in fact, that the Stubbyobs who had gathered around to cheer on their leader eventually yobbed off to sleep. When they opened their eyes, startled awake by the sound of their own snoring, the disciple of the Big Bear and the daughter of the Smith were saluting each other with great respect. They exchanged weapons. Their pitched battle had ended in a draw, and yet Berylbell's face was lit up with a smile. The dark clouds of discouragement had cleared.
Ever since that day, Berylbell has carefully preserved her honourable adversary's tonfas as both a souvenir and trophy. Who would have thought she could be so sentimental?

19194.descriptionId:
This combat lizard used to belong to the leader of a group of bandits. They say that, despite his kind heart, the bandit withered away to a dry, grey husk because of his hatred and thirst for vengeance.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19195.descriptionId: This mask is great for blending in on dark surfaces. Just be careful not to let your ears give you away; apparently, this is the Black Fang's greatest weakness.

19196.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Tokageko ornament.

19197.descriptionId: This cloak is equal parts comfort and practicality: it's cut short so you won't drag it in sewer water, and split down the middle for freedom of movement. Whoever fashioned it knew exactly what they were doing.

19198.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Martial Display emote.

19199.descriptionId: There is absolutely nothing morbid about a member of the Black Fang wearing another rat's fang. In actual fact, this shows a profound respect toward the elders who have come and gone in the clan's ranks.

19201.descriptionId: If the sound of your boots scraping on stone isn't enough to make your enemies scream, a good kick in the rear will surely do the trick.

19203.descriptionId: This belt will keep your sensitive parts safe when you're attacking the Swift Claw clan. Try to avoid sudden movements, though, as protection is highly volatile.

19205.descriptionId: This clawed glove is rather handy for quietly taking out a target. Just the thing for an assassin of the Black Fang clan.

19207.descriptionId:
Hard to say for sure what Swift Claw really is: a masked hero, or an underground gang from the Bonta sewers?
Either way, if a musician wearing this hat comes along to de-light your ears, make sure no one comes to light-en your pack.

19209.descriptionId: This well-ventilated cloak quickly gets rid of the smell of Bonta sewers once worn in the open air, so the wearer can have a more pleasant hunt with a more fruitful yield.

19211.descriptionId: This large collar doubles as fashionable jewellery for performances and a bib for tastings at the local tavern.

19213.descriptionId:
An iron paw in a velvet glove... A velvet glove in your pocket.
And your purse? Nowhere to be found.

19215.descriptionId: This sturdy belt was designed to support a great many tools and items from various sources.

19217.descriptionId: A Swift Claw minstrel needs to be swift-footed as well as nimble-fingered.

19219.descriptionId:
Scurvions may be among the best-armed monsters, but paradoxically, this helmet gives you everything you need to defend yourself where they cannot: on your head.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19221.descriptionId:
This cloak has settled on your back, which explains its colour.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19224.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Original Legend title.

19231.descriptionId: This ring was specifically designed not to interfere with the wearer's movements while handling a lance. As you can imagine, sprained ring fingers are common with weapons this heavy.

19245.descriptionId: Created by Ratathrosk, the grey dragon, this egg is an enigma. It may not be as powerful as a Primordial Dofus, but it seems older than time... You'd do well to guard it closely. After all, only the Norrai and the god Xelor know what the future holds.

19249.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the Wabbit Pwedatow title.

19251.descriptionId:
This shield is as strong as the great Krudtos's shield, which all the legends of the northern lands – and other lands – speak of.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19253.descriptionId:
Perhaps that feeling you have of bearing the weight of the world on your shoulders isn't just a feeling after all.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19255.descriptionId:
Nobody will mess around at the inn when you walk in with this helmet on your head. Just make sure you don't trip when stepping through the doorway.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19257.descriptionId: This trophy makes your heart rate drop, so you'll be able to run six or seven times longer than usual before you run out of breath. That should take you to somewhere between 30 and 40 seconds, if you've got wind in your sails.

19259.descriptionId: As a team of proud and brightly colourful heroes once said, "the best defence is a good offence". Speaking of which, whatever happened to them?

19261.descriptionId:
Just like you, he's seen many battles and isn't afraid of anything any more. And just like you, his lack of fear could be due to the number of hits he's taken to the helmet.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19263.descriptionId:
If you take this certificate to a stable, you will be able to collect your mount.
It is important to remember that it is only valid for 40 days. Once this time is up, the mount will be returned to the wild and the certificate will be invalidated, and you will no longer be able to collect your mount. Always leave your mount in a stable if you go away for a long time.

19265.descriptionId: If you shake this gift vigorously and hold it to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise as if it contained a real live creature. Don't wait a moment longer, open it now!

19269.descriptionId:
This cape does not react well to contact with water so the only way to keep it clean is to lick it regularly as any worthy disciple of Ecaflip would do.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19271.descriptionId:
"If I were a king, I'd be wary of aces," said someone who also wore these glasses.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19273.descriptionId:
In addition to its impeccable attention to detail, this shield has many pockets to protect your favourite cards from the hazards of life.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19275.descriptionId:
Pro tip: keep your purse of kamas out of the paws of this pet if you don't want to end up with snake eyes.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19277.descriptionId:
During your many adventures, you once crossed paths with a bard who sang a few of his best tunes for you. The song he wrote in honour of his petsmount was your favourite. You still can't get the song out of your head, either. It talked about flying on the wings of love to touch the stars... There's probably a hidden meaning there that went over your head.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19279.descriptionId:
Like that feather floating on the breeze, the melodies that accompany your tales flutter into the ears of the onlookers who care to listen. That very same feather leads you on the adventures you experience in the form of lovely ballads.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19281.descriptionId:
This cape is adorned with a magnificent instrument, one that will let you play the most beautiful harmonies at any time. You can also use it to cut butter – but only sweet butter, please.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19283.descriptionId:
The artisan who created this piece – the crowing glory of his life's work – refined every tiny detail until his last breath. If one day you are running out of steam, use your last breath to blow into this instrument. It'll produce notes that take your breath away.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19285.descriptionId:
This helmet always commands respect, no matter who's wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19287.descriptionId:

The last words its previous owner spoke before disappearing were supposedly, "I must go, for somewhere, a crime is being committed..."
No one's seen him again since, and no one knows where he went.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19466.descriptionId: Iron is essential to blacksmiths and anyone else who works with metal. Some logical creatures even use it for ironing.

19467.descriptionId:

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19468.descriptionId: Ash Wood is a low-quality wood but it is very common - it grows fast too.

19469.descriptionId:

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19470.descriptionId: This is the staple food of Green Jelly, so if you smell mint, don't get the teacups out right away...

19471.descriptionId:
This little dragon especially loves shiny, valuable things – anything that could seem like treasure. It even has its own hoard of collected treasures, hidden somewhere where only it can find them. This is probably for the best, given that there's no telling what it'd do to any wandering hands that might try to touch something they shouldn't.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19472.descriptionId: A small and fast-moving freshwater fish, the gudgeon is often caught by children and novice fishermen. Don't expect to feed your family with it.

19473.descriptionId:
You know that saying, "He doesn't know his own strength"? Your little friend here has that problem, but in reverse. He thinks he's a colossus, which sometimes leads him to act much more boldly than he should with his frail frame.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19474.descriptionId: This mini potion will make you feel a little better.

19475.descriptionId:
Half-monster, half-moron. The perfect match for you!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19478.descriptionId: Arrivée sur la tombe du chevalier de l'automne

19479.descriptionId:
This helmet confers a proud bearing upon all who wear it, even someone like you who's constantly bashing into doorframes with the horns.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19481.descriptionId:
Warm, soft and impressive-looking. What else could you want from a cape, except maybe not to weigh as much as six gobballs put together?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19482.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Nagate in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19483.descriptionId:
Who says a shield can't be both stylish and effective? The horns solidly attached to this one will effectively block your attackers' weapons and make you the centre of attention when you walk into the inn.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19484.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Tanukouï San in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19485.descriptionId:
You've caught it a few times staring at books and encyclopaedias with surprising intensity. A bluish gleam sparkles in your companion's eyes whenever you're near a well-stocked bookshelf.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19486.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Founoroshi in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19487.descriptionId:
Left, right, through the legs... You've never seen a mount with such incredible dexterity! It could be a valuable ally in your next gobbowl match. And in the meantime, you can count on it to keep you onside!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19488.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Shihan in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19489.descriptionId:
For hours, days, and years, he fought. Not once did he waver, and not once did an unruly strand stand out of place... and nor did a foul Shushu win the day.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19490.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Damadrya in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19491.descriptionId:
Just like your pride, it can take a beating, it can be harmed, it can be broken, but it can never be destroyed. That is how heroes whose names spark legends live and die.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19492.descriptionId: You might wonder what kind of door a ghostly key could open. The answer is simple: the kind with a ghostly lock.

19493.descriptionId:
Every blow that ever cut or pierced this cape was one that never hurt you. That's a lot of dangers averted with a wave of your hand.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19494.descriptionId: This relic shows you defeated Katamashii in this boss's dungeon. Bring it to Bossawa for a reward.

19495.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Pink Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

19496.descriptionId: This bamboo wood from Nolifis seems unreal, but it really is in your inventory. Magic can be surprising.

19497.descriptionId: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Golden Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

19498.descriptionId: By tinkling this bell, you can navigate between the material plane and the astral plane in Nolifis. Use at your own risk.

19499.descriptionId:
In addition to making you look like a wounded animal – and perfectly complementing your sour mood – this eye patch makes it easy to avoid the gaze of any Bworkettes who cross your path. You can trust Ravel when he says this protection isn't just window dressing – sometimes NOT catching someone's eye is the least embarrassing option.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19500.descriptionId: This was once filled with a strong alcohol that Pandawas rave about. Miraculously, the bottle is still intact after all this time.

19501.descriptionId:
Setting the skull of a centoror into a shield isn't nearly enough to give you the power to command spectres. It would take a lot more to truly follow in the footsteps of the Protector of Septangel. Points for effort, though.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19502.descriptionId: You sealed a spirit in a relatively fragile bottle. This unrivalled innovation in the field of exorcism could really boost your reputation.

19503.descriptionId:
The months slip by, each different from the last. Say goodbye to simple, festive evenings by the fire. The sun is rising later, leaves are turning brown, and the rain is wetting the dry ground. There's no mistaking the signs – Raval is working hard to usher in autumn.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19504.descriptionId: Many lanterns like this one can be seen on the cursed island of Nolifis. It's said that their soft light is capable of pacifying certain restless spirits that reside there.

19505.descriptionId:
This sidekick is as proud as he is dangerous, and he won't add a single kama to your food bill. 

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19506.descriptionId: This ordinary-seeming fabric is soaked with calligraphy ink. Unfortunately, it belonged to someone who was neither a calligrapher nor ordinary.

19507.descriptionId:
If you've always dreamed of straddling death and riding off into the sunset, this creature – revived by the power of Ravel – will exceed your wildest expectations. Of course, it isn't death itself you'll be riding – obviously, the queen of Externam has better things to do.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19508.descriptionId: Fu Zawa was an exceptional Pandawa samurai who accomplished many feats. This bracelet was one of his most cherished possessions.

19509.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Ravel Manifestation emote.

19510.descriptionId:
No one knows the origin of the crimson colour of this fighting drheller's horns. It probably has to do with the shade of your vanquished enemies' entrails. 

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19511.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)

Use this scroll to obtain the Raval's Domination ornament.

19512.descriptionId:
