If Toross has never been taken a beating, it's thanks in part to this shield. Stasis absorbs blows like nothing else. Even Wakfu can't overcome it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19513.descriptionId: This amulet is really nothing more than an assortment of flowers woven together around a cord. But it was sold to you so effectively that you believe with all your heart that it will bring you beauty and prosperity.

19515.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Tavern Fan ornament.

19516.descriptionId:
If you think this key will attract your dirty pig-friends, you really haven't got it... The only thing it will do is open up the Dragon Pig's Maze. 
Be careful, it self-destructs after use.

19517.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Timeless Krosplayer".

19518.descriptionId: You are now a Kitsou, thanks to Katamashii. It might be nice enough, if only you didn't have to fight the goddess Pandawa in this form...

19519.descriptionId: This potion will allow the leader of a guild to delevel a spell for a Perceptor.

19520.descriptionId:
Did you know? Back in the day, watchmen were posted at the entrances to the World of Twelve's cemeteries. Wearing this hat, they would reject souls they deemed unworthy of entering Externam – often the very ones who wore sandals or cropped trousers.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19521.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 7 years... And you have been here for them!

19522.descriptionId:
You'll cause a stir in Externam with this cloak. My, oh my! When you run into an enemy who's a bit too tough for you, it won't be a moment too soon!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19523.descriptionId: Ratathrosk sensed your strong desire to defeat the Autumn Knight and knock some sense into her. She is lending you her powers to help you, but only a body such as hers can withstand such powers...

19524.descriptionId:
A tombstone to repel those who want to send you straight to Externam. You've got to admit, it's comical!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19526.descriptionId:
Whether it's yellow, green, red, perhaps orange or even blue, this sinister-looking but chameleon petsmount will liven up your daily life. It's said to have inspired a renowned confectioner's range of sweets.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19528.descriptionId: You received this missive from Captain Amakna. You'd better read it straight away!

19530.descriptionId: The Lumino totem has been split in four. You happen to have found the head already. Gather all the pieces and you might just be able to fix it.

19531.descriptionId: A bundle of wool on Lousy Pig Plain.

19532.descriptionId: The Lumino totem has been split in four. You happen to have found the arms already. Gather all the pieces and you might just be able to fix it.

19533.nameId: Wood Borrowed From the Lousy Pig Camp
19533.descriptionId: Wood that will surely come in handy to repair Balthazar's Caravan.

19534.descriptionId: The Lumino totem has been split in four. You happen to have found the tail already. Gather all the pieces and you might just be able to fix it.

19535.descriptionId: A pile of books from the Temple of Scriptures that Antyklime Ax has set aside specially for Sacha and her companions.

19536.descriptionId: This card has space for multiple stamps from the attractions at the Trool Fair. Get them all and earn a reward!

19537.descriptionId:
A helmet as dark as Hyrkul himself. It will be perfectly clear to everyone which side its wearer was on during the Battle of the Crimson Dawn. Apparently, even certain Bontarians thought it was pretty refined... 
But the Bontarians in question were likely traitors.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19538.descriptionId: The Lumino totem has been split in four. You happen to have found the legs already. Gather all the pieces and you might just be able to fix it.

19539.descriptionId:
Hyrkul or Menalt... which side to choose? Some soldiers had a lot of trouble deciding. So to try and avoid being killed by the opposing camp, one Brakmarian chose to do a bit of custom sewing to show his affection for both sides.
But unfortunately... when it comes to war, loving everyone simply isn't an option.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19540.descriptionId: This totem is supposed to summon Trank to come to your rescue. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be working.

19541.descriptionId:
The blood that stains this shield came from the Bontarian soldiers protecting the eastern flank of the White City during the Battle of the Crimson Dawn. It most likely splattered there when Gghrugh made his successful push through the barricades.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19542.descriptionId: This totem is supposed to summon Lumino to come to your rescue. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be working.

19543.descriptionId:
Carrying this shield always comforts you a bit. You wonder if your mum might not have been entirely right to say "you're not made of sugar!" when you resisted getting into the bath.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19544.descriptionId: This totem is supposed to summon Beelzebug to come to your rescue. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be working.

19545.descriptionId:
The great hero Assbad had this cape custom-made to befit his excellence as a warrior. "To befit"...? "In befittance of"? "As befat"?
Alas, Assbad never found the answer to that question. But the cape does befit him, and that's all that really matters.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19546.descriptionId: This totem is supposed to summon Krobax to come to your rescue. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be working.

19547.descriptionId:
It's said that this wig was worn for many years by the great hero Assbad, who defeated countless waves of enemies with his trusty shield alone. But be careful... this wig spent a little too long just a little too close to a Iop's brain to be sure the mental defects won't rub off on you. After all, what kind of Iop forgets to draw his sword?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19548.descriptionId: This totem is supposed to summon Skale to come to your rescue. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to be working.

19549.descriptionId:
This is the famous shield that the great hero Assbad used to eliminate vast waves of enemies in his glorious past. No one will ever know if he just ploughed ahead into the waves shield-first or if he actually defeated vast waves of enemies. Assbad never really had a way with words. But in the end, it doesn't matter, since he became a hero either way.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19550.descriptionId: Trank the Multiman. After being defeated, he is now forced to follow you. Bring him to Captain Amakna!

19551.descriptionId:
One day, the great hero Assbad found this little fellow in a cupboard and decided to take him under his wing. He named him Asslan, and he soon became the hero's most faithful companion.
Shocked by his master's lack of intelligence, Asslan quickly developed a superior level of genius, even learning to speak. With no choice but to fix his master's many mistakes, he quietly emerged as the leader of the pair without Assbad even noticing.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19552.descriptionId: Krobax the Multiman. After being defeated, he is now forced to follow you. Bring him to Captain Amakna!

19553.descriptionId:
A small group of theatre fanatics cobbled together a small object that was intended to resemble a catapult from the Battle of the Crimson Dawn. Though only a prop at first, it soon began rolling about on its own by some mysterious power...
So the group decided to dub it the Kludgetapult, in honour of the various hacks and kludges that first brought it to life.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19554.descriptionId: Skale the Multiman. After being defeated, he is now forced to follow you. Bring him to Captain Amakna!

19555.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the "Weapon Skill" spell.

19556.descriptionId: Beelzebug the Multiman. After being defeated, he is now forced to follow you. Bring him to Captain Amakna!

19557.descriptionId: A knife covered with mud and dark patches. Unknown characters are engraved on the surface of the blade. It must have been used for sacrifices...

19558.descriptionId: Lumino the Multiman. After being defeated, he is now forced to follow you. Bring him to Captain Amakna!

19559.descriptionId: This gift leaves no room for doubt, so you can proudly proclaim, "I was there".

19560.descriptionId: This magic costume will turn you into an adorable little Ghast. Then, it's up to you to be terrifying.

19561.descriptionId: These pages describe a summoning ritual for a "vile creature", according to the Vilana Cultist. So be careful, because you don't know what kind of shivers might run through you as you read these pages...

19562.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Herdegrize Standard emote.

19563.descriptionId: You are overwhelmed with terror after what you've just read. Your consciousness and thoughts are struggling to become coherent again. You move your lips without making the slightest noise, except for a few abhorrent guttural sounds.

19564.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Grandapan Standard emote.

19565.descriptionId: You've slipped on a cultist's outfit to better infiltrate their ranks.

19566.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Oshimo Standard emote.

19567.descriptionId: Gobballs' wool is full of these little flowers from rolling around on the ground.

19568.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Brutas Standard emote.

19569.descriptionId: A rare horn of the Dark Gobball, proving how daring you are to have faced it and defeated it.

19570.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Dodge Standard emote.

19571.descriptionId: A black tofu feather found at the bottom of the now-empty crate of nuggets.

19572.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Terra Cogita Standard emote.

19573.descriptionId: A raw tofu nugget just waiting to be fried.

19574.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 8 years... And you were there!

19576.descriptionId: This somewhat repugnant organ may be useful for those into toxic substances. So why do you have it in your bag?

19577.descriptionId: A list of ingredients needed to make the famous AFT nuggets.

19578.descriptionId: It's impossible to confuse the eye-catching colour of this eye with another creature's. If you compare any two side-by-side, the difference really jumps out.

19579.descriptionId: A black tofu fillet needed to make AFT nuggets.

19580.descriptionId: Daddy Longlex is rumoured to have a razor-sharp wit. These appendages would tend to support that theory.

19581.descriptionId: A tofoone fillet needed to make AFT nuggets.

19582.descriptionId: So you thought nothing could be more uncomfortable than a gobball wool cape? Try sleeping under a Venomica wool blanket.

19583.descriptionId: A tofukaz fillet needed to make AFT nuggets.

19584.descriptionId: Tailors fight over this raw material, and for good reason: clothes made from Arachmutated silk have a slimming effect, which is hugely popular. It also causes a rash, but such is the cost of looking good.

19585.descriptionId: A tofurby fillet needed to make AFT nuggets.

19586.descriptionId: This fang was extracted by force from a Gargantula's mouth. Anaesthetic was unnecessary, as the monster had so many teeth, it didn't even notice one missing.

19587.descriptionId: A letter from Magus Ax to Harvey Caflip.

19589.descriptionId: That's the price for reading a letter that wasn't for you.

19593.nameId: Defeat the Wild Gobball for Saketsu
19593.descriptionId: Defeat the wild gobball for Saketsu.

19594.descriptionId: Terrakourial's magic prevents this petal from wilting as long as it stays within the Evil Forest, even if its original polter is dead.

19595.descriptionId: A roast gobball leg that could come in handy for bribing Master Jeduo.

19596.descriptionId: Hell Mina's mane is as unruly as she is, so she has to wear a headband to keep her field of vision unobstructed in battle. The accessory doesn't seem all that effective... But it's part of her charm!

19597.descriptionId: A Celestial Piwin feather that fell to the ground during your encounter. Indisputable proof of its existence...

19599.descriptionId:
Those who wear this armet will feel like they're constantly being watched. Looked upon unfavourably by the gods, this uncomfortable feeling isn't banal – they are the ones staring intently with worry... or disdain in the case of the most arrogant.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19601.descriptionId:
The eye on the back of this cape can predict your attackers' next actions. This vision is transferred to the wearer, allowing them to dodge even the sneakiest of blows.

(Equip this cape in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19603.descriptionId:
This shield can parry all blows. But what about its bearer? Not even a god could come out on top.

(Equip this shield in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19605.descriptionId:
An alternative but inferior form of the Grraruda, this adorable creature hides incredible strength. However, in this form, there's no using it otherwise its little body won't survive.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19607.descriptionId:
A creature is often seen taking on different forms, the Grraruda has decided to keep this feline form to show Twelvians its protective side. While its visible teeth and bulging eyes might revolt more than one, its kindness to whoever manages to tame and love it will be infinite.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19608.descriptionId: They say that Dark Vlad himself lit the eternal flame that flickers at the end of Hell Mina's partisan. You've managed to procure a copy for yourself. We strongly recommend practising excellent weapon care by regularly coating it in petrooleum.

19609.descriptionId:
With this hat firmly on your head, you'll be seen as one of the most charitable people in the entire Krosmoz. Whoever wears it deserves to hold the rank of Perfect Platypus. Note: a Perfect Platypus is much better than a simple Platypus! Wear it proudly!

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19610.descriptionId: This key unlocks the terrifying Long Slumber's Barrow. Supposedly, Hell Mina took up residence there to be near her beloved Dark Vlad. Venture inside at your own risk.

19611.descriptionId:
The Platypuses' insignia sits proudly on this standard, a symbol of freedom and independence. With it, Platypuses can proudly show off their status as "professional community helpers" to the world. Who knows, maybe this standard could attract new Twelvians in need?

(Equip this shield in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19612.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

19613.descriptionId:
A Platypus without a bag isn't a Platypus. And a Platypus bag isn't a bag without a Platypus. That's the rule.

(Equip this cape in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19614.descriptionId: Is your sworn enemy arachneephobic? Well, you're in luck – this is the perfect gift for their next birthday... which will be their last, fingers crossed.

19615.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19616.descriptionId: Supple and soft to the touch, these boots are incredibly comfortable. But be prepared to be asked to go barefoot by those who hate seeing those creepy crawlies scuttling across their floor.

19617.descriptionId:
This helmet covers the top of your head and its little wings on the sides look like rat ears. Those who've worn it have often been mocked. But, you know, rats shouldn't be underestimated... Just think about Sphincter Cell and your ego should recover a bit.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19618.descriptionId: This hat was a roaring success at the last fashion show organised by the Brakmar Black Widows' Association.

19619.descriptionId:
This helmet is the closest thing ever to a gladiator helmet. And you'll be glad when you wear it because it makes such a jolly sound when your opponents bonk you on the head: "Dong!"
That's how it got its name.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19620.descriptionId: Some claim that this talisman corrects eyesight problems, while others assure us that it merely multiplies them. The truth, as is often the case, depends on your point of view.

19621.descriptionId:
Donning this helmet immediately gets you in the mood for a fine mead and, better yet, gives you unequalled charisma. Now what good is that on the battlefield, you ask? Well, this little piwi feather on the back of the helmet smells strongly and deliciously of roast fowl... Just perfect for distracting your targets.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19622.descriptionId: This frightening belt will cure your back problems. Just be careful not to lean back too hard while wearing it, or the arak-hai abdomen on the back could burst.

19623.descriptionId:
Initially, this helmet was forged for King Allister's Guardiators. But apparently, everyone who wore it developed certain difficulties... notably when it came to spelling. It won't make you stupid. But it will make you unable to write "guardiator" properly. But does that really matter?

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19624.descriptionId: If you cross paths with Nevark the Hunter while wearing this cape, he may take you for the acolyte of Arachneeman and give you a good hiding. But you're free to do what you want, after all.

19625.descriptionId:
Anyone with a comb is, obviously, suspicious. And someone wearing a helmet with a comb on top is instantly even more suspicious. Be careful! Even if you aren't planning on being insidious, others could assume the worst about you when they see you wearing this helmet.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19627.descriptionId:
This strangely shaped cape is split in two. The rat theory can only get stronger when someone equips this: it looks so very much like two flattened rat tails stuck together to make a cape. But... think about the Black Rat to get over other people's comments. Sure, he's a rat... but he's powerful.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19629.descriptionId:
This cape is very worn and torn, showing signs of the many battles it's been in. Glad is maybe a bit of an exaggeration, as the only sound it makes is... when it rips all by itself.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19631.descriptionId:
Shoo Sookitama was a man who organised major clandestine tournaments among Twelvians. Accordingly, his tablecloths were often reinforced and – of course – much to pretty to stain. (With blood, of course.)
You're wearing one on your back right now, by the way.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19632.nameId: Title Scroll: Guardian of Forgotten Relics
19632.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Guardian of Forgotten Relics".

19633.descriptionId:
"Hey, guys, do we want to be guards or gladiators?!" is probably what one rather middling officer said to trigger the mental difficulties plaguing King Allister's guardiators back in the day. Mixing up words into mediocre mixtures is much easier than you'd think.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19634.descriptionId: [!] 500 sang d'Oni donnés à miss hyonaire

19635.descriptionId:
This cape is a bit long and wide at the bottom, making it a trap in its own right. That's right, if someone tries to attack you from behind, they're sure to trip and fall!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19636.descriptionId: [!] 500 Noeul mort donnés à miss hyonaire

19637.descriptionId:
This shield is simple. It's even quite ratty... Err, I meant to say... natty. Why does wearing it always bring rats to mind?! Even this shield – the simplest of all – falls prey to the rat theory.
Tell yourself that this shield is one the White Rat could carry. Sure, he's a rat... but he's got charisma.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19639.descriptionId:
This shield is full of glad tidings: different bell-like dings when its bumps are struck. Honestly, it's more useful than you'd expect. For example, it's great for drawing attention or throwing enemies off their game. The post-battle concerts and victory toasts are good, too.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19641.descriptionId:
Would you believe me if I told you this shield was originally a platter? A large dish for buffets, one that could protect the foodie from all the bodies flying his way. Of course, all the food would fall on his knees when he needed to lift it for protection, but gravy stains are much easier to deal with than blood stains. Both when doing laundry and when examining one's conscious.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19642.descriptionId: The malters have put you to the test. It's up to you to find a way out in the form of a Malterego.

19643.descriptionId:
This shield is the ultimate proof that the Guardiators are gladiators. This notion has gained traction, especially among Kolossium fans. Many guardiators deserted Amakna Castle to head there. So... be careful to avoid flaunting this bit of finery in King Allister's sight. You might make him angry.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19644.descriptionId:
No one knows why or how this pet suddenly grew horns. But in the end, it doesn't matter whether it was a blessing from a spirit or a genetic mutation. Thanks to their glow, you'll always be able to see where you're going, even on the darkest nights.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19645.descriptionId:
This shield gives off noble airs but hides a huge trap under this tricky ribbon. Apparently, it's supposed to cling to the neck of anyone who dares come too close. What a trickster, that ribbon!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19646.descriptionId:
Some species would be better off going extinct, but when you're made entirely of bones, you don't have much to worry about. If you give your Crossil milk every day, it'll make him stronger and he can stay with you forever!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19647.descriptionId:
A squad of Xelors randomly travelled back in time and spotted this strange horned helmet, which they brought back to the present day. Everyone was startled when the lights went out and the helmet was still glowing in the dark. And everyone is still startled whenever it happens.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19648.descriptionId: This token serves as a currency for trading between members of the Guild of Hunters. Go to their headquarters in Cania to use it.

19649.descriptionId:
"This cape is worn by strangely mechanical Twelvians in an unknown dimension."
— Draked Kir, its last known owner.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19650.descriptionId:
The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it. And in record time, as well!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19651.descriptionId:
A Xelor is said to have cut their fingers off trying to grab this disk by the bright sides. Don't do the same thing, even if it's not easy handling it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19652.descriptionId:
Only the rider himself knows where its monstrous horns come from. Whatever its back story, this is one impressive helmet!

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19653.descriptionId:
This little luminescent Ghast tried to replicate the Replicants by stealing one of their helmets, pretending to come from an unknown dimension. In reality, nothing but a different-coloured Ghast is hiding underneath this oversized helmet.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19654.descriptionId:
No one stabs the Black Horseman in the back! There'd be no point... Besides looking amazing, his cloak also protects his back, chest and shoulders.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19655.descriptionId:
When the stardust created by the Cryo'rora phenomenon fell on this helm, it gained magical properties.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19656.descriptionId:
There's a very simple way to know if you're the right distance from this shadowy mercenary: if you're close enough to appreciate the contours and fine details of his shield, then you're definitely too close.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19657.descriptionId:
The Cryo'rora is a rare phenomenon the occurs in the northernmost parts of the World of Twelve. Few have ever witnessed it, since, according to them, it only appears when the gods do battle. No one knows whether they really cause this magnificent sight.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19658.descriptionId:
A true pet of ill omen, this dark unikron always appears alongside the Black Horseman. At least now you know that a pet can be adorable AND seriously freaky.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19659.descriptionId:
Whenever this shield is carried for too long, its magical emanations turn its bearer's arms the colours of stardust. Unfortunately – or perhaps fortunately, for some people – these effects have always been irreversible and will remain so forever more.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19660.descriptionId:
This mysterious mask is filled with aromatic herbs. It's a good way to clear out your sinuses if you've got the sarapox.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19661.descriptionId:
This head was built in the image of the Drag-Long so you can dress up as him to celebrate the Year of the Dragon.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19662.descriptionId:
With this getup, you can play chemist anywhere: in bed, in the toilet, at work meetings... Just be careful not to sit on it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19663.descriptionId:
Anyone who wears this helmet will feel imbued with the great power of the Drag-Long. But it is just a feeling.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19664.descriptionId:
Long ago, many alchemists used this heavy-duty flask in their attempts to create an artificial Twelvian. Even if that's not your thing, you can still use it to splash toxic chemicals on your attackers whilst exploring a dungeon.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19665.descriptionId:
Putting on the Drag-Long's scales is claimed to automatically bring the wearer happiness. This is even more so for those who are lucky enough to find a pearl hidden between its scales.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19666.descriptionId:
To keep these flowers (and your mind) fresh, remember to water this headgear regularly.
(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19667.descriptionId:
This little dragon is thought to be a direct descendent of the Drag-Long. The baby's voice is often compared to the sound of banging pots and pans... Be prepared if you intend to keep him by your side.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19668.descriptionId:
Opt for a parry style that will thoroughly confuse your opponents: throw flowers at them!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19669.descriptionId:
This aegis is often carried by the most superstitious of people – those who hope the rains will come during great droughts. When the aegis is pointed skywards, the Drag-Long is said to walk on the clouds and make their tears fall.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19670.descriptionId:
This cape blooms all year long and leaves a delicate floral scent wherever you go. Perfect for those gassier days.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19671.descriptionId:
This helmet was long thought to belong to an Armarine who got trapped in the ice. But they didn't yet exist during the big freeze. Only by analysing the ice crystallised around this skull did the facts come to light – they were creatures or equipment of Twelvians who lived before that dark time and perished in the disaster.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19672.descriptionId:
Always dreamed of walking about on a carpet of flowers? With this petsmount, now you can!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19673.descriptionId:
These vertebrae found during the big freeze in Frigost turned out to be indestructible, no matter what spells were cast or weapons were used. They were crystallised by eternal ice and extracted to form equipment.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19674.descriptionId:
Did you know? This adorable pet is actually the result of a successful cutting!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19675.descriptionId:
The skulls of the ancestors of some of today's monsters on the continent of Frigost were found after the big freeze there. Nowadays, they are used as aegises for the most cold-resistant warriors who aren't afraid to face death.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19676.descriptionId:
This headgear will grant you great powers of persuasion. Everyone you talk to will find themselves unable to refuse anything you ask, even a treat or a cuddle.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19677.descriptionId:
This gallant creature only appears during the Cryo'rora. Everyone equates the Goatho'rora with a shooting star because of how rare it is. Apparently, it can bring to life all the thoughts of those who know how to tame it.
Note: it wouldn't be wise to think about falling off this mount and dying from the fall, as it might just come true.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19678.descriptionId:
Mum and her whole brood are out and about! It's a veritable symphony of babbling, singing, tweeting and chirping. Woe be to those who try to clip their wings... One peck isn't so bad, but four at a time will start to do some real damage...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19680.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Epsilon's Standard emote.

19681.descriptionId:
This species of turtle, which is native to the Archipelago of Scales, is sadly on the brink of extinction. Alas, it is essential to the reproduction of the Archipelago's endemic birds, due to the nesting box on top of its shell. A collective of Twelvians are getting together to save them from poaching and ensure that you'll still be able to see these animals centuries from now!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19682.descriptionId: You saved Amphibrute from Raul Mops's clutches. Now, take it to Oshimo!

19683.descriptionId:
Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19684.descriptionId: You saved Wallaburn from the tofus' clutches. Now, take it to Oshimo!

19685.descriptionId:
The Abominable Grinchy used to be Father Whupper's closest assistant. Every year, this diabolical Sadida would visit Amakna and carefully write down the names and addresses of anyone who made fun of his appearance. He would then find delight in denouncing them and depriving them of gifts at Nowel! Wearing his mask might make people around you be a little nicer to you...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19686.descriptionId: This small seed comes from the tall trees in Astrub Forest. Although they aren't carried by the wind to make the forest grow, fortunately, they can count on betapirs to eat them and spread them all over.

19687.descriptionId:
This soft cape will leave a thick trail of pine needles behind you. The Abominable Grinchy didn't really need it, given his extremely furry body, but it let him prick the feet of unfortunate people who went around barefoot. That makes it the perfect attire to wear when you visit friends you'd like to prank.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19688.descriptionId: You saved Betapir from the famished Snoowolf's clutches. Now, take it to Oshimo!

19689.descriptionId:
This magnificent shield comes with quite a dilemma for anyone thinking of wearing it – on the one hand, you'll give off a lovely woody scent, on the other hand, you won't be able to get near a fireplace without going up in flames. Although, you could always use it to decorate your Kwismas tree.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19690.descriptionId: This juicy fruit has always been used in incredible ways throughout the ages. Whether it's to keep doctors away, poison a princess or banish people from a wonderful place, apis will always delight you.

19691.descriptionId:
This little bow wow is known for spreading joy wherever he goes. He was so joyful that the Abominable Grinchy decided to kidnap him to deprive the inhabitants of Kwismas Island of his light-hearted joy. He's yours now, so make sure you take care of him!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19692.descriptionId: You've convinced the siroccorn to follow you. Now, take it to Oshimo!

19693.descriptionId:
This little cape is the strongest bow meow magnet ever invented. Its long ribbon seems to have a truly hypnotic effect on the little felines. Don't be surprised if you find one playing with it. Wear sparingly if you're allergic to those little furballs.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19694.nameId: [!] S'est fait surprendre par Milo - chanil
19694.descriptionId: [!] permet d'avoir un combat different contre milo

19695.descriptionId:
It took many hours to make the imposing bow on this headgear stay in place. Watch out for strong winds – and scissors!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19696.descriptionId:
This very young Elante was separated from its mother much too soon and under tragic circumstances. Take good care of it and it will reveal its magical powers.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19697.descriptionId:
The surface of this shield was sewn from the most beautiful gift wrapping ever. Wear it on a romantic outing and the object of your affections might just decide you're a gift from the heavens.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19698.descriptionId:
This little dragoturklet dreams of celebrating Kwismas, but first, it needs to avoid becoming a main dish at Skank Hivin.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19699.descriptionId:
This shield has managed to give you both the evil eye AND a nasty cold. Luckily, it offers adequate protection from nasty blows.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19700.descriptionId:
The Silver Coolwolf company is a group of Albueran mercenaries known for their brutality. It's said they let out monstrous howls as they close in on their prey, making it impossible to know whether the victim was torn to shreds by animals or Twelvians.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19702.descriptionId:
The mercenaries of the Silver Coolwolf company always wear a lance through their fur capes. It seems that the lance was the weapon they used as apprentices before being permitted to join the pack, lending them a strong symbolic value.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19703.descriptionId: A note from the Lousy Pig food safe.

19704.descriptionId:
This woven fur shield got to be quite stiff and scratchy with all the blood it's absorbed from the mercenaries' victims. Don't worry – it's since been washed... And besides, that only made it more resistant to incoming attacks!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19706.descriptionId:
This coolwolf was harnessed and trained by a mercenary troop from birth to become the exceptionally keen tracker and ferocious fighter it is today.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19707.descriptionId: You are overwhelmed with terror after what you've just read. Your consciousness and thoughts are struggling to become coherent again. You move your lips without making the slightest noise, except for a few abhorrent guttural sounds.

19708.descriptionId:
Zi was reputed to be the most famous troubadour in the World of Twelve. He quickly rose to the highest heights of society in the southern kingdoms. But what people tend not to know is that this reputation enabled him to organise a host of events for noble causes. So, like Zi, you too should be generous, because every little thing you do counts.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19713.descriptionId: This headgear seems to be a mixture of bones from the most powerful monsters you've encountered on your long journey. The crack on top of the skull shows all of the rage within you, unless it's your blood seeping out. Either way, others had better not cross you.

19714.descriptionId:
Contrary to popular belief, a drag-long is a dragon-like spirit, but that doesn't mean it's a dragon. So don't bother trying to charm it into giving you a Dofus – you won't get one.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19715.descriptionId:
This little snailmeow is a gift from your friend Sponge Mob. It meows like a bow meow and creeps along like a snailmet, making it the best of both worlds.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19717.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Fashion Icon ornament.

19718.descriptionId:
Some adventurers wear helmets to protect themselves from hard knocks. You wear this one because you've become a legend. These two types of adventurers are not the same.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19719.descriptionId:
This delectable pet would melt even the toughest warriors. Probably the most formidable weapon you've ever seen.	

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19720.descriptionId:
As shiny as it is tough, this pristine shield is awarded to adventurers who have demonstrated incredible courage.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19721.descriptionId:
You'll have a great time with him, foraging about without a care in the world.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19722.descriptionId:
A quick glance is all it takes for any experienced adventurer to appreciate what kind of feats you must have accomplished to wear this incredible cloak. Wear it with pride.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19723.descriptionId:
This petsmount will be a real lifesaver on those days when you don't feel like sticking your nose out of your chrysalis!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19724.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Paladin Glorious Pose emote.

19725.descriptionId:
Without being too flowery, this hat will illuminate you – it's a true metamorphosis!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19726.descriptionId:
You just gave a king a good thrashing, and that deserves a little reward! Let's just hope you haven't caused a diplomatic crisis.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19727.descriptionId:
This cape is made for anyone who enjoys fluttering back and forth!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19728.descriptionId:
This helm, forged from a metal with unique reflections, will help you find your bearings in the depths of the Labyrinth. Thanks to its unique properties, you can see at first glance that you've already been here and that you are, in fact, well and truly lost.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19729.descriptionId:
This shield will let you easily deal with overzealous opponents.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19730.descriptionId:
It's said that its iridescent reflections have the power to ward off the vile and mysterious creatures that lurk in the shadows of the Labyrinth. Or it might attract them. You can never be certain which. The best way to find out is to put it on. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19731.descriptionId:
Check Mate advances inexorably, cell by cell, towards its goal. At the end, it will give you a glimmer of hope, perhaps just enough for victory.	

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19732.descriptionId:
Carved out of the rock, this shield holds the dark secrets of the Labyrinth's depths. That explains the screams of fear and cries of distress that sometimes escape from it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19733.descriptionId:
Turn after turn, this shield will defend you till the end.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19734.descriptionId:
This mount is rather playful and may well pretend to get lost in the dark depths of the Labyrinth, and you along with it. But rest assured, it knows every nook and cranny like the back of its hand. Granted, that doesn't make the prank any funnier.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19735.descriptionId:
This cloak will make you feel as if you're soaring to victory. Of course, it's the only cloak that gives you wins!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19736.descriptionId: Called 'Zawooin Ling' in the ancient language of the Lenalds... rumour has it that this item was forged in a volcano beneath Fire Pandala by Zeewon, a mysterious Wabbit.

19737.descriptionId:
Once you've put on this hat, there's a good chance you'll start doing all sorts of funny things. You see? You're already reading this upside down and right to left!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19738.descriptionId:
(Double tap to get the title)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Treasure Hoarder".

19739.descriptionId:
What's stronger than a nacho to fend off shocks? Two nachos with extra kwakamole! Your opponents will be green with envy. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19740.descriptionId: This traditional Trool mess sponge cake is made according to an old Bwork recipe. Only a Bwork who's defeated a Trool with his bare hands is allowed to eat it. If he survived such a fight, he could eat just about anything!

19741.descriptionId:
Don't be fooled – this petsmount knows how to walk on eggshells... except when it's defending you. Then, it'll crush the eggshells underfoot.	

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19742.descriptionId: If we consider the weight and solidity of a Trool bone, it's easy to understand why it hurts so bad when they smack you during Trool-playing games.

19743.descriptionId:
Because it's already snuffed it, this little pet is ready to take any risk to protect you. What's dead is dead!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19744.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. The label says it contains 1 Melon Shigekax, 1 Vanilla Shigekax, 1 Pear Shigekax and 2 Chocolate Shigekax. Beware of tooth decay!

19745.descriptionId:
Your opponents will be so busy admiring this splendid shield, they won't see the fatal blow coming. Brilliant!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19747.descriptionId:
Yes, this cape adorned with water stones is quite heavy and cumbersome. It's not easy being armoured every day, is it?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19749.descriptionId:
This turban is already knotted so you don't have a nervous breakdown every time you try to... HOW DO YOU PUT ON THIS *&%@&*# *$#&??!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19750.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Royal Gobball Hunter".

19751.descriptionId:
With its golden fleece and membranous side protectors, this helmet radiates the charisma of the grey dragon through its wearer. Not machine washable.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19752.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Wa Wabbit Hunter".

19753.descriptionId:
The way it floats in the wind perfectly reproduces the flapping of the grey dragon's wings. At night, you can send your enemies running all while staying hidden yourself!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19754.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Dragon Pig Hunter".

19755.descriptionId:
This shield is not only dazzling – it's also named after the dragon that watches over the city. It has never failed. Although, it does depend on who's using it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19756.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Soft Oak Hunter".

19758.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Bworker Hunter".

19759.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Astrub Initiate".

19760.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Ougaa Hunter".

19761.descriptionId:
A dragoturkey for a gladiator? No. That's outdated. But a fighting madreggon? That's something.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19762.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Chaos Hunter".

19763.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Red Ribbon
19763.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a red ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"The egg you just found is red. 'As red as strawberry jam.'
That's what you say to reassure yourself. But you know full well it's nothing of the sort. The stench of sulphur and incense fills the space around it, hinting at the sacrifices this egg may have witnessed..."

19764.descriptionId: Clematys is a determined and resourceful Eniripsa.

19765.nameId: Fleaster Egg With an Orange Ribbon
19765.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with an orange ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"In a sugary vision upon touching this egg, you see a cherry tree on the edge of a lake. This vision then shifts to the image of five chocolatey rocks drenched in a vanilla sauce. Deliciously topped."

19766.nameId: Title Scroll: Champion of the Decade
19766.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Champion of the Decade".

19767.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Yellow Ribbon
19767.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a yellow ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"That's one more egg for you. Your stomach rumbling, you reach out to get a taste of the coating. But instead of the smooth touch of chocolate, you feel a muddy substance on your fingertips. Disgusted, you realise this smell, which would nauseate putrefied bark, didn't come from you, but from the egg."

19768.nameId: Title Scroll: Brawler of the Decade
19768.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Brawler of the Decade".

19769.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Green Ribbon
19769.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a green ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"As you gaze into its deep black shell, the egg in your hands evokes a profound sadness, not unlike a meal without a chocolatey dessert. Nevermore will you give in to the temptation to nosh on a cheese platter. Nevermore."

19771.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Royal Blue Ribbon
19771.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a royal blue ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"You now have a new Fleaster egg in your possession. Upon closer inspection, you notice a cawwot-coloured beard hair in the chocolate. You are reminded of a certain Stubbornyob described with this feature."

19772.descriptionId: Dardondakal, the dragon of light, is the eternal rival of the terrible Grougalorasalar.

19773.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Fuchsia Ribbon
19773.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a fuchsia ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"As you grab the egg, you notice it's completely coated in... ugh... Goblin snot. It also seems to have been dunked in a pot of funny-smelling, cherry-red soup."

19774.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Shadow Among Shadows".

19775.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Pink Ribbon
19775.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a pink ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"With its crunchy chocolate exterior, this balloon-like Fleaster egg almost appears to have been deep-fried. Makes you think of the last tofu hot dog you had."

19776.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Master Waitologist".

19777.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Purple Ribbon
19777.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a purple ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"The last egg thrums with a delighted energy, like a Meridia left in a chocolate factory all night. Your quest is almost over. It's time to collect your loot."

19778.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19779.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Blue Ribbon
19779.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a blue ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"You've just picked up the first Fleaster egg. A shiver runs down your spine. As you hold it in your hands, you notice it's strangely moist and smells of salty air. Your instincts are telling you to seek out a fountain to fill with chocolate."

19780.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19781.nameId: Fleaster Egg With a Turquoise Ribbon
19781.descriptionId:
Chocolate egg with a turquoise ribbon. Bravo, you found where it was hidden!

"As soon as you touch the egg, a dozen arachnees skitter out of it. Your key seems to have been carved in amber, similar to how a pastry chef would use caramel."

19782.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19783.descriptionId:
Legend has it that when the moon is full, Pandalans with telescopes can catch a glimpse of a wodent hopping rhythmically on its surface. 

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

19784.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19785.descriptionId: This headgear is a near-perfect reproduction of the Trooligophren's head. The tailor who worked on this piece did a really good job of transcribing his weak-mindedness. The empty eyes and the mouth really bring out that dumbfounded look. So in other words, you'll get recognised even when you're wearing this headgear.

19786.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19787.descriptionId: Not only does this ring give off an awful smell, but it also has a terrifying clump of hair that will tickle your nose whenever it gets the chance. Just don't put the ring too close to your nose, in other words.

19788.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19789.descriptionId: Against all expectations, these boots don't smell at all, and it only took three different shoemakers to get rid of their original stench. Make sure you don't wear them to the first two shoemakers' funerals. That would just be in bad taste.

19790.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19791.descriptionId: This cape was taken straight from the Troololens's mane. It just goes to show that mixing boowolf blood and slobber apparently makes for a good hair care product, and the stench of it will make you stronger in every way.

19792.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19793.descriptionId: It was customary for Trool children to suck their thumbs until they reached adulthood. Looks like you'll be able to keep this tradition alive. It would have been easier if you'd used your finger... Cleaner, too.

19794.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19795.descriptionId: This belt was once used as a loincloth that hid much more. It seems that over time, the cloth gradually wore away, much to the dismay of the other forest dwellers.

19796.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19797.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Special Partner".

19798.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19799.descriptionId:
With its baneful breath, this abomination could make even the toughest adventurers' blood run cold. The dark figure casts doubt as to its nature: is it a dragon or a demon?  Either way, the creature seems to have come from another dimension.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19800.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19801.descriptionId:
Despite its small size, this sordid creature's bite releases saliva that can melt metal. Alas, its ungainly appearance had already given you a glimpse of its limited potential as a tame little pet.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19802.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19803.descriptionId: Small poppy seeds to be taken to Jeanette Berger so she can create the weed killer.

19804.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19805.descriptionId:
The number of heroes in the Krosmoz is as huge as the Krosmoz itself. Would you be able to defeat these warriors from across time and space? With this shield, you can at least dream of it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19806.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19807.descriptionId: You found this mysterious page during a monster invasion. What might it be hiding...?

19808.descriptionId: Grougalorasalar pushes you to your limits.

19809.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Sprinter".

19811.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Long-Distance Runner".

19812.descriptionId:
Some merchants would swear on a stack of kamas that this prestigious pelisse was made from real Grougalorasalar skin... Be that as it may, the effect is convincing enough to fool even the Drasalar himself!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19813.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Marathon Runner".

19814.descriptionId:
Did Grougalorasalar have a secret tryst with Crocabulia? Or was this dreggon species just heavily influenced by Ebony season? Regardless, this carnivore has truly terrifying style and will recognise whomever wears the Darkdragon Cloak as his own mother or father!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19815.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Fearless Climber".

19816.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend Lover".

19817.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Blood for Blood".

19818.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 5 years... And you have been here for them!

19819.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Organised Gang".

19821.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Water Clock Survivor".

19822.descriptionId: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made sweet. Hmm... This shigekax really melts in your mouth.

19823.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Lighting Fast".

19824.descriptionId:
Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made sweet.
(This candy increases MP by 1 for 5 fights.)

19825.nameId: Title Scroll: Closer to the Heavens
19825.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Closer to the Heavens".

19826.descriptionId: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made sweet. Hmm... This shigekax really melts in your mouth.

19827.descriptionId: As long as you're wearing this ring on your finger, Gustiful will follow you everywhere. If you take it off, Gustiful will still follow you, because the little creature loves you no matter what.

19828.descriptionId:
Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made sweet.
(This candy increases Range by 1 for 5 fights.)

19829.descriptionId: As long as you're wearing this ring on your finger, Scorcheroo will follow you everywhere. If you take it off, Scorcheroo will still follow you, because the little creature loves you no matter what.

19830.nameId: Title Scroll: Adventurer of the Decade
19830.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Adventurer of the Decade".

19831.descriptionId: As long as you're wearing this ring on your finger, Amphibubble will follow you everywhere. If you take it off, Amphibubble will still follow you, because the little creature loves you no matter what.

19832.nameId: Title Scroll: Hero of the Decade
19832.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Hero of the Decade".

19833.descriptionId: As long as you're wearing this ring on your finger, Sweetapir will follow you everywhere. If you take it off, Sweetapir will still follow you, because the little creature loves you no matter what.

19834.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Dungeon Scourge".

19835.descriptionId: It might not save your life, but it will spare you a few bruises. It's the next best thing.

19836.nameId: Title Scroll: Climber of the Decade
19836.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Climber of the Decade".

19837.descriptionId: It might not save your life, but it will spare you a few bruises. It's the next best thing.

19838.nameId: Title Scroll: Mountaineer of the Decade
19838.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Mountaineer of the Decade".

19839.descriptionId: It might not save your life, but it will spare you a few bruises. It's the next best thing.

19840.nameId: Title Scroll: Pioneer of the Decade
19840.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Pioneer of the Decade".

19841.descriptionId: It might not save your life, but it will spare you a few bruises. It's the next best thing.

19842.nameId: Title Scroll: Muse of the Decade
19842.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Muse of the Decade".

19843.descriptionId: Use this potion to teleport to the Astrub Zaap cheaply and safely.

19844.descriptionId: You have to introduce Noi and the Bellaphones to Adviser Arky.

19845.descriptionId: This sidekick has been entrusted to you. Care for it, love it, and it will love you back many times over.

19846.descriptionId: This letter, scrawled by Adviser Arky, is for Maddy Plomatic. You have to bring it to her as soon as possible.

19847.descriptionId: This sidekick has been entrusted to you. Care for it, love it, and it will love you back many times over.

19848.descriptionId: This small piece of ochre shell has a soft bronze glow. It doesn't seem to contain any power, but it may be valuable to the right people.

19849.descriptionId: This sidekick has been entrusted to you. Care for it, love it, and it will love you back many times over.

19850.descriptionId: [!] Danger devant la tour d'Astrub (empeche d entrer dans la tour)

19851.descriptionId: This sidekick has been entrusted to you. Care for it, love it, and it will love you back many times over.

19852.descriptionId: [!] Vous avez vaincu les miliciens, vous pouvez entrer chez Archie

19853.descriptionId:
This shield won't protect you from ridicule.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19854.descriptionId: [!] a battu les mercemers sur le bateau vers la source

19855.descriptionId:
A very practical item of headgear to make sure everyone can see your fantastic follicles... or lack thereof. As you may have guessed, this hat is for exhibitionists and adventurers with no inhibitions.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19856.descriptionId:
Everything can change in an instant... Your face, for example, blue from the freezing cold, can get its normal colour back as soon as you put on this magnificent hood. Your frozen ears, however... just shattered on the floor and cannot be restored.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19857.descriptionId:
A cape specially designed for those who like to hide their cape? Now you've seen it all... or at least you would have, if you could see it...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19858.descriptionId:
To survive, some creatures have learned to blend in with their sworn enemies, or at least with their predators. What about you? Do you think the cold is your worst enemy... or your opponents'?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19859.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Strength.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Strength.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Strength is below 25.

19860.descriptionId:
If it were up to you, snow would never stop falling. It's so pretty! Well, guess what: this shield will endlessly delight you! Just avoid walking on ice, or else your legs will start to buckler...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19861.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Chance.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Chance.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Chance is below 25.

19862.descriptionId:
That unique look in its eyes, as if it's quietly judging you, comes from the day that Bearbacial began to notice its ice floe melting year after year. They say it's been petrified ever since. And that its tender heart melted as well...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19863.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Intelligence.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Intelligence.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Intelligence is below 25.

19865.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to gain Agility.)
Use this scroll to safely and permanently increase your Agility.
Be careful though, as you can only use it if your Agility is below 25.

19866.descriptionId: This key seems sturdy yet immaterial. It exudes runic magic.

19867.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19868.descriptionId:
Abominaplushie was once a Sram who elevated murder to a vocation. That was before he used black magic to transfer his soul into the body of an innocent stuffed toy to escape from the Bonta militia... He went on killing for a few years until he realised that his victims were putting him through just as much hell.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19869.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19870.descriptionId: saw Kaenn again after the Satays' Island quests

19871.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19873.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19875.descriptionId: Unlike your usual tofu eggs, these fresh eggs smell really good. But don't get used to it, because it'll only last for an hour, tops. That's why Harvey Caflip has asked you to kindly snatch these eggs from the nearby tofus. Nothing beats fresh eggs for AFT Nuggets.

19877.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Island Breeze".

19879.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19881.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19883.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

19885.descriptionId:
With this headgear, you can really stand out from the crowd – even a crowd of adventurers queuing at the entrance to a Zaap on server opening day.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19887.descriptionId:
It takes considerable brains to promote peace instead of war. Talok used this headgear to protect his grey matter so he could handle the Crocodyls in the best way possible.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19889.descriptionId:
Wear this headgear with the dignity of a samurai and the experience of a Pandawa general: Tiliwan.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19891.descriptionId:
Espilon has personally verified that this headgear is always trendy, in every era.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19893.descriptionId:
Your poise is matched only by your pioneering spirit. Both are dazzling, even from behind.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19895.descriptionId:
Hand-sewn from fabrics, gilding and gems in the purest Paztek tradition, every door of Ascension Island will open to you when you wear this cloak. Well, if you can defeat the monsters guarding them, of course.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19897.descriptionId:
Pandawa tradition and aesthetics combine in this embroidered cloak, in which every little decoration honours the Akwadala army.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19899.descriptionId:
The beauty of this cloak is undeniable, but beware of Iops. Some of them might run into your back thinking that they're using a Zaap!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19901.descriptionId:
Because it commands respect, this shield protects you from angry comments. But not from envious glances.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19903.descriptionId:
Paztek art in all its glory. Your ascension can begin!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19905.descriptionId:
The entire Bushido code of honour seems to emanate from this shield, which fully covers the fighter's arm like tiles protecting the rain temple.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19907.descriptionId:
As well as giving you a mysterious aura, this shield can also be used as a night light.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19909.descriptionId:
Small of stature and cute, but stout of heart and dangerous, Notaurius is known as one of the most appealing all-in-one pets.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

19911.descriptionId:
Elefurious will take your breath away and simply take you places. Having said that, make no mistake: when it charges, it's pure chaos!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19913.descriptionId:
Besides following you across the world, MD-12 will be happy to carry the weight of the world on its shoulders so you don't have to. Pretty useful, right?

(This legendary pet does not need to eat.)

19915.descriptionId: An essential accessory for travelling around the World of Twelve, this backpack will also help you take only the essentials.

19917.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "First Explorer".

19919.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "New World Builder".

19921.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Veni, Vidi, Vici".

19923.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "First!"

19925.descriptionId: Activate this magic stone to instantly earn 5,000 goultines. Just like that. No effort required.

19927.descriptionId:
This coin purse is very heavy – it must be worth a veritable fortune. 

(Double-tap to get the kamas.)

19929.descriptionId: This box contains a few badges which you can use to take on Lair Guardians.

19931.descriptionId:
A shield recovered among the dead creatures from the invasion. It seems to have come from far away...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19933.descriptionId:
This pet continuously records its owner's voice. Oftentimes it'll start repeating a phrase, but always something that was said a few hours before. For example: 
"Sweet, I got a Dofus!"
"Sweet, I got a Dofus!"
"Sweet, I got a Dofus!"
People soon realize they don't want the pet anymore, as it brings back painful memories.

19935.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Architect of Destruction".

19937.descriptionId:
No barrier has ever protected you as effectively as this shield, not even the language barrier.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19939.descriptionId: Weighing at least 20 kilo-pods, this shell is used for muscle strengthening during Master Tor Toise's training sessions.

19941.descriptionId: The two rubies set into this ring represent the gaze of the goddess Inali. Minuscule flames dance in the gems. Could the spirit of a real Kitsou live within this ring?... It's probably just a reflection of your own greed.

19943.descriptionId: Each people has its own warrior caste, and the yokai are no exception with the onirakam. Truly vengeful demons, they collect the armour taken from the samurai they massacre. Despite its age, this reinforced belt will protect your delicate hips just as effectively as it did the very first day.

19945.descriptionId: It took many tries to obtain this piece of armour able to protect its wearer's flanks while still allowing for optimal mobility.

19947.descriptionId: In addition to giving you an elegant eastern style, these geta will let you walk through ectoplasm without staining the rest of your outfit. If you're cold, you can also wear these sandals with socks. It's probably the only time you can wear socks with sandals and not look absolutely ridiculous.

19949.descriptionId: Don these boots and your legs will feel lighter and you'll move around more discretely, giving off clouds of mist with every step. With a bit of practice, you too might inherit the nickname "mist rider".

19951.descriptionId: Despite the persistent smell of putrefaction coming from this bag, it was designed to be kept for many a long year. With it, you'll have a friend to talk to whenever you're feeling lonely.

19953.descriptionId: It is often said that the Kaonashi are the spirits of Twelvians who died in complete obscurity, which would explain their lack of a face. Obviously, this is patently false, but nothing is stopping you from wearing this mask and masquerading as one of your slightly naive friends' late great-great grandfather.

19957.descriptionId: You can use this ring to puncture the Gobbowl Ball when you want to quietly enjoy a break in play.

19959.descriptionId: You can use this ring to puncture the Gobbowl ball when you want to quietly enjoy a break in play.

19961.descriptionId: [!] Cette bague permet d'éventrer la Boufballe lorsque vous voulez discrètement profiter d'un arrêt de jeu.

19963.descriptionId: [!] Cette bague permet d'éventrer la Boufballe lorsque vous voulez discrètement profiter d'un arrêt de jeu.

19965.descriptionId: [!] Cette bague permet d'éventrer la Boufballe lorsque vous voulez discrètement profiter d'un arrêt de jeu.

19967.descriptionId: [!] Cette bague permet d'éventrer la Boufballe lorsque vous voulez discrètement profiter d'un arrêt de jeu.

19969.descriptionId:
More than just headwear, it's a pass in the Slayspirit clan.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19971.descriptionId:
Walk backwards and imitate a yokai howl; the illusion will be stunning (unless you trip over yourself).

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19973.descriptionId:
This shield will protect you from many attacks, but not from the reaper's fatal blow (might as well warn you).

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19975.descriptionId:
After defeating that dungeon hands down, it's the perfect time for a quick trip to the inn to have a bite and show off a new shield.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19977.descriptionId:
This petsmount will take you everywhere except Externam (not that he doesn't want to). Cross his heart and hope to die!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

19979.descriptionId:
They say the onirakam can cause disasters with its fists. They say the onirakam became evil incarnate with its horns. 

It'll soon come back for this one.

19981.descriptionId:
"You're gorgeous, but your fringe is too long." 

Yukisamara frequently got this kind of comment. So, to prove her love, she pulled up her locks to show the man she loved her gorgeous eyes. He died instantly. His blood had frozen.

19983.descriptionId: These eyes make you feel strangely uneasy. They remind of your bow meow's at night... Makes you wonder if your bow meow could be a kaeneko. What if you somehow never knew?

19985.descriptionId: The kaonashi always seems sad and tormented, and you'll hear it crying through the bamboo trees. This is how it lures altruistic people in order to eat them.

19987.descriptionId:
Soulless maduras shrink down to the size of pebbles. Some use them as lucky charms. They draw in one of their pupils with ink and make a wish in their head, keeping the mini madura nearby until their wish comes true. Then and only then, they draw in the second pupil.

They never draw on it again.

19989.descriptionId: According to a certain calligrapher, this fire is the epitome of perfection. Being surrounded by it completely protects one from external harm.

19991.descriptionId: This pearl grants power to Katamashii. No one knows how many she has, but if she loses all her pearls, it's likely her flames will go out and her powers will fade.

19993.descriptionId: This residue is a mix of fur, hair and fabric from yokai, as well as from Pandalan spirits on the astral plane. A nice souvenir of your trip to Nolifis Island.

19995.descriptionId: [!] Cette bague permet d'éventrer la Boufballe lorsque vous voulez discrètement profiter d'un arrêt de jeu.

19997.descriptionId: This essence contains a part of the immense power of a dungeon keeper: the pick of the litter of monsters in the World of Twelve. Now you just have to find a use befitting such power.

19999.descriptionId: The Kushadokuro has begun to consume your soul. It's outside of your body now – do whatever it takes to stop him absorbing you.

20001.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

20003.descriptionId: This bark comes from the corpse of a short-tempered dark treechnee.

20005.descriptionId: [!] Donné les oignons à Nénuphar Intrépide - quêtes de grobe

20007.descriptionId: [!] Donné l'oeil de Kaeneko à Nénuphar timide - quêtes de grobe

20009.descriptionId: [!] Donné le shaké à Nénuphar alcoolique - quêtes de grobe

20011.descriptionId: [!] Donné le bois de bambou doré à Nénuphar vénal - quêtes de grobe

20013.descriptionId: [!] Donné les larmes de Kaonashi à Nénuphar alcoolique - quêtes de grobe

20015.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

20017.descriptionId: A Pandalan panji is written on this fragile scroll.

20019.descriptionId: You blindfolded these poor kitsous. Now unable to get their bearings except through smell, they've begun to follow you on their own.

20029.descriptionId: Held Jizonawa's hand in the Nolifis quests.

20031.descriptionId: The Dofus belonging to the dragon Imagirorukam. Its powers are yet to be fully awakened, as the egg is still in an immaterial state.

20033.descriptionId: You held Jizonawa's hand to walk around with him.

20035.descriptionId: This bottle contains the spirit of Fu Zawa, which you sealed away using your calligraphy skills.

20037.descriptionId: An empty bottle found in the ruins of Nolifis Island.

20039.descriptionId: You trapped a Pandalan spirit in this bottle. The bottle will allow this spirit to return home.

20041.descriptionId:
With great power comes a great hood, so put it to good use.

(Place this headgear over other, already-equipped headgear to change its appearance.)

20043.descriptionId:
Being a hero also means carrying the weight of the world – and of your mistakes – on your shoulders. In your case, there's really not much point in adding a cape, but at least it should bring you some comfort on this difficult path of yours.

(Place these shoulder pads over an already-equipped cape to change their appearance.)

20045.nameId: [!] A mis un dofus dans le réceptacle encre

20047.descriptionId:
This bandana is practical for concealing greasy, scruffy hair, and it will give you a rebellious look. A bit like a sea pirate, but without being an actual pirate. Okay, so you'll look like a holidaymaker, and that's all!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20049.descriptionId:
When shaken energetically at your opponents, this cloak will shower them with grains of sand, instantly blinding them. Just don't forget to run away afterwards (giggling all the way)!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)
