20051.descriptionId:
Does work keep washing over you relentlessly? To get your head above water, you sometimes have to put it under first! Just have a good swim, and your worries will float away!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20053.descriptionId:
There are highs, lows, jolts, laughing and crying... But you'll always have lasting memories of the time you spent wearing this cloak.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20055.descriptionId:
This petsmount is a real airhead. Some people claim it's even full of hot air. But what do you care what they think? If you run into trouble, it'll keep you afloat no matter what!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20057.descriptionId:
What's it doing here...?

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20059.nameId: Title Scroll: Legend of Terra Cogita
20059.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Terra Cogita".

20061.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Oshimo".

20063.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Herdegrize".

20065.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Grandapan".

20067.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Brutas".

20069.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Legend of Dodge".

20071.nameId: Title Scroll: Manager of the Old World
20071.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Manager of the Old World".

20073.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20075.descriptionId:
With its innovative filtration system, this headgear will make the air around you as pure as that of Aerdala. An invaluable item if you use the loo right after a Bwork.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20077.descriptionId:
This cloak is fitted with a laughing-gas tank to help you make light of things. Even the collapse of society... Ha ha ha! What a laugh!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20079.descriptionId:
Forged from a metal resistant to both weathering and stabbing, this shield will fully protect your right arm in even the fiercest of battles. As for your left arm, you'll have to cross your fingers...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20081.descriptionId:
The good news: the World of Twelve could blow up, and this chaos-proof petsmount would still be standing. On the other hand, you won't... but hey, you can't have it all!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20083.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Breaker of Dreams".

20085.descriptionId: You blindfolded these poor kitsous. Now unable to get their bearings except through smell, they've begun to follow you on their own.

20087.descriptionId: You blindfolded these poor kitsous. Now unable to get their bearings except through smell, they've begun to follow you on their own.

20089.descriptionId: You blindfolded these poor kitsous. Now unable to get their bearings except through smell, they've begun to follow you on their own.

20091.descriptionId: Use this ticket to participate in various activities at the Trool Fair.

20093.descriptionId: Give him a tasty bone, and Failip will follow you to the ends of the earth.

20095.descriptionId:
(Double-tap)
Use this scroll to meet all the requirements for starting the Nolifis Island quests.

20097.nameId: [!] A mis les bouteilles avec lanternes dans la rivière

20099.descriptionId:
We don't always know how much the past has helped us. But we know even less of what the future has in store.
Whatever the case may be, this one looks bright.

20105.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Music Superfan".

20107.descriptionId: [!] 1 victoire au jeu du Pile ou Face

20109.descriptionId: 2 wins in the Heads or Tails game.

20111.descriptionId: 3 wins in the Heads or Tails game.

20113.descriptionId:
If you bring this figurine to Fredo Krevin at the Trool Fair, you'll add it to your Krosllection.
You can also trade in your duplicate figurines at the fair.

20115.descriptionId:
This shield saved a Stubbyob prince's life when he faced an albino Bwork. It may save yours when you face your in-laws.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20117.descriptionId:
When wet, this shield tends to become a little salami. And you may find that carrying it makes you rather ham-fisted.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20119.descriptionId:
Some Wabbits say that the Wa starved his subjects, going so far as to pull cawwots right from the mouths of hungry Tiwabbits. One day, the unhappy citizens rebelled and took up arms. This shield now symbolises their revolution. Of course, they hadn't realised just how cruel His Majesty Barf I could be, and the revolutionaries all ended up in a stew.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20121.descriptionId:
With its strong smell of black pudding pizza, this shield is your VIP pass to skulking around Sphincter Cell's lair without drawing attention to yourself. Sometimes, smelling a rat is a very good thing indeed.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20123.descriptionId:
Koolich Aid is a symbol for those who rebel against parental authority, homework, tidying their bedrooms, being grounded, and for some young adventurers on a quest of self discovery, even the law. Yet if you ask them directly why they carry it, they'll tell you it's only for emotional support purposes. Guess you'll just have to try it for yourself.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20125.descriptionId:
The tusks attached to this shield are unstable and can't be used offensively. At the very least, we can say they're a (slight) deterrent.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20293.descriptionId:
Ever since a certain charming entity latched onto you, you've had a new sense of compassion for your fellow Twelvians. Sometimes you're even overcome by a wave of maternal instinct... Could you have been touched by the grace of the Great Goddess herself?

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20295.descriptionId:
Born of the breath of the Great Dragon, this creature is as cold as the yawning void between worlds. But don't be fooled: its fire burns with surprising intensity, especially when a manifestation of the Goddess is nearby...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20297.descriptionId:
In the old days, it was quite fashionable for gods to set a glowing aura upon their brow when appearing to their faithful followers. Though that tradition has more or less gone by the wayside, you've decided to bring it back with a modern twist by wearing this impressive halo. Best of all, the mortals lucky enough to cross your path will immediately know they're dealing with a higher being... Yes, much like the Krosmoz itself, your megalomania continues to expand without limits.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20299.descriptionId:
Some people struggle to carry the world on their shoulders. But you've got the entire universe on yours... It's enough to make your head spin!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20301.descriptionId:
Gazing upon the immensity of the Krosmoz may give you wings, but you should keep your feet firmly on the World of Twelve. Alas, you're not a celestial bird – if you were catapulted into the eternighty, you'd float for all eternity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20317.descriptionId:
Among the various celestial birds that inhabit the Krosmoz, the Eagles are distinguished by their wisdom. They are also a uniquely versatile group, known for being scholarly and pragmatic, with deep experience in the arts of war. In light of all that, it's quite natural that some of them would take on the role of mentor in Incarnam.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20319.descriptionId:
It's said that this cape was created by Master Attwerk himself. Not all newly incarnated souls are fated to become warriors... Those more inclined to the crafting professions can count on a Celestial Eagle to guide them.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20321.descriptionId:
Master Ganymede's words echo in your mind as you look upon this shield. "Will you be the new guardian of the Dofus? Only time will tell."

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20323.descriptionId:
We'd normally tell you to look at the dragoon's colour for an idea of what it's capable of, but in this case, just listen to your heart.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20325.descriptionId:
A tabi is a bit like a tofu, only much larger, woolly, and with teeth. So in other words, not that much like a tofu.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20411.descriptionId:
Pure magic, to the tips of your hair. Assuming you're lucky enough to have kept yours.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20445.descriptionId:
Tired of bending every which way for your bow meow? Is it never satisfied, no matter how many gudgeons and mimice you give it? With an origami version of it, you won't have to worry about that any more.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20447.descriptionId:
Drhellbert has an innate talent for finding his way, especially in Enurado, where he knows the scents like the back of his paw! He's the best companion there is to help you weave your way among the god Enutrof's piles of gold.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20449.descriptionId:
They say Bump used to dream of being able to jump so high he'd encounter dragons. But they also say that if you jump on Bump's head while he's wearing this helmet, you'll be able jump extra high. 
Looking at those blades sticking out the top, though, you just have to wonder who was stupid enough to come up with an idea like that.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20451.descriptionId:
Highly appreciated by fans of investigations, puzzles and other disciplines that lead to headaches, this headgear has its own mystery, which has not been solved to this day: why do those who wear it grow a magnificent moustache when they equip it? The most accepted theory (but not necessarily the most correct one) is that no one can solve an investigation without a big moustache.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20453.descriptionId:
Who said that the Enutrofs were feeble old relics from a forgotten time? This hat is proof that they can be formidable opponents and ahead of their time. Nothing to do with haemorrhoids, mind.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20455.descriptionId:
Slayspirits use these headbands to stop their vision and develop their other senses. This lets them more easily detect the ghosts they've sworn to fight. It'll mainly prevent you from seeing the ugly mugs of your companions, however.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20457.descriptionId:
Fashion trends come and go. So why not go all the way back to the source: nature. With the ever-present concern for the environment, you can choose to use this 100% natural shield. Just don't set it too close to your fireplace in the winter...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20459.descriptionId:
In this festive season, there's nothing like an afternoon of crafting after a morning in a Kwismas dungeon. What a surprising combination of branches and balls – you've really outdone yourself this time!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20461.descriptionId:
You won't succeed in impersonating a Merkator Foggernaut just by holding this shield. But it should be enough to protect you from your enemies' attacks.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20463.descriptionId:
Now you can be crowned the ruler of glacial winds and snowy plains! This headgear is worn slightly tilted to give your majesty an air of mystery.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20465.descriptionId:
When this train leaves a trail in the snow, your enemies will turn tail.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20467.descriptionId:
With your grandeur, any old shield won't do – you need something that fittingly shines to adorn your hat.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20469.descriptionId:
Any layabout can laze about in the summer... But riding around on a giant gecko in the winter? That's for royalty!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20471.descriptionId:
Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20473.descriptionId: An instrument used by polters to easily find each other.

20475.descriptionId: A Sadida doll that looks exactly like a polter. With its ability to move, it's easy to confuse it with the real thing.

20481.descriptionId:
This cowl was made by the polter tailor Punchy Nello. He supposedly crafted it as a show of gratitude to someone who had acted as a "guardian".

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20483.descriptionId:
According to Punchy Nello, this pelt protects the wearer from black magic. It's surely worth taking if you venture into the Evil Forest.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20485.descriptionId:
The leaves of this cloak were enchanted by polters. These enchantments are a good-luck charm for the adventurer wearing it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20487.descriptionId:
This polter was unusually tall from a young age. No one knows his birth name, as the village polters fittingly dubbed him Extra Pol.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20489.descriptionId:
This little polter will follow along in your travels on a quest for inspiration. As a budding poet, he believes going on an adventure will inspire him to write the most beautiful poems in the World of Twelve.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20491.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the special Polter Sceptre emote.

20503.descriptionId:
A distinctive feature of the Pumpkwin is that it prevents the dispersion of magic particles, making it a good magic insulator. That's why some warriors use this vegetable as headgear.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20521.descriptionId: You've been transformed into an Osamodas woman to "make Hell Mina happy". You cast doubt on Vinanna's claim, but apparently that's better than being a man...

20539.descriptionId:
If you bring this figurine to Fredo Krevin at the Trool Fair, you'll add it to your Krosllection.
You can also trade in your duplicate figurines at the fair.

20541.descriptionId: This well-made cape will make you look triumphant during battle – the perfect accessory to accompany the burning determination contained in each of your blows.

20543.descriptionId: Slip this ring on your finger to feel Hell Mina's burning fury. Just imagine what it'd feel like to don the full set!

20545.descriptionId: A simple belt bearing an evocative message: "Don't get too close, or I'll skewer you."

20547.descriptionId:
This ring is imbued with the power of malters, dark creatures capable of melting into the omnipresent obscurity of the Evil Forest. Unfortunately for you, its stealth power doesn't work on Twelvians.
As a side note, there's a rumour that a certain gobbowl player on the Bonta Blues team once tried to sneak into the women's locker room wearing this ring. When he came out, the black and blue bruises covering his face clashed horribly with the blue of his jersey.

20549.descriptionId: These boots give off the faint sound of rustling through dry leaves with every step you take, making every stroll a relaxing jaunt.

20551.descriptionId: This talisman is devoid of all magic now, but it still smells of petrichor, which has a calming effect on you.

20553.descriptionId: This item allows you to enter Dark Vlad's Domain.

20555.descriptionId: You were trapped in the Lair of the Rac Queen, and now you're a little arachnee. She probably wanted to prove her greatness to you.

20557.descriptionId:
In addition to being truly elegant, this headgear will let you clean all the nooks and crannies of your ears (and that's no small feat!). Truly the perfect hat.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20559.descriptionId:
This cape evokes prestige. No, make that charm. Oh, wait... Maybe splendour is more like it. What do you think? Class? Ah! Distinction! NO! Better yet: charisma! Or even... Never mind, let's not argue. It's simply killer!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20561.descriptionId:
Don't underestimate the value of this shield – even with all the right cards in your hand, no game is a guaranteed win.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20563.descriptionId:
Sick and tired of being patted by Enutrof grannies who found him "cute", this pet had a set of dragon teeth added. But now they just want to "eat him right up" more than ever.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20565.descriptionId:
One day you're cutting wheat, the next day you're cruising around on dragonback. Things sure can change fast in the World of Twelve...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20567.descriptionId:
"You're gorgeous, but your fringe is too long." 

Yukisamara frequently got this kind of comment. So, to prove her love, she pulled up her locks to show the man she loved her gorgeous eyes. He died instantly. His blood had frozen.

20569.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Fudahana ornament.

20571.descriptionId:
Despite its scary appearance, the Huntsarachnee is quite gentle. Its leaves flutter if you stroke it in the right place! However, if you watch it sleeping at night, you might start to wonder if it really is as benign as it appears. Its leaves shrink oddly, like they are starting to rot. And the next day, everything is back to normal, like nothing happened.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20573.descriptionId:
This Huntsarachnee fell victim to its own cursed venom. Defects in its immune system condemned it to becoming a walking nightmare. It is rotting, little by little, and the stone on its head has turned purple. It often quivers, like it's about to mutate...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20575.descriptionId:
The Goliath Huntsarachnee is the mutated form of the Cursed Huntsarachnee. It's a monster on legs whose eyes have turned piercing. And not just its eyes... Watch out when you mount it, because your clothing is likely to get torn to shreds from the brambles constantly growing and writhing on its back.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20577.descriptionId:
Don't be fooled by her small size... be afraid of it! Her quiet character is matched only by the danger she represents. A single drop of her venom will leave you sick in bed for weeks. So be careful when brushing her mouthparts if you hope to stay up and about.

(Place this pet over another, already-equipped pet to change its appearance.)

20579.descriptionId: This medallion, which you received for a victorious Raid, can be exchanged for something valuable at the Guild of Hunters at [-23,-14].

20581.descriptionId:
This mask was made by malters under Hell Mina's command. Apparently, Hell Mina intended to give it to Dark Vlad as a gift. But in the end, he simply couldn't accept it. His hair would have immediately burnt it to a crisp.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20587.descriptionId:
There's only one way to wear it: tilted rakishly at an angle. This gives you an air of mystery... and the evil eye!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20589.descriptionId:
When you walk into a room, those who are lucky enough to have pulled get their coat too. If it suits you, you always return the coats you don't need... Then, you're off again, into the night. All that's left in your wake are the total losers... inspiring nothing but pity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20591.descriptionId:
Anyone who has a bone to pick with you will forget what they wanted when they come face to face with this shield. What were they talking about again?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20593.descriptionId:
Your new number two has a head for business. In fact, they look after yours very well. And if anyone asks too many questions, they lower their shades... Nobody can resist those charmer's eyes.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20595.nameId: [!] A mis un dofus dans le réceptacle papier

20597.descriptionId: Oshimo has given you his blessing.

20599.descriptionId: Brutas has given you his blessing.

20601.descriptionId: Dodge has given you his blessing.

20603.descriptionId: Herdegrize has given you his blessing.

20605.descriptionId: Grandapan has given you his blessing.

20607.descriptionId: Terra Cogita has given you his blessing.

20619.descriptionId: It will keep warm you during the long winter nights, and let you to organise barbecues in the summer. In any case, avoid going too close to haystacks or bundles of kindling with it; otherwise, you could be mistaken for a dangerous arsonist.

20689.descriptionId:
"For the love of a rose, the gardener becomes the slave of a thousand thorns."

— Rosal

20691.descriptionId: Escort Amphibubblette to her sweetheart! To help you find him, Amphibubblette has mimicked a fountain with her water jets.

20693.descriptionId: Escort Scorcheroo to his sweetheart! To help you find her, Scorcheroo has jumped over a puddle of water a few times.

20695.descriptionId: Escort Sweetapir to his sweetheart! To help you find her, Sweetapir has drawn an axe on the ground with his trunk.

20697.descriptionId: Escort Gustifulette to her sweetheart! To help you find him, Gustifulette has tried to recreate a house and a pond in the ground.

20699.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly travel to the Amakna Castle Secret Laboratory. The Secret Laboratory must be open in order for this potion to be usable.

20701.descriptionId:
When you wear the Nachombrero, all eyes will be on you and everyone will follow you without question. Why, you ask? For the rakish charm it gives you? Oh no... For the delicious smell and the tasty morsels that fall to the ground as you walk!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20703.descriptionId:
You've wound up with this cape but have no idea where it came from. 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20705.descriptionId:
This helmet is really tough. It seems to have led a full life, yet it's more or less completely intact. No matter how carefully you inspect it, you have no idea of its origin.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20707.descriptionId: You found this mysterious page during a monster invasion. What might it be hiding...?

20719.nameId: [!] A interagi avec la dragodinde squelette - Guilde des Chasseurs
20719.descriptionId: [!] Permet d'avoir accès à l'archive top secrète

20725.descriptionId: The strange monster you defeated was carrying this letter... What do you suppose it says?

20727.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Glacial Predator".

20731.descriptionId: You feel strong as soon as you take your first sip. For now...

20733.descriptionId: You are powerful but mentally unstable.

20735.descriptionId:
With this thick hood on your head, you definitely won't catch cold. Just make sure you don't get caught by the Count's servants, as that'll probably be a lot harder to recover from.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20737.descriptionId:
When you live in Frigost, it's best to dress for the weather. This comfortable Mastogob-hair cape will be your strongest ally against the island's icy winds.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20739.descriptionId:
If you're ever caught in a snowstorm, hold this shield in front of your face. It will keep the snow and wind out of your eyes, and even light the path ahead of you. It doesn't tell time, however.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20741.descriptionId: The thick block of ice around this piwi protects it from the wintery cold of Frigost.

20743.descriptionId: Few creatures can boast as many surprising qualities as the permafrosty gobball. Did you know, for example, that it withstands high temperatures but can't handle the cold? Even more surprising is that when skies are clear, it sometimes hums little ditties about sailors. It has more quirks than can be counted, and as an adventuring companion, it can sometimes be hard to figure out. Nevertheless, it's a faithful steed and its cool coat makes it a very delightful ally in the Ohwymi desert.

20745.descriptionId:
This dazzling mask could make you a beacon in the night, or a destroyer of worlds.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20747.descriptionId:
This cape seems to be made not of cloth, but of the very fabric from which the dimensions are woven.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20749.descriptionId:
This mysterious portal seems to be connected to another dimension. While it's very handy for causing any projectiles fired your way to disappear without a trace, be careful not to step on it by mistake – no one knows where it leads...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20751.descriptionId:
This machine in the form of an owl seems to be linked to the power of the Eliacube, unless it's the Eliacube itself...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20753.descriptionId:
This machine in the form of a coolwolf seems to be linked to the power of the Eliacube, unless it's the Eliacube itself...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20755.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Temporal Aura emote.

20757.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Eliacube Aura emote.

20759.descriptionId: Stubbyobs are formidable sprinters over short distances.

20773.descriptionId: An old, dusty coin – maybe someone could use it?

20837.descriptionId: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

20839.descriptionId: You saved this myxomassive from the horrible creatures in the Dark Jungle! Hurry up and take it to Oshimo!

20841.descriptionId:
This helmet was forged decades or maybe even centuries ago in the depths of the Undersmithy. Wear it at your own risk, as the lava is obviously still hot... But you'll be sure to withstand the bitter cold of Frigost when you wear it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20843.descriptionId:
This shield was crafted decades or maybe even centuries ago in the depths of the Undersmithy. It might be really sturdy, but this shield has the nasty habit of leaking. The lava, which never solidifies, might fall on your feet and melt the leather of your boots, along with your toes... But it also has strong offensive capabilities, if you know how to turn this flaw to your advantage!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20845.descriptionId:
This cloak was crafted decades or maybe even centuries ago in the depths of the Undersmithy. You can see the lava inside constantly moving, as if it were alive...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20849.descriptionId:
The snooflerno is a cousin of the snoofle. It's a cousin that loves the heat and, like any good snoofle, kamas! But the snooflerno prides itself on being a true artist at heart. It can melt kamas and will then use the molten gold to seal letters, sinking its trunk into the softened metal. If you see the outline of two nostrils on a letter stamp, you'll know that a snooflerno made it!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20853.descriptionId:
A creature entrusted with protecting the magmatic rivers and fiery lakes in the depths of the earth. When a wagylava slithers along the ground to move, it carves out courses for rivers of lava.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20855.descriptionId: You saved this falcombustion from the poachers in the Orado Bayou! Hurry up and take it to Oshimo!

20857.descriptionId: You saved this wilderlily from the fisheralaks' fishing rods! Hurry up and take it to Oshimo!

20859.descriptionId: You saved this mysticorn from the dark rumours in Frigost Village! Hurry up and take it to Oshimo!

20861.descriptionId: You saved this yellobolder from the poachers who were after its bell! Hurry up and take it to Oshimo!

20863.descriptionId:
Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20865.descriptionId:
Deep within the earth, this drheller – amalgamated with a rare stone called bismuth – drills prolifically. With its keen sense of direction, it easily finds its way around the mazelike cuttings, which may well be an invaluable skill when navigating a labyrinth, but one that pales in comparison to its kindness.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20867.descriptionId:
A Boon just for you?! Who would've thought this fluffy companion could ever be yours? This four-legged stuffed toy is adorable from every angle, but it's also a huge ally. During the day, it'll disorientate your enemies, gaining their sympathy with but a look; at night, it'll comfort you after a long day, letting you nuzzle against its soft fur.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20959.descriptionId:
The downside of having nine lives is that you have to go through early childhood every time you're reincarnated. This Kerubaby may seem a bit grumpy at times, but try to understand – this is the ninth time he's tried to stop using his dummy, and he still can't do it!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20961.descriptionId:
Among some ancestral tribes, wearing a deceased pet's bones on your head is a common practice to protect you from evil spells. It also saves you from having to dig a hole. Well, when you just can't be bothered...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20963.descriptionId:
Fallen demigod, shamanic sorcerer or iconic winged creature – this cloak will cast doubt on which category you're in. But what if you decided to be all three at once? Niiiice...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20965.descriptionId:
This shield with a glyph on top provides optimal protection. It repels enemies and ensures that loved ones will return. It unbewitches your set, accelerates hair growth, resolves family, marital and neighbourhood problems, makes it easier to peel cawwots, and makes Iops smart. Basically, it cures all ills – even Eniripsa's!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20967.descriptionId:
It's so obvious that you simply can't have missed it – this petsmount can communicate with the afterlife. It can also see into the future, so it can save you a lot of trouble. It just goes to show that even if you look like a bird of ill omen, you can still be a gift from the gods!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20969.descriptionId:
As the prince or princess of dreamers, you deserve a cloak that symbolises your greatness every bit as much as your dreams of escape. It's a resounding success, don't you think?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20971.descriptionId:
Once your head is in this cloud of purplish wool, you'll be in the land of dreams! You may be seen as the black gobball in your group, but the mystery surrounding you will attract fewer enemies than it will envious onlookers.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20973.descriptionId:
This dream shield perfectly encapsulates your situation as a shepherd of dreams. Between reality and illusion, outside of time and space, the boundaries are blurred, and your potential in this role is limitless.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20975.descriptionId:
Like a strange idea taken straight out of a dream, Somnambump is always floating around somewhere nearby and can reappear at any time of day. Don't bother counting how many times it happens! You might fall asleep...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20977.descriptionId:
Have you seen this dream creature? Err, it's no chimera! Ride it, and all your dreams of escape will come true! In your deepest sleep, at least...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20979.descriptionId:
This pack comes with clear instructions. "Warning: keep your hands away from the fastener, as it has a tight grip." 

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20981.descriptionId:
This shield is nothing less than a reflection of your soul. So, you'll know who to blame if you think it's a bit too fragile for your liking.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20983.descriptionId:
Boundless tenderness hides beneath this little creature's hard mask. Adopting one is sure to bring a healthy dose of love into your life, be it on your shoulder or in your hood.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

20985.descriptionId: This fat purse of kamas should ensure that you eat very well today.

20989.descriptionId: My last breath will be your second.

20993.descriptionId: It's never too late to wake up.

20995.descriptionId: Making a grand entrance is important.

20997.descriptionId: A quick glance into the distance.

20999.descriptionId: Better a cautious approach than a hasty getaway.

21001.descriptionId: Ignite your life before it burns you out.

21003.descriptionId: After this time, there won't be another.

21005.descriptionId: Move forward, no matter what it takes.

21007.descriptionId: One more time – we're gonna celebrate.

21009.descriptionId: Everyone loves surprises, except in combat.

21011.descriptionId: Let the excitement of battle wash over you.

21017.descriptionId:
Say goodbye to flat and lifeless hair, because this visor will protect you from the sun's blinding rays while letting your stunning wild mane flow freely!

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21019.descriptionId:
This bag gives you a clear advantage by making sure you'll always have an eye on what's going on behind your back.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21021.descriptionId:
This is the first shield that defends and attacks at the same time. It's perfect for making your opponent lose their composure, and even more so if you're dealing with someone who's sensitive to the adorable purring sounds it makes between two well-placed scratches!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21023.descriptionId:
Why settle for one pet when you can have three? Three times the support with three times the love. Well, three times the poo and hair to pick up too... Hey! You wanted them, after all!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21025.descriptionId: Originally synonymous with culinary failure, this dish is given when it becomes apparent that an error has been made, regardless of its origin.

21027.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Gobbstock Grandstander".

This headgear, crafted from ultra-resistant futuristic materials, might just save your life if invaders unleash acid rain or some other kind of chemical attack. That should make you feel better!	

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21085.descriptionId:
Designed using innovative fabric and advanced crafting techniques, this cloak stands out from the rest for its optimal performance in terms of breathability, durability, mobility and impermeability. Try it – you'll love it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21087.descriptionId: This book appears to be magic. Very strange.

21089.descriptionId:
Good news! This shield will protect you from nasty sunburn when the fiery sphere begins its final journey towards the World of Twelve, when the end of all things is nigh!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21091.descriptionId: This book appears to be magic. Very strange.

This sidekick with formidable claws and an entirely metal structure can survive in the most extreme conditions and fears no real threat. Well, except the idea that you might not feel any affection for it...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21605.descriptionId:
If you bring this figurine to Fredo Krevin at the Trool Fair, you'll add it to your Krosllection.
You can also trade in your duplicate figurines at the fair.

21607.descriptionId:
This shield combines the solidity of Albueran rock and the fragility of flowers. It reflects your personality well – a tender heart under a tough-as-nails appearance.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21609.descriptionId:
"Vile intruder... You're still alive, it seems.
My dear, did you grant this miserable insect the honour of a victory?
No matter. Those blessed by the grace of the Twelve shall all meet death, in the embrace of Dark Vlad's flame!"

21611.descriptionId:
Before you put on this blood-and-sulphur-soaked tabard, make sure you really want to, because a fragment of the Incandescent One's soul may still reside within it.
 
Now there's a relationship that will send sparks flying!

21613.descriptionId: When you meet Dark Vlad somewhere along your way, it's best to run for your life and pray he doesn't catch you, or you'll end up like a grilled sausage.

21615.descriptionId: Inside this wedding ring, you can make out an inscription engraved by a metal tip and the fire of passion: Hell Mina + Dark Vlad = <3.

21617.descriptionId: You may not have realised it, but the Ponym shield is named after the equally renowned e-ponym-ous Ponym shield.

21619.descriptionId:
Under bleak skies as embers rise
The beetle's steeled shell lies sealed
In shadowy realms where whispers dwell

21621.descriptionId:
"Ruling means making it so your subjects cannot harm you... or even think about it."

— Danathor, Steward of Bonta

21623.descriptionId: Scaly scales are as hard as Iops' heads. This shield is covered in them, making it a must-have accessory for adventurers everywhere who like to jump carelessly into the fray.

21625.descriptionId:
This shield was originally a plaything for sailors, who would toss it about when they were bored at sea.
You can still use it to protect yourself from a few blows, though – especially if they don't hit you.

21627.descriptionId: Revenge is a dish best served cold, as Hell Mina knows full well. That's why she brings her Porribane along to every battle.

21629.descriptionId:
If you were hoping this shield would "unlock your inner alpha", you're definitely on the wrong track.
On the contrary, it reminds you of how primitive those who believe in the concept are.
But you're nothing like that, right?

21667.descriptionId: This big piece of cake gives off a variety of sweet aromas. As you admire its beautiful frosting, be careful not to drool everywhere. It's been 9 years... And you were there!

21669.descriptionId:
Surprised to see a lab rat in charge? Sometimes, Ratatony clambers up on to his pet human's head to take control by pulling on his eyelashes to concoct potions... Hey, we all shine where we can. Don't judge.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21671.descriptionId:
The paradoxical thing about this pet is that it's creation was inspired by the future. But when the model is only invented years after the copy that was used to create the original, who can say which one is authentic? And that sums up Paradoxine in a nutshell.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21673.descriptionId:
This young dragon may look cute now, but wait until you see its adult form.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21675.descriptionId:
If you're a little bit mad but are still able to keep a cool head, this helmet is for you.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21677.descriptionId:
With this draconic helmet, your enemies will look death in the eye while you see the world through rose-coloured glasses.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21679.descriptionId:
As the proud owner of a chtigredon with the warmest, silkiest fur he'd ever seen, Harebourg quickly realised that his pet was shedding a ridiculous amount of hair. He pragmatically decided to make it into capes for the harsh Frigostian winter.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21681.descriptionId:
This dragonskin cape will protect you from blasts of flame, but not from your own bad karma.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21683.descriptionId:
They say that the Sinistro frozen in this shield stopped working, thus stopping the passage of time along with it. As if stopping this metronome from ticking would have the power to freeze time. A heresy that most any Xelor will advise you to reject.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21685.descriptionId:
This little dragon still attached to its egg is a perfect defence against anyone who gets too close.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21687.descriptionId:
This petsmount is the offspring of a sabredon and a chtigress that Harebourg took in. It's kept its father's great resistance to the cold and his beastly nature, while preserving its mother's agility. Domesticated now, it's become a faithful and devoted steed.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21689.descriptionId:
Though once very small and not particularly ferocious, this terrifying adult black dragon is now an ideal steed to sow terror and chaos wherever you go.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21691.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Harebourg emote.

21693.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Grougalorasalar emote.

21699.descriptionId:
How can you resist this sweet creature's gaze? Enjoy its company while you still can. The day will come when no one can resist it. Absolutely no one.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21897.descriptionId:
Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21899.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Producer WAKFU S5".

21901.descriptionId: This gem seems to contain the power of a spell.

21903.descriptionId: If you shake this gift vigorously and hold it to your ear, you'll hear a strange noise as if it contained a real live creature. Don't wait a moment longer, open it now!

21905.descriptionId: [!] Le joueur a récupéré le cadeau de la salle de Dalles du Teasing Dédale

21907.descriptionId:
This tentacled hat looks like something straight out of a nightmare. Can you imagine? It could suck out your soul, eat your face or even slurp out your brain. Ha ha! How wild is that?! Well... Anyway, it's cool, right?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21909.descriptionId:
This shield doesn't just repel tenacious enemies; it also repels your worst nightmares, including that one where you've gone to school without any pants on.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21911.descriptionId:
Before you put this cape on, make sure you get inoculated for... well, just about everything really.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21913.descriptionId:
This petsmount will take you wherever you want. Well, it tends to prefer dark, damp and dirty places that smell of putrefaction, but who doesn't? You don't? Oh well.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21915.descriptionId:
With its many bulging eyes and annoying habit of appearing out of nowhere without warning, this pet will quickly become your enemies' worst nightmare. Well, it might become yours as well, but you'll just have to deal with it.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21917.descriptionId:
Ninja apprentices are encouraged to wear the most eye-catching clothes possible. Brightly-coloured suits, headbands, loads of accessories, and definitely a hairstyle that can be seen from miles away! And all this is designed to teach them how to be discreet, even when they attract so much attention.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21919.descriptionId:
Sinister individuals often wear this two-bit kimono when they climb out of the shadows to ask innocent victims if they can spare a few kamas. Or "lend" them "two bits", as they prefer to say. Seriously, though, who has any kamas – or bits – to spare these days? Honestly...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21921.descriptionId:
Made out of a gigantic piece of metal, this throwing star is known for its balance and aerodynamic properties. Such crucial qualities in a throwing star... It's a shame it's too heavy to throw! Luckily, the smith's miscalculation means it makes a good shield instead.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21923.descriptionId:
This crobak is the perfect partner for nighttime infiltration and silent assassinations. It carries a massive shuriken, which you can use as a spare weapon. That is, if you can convince the crobak to let go of it. Be warned: it's stubborn.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21925.descriptionId:
After centuries meditating under a hidden waterfall far from civilization in the mountains, and after memorising thousands of scrolls containing secret and sometimes forbidden techniques, this toad is now ready to be your petsmount. What a prestigious position!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21927.descriptionId:
If it unfurls its corolla while quivering and spitting small jets of acidic liquid from its gaping mouth, it's probably because it likes you. Or it wants to devour you. Either way, it's rather flattering!	

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

21951.descriptionId:
The blue light emitted by the torch he carries everywhere helps him to retrace his steps and never get lost in labyrinths.
Unfortunately, it doesn't work in fields and won't help you find where you parked your cart.

22539.descriptionId:
This shield was created as a tribute to Aerafal, the Air Dragon. It stirs a hunger for adventure you thought you'd lost with the last of your hair.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22541.descriptionId:
This shield was created as a tribute to Aguabrial, the Water Dragon. Carrying it makes you feel like nothing will happen to you, and yet anything could happen.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22543.descriptionId:
This shield gives off an intense heat, which you choose to attribute to Hell Mina's fiery passion for Vlad instead of to the fact that you sat on it for such a long journey.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22545.descriptionId:
When your sixth sense tells you that luck won't be on your side today, don't think about it: just put on this ultra-strong helmet, which will, at the very least, prevent your head from getting bashed in.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22547.descriptionId:
This cape, decorated with sharp, menacing swords pointed right at your back, may make you a tad nervous. When you think about it, though, that is sort of how you live every day, because the gods, unbeknownst to you, decide your fate from the shadows... Oh! Is that the first time you've really thought about it?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22549.descriptionId:
This wieldy shield will allow you to parry unexpected blows with great ease. Too bad it can't stop what will happen to you in 6 weeks and 2 days, at 11:58 p.m. What? Oh, don't worry, it's just a suspicion...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22551.descriptionId:
Sure, this puppy can bark three times as loud and will cost three times as much in food as a regular dog. But then, it can defend you from enemies no matter which direction they come from!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22553.descriptionId:
With its three eyes, this bow meow is supposed to be able to see the future. Your own, to be precise! To get it to tell you anything, though, you'll have to give it lots of attention and tasty treats, and reserve a special spot for it on your bed. So, basically, it's a bow meow like any other...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22785.descriptionId: Oli Venders carved this little creature out of wood as a present for his granddaughter. When he saw how her eyes lit up when she saw it, he realized the little critter had even more potential than he thought. Unable to stem the tide of artistic inspiration, he carved a ton more. What makes it truly special, though, is... that it's carved out of wood AND soft and cuddly!

22797.descriptionId:

22817.descriptionId:
This shield is more than just protection: it's also a symbol. The symbol of balance, passing time, stability, and a future waiting in the wings. Kind of a big deal, right?!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22819.descriptionId:
Don't worry. Someone's watching your six.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22821.descriptionId:
One thing's for sure – you've got a good head on your shoulders. But what in the world do you have on your head?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22823.descriptionId:
If you're wearing this cape, you most likely got mistook an Itzting for a fir tree. What's surprising is that it let you take its branches to wear. Perhaps its natural aggressiveness is just a front, and all it really wants is someone to spend the holidays with...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22825.descriptionId:
They say that a strange artefact was found several dozen years ago near Mount Neselite. A cube covered in grooves appearing to form a labyrinth on its surface... Mostly, though, it was organic. It moved. Terrified when they saw the surface of the item moving, the adventurers who had found it dropped it and ran off. This cape is said to bear a strange resemblance to that cube...
Ahem, well. It's all just rumours.


(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22837.descriptionId: This gem seems to contain the power of a spell.

22839.descriptionId: This gem seems to contain the power of a spell.

22845.descriptionId:
"The Aube Pâle shall burst forth in a flash of pure light and drive the demons from our lands. Pray and keep the faith, my brother." — Gideon, an educated farmer

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22847.descriptionId:
It's said that this tiara belonged to a mage who became famous for practising the occult arts. After much criticism from the villagers, he is said to have set off on an adventure, taking the entire local cemetery with him.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22849.descriptionId:
The Aube Pâle are trained to operate on the battlefield, providing both ointments and beatings. The shroud they wear lets them deal with both scenarios.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22851.descriptionId:
This rather simple-looking piece of fabric seems to draw the surrounding light to it, plunging its wearer into darkness.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22853.descriptionId:
The colours of this cape are reminiscent of the rising sun, its soft light chasing away the terrifying shadows of the night.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22855.descriptionId:
It's said that this cape is made from the countless will-o'-the-wisps captured by Mage Anta during his dreary travels.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Celestial Punishment ornament.

22859.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Aube Pâle Standard emote.

22861.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Mage Anta Standard emote.

22863.descriptionId: This item shows that you completed a challenge in the Vigilante Ring. You need three of them with the same character to complete a mission in Crimson Dofus season.

22865.descriptionId:
Blast 'em Open with Optimised Magic!
Use this item to reveal and activate all portals in the room.

22867.descriptionId:
Blast 'em Open with Optimised Magic!
Use this item to reveal and activate the portal where it is used.

22871.descriptionId:
Suitably crowned, your mind is sharper and your perception more alert. And you clearly look more threatening in this than in your Royal Gobball headgear!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22873.descriptionId:
Unlike ordinary folk, the greatest legends in the world always give off a special air. Even from behind!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22875.descriptionId:
Your loyalty is equalled only by your bravery and rectitude. This shield seems imbued with these wonderful qualities. A disaster for your opponents!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22877.descriptionId:
This swift little hybrid animal symbolizes wisdom, and its eyes are full of exceptional determination. It's sure to disconcert even the most unflappable enemy... and send the more cowardly ones running.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22879.descriptionId:
When you set these glasses on your nose, it's like seeing life through a filter. You'll start pouting like the famous Bella Porch and you'll feel a sudden urge to dance to intoxicating sounds. If you look around you, everyone else seems to be caught up in the same mania. Don't wear them for too long or you may become disconnected from reality.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22997.descriptionId:
Fate won't take you for a fool with this fool's cap. Because the world will seem sunnier with it on. Or maybe... you'll just look funnier.

(Equip this headgear in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

22999.descriptionId:
Why the serious face? Are you trying to figure this cape out? It is... like life – fluctuating, agitated, sometimes calm, sometimes wild. In short: unpredictable.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23001.descriptionId:
Brandish your shield with the utmost irreverence and take a stand against waves of sad, hateful comments. A lovely raspberry that will turn tragedy into comedy and send those haters' own spittle back their way!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23003.descriptionId:
This little sea dragon is a lot like coral: the prettier and more colourful it is, the more you should stay away! But... if you really want to try your luck, who are we to stand in your way?

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

Try not to drown your sorrows near this tofu, or else it'll be drowning you in its tears as well.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23061.descriptionId:
From afar, it could be mistaken for a sinistro.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23093.descriptionId:
A warrior's helmet can serve as a symbol of their quest, and yours has a valiant and angelic appearance that makes a powerful first impression. Try not to disappoint everyone too much when you take it off.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23095.descriptionId:
You'll need to present quite a noble profile to prove yourself worthy of this set – and this cape will definitely help.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23097.descriptionId:
This shield is infallible, in reflection of your virtuous soul. Although it does have an annoying tendency to shed feathers everywhere.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23099.descriptionId:
As light as a cloud and as powerful as lightning, Cumulofractus strikes hard both on the ground and in the sky! Plus, he adds a little extra touch of charisma.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23101.descriptionId:
Even when no one else will come to save you, Lalafangel will.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23103.descriptionId:
Your cheeky friends might ask what kind of look you're trying to go for. Dungeon bosses will probably think you look like trouble. But the truth is that with this brilliant sparkling crown, you simply look like an angel.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23105.descriptionId:
As you soar swiftly above the clouds astride your spirited petsmount, even the gods may be fooled for a moment and think you're flying straight out of Ingloriom.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23107.descriptionId:
Under the protective wing of a shield this impressive, absolutely no one can bring you down.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23109.descriptionId:
"Storm's rolling in..." Those will be your opponents' last words before you swoop in to take them down with your lively Cumulis.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23111.descriptionId:
This divine pet will cut the conversation short if he senses the other person getting the slightest bit prickly. Keep that in mind if you're talking with a friend who likes to tease you, or he might cut them down to size in a hurry!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23113.descriptionId:
Forged in fires of unimaginable heat, the dome of this helmet burns hot and cauterises the wounds it inflicts on your enemies before sending them to Externam. Made by pros for pros.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23115.descriptionId:
No one can sneak up on you when you're wearing this cape – it ignites everything it touches! ... Hopefully you're not too attached to your rugs and curtains!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23117.descriptionId:
With this shield, which is the product of lava spewed forth from the bowels of a volcano, you can blaze a trail in your future battles. Just warn your enemies: if you play with fire, you get burned.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23119.descriptionId:
This chubby little dragon has fire in its belly. Which might explain the chubbiness.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23121.descriptionId:
These imposing spikes warn your opponents of the danger you represent. And if that isn't enough, the sharp projections should encourage them to back away...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23123.descriptionId:
If you don't mind my asking... are you controlling that thing? I mean... err... a bit like a tail? Because if not, well... it's moving on its own behind you! As if it's autonomous... and, err... digesting something...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23125.descriptionId:
This shield alone is scary enough – there's no way to tell if it's a piece of a monstrous jawbone, a spiky carapace, or a spiky scale from a titan... Actually, never mind... it's better not to know!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23127.descriptionId:
It takes a lot of guts to train an animal like that! This chimera has survived the driest deserts, the deadliest jungles, and even volcanic depths before joining you. What could possibly harm it?

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

This little dragoone loves gobballs and refuses to devour them. To be able to live among them without frightening them, it had the bright idea of wearing gobball headgear, and it worked!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23369.descriptionId:
This charming little hairball has a tendency to copy its master's appearance. It mimics them so well that it even copies their questionable colour choices.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23371.descriptionId:
With this headgear, you can remember your youthful exploits. It also helps hide the fact that the days of such exploits are long gone, just like your hair.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23375.descriptionId:
Floral crowns may be traditional, but you probably should have thought twice before weaving this one! You mistakenly included a red spider lily, which will take root in your skull and plant its poisonous ideas straight into your mind...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23377.descriptionId:
Some plants produce beautiful flowers, but this one is merely an amalgamation of brambles, thorns and poison. Its appearance just screams, "I'm dangerous, so leave me well alone!" Wear it like a cloak, and perhaps everyone around you will finally get the message.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23379.descriptionId:
This shield doesn't have a handle. The only way it'll stay on your arm is by letting its thorns dig into your skin until they draw blood. It can be a bit unnerving at first if you're not a Sacrier...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23381.descriptionId:
Don't expect much affection from this pet. It's the kind that will happily eat your food without ever letting you stroke it. But since you both have a broken heart, is it too much to hope that you two will get along?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23383.descriptionId:
Forget fur – this petsmount is covered with poisonous thorns from nose to tail! We therefore recommend using a saddle to ride it, or else you're in for a really unpleasant experience.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23385.descriptionId: Ereziah has sent your soul to Clematys.

23387.descriptionId: To put your talents as a warrior to good use despite the situation, Clematys has agreed to let you fight at her side.

23731.descriptionId:
A single piece of wood crafted from the crown of a thousand-year-old tree, this unique headgear, solid and sharp as stone, is passed down from Terrakourial to adventurers who revere him.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23733.descriptionId:
This cape can withstand the ravages of time along with any traitorous blows – especially if those traitorous blows involve carving a heart around a pair of initials.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23735.descriptionId:
This shield disorients your aggressors: they'll think they're hitting it straight on, but they're actually so far away... As far as an earthworm from the treetop! And when it finally comes down on them, it'll be like an earthquake.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23737.descriptionId:
Among the trees and muddy earth, this wyrmling feels like a fish in water. Who knew muck could be so cosy?

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23739.descriptionId:
With this unique technological marvel, you can mull things over at blazingly fast speeds and adapt to any situation like a khamelerost. Even if your dragoturkey breaks down in the middle of a quest.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23741.descriptionId:
Having a power source like this on your back really gives you a boost. And that's just as well, because you're late... again. But late for what? Oh yes, your dragoturkey broke down... again. Hey, er, wait a second... You left without it.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23743.descriptionId:
With safety technology like this to watch over you, you can go adventuring with total confidence. Now you can feel 100% safe! Haha! Err... You did remember to charge it, right?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23745.descriptionId:
The khamelerost isn't known for its speed... or for having wings for that matter! However, with these wings, you'll rip through the air like never before! It seems this set has inherited the creature's ability to adapt to any situation.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23747.descriptionId:
Thanks to modern technology, this karmeleon has overcome all its natural failings, notably its lack of intelligence. However, it can no longer tolerate other people's idiocy and will go as far as eliminating them if necessary. So whatever you do, try not to screw up!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23749.descriptionId:
This headgear seems completely lifeless on its own... as you would expect, because it's just an inanimate object! However, once you put it on your skull, it seems to come to life. It's as if your mind melds with it... and it feels like a soulmate... You could say you're in your element!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23751.descriptionId:
Don't be fooled into thinking this cape will weigh a ton on your back! It's as light as a porous stone, yet as solid as a dense one. And the combination of shapes and colours also tends to make the more cowardly ones think twice before attacking. Let them come and break their blades on it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23753.descriptionId:
When you realize you can't even make a dent in this shield with your sword, at least you can claim that it's the strategy that's weak rather than yourself!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23755.descriptionId:
This little guy is living proof that size isn't everything (although he's more than capable of cutting anyone down to size). He'll quickly show you that it's all about ensuring your foundations are as solid as a rock!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23757.descriptionId:
This petsmount species was already roaming the lands of this planet in the Primitive Era. It has survived for millennia, so that should give you an idea of how good its armoured plating is.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23759.descriptionId:
Even though the top part of a mushroom is called the cap, it doesn't mean you should make a hat out of it. But you did it anyway. And that technically makes you a mushroom stalk. Watch out for spores in your eyes!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23761.descriptionId:
The way you let your cape drag on the floor in dark and damp places for weeks on end, it was bound to get all types of fungus growing on it eventually. At least these ones look pretty and only smell slightly of mildew.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23763.descriptionId:
Fungi that grow on dead tree stumps are often as hard as wood, so they make an excellent material for crafting shields. If only you could find a fungus that grows on steel...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23765.descriptionId:
The hybrid descendant of a prehistoric animal and an invasive species of mushroom, this creature has agreed to be your mount because your adventuring gives it the opportunity to spread its sporeggs everywhere you go.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23767.descriptionId:
Even today, experts are still divided on the nature of the fungal growth on the top of this pet. Does it grow on its skull, or did it find it somewhere and now wears it like an accessory?

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23769.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Bisoulmuth ornament.

23771.descriptionId: This animal has decided to follow you. Oshimo can probably help you to learn more about it.

23775.descriptionId: You found this blood-filled flask in the relaxation area. You have no idea why it was there, but you decided to keep it.

23777.descriptionId:
A creature with a very keen sense of smell has consumed the blood in your flask. It is following you from afar, in the darkness...

Maybe if you extract from the Labyrinth, it will follow you?

23781.descriptionId:
Originally named Nigel Snapper, the warrior better known as Guyomu Makatasa Oniwa was once the leader of a ferocious band of highway robbers. Hungry for greater glory, he placed his group in the service of Shogun Tofugawa, who promised him countless battles and entrusted him with guarding his castle. To go with his changed role, he also changed his name to something more Pandalan – and more intimidating, since he'd always had a bit of a complex about that.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23783.descriptionId:
Born and raised among the renowned builders of the Mamija Clan, Chun-Leia began learning martial arts at the age of five. Building on her father's famous kick-heavy style, the young Pandalan developed her own style inspired by the various schools of Pandawushu. At just 18 years old, she joined an elite group serving the Daimya to push back against the secret organisation known as the Chtiger's Fist, whom she believes to be responsible for her father's death.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23785.descriptionId:
"MY NAME... IS GUYOMU MAKATASA ONIWAAAA!!! AS I BREATHE, YOU WILL NOT PASS THE CASTLE GATE!"
— Guyomu Oniwa's last words.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23787.descriptionId:
As the centrepiece of any Pandalan woman's wardrobe, the qipao embodies the elegance and versatility of Pandalan femininity. This long, flowing qipao is a traditional version, whereas more recent models have tended towards a shorter, closer-fitting style.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23789.descriptionId:
Astride his powerful steed and wielding his famed yari – a very long traditional Pandalan lance – Guyomu Oniwa actually never used his shield all that much. Instead, he preferred to simply mow down his enemies by charging across the battlefield at breakneck speed. He was given this yari by Shogun Tofugawa himself, after his previous lance was broken. It's said that this weapon once belonged to one of the shogun's long-defeated rivals.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23791.descriptionId:
In Chun-Leia's hands, this shield – a gift from her late father – is as likely to be used as an offensive weapon as for defence. It's equally effective in both roles.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23793.descriptionId:
This little boowolf would follow Guyomu Oniwa everywhere, and he eventually got used to having it around. He was always there to witness his master's many feats of prowess, and to keep him company outside of battle. In a cruel twist of fate, the mysterious shinobi who ended up killing Guyomu in a vicious duel was known as "the one-armed boowolf"...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23795.descriptionId:
Whilst fleeing Chtiger's Fist cultists in Pandala Forest, Chun-Leia crossed paths with a strange minifoux known as Wikett. Though quite fearful and skittish at first, Wikett was quickly won over by the fighter's kindness after she offered him some of her food. Just when the cult assassins were about to catch Chun-Leia, Wikett distracted them, allowing the young Pandalan to regain the upper hand. Ever since, the two have been inseparable.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23797.descriptionId: You found some equipment belonging to an adventurer who disappeared. After a good clean, it could still be useful.
