23801.descriptionId: You found some equipment belonging to an adventurer who disappeared. After a good clean, it could still be useful.

23803.descriptionId: You found the travel companion of an adventurer who disappeared. Maybe after some time you would make a good team?

23805.descriptionId: You found some equipment belonging to an adventurer who disappeared. After a good clean, it could still be useful.

23807.descriptionId: You found some equipment belonging to an adventurer who disappeared. After a good clean, it could still be useful.

23809.descriptionId: You found some equipment belonging to an adventurer who disappeared. After a good clean, it could still be useful.

23811.descriptionId: You found the travel companion of an adventurer who disappeared. Maybe after some time you would make a good team?

23813.descriptionId:
Although it's turning 10, you don't need to worry about this egg. There won't be any sullen moods, questionable clothing or sudden outbreaks of pimples. It always be true to itself, with that never-ending desire to bring you joy and truly unforgettable memories. And that's something to celebrate!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23817.descriptionId:
Known for both its wisdom and soft feathers, this pint-sized pet will be right by your side for your greatest adventures and your toughest crossword puzzles.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23819.descriptionId:
The back of this shield is prominently marked with the phrase "Ages 10 years and up." Just under it in smaller print is a warning: "Induce vomiting immediately if swallowed."

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23821.descriptionId: [!] Peu importe le nombre de fois que vous croquez dedans, il semble toujours aussi grand.

23823.descriptionId:
This headgear offers a major upgrade to your adventures by shedding light on every level and helping you to see things more clearly. Your decisions will be wiser. Your view of the world will be more circumspect. You'll be the first to benefit from your newfound brilliance!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23825.descriptionId:
The misty aura of this cape seems to transform you into an all-powerful being, escaped from limbo and returning with all of the mysterious knowledge of the Krosmoz... Or maybe you're just stepping out of a walk-in freezer. Without even shivering. And hey, that's kind of impressive in its own right.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23827.descriptionId:
You're not normally the type to think the moon is made of green cheese, but you firmly believe that this gleaming shield can help you to take that moon down from the sky. Become a leading light in your guild, and illuminate your teammates' inner lanterns as well!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23829.descriptionId:
This little dragon will become your beacon in the darkest night, your light at the end of the tunnel! A precious guide overflowing with wisdom... although you shouldn't follow him too blindly, either. The thing is, Dardikil is a bit of a prankster who takes absolutely nothing seriously...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23833.descriptionId:
The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it. And this one is worth 10!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23835.descriptionId:
Don't be surprised if your hair gets stuck after wearing this hat... It's worth it, though, for letting you sparkle like the Emerald Dofus!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23837.descriptionId:
The famous (?) Chef Mikui crafted the fabulous gummy Dofus on this shield. Just don't move around too much, or you'll destroy that lovely tiered cake!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23839.descriptionId:
You've spent 10 years dreaming you would strut about with the Emerald Dofus on your back. Sure, this one is made of gelatine. But still...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23841.descriptionId: A priceless gift from Dardondakal, this shield reveals your infinite value. Hopefully it's infinite wisdom, not folly.

23843.descriptionId:
This little shushu isn't demonic by virtue of being a shushu. It's because it has the temperament of a child...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23845.descriptionId:
Bring in the livestock – black magic isn't behind their disappearance, or those blood-stained paintings stretching to the horizon. The Shushacabra isn't just a legend! The proof: it's on your back!

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23847.descriptionId:
The membranes of the Jellon's wings are made of gelatine. This gelatine regenerates whenever the Jellon eats. Even so, it is unable to fly and can only glide; if it bats its wings too much, the gelatine will disintegrate.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23849.descriptionId:
When gelatine touches a Dofus shell, it comes to life.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23853.descriptionId: Gerbeans typically love gnawing on treechnid trunks, but they seem to have discovered a new passion for mangrove trees in the Source.

23855.descriptionId: The Boarhog is the common boar's sturdier, friendlier cousin. As long as you let it lounge and eat a piece of cake once in a while, it'll be more than happy to carry all the stuff that won't fit in your already-bulging pockets for you.

23857.descriptionId: This voucher certifies your success against a dungeon keeper for novice adventurers.

23859.descriptionId: This voucher certifies your success against a dungeon keeper for advanced adventurers.

23861.descriptionId: This voucher certifies your success against a dungeon keeper for expert adventurers.

23863.descriptionId: This voucher certifies your success against a dungeon keeper for master adventurers.

23865.descriptionId: This piece of cake looks utterly sublime. It should make Nyom very happy if you offer it to him.

23867.nameId: Certificate of Acquisition: Delicious Piece of Cake
23867.descriptionId: This certificate shows that you collected your piece of cake today.

23869.descriptionId: This potion teleports you to the Source to take part in the anniversary festivities.

23871.descriptionId: This brooch seems to be the template for the famous amulet crafted by Boulgur, blacksmith to the gods.

23873.descriptionId: This belt is delightfully light, but very fragile, so keep it well away from water. If you get it wet, it won't hide anything at all. And no one wants to see that!

23875.descriptionId: Everyone knows this legendary cloak. But did you know there's a khardboard version that you can even paint blue?

23877.descriptionId: The Khardboard Goultard sword has been soaked in the blood of piglets, so it's a bit soft and smells a bit like black pudding.

23879.descriptionId: These khardboard getas were crafted by the best khardboard makers in the World of Twelve. Be careful not to step in any puddles with them on. Getting them wet voids the warranty.

23881.descriptionId: This shield symbolises renewal. Made entirely of recycled khardboard, it can be remade every time it's destroyed.

23883.descriptionId: What's more iconic than this headgear? Absolutely nothing. Except maybe the version not made of khardboard.

23885.descriptionId: Everyone knows certain items. And the Gelano is the best known of them all. Often imitated, but never equalled, it is an unattainable goal for many. You've managed to get your hands on a pale imitation – and it should do for now.

23887.descriptionId: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

23889.descriptionId:
Isn't it cute?

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23891.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Festive ornament.

23893.descriptionId: This shigekax has no effect, except warming your heart with its sweetness.

23895.descriptionId:
If you're hunted down like prey, this is exactly where you want your predator.  In your most primal aspect, you're free to show your truly savage nature.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23897.descriptionId:
It carries the scars of all your failures, but also your most painful victories... This cape exposes you to your opponents to better scare them when the killing blow strikes!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23899.descriptionId:
It's withstood thousands of hits. Those in your battles, and those in your life as well. But instead of showing its shortcomings, this shield has toughened up.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23901.descriptionId:
Some mounts are so intimidating that they can turn a battle around, like turning over the hides of certain animals to reveal the leather. Putrid is one of those! The smell of its own blood puts it in a tizzy.
(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23903.descriptionId:
A priceless gift from Dardondakal, this shield reveals your infinite value. Hopefully it's infinite wisdom, not folly.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23905.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Colour Wiz".

23907.descriptionId: This certificate shows the date of your last fight against this dopple.

23909.descriptionId:
Always seeking out new spaces to express its art, this sidekick will happily accompany you as you discover unfamiliar landscapes.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23911.descriptionId:
The events organised by Zi have become so popular that he gains new supporters each time. So, he decided to create this cloak so that each generous backer could wear his colours and raise the visibility of his project. You should wear this cloak with pride, because it proves your generosity to other adventurers in the World of Twelve.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23913.descriptionId:
The distant sound of a megaphone snaps you out of your daze. Only a moment had gone by, but it seemed to last 10 long years. You feel overcome by sweet melancholy and an almost-euphoric trance – the kind you feel when something important comes to an end. It's as if everything you'd put in was returned to you a hundredfold. So that's the power of Zi, then...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23915.descriptionId:
It may look innocent, but this little bird is wanted for insulting an officer of the law.
Cherish it, but don't be fooled.

23917.descriptionId: With a tongue that's so powerful it can cause sparks when hit against a rock, this pet has an unconditional love of fire. Perhaps too much so...

23923.descriptionId:
This little pet delights in sparking trouble. It will initiate many of your fights with the enemy, as well as domestic squabbles or internal disputes in your guild. For every outburst, you need only see the spark of joy in its eyes for you to instantly forgive it for its explosiveness.
(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23925.descriptionId:
Another crime committed by the enigmatic C! He made this poor gobball completely mad. To make it go forward, you'll have to tell it to back up. For it to go faster, you'll tell it to slow down. It's a bit disturbing at first, but you'll see – once you've lost your mind as well, it will all seem normal in the end.
(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23927.descriptionId:
Some hastily painted graffiti was enough to turn this cape into a manifesto of chaos. Don't be surprised if people start questioning your sanity when your back is turned...
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23929.descriptionId:
After being tagged by the enigmatic party-pooper C, this shield has become untenable. It sticks its tongue out, sniggering and punctuating fights with explosive noises. Its enemies lose their composure... and its bearer their patience!
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23931.descriptionId:
The second that enigmatic C painted his wacky graffiti, this headgear was infused with uncontrollable madness. Ever since, it's had the annoying habit of laughing hysterically every 30 seconds. On top of driving you crazy, it'll probably make you lose your hearing.
(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23935.descriptionId:
If a single sip of this armoured potion of magical energy doesn't make your days last 25 hours (at least), you must be drowsier than a Sadida...

Once consumed, this potion will automatically restore your HP to 100% after every fight. No more looking for consumables in the marketplace!

23937.descriptionId:
Ah, the fiery passion of youth, when your head is full of wild ideas and projects, and your bag is full of hopes and dreams! 
There's no doubt about it: you dare to assert yourself, freely expressing your tastes and your desire to change the world.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

23939.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to acquire.)
Use this scroll to obtain the Mischievous ornament.

23941.descriptionId: Use this scroll to learn the Festive Aura emote.

23943.descriptionId:
This letter written by Kerub invites you to come to his home.
A password is scribbled on the back of the missive.

23945.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

23947.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

23949.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

23951.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

You've received a new password from Kerub.

You've received a new password from Kerub.

You've received a new password from Kerub.

23959.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.

23961.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

23963.descriptionId:
You've received a new password from Kerub.
He must have something to tell you.

23965.descriptionId: The big day has arrived. Get all dressed up and head to Kerub's with the final password.

23967.descriptionId: This flower was once demonic, but it is now one of the centrepieces of a magnificent bouquet-to-be.

23969.descriptionId: The petals of this rose are so dark that its shadow seems to twinkle in comparison. It is now one of the centrepieces of a magnificent bouquet-to-be.

23971.descriptionId:
With this superb bouquet, the love for its recipient is clear as day.
Each petal is like a thought for the beloved.

23973.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Bridesmaid".

23975.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 10.

23977.descriptionId: A gleaming piece that is clearly of draconic origin.

23979.descriptionId:
Even unrefined, this stone is still magnificent, reminiscent of the ocean blue.
Ah... if only you could go on holiday.

23981.descriptionId: A magnificent medallion lent by Fallanster for this occasion. Be careful not to drop it.

23983.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 20.

23985.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 30.

23987.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 40.

23989.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 50.

23991.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 60.

23993.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 70.

23995.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 80.

23997.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 90.

23999.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 100.

24001.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 110.

24003.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 120.

24005.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 130.

24007.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 140.

24009.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 150.

24011.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 160.

24013.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 170.

24015.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 180.

24017.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 190.

24019.descriptionId: Use this potion to instantly reach level 200.

24023.descriptionId: A ravishing brooch that was just crafted.

24025.descriptionId: From high-quality mother-of-pearl collected on the beach.

24027.descriptionId: You took this claw from the Batofu after a fierce fight.

24029.descriptionId:
Father Whupper smells as funky as a pair of old socks, and with this shield, you'll be able to get your groove on too.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24031.descriptionId:
The Bellaphones didn't want to leaf you out, so they gave you this foliage.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24053.descriptionId:
A strange chocolate egg; you have no idea who left it here.
Perhaps it contains a surprise.

24055.descriptionId:
This festive cap makes you nostalgic for all the times you've spent on this world. All the memories and friendships you've built throughout your adventures are the most precious gift – but then again, an extra little gift would be nice too, wouldn't it?

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24057.descriptionId:
This spell book lets you use the spell inside it.
Warning: It will be consumed at the end of the fight, whether the spell was used or not.

24059.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "Infinity Breaker".

24061.descriptionId:
This voucher certifies your participation in the community events for the 10th anniversary.
It can be traded for Master Adventurer vouchers by talking to the Voucher Manager at [26,45].

24063.descriptionId:
This voucher certifies your combat prowess in the Kolossium.
It can be traded for Master Adventurer vouchers by talking to the Voucher Manager at [26,45].

24069.descriptionId:
A problem? A bug? A clever adventurer gave you 10% of your kamas? Don't panic! No need to contact Ankama Support because the adorable Weegle Owl will be there to guide you and dry your tears throughout your adventures in the World of Twelve. Not only that, this one's krosmic...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24071.descriptionId: This dish slightly increases XP received for 10 fights.

24073.descriptionId: This dish increases Prospecting by 25 points for 10 fights.

24075.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Agility by 50 points for 10 fights.

24077.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Strength by 50 points for 10 fights.

24079.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Intelligence by 50 points for 10 fights.

24081.nameId: Flavour of Grilled Surf and Turf
24081.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Chance by 50 points for 10 fights.

24083.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Agility by 50 points for 10 fights.

24085.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Strength by 50 points for 10 fights.

24087.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Intelligence by 50 points for 10 fights.

24089.descriptionId: This dish increases the entire team's Chance by 50 points for 10 fights.

24091.descriptionId: This dish greatly increases XP received for 10 fights.

24093.descriptionId: This dish increases Prospecting by 100 points for 10 fights.

24095.descriptionId:
Done in just 45 minutes – you might say it's a piece of cake...

(This dish slightly increases XP received for 10 fights.)

24097.descriptionId:
If you're feeling blue, simply eat this to make your troubles go away.

(This dish increases Prospecting by 25 points for 10 fights.)

24099.descriptionId:
Victory will be bittersweet with this drink.

(This dish increases the entire team's Agility by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24101.descriptionId:
There's never a bad time to get out the grill and cook up some tasty kebabs.

(This dish increases the entire team's Strength by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24103.descriptionId:
You'll have plenty of time to stew over this dish...

(This dish increases the entire team's Intelligence by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24105.descriptionId:
Whether you call it "surf and turf" or "reef and beef", it'll leave you "gratified and satisfied".

(This dish increases the entire team's Chance by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24107.descriptionId:
Here's a tip: toss in some essence of Amaknian souls to any recipe. It's a great way to add more flavour, without the extra calories.

(This dish increases the entire team's Agility by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24109.descriptionId:
Rest assured, no felines were used to make this broth. It was a close call, though – so watch out for hairballs...

(This dish increases the entire team's Strength by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24111.descriptionId:
You'll love this compote to the core.

(This dish increases the entire team's Intelligence by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24113.descriptionId:
Simple yet delicious, this soup is so good it'll make you cry.

(This dish increases the entire team's Chance by 50 points for 10 fights.)

24115.descriptionId:
Fresh out of the oven, the aroma of these madeleines is matched only by their softness.

(This dish greatly increases XP received for 10 fights.)

24117.descriptionId:
Who doesn't love cheese? Sprinkle some cheese on your cheese, with an extra side of cheese... You'll be over the moon.

(This dish increases Prospecting by 100 points for 10 fights.)

24119.descriptionId: This trinket can be used to enter Kickroach's Lair if you give it to the Rolipolipug guarding it, in the attic of Kerub's house.

24121.descriptionId:
Are those dark thoughts wafting out of your headgear...? Either way, the ebony colour suits you! It really brings out your darker side...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24123.descriptionId:
Is this cape really all that remains of the Black Dragon's final aerial fight: Azalar's broken wings? Or simply the state in which the Ebony Dofus's guardian left it after his claws had come out? In either case, it's cool.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24125.descriptionId:
Don't stare into this infernal circle for too long, because it might suck your soul right out of your body! Well, nobody's actually checked whether this curse is true, but I know a few Iops who've looked at an eclipse without protective goggles. Better to be safe than sorry.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24127.descriptionId:
Looks can be deceiving! This dark wyrmling has the temperament and appetite to match – they're destructive! Don't put your hand in front of it, and regularly count your fingers – you may be able to pet it on the head with its back turned, because that's the only place where you won't get blood drawn.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24151.nameId: Title Scroll: King of the Kitchen
24151.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "King of the Kitchen".

24153.descriptionId:
This armoured petsmount is a feisty and stylish way to find bugs safely.
(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24155.descriptionId:
Bugs won't bother you any more with this helmet.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24157.descriptionId:
This little shadow-flake decided to join you in confronting its sworn enemy, Count Harebourg, who imprisoned it in this icy form.
Careful not to upset it, though – it could fly into a rage and attack you and your snowmen.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24159.descriptionId: You collected this ring off Kickroach. It would be wonderful, if the thought of touching a cockroach weren't so repulsive to you.

24161.descriptionId:
Now the must-have accessory for the best vigilantes, this headgear will be an elegant way to show your desire to rid the World of Twelve of criminal scum. So, get to it!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24163.descriptionId:
No matter what kind of parade you're marching in, this cape proves that you can maintain order with style!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24165.descriptionId:
No matter what kind of parade you're marching in, this cape proves that you can maintain order with style!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24167.descriptionId:
A good vigilante must choose their teammate carefully. Beneath its majestic plumage, this piwi has a secret weapon: highly precise pecking that can clip the wings off the filthiest scoundrels in the World of Twelve!

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24169.descriptionId:
Cute, though unsettlingly lucid at times...

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24171.descriptionId:
Optimised for a variety of uses: nightcap, sledge, disc thrower or even a shield. Apparently, its original owner even used it to cook food... What a funny idea!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24173.descriptionId:
This hood might not make you as clever as Joris, but it will protect your head if the blows start raining down on you, no matter how stormy it gets.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24175.descriptionId:
"The first step in becoming a great hero is wearing a cape!" That's the advice Joris got from a mysterious stranger before leaving on his first adventures. So hurry up, put this cape on, and become a hero too!

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24177.descriptionId:
This robust, luxurious hair symbolises a happy and well-fed childhood.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24179.descriptionId:
Though originally designed for the winter season, this shield is apparently much more effective in hot weather. Something to do with the smell...

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24181.descriptionId: (Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24183.descriptionId:
It's the little things that really make the best wigs shine. By adding a feather of the same deep blue as your sparkling eyes, you'll exude a charm that few can hope to match.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24185.descriptionId:
The fur on this cape will warm any wearer's heart, even if they are haunted by solitude.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24187.descriptionId:
[!] WIP changer icon et skin

(Équipez cet objet sur un emplacement d'apparat pour utiliser son apparence)

24189.descriptionId:
Despite its cute appearance, this pet is secretly shameful about its true form. Perhaps by bonding with it over the course of your adventures, you'll discover what it actually looks like and help it regain confidence.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24201.nameId: Title Scroll: King of the Kitchen
24201.descriptionId:
(Double-tap to get the title.)
Use this scroll to earn the title "King of the Kitchen".

24203.descriptionId:
It seems that wearing this crown will make your hair go grey faster. Truly, power always comes at a cost.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24205.descriptionId:
This cape must never be suffered to drag on the ground. Take care to always have a few servants following you around to avoid such mishaps.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24207.descriptionId:
The shadow that flows from this shield reflects the colour of a queen's soul that has long since lost any trace of humanity.

(Equip this item in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24209.descriptionId:
This skull once belonged to a soldier, and it was brought back to life by an inconceivable power. It will follow you around without needing any upkeep.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24211.descriptionId:
This petsmount is in a worrisome state – its life force seems to have been drained. Apparently, sharing too much of its power weakened it.

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24251.descriptionId:
It may look innocent, but this little bird is wanted for insulting an officer of the law.
Cherish it, but don't be fooled.

(Equip this pet in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)

24253.descriptionId:
With a tongue that's so powerful it can cause sparks when hit against a rock, this pet has an unconditional love of fire. Perhaps too much so...

(Equip this petsmount in a ceremonial slot to use its appearance.)
